`AutoCatcher/system/scripts/game_write/catch_phone.py`:

```py
"""On-device launcher: runs the EXACT desktop catcher (catch_loop_fast.py) on the
phone by monkey-patching pg.get_session() to attach to the local loopback gadget
('Gadget' over 127.0.0.1:27047) instead of the desktop's adb-forward + pidof path.
Everything else (catch JS, re-throw, berry, dust tracking, telemetry) is unchanged.
Run with: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$HOME/applibs:$PREFIX/lib python3.13 catch_phone.py
"""
import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)

import frida  # noqa: E402
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

_dm = frida.get_device_manager()


def _dev():
    try:
        return _dm.add_remote_device(pg.FRIDA_REMOTE)
    except Exception:
        for d in _dm.enumerate_devices():
            nm = getattr(d, "name", "") or ""
            if pg.FRIDA_REMOTE in nm or getattr(d, "id", "") == "socket@" + pg.FRIDA_REMOTE:
                return d
        raise


def phone_get_session(retries=3):
    """Attach to the local gadget. Returns (frida.Session, pid) like the original."""
    last = None
    for _ in range(max(1, retries)):
        try:
            dev = _dev()
            sess = dev.attach("Gadget")
            pid = 0
            try:
                for p in dev.enumerate_processes():
                    if p.name == "Gadget":
                        pid = p.pid
                        break
            except Exception:
                pass
            return sess, pid
        except Exception as e:
            last = e
    raise last or RuntimeError("phone attach failed")


pg.get_session = phone_get_session

# Hand off to the real catcher (its module-level main() runs on import).
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import catch_loop_fast  # noqa: E402,F401

```

`AutoCatcher/system/scripts/game_write/reward_catcher.py`:

```py
"""REWARD CATCHER (v2): clear stacked Field-Research ('Today') reward encounters one-by-one. Replicates the
exact traced flow on the main-thread pump (CameraFollowingGround.LateUpdate):
  GetDanglingEncounterOfType(type,"") -> OpenQuestEncounter(proto) -> [wait network open] ->
  QuestMapPokemon.TryCapture(Excellent curveball Poke) -> settle -> next, until no type returns a dangling.

v2 changes (2026-06-08):
  * FAST blocked-throw recovery: STUCK 480->150 frames (~8s -> ~2.5s) + a single NUDGE re-open mid-wait,
    so a throw that doesn't register retries in ~1-2s instead of stalling ~8-11s (user complaint).
  * AUTO-RECONNECT: outer loop re-attaches after a PoGo restart / lossy-Tailscale drop (frida 'script
    destroyed'); catches bank server-side so it continues from the remaining danglings.
  * ROUND LOGGING for self-reflection: per-catch latency + stalls to reward_catch.log, and one structured
    JSON line per session (plus an operation summary) to reward_rounds.jsonl. Dust before/after is read
    in-session (IapService.get_Stardusts, max instance) to confirm stardust + any Star Piece bonus.

Usage:
  python reward_catcher.py [MAX] [--dry]
    MAX    number of catches; 0 = until dry (default 0).
    --dry  readiness check ONLY: attach, install hooks, pick singletons, read dust/box baseline, probe for
           a dangling, then detach WITHOUT catching anything. Use to confirm 'go go go' readiness.
Box count (PokemonOnlyCount) verifies catches (auto-transfer spares reward Pokemon)."""
import sys, os, time, json, shutil, subprocess
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

LOG = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "analysis", "pokemod", "reward_catch.log")
ROUNDS = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "analysis", "pokemod", "reward_rounds.jsonl")
_args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:]]
DRY = "--dry" in _args
_pos = [a for a in _args if a and not a.startswith("--")]   # the app's button passes an empty MAX ("")
MAX = int(_pos[0]) if _pos else 0      # 0 = until dry
TYPES = [4, 5, 6, 10, 13, 23]          # EncounterType values the Today view itself queries for dangling rewards
BALL = 1                               # Poke (rewards are guaranteed/no-flee; cheapest is fine)
RECONNECT_BUDGET = 8                   # how many re-attaches before giving up (drops bank progress, so generous)
SESSION_TIMEOUT = 1500                 # s, per-session safety cap

PAUSE_FILE = "/data/local/tmp/pogo_pause"   # handshake with the on-phone auto-catcher (see catch_loop_fast.py)


def _adb_su(cmd):
    """Desktop runs only. On the phone (reward_phone.py) there is no adb, and catcher_ctl.sh stops the catcher itself."""
    ser = pg._resolve_device() if shutil.which("adb") else None
    if not ser:
        return None
    try:
        return subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", ser, "shell", f"su -c '{cmd}'"], capture_output=True, text=True,
                              timeout=20).stdout.strip()
    except Exception:
        return None


def catcher_pause(seconds):
    """Ask the auto-catcher to let go of the single gadget, and wait until it has (about 1 s)."""
    if _adb_su(f"echo $(( $(date +%s) + {seconds} )) > {PAUSE_FILE}") is None:
        return
    for _ in range(20):
        if _adb_su("ss -tn | grep -c :27047") == "0":
            return
        time.sleep(0.5)


def catcher_resume():
    _adb_su(f"echo 0 > {PAUSE_FILE}")


JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
 function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a,{exceptions:'propagate'}):null;}   /* never steal ART's own faults */
 H={dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]),iGN:b("il2cpp_image_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),iGCC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class_count","uint32",["pointer"]),iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]),CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),CGNS:b("il2cpp_class_get_namespace","pointer",["pointer"]),OGC:b("il2cpp_object_get_class","pointer",["pointer"]),cMN:b("il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","int"]),rI:b("il2cpp_runtime_invoke","pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer","pointer"]),oN:b("il2cpp_object_new","pointer",["pointer"]),isVT:b("il2cpp_class_is_valuetype","int",["pointer"]),sN:b("il2cpp_string_new","pointer",["pointer"]),tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"])};
 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}
function img(name){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()===name)return im;}return null;}
function findClass(image,cls){var h=H_();var im=img(image);if(!im)return null;var cnt=h.iGCC(im);for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++){var k=h.iGC(im,i);if(k.isNull())continue;try{if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===cls)return k;}catch(e){}}return null;}
function mOf(k,nm,argc){var h=H_();if(!k)return null;var m=h.cMN(k,Memory.allocUtf8String(nm),argc);return (m&&!m.isNull())?m:null;}
function inv(m,obj,params){var h=H_();if(!m)return null;var n=params?params.length:0;var args=ptr(0);if(n){args=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize*n);for(var i=0;i<n;i++)args.add(i*Process.pointerSize).writePointer(params[i]);}var exc=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);exc.writePointer(ptr(0));var r=h.rI(m,obj,args,exc);if(!exc.readPointer().isNull())return null;return r;}

var QS=ptr(0), QSM=ptr(0), QMP=ptr(0), ACTIVE_QMP=ptr(0), PBT=null, PBT_VT=false, EMPTY=ptr(0);
var BALL=1, TYPES=[], FRAME=0, RUN=false, MAX=0, CAUGHT=0;
var ST=0, stAt=0, curProto=ptr(0), lastId="0", curId="0";
var SAMESTALL=0, SKIPTYPE={}, TYPEIDX=0, STUCKOUT=0;   // loop-breaker state (see STUCK escalation below)
var OPEN_LAG=866, SETTLE=299, STUCK=2499, NUDGE=700;   /* ms, not frames (2026-09-30): Pokemod's FirstAidKit sets the frame rate
   (90 fps), so a frame is no clock. = the old 52/18/150/42 frames at 60 fps, to the frame. STUCK 480->150 frames: ~2.5 s not ~8 s */
var STALLS=0, REOPENED=false, LOST=0, throwAt=-100000, LOSTWAIT=1499;   /* ms, 90 frames at 60 fps (was 2.5 s): 2026-09-30, 105 catches -- every clean catch took <=1.9 s from open (the throw
   to the box rise <=0.7 s), and the 17 lost throws each sat out the full wait, ~20% of the run. A box that rises = slowconf, never a 2nd throw */
var BAG=ptr(0), boxAtThrow=-1, SLOWCONF=0, slowNoted=false;              /* box (PokemonOnlyCount) = proof a throw registered */
var THROWS={}, MAXTHROWS=6, STUCKIDS={};                                   /* per-reward throw cap (a break-out needs a few, never infinite) */
rpc.exports.setBag=function(p){BAG=ptr(p);};
function readBox(){ try{ if(BAG.isNull())return -1; if(!M.box)M.box=mOf(H_().OGC(BAG),"get_PokemonOnlyCount",0); if(!M.box)return -1;
  var r=inv(M.box,BAG,[]); return r?r.add(0x10).readS32():-1; }catch(e){return -1;} }
var ERRS=[];
function nowMs(){ return Date.now(); }   /* THE clock for every wait above (reward_sim.js fakes it at 60 fps) */
var M={};  // cached methods

rpc.exports.setQs=function(p){QS=ptr(p);};
rpc.exports.setQsm=function(p){QSM=ptr(p);};
rpc.exports.setQmp=function(p){QMP=ptr(p);};
rpc.exports.setBall=function(b){BALL=b;};
rpc.exports.setTypes=function(arr){TYPES=arr;};
rpc.exports.setMax=function(m){MAX=m;};
rpc.exports.run=function(on){RUN=!!on; if(on){ST=0;CAUGHT=0;STALLS=0;}};
rpc.exports.stats=function(){return {caught:CAUGHT,state:ST,frame:FRAME,curId:curId,lastId:lastId,stalls:STALLS,lost:LOST,slowconf:SLOWCONF,samestall:SAMESTALL,stuckout:STUCKOUT,stuckIds:Object.keys(STUCKIDS),skipped:Object.keys(SKIPTYPE),errs:ERRS.slice(-6)};};
rpc.exports.qmpClass=function(){try{return H_().CGN(H_().OGC(QMP)).readCString();}catch(e){return null;}};
rpc.exports.nsOf=function(cls){var h=H_();var im=img("holo-game.dll");var cnt=h.iGCC(im);for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++){var k=h.iGC(im,i);if(k.isNull())continue;try{if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===cls)return h.CGNS(k).readCString();}catch(e){}}return null;};
rpc.exports.clsName=function(inst){try{return H_().CGN(H_().OGC(ptr(inst))).readCString();}catch(e){return null;}};
rpc.exports.call0i=function(inst,name){var m=mOf(H_().OGC(ptr(inst)),name,0);if(!m)return -999;var r=inv(m,ptr(inst),[]);try{return r?r.add(0x10).readS32():-998;}catch(e){return -997;}};
rpc.exports.probe=function(){for(var i=0;i<TYPES.length;i++){var p=getDangling(TYPES[i]);if(p&&!p.isNull())return TYPES[i];}return -1;};

rpc.exports.install=function(){
 var h=H_(); var st={};
 PBT=findClass("holo-game.dll","PokeballThrow"); if(PBT)PBT_VT=!!h.isVT(PBT); st.pbt=!!PBT;
 EMPTY=h.sN(Memory.allocUtf8String(""));
 // cache methods
 M.gde=mOf(h.OGC(QS),"GetDanglingEncounterOfType",2);
 M.open=mOf(h.OGC(QSM),"OpenQuestEncounter",1);
 M.cap=mOf(h.OGC(QMP),"TryCapture",2);
 M.eid=mOf(h.OGC(QMP),"get_EncounterId",0);
 st.gde=!!M.gde; st.open=!!M.open; st.cap=!!M.cap; st.eid=!!M.eid;
 var qmpC=findClass("holo-game.dll","QuestMapPokemon");var mSE=mOf(qmpC,"SendEncounterRequest",0);
 if(mSE){var sad=mSE.readPointer();if(!sad.isNull()){Interceptor.attach(sad,{onEnter:function(a){ACTIVE_QMP=a[0];}});st.hook=true;}}
 var camC=findClass("holo-game.dll","CameraFollowingGround");var mLU=mOf(camC,"LateUpdate",0);
 if(mLU){var ad=mLU.readPointer();if(!ad.isNull()){Interceptor.attach(ad,{onEnter:function(a){tick();}});st.pump=true;}}
 return st;
};

function getDangling(t){ try{ var iv=Memory.alloc(4); iv.writeS32(t); var r=inv(M.gde,QS,[iv,EMPTY]); return (r&&!r.isNull())?r:ptr(0); }catch(e){ERRS.push("gde:"+e);return ptr(0);} }
function openEnc(p){ try{ inv(M.open,QSM,[p]); }catch(e){ERRS.push("open:"+e);} }
function tgt(){ return (ACTIVE_QMP && !ACTIVE_QMP.isNull())?ACTIVE_QMP:QMP; }
function qmpId(){ try{ var r=inv(M.eid,tgt(),[]); return r?r.add(0x10).readU64().toString():"0"; }catch(e){return "0";} }
function fireCatch(){ try{ var obj=H_().oN(PBT); obj.add(0x10).writeS32(BALL); obj.add(0x14).writeFloat(1.0); obj.add(0x18).writeU8(1); obj.add(0x19).writeU8(1); obj.add(0x1a).writeU8(0); var p=PBT_VT?obj.add(0x10):obj; inv(M.cap,tgt(),[p,ptr(0)]); }catch(e){ERRS.push("cap:"+e);} }

function tick(){ if(!RUN)return; FRAME++;
 try{
  if(ST===0){ // IDLE: find next dangling across types
    curProto=ptr(0); REOPENED=false;
    for(var i=0;i<TYPES.length;i++){ if(SKIPTYPE[TYPES[i]])continue; var p=getDangling(TYPES[i]); if(p&&!p.isNull()){ curProto=p; TYPEIDX=i; break; } }
    if(curProto.isNull()){ ST=9; RUN=false; return; }   // dry -> done
    ACTIVE_QMP=ptr(0); openEnc(curProto); stAt=nowMs(); ST=1; return;
  }
  if(ST===1){ // OPENING: wait for SendEncounterRequest hook + network open, then catch. FAST recovery if blocked.
    var waited=nowMs()-stAt;
    if(waited<OPEN_LAG) return;                          // network open must settle (>=OPEN_LAG; racing it crashes PoGo)
    if(ACTIVE_QMP && !ACTIVE_QMP.isNull()){
      curId=qmpId();
      if(curId!=="0"){
        var n=THROWS[curId]||0;
        if(n>=MAXTHROWS){
          /* THROW CAP: this reward refused MAXTHROWS throws. Skip its type for the round and REPORT it (never a silent
             'dry'). Without a per-reward cap both v2 (every 3 stalls: each throw reset SAMESTALL, so the 6/9 escalation
             was unreachable) and a plain lost-throw retry would throw at it forever, burning a ball every few seconds. */
          STUCKIDS[curId]=1; SKIPTYPE[TYPES[TYPEIDX]]=1; STUCKOUT=1; ST=0; return;
        }
        if(curId!==lastId){ THROWS[curId]=n+1; boxAtThrow=readBox(); slowNoted=false; fireCatch(); CAUGHT++; lastId=curId; SAMESTALL=0; throwAt=nowMs(); stAt=throwAt; ST=2; return; }
        /* The game handed back the SAME reward we threw at. Box rose since that throw -> it WAS caught, the server just
           has not cleared it yet: wait, never throw twice. Box unchanged after LOSTWAIT -> the throw was LOST (or broke
           out): re-throw now. v2 waited out 3 full STUCK cycles here: ~9 s frozen per lost throw, 5 of 100 on 2026-09-26. */
        var bx=readBox();
        if(bx>=0 && boxAtThrow>=0 && bx>boxAtThrow){ if(!slowNoted){ SLOWCONF++; slowNoted=true; } }
        else if(nowMs()-throwAt>=LOSTWAIT){ THROWS[curId]=n+1; boxAtThrow=bx; fireCatch(); LOST++; throwAt=nowMs(); stAt=throwAt; ST=2; return; }
        if(waited<STUCK) return;   /* the encounter IS open: no nudge re-open here (it would restart the open wait) */
      }
    }
    // not ready (throw blocked / encounter not loaded yet): one mid-wait nudge, then give up FAST and re-probe
    if(!REOPENED && waited>=OPEN_LAG+NUDGE){ openEnc(curProto); REOPENED=true; }
    if(waited>=STUCK){ STALLS++; SAMESTALL++;
      /* LOOP BREAKER: ST0 re-probes and gets the SAME dangling back, so a reward whose throw never
         registers is retried forever ("stuck repeatedly on the same Pokemon"). Escalate instead:
         3 stalls -> clear lastId so a repeat encounterId is allowed to be thrown at again;
         6 stalls -> skip this dangling TYPE for the round; 9 -> end the round and SAY so. */
      if(SAMESTALL===3){ lastId="0"; }
      if(SAMESTALL===6){ SKIPTYPE[TYPES[TYPEIDX]]=1; }
      if(SAMESTALL>=9){ STUCKOUT=1; ST=9; RUN=false; return; }
      ST=0; return; }
    return;
  }
  if(ST===2){ // SETTLE
    if(nowMs()-stAt>=SETTLE){ ST=(MAX>0&&CAUGHT>=MAX)?9:0; if(ST===9)RUN=false; }
    return;
  }
 }catch(err){ERRS.push("tick:"+err);}
}
"""


def main():
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(LOG), exist_ok=True)
    f = open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8")

    def w(s):
        line = f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {s}"
        f.write(line + "\n"); f.flush(); print(line, flush=True)

    def jlog(obj):
        try:
            with open(ROUNDS, "a", encoding="utf-8") as jf:
                jf.write(json.dumps(obj) + "\n")
        except Exception as e:
            w(f"jlog err: {str(e)[:80]}")

    def best_of(e, hits, getter):
        """(handle, value) of the max-value instance among hits found BEFORE install() (the live one), or (None, None)."""
        best = None; bestv = None
        for h in hits:
            v = e.call0i(h, getter)
            if isinstance(v, int) and v >= 0 and (bestv is None or v > bestv):
                best = h; bestv = v
        return (best, bestv)

    def run_session(max_catches, dry):
        """One attach->install->run cycle. Never raises; returns a result dict."""
        res = {"caught": 0, "reason": "?", "errs": [], "stalls": 0, "box0": None, "box1": None,
               "dust0": None, "dust1": None, "latencies": [], "elapsed": 0.0, "pid": None,
               "install": None, "dangling_type": None}
        sess = None
        catcher_pause(SESSION_TIMEOUT + 120)   # re-armed before every attach, including reconnects
        for i in range(6):
            try:
                sess, pid = pg.get_session(); res["pid"] = pid; break
            except Exception as ex:
                if i == 5:
                    res["reason"] = "attach_failed"; res["errs"].append(str(ex)[:120]); return res
                time.sleep(4)
        try:
            finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
            sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
            e = sc.exports_sync

            def pick(ns, cls):
                r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, cls)
                return [h for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []) if e.cls_name(h) == cls]

            qs_hits = pick("Niantic.Holoholo.Quests", "QuestService")
            qsm_hits = pick("Niantic.Holoholo.Quests", "QuestStateManager")
            qmp_hits = pick("Niantic.Holoholo.Quests", "QuestMapPokemon")
            # EVERY heap (liveness, stopped-world) lookup happens HERE, before install() hooks LateUpdate: a stopped
            # world that catches UnityMain inside the pump's JS callback deadlocks on the shared JS lock (catcher 7b).
            def pick_any(ns, cls):
                hits = pick(ns, cls)
                if not hits:
                    alt = e.ns_of(cls)   # namespace moved in a game update: one class walk, still before any hook
                    hits = pick(alt, cls) if alt and alt != ns else []
                return hits
            iap_hits = pick_any("Niantic.Holoholo.Storefront", "IapService")
            bag_hits = pick_any("Niantic.Holoholo.Internal", "PokemonBagImpl")
            # LIVE SERVICE GRAPH (H01, Pokemon Inventory session 2026-09-29): the game can rebuild its services in-process;
            # the old copies answer with frozen data, so 'most stardust' / 'biggest bag' / 'first hit' can pick a stale one.
            # The live graph = the newest InventoryCache.latestTimestamp; each service is matched to it by its
            # IPlayerService / IInventoryCache / IPokemonBag reference. Still before install(): no hook exists yet.
            # The phone's own pogo_il2cpp (reward_phone.py) has no live_graph yet: keep the old picks there.
            HAS_GRAPH = hasattr(pg, "live_graph") and hasattr(pg, "_graph_of")
            try:
                g = pg.live_graph(sess) if HAS_GRAPH else {}
            except pg.GraphRefusal as ex:
                res["reason"] = "graph_refused"; res["errs"].append(str(ex)[:200]); w(f"GRAPH refused: {str(ex)[:200]}"); return res

            def graph_order(hits, label):
                """hits with the live graph's member first; provably-stale copies dropped; unlinkable classes unchanged."""
                if len(hits) <= 1 or not HAS_GRAPH:
                    return hits
                info = pg._graph_of(sess, hits)
                mine = [h for h in hits if pg._graph_link(info.get(h), g)]
                if mine:
                    stale = [h for h in hits if h not in mine and pg._has_graph_ref(info.get(h))]
                    if stale:
                        w(f"GRAPH {label}: {len(stale)} stale copy(ies) ignored, using the live graph's")
                    return mine + [h for h in hits if h not in mine and h not in stale]
                if any(pg._has_graph_ref(info.get(h)) for h in hits):
                    w(f"GRAPH {label}: {len(hits)} copies, none in the live graph -- refusing the stale ones")
                    return []
                return hits   # no graph reference on this class: the behaviour probe below decides (QuestService)

            qs_hits = graph_order(qs_hits, "QuestService")
            qsm_hits = graph_order(qsm_hits, "QuestStateManager")
            iap_hits = graph_order(iap_hits, "IapService")
            bag_hits = [g["bag"]] if g.get("bag") else graph_order(bag_hits, "PokemonBagImpl")
            w(f"attached pid={res['pid']} | hits QS={len(qs_hits)} QSM={len(qsm_hits)} QMP={len(qmp_hits)} "
              f"IAP={len(iap_hits)} BAG={len(bag_hits)}")
            if not (qsm_hits and qmp_hits):
                res["reason"] = "no_qsm"   # Today/Field-Research panel not open (lazily instantiated)
                return res
            if not qs_hits:
                res["reason"] = "no_qs"; return res
            e.set_qs(qs_hits[0]); e.set_qsm(qsm_hits[0]); e.set_qmp(qmp_hits[0])
            e.set_ball(BALL); e.set_types(TYPES); e.set_max(max_catches)
            st = e.install(); res["install"] = st
            need = ("pump", "pbt", "gde", "open", "cap", "hook")
            if not all(st.get(k) for k in need):
                res["reason"] = "install_failed"; res["errs"].append(str(st)); return res

            # pick the live QuestService (one of two is empty): the one returning a dangling
            chosen = None
            for h in qs_hits:
                e.set_qs(h)
                t = e.probe()
                if isinstance(t, int) and t != -1:
                    chosen = h; res["dangling_type"] = t; break
            if chosen is None:
                res["reason"] = "dry"   # nothing pending of these types
            else:
                e.set_qs(chosen)

            # baseline dust + box (cache the live handles for an exact before/after)
            iap_h, d0 = best_of(e, iap_hits[:1], "get_Stardusts")         # the live graph's copy, not the max value
            pb_h, b0 = best_of(e, bag_hits[:1], "get_PokemonOnlyCount")
            if pb_h:
                e.set_bag(pb_h)   # the pump reads the box to tell a LOST throw from a slow-to-clear catch
            res["dust0"] = d0; res["box0"] = b0
            w(f"baseline: dust={d0} box={b0} dangling_type={res['dangling_type']} install={st}")

            if dry:
                res["reason"] = "dry_check"
                res["dust1"] = d0; res["box1"] = b0
                return res
            if res["reason"] == "dry":
                res["dust1"] = d0; res["box1"] = b0
                return res

            # ---- run ----
            e.run(True)
            t0 = time.time(); last = -1; lastcatch_t = t0
            while True:
                time.sleep(0.6)
                try:
                    stt = e.stats()
                except Exception as ex:
                    res["reason"] = "error"; res["errs"].append("stats:" + str(ex)[:100]); break
                if not isinstance(stt, dict):
                    continue
                c = stt.get("caught", 0); res["caught"] = c; res["stalls"] = stt.get("stalls", 0); res["lost"] = stt.get("lost", 0); res["slowconf"] = stt.get("slowconf", 0)
                if c != last:
                    now = time.time(); lat = now - lastcatch_t; lastcatch_t = now
                    if last >= 0:
                        res["latencies"].append(round(lat, 2))
                    last = c
                    bx = e.call0i(pb_h, "get_PokemonOnlyCount") if pb_h else -1
                    w(f"  catch {c} state={stt.get('state')} +{lat:.1f}s stalls={stt.get('stalls')} lost={stt.get('lost')} slowconf={stt.get('slowconf')} box={bx} curId={stt.get('curId')}")
                if stt.get("state") == 9:
                    if stt.get("stuckout"):
                        # Looped on one un-catchable reward past every escalation — report it, don't
                        # pretend the queue is empty (it isn't; the rest are still waiting).
                        res["reason"] = "stuck"
                        res["errs"].append(f"stuck rewards={stt.get('stuckIds')} curId={stt.get('curId')} skipped_types={stt.get('skipped')}")
                        w(f"  STUCK: reward(s) {stt.get('stuckIds') or [stt.get('curId')]} refused every throw "
                          f"(skipped types={stt.get('skipped')}; the rest of those types wait for the next run) — ending round")
                    else:
                        res["reason"] = "max" if (max_catches > 0 and c >= max_catches) else "dry"
                    break
                if time.time() - t0 > SESSION_TIMEOUT:
                    res["reason"] = "timeout"; e.run(False); break
            res["elapsed"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
            res["dust1"] = e.call0i(iap_h, "get_Stardusts") if iap_h else None
            res["box1"] = e.call0i(pb_h, "get_PokemonOnlyCount") if pb_h else None
        except Exception as ex:
            res["reason"] = "error"; res["errs"].append(str(ex)[:150])
        finally:
            try:
                sess.detach()
            except Exception:
                pass
        return res

    # ---------------- orchestration ----------------
    if DRY:
        w(f"===== REWARD CATCHER v2 DRY-RUN (no catches) types={TYPES} =====")
        res = run_session(0, dry=True)
        ok = (res["reason"] == "dry_check")
        w(f"DRY result: reason={res['reason']} install={res['install']} dangling_type={res['dangling_type']} "
          f"dust={res['dust0']} box={res['box0']} errs={res['errs']}")
        jlog({"kind": "dry", "ts": time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), **{k: res[k] for k in
              ("reason", "install", "dangling_type", "dust0", "box0", "errs", "pid")}})
        if ok and res["dangling_type"] is not None:
            w("READY: hooks green, dangling reward present, dust/box baseline read. GO whenever.")
        elif ok:
            w("READY (hooks green) but NO dangling reward found right now — turn in research / open Today, then GO.")
        elif res["reason"] == "no_qsm":
            w("NOT READY: QuestStateManager absent — open the Today / Field Research panel, then re-check.")
        else:
            w(f"NOT READY: {res['reason']}")
        return

    w(f"===== REWARD CATCHER v2 run MAX={MAX} types={TYPES} =====")
    op = {"kind": "operation", "ts": time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), "caught_total": 0, "rounds": 0,
          "reconnects": 0, "dust0": None, "dust1": None, "box0": None, "box1": None, "errs": []}
    t_op = time.time(); budget = RECONNECT_BUDGET
    while True:
        res = run_session(MAX, dry=False)
        op["rounds"] += 1
        op["caught_total"] += res["caught"]
        if op["dust0"] is None and res["dust0"] is not None:
            op["dust0"] = res["dust0"]; op["box0"] = res["box0"]
        if res["dust1"] is not None:
            op["dust1"] = res["dust1"]; op["box1"] = res["box1"]
        op["errs"] += res["errs"]
        lats = res["latencies"]
        avg = round(sum(lats) / len(lats), 2) if lats else None
        dust_delta = (res["dust1"] - res["dust0"]) if (res["dust1"] is not None and res["dust0"] is not None) else None
        dpc = round(dust_delta / res["caught"], 1) if (dust_delta is not None and res["caught"]) else None
        jlog({"kind": "session", "ts": time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), "round": op["rounds"],
              "reason": res["reason"], "caught": res["caught"], "elapsed_s": res["elapsed"], "stalls": res["stalls"], "lost_rethrows": res.get("lost"), "slow_confirms": res.get("slowconf"),
              "avg_s_per_catch": avg, "min_s": (min(lats) if lats else None), "max_s": (max(lats) if lats else None),
              "box0": res["box0"], "box1": res["box1"],
              "dust0": res["dust0"], "dust1": res["dust1"], "dust_delta": dust_delta, "dust_per_catch": dpc,
              "latencies": lats, "errs": res["errs"], "pid": res["pid"]})
        w(f"round {op['rounds']} done: reason={res['reason']} caught={res['caught']} elapsed={res['elapsed']}s "
          f"stalls={res['stalls']} lost_rethrows={res.get('lost')} slow_confirms={res.get('slowconf')} "
          f"avg={avg}s/catch dust_delta={dust_delta} (~{dpc}/catch)")
        if res["reason"] in ("dry", "max"):
            break
        if res["reason"] == "graph_refused":
            w("live service graph could not be told apart -- NOT reconnecting (reopen PoGo, then retry)"); break
        if res["reason"] == "stuck":
            w("stuck reward — NOT reconnecting (a new session would just throw at it again)"); break
        if res["reason"] == "timeout":
            w("session timeout — stopping"); break
        budget -= 1
        if budget < 0:
            w("reconnect budget exhausted — stopping"); break
        op["reconnects"] += 1
        w(f"reconnecting (reason={res['reason']})... {budget} reconnects left")
        time.sleep(3)

    op["elapsed_s"] = round(time.time() - t_op, 1)
    op["dust_delta"] = (op["dust1"] - op["dust0"]) if (op["dust1"] is not None and op["dust0"] is not None) else None
    op["box_delta"] = (op["box1"] - op["box0"]) if (op["box1"] is not None and op["box0"] is not None) else None
    op["dust_per_catch"] = (round(op["dust_delta"] / op["caught_total"], 1)
                            if (op["dust_delta"] is not None and op["caught_total"]) else None)
    jlog(op)
    w(f"===== OPERATION DONE: caught_total={op['caught_total']} rounds={op['rounds']} reconnects={op['reconnects']} "
      f"box {op['box0']}->{op['box1']} (+{op['box_delta']}) dust {op['dust0']}->{op['dust1']} "
      f"(+{op['dust_delta']}, ~{op['dust_per_catch']}/catch) in {op['elapsed_s']}s =====")


try:
    main()
finally:
    catcher_resume()   # always hand the gadget back

```

`AutoCatcher/system/scripts/game_write/reward_phone.py`:

```py
"""On-device launcher for the Field-Research reward catcher (same trick as catch_phone.py):
monkey-patch pg.get_session() to attach to the local loopback gadget so reward_catcher.py runs
ON THE PHONE, driven by the app's "Catch Rewards" button instead of a desktop session.

The reward catcher needs the gadget to itself (single client), so catcher_ctl.sh stops the
auto-catcher around this and restores the toggles afterwards.

Writes a one-line result to /data/local/tmp/pogo_rewards.txt for the app UI to display.
Run: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$HOME/applibs:$PREFIX/lib python3.13 reward_phone.py [MAX] [--dry]
"""
import os
import sys
import time
import traceback

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)

import frida  # noqa: E402
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

STATUS = "/data/local/tmp/pogo_rewards.txt"   # app reads this (world-writable, pre-created by root)

_dm = frida.get_device_manager()


def _status(txt):
    """Publish a single status line for the app UI. Best-effort; never fatal."""
    try:
        with open(STATUS, "w") as fh:
            fh.write(txt.strip()[:300] + "\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def _dev():
    try:
        return _dm.add_remote_device(pg.FRIDA_REMOTE)
    except Exception:
        for d in _dm.enumerate_devices():
            nm = getattr(d, "name", "") or ""
            if pg.FRIDA_REMOTE in nm or getattr(d, "id", "") == "socket@" + pg.FRIDA_REMOTE:
                return d
        raise


def phone_get_session(retries=3):
    last = None
    for _ in range(max(1, retries)):
        try:
            dev = _dev()
            sess = dev.attach("Gadget")
            pid = 0
            try:
                for p in dev.enumerate_processes():
                    if p.name == "Gadget":
                        pid = p.pid
                        break
            except Exception:
                pass
            return sess, pid
        except Exception as e:
            last = e
    raise last or RuntimeError("phone attach failed")


pg.get_session = phone_get_session

_status(f"running... (started {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')})")
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
try:
    import reward_catcher  # noqa: E402,F401  (module-level main() does the work)
except SystemExit:
    raise
except Exception as e:
    # The most common real-world failure is the lazily-created QuestStateManager being absent
    # because Field Research / "Today" was never opened after a PoGo restart. Say so plainly.
    msg = str(e)
    if "singleton" in msg.lower() or "qsm" in msg.lower():
        _status("FAILED: open Field Research (Today) in PoGo first, then tap again")
    else:
        _status(f"FAILED: {type(e).__name__}: {msg[:120]}")
    traceback.print_exc()
    sys.exit(1)

# reward_catcher writes its own detailed log; summarise the last line for the UI.
try:
    logp = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "analysis", "pokemod", "reward_catch.log")
    tail = ""
    with open(logp, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
        for ln in fh:
            if "OPERATION DONE" in ln:
                tail = ln.strip()
    import re
    # Read the LAST outcome line of this run — never assume success. A failed/stuck pass previously
    # published "done", which is precisely the silent failure this status line exists to prevent.
    outcome = ""
    with open(logp, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
        for ln in fh:
            if ("OPERATION DONE" in ln or "NOT READY" in ln or "READY:" in ln
                    or "DRY result" in ln or "MISSING" in ln):
                outcome = ln.strip()
    now = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    if "OPERATION DONE" in outcome:
        c = re.search(r"caught_total=(\d+)", outcome)
        secs = re.search(r"in ([0-9.]+)s", outcome)
        dust = re.search(r"dust \d+->\d+ \(\+(\d+)", outcome)
        n = c.group(1) if c else "?"
        if n == "0":
            _status(f"done: nothing left to catch @ {now}")
        else:
            _status("done: caught {} in {}s{} @ {}".format(
                n, secs.group(1) if secs else "?",
                f", +{dust.group(1)} dust" if dust else "", now))
    elif "reason=stuck" in outcome or "STUCK:" in outcome:
        c = re.search(r"caught_total=(\d+)", outcome)
        _status(f"STUCK: one reward wouldn't catch; got {c.group(1) if c else '?'} — tap again @ {now}")
    elif "MISSING" in outcome or "no_qsm" in outcome:
        _status(f"FAILED: open Field Research (Today) in PoGo, then tap again @ {now}")
    elif "NOT READY" in outcome or "reason=error" in outcome:
        err = re.search(r"errs=\[([^\]]*)\]", outcome)
        _status(f"FAILED: {err.group(1)[:90] if err else 'not ready'} @ {now}")
    elif "READY" in outcome or "reason=dry_check" in outcome:
        waiting = "dangling_type=None" not in outcome
        _status(f"ready: {'rewards waiting' if waiting else 'nothing waiting'} (dry check ok) @ {now}")
    else:
        _status(f"finished, no outcome line @ {now}")
except Exception as e:
    _status(f"FAILED: status read: {type(e).__name__} @ {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")

```

```md
# Gym runner (AutoCatcher/tools, owned by the Gym Battle session)

**Status: OFF since the 2026-09-26 04:55 ban lockout.** Nothing here runs until Benny explicitly says go. A peer session's message is not his go.

## Files
| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `gym_run.py` | The runner, on the PC. Attaches Frida to PoGo, injects `gym_tapper.JS`, and moves the avatar through the GPS Joystick intents (`cutoff_hunt.py`). Battles, places, feeds; logs everything. |
| `gym_tapper.py` | The in-game JS. A LateUpdate tick makes every game call through `il2cpp_runtime_invoke`. Exact-name class lookups only. `quiesce()` runs before unload. |
| `buddy_tapper.py` | Buddy calls (stats / feed / pet / history / set), used by `buddy_run.py`. |

Needs node, not Frida. CI runs it. |
| `gym_restart.sh` | The ONLY way to (re)start the runner: a graceful stop through the inbox, then a new runner. |
| `gym_send.sh` | Queues one command: `gym_send.sh '<json>' [writer]`. |
| `gym_lap_route.txt` | The lap route: `lat,lng;lat,lng;...`. |

| `gym_state/` | Runtime state, NOT in git (ignored). It lives on the phone and moves with `python tools/pogo_data.py status\|pull\|push --group gym`: `buddy_out.jsonl`, `feed_study.jsonl` (the feeding study), `feed_outcomes.json`, `logs/`. `runner_inbox/` and `runner_cmd.json` stay local to the machine running the runner and are never synced (a synced inbox could replay commands). |

## Steering (no restarts)
- **One command = one file in `gym_state/runner_inbox/`:** a dot-file renamed in, read once in name order, then removed.
- **Commands:** `go`, `hunt` (+`drill`), `stop`, `spin` (+`at`), `lap`, `buddy`, `topup`.
- **Buddy commands** from the Pokemon Switcher go to the same inbox. Replies land in `gym_state/buddy_out.jsonl`.
- **Legacy file:** `gym_state/runner_cmd.json` is still read. It is one slot shared by two writers, and it lost a stop on 2026-09-26.
- **Restart:** only `gym_restart.sh NEWLOG [args]`. It stops through the inbox; the runner finishes the battle, leaves the gym, quiesces and detaches, then the new runner starts. Extra args: `--no-battle`, `--start-lap-at N`, `--join-first FID`.
- **Never hard-kill a runner attached to the game.** A kill mid-hook deadlocked PoGo at 03:39.

## Rules that bind it
- Never restart the game.
- Never stop the GPS Joystick while PoGo is open.
- Golden Razz only for his own defenders plus one teammate per gym. Never for buddies.
- Read and log the TEXT of every warning / lockout / error screen, not just its name.
- **Phone marker `/data/local/tmp/pogo_desktop_busy` is ADVISORY** (Benny, 2026-09-29: nobody pauses for anybody). The runner writes `GymBattle/<pid> <deadline>` only around its world-stopping phases (the install scans; quiesce + unload) and clears it after them. It logs anyone else's marker and never waits or refuses. It also stops `pogo_il2cpp.get_session()` from waiting on its behalf.

## Same-type bonus (STAB): changed 2026-09-30, CODE ONLY
Benny: "fix it". It ships at the next supervised run; every run or deploy still needs his explicit go. Nothing was run, attached or deployed.

The charged-move pick is power x the game's effectiveness label x STAB (x1.2 when the move's type is one of the attacker's two types). STAB never applied: in the 87 gym logs, 327 `charged moves:` readings, damage / power was always 1.0, 1.6 or 0.625, never x1.2 (Palkia: Aqua Tail 50, Draco Meteor 150; with STAB 60 and 180. Mewtwo: Psystrike 95 against Shadow Ball 100; with STAB 114, so the pick changes).
- **Proven cause (from the repo's own live dumps):** `PokemonSettingsProto` names its two types `type1_` @24 and `type2_` @28 (class recon `pogo_extract/_recon_evolve_out.json`, May). The 0.429.1 client dump `AutoCatcher/system/analysis/map_full.json` (2026-09-25) shows the same names (`"uniqueId_": 19, "type1_": 1`). The matcher wanted `type` / `type_` for the first, so `setT1` stayed -1 and `setOffs()` returned null with no log line. The class did match, so the one info line ("attacker settings class") never fired either, which is why none is in any log.
- **Inferred, not provable offline:**
  - `ChargeAttackDisplay` has an `IPokemonSettings` field at all (it was never `need()`-checked);
  - that field holds the ATTACKER's settings and not the defender's (the effectiveness label needs the defender's).
  - The repo history is one import commit, so it is not proven the STAB code was live in those runs. The `moves` line exists from `gym_v2_32` (2026-09-25 23:44).
- **What the tapper does now** (`gym_tapper.py`, the STAB block):
  - the type fields are found by declared type (`HoloPokemonType`, in declaration order), names only break ties;
  - **live** read: the button's settings object counts only when its species is one of our fighting six AND that Pokemon carries the button's move(s), so a defender's settings can never boost the wrong moves;
  - **table** fallback, independent of any live field: the attacker is our fighting six matched by the charge moves on the buttons, its types come from the client game master table the runner hands over (`gym_tapper.stab_config()` reads `pogo_extract/gamemaster_pokeminers.json` and `form_enum.json`; key `dex` or `dex:form`; the game master file is data, not in git, so `python tools/pogo_data.py pull --group inventory` brings it, and without it the runner says so and the live read decides alone). A mega-evolved attacker, a species the table lacks, or candidates that disagree get no boost (the old pick);
  - the multiplier is the live `GymBattleSettingsProto.SameTypeAttackBonusMultiplier` when it resolves, else the game master's 1.2.
  - Any failure in the STAB read leaves exactly the old pick. Pacing, targeting, feeding, deploying and timings are untouched.
- **First supervised run: read these lines to see which path fired:**
  - `same-type bonus (STAB): charge-button settings field(s) @... ; PokemonSettingsProto types @24/@28, species @16; multiplier x1.2 (live | game master | default)`, plus a `!! STAB:` line for anything unresolved;
  - `STAB table from the game master: N typings (... species + ... form overrides)`;
  - every `charged moves:` line now ends `stab xF` per move and `[attacker #dex Name; types: live | table | none (reason); same-type xM]`;
  - `STAB: the charge button settings object is species #N, not the attacker` means that field is the defender's (it is then ignored);
  - `STAB: a charge button has a settings object of another class` names the wrapper class.
  - The `related` fields in the first line list every button field that mentions a Pokemon, with its name: a field called `defenderSettings` answers the attacker/defender question at once.

## Attack reports: 3 s by default (2026-09-30)
The runner rewrites `GymBattleSettingsProto.AttackServerInterval` (the game's own value: 5 s) at every attach. `AutoCatcher/tools/apple_collector.py`:
```

```py
"""Collect event apples (map tappables: TAPPABLE_TYPE_MAPLE -> ITEM_OTHER_EVOLUTION_STONE_MAPLE_A/B/C =
Sweet/Tart/Syrupy Apple) the way a finger does: call the tappable's own DynamicTappableController.Tapped() on the
game's main thread, so the game sends its normal ProcessTappable request itself.

  python tools/apple_collector.py MINUTES|HH:MM [--live] [--types MAPLE,POKEBALL] [--maxdist 60]

Default is DRY: logs every apple it WOULD tap (id, type, distance, despawn) and calls nothing.
--live taps, at most one tap per 1.5 s, never an encounter tappable (IsEncounter: a Pokemon hides inside).
Proof = the server's reply: ProcessTappableOutProto (Status, Reward) is hooked and logged per tap.
Controllers are found as the game touches them (Initialize/Refresh + per-frame getters), validated by klass,
TypeKey and despawn time in the SAME tick they are tapped -- no pointer is trusted across ticks.
"""
import json
import math
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(HERE))
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

DEV = os.environ.get("ADB_TARGET", "100.98.158.56:5555")   # cloud: the Tailscale bridge exports ADB_TARGET
LIVE = "--live" in sys.argv
TYPES = ["TAPPABLE_TYPE_" + t.strip().upper() for t in (sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--types") + 1] if "--types" in sys.argv else "MAPLE").split(",")]
MAXDIST = float(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--maxdist") + 1]) if "--maxdist" in sys.argv else 60.0
ENCOUNTERS = "--encounters" in sys.argv   # experiment: tap the revealed-Pokemon tappables too (1 per 10 s)

JS = r"""
var PS = Process.pointerSize, PROP = {exceptions: 'propagate'}, EX = {};
Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so').enumerateExports().forEach(function (e) { if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_') === 0) EX[e.name] = e.address; });
function nf(n, r, a) { return new NativeFunction(EX[n], r, a, PROP); }
var IL = {
  domain: nf('il2cpp_domain_get', 'pointer', []), asms: nf('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']),
  asmImage: nf('il2cpp_assembly_get_image', 'pointer', ['pointer']), fromName: nf('il2cpp_class_from_name', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer', 'pointer']),
  methods: nf('il2cpp_class_get_methods', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']), mName: nf('il2cpp_method_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']),
  mArgs: nf('il2cpp_method_get_param_count', 'uint32', ['pointer']), mFrom: nf('il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer', 'int']),
  fields: nf('il2cpp_class_get_fields', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']), fName: nf('il2cpp_field_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']),
  fOff: nf('il2cpp_field_get_offset', 'uint32', ['pointer']), fType: nf('il2cpp_field_get_type', 'pointer', ['pointer']),
  tType: nf('il2cpp_type_get_type', 'int', ['pointer']), tName: nf('il2cpp_type_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']),
  fFlags: nf('il2cpp_field_get_flags', 'int', ['pointer']), cName: nf('il2cpp_class_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']),
  parent: nf('il2cpp_class_get_parent', 'pointer', ['pointer']),
  invoke: nf('il2cpp_runtime_invoke', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer', 'pointer', 'pointer']),
  mParam: nf('il2cpp_method_get_param', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'uint32']), mRet: nf('il2cpp_method_get_return_type', 'pointer', ['pointer']),
  fFrom: nf('il2cpp_class_get_field_from_name', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']), fStatic: nf('il2cpp_field_static_get_value', 'void', ['pointer', 'pointer'])
};

function skip(why) { STATS.skipped[why] = (STATS.skipped[why] || 0) + 1; }
function meters(a1, o1, a2, o2) { var r = 6371008.8, p1 = a1 * Math.PI / 180, p2 = a2 * Math.PI / 180, dl = (o2 - o1) * Math.PI / 180;
  return 2 * r * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(Math.pow(Math.sin((p2 - p1) / 2), 2) + Math.cos(p1) * Math.cos(p2) * Math.pow(Math.sin(dl / 2), 2))); }
function note(p) { var k = p.toString();
  if (DEAD[k]) { try { if (p.add(F.enc).readU64().toString() + ':' + (p.add(F.isEnc).readU8() !== 0) === DEAD[k]) return; } catch (e) { return; } delete DEAD[k]; }   /* reused by the pool for a new apple */

function read(o) {   /* same-tick snapshot of a controller; null if it is no longer a DynamicTappableController */

  var r = {id: o.add(F.id).readS32(), enc: o.add(F.enc).readU64().toString(), type: str(o.add(F.type).readPointer()),
           isEnc: o.add(F.isEnc).readU8() !== 0, despawn: o.add(F.despawn).readS64().toNumber(),
           lat: o.add(F.loc).readDouble(), lng: o.add(F.loc + 8).readDouble(), ready: true};
  for (var i = 0; i < GOS.length; i++) if (o.add(GOS[i]).readPointer().isNull()) { r.ready = false; break; }

  return r;
}
function readApples() {   /* game record: ItemBagImpl.GetItemCount(item) for Sweet/Tart/Syrupy, on UnityMain */
  if (!BAGP || !M_GIC || APPLE_IDS.length === 0) return;
  try { if (BAGP.readPointer().toString() !== IB.toString()) { BAGP = null; return; }

function tick() {
  if (FRAME % 600 === 0) readApples();
  if (++FRAME % 20) return;   /* ~3x/s */
  var now = Date.now();
  Object.keys(CAND).forEach(function (k) {
    var o = ptr(k), s; try { s = read(o); } catch (e) { s = null; }
    if (!s) { delete CAND[k]; return; }                                   /* pooled / freed: forget it */
    var key = s.enc + ':' + s.isEnc;
    if (s.despawn && s.despawn < now) { delete CAND[k]; DEAD[k] = key; if (!LOGGED['d' + key]) { LOGGED['d' + key] = 1; STATS.dead++;
        EV.push({t: now, k: 'EXPIRED', s: s}); } return; }   /* the game keeps expired tappables pooled: log once, never tap */
    if (!LOGGED['l' + key]) { LOGGED['l' + key] = 1; STATS.live++; EV.push({t: now, k: 'LIVE_APPLE', s: s}); }
    if (TAPPED[key]) return;
    if (TYPES.indexOf(s.type) < 0) { if (!TAPPED['t' + key]) { TAPPED['t' + key] = 1; EV.push({t: now, k: 'OTHER', s: s}); } return; }
    if (s.isEnc && !ENCTAP) { if (!TAPPED['e' + key]) { TAPPED['e' + key] = 1; EV.push({t: now, k: 'ENCOUNTER_TAPPABLE', s: s}); } return; }
    if (s.isEnc && now - lastEncTap < 10000) return;
    if (ENCTAP && !s.isEnc) return;   /* experiment mode: the on-phone catcher taps the plain apples */
    var d = (PLAT && s.lat) ? meters(PLAT, PLNG, s.lat, s.lng) : -1; s.dist = Math.round(d);
    if (!s.ready) { skip('not_ready'); return; }
    if (d < 0 || d > MAXDIST) { skip('far'); return; }
    STATS.eligible++;
    if (now - lastTap < 1500) return;                                     /* one tap per 1.5 s */
    lastTap = now; TAPPED[key] = now; if (s.isEnc) lastEncTap = now;
    if (!LIVE) { EV.push({t: now, k: 'WOULD_TAP', s: s}); return; }
    try { if (!EVARGS && EVARGS_F && !EVARGS_F.isNull()) { var box = Memory.alloc(PS); box.writePointer(NULL); IL.fStatic(EVARGS_F, box); EVARGS = box.readPointer(); }   /* main thread */
      var argv = Memory.alloc(PS * 2); argv.writePointer(o.add(F.gesture).readPointer()); argv.add(PS).writePointer(EVARGS || NULL);
      OURS = true; var exc = Memory.alloc(PS); exc.writePointer(NULL); IL.invoke(M_HANDLER, o, argv, exc); OURS = false;
      STATS.taps++; EV.push({t: now, k: 'TAP', s: s, exc: !exc.readPointer().isNull()}); }
    catch (e) { OURS = false; EV.push({t: now, k: 'tap_err', e: String(e), s: s}); }
  });
}
function hookEach(k, pick, cb) { var n = 0, it = Memory.alloc(PS); it.writePointer(NULL); var m;
  while ((m = IL.methods(k, it)) && !m.isNull()) { var nm = cs(IL.mName(m)), argc = IL.mArgs(m); if (!pick(nm, argc)) continue;
    var fp = m.readPointer(); if (fp.isNull()) continue; (function (nm, argc) { Interceptor.attach(fp, cb(nm, argc)); })(nm, argc); n++; }
  return n; }
function val(p, te) {
  switch (te) { case 0x02: return p.readU8() !== 0; case 0x08: case 0x11: return p.readS32(); case 0x09: return p.readU32(); case 0x0a: return p.readS64().toString();
    case 0x0b: return p.readU64().toString(); case 0x0c: return p.readFloat(); case 0x0d: return p.readDouble(); case 0x0e: return str(p.readPointer());
    case 0x12: case 0x15: case 0x1d: case 0x1c: var o = p.readPointer(); if (o.isNull()) return null; var kn = klassName(o); return kn === 'String' ? str(o) : '<' + kn + '>'; }
  return '<te ' + te + '>'; }
function deep(o, depth) {   /* every instance field; follows objects and RepeatedField`1 (arr@0x10, count@0x18) */
  if (!o || o.isNull()) return null; var out = {_c: klassName(o)};
  if (out._c && out._c.indexOf('RepeatedField') === 0) { var arr = o.add(0x10).readPointer(), n = o.add(0x18).readS32(), items = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < n && i < 12; i++) { var el = arr.add(0x20 + i * PS).readPointer(); items.push(depth > 0 ? deep(el, depth - 1) : String(el)); }
    return {_c: out._c, n: n, items: items}; }
  fieldsOf(o.readPointer()).forEach(function (f) { try { var v = val(o.add(f.off), f.te); out[f.name] = v;
    if (depth > 0 && typeof v === 'string' && v.charAt(0) === '<' && v !== '<String>') out[f.name] = deep(o.add(f.off).readPointer(), depth - 1); } catch (e) { out[f.name] = '<err>'; } });
  return out; }
function dumpReply(o) {   /* ProcessTappableOutProto: Status + Reward (repeated LootProto -> LootItem) + Encounter */
  var out = {status: o.add(RF.Status).readS32()}, rw = o.add(RF.Reward).readPointer();

  return out; }
var RF = {}, LOOTF = null, ITEMF = null, SEENREP = {}, ITEMNAMES = {}, IB = null, BAGP = null, M_GIC = null, APPLES = {}, APPLE_IDS = [];

def adb(cmd):
    return subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", DEV, "shell", cmd], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8",
                          errors="replace", env=dict(os.environ, MSYS_NO_PATHCONV="1")).stdout or ""


def main():
    arg = sys.argv[1]
    if ":" in arg:
        hh, mm = (int(x) for x in arg.split(":"))
        lt = time.localtime()
        minutes = (time.mktime((lt.tm_year, lt.tm_mon, lt.tm_mday, hh, mm, 0, 0, 0, -1)) - time.time()) / 60
    else:
        minutes = float(arg)
    out = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(HERE), "system", "analysis", "apple_collector.jsonl")
    if "Pixel" not in adb("getprop ro.product.model"):
        sys.exit("not the phone")
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = sess.create_script(JS)
    sc.load()
    st = sc.exports_sync.install(TYPES, LIVE, MAXDIST, ENCOUNTERS)
    print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {'LIVE' if LIVE else 'DRY'} pid {pid} types {TYPES} maxdist {MAXDIST} m | install {st}", flush=True)
    if not (isinstance(st, dict) and st.get("pump") and st.get("handler")):
        sc.unload(); sess.detach()
        sys.exit("install incomplete (no main-thread pump or no tap handler) -- refusing to run")
    t0, last_pos, last_stat, last_apples = time.time(), 0, 0, {}
    with open(out, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"t": int(time.time() * 1000), "k": "start", "live": LIVE, "st": st}) + "\n")
        try:
            while time.time() - t0 < minutes * 60:
                if time.time() - last_pos >= 2:
                    last_pos = time.time()
                    m = re.search(r"gps ([-0-9.]+),([-0-9.]+) ", adb("dumpsys location | grep -m1 'last mock location'"))
                    if m:
                        sc.exports_sync.set_player(float(m[1]), float(m[2]))
                d = sc.exports_sync.drain()
                for e in d["ev"]:
                    fh.write(json.dumps(e) + "\n")
                    s = e.get("s") or {}
                    if e["k"] == "TRACE":
                        print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} TRACE {e['m']} ours={e['ours']} a0={e['a0']} a1={e.get('a1')}", flush=True)
                        continue
                    print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {e['k']} {s.get('type', '')} enc={s.get('enc', '')} dist={s.get('dist', '')}m "
                          f"fort={str(s.get('fort'))[:12]} despawn_in={round((s.get('despawn', 0) - time.time() * 1000) / 60000, 1) if s.get('despawn') else ''}min "
                          f"{json.dumps({k: v for k, v in e['r'].items() if k != 'full'}) if e.get('r') else ''}{e.get('e', '')}", flush=True)
                if d.get("apples") and d["apples"] != last_apples:   # the GAME's own item counts
                    if last_apples:
                        delta = {k: v - last_apples.get(k, 0) for k, v in d["apples"].items() if v != last_apples.get(k, 0)}
                        print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} APPLES in bag {d['apples']} (change {delta})", flush=True)
                    else:
                        print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} APPLES in bag {d['apples']}", flush=True)
                    fh.write(json.dumps({"t": int(time.time() * 1000), "k": "apples", "counts": d["apples"]}) + "\n")
                    last_apples = dict(d["apples"])
                if time.time() - last_stat >= 30:
                    last_stat = time.time()
                    print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} stats {d['stats']} candidates {d['cand']}", flush=True)
                fh.flush()
                time.sleep(1)
        finally:
            try:
                sc.unload()
                sess.detach()
            except Exception:
                pass

    main()
```

```js
    src + `;return {get:(k)=>eval(k), set:(k,v)=>eval(k+'=v'), tick:()=>tick(), note:(p)=>note(p)};`)(
    P, { pointerSize: 8, findModuleByName: () => ({ enumerateExports: () => [] }) },
    { alloc: () => { const m = { writePointer: () => m, readPointer: () => ({ isNull: () => true }), add: () => m }; return m; } }, {}, function () {}, null,
    { now: () => NOW });
  let NOW = 1790716800000, taps = [];
  api.set('F', { enc: 0, isEnc: 0 }); api.set('TYPES', ['TAPPABLE_TYPE_MAPLE']); api.set('LIVE', true); api.set('MAXDIST', 60);
  api.set('PLAT', 40.7); api.set('PLNG', -74.0);
  api.set('read', (o) => { const c = WORLD[o.k]; return c ? Object.assign({ ready: true }, c) : null; });
  api.set('IL', { invoke: (m, o) => { taps.push(WORLD[o.k].enc); if (opts.onTap) opts.onTap(o.k, WORLD); } });
  api.set('M_TAPPED', {}); api.set('M_HANDLER', {}); api.set('F', { enc: 0, isEnc: 0, gesture: 0 });
  for (let step = 0; step < 400; step++) {
    NOW += 50;   // 20 frames per tick below = one decision pass per step
    if (opts.script) opts.script(step, WORLD);
    Object.keys(WORLD).forEach((k) => api.note(P(k)));   // the game touches every controller it holds
    for (let f = 0; f < 20; f++) api.tick();
  }
  const st = api.get('STATS');
  console.log(name.padEnd(16), 'taps', JSON.stringify(taps), 'live', st.live, 'dead', st.dead, 'seen', st.seen, 'skipped', JSON.stringify(st.skipped));
  return taps;
}
const near = { lat: 40.7001, lng: -74.0 }, far = { lat: 40.71, lng: -74.0 };
const mk = (enc, extra) => Object.assign({ enc, isEnc: false, type: 'TAPPABLE_TYPE_MAPLE', despawn: 1790716800000 + 600000 }, near, extra || {});
```

`AutoCatcher/tools/audit_bank.py`:

```py
"""Self-check of the map bank (system/map/pogo_wigle.db) -- catches stale / drifting fort data automatically.

The scanner (tools/pogo_wigle.py) runs run() every 5 min on its own connection and prints ONE line:
  SELFCHECK ok  | ...counts...
  SELFCHECK FAIL <check>=<n> [offending ids] ... | ...counts...
and writes system/map/selfcheck.json (shown by tools/map_live.py). On demand, read-only:

  python tools/audit_bank.py [--window 10] [--since "YYYY-mm-dd HH:MM:SS"] [--json] [--write-health]

Invariants (FAIL = the bank is lying about "now"; WARN = degraded; INFO = context only):
  heartbeat          moving (track kmh > 0 in the last 60 s) but no map reply for > 120 s
  schema             the gym-state / raw_t columns exist
  gym_state_lag      every gym seen in the window has gym_state_t == last_seen (state written on EVERY sighting)
  raw_vs_live        raw Team / GuardPokemonId == team / guard columns for every fort seen in the window
                     (the bug of 2026-09-25: raw said Valor, 842 CP, 5 open slots; the gym was Mystic and full).
                     A team change in the fort's last <= 30 s of sightings whose re-read the scanner's per-reply cap
                     postponed is "raw_pending" (INFO); longer than that it FAILs.
  same_read          where raw_t == last_seen, raw agrees with every live column written by the same read
  raw_age            forts seen in the window whose full record is > 10 min older than last_seen, or that were in
                     view > 60 s without one (> 5% of the window fails, fewer warns)
  team_event_refresh every team change in the window is followed by a gym-state read (always at that sighting) AND a
                     full-record read (pending as above)
  gym_consistency    team != 0 => guard != 0, gym_cp > 0, slots NOT NULL and 0..5; team == 0 => guard == 0, no CP,
                     slots NULL (no display sent) or 0..6; 0 <= motivation <= 1
  canary             the most recently seen gym: state stamped at that sighting (held => a display was read)
  js_reads           (scanner only) failed full reads <= 1 %, zero unreadable GymDisplay reads
  consumers   WARN   the map_live data file carries its age; no tools/*.py that opens the bank reads a DYNAMIC key
                     (GymDisplay, SlotsAvailable, Team, GuardPokemonId, IsInBattle, ...) -- those live in raw, stale
The window is the last --window minutes before the newest map reply; inside the scanner it is the same rolling
10 min but never before the scanner started, so rows written by older code are judged only as INFO (legacy_raw_stale),
and one past glitch cannot keep FAILing for the rest of the session (every sighting is still judged at least once).
"""
import argparse
import glob
import io
import json
import os
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
import time
import tokenize

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), os.pardir))
# keys of PokemonFortProto that change during play: a consumer must take them from the live columns, never from raw
DYNAMIC_RAW = re.compile(r"""["'](GymDisplay|SlotsAvailable|TotalGymCp|LowestPokemonMotivation|OccupiedMillis|IsInBattle|"""
                         r"""Team|GuardPokemonId|ActiveFortModifier|Visited|RaidInfo|PokestopDisplays)["']""")
LINT_SKIP = {"pogo_wigle.py", "audit_bank.py",      # the writer and this checker compare raw against the columns
             "route_planner.py"}                    # dynamic keys from map_full.json (a live read); the bank via columns
DB = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "map", "pogo_wigle.db")
HEALTH = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "map", "selfcheck.json")
LIVE_DATA = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "analysis", "pogo_map_data.js")
FMT = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
GYM_COLS = ("slots", "gym_cp", "motivation", "occupied_ms", "in_battle", "gym_state_t", "raw_t")
WINDOW_S = 600
RAW_MAX_LAG_S = 600
RAW_STALE_SHARE = 0.05
PENDING_S = 30              # a full re-read capped away in one reply lands within a few replies (~6 s each)


def ep(s):
    return time.mktime(time.strptime(s[:19], FMT)) if s else None


def st(e):
    return time.strftime(FMT, time.localtime(e))


def _raw(s):
    try:
        return json.loads(s) if s else None
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _b(v):
    return 1 if v else 0


def run(db, since=None, js=None, now=None, window_s=WINDOW_S, consumers=False, floor=None):
    """All checks; returns {"ok", "line", "fails", "warns", "info", "checked_at"}. Only SELECTs.
    since: judge forts seen at/after this time; default = the window before the newest reply, never before `floor`
    (the scanner passes its start time, so rows written by older code are only INFO)."""
    now = now or time.time()
    fails, warns, info = [], [], {}

    def flag(lst, name, ids, n=None):
        ids = sorted(ids)
        lst.append({"check": name, "n": len(ids) if n is None else n, "ids": ids[:8]})

    ref = db.execute("SELECT MAX(t) FROM replies").fetchone()[0]
    if ref is None:
        return {"ok": True, "line": "SELFCHECK ok | no map replies yet", "fails": [], "warns": [], "info": {},
                "checked_at": st(now)}
    if since is None:
        since = st(ep(ref) - window_s)
    if floor and since < floor:
        since = floor
    age = now - ep(ref)
    info.update(last_reply=ref, last_reply_age_s=round(age), since=since)

    # heartbeat
    moving = db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track WHERE t >= ? AND kmh > 0", (st(now - 60),)).fetchone()[0]
    if moving and age > 120:
        flag(fails, f"heartbeat(no reply {round(age)}s while moving)", [])

    cols = {r[1] for r in db.execute("PRAGMA table_info(forts)")}
    missing = [c for c in GYM_COLS if c not in cols]
    if "raw" not in cols:
        missing.append("raw")
    if missing:
        flag(fails, "schema(missing " + ",".join(missing) + ")", [], n=len(missing))
    sel = ", ".join(c if c in cols else f"NULL AS {c}" for c in ("raw",) + GYM_COLS)

    rows = db.execute(f"SELECT id, kind, team, guard, visited, lured, last_seen, {sel}, first_seen FROM forts WHERE last_seen >= ?",
                      (since,)).fetchall()
    # the scanner caps full reads per reply (game safety), so a team change seen in the fort's LAST <= 30 s of sightings
    # may still be waiting for its re-read: "pending" (INFO), not a FAIL. Seen longer than that and still stale = FAIL.
    tlast = dict(db.execute("SELECT fort, MAX(t) FROM fort_events WHERE event='team' AND t >= ? GROUP BY fort", (since,)))

    def pending(fid, last, rawt):
        e = tlast.get(fid)
        return e is not None and (rawt is None or rawt < e) and ep(last) - ep(e) <= PENDING_S

    raw_live, same, lag, cons, rawold, pend = [], [], [], [], [], set()
    ngym = nstop = nraw = nsame = 0
    for (fid, kind, team, guard, vis, lured, last, raw, slots, cp, mot, occ, bat, gst, rawt, first) in rows:
        gym = kind == "gym"
        ngym += gym
        nstop += not gym
        o = _raw(raw)
        if o is not None:
            nraw += 1
            if int(o.get("Team") or 0) != int(team or 0) or int(o.get("GuardPokemonId") or 0) != int(guard or 0):
                (pend.add(fid) if not missing and pending(fid, last, rawt) else raw_live.append(fid))
            if not missing and rawt == last:
                nsame += 1
                gd = o.get("GymDisplay") or {}
                bad = (_b(o.get("Visited")) != _b(vis) or _b(o.get("ActiveFortModifier")) != _b(lured))
                if gym and gst == last:
                    if slots is None:          # stamped "no GymDisplay" (neutral): the full record must have none either
                        bad = bad or bool(gd)
                    else:                      # raw omits proto3 zeros: absent SlotsAvailable / TotalGymCp = 0
                        bad = bad or (int(gd.get("SlotsAvailable") or 0) != slots or int(gd.get("TotalGymCp") or 0) != (cp or 0))
                    bad = bad or (bat is not None and _b(o.get("IsInBattle")) != bat)
                if bad:
                    same.append(fid)
        if missing:
            continue
        # never full-read: only late once the fort has been in view > 60 s of this window (a first sighting over the
        # per-reply cap is read on a later reply); read once: late when > 10 min older than the last sighting
        if (ep(last) - max(ep(first) or 0, ep(since)) > PENDING_S * 2) if rawt is None else (ep(last) - ep(rawt) > RAW_MAX_LAG_S):
            rawold.append(fid)
        if gym:
            if gst is None or gst < last:
                lag.append(fid)
            elif gst == last:
                t_, g_ = int(team or 0), int(guard or 0)
                ok = 0 <= (mot or 0) <= 1
                if t_:                         # held: a display with >= 1 defender (0-5 open slots), CP and a top guard
                    ok = ok and slots is not None and g_ != 0 and (cp or 0) > 0 and 0 <= slots <= 5
                else:                          # neutral: no guard; display absent (NULL) or 0-6 open slots, no CP
                    ok = ok and g_ == 0 and (slots is None or 0 <= slots <= 6) and not cp
                if not ok:
                    cons.append(fid)
    if raw_live:
        flag(fails, "raw_vs_live", raw_live)
    if same:
        flag(fails, "same_read", same)
    if lag:
        flag(fails, "gym_state_lag", lag)
    if cons:
        flag(fails, "gym_consistency", cons)
    if rawold:
        (flag(fails, "raw_age", rawold) if len(rawold) > max(2, RAW_STALE_SHARE * len(rows))
         else flag(warns, "raw_age", rawold))

    # every team change must be followed by a state read and a full-record read
    nev = 0
    if not missing:
        tev = []
        for t, fid, gst, rawt, last in db.execute(
                "SELECT e.t, e.fort, f.gym_state_t, f.raw_t, f.last_seen FROM fort_events e JOIN forts f ON f.id = e.fort"
                " WHERE e.event='team' AND e.t >= ?", (since,)):
            nev += 1
            if gst is None or gst < t:                 # gym state is read on every sighting: never pending
                tev.append(fid)
            elif rawt is None or rawt < t:
                (pend.add(fid) if pending(fid, last, rawt) else tev.append(fid))
        if tev:
            flag(fails, "team_event_refresh", set(tev))
    info["raw_pending"] = len(pend)

    # canary: the gym seen last had its state read AT that sighting (a held gym with a display). Its raw record is not
    # required here: a first sighting may wait one reply for the per-reply full-read cap; raw_vs_live judges raw.
    c = db.execute(f"SELECT id, team, last_seen, {sel} FROM forts WHERE kind='gym' ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
    if c and c[2] >= since and not missing:
        if c[9] != c[2] or (c[1] and c[4] is None):
            flag(fails, "canary", [c[0]])
    info["canary"] = c[0] if c else None

    # read counters from the scanner's JS (reset each self-check)
    if js:
        fu, ff = js.get("fulls", 0), js.get("full_fail", 0)
        if ff >= 3 and ff > 0.01 * fu:
            flag(fails, f"js_full_reads({ff}/{fu} failed)", [], n=ff)
        if js.get("gym_fail"):
            flag(fails, f"js_gym_reads({js['gym_fail']}/{js.get('gyms', 0)} unreadable)", [], n=js["gym_fail"])
        if js.get("gym_nogd"):
            flag(warns, f"js_gym_no_display({js['gym_nogd']})", [], n=js["gym_nogd"])
        info["js"] = js

    # context (never a FAIL): what a consumer must label or exclude
    legacy = 0
    for fid, team, guard, raw in db.execute("SELECT id, team, guard, raw FROM forts WHERE raw IS NOT NULL"):
        o = _raw(raw) or {}
        legacy += int(o.get("Team") or 0) != int(team or 0) or int(o.get("GuardPokemonId") or 0) != int(guard or 0)
    info["legacy_raw_stale"] = legacy
    info["seed_only"] = db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forts WHERE first_seen = '2026-09-25 03:13:57'"
                                   " AND last_seen = '2026-09-25 03:13:57'").fetchone()[0]   # one-time import, never seen live
    info["older_60min"] = db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forts WHERE last_seen < ?", (st(ep(ref) - 3600),)).fetchone()[0]
    info["lure_older_30min"] = db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forts WHERE lured=1 AND last_seen < ?",
                                          (st(ep(ref) - 1800),)).fetchone()[0]
    feeds = {}
    for name, q in (("spawns", "SELECT MAX(t) FROM spawns"), ("weather", "SELECT MAX(t) FROM weather"),
                    ("nearby", "SELECT MAX(t) FROM nearby"), ("raid", "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forts WHERE raid IS NOT NULL"),
                    ("displays", "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forts WHERE displays > 0")):
        try:
            feeds[name] = db.execute(q).fetchone()[0]
        except sqlite3.Error:
            feeds[name] = None
    info["not_collected"] = feeds       # by design since 2026-09-25 (no raid / incident / spawn decode)
    if not missing:
        fresh = db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forts WHERE kind='gym' AND gym_state_t >= ?", (st(ep(ref) - 120),)).fetchone()[0]
        info["gyms_state_2min"] = fresh

    if consumers and os.path.exists(LIVE_DATA):
        try:                            # "stats" is the LAST key of a ~0.5 MB file: read its tail, not its head
            with open(LIVE_DATA, "rb") as fh:
                fh.seek(max(0, os.path.getsize(LIVE_DATA) - 65536))
                txt = fh.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
            if '"last_reply_age_s"' not in txt:
                flag(warns, "map_live_data_unlabelled(no last_reply_age_s; restart map_live.py)", [], n=1)
        except OSError:
            pass
    if consumers:                       # the 2026-09-25 bug class: a bank consumer taking a dynamic value from raw
        hits = []
        for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(HERE, "*.py"))):
            if os.path.basename(p) in LINT_SKIP:
                continue
            try:
                src = open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
            except OSError:
                continue
            if "pogo_wigle.db" not in src:
                continue
            try:                        # string literals only (dict keys), so comments never trip it
                lits = [tk.string for tk in tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(src).readline) if tk.type == tokenize.STRING]
            except (tokenize.TokenError, SyntaxError):
                lits = [src]
            keys = sorted({k for s in lits for k in DYNAMIC_RAW.findall(s)})
            if keys:
                hits.append(f"{os.path.basename(p)}:{'/'.join(keys)}")
        if hits:
            flag(warns, "consumer_reads_dynamic_raw", hits)

    info.update(window_forts=len(rows), window_gyms=ngym, window_stops=nstop, window_raw=nraw, same_read_rows=nsame,
                team_events=nev)
    ok = not fails

    def fmt(x):
        ids = x["ids"]
        more = f" +{x['n'] - len(ids)}" if x["n"] > len(ids) else ""
        return f"{x['check']}={x['n']}" + (f" [{', '.join(ids)}{more}]" if ids else "")

    if missing:
        stamped = "gym state / raw age n/a (pre-fix schema)"
    else:
        stamped = (f"gym state fresh {ngym - len(lag)}/{ngym}, raw<=10min {len(rows) - len(rawold)}/{len(rows)},"
                   f" same-read {nsame - len(same)}/{nsame}, team events {nev}")
    counts = (f"since {since[11:]}: {ngym} gyms {nstop} stops seen, raw==live {nraw - len(raw_live)}/{nraw}, {stamped}"
              f" | last reply {round(age)}s ago | legacy raw stale {legacy}")
    if js:
        counts += f" | js full {js.get('fulls', 0)} fail {js.get('full_fail', 0)}, gym {js.get('gyms', 0)} fail {js.get('gym_fail', 0)}"
    head = "SELFCHECK ok" if ok else "SELFCHECK FAIL " + "; ".join(fmt(x) for x in fails)
    if warns:
        head += " | WARN " + "; ".join(fmt(x) for x in warns)
    return {"ok": ok, "line": f"{head} | {counts}", "fails": fails, "warns": warns, "info": info, "checked_at": st(now)}


def write_health(path, res):
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(res, fh, indent=1)
    for _ in range(5):
        try:
            os.replace(tmp, path)
            return True
        except PermissionError:
            time.sleep(0.2)
    return False


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--db", default=DB)
    ap.add_argument("--window", type=float, default=WINDOW_S / 60, help="minutes before the newest map reply")
    ap.add_argument("--since", help="judge rows seen at/after this local time instead of --window")
    ap.add_argument("--json", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--write-health", action="store_true", help=f"also write {HEALTH}")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    db = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{a.db}?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=10)
    res = run(db, since=a.since, window_s=a.window * 60, consumers=True)
    db.close()
    if a.json:
        print(json.dumps(res, indent=1))
    else:
        print(res["line"])
        for x in res["fails"]:
            print(f"  FAIL {x['check']}: {x['n']}  {' '.join(x['ids'])}")
        for x in res["warns"]:
            print(f"  WARN {x['check']}: {x['n']}  {' '.join(x['ids'])}")
        for k, v in res["info"].items():
            print(f"  info {k}: {v}")
    if a.write_health:
        write_health(HEALTH, res)
    sys.exit(0 if res["ok"] else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`AutoCatcher/tools/battle_probe.py`:

```py
"""Read-only probe: which battle engine do gym battles use in this game version?

Lists every class whose full name looks battle/gym related (metadata only -- nothing in the game is called or
changed), then the methods of the interesting ones. Output: system/analysis/battle_classes.json.

  python tools/battle_probe.py
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(HERE))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402
import dump_game_limits as dl  # noqa: E402

OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(HERE), "system", "analysis", "battle_classes.json")
JS = dl.JS.split("rpc.exports = {")[0] + r"""
var NS = f('il2cpp_class_get_namespace', 'pointer', ['pointer']);
var GM = f('il2cpp_class_get_methods', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']);
var MN = f('il2cpp_method_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']);
var MC = f('il2cpp_method_get_param_count', 'uint32', ['pointer']);
var PN = f('il2cpp_class_get_parent', 'pointer', ['pointer']);
function full(k) { var n = cs(NS(k)); return (n ? n + '.' : '') + cs(IL.className(k)); }
rpc.exports = {
  classes: function (pattern) {
    var re = new RegExp(pattern, 'i'), out = [], cnt = Memory.alloc(PS);
    var arr = IL.asms(IL.domain(), cnt), n = cnt.readU32();
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var img = IL.asmImage(arr.add(i * PS).readPointer()), iname = cs(IL.imageName(img)), c = IL.classCount(img);
      for (var j = 0; j < c; j++) {
        var k = IL.classAt(img, j); if (k.isNull()) continue;
        var nm = full(k);
        if (re.test(nm)) out.push({image: iname, name: nm, parent: (function () { var p = PN(k); return p.isNull() ? '' : full(p); })()});
      }
    }
    return out;
  },
  fieldTypes: function (name) {        /* fields of one class with their type names */
    var cnt = Memory.alloc(PS), arr = IL.asms(IL.domain(), cnt), n = cnt.readU32();
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var img = IL.asmImage(arr.add(i * PS).readPointer()), c = IL.classCount(img);
      for (var j = 0; j < c; j++) { var k = IL.classAt(img, j); if (!k.isNull() && full(k) === name)
        return fieldsOf(k).map(function (x) { return {name: x.name, off: x.off, type: x.tn}; }); }
    }
    return null;
  },
  methods: function (names) {
    var want = {}, res = {}, cnt = Memory.alloc(PS);
    names.forEach(function (x) { want[x] = 1; });
    var arr = IL.asms(IL.domain(), cnt), n = cnt.readU32();
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var img = IL.asmImage(arr.add(i * PS).readPointer()), c = IL.classCount(img);
      for (var j = 0; j < c; j++) {
        var k = IL.classAt(img, j); if (k.isNull()) continue;
        var nm = full(k); if (!want[nm]) continue;
        var ms = [], it = Memory.alloc(PS); it.writePointer(NULL); var m;
        while ((m = GM(k, it)) && !m.isNull()) ms.push(cs(MN(m)) + '/' + MC(m));
        var fs = []; try { fs = fieldsOf(k).map(function (x) { return x.name + '@' + x.off; }); } catch (e) {}
        res[nm] = {methods: ms, fields: fs};
      }
    }
    return res;
  }
};
"""

PATTERN = r"(gym.*(battle|attack|session|combat|fight|lobby|approach)|(battle|attack|session|combat|fight).*gym|vnext\..*(battle|director|gamemode|attack|pokemon|input|state)|battledirector|battlegamemode|battleinput|attackbutton|\.battle\.)"
FOCUS = ("BattleDirector", "GymBattle", "GameMode", "BattleInput", "AttackButton", "BattleUI", "GymBattleVNext", "GymVNext")


def of(cls):
    """--of CLASS: its fields with types, then the methods of every field's class (read-only)."""
    pg.wait_ready_to_attach(timeout_s=300, min_age_s=45)
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = sess.create_script(JS)
    sc.load()
    fields = sc.exports_sync.field_types(cls) or []
    types = sorted({f["type"].split("<")[0] for f in fields if f["type"].startswith(("Niantic.", "Holoholo."))})
    meth = sc.exports_sync.methods(types)
    sc.unload()
    sess.detach()
    for f in fields:
        print(f"  {f['off']:4d}  {f['name']:<40} {f['type']}")
    for t, v in meth.items():
        print(f"\n== {t}\n  methods: {', '.join(v['methods'])}\n  fields: {', '.join(v['fields'][:40])}")


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) > 2 and sys.argv[1] == "--of":
        return of(sys.argv[2])
    pg.wait_ready_to_attach(timeout_s=300, min_age_s=45)
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = sess.create_script(JS)
    sc.load()
    t0 = time.time()
    cls = sc.exports_sync.classes(PATTERN)
    print(f"attached pid {pid}; {len(cls)} matching classes in {time.time() - t0:.1f} s", flush=True)
    names = sorted({c["name"] for c in cls if any(k.lower() in c["name"].lower() for k in FOCUS)})[:80]
    meth = sc.exports_sync.methods(names)
    sc.unload()
    sess.detach()
    json.dump({"read_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "pid": pid, "classes": cls, "detail": meth}, open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=1)
    gym = [c["name"] for c in cls if "gym" in c["name"].lower()]
    vnext = [c["name"] for c in cls if "vnext" in c["name"].lower()]
    print(f"gym-named classes: {len(gym)} | VNext battle classes: {len(vnext)} | detail for {len(meth)} -> {OUT}")
    for n in sorted(gym)[:80]:
        print("  G", n)
    for n in sorted(vnext)[:80]:
        print("  V", n)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
