`AutoCatcher/tools/pogo_wigle.py`:

```py
"""PoGo "WiGLE": a database that grows as you walk. Read-only.

Every map reply the server sends (GetMapObjectsOutProto, every few seconds while moving) is captured the moment it is
parsed and every record in it is stored in SQLite -- no heap scans, no stutter:
  forts     every PokeStop / gym: position, type, team, defender, lure, visited, EX, power-up, image;
            first_seen / last_seen / times_seen, plus a history of changes (fort_events: new, team, lure, defenders, spin).
            Gym state is read on EVERY sighting: slots (open slots; defenders = 6 - slots), gym_cp, motivation (lowest),
            occupied_ms, in_battle, stamped gym_state_t. `raw` is the full record, stamped raw_t; it is re-read when the
            team/guard change or after 5-6 min, so NEVER read a dynamic value from raw -- use the columns + their stamps.
            raid / displays (Rocket, Showcase) are NOT decoded (user, 2026-09-25): NULL means unknown, not "none".
  spawns    every wild Pokemon: species, form, shiny, exact spot, spawn point, time seen, despawn timer
  nearby    every radar entry: species near which stop, distance
  stations  Power Spots: name, position, Max Battle boss, level, window
  routes    in-game Routes (SharedRouteProto) seen in map cells (raw record)
  weather   per S2 cell gameplay weather
  track     where you were (spoofed position + speed) every few seconds

  python tools/pogo_wigle.py            (runs until stopped; re-attaches if PoGo restarts)
Every 5 min it prints one "SELFCHECK ok|FAIL ..." line (tools/audit_bank.py, DB reads only) and writes
system/map/selfcheck.json, which tools/map_live.py shows. On demand: python tools/audit_bank.py
DB: system/map/pogo_wigle.db
"""
import json
import os
import re
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(HERE))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402
import dump_game_limits as dl  # noqa: E402
import audit_bank as ab  # noqa: E402
import quests as qz  # noqa: E402

DEV = os.environ.get("ADB_TARGET", "100.98.158.56:5555")   # cloud: the Tailscale bridge exports ADB_TARGET
DB = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(HERE), "system", "map", "pogo_wigle.db")
SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS forts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, lat REAL, lng REAL, kind TEXT, first_seen TEXT, last_seen TEXT,
  times_seen INT, team INT, guard INT, enabled INT, visited INT, ex INT, lured INT, lure_item INT, displays INT,
  raid TEXT, power_up_pts INT, closed INT, image TEXT, cell TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fort_events (t TEXT, fort TEXT, event TEXT, detail TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spawns (enc TEXT PRIMARY KEY, t TEXT, lat REAL, lng REAL, spawn_point TEXT, pid INT, form INT,
  shiny INT, ttl_ms INT, source TEXT, cell TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nearby (enc TEXT PRIMARY KEY, t TEXT, pid INT, form INT, fort TEXT, dist REAL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stations (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, lat REAL, lng REAL, name TEXT, first_seen TEXT, last_seen TEXT, raw TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS routes (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, first_seen TEXT, last_seen TEXT, raw TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS weather (cell TEXT, t TEXT, cond INT, raw TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (cell, t));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS track (t TEXT, lat REAL, lng REAL, kmh REAL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fort_details (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, t TEXT, name TEXT, description TEXT, images TEXT, raw TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spins (t TEXT, fort TEXT, result INT, xp INT, cooldown TEXT, raw TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS replies (t TEXT, cells INT, forts INT, wild INT, nearby INT, catchable INT, stations INT, routes INT);
""" + qz.SCHEMA
# columns added in place (ALTER TABLE, additive). Gym state is written on EVERY sighting from GymDisplay/IsInBattle;
# raw_t = when `raw` (the full record) was read, so its age is always visible.
NEW_COLS = (("raw", "TEXT"), ("name", "TEXT"), ("slots", "INT"), ("gym_cp", "INT"), ("motivation", "REAL"),
            ("occupied_ms", "INT"), ("in_battle", "INT"), ("gym_state_t", "TEXT"), ("raw_t", "TEXT"))
# raw keys a partial record (see store()) never carries; none of them changes during play
STATIC_RAW = ("Latitude", "Longitude", "FortType", "IsExRaidEligible", "PartnerId", "FortVpsInfo", "ArExperiencesAllowed",
              "IsArScanEligible")
SELFCHECK_EVERY = 300                       # seconds; the self-check reads the DB only
HEALTH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(DB), "selfcheck.json")

JS = dl.JS.split("rpc.exports = {")[0] + r"""
var Q = [], Q2 = [], OFF = {}, LASTP = null, LASTT = 0, HOOKS = 0, FULL = {}, LASTX = {}, GDK = null, GDN = '', DRAINS = 0;
/* FULL[id] = {lm, team, guard, due, t} after a successful full read, {retry, fails, t} after a failed one. The full
   record is re-read when LastModifiedMs changes (it is 0 in every fort seen so far), team or guard changed since the
   last full read, or `due` (5-6 min after it) has passed. A failed read is retried after a back-off (30 s, doubling to
   10 min) -- never on every reply.
   GAME SAFETY: all of this runs INSIDE the game's parse call (a reply carries ~500 forts every ~6 s), so full reads
   are capped per reply: FULL_MAX in total (first sightings included -- the first reply after an attach used to
   full-read every fort in one call), timed and retry reads also within BUDGET. A fort over the cap keeps its reason
   and is read on a later reply. prune() (from drain, outside the game's call) keeps FULL / LASTX bounded. */
var FULL_MS = 300000, FULL_JITTER = 60000, FULL_BUDGET = 25, FULL_MAX = 40, BUDGET = 0, NFULL = 0;
var RETRY_MS = 30000, RETRY_MAX_MS = 600000, CACHE_TTL_MS = 3600000, GD_FIELDS = ['SlotsAvailable', 'TotalGymCp', 'LowestPokemonMotivation', 'OccupiedMillis'];
var STAT = {fulls: 0, full_fail: 0, gyms: 0, gym_fail: 0, gym_nogd: 0};
function offs(cls, names) { var k = findClass('holo-protos.dll', cls), o = {}; if (!k) return null;
  fieldsOf(k).forEach(function (f) { if (names.indexOf(f.name) >= 0) o[f.name] = f.off; }); return o; }
function rep(p) { if (p.isNull()) return []; var a = p.add(0x10).readPointer(), n = p.add(0x18).readS32(), out = [];
  if (a.isNull() || n <= 0 || n > 5000) return out; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(a.add(0x20 + 8 * i).readPointer()); return out; }
function repInt(p) { if (p.isNull()) return []; var a = p.add(0x10).readPointer(), n = p.add(0x18).readS32(), out = [];
  if (a.isNull() || n <= 0 || n > 64) return out; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(a.add(0x20 + 4 * i).readS32()); return out; }
function S(o, off) { return str(o.add(off).readPointer()); }
function gdv(gd, n) {             /* one GymDisplay field, typed by il2cpp metadata; plain memory read */
  var d = OFF.gd[n], v = d ? prim(gd.add(d.off), d.te) : undefined;
  if (v === undefined) throw new Error(n); return v;
}
function readGym(f, r) {          /* dynamic gym state, read on EVERY sighting -- never taken from the cached full record.
     GAME SAFETY (this runs ~50-100x per reply): plain memory reads at offsets resolved from metadata at install. The
     GymDisplay pointer comes out of object memory, so it is never handed to an il2cpp function (readObj would pass its
     class to il2cpp_class_get_fields), and its fields are read only after its class pointer is GymDisplay's own. */
  var O = OFF.fort, gs = r.gs = {battle: null}; STAT.gyms++;
  try {
    if (O.IsInBattle !== undefined) gs.battle = f.add(O.IsInBattle).readU8();
    if (O.GymDisplay === undefined || !GDK) { STAT.gym_fail++; gs.err = 'no GymDisplay offset'; return; }
    var gd = f.add(O.GymDisplay).readPointer();
    if (gd.isNull()) { if (r.team) STAT.gym_nogd++; gs.err = 'GymDisplay null'; return; }   /* neutral: store() stamps it NULL */
    if (!gd.readPointer().equals(GDK) && jsClass(gd).name !== GDN) { STAT.gym_fail++; gs.err = 'GymDisplay wrong class'; return; }
    /* proto3: an unset field reads as 0 -- SlotsAvailable 0 = no open slot = full gym (6 defenders) */
    gs.slots = gdv(gd, 'SlotsAvailable'); gs.cp = gdv(gd, 'TotalGymCp'); gs.mot = gdv(gd, 'LowestPokemonMotivation');
    gs.occ = String(gdv(gd, 'OccupiedMillis'));
  } catch (e) { STAT.gym_fail++; r.gs = {battle: gs.battle, err: 'unreadable ' + e.message}; }
}
function readFort(f) {
  var O = OFF.fort;
  var r = {id: S(f, O.FortId), lat: f.add(O.Latitude).readDouble(), lng: f.add(O.Longitude).readDouble(),
    type: f.add(O.FortType).readS32(), team: f.add(O.Team).readS32(), guard: f.add(O.GuardPokemonId).readS32(),
    en: f.add(O.Enabled).readU8(), vis: f.add(O.Visited).readU8(), ex: f.add(O.IsExRaidEligible).readU8(),
    lure: repInt(f.add(O.ActiveFortModifier).readPointer()), pup: f.add(O.PowerUpProgressPoints).readS32(),
    closed: f.add(O.Closed).readU8(), img: S(f, O.ImageUrl)};
  if (!r.id) return r;             /* store() drops a fort without an id: spend nothing more on it inside the game */
  if (r.type !== 1) readGym(f, r); /* stops carry a placeholder GymDisplay (6 slots, motivation 1): never read */
  var lm = f.add(O.LastModifiedMs).readS64().toString(), now = Date.now(), c = FULL[r.id], why = null;
  if (!c) why = 'new';
  else if (c.retry) why = now >= c.retry ? 'retry' : null;          /* last read failed: wait out the back-off */
  else if (c.lm !== lm) why = 'modified';
  else if (c.team !== r.team || c.guard !== r.guard) why = 'team';
  else if (now >= c.due) why = 'age';
  var timed = why === 'age' || why === 'retry';
  if (why && (NFULL <= 0 || (timed && BUDGET <= 0))) why = null;    /* over this reply's cap: a later reply reads it */
  if (why) {
    NFULL--; if (timed) BUDGET--;
    STAT.fulls++;
    var full = null; try { full = readObj(f, 3); } catch (e) { full = null; }
    if (full && typeof full === 'object' && full.FortId === r.id) {
      r.full = full; r.full_why = why;
      FULL[r.id] = {lm: lm, team: r.team, guard: r.guard, t: now, due: now + FULL_MS + Math.floor(Math.random() * FULL_JITTER)};
    } else {                       /* counted, and retried after a back-off -- not on every reply */
      STAT.full_fail++; var nf = ((c && c.fails) || 0) + 1;
      FULL[r.id] = {t: now, fails: nf, retry: now + Math.min(RETRY_MAX_MS, RETRY_MS * Math.pow(2, nf - 1))};
    }
  }
  return r;                        /* no raid / incident decode (user, 2026-09-25): those columns stay NULL = unknown */
}
function enumMap(name, probe) {   /* {value: name} of a holo-protos enum; install-time metadata read only */
  var sgv = EX['il2cpp_field_static_get_value'] ? new NativeFunction(EX['il2cpp_field_static_get_value'], 'void', ['pointer', 'pointer'], PROP) : null;
  if (!sgv) return null;
  var sp = Memory.alloc(4), a = IL.asms(IL.domain(), sp), n = sp.readS32(), buf = Memory.alloc(16);
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    var im = IL.asmImage(a.add(i * PS).readPointer()); if (cs(IL.imageName(im)) !== 'holo-protos.dll') continue;
    var c = IL.classCount(im);
    for (var j = 0; j < c; j++) {
      var k = IL.classAt(im, j); if (k.isNull() || cs(IL.className(k)) !== name || !IL.isEnum(k)) continue;
      var out = {}, hit = false, it = Memory.alloc(PS); it.writePointer(NULL); var fd;
      while ((fd = IL.fields(k, it)) && !fd.isNull()) {
        if ((IL.fieldFlags(fd) & 0x50) !== 0x50) continue;          /* static + literal = the enum's named values */
        buf.writeU64(0); sgv(fd, buf); var nm = cs(IL.fieldName(fd)); out[buf.readS32()] = nm; if (probe.test(nm)) hit = true;
      }
      if (hit) return out;
    }
  }
  return null;
}
function prune() {                 /* bounded caches; runs from drain(), never inside the game's parse call */
  var now = Date.now(), id, k;
  for (id in FULL) if (now - FULL[id].t > CACHE_TTL_MS) delete FULL[id];    /* in view = re-read every 5-6 min */
  for (k in LASTX) if (now - LASTX[k] > 60000) delete LASTX[k];
}
function readWild(w) {
  var O = OFF.wild, pk = w.add(O.Pokemon).readPointer(), pid = 0, form = 0, shiny = 0;
  if (!pk.isNull()) { pid = pk.add(OFF.pk.pid).readS32(); var dp = pk.add(OFF.pk.disp).readPointer();
    if (!dp.isNull()) { form = dp.add(OFF.disp.Form).readS32(); shiny = dp.add(OFF.disp.Shiny).readU8(); } }
  return {enc: w.add(O.EncounterId).readU64().toString(), lat: w.add(O.Latitude).readDouble(), lng: w.add(O.Longitude).readDouble(),
          sp: S(w, O.SpawnPointId), pid: pid, form: form, shiny: shiny, ttl: w.add(O.TimeTillHiddenMs).readS32()};
}
function readNear(n) {
  var O = OFF.near, dp = n.add(O.PokemonDisplay).readPointer();
  return {enc: n.add(O.EncounterId).readU64().toString(), pid: n.add(O.PokedexNumber).readS32(), dist: n.add(O.DistanceMeters).readFloat(),
          fort: S(n, O.FortId), form: dp.isNull() ? 0 : dp.add(OFF.disp.Form).readS32()};
}
function onReply(g) {
  var now = Date.now(); if (LASTP && g.equals(LASTP) && now - LASTT < 1500) return; LASTP = g; LASTT = now; BUDGET = FULL_BUDGET; NFULL = FULL_MAX;
  var cells = rep(g.add(OFF.gmo.MapCell).readPointer()), out = {t: now, cells: []};
  cells.forEach(function (c) {
    var C = OFF.cell, cid = c.add(C.S2CellId).readU64().toString(), rec = {cell: cid, forts: [], wild: [], near: [], catch: [], st: [], rt: 0};
    try { rep(c.add(C.Fort).readPointer()).forEach(function (f) { try { rec.forts.push(readFort(f)); } catch (e) {} }); } catch (e) {}
    try { rep(c.add(C.Stations).readPointer()).forEach(function (s) { try { rec.st.push(readObj(s, 2)); } catch (e) {} }); } catch (e) {}
    try { var rr = rep(c.add(C.Routes).readPointer()); rec.rt = rr.length; if (rr.length) { rec.routes = []; rr.forEach(function (x) { try { rec.routes.push(readObj(x, 2)); } catch (e) {} }); } } catch (e) {}
    out.cells.push(rec);
  });
  Q.push(out); if (Q.length > 200) Q.shift();
  LASTT = Date.now();              /* de-dup window runs from the END: a slow pass is not re-run by the outer parse method */
}
rpc.exports = {
  install: function () {
    OFF.gmo = offs('GetMapObjectsOutProto', ['MapCell', 'ClientWeather']);
    OFF.cell = offs('ClientMapCellProto', ['S2CellId', 'Fort', 'WildPokemon', 'NearbyPokemon', 'CatchablePokemon', 'Stations', 'Routes']);
    OFF.fort = offs('PokemonFortProto', ['FortId', 'Latitude', 'Longitude', 'FortType', 'Team', 'GuardPokemonId', 'Enabled', 'Visited',
      'IsExRaidEligible', 'ActiveFortModifier', 'PokestopDisplays', 'PowerUpProgressPoints', 'Closed', 'ImageUrl', 'RaidInfo', 'LastModifiedMs', 'GymDisplay', 'IsInBattle']);
    /* GymDisplay's class + field offsets/types come from il2cpp METADATA (the declared type of PokemonFortProto.GymDisplay),
       never from object memory; readGym then needs no il2cpp call at all. All four fields or none (= counted gym_fail).
       A failure here must never fail install(): that would make the scanner detach/re-attach in a loop. */
    OFF.gd = {};
    try {
      var fk = findClass('holo-protos.dll', 'PokemonFortProto');
      if (fk) fieldsOf(fk).forEach(function (fd) {
        if (fd.name !== 'GymDisplay') return;
        var gk = IL.classFromType(fd.t); if (!gk || gk.isNull()) return;
        var gf = {}; fieldsOf(gk).forEach(function (g) { if (GD_FIELDS.indexOf(g.name) >= 0) gf[g.name] = {off: g.off, te: g.te}; });
        OFF.gd = gf;
        if (GD_FIELDS.every(function (n) { return gf[n] !== undefined; })) { GDK = gk; GDN = cs(IL.className(gk)); }
      });
    } catch (e) { GDK = null; OFF.gd = {err: String(e)}; }
    OFF.wild = offs('WildPokemonProto', ['EncounterId', 'Latitude', 'Longitude', 'SpawnPointId', 'Pokemon', 'TimeTillHiddenMs']);
    OFF.near = offs('NearbyPokemonProto', ['PokedexNumber', 'DistanceMeters', 'EncounterId', 'FortId', 'PokemonDisplay']);
    var pk = offs('PokemonProto', ['pokemonId_', 'PokemonId', 'pokemonDisplay_', 'PokemonDisplay']);
    OFF.pk = {pid: pk.pokemonId_ !== undefined ? pk.pokemonId_ : pk.PokemonId, disp: pk.pokemonDisplay_ !== undefined ? pk.pokemonDisplay_ : pk.PokemonDisplay};
    OFF.disp = offs('PokemonDisplayProto', ['Form', 'Shiny']);
    var getM = new NativeFunction(EX['il2cpp_class_get_methods'], 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer'], PROP);
    var mName = new NativeFunction(EX['il2cpp_method_get_name'], 'pointer', ['pointer'], PROP);
    var mArgs = new NativeFunction(EX['il2cpp_method_get_param_count'], 'uint32', ['pointer'], PROP);
    function hookParse(cls, fn) {   /* every 1-arg parse method (MergeFrom + the obfuscated internal one) */
      var k = findClass('holo-protos.dll', cls), n = 0; if (!k) return 0;
      var it = Memory.alloc(PS); it.writePointer(NULL); var m;
      while ((m = getM(k, it)) && !m.isNull()) {
        var nm = cs(mName(m));
        if (mArgs(m) !== 1 || ['WriteTo', 'Equals', '.ctor', 'CalculateSize'].indexOf(nm) >= 0) continue;
        Interceptor.attach(m.readPointer(), {onEnter: function (a) { this.g = a[0]; }, onLeave: function () { try { fn(this.g); } catch (e) {} }});
        n++;
      }
      return n;
    }
    function extra(kind, depth) { return function (g) { var now = Date.now(), key = kind + g;
      if (LASTX[key] && now - LASTX[key] < 1500) return; LASTX[key] = now;
      try { Q2.push({k: kind, t: now, o: readObj(g, depth === undefined ? 3 : depth)}); } catch (e) {} if (Q2.length > 300) Q2.shift(); }; }
    /* a spin's task sits 5 levels down (spin > ChallengeQuest > Quest > reward > MegaResource): read from depth 1.
       One read per spin, and only a hand spin reaches this process. */
    var EN = {};
    try { EN.Item = enumMap('Item', /^(Item)?RareCandy$/); } catch (e) { EN.Item = null; }
    try { EN.HoloPokemonId = enumMap('HoloPokemonId', /^Bulbasaur$/i); } catch (e) { EN.HoloPokemonId = null; }
    HOOKS = hookParse('GetMapObjectsOutProto', onReply);
    var hd = hookParse('FortDetailsOutProto', extra('details')), hs = hookParse('FortSearchOutProto', extra('spin', 1));
    return {hooks: HOOKS, details_hooks: hd, spin_hooks: hs, off: OFF, enums: EN};
  },
  drain: function () { var q = Q, x = Q2, s = STAT; Q = []; Q2 = [];
    STAT = {fulls: 0, full_fail: 0, gyms: 0, gym_fail: 0, gym_nogd: 0};
    if (++DRAINS % 150 === 0) { try { prune(); } catch (e) {} }     /* ~every 5 min at the scanner's 2 s poll */
    return {replies: q, extras: x, stat: s}; }
};
"""


def adb(cmd):
    return subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", DEV, "shell", cmd], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8",
                          errors="replace", env=dict(os.environ, MSYS_NO_PATHCONV="1")).stdout or ""


def me():
    m = re.search(r"Location\[gps ([-0-9.]+),([-0-9.]+) .*?vel=([0-9.]+)", adb("dumpsys location | grep -m1 'last mock location'"))
    return (float(m[1]), float(m[2]), round(float(m[3]) * 3.6, 2)) if m else None


def ts(ms):
    return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ms / 1000))


def _num(v, cast):
    try:
        return cast(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def ensure_columns(db):
    """Additive schema upgrade: never drops or rewrites anything. The new gym-state columns start NULL (= unknown);
    they are NOT back-filled from `raw`, because `raw` is exactly the stale first-sighting copy this fixes."""
    cols = {r[1] for r in db.execute("PRAGMA table_info(forts)")}
    for c, typ in NEW_COLS:
        if c not in cols:
            db.execute(f"ALTER TABLE forts ADD COLUMN {c} {typ}")
    db.commit()


def store(db, rep_):
    t = ts(rep_["t"])
    nf = nw = nn = nc = ns = nr = 0
    for c in rep_["cells"]:
        for f in c["forts"]:
            if not f.get("id"):
                continue
            nf += 1
            lured = 1 if f["lure"] else 0
            # raid / incident are not decoded (user, 2026-09-25): store NULL (= unknown), never 0 / "none"
            disp = f.get("disp") if "disp" in f else None
            rocket = sum(1 for d in disp or [] if isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("IncidentDisplayType"))
            raid = json.dumps(f["raid"]) if f.get("raid") else None
            ndisp = len(disp) if disp is not None else None
            row = db.execute("SELECT team, lured, displays, raid, visited, slots, last_seen, kind FROM forts WHERE id=?", (f["id"],)).fetchone()
            if row is not None and row[6] and row[6] > t:
                continue                # a reply older than what the bank already holds never overwrites it
            # game 0.435.0 resends a fort it already holds as a PARTIAL record (2026-10-31): the changing fields only --
            # no position and no FortType (which then reads 0 = gym). It never places, types or creates a fort.
            partial = not f["lat"] and not f["lng"]
            if partial and row is None:
                continue                # banked when the game sends its full record
            kind = row[7] if partial else ("stop" if f["type"] == 1 else "gym")
            if row is None:
                db.execute("INSERT INTO forts (id, lat, lng, kind, first_seen, last_seen, times_seen, team, guard, enabled,"
                           " visited, ex, lured, lure_item, displays, raid, power_up_pts, closed, image, cell)"
                           " VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                           (f["id"], f["lat"], f["lng"], kind, t, t, 1, f["team"], f["guard"], f["en"], f["vis"], f["ex"], lured,
                            f["lure"][0] if f["lure"] else None, ndisp, raid, f["pup"], f["closed"], f["img"], c["cell"]))
                db.execute("INSERT INTO fort_events VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (t, f["id"], "new", kind))
            else:
                if kind == "gym" and row[0] != f["team"]:
                    db.execute("INSERT INTO fort_events VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (t, f["id"], "team", f"{row[0]}->{f['team']}"))
                if lured and not row[1]:
                    db.execute("INSERT INTO fort_events VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (t, f["id"], "lure", str(f["lure"])))
                if rocket and not row[2]:
                    db.execute("INSERT INTO fort_events VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (t, f["id"], "incident", json.dumps(f.get("disp"))[:500]))
                if raid and raid != row[3]:
                    db.execute("INSERT INTO fort_events VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (t, f["id"], "raid", raid[:500]))
                if partial:             # position, kind, EX and image stay as the last full record gave them
                    db.execute("""UPDATE forts SET last_seen=?, times_seen=times_seen+1, team=?, guard=?, enabled=?, visited=?,
                                  lured=?, lure_item=?, displays=?, raid=?, power_up_pts=?, closed=? WHERE id=?""",
                               (t, f["team"], f["guard"], f["en"], f["vis"], lured, f["lure"][0] if f["lure"] else None,
                                ndisp, raid, f["pup"], f["closed"], f["id"]))
                else:
                    db.execute("""UPDATE forts SET lat=?, lng=?, kind=?, last_seen=?, times_seen=times_seen+1, team=?, guard=?, enabled=?,
                                  visited=?, ex=?, lured=?, lure_item=?, displays=?, raid=?, power_up_pts=?, closed=?,
                                  image=COALESCE(?, image) WHERE id=?""",
                               (f["lat"], f["lng"], kind, t, f["team"], f["guard"], f["en"], f["vis"], f["ex"], lured,
                                f["lure"][0] if f["lure"] else None, ndisp, raid, f["pup"], f["closed"], f["img"], f["id"]))
            gs = f.get("gs") if kind == "gym" else None
            # a NEUTRAL gym whose reply has no GymDisplay was still read at this sighting: stamp it with NULL slots / CP
            # (= not reported), so the self-check does not call it lagging; a HELD gym without one stays an error
            if gs is not None and ("err" not in gs or (gs["err"] == "GymDisplay null" and not f["team"])):
                slots = _num(gs.get("slots"), int)
                if row is not None and row[5] is not None and slots is not None and slots != row[5]:
                    was, now_ = (6 - row[5] if row[0] else 0), (6 - slots if f["team"] else 0)   # neutral = 0 defenders
                    db.execute("INSERT INTO fort_events VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                               (t, f["id"], "defenders", f"{was}->{now_} (slots {row[5]}->{slots})"))
                # read from THIS sighting only; the guard stops an older reply from overwriting a newer state
                db.execute("UPDATE forts SET slots=?, gym_cp=?, motivation=?, occupied_ms=?, in_battle=?, gym_state_t=?"
                           " WHERE id=? AND (gym_state_t IS NULL OR gym_state_t <= ?)",
                           (slots, _num(gs.get("cp"), int), _num(gs.get("mot"), float), _num(gs.get("occ"), int),
                            None if gs.get("battle") is None else (1 if gs["battle"] else 0), t, f["id"], t))
            if f.get("full"):
                full = f["full"]
                if partial:             # a partial full-read keeps the static fields of the record it replaces
                    old = ab._raw(db.execute("SELECT raw FROM forts WHERE id=?", (f["id"],)).fetchone()[0]) or {}
                    full = dict(full, **{k: old[k] for k in STATIC_RAW if k in old and k not in full})
                db.execute("UPDATE forts SET raw=?, raw_t=? WHERE id=? AND (raw_t IS NULL OR raw_t <= ?)",
                           (json.dumps(full), t, f["id"], t))
        for w in c["wild"]:
            nw += 1
            db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO spawns VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                       (w["enc"], t, w["lat"], w["lng"], w["sp"], w["pid"], w["form"], w["shiny"], w["ttl"], "wild", c["cell"]))
        for m in c["catch"]:
            nc += 1
            disp = m.get("PokemonDisplay") or {}
            db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO spawns VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                       (str(m.get("EncounterId")), t, m.get("Latitude"), m.get("Longitude"), m.get("SpawnPointId"),
                        m.get("PokedexTypeId") or m.get("PokemonId"), disp.get("Form"), 1 if disp.get("Shiny") else 0,
                        m.get("ExpirationTimeMs"), "catchable", c["cell"]))
        for n in c["near"]:
            nn += 1
            db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO nearby VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)", (n["enc"], t, n["pid"], n["form"], n["fort"], n["dist"]))
        for s in c["st"]:
            ns += 1
            sid = s.get("Id")
            if sid:
                if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM stations WHERE id=?", (sid,)).fetchone():
                    db.execute("UPDATE stations SET last_seen=?, raw=? WHERE id=?", (t, json.dumps(s), sid))
                else:
                    db.execute("INSERT INTO stations VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (sid, s.get("Lat"), s.get("Lng"), s.get("Name"), t, t, json.dumps(s)))
        for r in c.get("routes") or []:
            nr += 1
            rid = r.get("Id") or json.dumps(r)[:80]
            if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM routes WHERE id=?", (rid,)).fetchone():
                db.execute("UPDATE routes SET last_seen=?, raw=? WHERE id=?", (t, json.dumps(r), rid))
            else:
                db.execute("INSERT INTO routes VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (rid, t, t, json.dumps(r)))
    for w in rep_.get("weather") or []:
        db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO weather VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (str(w.get("S2CellId")), t[:16],
                   (w.get("GameplayWeather") or {}).get("GameplayCondition"), json.dumps(w)))
    db.execute("INSERT INTO replies VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (t, len(rep_["cells"]), nf, nw, nn, nc, ns, nr))
    return nf, nw, nn, nc, ns, nr


def store_extra(db, x):
    t, o = ts(x["t"]), x.get("o") or {}
    if x["k"] == "details" and o.get("Id"):
        imgs = o.get("ImageUrl") if isinstance(o.get("ImageUrl"), list) else [o.get("ImageUrl")]
        db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO fort_details VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                   (o["Id"], t, o.get("Name"), o.get("Description"), json.dumps(imgs), json.dumps(o)))
        db.execute("UPDATE forts SET name=? WHERE id=?", (o.get("Name"), o["Id"]))
        return "details"
    if x["k"] == "spin" and o.get("FortId"):
        cd = o.get("CooldownComplete")
        db.execute("INSERT INTO spins VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)", (t, o["FortId"], o.get("Result"), o.get("XpAwarded"),
                   ts(int(cd)) if cd else None, json.dumps(o)[:20000]))
        db.execute("INSERT INTO fort_events VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (t, o["FortId"], "spin", str(o.get("Result"))))
        try:
            q = qz.store(db, t, o)
        except Exception as qe:                            # a quest that will not decode must never cost the spin row
            q = f"quest not decoded ({type(qe).__name__}: {str(qe)[:80]})"
        return ("quest", o["FortId"], q) if q else "spin"
    return None


def main():
    if "Pixel" not in adb("getprop ro.product.model"):
        sys.exit("not the phone")
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(DB), exist_ok=True)
    db = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    db.executescript(SCHEMA)
    ensure_columns(db)
    started = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")          # the self-check only judges rows written by this code
    print(f"{started[11:]} scanner started; self-check every {SELFCHECK_EVERY // 60} min", flush=True)
    sess = sc = None
    last_track, last_report, last_check = 0, 0, time.time()
    jsw = {}                                               # JS read counters since the last self-check
    while True:
        try:
            if sc is None:
                pg.wait_ready_to_attach(timeout_s=900, min_age_s=45)
                sess, pid = pg.get_session()
                sc = sess.create_script(JS)
                sc.load()
                info = sc.exports_sync.install()
                print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} attached pid {pid}; hooks: map {info['hooks']}, details {info['details_hooks']}, spins {info['spin_hooks']}", flush=True)
                en = info.get("enums") or {}
                qz.save_enums({k: v for k, v in en.items() if v})
                print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} enums: Item {len(en.get('Item') or {})} names, HoloPokemonId {len(en.get('HoloPokemonId') or {})} names"
                      + ("" if en.get("Item") and en.get("HoloPokemonId") else " -- WARNING missing: quest rewards will show ids"), flush=True)
                off = info.get("off") or {}
                miss = [k for k in ("GymDisplay", "IsInBattle") if k not in (off.get("fort") or {})]
                miss += ["GymDisplay." + k for k in ("SlotsAvailable", "TotalGymCp", "LowestPokemonMotivation", "OccupiedMillis")
                         if k not in (off.get("gd") or {})]
                if miss:
                    print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} WARNING PokemonFortProto has no {miss}: gym state will not be read", flush=True)
                # a fresh attach full-reads its first ~500 forts at 40 per reply (~75 s): no self-check inside that
                last_check = max(last_check, time.time() - SELFCHECK_EVERY + 120)
            tot = [0] * 6
            got = sc.exports_sync.drain()
            for k, v in (got.get("stat") or {}).items():
                jsw[k] = jsw.get(k, 0) + v
            for r in got["replies"]:
                for i, v in enumerate(store(db, r)):
                    tot[i] += v
            for x in got["extras"]:
                res = store_extra(db, x)
                if res == "details":
                    print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} named: {(x.get('o') or {}).get('Name')}", flush=True)
                elif isinstance(res, tuple) and res[0] == "quest":
                    nm = (db.execute("SELECT name FROM forts WHERE id=?", (res[1],)).fetchone() or [None])[0]
                    print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} QUEST {nm or res[1]}: {res[2]}", flush=True)
            if time.time() - last_track >= 5:
                p = me()
                if p:
                    db.execute("INSERT INTO track VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), p[0], p[1], p[2]))
                last_track = time.time()
            db.commit()
            if time.time() - last_report >= 60:
                c = db.execute("SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forts WHERE kind='stop'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forts WHERE kind='gym'),"
                               " (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spawns), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nearby), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stations),"
                               " (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM routes), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM replies), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forts WHERE raw IS NOT NULL),"
                               " (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fort_details), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spins)").fetchone()
                print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} DB: {c[0]} stops, {c[1]} gyms, {c[2]} spawns, {c[3]} radar, {c[4]} Power Spots,"
                      f" {c[5]} in-game routes | full records {c[7]}, named {c[8]}, spins {c[9]} | map replies {c[6]}", flush=True)
                last_report = time.time()
            if time.time() - last_check >= SELFCHECK_EVERY:
                last_check = time.time()
                try:                                       # a failing check must never cost the attach
                    # rolling window (10 min > the 5 min period, so every sighting is judged at least once), never
                    # before this scanner started: one past glitch cannot hold FAIL for the rest of the session
                    res = ab.run(db, floor=started, js=jsw, consumers=True)
                    print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {res['line']}", flush=True)
                    ab.write_health(HEALTH, res)
                except Exception as ce:
                    print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} SELFCHECK ERROR {type(ce).__name__}: {str(ce)[:150]}", flush=True)
                jsw = {}
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:150]} -- re-attaching", flush=True)
            try:
                sess and sess.detach()
            except Exception:
                pass
            sess = sc = None
            time.sleep(5)
        time.sleep(2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`AutoCatcher/tools/quests.py`:

```py
"""Field Research tasks, read from the player's OWN spins (FortSearchOutProto.ChallengeQuest).

A stop's task is only revealed by spinning it, so this bank only holds stops you spun yourself (by hand: the virtual
GO Plus spins in the :pgp process, which the scanner does not hook). Tasks rotate at local midnight, so rows are keyed
by (day, fort) and the map shows today's only.

Names come from the game's own enums (Item, HoloPokemonId), read by the scanner at attach and saved to
system/map/enums.json -- never from a hard-coded id table (1301 vs 902 for Rare Candy was already wrong once).
Used by tools/pogo_wigle.py (store) and tools/map_live.py (read).
"""
import json
import os
import re

ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), os.pardir))
ENUMS = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "map", "enums.json")
SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quests (day TEXT, fort TEXT, t TEXT, template TEXT, goal INT, rewards TEXT, mega_pid INT,
  mega_name TEXT, mega_amount INT, rare_candy INT, summary TEXT, raw TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (day, fort));
"""
REWARD_KEYS = ("MegaResource", "Item", "Candy", "XlCandy", "Stardust", "Exp", "PokemonEncounter", "Pokecoin", "Sticker",
               "AvatarTemplateId", "LevelCap", "Incident", "PlayerAttribute", "NeutralAvatarItemTemplate")
_cache = {"mtime": None, "enums": {}}


def save_enums(enums):
    if not enums:
        return
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(ENUMS), exist_ok=True)
    tmp = ENUMS + ".tmp"
    json.dump(enums, open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8"))
    os.replace(tmp, ENUMS)


def enums():
    try:
        m = os.path.getmtime(ENUMS)
    except OSError:
        return {}
    if m != _cache["mtime"]:
        try:
            _cache["enums"] = json.load(open(ENUMS, encoding="utf-8"))
            _cache["mtime"] = m
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            pass
    return _cache["enums"]


def human(name):
    """RareCandy -> Rare Candy; keeps unknown ids readable."""
    return re.sub(r"(?<=[a-z0-9])(?=[A-Z])", " ", str(name))


def _name(kind, v):
    table = (enums().get(kind) or {})
    n = table.get(str(v))
    return n if n else f"{kind} {v}"


def _int(v):
    try:
        return int(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0


def _walk(o):
    if isinstance(o, dict):
        yield o
        for v in o.values():
            yield from _walk(v)
    elif isinstance(o, list):
        for v in o:
            yield from _walk(v)


def rewards(quest):
    """Every reward dict inside the quest subtree (a dict with a Type and a known reward key)."""
    out = []
    for d in _walk(quest):
        keys = [k for k in REWARD_KEYS if k in d]
        if not keys or "Type" not in d:
            continue
        k = keys[0]
        v = d[k]
        if k == "MegaResource" and isinstance(v, dict):
            pid = _int(v.get("PokemonId"))
            out.append({"kind": "mega", "pid": pid, "name": _name("HoloPokemonId", pid), "amount": _int(v.get("Amount"))})
        elif k == "Item" and isinstance(v, dict):
            it = _int(v.get("Item"))
            out.append({"kind": "item", "item": it, "name": _name("Item", it), "amount": _int(v.get("Amount") or v.get("ItemCount"))})
        elif k in ("Candy", "XlCandy") and isinstance(v, dict):
            pid = _int(v.get("PokemonId"))
            out.append({"kind": k.lower(), "pid": pid, "name": _name("HoloPokemonId", pid), "amount": _int(v.get("Amount"))})
        elif k == "PokemonEncounter" and isinstance(v, dict):
            pid = _int(v.get("PokemonId"))
            out.append({"kind": "encounter", "pid": pid, "name": _name("HoloPokemonId", pid)})
        elif k in ("Stardust", "Exp", "Pokecoin"):
            out.append({"kind": k.lower(), "amount": _int(v)})
        else:
            out.append({"kind": k, "raw": v if isinstance(v, (int, str)) else None})
    return out


def describe(rw):
    parts = []
    for r in rw:
        k = r["kind"]
        if k == "mega":
            parts.append(f"{human(r['name'])} Mega Energy x{r['amount']}")
        elif k == "item":
            parts.append(f"{human(r['name'])} x{r['amount']}")
        elif k in ("candy", "xlcandy"):
            parts.append(f"{human(r['name'])} {'XL ' if k == 'xlcandy' else ''}Candy x{r['amount']}")
        elif k == "encounter":
            parts.append(f"{human(r['name'])} encounter")
        elif k in ("stardust", "exp", "pokecoin"):
            parts.append(f"{r['amount']} {k}")
        else:
            parts.append(k)
    return ", ".join(parts) or "no reward decoded"


def store(db, t, spin):
    """Record the task a spin handed out. Returns the summary, or None when the spin carried no task."""
    q = spin.get("ChallengeQuest")
    if not isinstance(q, dict) or not q:
        return None
    rw = rewards(q)
    mega = next((r for r in rw if r["kind"] == "mega"), None)
    rare = sum(r.get("amount", 0) for r in rw if r["kind"] == "item" and re.search(r"RareCandy", str(r["name"]), re.I))
    tpl = next((d.get("TemplateId") for d in _walk(q) if isinstance(d.get("TemplateId"), str)), None)
    goal = next((_int(d["Goal"].get("Target")) for d in _walk(q) if isinstance(d.get("Goal"), dict)), 0)
    summary = describe(rw)
    db.executescript(SCHEMA)
    db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO quests VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
               (t[:10], spin.get("FortId"), t, tpl, goal, json.dumps(rw), mega["pid"] if mega else None,
                mega["name"] if mega else None, mega["amount"] if mega else None, rare or None, summary, json.dumps(q)[:20000]))
    return summary


def today(db, day):
    """{fort_id: {summary, kind: 'mega'|'rare'|'other', ...}} for the given local day; {} when there is no table yet."""
    if not db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='quests'").fetchone():
        return {}
    out = {}
    for fort, s, mn, ma, rc, tpl, goal in db.execute(
            "SELECT fort, summary, mega_name, mega_amount, rare_candy, template, goal FROM quests WHERE day=?", (day,)):
        out[fort] = {"s": s, "k": "mega" if mn else ("rare" if rc else "other"), "tpl": tpl, "goal": goal}
    return out
```

`AutoCatcher/tools/reward_sim.js`:

```js
const fs=require('fs');
function run(name, scen){
  const src=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2]||'rc.js','utf8');
  const f=new Function('ptr','Process','Memory','Interceptor', src+`
   ;return {get:(k)=>eval(k), set:(k,v)=>eval(k+'=v'), tick:()=>tick()};`);
  // minimal fakes
  const P=(v)=>({v, isNull:()=>v===0, equals:(o)=>o.v===v});
  const api=f(P, {pointerSize:8}, {}, {});
  let queue=scen.rewards.slice(), box=100, thrown=[], openFrame=0, cur=null, frame=0, pendingClear=null;
  // override game calls
  api.set('getDangling', function(t){ if(pendingClear&&frame>=pendingClear.at){ queue=queue.filter(x=>x!==pendingClear.id); pendingClear=null;} return queue.length? P(queue[0]) : P(0); });
  api.set('openEnc', function(p){ cur=p.v; api.set('ACTIVE_QMP', P(1)); });
  api.set('qmpId', function(){ return String(cur); });
  api.set('readBox', function(){ return box; });
  api.set('fireCatch', function(){ thrown.push([frame,cur]); const r=scen.onThrow(cur, thrown.filter(x=>x[1]===cur).length);
       if(r.register){ box+=1; pendingClear={id:cur, at:frame+(r.clearAfter||5)}; } });
  api.set('nowMs', ()=>frame*1000/60);   // the catcher waits in ms (2026-09-30): the sim's clock runs 60 fps
  api.set('RUN', true); api.set('ST', 0); api.set('BALL',1); api.set('TYPES',[4]); api.set('MAX',0);
  for(frame=0; frame<5000 && api.get('RUN'); frame++){ if(pendingClear&&frame>=pendingClear.at){ queue=queue.filter(x=>x!==pendingClear.id); pendingClear=null;} api.tick(); }
  console.log(name.padEnd(14), 'frames', frame, 'throws', thrown.length, JSON.stringify(thrown.map(x=>x[1])), 'box+', box-100,
              'lost', api.get('LOST'), 'slowconf', api.get('SLOWCONF'), 'stalls', api.get('STALLS'), 'ST', api.get('ST'), 'errs', JSON.stringify(api.get('ERRS')));
}
run('normal',    {rewards:[11,12,13], onThrow:(id,n)=>({register:true})});
run('lost-once', {rewards:[11,12,13], onThrow:(id,n)=>({register: !(id===12 && n===1)})});
run('slow-clear',{rewards:[11,12,13], onThrow:(id,n)=>({register:true, clearAfter: id===12?220:5})});
run('never',     {rewards:[11,12],    onThrow:(id,n)=>({register: id!==12})});
```

```py
"""Offline test of the reward catcher's state machine (no phone): extracts the JS from reward_catcher.py, fakes the
game calls and runs 4 scenarios -- normal / one lost throw / a catch the server is slow to clear / a reward that never
registers. Run after ANY change to the tick() logic:

  python tools/reward_sim.py [path/to/reward_catcher.py]

Expected (2026-09-30 build: waits in ms, LOSTWAIT 1499; the sim's clock runs 60 fps, so = 90 frames): normal 3 throws, 214 frames; lost-once 4 throws lost=1, 304 frames (364 at
LOSTWAIT 150, v2 took 738); slow-clear 3 throws slowconf=1 (never a double throw); never 7 throws then ST 9 in 646 frames
(throw cap 6; 946 at LOSTWAIT 150; v2 threw forever)."""
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

i = s.index('JS = r"""') + 9
js = s[i:s.index('"""', i)]
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(os.path.join(d, "rc.js"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write("var rpc={exports:{}};\n" + js)
```

`AutoCatcher/tools/route_planner.py`:

```py
"""Plan walking loops through the densest PokeStops/gyms the GAME reports, along real walkable ways (OpenStreetMap).

  python tools/route_planner.py plan --km 4 [--bbox S,W,N,E] [--near LAT,LNG] [--name NAME]
                                     [--spots map|bank] [--pattern loop|clover] [--petals 4]
  python tools/route_planner.py hubs [--bbox S,W,N,E] [--spots map|bank] [--n 5] [--sep 1200]

hubs prints the n densest centres (stops + gyms within 300 m), at least --sep metres apart: where to centre a route
(pass one as --near).

Spots come from system/analysis/map_full.json (map_read.py: PokemonFortProto read live from PoGo), or with
--spots bank from the scanner's bank system/map/pogo_wigle.db (pogo_wigle.py: every map reply while you walk). A spot
is COVERED when the path passes within 80 m (FortSettings.InteractionRangeMeters); each spot counts once per lap.
Ways: manhattan_ways.json inside Manhattan; anywhere else the bbox's walkable ways are downloaded once from
Overpass and cached as system/map/ways_S_W_N_E.json.
The loop is built with a prize-collecting insertion heuristic on the walking graph (sidewalks, crossings,
footpaths, plazas, indoor corridors, steps; no motorways): keep adding the anchor with the best
new-spots-per-extra-metre until the length budget is used, then 2-opt. --pattern clover splits the budget into
PETALS loops that all start and end at the densest hub (the anchor with the most spots within 150 m), one per
compass sector (borders rotated to balance the sectors); every petal is at least MIN_PETAL_M, so the hub's stops are
off their 5-min cooldown each time a petal brings you back. Output: waypoints for the GPS Joystick WALK command, a
GPX file (importable as a saved joystick route) and an HTML map.
"""
import argparse
import glob
import heapq
import html
import json
import math
import os
import pickle
import sqlite3
import time
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from collections import defaultdict

ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), os.pardir))
WAYS = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "map", "manhattan_ways.json")
MANHATTAN = (40.70, -74.02, 40.88, -73.91)                       # S, W, N, E fully covered by WAYS
OVERPASS = "https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter"
SPOTS = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "analysis", "map_full.json")
BANK = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "map", "pogo_wigle.db")
OUTDIR = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "map", "routes")
RANGE = 80.0
MIN_PETAL_M = 900.0                                               # 5 min at 10.6 km/h = a stop's spin cooldown
WALKABLE = {"footway", "pedestrian", "path", "steps", "living_street", "residential", "service", "tertiary",
            "secondary", "primary", "unclassified", "cycleway", "track", "bridleway", "corridor", "elevator",
            "primary_link", "secondary_link", "tertiary_link", "road"}
R = 6371008.8


def hav(a, b):
    p1, p2 = math.radians(a[0]), math.radians(b[0])
    dl = math.radians(b[1] - a[1])
    return 2 * R * math.asin(math.sqrt(math.sin((p2 - p1) / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(p1) * math.cos(p2) * math.sin(dl / 2) ** 2))


class Grid:
    """Metre-ish bucket index for points near a latitude."""
    def __init__(self, lat0, cell=100.0):
        self.ky, self.kx, self.cell, self.b = 111320.0, 111320.0 * math.cos(math.radians(lat0)), cell, defaultdict(list)

    def key(self, p):
        return int(p[0] * self.ky // self.cell), int(p[1] * self.kx // self.cell)

    def add(self, p, item):
        self.b[self.key(p)].append(item)

    def near(self, p, rad):
        ky, kx = self.key(p)
        n = int(rad // self.cell) + 1
        for i in range(ky - n, ky + n + 1):
            for j in range(kx - n, kx + n + 1):
                yield from self.b.get((i, j), ())


def seg_dist(p, a, b):
    k = math.cos(math.radians(p[0])) * 111320.0
    ax, ay = (a[1] - p[1]) * k, (a[0] - p[0]) * 111320.0
    bx, by = (b[1] - p[1]) * k, (b[0] - p[0]) * 111320.0
    dx, dy = bx - ax, by - ay
    t = max(0.0, min(1.0, -(ax * dx + ay * dy) / ((dx * dx + dy * dy) or 1.0)))
    return math.hypot(ax + t * dx, ay + t * dy)


def ways_for(bbox):
    """The walkable-way file covering bbox: the Manhattan dump, any cached download whose bbox contains it, else an
    Overpass download cached per bbox."""
    s, w, n, e = bbox
    if MANHATTAN[0] <= s and n <= MANHATTAN[2] and MANHATTAN[1] <= w and e <= MANHATTAN[3]:
        return WAYS
    for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "map", "ways_*.json")):
        try:
            cs, cw, cn, ce = (float(x) for x in os.path.basename(p)[5:-5].split("_"))
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if cs <= s and n <= cn and cw <= w and e <= ce:
            return p
    path = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "map", f"ways_{s:.3f}_{w:.3f}_{n:.3f}_{e:.3f}.json")
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        q = f'[out:json][timeout:180];way["highway"]({s},{w},{n},{e});out geom;'
        req = urllib.request.Request(OVERPASS, data=urllib.parse.urlencode({"data": q}).encode(),
                                     headers={"User-Agent": "pogo-route-planner/1.0"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=300) as r:
            data = r.read()
        if not json.loads(data).get("elements"):                 # never cache an empty or broken download
            raise RuntimeError(f"Overpass returned no ways for {bbox}")
        open(path, "wb").write(data)
    return path


def load_graph(bbox, ways=None):
    s, w, n, e = bbox
    ways = ways or ways_for(bbox)
    cache = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "map", f"graph_{s:.3f}_{w:.3f}_{n:.3f}_{e:.3f}.pkl")
    if os.path.exists(cache) and os.path.getmtime(cache) > os.path.getmtime(ways):
        return pickle.load(open(cache, "rb"))
    d = json.load(open(ways, encoding="utf-8"))
    pos, adj = {}, defaultdict(list)
    for el in d["elements"]:
        if el["type"] != "way" or el["tags"].get("highway") not in WALKABLE:
            continue
        nodes, geom = el.get("nodes") or [], el.get("geometry") or []
        if len(nodes) != len(geom):
            continue
        prev = None
        for nid, g in zip(nodes, geom):
            p = (g["lat"], g["lon"])
            inside = s <= p[0] <= n and w <= p[1] <= e
            if inside:
                pos[nid] = p
            if prev is not None and inside and prev in pos:
                L = hav(pos[prev], p)
                adj[prev].append((nid, L))
                adj[nid].append((prev, L))
            prev = nid if inside else None
    # keep the largest connected component (islands of sidewalk pieces are useless for loops)
    seen, best = set(), []
    for start in pos:
        if start in seen or start not in adj:
            continue
        comp, stack = [], [start]
        seen.add(start)
        while stack:
            u = stack.pop()
            comp.append(u)
            for v, _ in adj[u]:
                if v not in seen:
                    seen.add(v)
                    stack.append(v)
        if len(comp) > len(best):
            best = comp
    keep = set(best)
    pos = {k: v for k, v in pos.items() if k in keep}
    adj = {k: [(v, L) for v, L in adj[k] if v in keep] for k in keep}
    pickle.dump((pos, adj), open(cache, "wb"))
    return pos, adj


def load_bank_spots(bbox):
    """Every enabled stop/gym the scanner banked inside bbox (lured = lured at a sighting in the last 30 min; Rocket
    unknown). The `closed` column is not a filter: the game sets Closed on every held gym."""
    s, w, n, e = bbox
    db = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{BANK}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    where = "lat BETWEEN ? AND ? AND lng BETWEEN ? AND ?"
    fresh = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time.localtime(time.time() - LURE_MAX_S))
    spots = {}
    for fid, lat, lng, kind, lured, team, visited, seen in db.execute(
            f"SELECT id, lat, lng, kind, lured, team, visited, last_seen FROM forts WHERE {where} AND COALESCE(enabled, 1) = 1",
            (s, n, w, e)):
        stop = kind == "stop"
        spots[fid] = {"p": (lat, lng), "stop": stop, "lured": bool(lured) and (seen or "") >= fresh, "rocket": False,
                      "team": None if stop else int(team or 0), "visited": bool(visited)}
    read_at = db.execute(f"SELECT MAX(last_seen) FROM forts WHERE {where}", (s, n, w, e)).fetchone()[0] or ""
    db.close()
    return spots, read_at


def load_spots(bbox, source="map"):
    if source == "bank":
        return load_bank_spots(bbox)
    s, w, n, e = bbox
    d = json.load(open(SPOTS, encoding="utf-8"))
    spots = {}
    for f in d.get("PokemonFortProto", []):
        if f.get("Latitude") and f.get("FortId") and s <= f["Latitude"] <= n and w <= f["Longitude"] <= e:
            stop = f.get("FortType") not in (None, 0)
            disp = f.get("PokestopDisplays") if isinstance(f.get("PokestopDisplays"), list) else []
            spots[f["FortId"]] = {"p": (f["Latitude"], f["Longitude"]), "stop": stop, "lured": bool(f.get("ActiveFortModifier")),
                                  "rocket": any(isinstance(x, dict) and x.get("IncidentDisplayType") for x in disp),
                                  "team": int(f.get("Team") or 0) if not stop else None, "visited": bool(f.get("Visited"))}
    return spots, d.get("read_at", "")


LURE_MAX_S = 1800          # a lure lasts 30 min: lure / Rocket flags from an older snapshot are history, not "now"


def snapshot_age_s(read_at):
    try:
        return time.time() - time.mktime(time.strptime(read_at[:19], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def dijkstra(adj, pos, src, dst):
    goal = pos[dst]
    dist, prev, pq = {src: 0.0}, {}, [(hav(pos[src], goal), 0.0, src)]
    while pq:
        _, g, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if u == dst:
            break
        if g > dist.get(u, 1e18):
            continue
        for v, L in adj[u]:
            ng = g + L
            if ng < dist.get(v, 1e18):
                dist[v], prev[v] = ng, u
                heapq.heappush(pq, (ng + hav(pos[v], goal), ng, v))
    if dst not in dist:
        return None, float("inf")
    path, u = [dst], dst
    while u != src:
        u = prev[u]
        path.append(u)
    return path[::-1], dist[dst]


DET = 1.30                                                         # street detour factor over straight lines


def prepare(bbox, source="map"):
    """Graph, spots, spot values and anchors shared by every pattern."""
    pos, adj = load_graph(bbox)
    spots, read_at = load_spots(bbox, source)
    lat0 = (bbox[0] + bbox[2]) / 2
    ng = Grid(lat0, 60.0)
    for nid, p in pos.items():
        ng.add(p, nid)
    # value of each spot: stops 1, gyms 1 (both spinnable), lured +0.5 (Pokemon magnet), Rocket +0.3 -- the bonuses only
    # while the snapshot is younger than a lure's 30 min; after that they are history and would bias the loop
    age = snapshot_age_s(read_at)
    live = age is not None and age <= LURE_MAX_S
    if not live:
        print(f"spots snapshot {read_at} is {'?' if age is None else round(age / 60)} min old: lure / Rocket bonuses ignored", flush=True)
    val = {k: 1.0 + ((0.5 if v["lured"] else 0) + (0.3 if v["rocket"] else 0) if live else 0) for k, v in spots.items()}
    # anchor = the graph node closest to each spot (a path through it covers the spot and its neighbours)
    sg = Grid(lat0, 80.0)
    for k, v in spots.items():
        sg.add(v["p"], k)
    anchors = {}
    for k, v in spots.items():
        best = min(ng.near(v["p"], 60.0), key=lambda nid: hav(pos[nid], v["p"]), default=None)
        if best is not None:
            anchors[best] = [s for s in sg.near(pos[best], RANGE) if hav(spots[s]["p"], pos[best]) <= RANGE]
    return {"pos": pos, "adj": adj, "spots": spots, "read_at": read_at, "age": age, "live": live, "val": val, "sg": sg,
            "anchors": anchors}


def grow(tour, length, pool, covered, budget, ctx):
    """Prize-collecting insertion: keep adding the anchor with the best new-spots-per-extra-metre until the length
    budget is used. Updates `covered` in place; tour[0] stays first."""
    pos, anchors, val = ctx["pos"], ctx["anchors"], ctx["val"]
    pool = list(pool)
    while True:
        best, bgain = None, 0.0
        for c in pool:
            gain = sum(val[s] for s in anchors[c] if s not in covered)
            if gain <= 0:
                continue
            for i in range(len(tour)):
                a, b = pos[tour[i]], pos[tour[(i + 1) % len(tour)]]
                extra = (hav(a, pos[c]) + hav(pos[c], b) - hav(a, b)) * DET
                if length + extra > budget:
                    continue
                score = gain / (extra + 30.0)
                if score > bgain:
                    best, bgain, bi, bx = c, score, i, extra
        if best is None:
            return tour, length
        tour.insert(bi + 1, best)
        covered |= set(anchors[best])
        length += bx
        pool.remove(best)


def two_opt(tour, pos):
    """2-opt on straight-line distances; tour[0] never moves."""
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        for i in range(len(tour) - 1):
            for j in range(i + 2, len(tour) - (i == 0)):
                a, b, c, d = pos[tour[i]], pos[tour[i + 1]], pos[tour[j]], pos[tour[(j + 1) % len(tour)]]
                if hav(a, c) + hav(b, d) < hav(a, b) + hav(c, d) - 1:
                    tour[i + 1:j + 1] = reversed(tour[i + 1:j + 1])
                    improved = True
    return tour


def walk(tour, ctx):
    """The real walking path around the closed tour: (graph nodes, metres)."""
    pos, adj = ctx["pos"], ctx["adj"]
    path, real = [], 0.0
    for i in range(len(tour)):
        seg, L = dijkstra(adj, pos, tour[i], tour[(i + 1) % len(tour)])
        if seg is None:
            continue
        path += seg if not path else seg[1:]
        real += L
    return path, real


def result(path, real, n_anchors, t0, ctx):
    """Exact coverage along the real path, and the summary every pattern reports."""
    pos, spots, sg, age = ctx["pos"], ctx["spots"], ctx["sg"], ctx["age"]
    pts = [pos[n] for n in path]
    cov = set()
    for a, b in zip(pts, pts[1:] + pts[:1]):
        mid = ((a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2)
        for s in sg.near(mid, RANGE + hav(a, b) / 2):
            if s not in cov and seg_dist(spots[s]["p"], a, b) <= RANGE:
                cov.add(s)
    return {"km": real / 1000, "points": pts, "covered": sorted(cov), "stops": sum(1 for s in cov if spots[s]["stop"]),
            "gyms": sum(1 for s in cov if not spots[s]["stop"]), "lured": sum(1 for s in cov if spots[s]["lured"]),
            "rocket": sum(1 for s in cov if spots[s]["rocket"]), "anchors": n_anchors, "secs": time.time() - t0,
            "read_at": ctx["read_at"], "age_txt": "?" if age is None else f"{age / 60:.0f} min", "lure_weighted": ctx["live"]}


def plan(bbox, km, near=None, candidates=900, source="map"):
    t0 = time.time()
    ctx = prepare(bbox, source)
    pos, anchors, val = ctx["pos"], ctx["anchors"], ctx["val"]
    ranked = sorted(anchors, key=lambda a: -sum(val[s] for s in anchors[a]))[:candidates]
    if near:
        ranked.sort(key=lambda a: hav(pos[a], near) / 400.0 - sum(val[s] for s in anchors[a]))
    start = ranked[0]
    partner = max(ranked[1:60], key=lambda a: sum(val[s] for s in set(anchors[a]) - set(anchors[start])) / (hav(pos[a], pos[start]) + 50))
    tour = [start, partner]
    covered = set(anchors[start]) | set(anchors[partner])
    tour, _ = grow(tour, 2 * hav(pos[start], pos[partner]) * DET, [a for a in ranked if a not in tour], covered, km * 1000.0, ctx)
    path, real = walk(two_opt(tour, pos), ctx)
    return result(path, real, len(tour), t0, ctx), ctx["spots"]


def bearing(a, b):
    """Compass bearing a -> b in degrees (0 = north, clockwise)."""
    p1, p2, dl = math.radians(a[0]), math.radians(b[0]), math.radians(b[1] - a[1])
    return math.degrees(math.atan2(math.sin(dl) * math.cos(p2), math.cos(p1) * math.sin(p2) - math.sin(p1) * math.cos(p2) * math.cos(dl))) % 360


def plan_clover(bbox, km, petals=4, near=None, candidates=900, source="map"):
    """PETALS loops that all start and end at one hub: the anchor with the most spot value within 150 m (only anchors
    within 300 m of `near` if given). Each petal grows only in its own compass sector, with km/PETALS of the budget."""
    t0 = time.time()
    ctx = prepare(bbox, source)
    pos, anchors, val, spots, sg = ctx["pos"], ctx["anchors"], ctx["val"], ctx["spots"], ctx["sg"]
    petals = max(1, min(petals, int(km * 1000 // MIN_PETAL_M)))
    core = {a: sum(val[s] for s in sg.near(pos[a], 150.0) if hav(spots[s]["p"], pos[a]) <= 150.0) for a in anchors}
    pick = list(anchors)
    if near:                                                      # never drift to a denser hub elsewhere in the bbox
        pick = [a for a in anchors if hav(pos[a], near) <= 300.0] or [min(anchors, key=lambda a: hav(pos[a], near))]
    hub = max(pick, key=lambda a: core[a])
    budget = km * 1000.0 / petals
    reach = budget / 2 / DET                                      # a petal goes out and back: it reaches ~half its length
    ranked = sorted(anchors, key=lambda a: -sum(val[s] for s in anchors[a]))[:candidates]
    cand = [a for a in ranked if a != hub and hav(pos[a], pos[hub]) <= reach]
    ang, width = {a: bearing(pos[hub], pos[a]) for a in cand}, 360.0 / petals

    def sector(a, off):
        return int(((ang[a] - off) % 360) // width) % petals

    def balance(off):                                             # the weakest sector's value for these borders
        tot = [0.0] * petals
        for a in cand:
            tot[sector(a, off)] += sum(val[s] for s in anchors[a])
        return min(tot)
    off = max(range(0, max(5, int(width)), 5), key=balance)
    covered, path, real, lens, ends, n = set(anchors[hub]), [], 0.0, [], [], 1
    for i in range(petals):
        tour, _ = grow([hub], 0.0, [a for a in cand if sector(a, off) == i], covered, budget, ctx)
        if len(tour) < 2:
            continue
        p, L = walk(two_opt(tour, pos), ctx)
        if L < MIN_PETAL_M / 3:                                   # a stub, not a petal
            continue
        path += p if not path else p[1:]
        real += L
        lens.append(L / 1000)
        ends.append(len(path))                                    # points[:ends[0]] = petal 1, and so on
        n += len(tour) - 1
    res = result(path, real, n, t0, ctx)
    res.update({"pattern": "clover", "petals": lens, "petal_ends": ends, "hub": pos[hub],
                "hub_spots": sum(1 for s in sg.near(pos[hub], RANGE) if hav(spots[s]["p"], pos[hub]) <= RANGE)})
    return res, spots


def hubs(bbox, n=5, sep=1200.0, radius=300.0, source="map"):
    """The n densest centres (spot value within `radius`), at least `sep` apart: where routes should be centred."""
    ctx = prepare(bbox, source)
    pos, anchors, val, spots, sg = ctx["pos"], ctx["anchors"], ctx["val"], ctx["spots"], ctx["sg"]
    dens = {a: sum(val[s] for s in sg.near(pos[a], radius) if hav(spots[s]["p"], pos[a]) <= radius) for a in anchors}
    out = []
    for a in sorted(dens, key=lambda a: -dens[a]):
        if all(hav(pos[a], h["p"]) >= sep for h in out):
            out.append({"p": pos[a], "value": dens[a],
                        "stops": sum(1 for s in sg.near(pos[a], radius) if spots[s]["stop"] and hav(spots[s]["p"], pos[a]) <= radius),
                        "gyms": sum(1 for s in sg.near(pos[a], radius) if not spots[s]["stop"] and hav(spots[s]["p"], pos[a]) <= radius)})
            if len(out) == n:
                break
    return out


def simplify(pts, tol=4.0):
    """Douglas-Peucker in metres (keeps the walking shape, drops redundant sidewalk vertices)."""
    if len(pts) < 3:
        return pts
    keep = [False] * len(pts)
    keep[0] = keep[-1] = True
    stack = [(0, len(pts) - 1)]
    while stack:
        i, j = stack.pop()
        best, bi = 0.0, None
        for k in range(i + 1, j):
            d = seg_dist(pts[k], pts[i], pts[j])
            if d > best:
                best, bi = d, k
        if bi is not None and best > tol:
            keep[bi] = True
            stack += [(i, bi), (bi, j)]
    return [p for p, k in zip(pts, keep) if k]


def export(res, spots, name):
    os.makedirs(OUTDIR, exist_ok=True)
    way = simplify(res["points"])
    if way[0] != way[-1]:
        way.append(way[0])
    wp = ";".join(f"{a:.6f},{b:.6f}" for a, b in way)
    open(os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"{name}.waypoints.txt"), "w").write(wp)
    gpx = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>', '<gpx version="1.1" creator="pogo-route-planner" xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1">',
           f"<rte><name>{html.escape(name)}</name>"] + [f'<rtept lat="{a:.6f}" lon="{b:.6f}"/>' for a, b in way] + ["</rte></gpx>"]
    open(os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"{name}.gpx"), "w").write("\n".join(gpx))
    cov = set(res["covered"])
    spts = [{"a": v["p"][0], "o": v["p"][1], "s": 1 if v["stop"] else 0, "c": 1 if k in cov else 0, "l": 1 if v["lured"] else 0,
             "r": 1 if v["rocket"] else 0, "t": v["team"] or 0} for k, v in spots.items()]
    page = f"""<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>PoGo Route</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.css">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.js"></script>
<style>
:root {{ --fg:#1d1d1b; --mut:#6b6b66; --line:#e4e2dc; --card:#ffffff; --bg:#fafaf8; }}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {{ :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {{ --fg:#ecebe6; --mut:#a3a19a; --line:#2c2b28; --card:#1c1c1a; --bg:#141413; }} }}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {{ --fg:#ecebe6; --mut:#a3a19a; --line:#2c2b28; --card:#1c1c1a; --bg:#141413; }}
html,body {{ height:100%; margin:0; background:var(--bg); font:14px/1.45 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif; }}
#map {{ position:absolute; inset:0; }}
.panel {{ position:absolute; z-index:1000; top:12px; left:12px; max-width:min(320px, calc(100% - 24px)); background:var(--card); color:var(--fg);
  border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:10px 12px; box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.15); }}
.panel h1 {{ font-size:15px; margin:0 0 4px; }} .mut {{ color:var(--mut); font-size:12px; }} .row {{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; }}
</style></head><body><div id="map"></div>
<div class="panel"><h1>{html.escape(name)}</h1>
<div class="mut">Planned on real walkable ways (OpenStreetMap) through the spots PoGo reported at {html.escape(res['read_at'])}.
A spot counts when the route passes within 80 m (the game's interaction range); once per lap.</div>
<div class="row"><span>Loop length</span><b>{res['km']:.2f} km</b></div>
<div class="row"><span>PokéStops in range</span><b>{res['stops']}</b></div>
<div class="row"><span>Gyms in range</span><b>{res['gyms']}</b></div>
<div class="row"><span>Stops + gyms per km</span><b>{(res['stops'] + res['gyms']) / max(res['km'], 0.01):.1f}</b></div>
<div class="row"><span>Lured at {html.escape(res['read_at'][11:])} ({html.escape(res['age_txt'])} old)</span><b>{res['lured']}</b></div>
<div class="row"><span>Team Rocket at {html.escape(res['read_at'][11:])}</span><b>{res['rocket']}</b></div>
<div class="row"><span>Lap time at 10.6 km/h</span><b>{res['km'] / 10.6 * 60:.0f} min</b></div>
{f'<div class="row"><span>Cloverleaf: {len(res["petals"])} petals from the hub</span><b>{" / ".join(f"{L / 10.6 * 60:.0f}" for L in res["petals"])} min</b></div>' if res.get("petals") else ""}
<div class="mut">Waypoints: {len(way)} (for the joystick WALK command / GPX route)</div></div>
<script>
var S = {json.dumps(spts, separators=(',', ':'))};
var R = {json.dumps([[round(a, 6), round(b, 6)] for a, b in way], separators=(',', ':'))};
var map = L.map('map', {{preferCanvas: true}});
L.tileLayer('https://{{s}}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{{z}}/{{x}}/{{y}}.png', {{maxZoom: 19, attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap'}}).addTo(map);
var TEAM = ['#8a8a8a', '#2f7de1', '#e0463f', '#f2c230'];
S.forEach(function (p) {{
  var col = p.s ? (p.r ? '#222' : (p.l ? '#e84fa3' : '#2f7de1')) : (TEAM[p.t] || '#8a8a8a');
  L.circleMarker([p.a, p.o], {{radius: p.s ? (p.c ? 5 : 3) : 7, color: p.c ? '#ff7a00' : col, weight: p.c ? 2 : 1, fillColor: col, fillOpacity: p.c ? .95 : .35}}).addTo(map);
}});
var line = L.polyline(R, {{color: '#ff7a00', weight: 4}}).addTo(map);
map.fitBounds(line.getBounds(), {{padding: [30, 30]}});
</script></body></html>"""
    open(os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"{name}.html"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(page)
    return way


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("cmd", choices=["plan", "hubs"])
    ap.add_argument("--km", type=float, default=4.0)
    ap.add_argument("--bbox", default="40.745,-73.995,40.772,-73.965")     # Midtown: 34th..64th St, 9th Ave..Lexington
    ap.add_argument("--near", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--name", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--spots", choices=["map", "bank"], default="map")
    ap.add_argument("--pattern", choices=["loop", "clover"], default="loop")
    ap.add_argument("--petals", type=int, default=4)
    ap.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=5)
    ap.add_argument("--sep", type=float, default=1200.0)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    bbox = tuple(float(x) for x in a.bbox.split(","))
    near = tuple(float(x) for x in a.near.split(",")) if a.near else None
    if a.cmd == "hubs":
        for i, h in enumerate(hubs(bbox, a.n, a.sep, source=a.spots), 1):
            print(f"{i}. {h['p'][0]:.6f},{h['p'][1]:.6f}  {h['stops']} stops + {h['gyms']} gyms within 300 m")
        return
    if a.pattern == "clover":
        res, spots = plan_clover(bbox, a.km, a.petals, near, source=a.spots)
    else:
        res, spots = plan(bbox, a.km, near, source=a.spots)
    name = a.name or f"midtown_{a.km:g}km"
    way = export(res, spots, name)
    print(f"{name}: {res['km']:.2f} km | stops {res['stops']} gyms {res['gyms']} = {(res['stops'] + res['gyms']) / res['km']:.1f}/km"
          f" | lured {res['lured']} rocket {res['rocket']} as of {res['read_at']} ({res['age_txt']} old) | anchors {res['anchors']} | waypoints {len(way)} | {res['secs']:.0f}s")
    if res.get("petals"):
        print(f"  clover hub {res['hub'][0]:.6f},{res['hub'][1]:.6f} ({res['hub_spots']} spots in range) | petals "
              + ", ".join(f"{L:.2f} km = {L / 10.6 * 60:.0f} min" for L in res["petals"]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
