try:
    run_loop([P(J, 280), P(J, 280)], {"pet": {"err": "x"}})
    raise AssertionError("a refused play must stop the run")
except br.Stop:
    pass
br.time.sleep = real_sleep
said.clear()

T.hist = {E: [290, 0, 0]}                                        # the current buddy is not in the game's history list

# ---- buddy_tapper's walk to the player record (findCpp / follow / isA), the real JS under node ----
def js_fn(name):
    i = bt.JS.index("function " + name + "(")
    line_end = bt.JS.index("\n", i)
    line = bt.JS[i:line_end]
    if line.count("{") and line.count("{") == line.count("}"):
        return line + "\n"
    return bt.JS[i:bt.JS.index("\n}\n", i) + 3]


MOCK = r"""
var NULLP = {isNull: function () { return true; }, toString: function () { return '0x0'; }};
var REG = {};
function O(id, klass, fields) {                 /* a mock object: readPointer() = its klass, add(off).readPointer() = a field */
  var o = {fields: fields || {}, isNull: function () { return false; }, toString: function () { return id; },
    readPointer: function () { return klass; }, add: function (off) { return {readPointer: function () { return o.fields[off] || NULLP; }}; }};
  REG[id] = o; return o;
}
function ptr(s) { return REG[s]; }
function C(name) { var k = {name: name, equals: function (x) { return x === k; },   /* Il2CppClass: name@0x10 */
  add: function (off) { return {readPointer: function () { return {readCString: function () { return name; }}; }}; }}; return k; }
var TYPES = {PlayerService: [['info', 0x12, 16], ['self', 0x12, 32], ['vt', 0x15, 40, 'VT'], ['list', 0x15, 48, 'REF']],
             PlayerInfo: [['proto', 0x12, 24], ['n', 0x08, 8]], Deep: [['a', 0x12, 8]], ClientPlayerProto: []};
var CALLED = [];                                /* every class handed to il2cpp's field enumeration */
function fieldsOf(k) { CALLED.push(k.name); return (TYPES[k.name] || []).map(function (x) { return {name: x[0], te: x[1], off: x[2], t: x[3] || null}; }); }
var IL = {isValueType: function (c) { return c === 'VT'; }, classFromType: function (t) { return t; }};
var KPS = C('PlayerService'), KPI = C('PlayerInfo'), KD = C('Deep'), K = {cpp: C('ClientPlayerProto')}, GRAPH = null;
function ok(c, m) { if (!c) { console.log('FAIL: ' + m); process.exit(1); } }
"""
TESTS = r"""
var cpp1 = O('cpp1', K.cpp), pi = O('pi', KPI, {24: cpp1}), ps = O('ps', KPS, {16: pi});
ps.fields[32] = ps;                                              /* a cycle back to itself */
var path = findCpp(ps, 3);
ok(JSON.stringify(path) === '[16,24]', 'the path PlayerService -> PlayerInfo -> ClientPlayerProto: ' + JSON.stringify(path));
GRAPH = {player: 'ps'};
ok(follow(path) === cpp1, 'follow() reaches the player record');
var cpp2 = O('cpp2', K.cpp); pi.fields[24] = cpp2;
ok(follow(path) === cpp2, 'the game replaced the record: follow() re-walks the path and finds the new one');
pi.fields[24] = O('junk', KD); ok(follow(path) === null, 'something else at the end of the path: null, never a misread');
pi.fields[24] = undefined; ok(follow(path) === null, 'a null on the way: null');
var ps2 = O('ps2', KPS, {40: O('cppvt', K.cpp)});
ok(findCpp(ps2, 3) === null, 'a value-type field is never followed as a pointer');
var d3 = O('d3', KD, {8: O('cppdeep', K.cpp)}), d2 = O('d2', KD, {8: d3}), d1 = O('d1', KD, {8: d2}), ps3 = O('ps3', KPS, {16: d1});
ok(findCpp(ps3, 3) === null && JSON.stringify(findCpp(ps3, 4)) === '[16,8,8,8]', 'the depth limit holds');
ok(isA(cpp1, K.cpp) && !isA(pi, K.cpp) && !isA(NULLP, K.cpp), 'isA');
var ps5 = O('ps5', KPS, {16: O('notobj', C('\u0001\u0007'))}); CALLED.length = 0;
ok(findCpp(ps5, 3) === null && CALLED.indexOf('\u0001\u0007') < 0, 'memory that is not an object never reaches il2cpp');
console.log('ok: 9 player-record walk checks passed');
"""
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".js", delete=False, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(MOCK + js_fn("jsClass") + js_fn("klassOf") + js_fn("isA") + js_fn("findCpp") + js_fn("follow") + TESTS)
try:
    r = subprocess.run(["node", f.name], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(r.stdout.strip() or r.stderr.strip())
    sys.exit(r.returncode)
finally:
    os.unlink(f.name)

var REG = {};
function P(id, klass, fields) {                 /* a mock object: readPointer() = its klass; add(off) = its fields */
  var o = {fields: fields || {}, isNull: function () { return false; }, toString: function () { return id; },
    readPointer: function () { return klass; },

      readS64: function () { return {toNumber: function () { return f; }}; }}; }};

`AutoCatcher/tools/test_gym_stab.py`:

```py
"""Offline check of the gym tapper's same-type attack bonus (STAB) and of its script text (2026-09-30, Benny: "fix it").
No phone, no Frida: the REAL code between the ">>> STAB" and "<<< STAB" markers of gym_tapper.JS runs under node against mock
il2cpp objects (a typed memory: a read of the wrong width throws like Frida's access violation), the runner's new report lines
run against a fake tapper, and the typing table is built from a small synthetic game master (plus the real one when it is here).
Run: python test_gym_stab.py      (needs node; frida is not needed -- a stub stands in when it is not installed)

  1. the whole tapper script text passes `node --check`, and declares no top-level name twice (`node --check` lets a second
     `var X` silently replace the first: a duplicate WATCH killed the feeder for 3 minutes once);
  2. the STAB block: the field-offset resolution against the REAL PokemonSettingsProto recon (the old matcher could not find type1_),
     the live read (validated by species), the game master table fallback, every refusal, the multiplier, the pick that changes;
  3. stab_config(): the typing table from a synthetic game master, and from the real one when present;
  4. gym_run's report lines: stab_tag() and stab_setup() with a fake tapper.
"""
import contextlib
import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import types

try:
    import frida  # noqa: F401
except ImportError:                                          # CI / the offline sandbox: nothing here ever attaches
    sys.modules["frida"] = types.ModuleType("frida")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import gym_tapper  # noqa: E402

NODE = shutil.which("node")
FAILS = []


def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        FAILS.append(msg)
        print("FAIL:", msg)
    return cond


def block(js):
    a, b = js.index("/* >>> STAB"), js.index("/* <<< STAB */")
    check(js.count("/* >>> STAB") == 1 and js.count("/* <<< STAB */") == 1, "the STAB markers appear exactly once in the tapper script")
    for fn in ("rank", "settingsFields", "typeIds", "liveMult", "loadStab", "resolveStab", "resolveLiveMult", "stabReport", "setOffs", "dispOffs",
               "fightingSix", "attackerTypes", "moveScore", "attack"):
        check(f"function {fn}(" in js[a:b], f"function {fn}() fell out of the marked STAB block (the markers must still cover it)")
    return js[a:b]


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 1. the script text
def script_text(js):
    check("/^type_?$/i" not in js, "the old first-type matcher (type / type_ only) is back in the script")
    check("O.cadSettings" not in js, "a stale O.cadSettings reference is back in the script")
    check("stab: function (cfg)" in js and "stab: stabReport()" in js, "the stab() export / the install stab report are missing")
    check("    resolveStab();" in js and "    resolveLiveMult();" in js, "install() no longer calls resolveStab() / resolveLiveMult()")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        p = os.path.join(td, "tapper.js")
        with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(js)
        r = subprocess.run([NODE, "--check", p], capture_output=True, text=True)
        check(r.returncode == 0, "node --check of the whole tapper script failed: " + (r.stderr or r.stdout).strip()[:600])
        dup = r"""
const fs = require('fs'); let acorn;
try { acorn = require('internal/deps/acorn/acorn/dist/acorn'); } catch (e) { console.log('SKIP'); process.exit(0); }
const ast = acorn.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'), {ecmaVersion: 2020});
const seen = {}, dups = [];
const add = (n) => { if (seen[n]) dups.push(n); seen[n] = 1; };
for (const s of ast.body) {
  if (s.type === 'FunctionDeclaration') add(s.id.name);
  else if (s.type === 'VariableDeclaration') for (const d of s.declarations) if (d.id.type === 'Identifier') add(d.id.name);
}
console.log(dups.length ? 'DUP ' + dups.join(',') : 'OK ' + Object.keys(seen).length);
"""
        q = os.path.join(td, "dup.js")
        with open(q, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(dup)
        r = subprocess.run([NODE, "--expose-internals", q, p], capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = (r.stdout or "").strip()
        if out.startswith("OK"):
            print(f"ok: tapper script passes node --check; {out[3:]} top-level names, none declared twice")
        elif out == "SKIP" or r.returncode != 0:
            print("ok: tapper script passes node --check (top-level duplicate scan skipped: this node has no internal parser)")
        else:
            check(False, "top-level names declared twice in the tapper script: " + out)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 2. the STAB block

def stab_block(js):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        p = os.path.join(td, "stab_block.js")
        with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(MOCK + block(js) + "\n" + TESTS)
        r = subprocess.run([NODE, p], capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = (r.stdout.strip() + "\n" + r.stderr.strip()).strip()
        print(out)
        check(r.returncode == 0, "the STAB block checks failed under node")

def config_checks():

        check(c["species_typed"] == ["PalkiaOrigin"] and "484:300" not in t,
              f"a form the game master lacks is named as running on its species' typing; a year / shadow / costume form is not ({c['species_typed']})")
        check(gym_tapper.stab_config(g, e) is c, "the table is built once per file pair")
        check(json.dumps({"mult": c["mult"], "types": t}), "the hand-over payload is plain JSON")
        bad = gym_tapper.stab_config(os.path.join(td, "missing.json"), e)
        check("err" in bad and "hint" in bad and "types" not in bad, "a missing game master comes back as an error dict (the runner goes on), never raises")
        broken = os.path.join(td, "broken.json")

            f.write("{not json")

        gm2 = os.path.join(td, "gm2.json")

        print(f"ok: real game master table: {len(t)} entries ({c['species']} species + {c['forms']} form overrides), multiplier {c['mult']}")
    else:

def runner_checks():
    import gym_run
    names = {150: "Mewtwo"}
    tag = gym_run.stab_tag({"who": 150, "src": "live", "mult": 1.2, "note": ""}, names)
    check(tag == " [attacker #150 Mewtwo; types: live; same-type x1.2]", f"stab_tag live: {tag!r}")
    tag = gym_run.stab_tag({"who": None, "src": "none", "mult": 1.2, "note": "no snapshot of our six"}, names)
    check("attacker unknown" in tag and "types: none (no snapshot of our six)" in tag, f"stab_tag none: {tag!r}")
    check("#999;" in gym_run.stab_tag({"who": 999, "src": "table", "mult": 1.25}, names) and "x1.25" in gym_run.stab_tag({"who": 999, "src": "table", "mult": 1.25}, names),
          "stab_tag for a species with no name")

    def said(fn, *a):
        buf = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
            fn(*a)
        return buf.getvalue()

    g = gym_run.Game()
    g.stab_names = names
    out = said(g.on_msg, {"type": "send", "payload": {"k": "moves", "list": [{"n": "V0109MovePsystrike", "dmg": 114, "en": 50, "dpe": 2.28, "stab": 1.2},
                                                                              {"n": "V0070MoveShadowBall", "dmg": 100, "en": 50, "dpe": 2.0, "stab": 1}],
                                                     "src": "live", "who": 150, "note": "", "mult": 1.2}}, None)
    check("charged moves: V0109MovePsystrike 114 dmg / 50 energy stab x1.2, V0070MoveShadowBall 100 dmg / 50 energy stab x1 -> the strongest fires when charged "
          "[attacker #150 Mewtwo; types: live; same-type x1.2]" in out, f"the charged moves line: {out!r}")

    class Fake:                                   # a tapper that answers stab() like the real one
        def __init__(self):
            self.sent = None
            self.exports_sync = self

        def stab(self, cfg):
            self.sent = cfg
            return {"types": len(cfg["types"]), "rejected": 0, "mult": 1.2, "multSrc": "game master", "liveMult": None, "gmMult": cfg["mult"]}

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        gm, en = gm_fixture(td)
        real_cfg = gym_tapper.stab_config
        gym_tapper.stab_config = lambda: real_cfg(gm, en)
        try:
            good = {"stab": {"cadSettings": [560], "setT1": 24, "setT2": 28, "setId": 16, "moveType": True, "typeNames": 18, "mult": 1.2, "multSrc": "live",
                             "related": ["attackerSettings:IPokemonSettings@560"], "err": None}}
            fk, g2 = Fake(), gym_run.Game()
            out = said(gym_run.stab_setup, fk, g2, good)
            check("settings field(s) @560" in out and "types @24/@28, species @16" in out and "multiplier x1.2 (live)" in out and "attackerSettings:IPokemonSettings@560" in out, f"install line: {out!r}")
            check("!!" not in out and "STAB table from the game master: 9 typings (6 species + 3 form overrides)" in out, f"table line: {out!r}")
            check(fk.sent and fk.sent["mult"] == 1.2 and "484" in fk.sent["types"] and "names" not in fk.sent and g2.stab_names[484] == "Palkia", "the tapper gets mult + types only; the names stay on the runner")
            bad = {"stab": {"cadSettings": [], "setT1": -1, "setT2": 28, "setId": 16, "moveType": False, "typeNames": 0, "mult": 1.2, "multSrc": "default", "err": "boom"}}
            out = said(gym_run.stab_setup, Fake(), gym_run.Game(), bad)
            for want in ("settings field(s) NONE", "no IPokemonSettings field", "types / species not all found", "is not a HoloPokemonType", "enum was not read", "raised: boom"):
                check(want in out, f"the report flags {want!r}: {out!r}")
            gym_tapper.stab_config = lambda: {"err": "FileNotFoundError: gone", "hint": "pull it"}
            fk = Fake()
            out = said(gym_run.stab_setup, fk, gym_run.Game(), good)
            check("table unavailable (FileNotFoundError: gone; pull it)" in out and fk.sent is None, "no game master: said plainly, the tapper is not called, the runner goes on")
        finally:
            gym_tapper.stab_config = real_cfg
    if not FAILS:
        print("ok: gym_run stab_tag() / stab_setup() / the charged moves line")


def main():
    js = gym_tapper.JS
    if NODE is None:
        print("SKIP: node not found -- the script text and the STAB block were NOT checked (CI has node)")
        if os.environ.get("CI"):                 # 2026-09-30 (review of #27): in CI a missing node is a failure, never a silent pass
            FAILS.append("node not found in CI: the tapper script and the STAB block were not checked")
    else:
        script_text(js)
        stab_block(js)
    config_checks()
    runner_checks()
    if FAILS:
        print(f"\n{len(FAILS)} check(s) FAILED")
        return 1
    print("\nALL GYM STAB CHECKS PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

`AutoCatcher/tools/track_walk.py`:

```py
"""Live check that walking distance is being credited: km walked (PlayerStats), egg incubators, buddy.

Read-only. Every SNAP_S seconds: the C liveness lookup (world stopped, no JS inside -- the same code as the
catcher and the limits dumper) finds the live PlayerStatsProto / EggIncubatorProto / BuddyPokemonProto objects and
their fields are read with plain memory reads. The newest PlayerStats is the one with the highest KmWalked
(it only ever grows). The phone's spoofed position is sampled at the same time for the distance actually moved.

Usage: python tools/track_walk.py [minutes=5] [snapshot seconds=30]
"""
import json
import math
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402
import dump_game_limits as dl  # noqa: E402  (reuses its read-only JS: IL bindings, C liveness lookup, readObj)

DEV = os.environ.get("ADB_TARGET", "100.98.158.56:5555")   # cloud: the Tailscale bridge exports ADB_TARGET
JS = dl.JS.split("rpc.exports = {")[0] + r"""
var KS = {};
function k(name) { if (!(name in KS)) KS[name] = findClass('holo-protos.dll', name); return KS[name]; }
rpc.exports = {
  snap: function (names) {
    var out = {};
    (names || ['PlayerStatsProto', 'EggIncubatorProto', 'BuddyPokemonProto']).forEach(function (n) {
      var kl = k(n); if (!kl) { out[n] = 'class not found'; return; }
      out[n] = instances(kl, 64).map(function (o) { return readObj(o, 1); });
    });
    return out;
  }
};
"""


def adb(cmd):
    return subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", DEV, "shell", cmd], capture_output=True, text=True,
                          env=dict(os.environ, MSYS_NO_PATHCONV="1")).stdout


def spot():
    m = re.search(r"Location\[gps ([-0-9.]+),([-0-9.]+) .*?vel=([0-9.]+)", adb("dumpsys location | grep -m1 'last mock location'"))
    return (float(m[1]), float(m[2]), float(m[3])) if m else None


def meters(a, b):
    r = 6371008.8
    p1, p2 = math.radians(a[0]), math.radians(b[0])
    dl_ = math.radians(b[1] - a[1])
    return 2 * r * math.asin(math.sqrt(math.sin((p2 - p1) / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(p1) * math.cos(p2) * math.sin(dl_ / 2) ** 2))


def num(v):
    try:
        return float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def main():
    minutes = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 5
    every = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 30
    if "Pixel" not in adb("getprop ro.product.model"):
        sys.exit("not the phone -- refusing")
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = sess.create_script(JS)
    sc.load()
    print(f"attached pid {pid}; snapshot every {every:g}s for {minutes:g} min", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    first_km, moved, last_pos, prev_km = None, 0.0, spot(), None
    walk_t = time.time()
    full = sc.exports_sync.snap(None)          # eggs + buddy once (they change only on a hatch / candy)
    try:
        while time.time() - t0 <= minutes * 60 + 1:
            last = time.time() - t0 > minutes * 60 - every
            s = full if first_km is None else sc.exports_sync.snap(None if last else ["PlayerStatsProto"])
            if last:
                full = s
            ps = [x for x in (s.get("PlayerStatsProto") or []) if isinstance(x, dict)]
            kms = [num(x.get("KmWalked")) for x in ps if num(x.get("KmWalked")) is not None]
            km = max(kms) if kms else None
            if first_km is None and km is not None:
                first_km = km
            # distance actually moved: sample the spoofed position a few times since the last snapshot
            while time.time() - walk_t < every - 0.5:
                p = spot()
                if p and last_pos:
                    d = meters(last_pos, p)
                    if d < 200:        # ignore a teleport
                        moved += d
                last_pos = p or last_pos
                time.sleep(2)
            walk_t = time.time()
            eggs = []
            for e in full.get("EggIncubatorProto") or []:
                if not isinstance(e, dict):
                    continue
                tgt, start = num(e.get("TargetKmWalked")), num(e.get("StartKmWalked"))
                if tgt and km is not None and tgt > km and e.get("PokemonId"):
                    eggs.append((round(tgt - km, 3), round(tgt - (start or 0), 1), e.get("Id") or e.get("IncubatorType")))
            eggs = sorted(set(eggs))
            buddy = []
            for b in full.get("BuddyPokemonProto") or []:
                if isinstance(b, dict) and (b.get("Id") or b.get("StartKmWalked")):
                    buddy.append((b.get("LastKmAwarded"), b.get("StartKmWalked")))
            buddy = sorted(set((num(a), num(c)) for a, c in buddy))
            gain = (km - first_km) if (km is not None and first_km is not None) else None
            step = (km - prev_km) if (km is not None and prev_km is not None) else None
            prev_km = km if km is not None else prev_km
            el = time.time() - t0
            print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} +{el:4.0f}s | km walked {km if km is None else f'{km:.3f}'}"
                  f" | credited +{0 if gain is None else gain * 1000:.0f} m (this step +{0 if step is None else step * 1000:.0f} m)"
                  f" | moved {moved:.0f} m | label {last_pos[2] * 3.6 if last_pos else 0:.1f} km/h"
                  f" | eggs left (km): {', '.join(f'{r:.2f}/{tot:g}' for r, tot, _ in eggs[:9]) or '-'}"
                  f" | buddy +{(km - buddy[-1][1]) if (buddy and km is not None and buddy[-1][1]) else 0:.3f} km since set", flush=True)
            if el == 0 or len(sys.argv) > 3:
                print("   raw PlayerStats:", json.dumps(ps[:1])[:600], flush=True)
    finally:
        sc.unload()
        sess.detach()
    print("done", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`AutoCatcher/tools/track_walk2.py`:

```py
"""Live walking progress from the GAME'S OWN RECORDS only (read-only).

Every SNAP_S seconds:
  PlayerStatsProto.KmWalked            -- the distance the server has credited you (newest copy = highest value)
  BuddyObservedData.TotalStats.KmWalked -- the buddy's own walked record (+ CurrentPointsEarned)
Every 3rd snapshot (and at start/end):
  EggIncubatorProto Start/TargetKmWalked -- each egg's "walked X / Y km", the game's formula (KmWalked - Start)
At start/end: BuddyPokemonProto (LastKmAwarded, StartKmWalked) and the buddy's PokemonProto (BuddyKmWalked,
BuddyCandyAwarded) found by BuddyPokemonId.
GPS movement is printed separately and labelled -- it is my measurement, not a game record.

Usage: python tools/track_walk2.py [minutes=5] [snapshot seconds=30]
"""
import math
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(HERE))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402
import dump_game_limits as dl  # noqa: E402

DEV = os.environ.get("ADB_TARGET", "100.98.158.56:5555")   # cloud: the Tailscale bridge exports ADB_TARGET
JS = dl.JS.split("rpc.exports = {")[0] + r"""
var KS = {};
function k(name) { if (!(name in KS)) KS[name] = findClass('holo-protos.dll', name); return KS[name]; }
function off(kl, name) { var o = -1; fieldsOf(kl).forEach(function (fd) { if (fd.name === name) o = fd.off; }); return o; }
rpc.exports = {
  snap: function (names) {
    var out = {};
    names.forEach(function (n) {
      var kl = k(n); if (!kl) { out[n] = 'class not found'; return; }
      out[n] = instances(kl, 64).map(function (o) { return readObj(o, 2); });
    });
    return out;
  },
  buddyMon: function (idStr) {   /* the buddy's own PokemonProto: match the u64 Id, read only that object */
    var kl = k('PokemonProto'); if (!kl) return 'no class';
    var io = off(kl, 'Id'); if (io < 0) return 'no Id field';
    var want = uint64(idStr), hits = instances(kl, 30000), n = hits.length, best = null, copies = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {   /* several live copies can exist (old syncs): keep the one with the most buddy km */
      try { if (hits[i].add(io).readU64().equals(want)) { copies++; var r = readObj(hits[i], 1); var o = {};
        Object.keys(r).forEach(function (key) { if (/Buddy|PokemonId|Nickname|Cp$/.test(key)) o[key] = r[key]; });
        if (!best || (parseFloat(o.BuddyKmWalked) || 0) > (parseFloat(best.BuddyKmWalked) || 0)) best = o; } } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (!best) return {notFound: true, scanned: n};
    best._copies = copies; best._scanned = n; return best;
  }
};
"""


def adb(cmd):
    return subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", DEV, "shell", cmd], capture_output=True, text=True,
                          env=dict(os.environ, MSYS_NO_PATHCONV="1")).stdout


def spot():
    m = re.search(r"Location\[gps ([-0-9.]+),([-0-9.]+) .*?vel=([0-9.]+)", adb("dumpsys location | grep -m1 'last mock location'"))
    return (float(m[1]), float(m[2]), float(m[3])) if m else None


def meters(a, b):
    r = 6371008.8
    p1, p2 = math.radians(a[0]), math.radians(b[0])
    dl_ = math.radians(b[1] - a[1])
    return 2 * r * math.asin(math.sqrt(math.sin((p2 - p1) / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(p1) * math.cos(p2) * math.sin(dl_ / 2) ** 2))


def f(v):
    try:
        return float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def top(rows, getter):
    vals = [getter(r) for r in rows if isinstance(r, dict)]
    vals = [v for v in vals if v is not None]
    return max(vals) if vals else None


def main():
    minutes = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 5
    every = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 30
    if "Pixel" not in adb("getprop ro.product.model"):
        sys.exit("not the phone -- refusing")
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = sess.create_script(JS)
    sc.load()
    print(f"attached pid {pid}; game records every {every:g}s for {minutes:g} min", flush=True)

    def buddy_block(tag):
        s = sc.exports_sync.snap(["BuddyPokemonProto"])
        bp = [x for x in s["BuddyPokemonProto"] if isinstance(x, dict) and x.get("BuddyPokemonId")]
        if not bp:
            print(f"{tag} BuddyPokemonProto: none", flush=True)
            return None
        b = bp[-1]
        mon = sc.exports_sync.buddy_mon(str(b["BuddyPokemonId"]))
        print(f"{tag} BuddyPokemonProto: LastKmAwarded={b.get('LastKmAwarded')} StartKmWalked={b.get('StartKmWalked')} "
              f"set@{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S', time.localtime(int(b.get('LastSetTimestampMs', 0)) / 1000))} | "
              f"buddy PokemonProto: {mon}", flush=True)
        return b

    buddy_block("START")
    t0, i, moved, last = time.time(), 0, 0.0, spot()
    base = {}
    eggs_raw = []
    try:
        while True:
            names = ["PlayerStatsProto", "BuddyObservedData"] + (["EggIncubatorProto"] if i % 3 == 0 else [])
            s = sc.exports_sync.snap(names)
            km = top(s["PlayerStatsProto"], lambda r: f(r.get("KmWalked")))
            bo = [r for r in s["BuddyObservedData"] if isinstance(r, dict)]
            bkm = top(bo, lambda r: f((r.get("TotalStats") or {}).get("KmWalked")))
            bpts = top(bo, lambda r: f(r.get("CurrentPointsEarned")))
            aff = top(bo, lambda r: f((r.get("TodayStatsShownHearts") or {}).get("BuddyAffectionKmInProgress", 0)))
            if "EggIncubatorProto" in s:
                eggs_raw = [e for e in s["EggIncubatorProto"] if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("PokemonId")]
            base.setdefault("km", km)
            base.setdefault("bkm", bkm)
            eggs = {}
            for e in eggs_raw:
                st, tg = f(e.get("StartKmWalked")), f(e.get("TargetKmWalked"))
                if st is not None and tg and km is not None and tg > km:
                    eggs[(st, tg)] = f"{km - st:.2f}/{tg - st:g} km"
            el = time.time() - t0
            print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} +{el:4.0f}s | PlayerStats.KmWalked {km:.3f} (+{(km - base['km']) * 1000:.0f} m)"
                  f" | eggs (walked/total): {', '.join(v for _, v in sorted(eggs.items())) or '-'}"
                  f" | WalkTogether BuddyAffectionKmInProgress {aff:.3f} | hearts {bpts:g}"
                  f" | moved (GPS, not a game record) {moved:.0f} m", flush=True)
            i += 1
            if el >= minutes * 60:
                break
            nxt = time.time() + every
            while time.time() < nxt - 1:
                p = spot()
                if p and last and meters(last, p) < 200:
                    moved += meters(last, p)
                last = p or last
                time.sleep(2)
        buddy_block("END  ")
    finally:
        sc.unload()
        sess.detach()
    print("done", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`AutoCatcher/tools/track_walk3.py`:

```py
"""Speed-cutoff run with a message trace. Game records only; GPS movement is labelled as mine.

  python tools/track_walk3.py MINUTES "0:walking,300:jogging,600:running"

* Hooks (read-only, like the catcher's): when each of these messages is SENT (WriteTo) or RECEIVED (MergeFrom),
  with a timestamp -- location/fitness reports out, inventory syncs in, buddy-walk claims, and every new
  PlayerStats.KmWalked value the moment it is parsed. This shows the interval and the trigger of each credit.
* Every 60 s: liveness read of BuddyObservedData (Walk-together km) and the egg incubators.
* Schedule: at each offset, tap that speed button on the joystick overlay and measure the speed.
"""
import math
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(HERE))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402
import dump_game_limits as dl  # noqa: E402

DEV = os.environ.get("ADB_TARGET", "100.98.158.56:5555")   # cloud: the Tailscale bridge exports ADB_TARGET
OUT_MSGS = ["GetMapObjectsProto", "HoloFitnessReportProto", "PlayerLocationRpcProto", "GetHoloholoInventoryProto",
            "GetInventoryProto", "GetBuddyWalkedProto", "GetFitnessRewardsProto", "SoftSfidaLocationUpdateProto"]
IN_MSGS = ["GetMapObjectsOutProto", "GetHoloholoInventoryOutProto", "GetInventoryResponseProto", "InventoryDeltaProto",
           "GetBuddyWalkedOutProto", "GetFitnessRewardsOutProto", "PlayerStatsSnapshotsProto"]
JS = dl.JS.split("rpc.exports = {")[0] + r"""
var EV = [], LAST = {}, KMOFF = -1, KMTE = 0, SAMPLES = {};
function note(kind, cls, extra) {
  var now = Date.now(), key = kind + cls;
  if (LAST[key] && now - LAST[key] < 150) return;    /* one message can pass through several overloads */
  LAST[key] = now; EV.push({t: now, k: kind, c: cls, x: extra || null});
}
function hookMethods(kl, cls, names, kind, onLeave) {
  var n = 0, it = Memory.alloc(PS); it.writePointer(NULL);
  var getM = new NativeFunction(EX['il2cpp_class_get_methods'], 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer'], PROP);
  var mName = new NativeFunction(EX['il2cpp_method_get_name'], 'pointer', ['pointer'], PROP);
  var mArgs = new NativeFunction(EX['il2cpp_method_get_param_count'], 'uint32', ['pointer'], PROP);
  var m;
  while ((m = getM(kl, it)) && !m.isNull()) {
    var nm = cs(mName(m));
    if (names.indexOf(nm) < 0 || mArgs(m) !== 1) continue;
    var fp = m.readPointer(); if (fp.isNull()) continue;
    try {
      Interceptor.attach(fp, onLeave ? {onEnter: function (a) { this.self = a[0]; }, onLeave: function () { onLeave(this.self); }}
                                     : {onEnter: function () { note(kind, cls); }});
      n++;
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  return n;
}
rpc.exports = {
  install: function (outs, ins) {
    var got = {};
    outs.forEach(function (c) { var kl = findClass('holo-protos.dll', c); got['>' + c] = kl ? hookMethods(kl, c, ['WriteTo'], 'OUT') : 'no class'; });
    ins.forEach(function (c) { var kl = findClass('holo-protos.dll', c); got['<' + c] = kl ? hookMethods(kl, c, ['MergeFrom'], 'IN') : 'no class'; });
    var ps = findClass('holo-protos.dll', 'PlayerStatsProto');
    fieldsOf(ps).forEach(function (fd) { if (fd.name === 'KmWalked') { KMOFF = fd.off; KMTE = fd.te; } });
    got['<PlayerStatsProto'] = hookMethods(ps, 'PlayerStatsProto', ['MergeFrom'], 'IN', function (self) {
      try { var v = KMTE === 0x0d ? self.add(KMOFF).readDouble() : self.add(KMOFF).readFloat(); note('KM', 'PlayerStatsProto', v); } catch (e) {}
    });
    return got;
  },
  drain: function () { var e = EV; EV = []; return e; },
  snap: function () {
    var out = {};
    ['BuddyObservedData', 'EggIncubatorProto'].forEach(function (n) {
      var kl = findClass('holo-protos.dll', n); out[n] = kl ? instances(kl, 64).map(function (o) { return readObj(o, 2); }) : [];
    });
    return out;
  }
};
"""


def adb(cmd):
    return subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", DEV, "shell", cmd], capture_output=True, text=True,
                          env=dict(os.environ, MSYS_NO_PATHCONV="1")).stdout


def spot():
    m = re.search(r"Location\[gps ([-0-9.]+),([-0-9.]+) .*?vel=([0-9.]+)", adb("dumpsys location | grep -m1 'last mock location'"))
    return (float(m[1]), float(m[2]), float(m[3])) if m else None


def meters(a, b):
    r = 6371008.8
    p1, p2 = math.radians(a[0]), math.radians(b[0])
    dl_ = math.radians(b[1] - a[1])
    return 2 * r * math.asin(math.sqrt(math.sin((p2 - p1) / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(p1) * math.cos(p2) * math.sin(dl_ / 2) ** 2))


def f(v):
    try:
        return float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def main():
    minutes = float(sys.argv[1])
    sched = []
    if len(sys.argv) > 2 and sys.argv[2]:
        for part in sys.argv[2].split(","):
            at, m = part.split(":")
            sched.append((float(at), m))
    if "Pixel" not in adb("getprop ro.product.model"):
        sys.exit("not the phone -- refusing")
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = sess.create_script(JS)
    sc.load()
    print("hooks:", sc.exports_sync.install(OUT_MSGS, IN_MSGS), flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    tm = lambda ms: time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ms / 1000)) + f".{int(ms % 1000):03d}"
    km_last, km_first, moved, last, gmo, next_snap, credits = None, None, 0.0, spot(), [], 0, []
    seg_start = time.time()
    try:
        while time.time() - t0 < minutes * 60:
            el = time.time() - t0
            while sched and el >= sched[0][0]:
                _, m = sched.pop(0)
                r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(HERE, "joystick_round.py"), "mode", m], capture_output=True, text=True)
                print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} === SPEED MODE -> {m}: {r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if r.stdout.strip() else r.stderr.strip()[-200:]}", flush=True)
                seg_start, moved = time.time(), 0.0
            for e in sc.exports_sync.drain():
                if e["k"] == "KM":
                    v = e["x"]
                    if km_last is None or abs(v - km_last) > 1e-6:
                        d = 0 if km_last is None else (v - km_last) * 1000
                        km_first = v if km_first is None else km_first
                        if km_last is not None:
                            credits.append((e["t"], d))
                        gap = f", {(e['t'] - credits[-2][0]) / 1000:.0f} s after the last credit" if len(credits) > 1 else ""
                        print(f"{tm(e['t'])} <- PlayerStats.KmWalked {v:.3f} (+{d:.0f} m{gap}) | moved (GPS) since mode switch {moved:.0f} m", flush=True)
                        km_last = v
                elif e["c"] == "GetMapObjectsProto":
                    gmo.append(e["t"])
                else:
                    print(f"{tm(e['t'])} {'->' if e['k'] == 'OUT' else '<-'} {e['c']}", flush=True)
            if time.time() >= next_snap:
                s = sc.exports_sync.snap()
                aff = max([f((b.get("TodayStatsShownHearts") or {}).get("BuddyAffectionKmInProgress", 0)) or 0
                           for b in s["BuddyObservedData"] if isinstance(b, dict)] or [0])
                eggs = sorted({(f(e.get("StartKmWalked")), f(e.get("TargetKmWalked"))) for e in s["EggIncubatorProto"]
                               if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("PokemonId")})
                egg_txt = ", ".join(f"{(km_last or 0) - a:.2f}/{b - a:g}" for a, b in eggs if a is not None and b and km_last and b > km_last)
                gi = [round((b - a) / 1000, 1) for a, b in zip(gmo, gmo[1:])][-6:]
                p = spot()
                print(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} records | eggs {egg_txt or '-'} | WalkTogether {aff:.3f} km | "
                      f"map requests last intervals (s) {gi} | label {p[2] * 3.6 if p else 0:.2f} km/h", flush=True)
                next_snap = time.time() + 60
            p = spot()
            if p and last and meters(last, p) < 200:
                moved += meters(last, p)
            last = p or last
            time.sleep(2)
    finally:
        sc.unload()
        sess.detach()
    print("done", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

`README.md`:

```md
<div align="center">

<img src="assets/hero.svg" alt="PoGo Gotta Catch 'Em All: Autonomous Mobile Ingestion &amp; Statistical Arbitration" width="100%">

# PoGo-Gotta-Catch-Em-All

### Autonomous, self-auditing Pokémon GO collection curation pipeline for rooted Android: IL2CPP runtime memory walk, PvP stat-product ranking engine, and 11-audit cryptographic hard gate.

[![Android 17](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-17-3DDC84?style=for-the-badge&logo=android&logoColor=white)](https://www.android.com/)
[![Pixel 9 Pro](https://img.shields.io/badge/Device-Pixel%209%20Pro-4285F4?style=for-the-badge&logo=google&logoColor=white)](https://store.google.com/product/pixel_9_pro)
[![Root: Magisk + Zygisk](https://img.shields.io/badge/Root-Magisk%20%2B%20Zygisk-00AF9C?style=for-the-badge&logo=magisk&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk)
[![Frida 17](https://img.shields.io/badge/Frida-17.9.11-EF6456?style=for-the-badge&logo=frida&logoColor=white)](https://frida.re)
[![SQLite WAL](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-WAL%20Provenance-003B57?style=for-the-badge&logo=sqlite&logoColor=white)](https://www.sqlite.org/)
[![Python 3.12](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.12-3776AB?style=for-the-badge&logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://www.python.org/)

[![CI](https://github.com/BennyWaitWhat/PoGo-Gotta-Catch-Em-All/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/BennyWaitWhat/PoGo-Gotta-Catch-Em-All/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Audit Gate: 11 Checks](https://img.shields.io/badge/Audit%20Gate-11%20Parallel%20Checks-2ea043)](pogo_extract/full_audit.py)
[![Atomic Tagging](https://img.shields.io/badge/Execution-Tag%20Only%20%28Zero%20Releases%29-brightgreen)](pogo_extract/system/scripts/prune_tags.py)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-All%20Rights%20Reserved-lightgrey)](LICENSE)

[System Architecture](#-system-architecture) • [The Engineering Problem](#-the-engineering-problem) • [Core Pipeline](#-core-pipeline-mechanics) • [11-Audit Gate](#-the-11-audit-cryptographic-gate) • [Visual Proof](#-verified-visual-proof) • [Offline Verification](#-offline-verification--self-tests)

</div>

---

## ⚡ Executive Summary

**PoGo-Gotta-Catch-Em-All** is an autonomous collection management and statistical arbitration system built for rooted Android (**Pixel 9 Pro / Android 17**). It intercepts and inspects the live runtime memory of **Pokémon GO (0.429.1)** via an injected **Frida 17** gadget, extracts complete inventory state (~5,700 items) into an immutable SQLite WAL database, computes competitive PvP stat-product rankings with canonical CP multipliers, and enforces an **11-audit hard gate** before synchronizing in-game tags via Protobuf RPC.

The pipeline operates under a strict safety invariant: **zero automated releases**. The software identifies candidate transfers, validates them against multi-source freshness tripwires and regression test suites, tags them atomically in-game, and outputs an audit receipt for final player confirmation.

---

## 🔬 The Engineering Problem

Operating an inventory pipeline directly against a production mobile Unity / IL2CPP game environment introduces three core systems-engineering challenges:

1. **Transient Runtime Memory & Obfuscated Heap Layouts**:
   Unity's IL2CPP compiles C# code to native ARM64 assembly, stripping symbol tables and packing internal object layouts into dynamic Mono heap structures. Standard memory scraping risks application crashes, garbage collection deadlocks, or reading partially mutated pointers during active catching sessions.
2. **Silent Staleness & Service Graph Rebuilds**:
   The game engine frequently rebuilds internal service graphs without restarting the parent process. A naive memory walk can successfully extract consistent-looking data from an abandoned object graph, creating an illusion of validity while operating on obsolete collection state.
3. **Irreversible Destruction Risk**:
   Transferring a Pokémon in Pokémon GO is irreversible. A single false positive on an IV calculation, a misclassified costume form, a overlooked legacy move, or a top-ranked PvP stat product (e.g. Rank 1 Great League spread) results in permanent asset loss.

---

## 🏗️ System Architecture

The pipeline processes collection data across four decoupled stages, isolating phone-bound extraction from offline policy arbitration and atomic tag synchronization:

<div align="center">
  <img src="assets/review-pipeline.svg" alt="System Plate: The Maintained Cull Path" width="100%">
</div>

### 1. Runtime Injection & IL2CPP Memory Walk (`pogo_extract/pogo_pipeline.py`, `pogo_extract/pogo_il2cpp.py`)
- **Frida 17 Gadget**: Injected via ZygiskFrida (`127.0.0.1:27047`), binding directly into `com.nianticlabs.pokemongo` without placing the game on Magisk's DenyList.
- **Single-Attach Traversal**: Replaces multi-step process chains with a unified attach. Traverses `PokemonBagImpl` getters in compiled C (`LV_SRC`) to avoid JavaScript engine deadlocks during concurrent engine garbage collection.
- **Multi-Source Freshness Tripwires (`pogo_extract/walk_tripwires.py`)**: Cross-references phone epoch timestamps, database scan timestamps (`MAX(last_scanned)`), and background catcher counters to confirm that the service graph is actively receiving live game updates.

### 2. PvP Stat-Product Arbitration Engine (`pogo_extract/system/scripts/keep_policy.py`)
- **Canonical CPM Constants (`pogo_extract/system/scripts/cpm_table.py`)**: Single-sources all Combat Power Multipliers (L1.0 through L51.0, including `CPM50 = 0.8403000235557556`) and league caps (500 CP Little, 1500 CP Great, 2500 CP Ultra). Verified across 10 engine modules by `check_constant_drift.py` to prevent multi-file constant drift.
- **Comb-Up Evolution Simulation**: Recursively computes the stat product for every legal evolutionary branch. If an unevolved Pokémon can evolve into a superior PvP contender compared to an existing keeper, it is promoted and protected.
- **Multi-Factor Keeper Matrix**: Enforces strict retention for 100% IVs (hundos), 0% IVs (nundos), legacy movesets, lucky variants, costume forms, XXL/XXS showcase scores, and shadow/purified variants.

### 3. Cryptographic Provenance & Preflight Binding (`pogo_extract/system/scripts/preflight_transfer.py`)
- **Database Content Hashing**: Computes a normalized SHA-256 fingerprint (`db_content_sha256`) across database rows rather than file modification time, ensuring SQLite WAL checkpoints do not invalidate valid policy decisions.
- **Immutable Provenance (`pile_provenance.json`)**: Binds candidate transfer sets to specific database content hashes and policy fingerprints.
- **Signed Preflight Receipt**: Authorizes tag synchronization only when the candidate pile SHA-256 precisely matches the output of the audit gate.

### 4. Atomic Tag Synchronization & Human Verification (`pogo_extract/system/scripts/prune_tags.py`)
- **Protobuf RPC Tagging**: Dispatches tag mutations in validated batches and waits for explicit server acknowledgment (`Success`).
- **Cache Reconciliation**: Post-push verification re-reads the client tag cache to ensure local state reflects server truth.
- **Zero Automated Releases**: No release API exists in the codebase. Tagged candidates appear under the in-game `Transfer` tag, allowing the human trainer to inspect and execute the batch release manually.

---

## 🛡️ The 11-Audit Cryptographic Gate

Before any in-game tag write is permitted, `pogo_extract/full_audit.py` executes 11 independent, read-only verification jobs concurrently. A failure in any single audit triggers an immediate hard stop:

| # | Audit Job | Source Script | Pass Condition / Invariant |
|---|---|---|---|
| **01** | **8-Layer Cull Audit** | `pogo_extract/audit_cull.py` | `ALL LAYERS PASS` — Confirms no trophy, hundo, shiny, legendary, or costume mon is present in the transfer pile. |
| **02** | **Tag Membership Audit** | `pogo_extract/audit_tags_membership.py` | `ALL TAG MEMBERSHIPS CORRECT` — Re-derives all tag assignments against the policy rulebook. |
| **03** | **Evolution Comb-Up Audit** | `pogo_extract/_evocheck.py` | `none of the tagged mons would improve` — Asserts that no candidate transfer could evolve into a superior rank. |
| **04** | **Keep Law Re-Derivation** | `pogo_extract/_lawcheck.py` | `UNEXPLAINED: 0` — Independent algebraic verification that every kept mon has a lawful keep reason. |
| **05** | **Label Law Audit** | `pogo_extract/audit_labels.py` | `ALL LABELS LAWFUL` — Confirms display labels correspond strictly to documented game state. |
| **06** | **Evolution Promises Audit** | `pogo_extract/audit_promises.py` | `ALL PROMISES HOLD` — Sandboxes evolution advice to ensure post-evolution stats match predictions. |
| **07** | **Game Master Consistency** | `pogo_extract/audit_gamemaster.py` | `GAME MASTER CONSISTENT` — Validates protobuf game master definitions against PvPoke and PokeMiners schemas. |
| **08** | **Rank Tag Accuracy** | `pogo_extract/audit_rank_tags.py` | `EVERY RANK TAG CHECKS OUT` — Verifies Great and Ultra League PvP ranks against exact CPM multipliers. |
| **09** | **Tag Truth Verification** | `pogo_extract/audit_tag_truth.py` | `EVERY TAG IS TRUE` — Audits every applied tag directly against the monster's live memory attributes. |
| **10** | **Structural Invariants** | `pogo_extract/audit_invariants.py` | `ALL STRUCTURAL INVARIANTS HOLD` — Asserts schema models, enum bounds, and category constraints. |
| **11** | **PvP Keeper Regression** | `pogo_extract/system/scripts/regress_pvp_keepers.py` | `ALL PVP KEEPER FIXTURES KEPT` — Sandboxes historical keeper test fixtures to guarantee zero regression false positives. |

PoGo-Gotta-Catch-Em-All/
├── assets/                           # High-contrast vector artwork & authentic terminal captures
│   ├── hero.svg                      # Custom avant-garde repository hero banner
│   ├── review-pipeline.svg           # High-contrast 4-pillar architectural system plate
│   ├── field-journal.svg             # Editorial collection classification plate
│   └── cull_report_terminal.png      # Retina terminal capture of verified test executions
├── pogo_extract/                     # Core collection curation & memory extraction engine
│   ├── pogo_pipeline.py              # Single-attach Frida IL2CPP heap reader & database builder
│   ├── pogo_il2cpp.py                # Native IL2CPP type mapping & ARM64 bridge
│   ├── walk_tripwires.py             # Multi-source memory freshness verification
│   ├── full_audit.py                 # 11-audit parallel gate coordinator & tag synchronization
│   ├── cull_report.py                # Human-readable differential report generator
│   ├── system/scripts/               # Policy rules, CPM constants, and cryptographic provenance
│   │   ├── keep_policy.py            # Primary curation rulebook & stat-product calculation
│   │   ├── cpm_table.py              # Canonical Combat Power Multiplier reference (L1-L51)
│   │   ├── check_constant_drift.py   # Guard script verifying single-sourced game constants
│   │   ├── preflight_transfer.py     # Cryptographic receipt builder for Transfer tag writes
│   │   └── prune_tags.py             # Atomic in-game tag synchronization engine
│   ├── LAW.md                        # Formal specification of collection retention rules
│   └── RUNBOOK.md                    # Operational guide for manual verification and passes
├── AutoCatcher/                      # Optional on-device automation (manual opt-in)
│   ├── README.md                     # Architecture of background catching and crash recovery
│   └── tools/GYM.md                  # Specification for gym interaction and buddy routines
├── tools/                            # System-level auditing & data persistence utilities
│   ├── triple_check.py               # Pre-commit integrity gate (compilation, tests, secrets)
│   └── pogo_data.py                  # Phone data store synchronization utility
└── docs/                             # Engineering specifications & setup guides
    ├── cloud_setup.md                # Rooted phone network bridge configuration
    ├── data.md                       # Data ownership & phone store storage layout
    ├── phone_access.md               # ADB permission boundaries & security restrictions
    ├── START_HERE.md                 # Technical overview for new environments
    ├── HANDOFF.md                    # Engineering logs & state machine checkpoints
    └── CHANGELOG.md                  # Evolution of the curation pipeline
```

## 🧪 Offline Verification & Self-Tests

The repository enforces offline self-tests that run without an attached phone or live database:

```bash
# 1. Verify phone data store manifest integrity
python tools/pogo_data.py selftest

# 2. Run freshness tripwire engine self-test
python pogo_extract/walk_tripwires.py --selftest

# 3. Verify single-sourced game constants (Defect D4 check)
python pogo_extract/system/scripts/check_constant_drift.py

# 4. Verify cull report formatting and power-up budget math
python pogo_extract/cull_report.py --selftest

# 5. Verify game master parser offline integrity
python pogo_extract/system/scripts/refresh_gamemaster.py --selftest

# 6. Verify gym battle damage calculations
python AutoCatcher/tools/test_gym_stab.py

# 7. Run full pre-commit triple-check suite
python tools/triple_check.py
```

## ⚙️ Hardware & Environment Requirements

| Component | Tested Environment | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **Device** | Google Pixel 9 Pro | Target ARM64 execution platform |
| **Operating System** | Android 17 (Vanilla Ice Cream) | Mobile OS environment |
| **Root Solution** | Magisk 30.7 + Zygisk | Device privilege escalation & runtime injection |
| **Hook Engine** | Frida 17.9.11 + ZygiskFrida 1.9.0 | IL2CPP memory walk without DenyList conflict |
| **Target App** | Pokémon GO 0.429.1 | Production game binary |
| **Integrity Suite** | Play Integrity Fix + Shamiko | Environmental root hiding |
| **Network Bridge** | Tailscale 1.102 + ADB over Wi-Fi (:5555) | Secure, encrypted transport to phone shell |
| **Runtime** | Python 3.11+ / 3.12 | Local curation engine execution |

## ⚠️ Security, Safety & Legal Disclaimer

- **Zero In-Game Release Primitive**: This software does not contain any code capable of transferring or deleting Pokémon. It writes descriptive tags (`Transfer`, `Best GL`, `Power Up to 1500`) directly to the game's tagging system. The user must manually review and confirm any batch transfer within the official Pokémon GO client.
- **Account Risk**: Modifying memory or running automation on Pokémon GO violates Niantic's Terms of Service and may result in account penalties or permanent bans. This repository is provided strictly for educational and reverse-engineering research purposes.
- **Intellectual Property**: Pokémon and Pokémon GO are registered trademarks of Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc., and Niantic, Inc. This project is independent and has not been authorized, sponsored, or approved by the trademark holders.

`cloud/README.md`:

```md
# cloud

## `setup.sh` — the Claude cloud environment's setup script

Paste the whole file into the environment's **Setup script** field (claude.ai/code → environment settings). It runs once
as root on Ubuntu 24.04 and the result is cached, so later sessions start with everything installed:

- adb, socat, sqlite3, tzdata, `gh`, Node.js
- Tailscale (the official installer, or the static build when the installer can't run)
- Python: `frida==17.9.11` (must match the phone's gadget), `frida-tools==14.8.2`, `s2sphere`, `flask`, `protobuf`

The per-session part — joining the tailnet and bridging adb to the phone — is
`../.claude/hooks/cloud_session_start.sh`. Step-by-step setup and troubleshooting:
[`../docs/cloud_setup.md`](../docs/cloud_setup.md).

```

`cloud/setup.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# CLOUD ENVIRONMENT SETUP SCRIPT -- the copy in the repo is cloud/setup.sh (keep them identical).
# BEST-EFFORT ON PURPOSE: a failing setup script blocks the whole session (2026-09-29: pip died mid-download and the
# session never started). Nothing here may fail hard; the SessionStart hook reports anything still missing, with the fix.
# Network access must be FULL (Trusted blocks Tailscale).
set -uo pipefail
log() { echo "[setup] $*"; }
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

apt-get update -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || log "apt-get update failed"
for pkgs in "android-tools-adb socat curl ca-certificates iproute2 procps tzdata sqlite3" \
            "python3-pip nodejs sudo gh" "python-is-python3"; do
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends $pkgs >/dev/null 2>&1 || log "apt could not install some of: $pkgs"
done

# Tailscale: the official installer; if it fails (no systemd in the container), the static build.
if ! command -v tailscaled >/dev/null; then
  curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh | sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || log "tailscale install.sh failed -- trying the static build"
fi
if ! command -v tailscaled >/dev/null; then
  TGZ=$(curl -fsSL 'https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/?mode=json' | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["Tarballs"]["amd64"])' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "${TGZ:-}" ] && curl -fsSL "https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/$TGZ" | tar xz -C /tmp; then
    install -m 755 "/tmp/${TGZ%.tgz}/tailscale" "/tmp/${TGZ%.tgz}/tailscaled" /usr/local/bin/ || log "tailscale static install failed"
  else
    log "tailscale static download failed"
  fi
fi

# Python: frida MUST match the phone's gadget (17.9.11); frida-tools pinned with it (newer ones need frida >= 17.10).
# Two tries with retries/timeouts; the image's own python3 (3.11 on 2026-09-29) is fine -- frida ships abi3 wheels.
PIP="python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --retries 5 --timeout 120 --progress-bar off"
# 2026-09-30: Debian's python3-blinker 1.7 has no RECORD file, so pip can't upgrade it to flask's blinker>=1.9 and the
# whole install below failed (flask + frida-tools missing). Install the new one beside it (earlier on sys.path).
python3 -c 'import flask' 2>/dev/null || timeout 300 $PIP --ignore-installed 'blinker>=1.9' || log "blinker install failed"
for try in 1 2; do
  timeout 600 $PIP frida==17.9.11 frida-tools==14.8.2 s2sphere flask protobuf && break
  log "pip install failed (try $try)"; sleep 5
done

log "summary: tailscale=$(command -v tailscaled >/dev/null && echo ok || echo MISSING)" \
    "adb=$(command -v adb >/dev/null && echo ok || echo MISSING)" \
    "socat=$(command -v socat >/dev/null && echo ok || echo MISSING)" \
    "frida=$(python3 -c 'import frida; print(frida.__version__)' 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
exit 0

```

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project. Format: [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/);
versions follow [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## [Unreleased]

### Added
- Bag Pulse redesign: a night Pokédex frame from the README banner (Poké Ball header, navy-to-plum) with Oura-style data —
  score rings, light numerals, pastel series, smooth lines with fading fills; the page now shows the real scan time.
- Bag Pulse pictures: the Transfer pile as tiles with each mon's exact icon (form, costume, gender, shiny), location-card
  thumbnails, the game's own species and form names, and small icons in the pass table. Embedded from PokeMiners/pogo_assets
  into the page (`pogo_extract/bag_art.py`, `pogo_display.py`, `pogo_icon_index.txt`, `official_names_en.json`); the cache is
  rebuildable and not in the phone data store; every failure falls back to text and `BAG_ART=0` gives the old page.
- Exact Power Up costs from the game master (`pogo_extract/game_opportunities.py`, Benny 2026-09-30: "yes"): `power_up_cost()` prices any
  level range in stardust, candy (to L39.5) and XL candy (from L40) from the client game master's `POKEMON_UPGRADE_SETTINGS` at call
  time, with the shadow / purified / lucky multipliers and the per-species override (Eternatus: 8,900 XL candy for L40 to L50). The cull
  report gets a report-only Power Up block: each mon the Power Up tags hold, its price against your stardust and its family's candy
  and XL candy, and "doable now" / "doable after exchanging N candy" (if the game allows it) / "short X". No tag, keep reason or pile
  decision reads it: on the 2026-09-30 01:43 bag the pile, the keep reasons and all 33 tag files come out byte-identical to before.
  `python game_opportunities.py --selftest` (offline, golden prices hand-checked against the tables) is in CI and `tools/triple_check.py`.

### Changed
- Client game-master guard, three more checks (`gm_guard.py`, `refresh_gamemaster.py`, `evolvable_forms.py`, `costume_forms.py`):
  each held form's costume flag is judged (a batch that flags or unflags one stops for review); a content canary refuses a batch
  under 90% of the installed one on any of 14 counts (renamed templateIds, base stats, evolution table, flags, move lists ...;
  0 false stops in the 154 PokeMiners batches since 2023; `--accept-smaller` lets a genuine format change through, only on
  Benny's word); ids a batch prints as enum numbers (0.381.2, 0.395.1) are named on download and in `evolvable_forms`, which
  crashed on them and then kept half a table. No keep decision changes (0 tags, 0 reasons, same 41-mon pile).
- Evolution quests are worded in the game's own text ("Defeat 15 Dark- or Steel-type Raid Bosses", "Win 10 raids", "Earn 70 hearts
  with your buddy") in the gated-evolution `need` strings, the "Which way to evolve" lines and the ladder report. The hand-built
  wording was wrong for 14 of the 37 quests (Sirfetch'd lost "Excellent", Overqwil "complete" for "win", hearts on a goal of 20 said
  "earn hearts with 20 times"). The texts ship in `pogo_extract/official_names_en.json` (`quests`), rebuilt with the same
  `bag_art.py --refresh-names` command; `evolvable_forms.json` cache v11. Text only: pile, reasons and tags are unchanged.
- A shadow mon's 2nd-move price is now x1.2 and a purified mon's x0.8 (`SHARED_MOVE_SETTINGS`); it was the plain price for every mon.
  `deep_profile.py` prices `power-up->L50` from the same tables (L40 to L50 was 340,000 dust / 290 XL, the game says 250,000 / 296;
  L20 to L50 was 840,000 dust, the game says 475,000). `game_opportunities.py` with an unknown argument prints its usage and exits 2.
- Root tidied: CONTRIBUTING / SECURITY / CODE_OF_CONDUCT moved to `.github/`, the CHANGELOG to `docs/`,
  `data_manifest.txt` to `tools/`, `wf_master.json` to `pogo_extract/`; `.editorconfig` removed.

### Changed
- AutoCatcher: every path that force-stopped PoGo is retired (#6): `restart_pogo_and_wait` raises, `tools/joystick_round.py`
  refuses while PoGo is open, and 41 retired `ondevice_toggle/` files plus `catch_loop_fast.v1-pause.py` left git (they stay on the PC).
- `docs/memory` re-synced with the PC memory (#7).

## [1.0.0] — 2026-09-29 — the move to the cloud

Before this release the tooling lived only on Benny's Windows PC (bag curation since 2026-05, the on-phone catcher
since 2026-06, the gym and buddy runners since 2026-09). This release puts it in one private repo that Claude cloud sessions run.

### Added
- The repository: `pogo_extract/` (bag curation), `AutoCatcher/` (on-phone catcher, research tools, gym/buddy runners),
  `pokegenie_work/` (PokeGenie tooling), whitelist `.gitignore` files, byte-exact `.gitattributes`.
- **Cloud phone bridge**: a SessionStart hook runs Tailscale inside the cloud VM, bridges adb over `tailscale nc`
  (on the phone's own address when the VM allows it) and exports `ADB_TARGET` and `TZ`; `cloud/setup.sh` for the environment.
- **Phone data store** (`tools/pogo_data.py`, `data_manifest.txt`): per-group versioned, sha256-checked tarballs on the
  phone; pull refuses to overwrite newer local work; push refuses to overwrite newer phone data; SQLite-safe packing.
- Docs: `docs/START_HERE.md` (printed into every session), `cloud_setup.md`, `data.md`, `phone_access.md`, and the
  exported working memory (113 notes).
- `pogo_extract/CLAUDE.md`; the `/cull` skill for the cloud (pull → cull → push → Bag Pulse).
- Community files, CI (offline checks + secret scan), issue/PR templates, CODEOWNERS, Dependabot for Actions.

### Changed
- The phone busy marker is **advisory**: logged, never waited on (“no one should be pausing anything for anyone”).
- `full_audit.py` refuses unknown flags (rc 2) and refuses to run without a real `pokemon.db`.
- `evolvable_forms.py` writes its cache atomically (parallel cold starts crashed 6 of 25 rounds before, 0 after).
- `dashboard.py` cancels jobs on Linux; `verify_tags_live.py` honours `ADB_TARGET`.
- `granular_tags.py --audit` says NOT RUN instead of a false green when no tag sets exist.
- `pogo_il2cpp.restart_pogo_and_wait()` refuses (#4): tools never force-stop or relaunch PoGo; `set_nicknames.py` stops
  instead of restarting the game.
- CI actions bumped by Dependabot: `actions/checkout` v7 (#2), `actions/setup-python` v7 (#3).

### Removed
- From the repo (kept on the PC): scripts that break the hard rules — bulk release, tag nukes outside `safe_nuke_tags.py`,
  game force-stoppers, the retired autocull and self-update daemons — plus stale-cap policy docs and third-party RE notes.

### Security
- Secrets and personal data excluded by whitelist; a Google-account identifier kept out of a research doc; CI secret scan.

## 8. Gotchas that cost time today
- **"Done" means `python tools/triple_check.py --gate` says ALL CLEAR** (Benny: "triple check everything. Same for future
  posterity.") — and every owning session confirmed its own area.
- **Never run a script with `--help` to learn it** — `full_audit.py --help` ran a real cull (fixed: unknown flags → rc 2).
  Never pipe a phone script into `head`/`tail`: a broken pipe kills it mid-cycle.
- **Heredocs mangle backslashes and quotes** in the agent shell: write patch scripts to a file, then run them.
- **Keep each file's line endings** (`* -text`; many pogo_extract files are CRLF). Python rewrites with default newline
  handling silently convert CRLF → LF — read/write bytes, or use the Edit tool.
- **Other adb devices share the tailnet** (Bravia TV 100.113.169.96, Google TV 100.85.17.54): always `adb -s "$ADB_TARGET"`.
- **The app's PR monitor can't read this repo's CI** (its GitHub account lacks access): read `gh pr checks N` once; don't poll.
- **adb over the tailnet runs ~1 MB/s**: big transfers take minutes; `pogo_data.py` timeouts scale with size.
- **Cloud sessions can't message each other back.** Coordinate through the repo (PR descriptions, `docs/memory/`) and Benny.

## 9. Standing rules (full text: `START_HERE.md` §4, `pogo_extract/CLAUDE.md`, `docs/memory/`)
Tag only, never release · the pile's one route: `preflight_transfer.py` → `prune_tags.py --atomic` · never restart / force-stop
PoGo · never pause the catcher; nobody waits for anybody · no game automation without Benny's explicit "go" · no system
settings without asking · policy = numbered options, his picks, `LAW.md` first · bag counts only from this turn's walk ·
report game-owned numbers from the game · say what you verified and what you didn't.

# docs

- **Policy is Benny's call:** anything that changes what is kept → numbered options, wait for his picks.
- **Bag counts only from this turn's live walk.** Game numbers come from the game, never from memory or a doc.
- **No secrets anywhere** in the repo or chat. Found a token, key or password? Stop and tell Benny.

`docs/cloud_setup.md`:

```md
# Cloud setup — how a Claude cloud session reaches the phone

```
cloud VM ──tailscaled (userspace, HTTPS via the VM's proxy)──> Benny's tailnet ──> Pixel 100.98.158.56:5555 (adbd)
   adb ─> socat 100.98.158.56:5555 (VM loopback) ─> `tailscale nc` ─┘        Frida: adb forward tcp:27047 over the same link
```
Pieces in this repo: `cloud/setup.sh` (installs adb, socat, Tailscale, Python deps — the environment's setup script),
`.claude/hooks/cloud_session_start.sh` (every session: join the tailnet, restore the adb key, bridge, `adb connect`, export `ADB_TARGET`
and `TZ`), `.claude/settings.json` (registers the hook).

## Phone prerequisites (once)
- **Root:** Magisk with Zygisk on (tested: Magisk 30.7 · Pixel 9 Pro · Android 17).
- **Frida gadget in the game:** ZygiskFrida (tested v1.9.0) targeting `com.nianticlabs.pokemongo` with a Frida 17 gadget in
  listen mode. The gadget config the tools expect is
  [`AutoCatcher/ondevice_toggle/config.listen.so`](../AutoCatcher/ondevice_toggle/config.listen.so):
  `{"interaction":{"type":"listen","address":"127.0.0.1","port":27047,"on_load":"resume"}}`
  (ZygiskFrida's own files live in `/data/local/tmp/re.zyg.fri/`). Pokémon GO must **not** be on Magisk's DenyList.
- **Root hiding:** Shamiko (DenyList configured but NOT enforced) + Play Integrity Fix.
- **Tailscale** app on the phone, signed in to the tailnet the cloud key joins.
- **adb over Wi-Fi at every boot** — save as `/data/adb/service.d/adb_tcp_5555.sh`, then `chmod 755` it:
  ```sh
  #!/system/bin/sh
  setprop service.adb.tcp.port 5555
  stop adbd
  start adbd
  ```
- *Automation only:* Termux + Termux:Boot (the on-phone catcher), GPS Joystick, Pokemod.

## Benny's one-time steps (≈15 min)
1. **GitHub access.** claude.ai/code → pick the repo `BennyWaitWhat/PoGo-Gotta-Catch-Em-All`. If it isn't listed, install/authorize the
   Claude GitHub app for BennyWaitWhat and give it this repo.
2. **Tailscale key** (login.tailscale.com/admin -> Settings -> Keys -> Generate auth key): Reusable ON, Ephemeral ON,
   Pre-approved ON (if shown), expiry 90 days. Copy the `tskey-auth-...` value. (Optional hardening, after it works: the
   "Lock it down" section below.)
3. **A cloud-only ADB key** (PowerShell on the PC; keeps the PC's own key private, and you can revoke it on its own):
   ```
   adb keygen "$env:USERPROFILE\.android\cloud_adbkey"
   [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("$env:USERPROFILE\.android\cloud_adbkey")) | Set-Clipboard
   ```
   paste it as `ADB_KEY_B64=` below; then run the last line again with `cloud_adbkey.pub` for `ADB_PUB_B64=`.
   The FIRST cloud session makes the phone ask "Allow USB debugging?": tick **Always allow from this computer**, tap Allow,
   then tell the session "retry the bridge" (it runs `adb connect "$ADB_TARGET"`).
4. **Cloud environment** (claude.ai/code → environment settings → new environment "PoGo"):
   - Network access: **Full** (Trusted blocks Tailscale).
   - Environment variables:
     ```
     TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY=tskey-auth-...
     ADB_KEY_B64=...
     ADB_PUB_B64=...
     ```
   - Setup script: paste all of `cloud/setup.sh`.
5. **Test:** start a session on the repo with that environment and say `cull`. The first message context shows `PHONE BRIDGE: connected`;
   the session pulls the data from the phone, runs the cull, pushes the data back, and reports.

Every 90 days the Tailscale key expires: generate a new one (step 2) and replace `TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY`.

## Lock it down (optional, once the bridge works)
Limit the cloud VM to the phone's adb port instead of the whole tailnet:
1. Access controls: add `"tagOwners": {"tag:claude-cloud": ["autogroup:admin"]}`, and an allow rule for
   `tag:claude-cloud` -> `100.98.158.56:5555` only. If the file still has the allow-all rule (`"src": ["*"]`), change that
   `*` to `autogroup:member` so your own devices keep full access and the tag gets only the rule above.
   (`acls` syntax: `{"action": "accept", "src": ["tag:claude-cloud"], "dst": ["100.98.158.56:5555"]}`;
   `grants` syntax: `{"src": ["tag:claude-cloud"], "dst": ["100.98.158.56"], "ip": ["tcp:5555"]}`.)
2. Generate a new key as in step 2 with Tags: `tag:claude-cloud`, and replace `TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY`.

## When the bridge says NOT connected (for sessions)
Read `/tmp/pogo_bridge.log`, then tell Benny the one matching line:
| Log shows | Cause | Fix (Benny) |
|---|---|---|
| `tailscale is not installed` | setup script missing/failed | paste `cloud/setup.sh` as the setup script |
| `TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY is not set` | env var missing | step 4 |
| `tailscale up failed` / auth errors | key expired/revoked, or network not Full | new key (step 2) / network Full |
| up, but `adb connect` fails or times out | phone off/offline, or its Tailscale app is off | wake the phone, turn Tailscale on (adb over TCP 5555 comes back by itself at boot: Magisk `service.d/adb_tcp_5555.sh`) |
| `unauthorized` in `adb devices` | the phone has not allowed the cloud key yet, or a wrong key | tap Allow on the phone ("Always allow"), then `adb connect "$ADB_TARGET"`; else redo step 3 |
| `could not add 100.98.158.56 to loopback` | VM without root/NET_ADMIN | works on `127.0.0.1:5555`; tools that hardcode the address won't reach the phone |

Check by hand: `tailscale --socket=/tmp/tailscaled.sock status`, `adb devices`, `adb -s "$ADB_TARGET" shell getprop ro.product.model`.

## What changed for the PC (2026-09-29)
The PC seeded the phone data store and made the first commit. PoGo work no longer happens there; its folders stay as a backup copy.

`docs/data.md`:

```md
# The game data lives on the phone

Git holds code and docs. Everything the tools READ AND WRITE as they run — `pokemon.db`, the DB snapshots, walk outputs (candy, items,
Pokédex, player state), tag sets, `keep_config.json` (per account), the game-master copies, catcher studies, gym state — lives in one
place: `/data/local/tmp/pogo_data/` on the Pixel. Why there: cloud VMs are wiped between sessions, cloud sessions can only push their own
git branch, git LFS does not work in the cloud, and the data changes every run (committing it would bloat the repo by GBs a month).
Every session that does phone work reaches the phone anyway.

## Commands (repo root)
```
python tools/pogo_data.py status                   # every group: phone version vs the version this checkout holds
python tools/pogo_data.py pull                     # all non-cold groups -> into this checkout (only what changed)
python tools/pogo_data.py pull --group inventory   # one group
python tools/pogo_data.py push --group inventory   # after a cull (owner only); refused if the phone moved since your pull
python tools/pogo_data.py selftest                 # offline check of the tool itself
```

## Groups (`tools/data_manifest.txt` says exactly which files)
| Group | Owner (only the owner pushes it) | What | Pulled by default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inventory` | Pokemon Inventory | `pokemon.db`, walk outputs, tag sets, analysis state, per-account sets, newest 6 snapshots | yes |
| `inventory-cold` | Pokemon Inventory | every DB snapshot + the pre-switch archive (`archive_main_account_20260926/`, keep forever). **Kept on the PC, not the phone** (Benny 2026-09-30: "maybe pc is ok"): 1.6 GB on 2026-09-30, because every cull saves a full ~4 MB copy of the bag and nothing ever thinned them; since then each cull keeps only the newest 100 per account (`db_safety.KEEP_RECENT`, Benny: "Just keep the last 100 culls."), about 400 MB, and `archive_main_account_20260926/` is never pruned. The phone's `inventory` group already carries the newest 6 snapshots. Seeding it anyway is one `push --group inventory-cold` from the PC (~25 min at ~1 MB/s, phone idle) | no |
| `catcher` | AutoCatcher | map data, studies (`*.jsonl`), caches its tools read | yes |
| `gym` | Gym Battle | `AutoCatcher/tools/gym_state/` except the runner inbox | yes |

## Guarantees
- **Per-group versions.** Sessions never block each other; a push is refused only when THAT group moved since your pull (`--force` exists
  for recovery; never use it over another session's work).
- **Nothing lost silently.** A pull refuses to overwrite a local file that is newer than the phone's copy (a PC that still holds unpushed
  work); `--force` takes the phone's copy anyway.
- **Code never rolls back.** Files git tracks are never packed, so a pull cannot overwrite code.
- **SQLite-safe.** `*.db` files are packed through SQLite's backup API; stale `-wal`/`-shm` files are removed on pull.
- **Atomic.** Uploads land under a temp name, are sha256-checked on the phone, then renamed; a reader never sees half a file.

## Not in the data store
Secrets (Pokemod/Niantic prefs, `nia_secret_*`, keystores, `game_limits.json`, `pogo_extract/system/analysis/pokemod/`), RE dumps,
binaries, logs, backups, and `system/scripts/rank_tables.pkl` (333 MB, rebuilds itself when missing — the first cull in a fresh VM is
slower for it). To add a file: put its pattern in `tools/data_manifest.txt` under the owning group (owner edits), then push that group.

Also not stored: Bag Pulse's picture cache, `pogo_extract/system/analysis/art_cache/` (2026-09-30). It is thumbnails of a public source
(PokeMiners/pogo_assets), rebuilt by the next cull in 2-3 s (about 20 single-file GETs; an offline cull just shows text), so it is
derived, not state; the manifest's single-level `system/analysis/*.json` globs do not match it. Revisit only if a cold fetch ever takes
over ~10 s or raw.githubusercontent.com proves unreliable from cloud sessions: then add `pogo_extract/system/analysis/art_cache/**` to
`[inventory]`. The two reference files it reads (`pogo_icon_index.txt`, `official_names_en.json`) are code: git tracks them.

## The PC
The Windows PC is no longer where PoGo work happens. It seeded the store on 2026-09-29 and still holds the original copies. If a PC
session ever works again: `pull` first, `push` after — the version checks keep the PC and the cloud from overwriting each other.

```md
# Phone access — who attaches what

One game on one phone, several sessions and tools. **Benny's rule (2026-09-29): "everything should be working while each tool is in
there. no one should be pausing anything for anyone."** Tools overlap by design; nobody waits, refuses or pauses for another.

## The plumbing
- **Cloud:** the SessionStart hook runs `tailscaled` (userspace), pipes `socat` → `tailscale nc 100.98.158.56 5555` and runs
  `adb connect`. The bridge listens on the phone's own address (`100.98.158.56:5555`, added to the VM's loopback) when the VM allows it,
  else on `127.0.0.1:5555`. `ADB_TARGET` is exported either way; every current tool reads it (default `100.98.158.56:5555`).
  Always `adb -s "$ADB_TARGET"`.
- **Frida:** the game runs a Frida gadget injected at zygote fork (ZygiskFrida). Desktop tools `adb forward tcp:27047` and attach to
  `127.0.0.1:27047` through `pogo_il2cpp.get_session()` (connect + forward + readiness gate + attach). Each copy of `pogo_il2cpp.py`
  (`pogo_extract/`, `AutoCatcher/`) belongs to its folder's owner.
- **On-phone catcher:** runs inside the phone (Termux), attaches to the same gadget locally, and needs no bridge. It never stops for us.

## Who attaches what
| Actor | Owner | When |
|---|---|---|
| The cull (`pogo_extract/full_audit.py`: walk, tag sync, post tags) | Pokemon Inventory | When Benny says "cull" (or asks for a read-only walk). One pass per ask |
| Other `pogo_extract` tools that attach | Pokemon Inventory | On Benny's go |
| AutoCatcher desktop tools, `deploy.sh`, `catcher_ctl.sh` | AutoCatcher | On Benny's go; anything that acts in the game needs an explicit go |
| Gym and buddy runners, tappers | Gym Battle | Explicit go every time (2026-09-26 lockout) |
| The on-phone catcher | AutoCatcher | Always running; toggled by its flag files |

## The busy marker — ADVISORY
`/data/local/tmp/pogo_desktop_busy` = `<name> <epoch-seconds deadline>` (phone clock). Every desktop attacher writes its own name with a
deadline ≤ 300 s ahead, refreshes it while attached, and clears it on exit only if it still names itself. A foreign live marker is
**logged and reported, never waited on, never a reason to refuse**. It exists so a crash or oddity can be traced to who was attached.
Implementations: `pogo_extract/pogo_il2cpp.phone_busy_acquire`, `AutoCatcher/pogo_il2cpp.py`. The on-phone catcher is exempt.

## Rules of the road
- Tell Benny what a phone step will do before it starts (which step attaches, roughly how long, PoGo must stay open), unless he just
  asked for exactly that ("cull" is the go for one cull).
- One pass per go. Never re-run a failed pass while the game is restarting; never attach-probe in a retry loop.
- Attach only when PoGo is attach-safe (`pogo_il2cpp.wait_ready_to_attach()`: libil2cpp mapped, process older than 45 s).
- Never restart, force-stop or relaunch PoGo; never stop GPS Joystick or Pokemod while PoGo is open; never change system settings.
- Contract the cull relies on (tell Pokemon Inventory before changing it): the `^HH:MM:SS CATCH ` lines of
  `~/pogo/system/analysis/pokemod/catch_loop.log` and `caught=` in `/data/local/tmp/pogo_state.txt` (read by `walk_tripwires.py`).
- The pause file `/data/local/tmp/pogo_pause` (the catcher detaches while its deadline is in the future): the cull never sets it
  (`full_audit.CATCHER_PAUSE_ENABLED = False`). AutoCatcher's reward catcher used it; under the no-pausing rule, reward catching is
  being folded into the catcher itself (AutoCatcher owns that).

```
