```py
def decode(bs, offset, typ):
    if not bs: return None
    if typ == 'bool':
        return bs[offset] if offset < len(bs) else None
    if typ == 'i8':
        if offset >= len(bs): return None
        v = bs[offset]
        return v if v < 128 else v - 256
    if typ == 'i32':
        return struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, offset)[0] if offset+4 <= len(bs) else None
    if typ == 'i64':
        return struct.unpack_from('<q', bs, offset)[0] if offset+8 <= len(bs) else None
    if typ == 'u32':
        return struct.unpack_from('<I', bs, offset)[0] if offset+4 <= len(bs) else None
    if typ == 'u64':
        return struct.unpack_from('<Q', bs, offset)[0] if offset+8 <= len(bs) else None
    if typ == 'f32':
        return struct.unpack_from('<f', bs, offset)[0] if offset+4 <= len(bs) else None
    if typ == 'f64':
        return struct.unpack_from('<d', bs, offset)[0] if offset+8 <= len(bs) else None
    return None


def ensure_columns(conn):
    c = conn.cursor()
    existing = {r[1] for r in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(pokemon)')}
    added = []
    all_new = (
        [(name, sql) for name, _, _, sql in PROTO_FIELDS] +
        [(name, sql) for name, _, _, sql in DISPLAY_FIELDS] +
        [(name, 'TEXT') for name, _, is_new in STRING_FIELDS if is_new] +
        [(name, sql) for name, sql, is_new in DERIVED_FIELDS if is_new]
    )
    for name, sql_type in all_new:
        if name not in existing:
            c.execute(f'ALTER TABLE pokemon ADD COLUMN {name} {sql_type}')
            added.append(name)
    conn.commit()
    return added


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--dry-run', action='store_true')
    args = ap.parse_args()

    print('Attaching...')
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print(f'  pid={pid}')
    try:
        bag = pg.find_singleton(sess, 'Niantic.Holoholo.Internal', 'PokemonBagImpl')
        print(f'  bag @ {bag}')
        script = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, WALK_JS)
        t0 = time.time()
        entries = script.exports_sync.full_enrich_walk(bag)
        print(f'  walked {len(entries)} entries in {time.time()-t0:.2f}s')
        script.unload()
    finally:
        sess.detach()

    if args.dry_run:
        # Show one example to verify
        ex = entries[0] if entries else None
        if ex:
            print(f'\nExample (first entry):')
            print(f'  uid={ex["uid"]}')
            print(f'  nickname={ex.get("nickname")!r}')
            print(f'  ownerName={ex.get("ownerName")!r}')
            print(f'  originalOwnerNickname={ex.get("originalOwnerNickname")!r}')
            pBytes = bytes.fromhex(ex['protoBytes'])
            dBytes = bytes.fromhex(ex.get('displayBytes') or '')
            print('  proto decoded:')
            for name, off, typ, _ in PROTO_FIELDS:
                v = decode(pBytes, off, typ)
                print(f'    {name:32s} = {v}')
            print('  display decoded:')
            for name, off, typ, _ in DISPLAY_FIELDS:
                v = decode(dBytes, off, typ)
                print(f'    {name:32s} = {v}')
        print('\n(--dry-run; no DB writes)')
        return

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    added = ensure_columns(conn)
    if added:
        print(f'  added {len(added)} new columns: {added}')

    form_enum = json.load(open(FORM_ENUM_JSON, encoding='utf-8')) if os.path.exists(FORM_ENUM_JSON) else {}

    c = conn.cursor()
    proto_cols = [name for name, _, _, _ in PROTO_FIELDS]
    disp_cols  = [name for name, _, _, _ in DISPLAY_FIELDS]
    string_cols = [name for name, _, _ in STRING_FIELDS]
    derived_cols = [name for name, _, _ in DERIVED_FIELDS]
    all_cols = proto_cols + disp_cols + string_cols + derived_cols
    set_clause = ', '.join(f'{col}=?' for col in all_cols)
    update_sql = f'UPDATE pokemon SET {set_clause} WHERE uid_hex=?'

    # Pull pokemon_id, form, iv_total, fresh_current_temp_evolution, fresh_alignment
    # for derived computation (these come from the DB which is fresh from pipeline)
    info_rows = c.execute(
        "SELECT uid_hex, pokemon_id, form, iv_total, fresh_current_temp_evolution, fresh_alignment "
        "FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1"
    ).fetchall()
    info_map = {r[0]: r[1:] for r in info_rows}

    n_updated = 0
    t0 = time.time()
    for rec in entries:
        uid_unsigned = int(rec['uid'])
        uid_hex = f"{uid_unsigned & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF:016x}"
        pBytes = bytes.fromhex(rec['protoBytes'])
        dBytes = bytes.fromhex(rec.get('displayBytes') or '')

        # Decode proto + display primitives + strings
        vals = []
        decoded_proto = {}
        decoded_disp  = {}
        for name, off, typ, _ in PROTO_FIELDS:
            v = decode(pBytes, off, typ)
            decoded_proto[name] = v
            vals.append(v)
        for name, off, typ, _ in DISPLAY_FIELDS:
            v = decode(dBytes, off, typ) if dBytes else None
            decoded_disp[name] = v
            vals.append(v)
        for _, json_key, _ in STRING_FIELDS:
            vals.append(rec.get(json_key))

        # Derived fields — order matches DERIVED_FIELDS list
        info = info_map.get(uid_hex)
        if info:
            pid, form_id, iv_total, fresh_tempevo, fresh_align = info
        else:
            # New UID not in DB yet (insert pending) — fall back to proto-decoded values
            pid = decoded_proto.get('pokemon_id')  # not in PROTO_FIELDS by name — use proto bytes
            pid = struct.unpack_from('<i', pBytes, 0x28)[0] if len(pBytes) >= 0x2c else 0
            form_id = decoded_disp.get('original_costume')  # not exactly form; safer to skip
            form_id = struct.unpack_from('<i', dBytes, 0x1c)[0] if dBytes and len(dBytes) >= 0x20 else 0
            iv_total = (decoded_proto.get('stamina', 0) or 0)  # not right; recompute
            iv_atk = struct.unpack_from('<i', pBytes, 0x70)[0] if len(pBytes) >= 0x74 else 0
            iv_def = struct.unpack_from('<i', pBytes, 0x74)[0] if len(pBytes) >= 0x78 else 0
            iv_sta = struct.unpack_from('<i', pBytes, 0x78)[0] if len(pBytes) >= 0x7c else 0
            iv_total = iv_atk + iv_def + iv_sta
            fresh_tempevo = struct.unpack_from('<i', dBytes, 0x2c)[0] if dBytes and len(dBytes) >= 0x30 else 0
            fresh_align = struct.unpack_from('<i', dBytes, 0x24)[0] if dBytes and len(dBytes) >= 0x28 else 0

        add_cpm = decoded_proto.get('additional_cpm') or 0
        deployed_fort = rec.get('deployedFortId')
        badge = struct.unpack_from('<i', dBytes, 0x28)[0] if dBytes and len(dBytes) >= 0x2c else 0

        derived = {
            'is_best_buddy':         1 if add_cpm > 0 else 0,
            'is_deployed':           1 if (deployed_fort and deployed_fort.strip()) else 0,
            'is_purified_flag':      1 if fresh_align == 2 else 0,
            'is_mega_evolved':       1 if (fresh_tempevo or 0) != 0 else 0,
            'is_legendary':          1 if pid in LEGENDARY_IDS else 0,
            'is_mythical':           1 if pid in MYTHICAL_IDS else 0,
            'is_ultra_beast':        1 if pid in ULTRA_BEAST_IDS else 0,
            'is_paradox':            1 if pid in PARADOX_IDS else 0,
            'can_mega_evolve':       1 if pid in MEGA_EVOLUTION_IDS else 0,
            'is_dynamax_capable':    None,  # canonical list not derivable; skip
            'is_gigantamax_capable': 1 if pid in GMAX_RELEASED_IDS else 0,
            'is_adventure_effect_species': 1 if pid in ADVENTURE_EFFECT_SPECIES else 0,
            'form_region':           _form_region(form_id, form_enum),
            'was_best_buddy_badge':  1 if badge == 1 else 0,
            'is_three_star':         1 if (iv_total or 0) >= 37 else 0,
            'is_four_star':          1 if (iv_total or 0) == 45 else 0,
        }
        for name, _, _ in DERIVED_FIELDS:
            vals.append(derived.get(name))

        vals.append(uid_hex)
        c.execute(update_sql, vals)
        if c.rowcount > 0: n_updated += 1
    conn.commit()
    print(f'  DB updated: {n_updated}/{len(entries)} rows in {time.time()-t0:.2f}s')

    # ---- Quick verification snapshot ----
    print('\n=== Verification ===')
    GENDER = {0:'UNSET', 1:'MALE', 2:'FEMALE', 3:'GENDERLESS'}
    print('Gender distribution (in_bag):')
    for g, n in c.execute("SELECT gender, COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 GROUP BY gender ORDER BY gender"):
        print(f'  {g} ({GENDER.get(g, "?")}): {n}')
    fav   = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND favorite=1").fetchone()[0]
    nick  = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND nickname IS NOT NULL AND nickname != ''").fetchone()[0]
    mega  = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND has_mega_evolved=1").fetchone()[0]
    remote= c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND marked_remote_tradable=1").fetchone()[0]
    hatch = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND hatched_from_egg=1").fetchone()[0]
    party = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND caught_in_party=1").fetchone()[0]
    fort  = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND from_fort=1").fetchone()[0]
    own   = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND original_owner_name IS NOT NULL AND original_owner_name != ''").fetchone()[0]
    print(f'Favorite:                 {fav}')
    print(f'Nicknamed:                {nick}')
    print(f'Has mega-evolved (ever):  {mega}')
    print(f'Marked remote-tradable:   {remote}  (Forever Friends opt-in)')
    print(f'Hatched from egg:         {hatch}')
    print(f'Caught in party play:     {party}')
    print(f'From fort/raid:           {fort}')
    print(f'Has original owner name:  {own}')

    # Combee gender check (relevant for Vespiquen evolution)
    print('\nCombee (pid 415) gender breakdown:')
    for r in c.execute("SELECT uid_hex, cp, iv_total, fresh_shiny, gender FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND pokemon_id=415 ORDER BY iv_total DESC"):
        g = GENDER.get(r[4], f'enum{r[4]}')
        sh = '★' if r[3] else ' '
        print(f'  {r[0]}  cp={r[1]:>4} iv={r[2]:>2} shiny={sh} gender={g}')

    conn.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
            "EventManager","EventService","Calendar","Promo","BonusBox","ActiveEvent",

"""


def main():
    out = {"ok": False}
    last_err = None
    for attempt in range(4):
        sess = None
        try:
            sess, pid = pg.get_session()
            sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
            res = {}
            for image in ["holo-game.dll", "holo-protos.dll"]:
                rows = sc.exports_sync.scan(image, KEYWORDS)
                # de-dup by (ns,cls)
                seen = set()
                kept = []
                for r in rows:
                    key = (r.get("ns", ""), r.get("cls", ""))
                    if key in seen:
                        continue
                    seen.add(key)
                    kept.append(r)
                res[image] = kept
            out["classes"] = res
            out["counts"] = {k: len(v) for k, v in res.items()}
            out["pid"] = pid
            out["ok"] = True
            print(json.dumps(out, indent=0))
            sess.detach()
            return
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = str(e)[:160]
            try:
                sess.detach()
            except Exception:
                pass
            time.sleep(3)
    out["error"] = last_err
    print(json.dumps(out))


main()
```

`pogo_extract/_event_descriptor.py`:

```py
"""READ-ONLY: use protobuf reflection (MessageDescriptor.Fields -> FieldDescriptor
.Name + .Accessor.GetValue(message)) to read populated event protos by their REAL
.proto field names, bypassing the obfuscated C# getters. Reads a live EventSectionProto
(and its children) + DailyBonusProto + a live EventInfoProto if any field yields one."""
import sys, os, time, json

           "AppliedBonusProto", "ContestScheduleProto", "EventSettingsProto"]

function S(s){var h=H_();if(!s||s.isNull())return null;try{var len=h.strLen(s);var cp=h.strChars(s);if(!cp||cp.isNull())return null;return cp.readUtf16String(len);}catch(e){try{return s.add(0x14).readUtf16String();}catch(e2){return null;}}}
function call0(inst,name){var h=H_();var m=h.cMN(h.OGC(inst),Memory.allocUtf8String(name),0);if(!m||m.isNull())return undefined;var exc=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);exc.writePointer(ptr(0));var r=h.rI(m,inst,ptr(0),exc);if(!exc.readPointer().isNull())return undefined;return r;}

function toList(enumObj){var h=H_();var out=[];if(!enumObj||enumObj.isNull())return out;var gem=h.cMN(h.OGC(enumObj),Memory.allocUtf8String("GetEnumerator"),0);if(!gem||gem.isNull())return out;var exc=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);exc.writePointer(ptr(0));var enr=h.rI(gem,enumObj,ptr(0),exc);if(!enr||enr.isNull())return out;var enrC=h.OGC(enr);var mn=h.cMN(enrC,Memory.allocUtf8String("MoveNext"),0),gc=h.cMN(enrC,Memory.allocUtf8String("get_Current"),0);if(!mn||!gc)return out;var guard=0;while(guard++<200){var e2=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);e2.writePointer(ptr(0));var r=h.rI(mn,enr,ptr(0),e2);if(!r||r.add(0x10).readU8()===0)break;var e3=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);e3.writePointer(ptr(0));var cur=h.rI(gc,enr,ptr(0),e3);out.push(cur);}return out;}

// Reflectively read a message's fields via Descriptor: returns [{num,name,val}] where val is
// a string (for scalars/strings) or a child-ptr marker for sub-messages.
function reflect(inst,depth){var h=H_();var res=[];if(!inst||inst.isNull())return res;
 var clsName=""; try{clsName=h.CGN(h.OGC(inst)).readCString();}catch(e){}
 var desc=call0(inst,"get_Descriptor"); if(!desc||desc.isNull())return [{_err:"no descriptor",cls:clsName}];

  var val=undefined; if(acc&&!acc.isNull()){ try{val=call1(acc,"GetValue",inst);}catch(e){} }
  var entry={num:num,name:nm};
  if(val===undefined||val===null){entry.val=null;}
  else if(val.isNull&&val.isNull()){entry.val=null;}
  else{ // figure out the value type
   var vc=""; try{vc=h.CGN(h.OGC(val)).readCString();}catch(e){vc="?";}
   entry.vcls=vc;
   if(vc==="String"){entry.val=S(val);}
   else if(vc==="Int64"||vc==="UInt64"){entry.val=val.add(0x10).readS64().toString();}
   else if(vc==="Int32"||vc==="UInt32"){entry.val=val.add(0x10).readS32();}
   else if(vc==="Boolean"){entry.val=val.add(0x10).readU8();}
   else if(vc==="Single"){entry.val=val.add(0x10).readFloat();}
   else if(vc==="Double"){entry.val=val.add(0x10).readDouble();}

   }

   else{ // boxed enum or other: read int at +0x10
     try{entry.val={enumInt:val.add(0x10).readS32(),vcls:vc};}catch(e){entry.val={_cls:vc,_ptr:val.toString()};}
   }
  }
  res.push(entry);
 }
 return {cls:clsName,fields:res};
}
rpc.exports.reflect=function(instStr,depth){return reflect(ptr(instStr),depth||1);};

def nonempty(rf):
    # heuristic: a reflect() result that has at least one non-null field value
    try:
        for f in rf.get("fields", []):
            v = f.get("val")
            if v not in (None, "", 0):
                return True
    except Exception:
        pass
    return False


def main():
    out = {"ok": False, "events": {}}
    last_err = None
```

`pogo_extract/_event_harvest.py`:

```py
"""READ-ONLY: generic proto harvester. For each live event proto, walk its object slots
(0x10..0xC0). For each slot: if it points to a System.String -> read it; if to a *Proto ->
recurse 1 level; also interpret raw 8-byte slots as candidate epoch-ms timestamps (plausible
range) and 4-byte ints. Bypasses obfuscated getters/descriptors entirely. Targets the protos
that carry today's event identity: EventSectionProto + its children, DailyBonusProto,
GenericClientEvent-ish, ContestScheduleProto entries, AppliedBonus*."""
import sys, os, time, json, datetime

sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

TARGETS = ["EventSectionProto", "EventBannerSectionProto", "CurrentEventsSectionProto",
           "UpcomingEventsSectionProto", "DailyBonusProto", "ContestScheduleProto",
           "AppliedBonusesProto", "AppliedBonusProto", "EventSettingsProto", "EventInfoProto",
           "WeatherBonusProto", "PromotionalBannerProto"]

JS = r"""

  OGC:b("il2cpp_object_get_class","pointer",["pointer"]),rcInit:b("il2cpp_runtime_class_init","void",["pointer"]),tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"]),alloc:b("il2cpp_alloc","pointer",["size_t"]),free:b("il2cpp_free","void",["pointer"]),strLen:b("il2cpp_string_length","int",["pointer"]),strChars:b("il2cpp_string_chars","pointer",["pointer"]),
  livenessAlloc:b("il2cpp_unity_liveness_allocate_struct","pointer",["pointer","int","pointer","pointer","pointer"]),livenessFromStatics:b("il2cpp_unity_liveness_calculation_from_statics","void",["pointer"]),livenessFinalize:b("il2cpp_unity_liveness_finalize","void",["pointer"]),livenessFreeStruct:b("il2cpp_unity_liveness_free_struct","void",["pointer"]),stopWorld:b("il2cpp_stop_gc_world","void",[]),startWorld:b("il2cpp_start_gc_world","void",[])};

// Is ptr a plausible il2cpp object? (points into a mapped range, class ptr readable + has a name)
function clsNameOf(p){var h=H_();try{if(!p||p.isNull())return null;var k=p.readPointer();if(!k||k.isNull())return null;var nmp=h.CGN(k);if(!nmp||nmp.isNull())return null;var s=nmp.readCString();if(!s||s.length===0||s.length>64)return null;for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++){var c=s.charCodeAt(i);if(c<0x20||c>0x7e)return null;}return s;}catch(e){return null;}}
function readStr(p){var h=H_();try{var len=h.strLen(p);if(len<0||len>2000)return null;var cp=h.strChars(p);if(!cp||cp.isNull())return null;var s=cp.readUtf16String(len);return s;}catch(e){return null;}}
function looksTs(v){ // epoch ms between 2020-01-01 and 2030-01-01
 try{var lo=Int64("1577836800000"),hi=Int64("1893456000000");return v.compare(lo)>=0&&v.compare(hi)<=0;}catch(e){return false;}}

// Harvest one object: scan slots 0x10..0xC8, classify.
function harvest(instStr,depth){var h=H_();var inst=ptr(instStr);var out={cls:clsNameOf(inst),slots:{}};
 for(var off=0x10;off<=0xC8;off+=8){ var slotName="+0x"+off.toString(16); var info={};
  var p; try{p=inst.add(off).readPointer();}catch(e){continue;} if(!p||p.isNull()){continue;}
  // candidate string object?
  var cn=clsNameOf(p);
  if(cn==="String"){ var s=readStr(p); if(s!==null&&s.length){info.str=s;} }
  else if(cn&&cn.indexOf("Proto")>=0){ info.child=cn; if(depth>0){info.sub=harvest(p.toString(),depth-1);} }
  else if(cn&&(cn.indexOf("RepeatedField")>=0)){ info.repeated=cn; /* dump element ptrs by reading backing array */
    try{var arr=p.add(0x10).readPointer();var cnt=p.add(0x18).readS32();info.count=cnt;var els=[];for(var j=0;j<cnt&&j<10;j++){var ep=arr.add(0x20+j*8).readPointer();var ec=clsNameOf(ep);if(ec==="String"){els.push({s:readStr(ep)});}else if(ec&&ec.indexOf("Proto")>=0){els.push(depth>0?{c:ec,h:harvest(ep.toString(),depth-1)}:{c:ec});}else{els.push({raw:ep.toString(),c:ec});}}info.elems=els;}catch(e){info.repErr=String(e);}
  }
  else if(cn){ info.obj=cn; }
  else {
   // not a pointer to an object: interpret raw 8 bytes as int64 (timestamp?) and low 4 bytes as int32
   try{var v64=inst.add(off).readS64(); if(looksTs(v64)){info.tsMs=v64.toString();} else {var v32=inst.add(off).readS32(); if(v32!==0&&v32>-2000000000&&v32<2000000000)info.i32=v32;} }catch(e){}
  }
  if(Object.keys(info).length){out.slots[slotName]=info;}
 }
 return out;
}
rpc.exports.harvest=function(instStr,depth){return harvest(instStr,depth);};
"""


def has_signal(h):
    try:
        for k, v in h.get("slots", {}).items():
            if "str" in v or "child" in v or "tsMs" in v or "repeated" in v:
                return True
    except Exception:
        pass
    return False


def main():
    out = {"ok": False, "events": {}}
    last_err = None
    for attempt in range(4):
        sess = None
        try:
            sess, pid = pg.get_session()
            sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
            for cls in TARGETS:
                r = sc.exports_sync.live(cls)
                hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
                kept = []
                for hp in hits[:12]:
                    h = sc.exports_sync.harvest(hp, 2)
                    if isinstance(h, dict) and has_signal(h):
                        kept.append(h)
                out["events"][cls] = {"n": len(hits), "populated": kept[:8]}
            out["pid"] = pid
            out["ok"] = True
            print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
            sess.detach()
            return
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = str(e)[:200]
            try:
                sess.detach()
            except Exception:
                pass
            time.sleep(3)
    out["error"] = last_err
    print(json.dumps(out))


main()
```

```py
"""READ-ONLY: for each candidate event proto/service class, run the liveness API to
count live instances. For proto hits, call ToString() (read-only, protobuf text dump)
and also enumerate Descriptor field names. Reports the richest live event data found."""
import sys, os, time, json
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

# (image, ns, cls) — protos live in holo-protos.dll. ns from the earlier scan.
CANDIDATES = [
    ("holo-protos.dll", "Holoholo.Rpc", "GetBonusesOutProto"),
    ("holo-protos.dll", "Holoholo.Rpc", "AppliedBonusesProto"),
    ("holo-protos.dll", "Holoholo.Rpc", "EventInfoProto"),
    ("holo-protos.dll", "Holoholo.Rpc", "ContestScheduleProto"),
    ("holo-protos.dll", "Holoholo.Rpc", "CurrentEventsSectionProto"),

    ("holo-protos.dll", "Holoholo.Rpc", "EventSettingsProto"),
    ("holo-protos.dll", "Holoholo.Rpc", "EventInfoProto"),
    ("holo-protos.dll", "Holoholo.Rpc", "PromotionalBannerProto"),
    ("holo-protos.dll", "Holoholo.Rpc", "DailyBonusProto"),
    ("holo-protos.dll", "Holoholo.Rpc", "WeatherBonusProto"),
]

# extra_js: ToString() + Descriptor field-name enumeration, both read-only, against a live proto.
EXTRA = r"""
function pH(){ if(globalThis.__PH)return globalThis.__PH; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
 function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
 var H={OGC:b("il2cpp_object_get_class","pointer",["pointer"]),CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),cMN:b("il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","int"]),rI:b("il2cpp_runtime_invoke","pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer","pointer"]),strChars:b("il2cpp_string_chars","pointer",["pointer"]),strLen:b("il2cpp_string_length","int",["pointer"])};

rpc.exports.clsOf=function(instStr){ var H=pH(); try{return H.CGN(H.OGC(ptr(instStr))).readCString();}catch(e){return null;} };
"""


def main():
    out = {"ok": False, "live": {}}
    last_err = None
    for attempt in range(4):
        sess = None
        try:
            sess, pid = pg.get_session()
            finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)      # findSingleton/liveness
            sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, EXTRA)    # ToString helper
            seen_cls = set()
            for image, ns, cls in CANDIDATES:
                if cls in seen_cls:
                    continue
                seen_cls.add(cls)
                try:
                    r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, cls)
                except Exception as e:
                    out["live"][cls] = {"err": str(e)[:80]}
                    continue
                if isinstance(r, dict) and "err" in r:
                    out["live"][cls] = {"err": r["err"][:80]}
                    continue
                hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
                entry = {"n": len(hits), "dumps": []}
                # ToString a few hits (cap to keep attach short + output sane)
                for h in hits[:6]:
                    try:
                        ts = sc.exports_sync.proto_to_string(h)
                        s = ts.get("s") if isinstance(ts, dict) else None
                        if s and s.strip() and s.strip() not in ("{ }", "{}"):
                            entry["dumps"].append({"ptr": h, "str": s[:4000]})
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                out["live"][cls] = entry
            out["pid"] = pid
            out["ok"] = True
            print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
            sess.detach()
            return
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = str(e)[:160]
            try:
                sess.detach()
            except Exception:
                pass
            time.sleep(3)
    out["error"] = last_err
    print(json.dumps(out))


main()
```

```py
    last_err = None
    for attempt in range(4):
        sess = None
        try:
            sess, pid = pg.get_session()
            sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
            for cls in CANDIDATES:
                try:
                    r = sc.exports_sync.live_protos(cls)
                except Exception as e:
                    out["live"][cls] = {"err": str(e)[:80]}
                    continue
                if isinstance(r, dict) and "err" in r:
                    out["live"][cls] = {"err": r["err"][:80]}
                    continue
                hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
                entry = {"n": len(hits), "dumps": []}
                for h in hits[:8]:
                    try:
                        ts = sc.exports_sync.proto_to_string(h)
                        s = ts.get("s") if isinstance(ts, dict) else None
                        if s and s.strip() and s.strip() not in ("{ }", "{}"):
                            entry["dumps"].append(s[:5000])
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                out["live"][cls] = entry
            out["pid"] = pid
            out["ok"] = True
            print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
            sess.detach()
            return
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = str(e)[:200]
            try:
                sess.detach()
            except Exception:
                pass
            time.sleep(3)
    out["error"] = last_err
    print(json.dumps(out))


main()
```

```py
IV is preserved through evolution, so a 93% Popplio becomes a 93% Primarina. This independently
re-derives the comb-up question the engine's evo_extra pass is supposed to answer, and reports any
tagged mon whose evolution would beat the user's best copy of a reachable later stage.

exact substring 'none of the tagged mons would improve'.
2026-09-26: also BLOCKS an advice label (an evolve tag / Power Up / Unlock 2nd Move) on a pile mon, and (2026-09-29, the

# "no keep reason yet", this replay from policy_reasons.json + unpaid_holds.json -- and a within-cap STOCK copy carries
# no reason at comb-up time (its 'variant_floor' is marked only after it fails to move up). So 9 stock copies (two 93%
# Farfetch'd under a 98% Sirfetch'd, a 91% Floette under a 98% Florges ...) were told to Evolve Once into spare slots
# and 16 more HELD spare slots they never needed, and all 11 audits passed it: the replay granted the same rescue
# because it read the same files. The answer is a fact about the copy's OWN stage, computed here like the engine's
# plain ladder (keep_policy stage_pool / _eff_cap / topn): the plain, slot-holding copies of (speciesId, form, gender),
# the non-hundo shinies and cosmetic copies of that stage displacing them by IV (special wins ties), the stage cap
# (middle = plain_line_preevo, else plain_line; 2 per gender where the look differs), the collection floor. A copy
# inside that top-cap stays as stock whatever happens -- it is never rescued.
_NUNDO_ON = keep_config.rule_enabled('nundo')
def _own_key(r):
    _s = sid_of(r)
    return evolvable_forms.stage_of(_s, r['form'] or 0) + (evolvable_forms.gender_key(r['pokemon_id'], r['gender']),)
def _holds_slot(r):                                   # the engine's stage_pool: plain, truly plain, not slot-exempt
    return ((r['fresh_alignment'] or 0) != 1 and not r['fresh_shiny'] and _truly_plain(r) and iv(r) != 45
            and not (_NUNDO_ON and r['is_zero'] and r['pokemon_id']) and not pattern_pools.is_pooled(r['pokemon_id']))
_own_plain, _own_spec, _own_evo = collections.defaultdict(list), collections.defaultdict(list), collections.defaultdict(bool)
for r in rows:
    if keep_config.is_fused_component(r):             # fused components hold no ladder slot (2026-09-26)
        continue
    _k0 = _own_key(r)
    if (r['fresh_alignment'] or 0) != 1 and not r['fresh_shiny']:
        _own_evo[_k0] = _own_evo[_k0] or can_evo(r)   # the engine's stage rep: one evolvable plain-pool copy makes it a step
    if _holds_slot(r):
        _own_plain[_k0].append(r)
    elif iv(r) != 45 and (r['fresh_shiny'] or ((r['fresh_alignment'] or 0) != 1 and not _truly_plain(r))):
        _own_spec[_k0].append((iv(r), _cp(r)))       # a non-hundo shiny (any alignment) or cosmetic copy displaces by IV
_STOCK = set()
for _k0, _pl in _own_plain.items():
    _c0 = evolvable_forms.ladder_cap(CAP_PRE if (_own_evo[_k0] and _is_pre_sp.get(_k0[0]) and _k0[0] in _HAS_PARENT)
                                     else CAP_FIN, _DEX_SID.get(_k0[0]), _k0[2])
    _m0 = sorted([(a, b, 0) for a, b in _own_spec.get(_k0, ())] + [(iv(x), _cp(x), 1) for x in _pl],
                 key=lambda t: (-t[0], -t[1], t[2]))[:_c0]
    _srt0 = [x for i, x in enumerate(sorted(_pl, key=lambda x: (-iv(x), -_cp(x), x['uid_hex'])))
             if i == 0 or iv(x) >= keep_config.floor_iv_for(x['pokemon_id'])]   # the collection floor (legendaries: their own)
    _STOCK |= {x['uid_hex'] for x in _srt0[:sum(1 for t in _m0 if t[2] == 1)]}
def _rescue_ok(r):
    """The engine's RESCUE, from the law: not stock at its own stage (above), and kept by nothing but the evolve
    promise / its hold ('variant_floor' on a copy beyond its stage cap is the hold itself)."""
    return (r['uid_hex'] not in _STOCK
            and not (set(pol.get(r['uid_hex'], [])) - {'evolve_1', 'evolve_2', 'variant_floor'}))
# ... BUT STOCK-NESS NEVER VETOES THE COLLAPSE'S SECOND CHANCE (R-A review, 2026-09-29). keep_policy's dominance collapse
# DELETES a true-plain stock copy kept by nothing but its stage slot when a KEPT copy of its own stage with a collectible
# attribute (shiny, background, card, costume, Max, shadow -- any such set is a strict superset of none) has a higher IV
# (a trophy never dominates). Its alternative IS release, so the engine judges its evolution as a RESCUE
# (keep_policy._collapsing, the 2026-09-23 Minccino) -- after its main pass found no slot without one. Without this the
# replay commits that lawful promise / hold to no stage: 'EVOLVE PROMISE(S) THE COMB-UP REPLAY COMMITS ELSEWHERE', or the
# hold's slot reads open and a piled copy reads as a missed upgrade. Read from the bag, never from the engine.
_DOM_IV = collections.defaultdict(list)                # own stage -> IVs of the KEPT, non-trophy copies with an attribute
for r in rows:
    if (keep_config.is_fused_component(r) or r['uid_hex'] not in pol or iv(r) == 45
            or (_NUNDO_ON and r['is_zero'] and r['pokemon_id']) or not _attrs(r)):
        continue
    _DOM_IV[_own_key(r)].append(iv(r))
def _collapse_victim(r):
    """keep_policy's dominance collapse deletes this copy (its alternative is release): a true plain, kept by nothing
    but its slot / the evolve promise, with a KEPT richer copy of its own stage at a higher IV."""
    return (not _attrs(r) and not (set(pol.get(r['uid_hex'], [])) - {'evolve_1', 'evolve_2', 'variant_floor'})
            and any(v > iv(r) for v in _DOM_IV.get(_own_key(r), ())))
_ORDER = sorted([(r, False) for r in _earmarked] + [(r, True) for r in _cands],
                key=lambda x: (-iv(x[0]), -_cp(x[0]), x[0]['uid_hex']))


# CANDY mirror (2026-09-17) + ITEM mirror (2026-11-03): the engine promises only what the bag can pay -- family candy AND the
# evolution item (keep_policy._afford / _spend) -- best-first, after Evolve Shiny. On candy alone a 96% Litwick the engine had
# promised to Lampent (0 Unova Stones) was committed to Chandelure here, and the gate BLOCKED a correct pile (2026-11-03).
_WALK = max((str(r['last_scanned']) for r in rows if r.get('last_scanned')), default=None)   # the walk, not the clock (2026-09-29)
_CANDY = evolvable_forms.candy_now(walk=_WALK)
_ITEMS = evolvable_forms.items_now(walk=_WALK)
if _CANDY is not None or _ITEMS is not None:
    try:
        import refresh_evolve_shiny as _res
        _sp, _si = {}, {}
        _res.compute_target(why={u: set(v) for u, v in pol.items()}, spent=_sp, walk=_WALK, items_spent=_si)
        if _CANDY is not None:
            for _f, _n in _sp.items():
                _CANDY[_f] = _CANDY.get(_f, 0) - _n
        if _ITEMS is not None:
            for _k, _n in _si.items():
                _ITEMS[_k] = _ITEMS.get(_k, 0) - _n
    except Exception as _e:
        print('Evolve Shiny candy/item mirror skipped:', _e)


def sweep(drop_trophies, drop_piled, commits=None):
    """Replay the engine's comb-up. Returns {uid: (lines, [improving stages])} for the pile mons.
    drop_trophies/drop_piled remove those copies from the stage occupancy (the advisory pass).
    commits (2026-09-26): a dict that receives {uid: [stage(s)]} -- where each earmarked copy is committed."""
    held = collections.defaultdict(list)
    spec = collections.defaultdict(list)     # displacing specials per stage: non-hundo shiny or cosmetic/Dmax/Gmax, not shadow
    held_cp = collections.defaultdict(list)  # the same two lists as (iv, cp): the engine ranks by IV, CP breaks ties (LAW row 9)
    spec_cp = collections.defaultdict(list)
    doms = collections.defaultdict(list)     # stage -> [(attrs, iv)] of KEPT non-trophy rows with collectible attributes
    best = collections.defaultdict(lambda: -1)   # stage -> best plain IV of copies that HOLD a slot (hundos excluded 2026-09-23)
    # A STAGE IS A (speciesId, FORM) (2026-09-20). pvpoke calls every Florges colour 'florges', both Gastrodon
    # seas 'gastrodon', every Sawsbuck season 'sawsbuck' and all 28 Unown letters 'unown', so one colour's copies
    # answered for another's. Gender terminals, pattern-pooled lines and form-encoded costumes are already split
    # by their own rules above; this covers the rest. Every pool is filled under BOTH the bare speciesId and the
    # form, and read under the form ONLY when the game names which form the specimen becomes -- so when it cannot
    # say, the bar is the whole speciesId exactly as before and nothing here can read as an empty stage.
    _GMD = {p['speciesId']: p.get('dex') for p in json.load(open('pvpoke_gamemaster.json', encoding='utf-8'))['pokemon']}
    def _gk(sid, r):
        # GENDER IS A LOOK (2026-09-23): the engine keys a dimorphic / gender-locked stage by gender, so must this audit
        return evolvable_forms.gender_key(_GMD.get(sid) or (r['pokemon_id'] if r is not None else 0), r['gender'] if r is not None else 0)
    def _kk(sid, form, r=None):
        # a SET: for a plain form (0 or <SPECIES>_NORMAL) stage_of IS (sid, ''), and a list filed every such copy
        # twice -- one Krokorok read as [96, 96], a full stage, so a copy that could fill its open slot passed.
        g = _gk(sid, r)
        return {(sid, '', g), evolvable_forms.stage_of(sid, form or 0) + (g,)}

    def _tk(t, r):
        if r is None:
            return (t, '', 0)
        _tf = evolvable_forms.target_form(r['fresh_form'] or r['form'], t, sid_of(r), r['gender'])
        return (t, evolvable_forms.canon_form(t, _tf), _gk(t, r))   # same canonicalisation the fill side uses, or they miss
    # RULE 13's CARD LADDERS (2026-10-25), for the engine's card branch in improves(): (stage, card) -> [(iv, cp, look, trophy)].
    # GENDER-BLIND, as rule 13 ranks; a costume + card copy holds no card slot (costume_forms.card_folds_into_costume).
    card_lad = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        if drop_piled and r['uid_hex'] in ps:
            continue
        if keep_config.is_fused_component(r):     # (2026-09-26) fused components hold no ladder slot
            continue
        if (r['fresh_has_location_card'] == 1 and (r['fresh_loc_card_enum'] or 0) and not pattern_pools.is_pooled(r['pokemon_id'])
                and not _card_folds(r)):
            _cosf = is_costume_form(r['fresh_form']) or is_costume_form(r['form'])
            for _k in {evolvable_forms.stage_of(sid_of(r), r['form'] or 0)} | (set() if _cosf else {(sid_of(r), '')}):
                card_lad[_k + (r['fresh_loc_card_enum'],)].append((iv(r), _cp(r), keep_config.card_look(r), _trophy(r)))
        # a form-ENCODED costume is its own stage key in the engine: it neither displaces nor dominates the plain form.
        # A GENDER TERMINAL (Ralts, Kirlia, Combee ...) is no longer split here (2026-11-02): _kk keys it by gender, as the
        # engine's _stage_key / _domgrp do (F7), so its specials displace and dominate their own gender only. Split outright,
        # a 98% Dynamax Kirlia left the female plain slot reading open, and a 69% Ralts the 75% floor piled read as a missed
        # upgrade there (the engine rightly gives that slot to the Dynamax copy).
        _split = (pattern_pools.is_pooled(r['pokemon_id'])
                  or is_costume_form(r['fresh_form']) or is_costume_form(r['form']))
        if (r['fresh_alignment'] or 0) != 1 and iv(r) != 45 and (r['fresh_shiny'] or not _truly_plain(r)) and not _split:
            for _k in _kk(sid_of(r), r['form'], r):
                spec[_k].append(iv(r)); spec_cp[_k].append((iv(r), _cp(r)))
        if not _split and not _trophy(r) and r['uid_hex'] in pol and _attrs(r):
            for _k in _kk(sid_of(r), r['form'], r): doms[_k].append((_attrs(r), iv(r)))   # a transferred mon is never a dominator
        if _in_pool(r) and not _trophy(r):   # a hundo holds no slot, so it never sets the ladder's bar (2026-09-23)
            for _k in _kk(sid_of(r), r['form'], r): best[_k] = max(best[_k], iv(r))
        if not _in_pool(r) or (drop_trophies and _trophy(r)):
            continue
        for _k in _kk(sid_of(r), r['form'], r):
            held[_k].append(iv(r)); held_cp[_k].append((iv(r), _cp(r)))
    for v in held.values():
        v.sort(reverse=True)
    def improves(t, i, r=None, rescue=False):
        # THE ENGINE'S SLOT MODEL (keep_policy._earns_slot + _eff_cap; review 2026-09-29). Specials share the plain slots
        # by IV, CP breaking ties (LAW row 9); the plain slots are those the merged top-cap leaves plain copies WITH the
        # arrival counted. When the arrival only pushes a SPECIAL out of that count (the special stays kept by its own
        # rule, no plain copy goes), the plain ladder just grows: an OPEN slot, worth it only as a rescue or a new best.
        # The old IV-only merge let a special win every IV tie and called that case an upgrade, so a 96% Smoliv kept as
        # stock was "committed" to Arboliva (98 / 93 / shiny 93) while the engine rightly promised Dolliv -- gate failed.
        tk = _tk(t, r)
        c = cap_of(t, tk[2])
        cpc = _cp(r) if r is not None else 0
        # THE ENGINE'S CARD BRANCH FIRST (keep_policy._earns_slot, 2026-10-25): a card copy is judged inside that card's own
        # ladder at the target (rule 13: every gender, the floor keeping each look's best), and a new card there, a new
        # best or a weaker copy it replaces earns the move before any plain slot is asked. Without it the 50% floor's
        # lawful card moves (a 33% card Totodile to Croconaw, whose only card copy is 27% ...) read as committed nowhere.
        _card = (r['fresh_loc_card_enum'] or 0) if r is not None and r['fresh_has_location_card'] == 1 else 0
        if _card:
            _lad = card_lad.get(tk[:2] + (_card,), [])
            _grp = [x for x in _lad if not x[3]]
            _nc = keep_config.species_cap('location_card', _DEX_SID.get(t), keep_config.cap('location_card'))
            _srt = sorted([(a, b, lk, 0) for a, b, lk, _tr in _grp] + [(i, cpc, keep_config.card_look(r), 1)],
                          key=lambda x: (-x[0], -x[1], x[3]))                  # an exact tie keeps the copy you hold
            _top = keep_config.floor_top([{'iv_total': a, 'look': lk, 'arr': w} for a, b, lk, w in _srt],
                                         look=lambda d: d['look'], pid=_DEX_SID.get(t))[:_nc]
            if any(d['arr'] for d in _top) and (len(_grp) >= _nc or i > max([x[0] for x in _lad] + [-1])):
                return True
        if r is not None:                    # the dominance pass, exactly: a KEPT strict-superset copy with higher IV collapses it
            mv = _attrs(r)
            if any(ma != mv and (ma | mv) == ma and a_iv > i for ma, a_iv in doms.get(tk, ())):
                return False
        pool = sorted([(v, cp_, 0) for v, cp_ in held_cp.get(tk, ())] + [(i, cpc, 1)],   # 1 = the arrival; an exact
                      key=lambda x: (-x[0], -x[1], x[2]))                                  # tie keeps the copy you hold
        merged = sorted([(v, cp_, 0) for v, cp_ in spec_cp.get(tk, ())] + [(v, cp_, 1) for v, cp_, _a in pool],
                        key=lambda x: (-x[0], -x[1], x[2]))[:c]                            # special first on a full tie
        n = sum(1 for x in merged if x[2] == 1)
        # THE COLLECTION FLOOR, as keep_policy.topn applies it to the plain pool (2026-10-25): under it a copy holds no slot
        # unless it is the stage's best -- the arrival too. The old blanket "under the floor it never moves beside any copy"
        # refused a sub-floor arrival that would be a stage's new best, which the engine rightly promises.
        _in = {d['j'] for d in keep_config.floor_top([{'iv_total': x[0], 'j': j} for j, x in enumerate(pool)],
                                                     pid=_DEX_SID.get(t))[:n]}
        if not any(pool[j][2] == 1 for j in _in):
            return False                     # no plain slot for it: beyond the cap, under the floor or displaced by a special
        if len(pool) - 1 < n and not (rescue or i > best[tk]):
            return False                     # open slot: worth it only as the stage's first copy or a new best -- UNLESS
            #                                  the alternative is release (keep_policy._earns_slot, 2026-09-20)
        _out = [x[0] for j, x in enumerate(pool) if j not in _in]
        return not _out or max(_out) < i     # it must push out only copies weaker on IV, never on CP alone
    left = dict(_CANDY) if _CANDY is not None else None
    ileft = dict(_ITEMS) if _ITEMS is not None else None
    def cost(r, ts):
        cs = [evolvable_forms.path_cost(sid_of(r), t, _allreach) for t in ts]
        return None if (not cs or any(c is None for c in cs)) else max(cs)
    def need_items(r, ts):
        need = {}
        for t in ts:
            for k, v in evolvable_forms.path_items(sid_of(r), t, _allreach).items():
                need[k] = max(need.get(k, 0), v)
        return need
    def afford(r, ts):
        if ileft is None and need_items(r, ts):
            return False
        if ileft is not None:
            for k, n in need_items(r, ts).items():
                if ileft.get(evolvable_forms._item_key(k), 0) < n:
                    return False
        if left is None:
            return False
        c, f = cost(r, ts), evolvable_forms.family(sid_of(r))
        return c is None or f is None or left.get(f, 0) >= c
    def spend(r, ts):
        c, f = cost(r, ts), evolvable_forms.family(sid_of(r))
        if left is not None and c is not None and f is not None:
            left[f] = left.get(f, 0) - c
        if ileft is not None:
            for k, n in need_items(r, ts).items():
                _k = evolvable_forms._item_key(k)
                ileft[_k] = ileft.get(_k, 0) - n
    out = {}
    for r, is_pile in _ORDER:
        tg = targets(r)
        if not is_pile:
            # an UNPAID hold (H09-1, 2026-09-29): keep_policy committed it to the first target that earns and spent
            # nothing -- it is held BECAUSE it could not pay. A copy that also wears an evolve label was paid after all.
            _unp = r['uid_hex'] in _UNPAID and not any(str(x).startswith('evolve_') for x in pol.get(r['uid_hex'], []))
            # the engine's RESCUE (2026-09-20): a copy kept by nothing but its evolve promise may fill an open slot
            # (H08, 2026-09-29) re-derived: never "only evolve reasons in policy_reasons" / "listed in unpaid_holds.json"
            _rs = _rescue_ok(r)
            _f = sorted(x for x in tg if not _is_pre_sp.get(x))   # mirrors keep_policy._promise_targets (2026-09-17)
            _order = _f if len(_f) > 1 else _f + sorted(x for x in tg if _is_pre_sp.get(x))
            def _choose(rs):
                if len(_f) > 1:
                    return _f if all(improves(t, iv(r), r, rs) for t in _f) else []
                # the engine's choice: the first target that earns a slot AND is affordable, else the first that earns
                return (next(([t] for t in _order if improves(t, iv(r), r, rs)), []) if _unp else   # H09-1
                        next(([t] for t in _order if improves(t, iv(r), r, rs) and afford(r, [t])), None) or
                        next(([t] for t in _order if improves(t, iv(r), r, rs)), []))
            _to = _choose(_rs)
            if not _to and not _rs and _collapse_victim(r):
                _to = _choose(True)                         # the engine's collapse pass: the same copy, judged as a RESCUE
            if _to and not _unp:                            # H09-1: an unpaid hold spends nothing
                spend(r, _to)
            if commits is not None:
                commits[r['uid_hex']] = _to
            for t in _to:
                for _k in {(t, ''), _tk(t, r)}:
                    held[_k].append(iv(r)); held[_k].sort(reverse=True)   # raise the bar where the engine does
                    held_cp[_k].append((iv(r), _cp(r)))
                    best[_k] = max(best[_k], iv(r))
                    if _attrs(r) and not _trophy(r):
                        doms[_k].append((_attrs(r), iv(r)))        # a promoted card copy dominates there (2026-09-13)
                if r['fresh_has_location_card'] == 1 and (r['fresh_loc_card_enum'] or 0) and not _card_folds(r):
                    for _ck in {(t, ''), _tk(t, r)[:2]}:            # ... and takes its card's slot (2026-10-25)
                        card_lad[_ck + (r['fresh_loc_card_enum'],)].append((iv(r), _cp(r), keep_config.card_look(r), False))
            continue
        lines, up = [], []
        _fins = [t for t in tg if not _is_pre_sp.get(t)]
        _rand = len(_fins) > 1                                  # split line: EVERY final must hold (2026-09-17)
        # A PILED mon has no other keep reason, so both 2026-09-20 engine rules apply to it: RESCUE (an open slot beats
        # release, even beneath better copies) and HOLD (a slot it cannot pay for today is held, never released --
        # keep_policy._earned_unpaid). Candy is therefore irrelevant here: any slot it earns means it must not be piled.
        _all_fin = bool(_fins) and all(improves(t, iv(r), r, True) for t in _fins)
        for t in sorted(tg):
            c, h = cap_of(t, _tk(t, r)[2]), held[_tk(t, r)]
            better = improves(t, iv(r), r, True) if not _rand else (_all_fin and t in _fins)
            if better:
                up.append(t)
            nm = (BS.get(t) or {}).get('speciesName', t)
            lines.append('%s(contenders %s, cap %d%s)' % (nm, [round(x / 45 * 100) for x in h[:c]] or 'NONE',
                                                          c, ' <-- ROOM/UPGRADE' if better else ''))
        out[r['uid_hex']] = (lines, up)
    return out


# CROSS-PACKAGE RECONCILIATION 2026-09-02. keep_policy._stage_hold now EXCLUDES slot-exempt trophies
# (`if _truly_plain(r) and not _slot_exempt(r)`), matching stage_pool -- the engine fix this file's own
# advisory used to ask for. GATE was still built with drop_trophies=False, i.e. it modelled the OLD
# engine and judged every pile mon against a bar the engine no longer raises. Measured on the live
# pile: GATE printed "none of the tagged mons would improve" (PASS, and that string is full_audit's
# verdict needle) while the non-gating advisory below named 21 tagged mons that DO enter a later stage.
# An audit that under-reports relative to the engine is precisely the failure this file exists to
# prevent, so GATE now mirrors the engine exactly.
#   drop_piled stays False: _stage_hold is built from the whole plain pool, before any pile exists.
#   `_trophy` (iv in {0,45}) vs the engine's `_slot_exempt` (iv==45, or is_zero+pokemon_id while
#   rules.nundo is ON): 0 rows differ in the live bag (measured 2026-09-02), and the engine's own
#   `_evo_ok` gates candidates on the same iv-in-{0,45} test.
GATE_COMMIT = {}                                        # uid -> the stage(s) GATE commits each earmarked copy to
GATE = sweep(drop_trophies=True, drop_piled=False, commits=GATE_COMMIT)   # exactly keep_policy._stage_hold (trophy-exempt)
ADV = sweep(drop_trophies=True, drop_piled=True)        # + copies already in THIS pile stop occupying slots

print('EVO COMB-UP CHECK on the %d tagged mons   (evo graph: %s)' % (len(ps), _GRAPH_SRC))
print('(IV is preserved through evolution -- would evolving this beat your best of a later stage?)\n')
problems = []
fused_piled = []     # (2026-09-26) a fused component is HELD inside a Kyurem: kept as 'fused', never a Transfer candidate
for u in sorted(ps, key=lambda z: (-(iv(by[z]) if z in by else 0), z)):
    if u not in by:
        print('  *** tagged uid %s is NOT in the bag' % u)
        continue
    r = by[u]
    if keep_config.is_fused_component(r):
        fused_piled.append(r)
        print('  %-12s %3d%%  *** FUSED COMPONENT IN THE PILE (held inside a Kyurem fusion -- kept as \'fused\', '
              'never a Transfer candidate) ***' % (r['species_name'], round(iv(r) / 45 * 100)))
        continue
    if u not in GATE:
        why = ('shiny/shadow/cosmetic -- capped on its own axis, not by the line cap' if not _in_pool(r)
               else 'hundo/nundo trophy' if _trophy(r) else 'terminal/no evolution')
        print('  %-12s %3d%%  not a comb-up candidate under the law (%s)' % (
            r['species_name'], round(iv(r) / 45 * 100), why))
        continue
    lines, up = GATE[u]
    if not lines:
        print('  %-12s %3d%%  terminal/no evolution -- nothing to comb up' % (r['species_name'], round(iv(r) / 45 * 100)))
        continue
    # the engine never promotes a legendary/mythical/UB/paradox (keep_policy._evo_ok), so an improving
    # rare is a law statement, not an engine deviation -- reported, but not a gate failure.
    flag = ''
    if up:

# promises.json is); the replay above derives its own.
```

`pogo_extract/_evolve_analysis.py`:

```py
"""PROTOTYPE (read-only): LINE-LEVEL cap. Pool every PLAIN specimen of a line (all evo stages,
same form-region) into its TERMINAL's cap, keep top-3 by IV. Pre-evo winners -> EVOLVE; terminal
winners -> KEEP; losers -> TRANSFER. 98+89 Bulba should displace 78+81 Venusaur."""
import json, sqlite3
from collections import defaultdict

gm = json.load(open('pvpoke_gamemaster.json'))
by_sp = {p['speciesId']: p for p in gm['pokemon']}
sp_to_dex = {p['speciesId']: p.get('dex') for p in gm['pokemon']}
dex_to_sp = {}
for p in gm['pokemon']:
    sid, d = p['speciesId'], p.get('dex')
    if not d or any(x in sid for x in ('_shadow', '_mega', '_xl')): continue
    if d not in dex_to_sp or '_' not in sid: dex_to_sp[d] = sid
def direct(sid): return ((by_sp.get(sid, {}).get('family', {})) or {}).get('evolutions', []) or []
def terminals(sid, seen=None):
    if seen is None: seen = set()
    evos = direct(sid)
    if not evos:
        d = sp_to_dex.get(sid); return {d} if d else set()
    out = set()
    for e in evos:
        if e in seen: continue
        seen.add(e); out |= terminals(e, seen)
    return out
is_preevo, term_of = {}, {}
for d, sid in dex_to_sp.items():
    is_preevo[d] = bool(direct(sid)); term_of[d] = terminals(sid)

GENDER_TERMINALS = {
    415: {1: set(), 2: {416}}, 757: {1: set(), 2: {758}},
    361: {1: {362}, 2: {478, 362}}, 281: {1: {475, 282}, 2: {282}},
    280: {1: {475, 282}, 2: {282}}, 412: {1: {414}, 2: {413}},
}
def reach(pid, g):
    gt = GENDER_TERMINALS.get(pid)
    if gt is not None: return gt.get(g, term_of.get(pid, set()))
    return term_of.get(pid, set()) if is_preevo.get(pid) else set()

c = sqlite3.connect('pokemon.db'); c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
rows = c.execute("""SELECT uid_hex,pokemon_id,species_name,form,form_region,iv_total,cp,gender,
    fresh_shiny,fresh_alignment,fresh_costume,special_bg_id,natural_art_background,
    costume_decoration_id,fresh_bread_mode FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1""").fetchall()
def plain(r):
    return (not r['fresh_shiny'] and r['fresh_alignment'] != 1 and not (r['fresh_costume'] or 0)
            and not (r['special_bg_id'] or 0) and not (r['natural_art_background'] or 0)
            and not (r['costume_decoration_id'] and str(r['costume_decoration_id']) != '0')
            and not (r['fresh_bread_mode'] or 0))

LINE_CAP = 3
pool = defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:
    if not plain(r): continue
    region = r['form_region'] or 'kantonian'
    terms = reach(r['pokemon_id'], r['gender'])
    if terms:
        for t in terms: pool[(t, region)].append(r)
    else:
        pool[(r['pokemon_id'], region)].append(r)

decision = {}   # uid -> KEEP / EVOLVE
for (term, region), lst in pool.items():
    cap = 1 if is_preevo.get(term) else LINE_CAP
    for r in sorted(lst, key=lambda r: (-(r['iv_total'] or 0), -(r['cp'] or 0)))[:cap]:
        ev = bool(reach(r['pokemon_id'], r['gender']))
        decision[r['uid_hex']] = 'EVOLVE' if ev else 'KEEP'

plain_rows = [r for r in rows if plain(r)]
ev_n = sum(1 for v in decision.values() if v == 'EVOLVE')
keep_n = sum(1 for v in decision.values() if v == 'KEEP')
free_n = len(plain_rows) - len(decision)
print(f"PLAIN specimens: {len(plain_rows)}  ->  KEEP(terminal) {keep_n}  EVOLVE {ev_n}  FREED {free_n}")
print("(specials shiny/hundo/PvP/legendary/cosmetic still protected separately -- real freed will be lower)\n")

def show_line(termpid, name):
    sub = defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        if not plain(r): continue
        for t in reach(r['pokemon_id'], r['gender']) or {r['pokemon_id']}:
            if t == termpid: sub[r['form_region'] or 'kantonian'].append(r)
    print(f"=== {name} line (terminal {termpid}) ===")
    for region, lst in sub.items():
        print(f"  region {region}:")
        for r in sorted(lst, key=lambda r: -(r['iv_total'] or 0)):
            g = {1: 'M', 2: 'F', 3: '-'}.get(r['gender'], '?')
            d = decision.get(r['uid_hex'], 'transfer')
            print(f"    {r['species_name']:<11} iv={r['iv_total']:>2} {g} cp={r['cp']:<5} -> {d}")

show_line(3, 'Bulbasaur')
show_line(416, 'Combee/Vespiquen')
show_line(149, 'Dratini/Dragonite')
```

```py
function imgByName(name){_ensureInit();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var asms=IL2.dGA(IL2.dG(),sp);var na=sp.readS32();
  for(var a=0;a<na;a++){var img=IL2.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(IL2.iGN(img).readCString()===name)return img;}return null;}

var _oGC=null,_cGNm=null,_mGpc=null;
function _ii(){_ensureInit();if(_oGC)return;var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');var e={};
  il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
  function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
  _oGC=b('il2cpp_object_get_class','pointer',['pointer']);_cGNm=b('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
  _mGpc=b('il2cpp_method_get_param_count','uint32',['pointer']);}
function objCls(o){_ii();if(o.isNull())return 'null';try{return _cGNm(_oGC(o)).readCString();}catch(e){return '?';}}
function readStr(p){if(p.isNull())return '';var len=p.add(0x10).readS32();if(len<=0||len>400)return '';var s='';for(var i=0;i<len;i++)s+=String.fromCharCode(p.add(0x14+i*2).readU16());return s;}

function getDict(invAddr){var k=gmCls('Niantic.Holoholo.Collections','InventoryCache');var m=cMN(k,'GetCurrentItems',0);
  var coll=rI(m,ptr(invAddr),ptr(0),null);if(coll.isNull())return null;return coll.add(0x10).readPointer();}
function walk(dict,cb){var en=dict.add(0x18).readPointer();if(en.isNull())return 0;var c=en.add(0x18).readS32();
  var base=en.add(0x20);var n=0;for(var i=0;i<c;i++){var e=base.add(i*0x18);if(e.readS32()<0)continue;
    var key=e.add(8).readPointer();var val=e.add(0x10).readPointer();if(key.isNull())continue;if(cb(key,val,i)===false)return n;n++;}return n;}
function resolveItem(ci){for(var base=0x10;base<=0x18;base+=8){var model=ci.add(base).readPointer();if(model.isNull())continue;
  var gi=model.add(0x10).readPointer();if(!gi.isNull()&&objCls(gi)==='HoloInventoryItemProto')return gi;}return ptr(0);}
function unboxI32(boxptr){if(boxptr.isNull())return null;return boxptr.add(0x10).readS32();}

// Read all Item-keyed entries: key.get_Item -> Item enum; item.get_Item -> ItemProto.Count
rpc.exports.items = function(invAddr, wantItems){
    var dict=getDict(invAddr);if(!dict||dict.isNull())return{err:'no dict'};
    var keyCls=protoCls('Holoholo.Rpc','HoloInventoryKeyProto');
    var itemCls=protoCls('Holoholo.Rpc','HoloInventoryItemProto');
    var getItemKey=cMN(keyCls,'get_Item',0);          // returns Item enum (boxed)
    var getItemVal=cMN(itemCls,'get_Item',0);          // returns ItemProto
    var want={};for(var i=0;i<wantItems.length;i++)want[wantItems[i]]=true;
    var found={};var allItemKeys={};
    walk(dict,function(key,val){
        if(key.add(24).readS32()!==2)return true; // Item case = 2
        var itemEnum=null;try{var r=rI(getItemKey,key,ptr(0),null);itemEnum=unboxI32(r);}catch(e){}
        if(itemEnum===null)return true;
        allItemKeys[itemEnum]=(allItemKeys[itemEnum]||0)+1;
        if(!want[itemEnum])return true;
        var item=resolveItem(val);
        if(item.isNull()){found[itemEnum]={err:'no item'};return true;}
        var ip;try{ip=rI(getItemVal,item,ptr(0),null);}catch(e){found[itemEnum]={err:'threw'};return true;}
        if(ip.isNull()){found[itemEnum]={err:'null itemproto'};return true;}
        // ItemProto: Item enum @ +16, Count @ +20 (typical). Dump a few.
        found[itemEnum]={itemProtoCls:objCls(ip), w16:ip.add(16).readS32(), w20:ip.add(20).readS32(), w24:ip.add(24).readS32()};
        return true;
    });
    return {ok:true, wanted:found, allItemEnums:allItemKeys};

// PlayerStats full int dump (to find stardust)
rpc.exports.playerstats = function(invAddr){

    var m=cMN(itemCls,'get_PlayerStats',0);var res=null;
```

```py
"""Read EVOLUTION REQUIREMENTS for the 3 target species from the LIVE game master.
Path: GameMasterData singleton -> Get_PokemonSettings(HoloPokemonId) -> PokemonSettingsProto
      -> evolutionBranch_ (+144 RepeatedField<EvolutionBranchProto>).
READ ONLY."""
import frida, sys, time, json
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import pogo_il2cpp as pg
sys.stdout.reconfigure(line_buffering=True)

# pid -> (name, target_pid, target_name)
TARGETS = {
    824: ('Dottler', 826, 'Orbeetle'),
    625: ('Bisharp', 983, 'Kingambit'),
    999: ('Gimmighoul', 1000, 'Gholdengo'),
}

EVO_JS = r"""
function imgByName(name) {
    _ensureInit();
    var sp = Memory.alloc(4);
    var asms = IL2.dGA(IL2.dG(), sp);
    var na = sp.readS32();
    for (var a = 0; a < na; a++) {
        var img = IL2.aGI(asms.add(a * Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
        if (IL2.iGN(img).readCString() === name) return img;
    }
    return null;
}
function gmCls(ns, name) {
    var i = imgByName('holo-game.dll');
    return IL2.cFN(i, Memory.allocUtf8String(ns), Memory.allocUtf8String(name));
}
function readStr(p) {
    if (p.isNull()) return '';
    var len = p.add(0x10).readS32();
    if (len <= 0 || len > 400) return '';
    var s = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) s += String.fromCharCode(p.add(0x14 + i*2).readU16());
    return s;
}
// RepeatedField<T>: items pointer @ +0x10 (managed array), count @ +0x18. Array data @ +0x20.
function repeatedCount(rf) { if (rf.isNull()) return 0; return rf.add(0x18).readS32(); }
function repeatedItemPtr(rf, i) {
    var arr = rf.add(0x10).readPointer();
    return arr.add(0x20 + i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
}

// Find GameMasterData singleton via liveness (DI container singleton).
rpc.exports.findgm = function() {
    var k = gmCls('', 'GameMasterData');
    if (k.isNull()) return {err:'no GameMasterData class'};
    return liveness_find_instances(k);
};

// Probe: read get_StaticDataIsReady on a candidate
rpc.exports.gmready = function(addr) {
    var k = gmCls('', 'GameMasterData');
    var m = cMN(k, 'get_StaticDataIsReady', 0);
    try { var r = rI(m, ptr(addr), ptr(0), null); return {ok:true, ready: !!(r.toInt32() & 0xff)}; }
    catch(e) { return {ok:false, err:e.toString()}; }
};

// Call Get_PokemonSettings(HoloPokemonId) -> PokemonSettingsProto, then dump evolution branches.
rpc.exports.evoreqs = function(gmAddr, pid) {
    var gmk = gmCls('', 'GameMasterData');
    // pick the 1-arg Get_PokemonSettings overload
    var m = null;
    var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
    var mm;
    var _mGpc = (function(){
        var il2cpp=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');var e=null;
        il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name==='il2cpp_method_get_param_count')e=x.address;});
        return e?new NativeFunction(e,'uint32',['pointer']):null;
    })();
    while ((mm = IL2.cGM(gmk, iter)) && !mm.isNull()) {
        if (IL2.mGN(mm).readCString() === 'Get_PokemonSettings') {
            var pc = _mGpc ? _mGpc(mm) : -1;
            if (pc === 1) { m = mm; break; }
        }
    }
    if (!m) return {err:'no 1-arg Get_PokemonSettings'};
    // HoloPokemonId is an int32 enum -> pass boxed as a value-type arg (pointer to int32).
    var idBuf = Memory.alloc(4); idBuf.writeS32(pid);
    var args = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); args.writePointer(idBuf);
    var settings;
    try { settings = rI(m, ptr(gmAddr), args, null); }
    catch(e) { return {err:'invoke threw: '+e.toString()}; }
    if (settings.isNull()) return {ok:true, found:false, pid:pid};

    // PokemonSettingsProto offsets (verified from recon):
    //  uniqueId_ @16, familyId_ @120, candyToEvolve_ @124, kmBuddyDistance_ @128,
    //  evolution_ @80 (RepeatedField<HoloPokemonId>), evolutionBranch_ @144 (RepeatedField<EvolutionBranchProto>)
    var out = {ok:true, found:true, pid:pid};
    out.uniqueId = settings.add(120).readS32();   // familyId is also the family enum
    out.familyId = settings.add(120).readS32();
    out.candyToEvolve = settings.add(124).readS32();
    out.kmBuddyDistance = settings.add(128).readFloat();
    out.unique = settings.add(16).readS32();

    // simple evolution list
    var evoRf = settings.add(80).readPointer();
    var evos = [];
    var ec = repeatedCount(evoRf);
    var evoArr = evoRf.isNull() ? null : evoRf.add(0x10).readPointer();
    for (var i = 0; i < ec && i < 20; i++) {
        evos.push(evoArr.add(0x20 + i*4).readS32());
    }
    out.evolutionIds = evos;

    // evolution branches
    var brRf = settings.add(144).readPointer();
    var bc = repeatedCount(brRf);
    var branches = [];
    for (var b = 0; b < bc && b < 20; b++) {
        var br = repeatedItemPtr(brRf, b);
        if (br.isNull()) continue;
        // EvolutionBranchProto offsets (verified):
        //  Evolution@16, EvolutionItemRequirement@20, CandyCost@24, KmBuddyDistanceRequirement@28,
        //  Form@32, GenderRequirement@36, LureItemRequirement@40, MustBeBuddy@44,
        //  Priority@48, NoCandyCostViaTrade@52, TemporaryEvolution@56,
        //  QuestDisplay@72 (RepeatedField<EvolutionQuestInfoProto>),
        //  CandyCostPurified@84, EvolutionItemRequirementCost@92, EvolutionMoveRequirement@96
        var branch = {
            evolution:        br.add(16).readS32(),
            evolutionItemReq: br.add(20).readS32(),
            candyCost:        br.add(24).readS32(),
            kmBuddyDistanceReq: br.add(28).readFloat(),
            form:             br.add(32).readS32(),
            genderReq:        br.add(36).readS32(),
            lureItemReq:      br.add(40).readS32(),
            mustBeBuddy:      !!br.add(44).readU8(),
            priority:         br.add(48).readS32(),
            noCandyViaTrade:  !!br.add(52).readU8(),
            tempEvolution:    br.add(56).readS32(),
            candyCostPurified: br.add(84).readS32(),
            evoItemReqCost:   br.add(92).readS32(),
            evoMoveReq:       br.add(96).readS32(),
        };
        // QuestDisplay repeated field
        var qdRf = br.add(72).readPointer();
        var qdc = repeatedCount(qdRf);
        var quests = [];
        for (var q = 0; q < qdc && q < 10; q++) {
            var qd = repeatedItemPtr(qdRf, q);
            if (qd.isNull()) continue;
            // EvolutionQuestInfoProto: QuestRequirementTemplateId@16(string), Description@24(string), Target@32(int)
            quests.push({
                templateId: readStr(qd.add(16).readPointer()),
                description: readStr(qd.add(24).readPointer()),
                target: qd.add(32).readS32(),
            });
        }
        branch.quests = quests;
        branches.push(branch);
    }
    out.branches = branches;
    return out;
};
"""

def pick_gm(sc, hits):
    if not hits:
        return None
    if len(hits) == 1:
        return hits[0]
    for h in hits:
        try:
            r = sc.exports_sync.gmready(h)
            if r.get('ok') and r.get('ready'):
                return h
        except Exception:
            pass
    return hits[0]

def main():
    for attempt in range(10):
        try:
            sess, pid = pg.get_session()
            print(f"attached pid={pid}")
            sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, EVO_JS)
            sc.exports_sync.init()
            gm_r = sc.exports_sync.findgm()
            if 'err' in gm_r:
                print(f"findGM err: {gm_r['err']}")
                sess.detach(); return
            hits = gm_r.get('hits', [])
            print(f"GameMasterData instances: {len(hits)} -> {hits}")
            gm = pick_gm(sc, hits)
            print(f"using GM @ {gm}")
            out = {}
            for spid, (name, tpid, tname) in TARGETS.items():
                r = sc.exports_sync.evoreqs(gm, spid)
                out[str(spid)] = {'name': name, 'target_pid': tpid, 'target_name': tname, 'data': r}
                print(f"\n=== {name} (pid {spid}) -> {tname} (pid {tpid}) ===")
                if r.get('err'):
                    print(f"  ERR: {r['err']}")
                    continue
                if not r.get('found'):
                    print("  no PokemonSettings found")
                    continue
                print(f"  familyId={r['familyId']} candyToEvolve(default)={r['candyToEvolve']} kmBuddy={r['kmBuddyDistance']}")
                print(f"  evolutionIds={r['evolutionIds']}")
                for b in r['branches']:
                    print(f"  BRANCH -> evo={b['evolution']} candyCost={b['candyCost']} "
                          f"itemReq={b['evolutionItemReq']} itemReqCost={b['evoItemReqCost']} "
                          f"kmBuddy={b['kmBuddyDistanceReq']} mustBeBuddy={b['mustBeBuddy']} "
                          f"lureReq={b['lureItemReq']} moveReq={b['evoMoveReq']} "
                          f"tempEvo={b['tempEvolution']} noCandyViaTrade={b['noCandyViaTrade']}")
                    for q in b['quests']:
                        print(f"      QUEST templateId='{q['templateId']}' target={q['target']} desc='{q['description']}'")
            json.dump(out, open('_extract_evo_reqs_out.json','w'), indent=2)
            print("\nwrote _extract_evo_reqs_out.json")
            sess.detach()
            return
        except (frida.InvalidOperationError, frida.TransportError, frida.ProcessNotFoundError,
                frida.ServerNotRunningError, RuntimeError) as e:
            print(f"[retry {attempt+1}] {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
            time.sleep(4)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`pogo_extract/_find_byte_dispatch.py`:

```py
"""Find an RPC dispatch path that takes either bytes or non-generic message."""
import frida, subprocess, json
adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','-s','100.98.158.56:5555','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
d = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
sess = d.attach(adb_pid)
js = """
rpc.exports = {
    findDispatch: function() {
        var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
        var addrs = {}; il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) addrs[e.name] = e.address; });
        function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(addrs[n],r,a); }
        var dG = bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
        var dGA = bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var aGI = bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGN = bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGCC = bind('il2cpp_image_get_class_count','int',['pointer']);
        var iGC = bind('il2cpp_image_get_class','pointer',['pointer','int']);
        var cGN = bind('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cGNS = bind('il2cpp_class_get_namespace','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cGM = bind('il2cpp_class_get_methods','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var mGN = bind('il2cpp_method_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var mGPC = bind('il2cpp_method_get_param_count','int',['pointer']);
        var mGP = bind('il2cpp_method_get_param','pointer',['pointer','int']);
        var tGN = bind('il2cpp_type_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var tA = bind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']);
        tA(dG());
        var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = dGA(dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();
        var hits = [];
        for (var ai = 0; ai < na; ai++) {
            var img = aGI(asms.add(ai*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
            var iN = iGN(img).readCString();
            if (iN !== 'holo-game.dll' && iN !== 'holo-protos.dll') continue;
            var cc = iGCC(img);
            for (var ci = 0; ci < cc; ci++) {
                var c = iGC(img, ci);
                if (!c || c.isNull()) continue;
                var clsName = cGN(c).readCString();
                var ns = cGNS(c).readCString();
                if ((ns + '.' + clsName).indexOf('Rpc') < 0 && clsName.indexOf('Request') < 0) continue;
                var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
                var m;
                while ((m = cGM(c, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
                    var n = mGN(m).readCString();
                    var pc = mGPC(m);
                    var hasIMessage = false; var hasInt = false; var hasBytes = false;
                    var paramTypes = [];
                    for (var pi = 0; pi < pc; pi++) {
                        var pt='?'; try { pt = tGN(mGP(m, pi)).readCString(); } catch(e) {}
                        paramTypes.push(pt);
                        if (pt.indexOf('IMessage') >= 0) hasIMessage = true;
                        if (pt === 'System.Int32' || pt === 'Holoholo.Rpc.Method') hasInt = true;
                        if (pt.indexOf('ByteString') >= 0 || pt.indexOf('Byte[]') >= 0) hasBytes = true;
                    }
                    if (hasIMessage && hasInt) hits.push({cls:clsName, ns:ns, method:n, params:paramTypes, score: 'IMessage+Int'});
                    else if (hasBytes && hasInt) hits.push({cls:clsName, ns:ns, method:n, params:paramTypes, score: 'Bytes+Int'});
                }
            }
        }
        return hits;
    }
};
"""
sc = sess.create_script(js); sc.load()
hits = sc.exports_sync.find_dispatch()
print(f'Found {len(hits)} candidate dispatch methods:')
for h in hits[:30]:
    print(f"  [{h['score']}] {h['ns']}.{h['cls']}.{h['method']}({', '.join(p[:50] for p in h['params'])})")
sess.detach()
```

```py
        var dG = bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);

        var cGNS = bind('il2cpp_class_get_namespace','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cGM = bind('il2cpp_class_get_methods','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var mGN = bind('il2cpp_method_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var mGPC = bind('il2cpp_method_get_param_count','int',['pointer']);

        var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = dGA(dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();

        for (var ai = 0; ai < na; ai++) {
            var img = aGI(asms.add(ai*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
            var imgN = iGN(img).readCString();

            var cc = iGCC(img);

                var cls = iGC(img, ci);
                if (!cls || cls.isNull()) continue;
                var name = cGN(cls).readCString();

                var m, methods = [];

                    methods.push({name: mGN(m).readCString(), params: mGPC(m)});
                }
                hits.push({ns: ns, name: name, methods: methods.slice(0,30)});
            }
        }
```

`pogo_extract/_find_pgp_native.py`:

```py
"""Enumerate all native modules + find pgp/holo/sleep symbols."""
import frida, subprocess
adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','-s','100.98.158.56:5555','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
d = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
sess = d.attach(adb_pid)
js = """
rpc.exports = {
    listModules: function() {
        var mods = Process.enumerateModules();
        return mods.map(function(m){ return {name:m.name, base:m.base.toString(), size:m.size, path:m.path}; })
            .filter(function(m){ return m.name.toLowerCase().match(/pgp|holo|sleep|wear|sfida|niantic|libpoke/); });
    },
    listExports: function(modName) {
        try {
            var exps = Module.enumerateExports(modName);
            return exps.filter(function(e){
                var n = e.name.toLowerCase();
                return n.indexOf('pgp')>=0 || n.indexOf('sleep')>=0 || n.indexOf('waina')>=0 || n.indexOf('sfida')>=0;
            }).slice(0, 50).map(function(e){return {name:e.name, addr:e.address.toString()};});
        } catch(e) { return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },
    findStringRefs: function(modName, str) {
        var mod = Process.findModuleByName(modName);
        if (!mod) return {error:'mod not found'};
        var hits = [];
        try {
            Memory.scanSync(mod.base, mod.size, str.split('').map(function(c){
                return ('0'+c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2);
            }).join(' ')).forEach(function(m){
                hits.push(m.address.toString());
            });
        } catch(e) { return {error:e.toString()}; }
        return {hits: hits.slice(0, 10), total: hits.length};
    }
};
"""
sc = sess.create_script(js); sc.load()
import json
print('=== Relevant modules ===')
mods = sc.exports_sync.list_modules()
for m in mods:
    print(f"  {m['name']:30s} base={m['base']} size={m['size']} path={m['path']}")
print('\n=== libpogoplus / similar exports (top 50) ===')
for m in mods:
    if 'pgp' in m['name'].lower() or 'plus' in m['name'].lower() or 'wear' in m['name'].lower() or 'pokemon' in m['name'].lower():
        print(f"\n--- {m['name']} ---")
        exps = sc.exports_sync.list_exports(m['name'])
        if isinstance(exps, list):
            for e in exps[:30]: print(f"  {e['addr']}  {e['name'][:80]}")
sess.detach()
```

`pogo_extract/_find_pokedex_now.py`:

```py
"""Heap-scan for current PokedexImpl singleton."""
import frida, subprocess

print(f"PoGo PID: {adb_pid}")

    scan: function(startHi, sizeBytes) {
        var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
        var exp = {}; il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) exp[e.name] = e.address; });
        function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(exp[n],r,a); }
        var dG=bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
        var dGA=bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var aGI=bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGN=bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cFN=bind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
        var tA=bind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']); tA(dG());
        var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var asms=dGA(dG(),sp); var na=sp.readS32();
        var gi=null;
        for (var a=0;a<na;a++){ var i=aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if (iGN(i).readCString()==='holo-game.dll'){gi=i;break;} }
        var cls=cFN(gi, Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Internal'), Memory.allocUtf8String('PokedexImpl'));
        var hits = [];
        var startAddr = ptr(startHi); var endAddr = startAddr.add(sizeBytes);
        Process.enumerateRanges({protection:'rw-'}).forEach(function(r){
            if (hits.length > 5) return;
            var rEnd = r.base.add(r.size);
            if (r.base.compare(endAddr) >= 0 || rEnd.compare(startAddr) <= 0) return;
            var p = r.base.compare(startAddr) > 0 ? r.base : startAddr;
            var e = rEnd.compare(endAddr) < 0 ? rEnd : endAddr;
            while (p.compare(e) < 0 && hits.length < 5) {
                try {
                    if (p.readPointer().equals(cls)) {
                        // Probe +0x10 dict pointer - PokedexImpl has 10 dicts starting at +0x10
                        var dict = p.add(0x10).readPointer();
                        if (!dict.isNull()) hits.push({addr: p.toString()});
                    }
                } catch(e2) {}
                p = p.add(8);
            }
        });
        return {hits: hits};
    }
};
"""
sc = sess.create_script(js); sc.load()
base = 0x7000000000
chunk = 0x10000000
for offset in range(0, 0x1000000000, chunk):
    try:
        r = sc.exports_sync.scan(base + offset, chunk)
        if r['hits']:
            print(f"  base=0x{base+offset:x}: {r['hits']}")
            break
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  fail at 0x{base+offset:x}: {e}")
        break
sess.detach()
```

`pogo_extract/_find_quest_status.py`:

```py
import frida, subprocess, json
adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','-s','100.98.158.56:5555','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
```
