```js
    /* AddTag on a SPECIFIC instance pointer (the real one we captured). */
    addTagOnInstance: function(instanceStr, name, colorInt) {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err:state.err};
        var inst = ptr(instanceStr);

        var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var m, addTag = null;
        while ((m = fns.cGM(taggingServiceClass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
            if (fns.mGN(m).readCString() === "AddTag" && fns.mGPC(m) === 2) { addTag = m; break; }
        }
        if (!addTag) return {ok:false, err:"no AddTag"};

        var sN = (function() {
            var exp = {};
            Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so").enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){
                if (e.name === "il2cpp_string_new") exp[e.name] = e.address;
            });
            return new NativeFunction(exp.il2cpp_string_new, 'pointer', ['pointer']);
        })();

        var nameStr = sN(Memory.allocUtf8String(name));
        var colorBuf = Memory.alloc(4); colorBuf.writeS32(colorInt);
        var args = Memory.alloc(2 * Process.pointerSize);
        args.writePointer(nameStr);
        args.add(Process.pointerSize).writePointer(colorBuf);
        var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var ret = fns.rI(addTag, inst, args, exc);
        if (!exc.readPointer().isNull()) {
            var k = exc.readPointer().readPointer();
            return {ok:false, err:"exc", excClass: fns.cGNs(k).readCString() + "." + fns.cN(k).readCString()};
        }
        return {ok:true, ret: ret.toString()};
    },

    /* Enumerate ALL tags via GetCachedTagToPokemonBindingForIndex on real instance. */
    listAllTags: function(instanceStr) {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err:state.err};
        var inst = ptr(instanceStr);

        // Find methods
        var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var m, getCount=null, getBinding=null;
        while ((m = fns.cGM(taggingServiceClass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
            var name = fns.mGN(m).readCString();
            if (name === "get_NumberOfTags") getCount = m;
            if (name === "GetCachedTagToPokemonBindingForIndex") getBinding = m;
        }
        if (!getCount || !getBinding) return {ok:false, err:"missing methods"};

        // Get count via boxed int
        var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var ret = fns.rI(getCount, inst, ptr(0), exc);
        if (!exc.readPointer().isNull()) return {ok:false, err:"count exc"};
        var count = ret.add(0x10).readS32();
        send({type:"status", msg:"Total tags: " + count});

        var tags = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            var idxBuf = Memory.alloc(4); idxBuf.writeS32(i);
            var args = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
            args.writePointer(idxBuf);
            var exc2 = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc2.writePointer(ptr(0));
            try {
                var bindingPtr = fns.rI(getBinding, inst, args, exc2);
                if (!exc2.readPointer().isNull()) {
                    tags.push({i:i, err:"exc"});
                    continue;
                }
                if (bindingPtr.isNull()) { tags.push({i:i, err:"null"}); continue; }

                // Walk binding fields - probe offsets 0x00 to 0x40 looking for strings
                var bindingInfo = {i:i, addr: bindingPtr.toString()};
                try {
                    var klass = bindingPtr.readPointer();
                    bindingInfo.klassName = fns.cGNs(klass).readCString() + "." + fns.cN(klass).readCString();
                } catch(e) {}

                // Probe field offsets for object pointers and try to read C# strings
                var fields = [];
                for (var off = 0x10; off <= 0x40; off += 8) {
                    try {
                        var fp = bindingPtr.add(off).readPointer();
                        if (fp.isNull()) continue;
                        var fInfo = {off:'0x'+off.toString(16), ptr:fp.toString()};
                        // Try as C# string: vtable@+0, monitor@+8, length@+0x10, chars@+0x14 (UTF-16)
                        try {
                            var len = fp.add(0x10).readS32();
                            if (len > 0 && len < 200) {
                                var chars = [];
                                for (var ci = 0; ci < len; ci++)
                                    chars.push(String.fromCharCode(fp.add(0x14 + ci*2).readU16()));
                                var s = chars.join('');
                                if (/^[\x20-\x7e]+$/.test(s)) fInfo.asString = s;
                            }
                        } catch(e) {}
                        // Try as integer
                        try { fInfo.asInt = bindingPtr.add(off).readS64().toString(); } catch(e) {}
                        // Try nested object - read its klass
                        try {
                            var nestKlass = fp.readPointer();
                            var nestName = fns.cGNs(nestKlass).readCString() + "." + fns.cN(nestKlass).readCString();
                            if (nestName.indexOf("Niantic") >= 0 || nestName.indexOf("Holoholo") >= 0) {
                                fInfo.nestedKlass = nestName;
                                // Probe nested object DEEPLY for strings
                                for (var noff = 0; noff <= 0x80; noff += 8) {
                                    try {
                                        var fp2 = fp.add(noff).readPointer();
                                        if (fp2.isNull()) continue;
                                        var len2 = fp2.add(0x10).readS32();
                                        if (len2 > 0 && len2 < 100) {
                                            var chars2 = [];
                                            for (var ci2 = 0; ci2 < len2; ci2++)
                                                chars2.push(String.fromCharCode(fp2.add(0x14 + ci2*2).readU16()));
                                            var s2 = chars2.join('');
                                            if (/^[\x20-\x7e]+$/.test(s2) && s2.length > 0) {
                                                fInfo['nested_str_+0x' + noff.toString(16)] = s2;
                                            }
                                        }
                                    } catch(e) {}
                                }
                                // Also dump int values at fixed nested offsets
                                for (var noff2 = 0x18; noff2 <= 0x40; noff2 += 8) {
                                    try {
                                        var v = fp.add(noff2).readS64();
                                        if (v != 0) fInfo['nested_int_+0x' + noff2.toString(16)] = v.toString();
                                    } catch(e) {}
                                }
                            }
                        } catch(e) {}
                        fields.push(fInfo);
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
                bindingInfo.fields = fields;
                tags.push(bindingInfo);
            } catch(e) {
                tags.push({i:i, err:e.message});
            }
        }
        return {ok:true, count: count, tags: tags};
    },

    /* Validate a candidate instance: check klass + call get_NumberOfTags. */
    validateInstance: function(ptrStr) {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err:state.err};
        var inst = ptr(ptrStr);
        var report = {addr: ptrStr};
        try {
            var klass = inst.readPointer();
            report.klass = klass.toString();
            report.expectedKlass = taggingServiceClass.toString();
            report.klassMatches = (klass.toString() === taggingServiceClass.toString());
            try {
                var ns = fns.cGNs(klass).readCString();
                var nm = fns.cN(klass).readCString();
                report.klassName = ns + "." + nm;
            } catch(e) { report.klassErr = e.message; }
        } catch(e) { report.readErr = e.message; }

        // Try get_NumberOfTags
        try {
            var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
            var m, getCount = null;
            while ((m = fns.cGM(taggingServiceClass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
                if (fns.mGN(m).readCString() === "get_NumberOfTags") { getCount = m; break; }
            }
            if (getCount) {
                var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
                var ret = fns.rI(getCount, inst, ptr(0), exc);
                if (exc.readPointer().isNull()) {
                    // Boxed int return: ptr -> {vtable@+0, monitor@+8, int@+0x10}
                    report.retPtr = ret.toString();
                    if (!ret.isNull()) {
                        try { report.boxedInt = ret.add(0x10).readS32(); } catch(e) {}
                        try { report.directInt = ret.toInt32(); } catch(e) {}
                    }
                } else {
                    report.invokeExc = "yes";
                }
            }
        } catch(e) { report.invokeErr = e.message; }
        return report;
    },

    /* Probe MethodInfo struct layout - find offset of native code pointer. */
    probeMethodInfo: function() {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err:state.err};
        var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var m, getCount = null;
        while ((m = fns.cGM(taggingServiceClass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
            if (fns.mGN(m).readCString() === "get_NumberOfTags") { getCount = m; break; }
        }
        if (!getCount) return {ok:false, err:"no method"};

        var probe = {methodInfo: getCount.toString(), offsets: []};
        for (var off = 0; off <= 0x40; off += 8) {
            try {
                var p = getCount.add(off).readPointer();
                var info = "+0x" + off.toString(16) + " = " + p.toString();
                // Check if it's in an executable region
                try {
                    var range = Process.findRangeByAddress(p);
                    if (range) info += " " + range.protection + " " + (range.file ? range.file.path : "anon");
                } catch(e) {}
                probe.offsets.push(info);
            } catch(e) { probe.offsets.push("+0x" + off.toString(16) + " err"); }
        }
        return probe;
    },

    /* Hook MULTIPLE TaggingRpcService methods. ANY UI interaction with tags fires SOMETHING. */
    hookForRealInstance: function(durationSec) {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err:state.err};

        // Hook EVERY method on the class - we want to know which fire during user actions
        var TARGET_METHODS = null;  // null = hook all

        var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var m, hookedCount = 0;
        var hookNames = [];
        while ((m = fns.cGM(taggingServiceClass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
            var name = fns.mGN(m).readCString();
            if (TARGET_METHODS === null || TARGET_METHODS.indexOf(name) >= 0) {
                try {
                    var nativeAddr = m.readPointer();
                    var capturedName = name;  // closure capture
                    Interceptor.attach(nativeAddr, {
                        onEnter: function(args) {
                            var thisPtr = args[0].toString();
                            if (!capturedThisPointers[thisPtr]) {
                                capturedThisPointers[thisPtr] = {count:0, methods:{}};
                                send({type:"status", msg:"captured this @ " + thisPtr + " via " + capturedName});
                            }
                            capturedThisPointers[thisPtr].count++;
                            capturedThisPointers[thisPtr].methods[capturedName] = (capturedThisPointers[thisPtr].methods[capturedName] || 0) + 1;

                            // Capture SetPokemonTags args - the List<PokemonTagChanges>
                            if (capturedName === "SetPokemonTags" && !capturedSetPokemonTagsArgs) {
                                capturedSetPokemonTagsArgs = {
                                    thisPtr: args[0].toString(),
                                    listPtr: args[1].toString()
                                };
                                send({type:"status", msg:"captured SetPokemonTags args: this=" + args[0] + " list=" + args[1]});
                            }
                            // Capture AddTag args
                            if (capturedName === "AddTag" && !capturedAddTagArgs) {
                                capturedAddTagArgs = {
                                    thisPtr: args[0].toString(),
                                    nameStrPtr: args[1].toString(),
                                    colorPtr: args[2].toString()
                                };
                                send({type:"status", msg:"captured AddTag args: name=" + args[1] + " color=" + args[2]});
                            }
                        }
                    });
                    hookedCount++;
                    hookNames.push(name);
                } catch(e) { send({type:"status", msg:"hook fail " + name + ": " + e.message}); }
            }
        }
        return {ok:true, hookedCount: hookedCount, methods: hookNames};
    },

    getCaptured: function() {
        return {ok:true, captured: capturedThisPointers, setPokemonTagsArgs: capturedSetPokemonTagsArgs, addTagArgs: capturedAddTagArgs};
    },

    /* Dump the captured List<PokemonTagChanges> structure so we know the layout. */
    dumpCapturedList: function() {
        if (!capturedSetPokemonTagsArgs) return {ok:false, err:"no SetPokemonTags captured yet"};
        var listPtr = ptr(capturedSetPokemonTagsArgs.listPtr);
        var dump = {addr: capturedSetPokemonTagsArgs.listPtr};
        try { dump.klass = listPtr.readPointer().toString(); } catch(e) {}
        // C# List<T>: klass@+0, monitor@+8, items_array@+0x10, count@+0x18, _version@+0x1c
        for (var off = 0; off <= 0x40; off += 4) {
            try {
                var v32 = listPtr.add(off).readS32();
                var v64 = listPtr.add(off).readS64().toString();
                if (v32 != 0) dump['+0x' + off.toString(16) + '_i32'] = v32;
                if (v64 != "0" && v64.length < 20) dump['+0x' + off.toString(16) + '_i64'] = v64;
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        // List items array typically at +0x10
        try {
            var itemsArr = listPtr.add(0x10).readPointer();
            dump.itemsArr = itemsArr.toString();
            dump.itemsCount = listPtr.add(0x18).readS32();
            // Array layout: klass@+0, monitor@+8, length@+0x10, items[0]@+0x20
            if (!itemsArr.isNull()) {
                var arrLen = itemsArr.add(0x18).readS32();
                dump.arrLen = arrLen;
                // First few elements (PokemonTagChanges structs or ptrs)
                var elems = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < Math.min(3, dump.itemsCount); i++) {
                    var elemAddr = itemsArr.add(0x20 + i*Process.pointerSize);
                    var elemPtr = elemAddr.readPointer();
                    var e = {i:i, addr:elemAddr.toString(), ptr:elemPtr.toString()};
                    // Dump PokemonTagChanges contents
                    if (!elemPtr.isNull()) {
                        try { e.klass = elemPtr.readPointer().toString(); } catch(_){}
                        var elemFields = {};
                        for (var off2 = 0; off2 <= 0x40; off2 += 8) {
                            try {
                                var pv = elemPtr.add(off2).readS64().toString();
                                if (pv != "0" && pv.length < 21) elemFields['+0x' + off2.toString(16)] = pv;
                            } catch(_){}
                        }
                        e.fields = elemFields;
                    }
                    elems.push(e);
                }
                dump.elements = elems;
            }
        } catch(e) { dump.parseErr = e.message; }
        return {ok:true, dump:dump};
    },

    /* Scan all klass matches, validate each via boxed-int return.
     * Real instance = boxedInt at ret+0x10 in 0..50 range. */
    findRealInstance: function() {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err:state.err};
        var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var m, getCount = null;
        while ((m = fns.cGM(taggingServiceClass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
            if (fns.mGN(m).readCString() === "get_NumberOfTags") { getCount = m; break; }
        }
        if (!getCount) return {ok:false, err:"no method"};

        var pat = buildKlassPattern(taggingServiceClass);
        var ranges = [];
        Process.enumerateRanges('rw-').forEach(function(r) {
            if (r.size > 512*1024*1024) return;
            if (r.size < 4096) return;
            ranges.push(r);
        });

        var sane = [];
        var totalMatches = 0;
        for (var ri = 0; ri < ranges.length; ri++) {
            var rs;
            try { rs = Memory.scanSync(ranges[ri].base, ranges[ri].size, pat); }
            catch(e) { continue; }
            for (var k = 0; k < rs.length; k++) {
                totalMatches++;
                var addr = rs[k].address;
                try {
                    var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
                    var ret = fns.rI(getCount, addr, ptr(0), exc);
                    if (!exc.readPointer().isNull() || ret.isNull()) continue;
                    var c = ret.add(0x10).readS32();
                    if (c >= 0 && c <= 50) {
                        sane.push({addr: addr.toString(), count: c});
                        if (sane.length >= 5) return {ok:true, totalMatches:totalMatches, sane:sane};
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            }
        }
        return {ok:true, totalMatches:totalMatches, sane:sane};
    },

    /* Find the REAL TaggingRpcService by enumerating ALL klass matches
     * and probing each with get_NumberOfTags. Real instance returns 0-50; garbage returns nonsense. */
    countTags: function() {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err:state.err};
        var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var m, getCount = null;
        while ((m = fns.cGM(taggingServiceClass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
            if (fns.mGN(m).readCString() === "get_NumberOfTags") { getCount = m; break; }
        }
        if (!getCount) return {ok:false, err:"no method"};

        // Get ALL matches across ALL heap regions, no maxMatches limit
        var pat = buildKlassPattern(taggingServiceClass);
        var ranges = [];
        Process.enumerateRanges('rw-').forEach(function(r) {
            if (r.size > 256*1024*1024) return;
            if (r.size < 4096) return;
            if (r.file) return;
            ranges.push(r);
        });
        var matches = [];
        for (var ri = 0; ri < ranges.length; ri++) {
            try {
                var rs = Memory.scanSync(ranges[ri].base, ranges[ri].size, pat);
                for (var k = 0; k < rs.length; k++) matches.push(rs[k].address);
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        send({type:"status", msg:"Total klass-pattern matches: " + matches.length});

        var sane = [];
        var insane = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) {
            try {
                var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
                var ret = fns.rI(getCount, matches[i], ptr(0), exc);
                if (exc.readPointer().isNull()) {
                    var c = ret.toInt32();
                    if (c >= 0 && c <= 100) {
                        sane.push({addr: matches[i].toString(), count: c});
                    } else {
                        insane++;
                    }
                } else { insane++; }
            } catch(e) { insane++; }
        }
        return {ok:true, totalMatches: matches.length, sane: sane, insane: insane};
    },

    /* Find ALL TaggingRpcService instances in heap and probe each. */
    findAllInstances: function() {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err:state.err};
        var matches = heapScan(taggingServiceClass, "TaggingRpcService", 1000);
        var results = [];
        // Find get_NumberOfTags method
        var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var m, getCountMethod = null;
        while ((m = fns.cGM(taggingServiceClass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
            if (fns.mGN(m).readCString() === "get_NumberOfTags") { getCountMethod = m; break; }
        }
        for (var i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) {
            var inst = matches[i];
            var info = {addr: inst.toString()};
            if (getCountMethod) {
                try {
                    var args = Memory.alloc(0);
                    var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
                    var ret = fns.rI(getCountMethod, inst, args, exc);
                    if (exc.readPointer().isNull()) {
                        // ret is boxed int? or unboxed pointer? for primitive return, check both
                        info.tagCount = ret.toInt32();
                        info.tagCountAlt = ret.readU32();
                    } else {
                        info.exception = "yes";
                    }
                } catch(e) { info.callErr = e.message; }
            }
            results.push(info);
        }
        return {ok:true, instances: results};
    },

    /* Minimal: BEFORE count, ADD tag, AFTER count. Single instance. 3 calls total. */
    addTagVerified: function(name, colorInt) {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err:state.err};

        var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var m, addTagMethod=null, getCountMethod=null;
        while ((m = fns.cGM(taggingServiceClass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
            var nm = fns.mGN(m).readCString();
            if (nm === "AddTag" && fns.mGPC(m) === 2) addTagMethod = m;
            if (nm === "get_NumberOfTags") getCountMethod = m;
        }
        if (!addTagMethod || !getCountMethod) return {ok:false, err:"missing methods"};

        var inst = findServiceInstance();
        if (!inst) return {ok:false, err:"no instance"};

        var report = {addr: inst.toString()};

        // BEFORE
        try {
            var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
            var ret = fns.rI(getCountMethod, inst, ptr(0), exc);
            report.beforeCount = exc.readPointer().isNull() ? ret.toInt32() : "exc";
        } catch(e) { report.beforeErr = e.message; }

        // ADD
        try {
            var exp = {}; Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so").enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){
                if (e.name === "il2cpp_string_new") exp[e.name] = e.address;
            });
            var sN = new NativeFunction(exp.il2cpp_string_new, 'pointer', ['pointer']);
            var nameStr = sN(Memory.allocUtf8String(name));
            var colorBuf = Memory.alloc(4); colorBuf.writeS32(colorInt);
            var args2 = Memory.alloc(2 * Process.pointerSize);
            args2.writePointer(nameStr);
            args2.add(Process.pointerSize).writePointer(colorBuf);
            var exc2 = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc2.writePointer(ptr(0));
            var ret2 = fns.rI(addTagMethod, inst, args2, exc2);
            report.addTagRet = exc2.readPointer().isNull() ? ret2.toString() : "exc";
            // If success, dump fields of the returned object
            if (!exc2.readPointer().isNull()) {
                var k = exc2.readPointer().readPointer();
                report.addTagExc = fns.cGNs(k).readCString() + "." + fns.cN(k).readCString();
            } else if (!ret2.isNull()) {
                // dump a few longs
                report.retDump = [];
                for (var off = 0; off < 0x60; off += 8) {
                    try { report.retDump.push("+0x" + off.toString(16) + ": " + ret2.add(off).readPointer().toString()); }
                    catch(e) {}
                }
            }
        } catch(e) { report.addTagErr = e.message; }

        // AFTER
        try {
            var exc3 = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc3.writePointer(ptr(0));
            var ret3 = fns.rI(getCountMethod, inst, ptr(0), exc3);
            report.afterCount = exc3.readPointer().isNull() ? ret3.toInt32() : "exc";
        } catch(e) { report.afterErr = e.message; }

        report.changed = (report.beforeCount !== report.afterCount);
        return {ok:true, report: report};
    },

    /* Dump all tag definitions from the user's account (via TaggingRpcService internal cache).
     * We find the TagCache object on the service and walk its tags. */
    listAllTagDefinitions: function() {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err:state.err};
        // Get the service instance, find its TagCache field
        var instance = findServiceInstance();
        if (!instance) return {ok:false, err:"no instance"};

        // Scan the service object's fields - look for pointers that look like a TagCache
        // Service object header: vtable @+0, klass @+8 (typical il2cpp object)
        // Then C# fields at +0x10 and onwards
        var found = [];
        for (var off = 0x10; off <= 0x100; off += 8) {
            try {
                var p = instance.add(off).readPointer();
                if (p.isNull()) continue;
                // Try to read as klass, see if name matches TagCache
                try {
                    var k = p.readPointer();  // potential klass pointer
                    var n = fns.cN(k).readCString();
                    var ns = fns.cGNs(k).readCString();
                    found.push({off: '0x' + off.toString(16), ptr: p.toString(), klassName: ns + "." + n});
                } catch(e) {}
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        return {ok:true, fields: found};
    },

    /* Read PokemonTagProto fields from a pointer (returned by AddTag etc.) */
    readPokemonTagProto: function(ptrStr) {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err:state.err};
        var p = ptr(ptrStr);
        var details = {ptr: ptrStr};
        // C# proto messages typically have:
        //   +0  vtable
        //   +8  klass
        //   +0x10... fields
        try { details.klass = p.readPointer().toString(); } catch(e) {}
        // Walk first 8 dwords to dump field-shaped data
        for (var off = 0x10; off <= 0x40; off += 8) {
            try {
                var v_ptr = p.add(off).readPointer();
                var v_i64 = p.add(off).readS64();
                details["off_0x" + off.toString(16) + "_ptr"] = v_ptr.toString();
                details["off_0x" + off.toString(16) + "_i64"] = v_i64.toString();
                // If it's a pointer, try to read it as a string
                try {
                    var len = v_ptr.add(0x10).readS32();
                    if (len > 0 && len < 100) {
                        var charsPtr = v_ptr.add(0x14);
                        var chars = [];
                        for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) chars.push(String.fromCharCode(charsPtr.add(i*2).readU16()));
                        details["off_0x" + off.toString(16) + "_str"] = chars.join('');
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        return {ok:true, details: details};
    },

    /* Read-only test: GetAllTags(PokemonProto) - safer than AddTag, just reads tags. */
    getAllTagsTest: function(uidLow, uidHigh) {
        if (!init()) return {ok: false, err: state.err};
        if (!protoIndex) protoIndex = buildProtoIndex();
        var key = uidLow + "," + uidHigh;
        var protoPtr = protoIndex[key];
        if (!protoPtr) return {ok: false, err: "pokemon not in heap index", key: key};

        var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var m, getMethod = null;
        while ((m = fns.cGM(taggingServiceClass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
            if (fns.mGN(m).readCString() === "GetAllTags") { getMethod = m; break; }
        }
        if (!getMethod) return {ok: false, err: "GetAllTags not found"};

        var instance = findServiceInstance();
        if (!instance) return {ok: false, err: "service instance not found"};

        try {
            var args = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
            args.writePointer(protoPtr);
            var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
            send({type:"status", msg:"Invoking GetAllTags on proto " + protoPtr});
            var ret = fns.rI(getMethod, instance, args, exc);
            var excPtr = exc.readPointer();
            if (!excPtr.isNull()) {
                var klass = excPtr.readPointer();
                return {ok:false, err:"exc", excClass: fns.cGNs(klass).readCString() + "." + fns.cN(klass).readCString()};
            }
            return {ok: true, ret: ret.toString(), retIsNull: ret.isNull()};
        } catch(e) {
            return {ok:false, err:"JS: " + e.message};
        }
    },

    /* Smoke test: invoke AddTag(string, color) on TaggingRpcService.
     * AddTag(System.String, Holoholo.Rpc.PokemonTagColor) - creates a new tag.
     * Color is an enum int. Returns IPromise<PokemonTagProto> probably.
     */
    addTagTest: function(name, colorInt) {
        if (!init()) return {ok: false, err: state.err};
        try {
            // Find AddTag method
            var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
            var m, addTagMethod = null;
            while ((m = fns.cGM(taggingServiceClass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
                if (fns.mGN(m).readCString() === "AddTag" && fns.mGPC(m) === 2) {
                    addTagMethod = m; break;
                }
            }
            if (!addTagMethod) return {ok: false, err: "AddTag method not found"};

            var instance = findServiceInstance();
            if (!instance) return {ok: false, err: "TaggingRpcService instance not found"};
            send({type:"status", msg:"Found service instance @ " + instance});

            // Build args: string name, color int
            var nameStr = (function() {
                var sn = (function(){
                    var exp = {};
                    Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so").enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){
                        if (e.name === "il2cpp_string_new") exp[e.name] = e.address;
                    });
                    return new NativeFunction(exp.il2cpp_string_new, 'pointer', ['pointer']);
                })();
                return sn(Memory.allocUtf8String(name));
            })();

            // PokemonTagColor enum is value type, passed as boxed int or unboxed
            // For IL2CPP, value types are passed by reference of unboxed value
            var colorBuf = Memory.alloc(4); colorBuf.writeS32(colorInt);

            var args = Memory.alloc(2 * Process.pointerSize);
            args.writePointer(nameStr);
            args.add(Process.pointerSize).writePointer(colorBuf);

            var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
            send({type:"status", msg:"Invoking AddTag(" + name + ", color=" + colorInt + ")"});
            var ret = fns.rI(addTagMethod, instance, args, exc);
            var excPtr = exc.readPointer();
            if (!excPtr.isNull()) {
                // Read C# exception details
                var details = {excPtr: excPtr.toString()};
                try {
                    // Exception is a C# object: vtable at +0, klass at +0
                    var klass = excPtr.readPointer();
                    var className = fns.cN(klass).readCString();
                    var ns = fns.cGNs(klass).readCString();
                    details.exceptionClass = ns + "." + className;
                    // Standard exception fields - Message at offset 0x10 typically
                    for (var off = 0x10; off <= 0x40; off += 8) {
                        try {
                            var p = excPtr.add(off).readPointer();
                            if (!p.isNull()) {
                                // C# string: header + length + chars
                                var len = p.add(0x10).readS32();
                                if (len > 0 && len < 500) {
                                    var charsPtr = p.add(0x14);
                                    var chars = [];
                                    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) chars.push(String.fromCharCode(charsPtr.add(i*2).readU16()));
                                    details["str_at_off_0x" + off.toString(16)] = chars.join('');
                                }
                            }
                        } catch(e) {}
                    }
                } catch(e) { details.readErr = e.message; }
                return {ok: false, err: "exception thrown", details: details};
            }
            return {ok: true, ret: ret.toString()};
        } catch (e) {
            return {ok: false, err: "JS exception: " + e.message + "\n" + e.stack};
        }
    },

    tagOne: function(uidLow, uidHigh, tagIds) {
        if (!init()) return {ok: false, err: state.err};
        if (!protoIndex) protoIndex = buildProtoIndex();
        var key = uidLow + "," + uidHigh;
        var protoPtr = protoIndex[key];
        if (!protoPtr) return {ok: false, err: "pokemon not in heap index"};
        var instance = findServiceInstance();
        if (!instance) return {ok: false, err: "TaggingRpcService instance not found"};

        try {
            var args = Memory.alloc(setTagsParamCount * Process.pointerSize);
            args.writePointer(protoPtr);
            // Second arg likely tag list - pass as-is for now (would need List<int> construction)
            args.add(Process.pointerSize).writePointer(ptr(0));
            var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
            var ret = fns.rI(setTagsMethod, instance, args, exc);
            var excPtr = exc.readPointer();
            if (!excPtr.isNull()) {
                return {ok: false, err: "exception", excPtr: excPtr.toString()};
            }
            return {ok: true, ret: ret.toString()};
        } catch (e) {
            return {ok: false, err: "JS exception: " + e.message};
        }
    }
};

// ---- SERVER ANSWERS (H02-2, 2026-09-29) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A generic, read-only dump of a settled promise: its own + inherited fields, one level into each referenced object, and
// for an *OutProto one more level (its int / enum fields and repeated enums), so the caller can read the reply's status.
var _GHAPI = null;
function _GH() {
    if (_GHAPI) return _GHAPI;
    var e = {};
    Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so').enumerateExports().forEach(function (x) { if (x.name.indexOf('il2cpp_') === 0) e[x.name] = x.address; });
    function b(n, r, a) { return e[n] ? new NativeFunction(e[n], r, a, {exceptions: 'propagate'}) : null; }
    _GHAPI = {oc: b('il2cpp_object_get_class', 'pointer', ['pointer']), flds: b('il2cpp_class_get_fields', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']),
              fnm: b('il2cpp_field_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']), foff: b('il2cpp_field_get_offset', 'size_t', ['pointer']),
              ftyp: b('il2cpp_field_get_type', 'pointer', ['pointer']), fflg: b('il2cpp_field_get_flags', 'int', ['pointer']),
              tnm: b('il2cpp_type_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']), cft: b('il2cpp_class_from_type', 'pointer', ['pointer']),
              isVT: b('il2cpp_class_is_valuetype', 'bool', ['pointer']), cnm: b('il2cpp_class_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']),
              parent: b('il2cpp_class_get_parent', 'pointer', ['pointer']),
              ghNew: b('il2cpp_gchandle_new', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'bool']),      // Il2CppGCHandle is a POINTER (Unity 2021.2+)
              ghGet: b('il2cpp_gchandle_get_target', 'pointer', ['pointer']), ghFree: b('il2cpp_gchandle_free', 'void', ['pointer'])};
    return _GHAPI;
}
function _ghFields(k, inherited) {
    var y = _GH(), out = [];
    for (var c = k; c && !c.isNull(); c = inherited ? y.parent(c) : null) {
        if (y.cnm(c).readCString() === 'Object') break;
        var it = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
        while ((f = y.flds(c, it)) && !f.isNull()) {
            if (y.fflg(f) & 0x10) continue;
            var t = y.ftyp(f);
            out.push({name: y.fnm(f).readCString(), off: Number(y.foff(f)), type: y.tnm(t).readCString(), vt: y.isVT(y.cft(t)) ? 1 : 0});
        }
        if (!inherited) break;
    }
    return out;
}
function _ghRepeated(rf) {
    var arr = null, cnt = null;
    _ghFields(_GH().oc(rf), true).forEach(function (f) {
        if (/\[\]$/.test(f.type)) arr = rf.add(f.off).readPointer();
        else if (/Int32/.test(f.type)) cnt = rf.add(f.off).readS32();
    });
    if (arr === null || arr.isNull() || cnt === null || cnt < 0 || cnt > 256) return null;
    var v = []; for (var i = 0; i < cnt; i++) v.push(arr.add(0x20 + 4 * i).readS32()); return v;
}
function _ghStr(p) { try { var n = p.add(0x10).readS32(); return (n >= 0 && n < 400) ? p.add(0x14).readUtf16String(n) : null; } catch (e) { return null; } }
// Niantic's Promise<T> (Gym Battle, proven on GymFeedPokemonOutProto / MapPlaceDetails / Buddy* replies): completeCalled /
// errorCalled are the settle flags, completedValue holds the reply (*OutProto), errorValue an Exception (_message).
function _ghDump(obj, depth) {
    var y = _GH(), cls = y.cnm(y.oc(obj)).readCString(), o = {cls: cls, f: {}};
    _ghFields(y.oc(obj), true).forEach(function (f) {
        var a = obj.add(f.off);
        try {
            if (f.vt) { o.f[f.name] = /Boolean|Byte/.test(f.type) ? a.readU8() : (/Int64|UInt64/.test(f.type) ? a.readS64().toString() : a.readS32()); return; }
            var p = a.readPointer();
            if (p.isNull()) { o.f[f.name] = null; return; }
            var c = y.cnm(y.oc(p)).readCString();
            if (c === 'String') { o.f[f.name] = {cls: 'String', s: _ghStr(p)}; return; }
            if (/RepeatedField/.test(c)) { o.f[f.name] = {cls: c, v: _ghRepeated(p)}; return; }
            var deep = depth > 0 && (/OutProto$/.test(c) || /Exception/.test(c) || /Promise/.test(c)
                                     || f.name === 'completedValue' || f.name === 'errorValue');
            o.f[f.name] = deep ? _ghDump(p, depth - 1) : {cls: c};
        } catch (e) { o.f[f.name] = {err: String(e)}; }
    });
    return o;
}
rpc.exports.promiseState = function (h) {
    try { var p = _GH().ghGet(ptr(h)); return p.isNull() ? null : _ghDump(p, 3); }
    catch (e) { return {err: String(e)}; }
};
rpc.exports.promiseFree = function (h) { try { _GH().ghFree(ptr(h)); return true; } catch (e) { return false; } };

send({type:"ready", msg:"bulk_tag.js loaded"});
```

`pogo_extract/compute_all_ranks.py`:

```py
if __name__ != '__main__':
    raise ImportError("compute_all_ranks.py is a SCRIPT, not a module: importing it opens pokemon.db relative to the CWD, re-ranks every in_bag row and commits. Import CPM from cpm_table instead.")
"""Compute GL/UL ranks for all in-bag pokemon. Store best rank across evolution chain.

FIXES APPLIED:
- Level cap = 50 (idx 98), not 51. Confirmed by Perrserker UL match.
- Complete FORM_OVERRIDES from form_overrides_complete.py.
"""
import json, sqlite3, math, time
from form_overrides_complete import FORM_OVERRIDES

# MAX_LEVEL_IDX + the CPM table + the league CP caps come from cpm_table.py, the SINGLE
# SOURCE OF TRUTH (defect D4). DO NOT paste a literal table back in here -- import it.
from cpm_table import MAX_LEVEL_IDX, LL_CAP, GL_CAP, UL_CAP, cpm_list

with open('pvpoke_gamemaster.json') as f:
    gm = json.load(f)
pokemon_db = {p['speciesId']: p for p in gm['pokemon']}

CPM = cpm_list()

# FORM_OVERRIDES imported from form_overrides_complete.py (160 entries, all 1400 forms covered)

def to_pvpoke_id(species_name, form_code, costume=0):
    if (species_name, form_code) in FORM_OVERRIDES:
        return FORM_OVERRIDES[(species_name, form_code)]
    base = species_name.lower().replace(' ', '_').replace("'", '').replace('.', '').replace('-', '_').replace('é', 'e')
    return base

def compute_cp(ba, bd, bs, ia, idf, ista, cpm, shadow=False):
    # CP is shadow-INDEPENDENT (the 1.2x/0.833x shadow boost is COMBAT-ONLY, not in CP).
    # Do NOT apply the shadow multiplier here or shadows cap at the wrong level and
    # high-attack shadow IV-ranks are wildly wrong (fixed 2026-05-29; matches PvPoke).
    return max(10, int((ba+ia)*cpm * math.sqrt((bd+idf)*cpm) * math.sqrt((bs+ista)*cpm) / 10))

def stat_product(ba, bd, bs, ia, idf, ista, cpm, shadow=False):
    am = 1.2 if shadow else 1.0; dm = 5/6 if shadow else 1.0
    return (ba+ia)*cpm*am * (bd+idf)*cpm*dm * math.floor((bs+ista)*cpm)

def find_max_idx(ba, bd, bs, ia, idf, ista, cap, shadow=False):
    for i in range(MAX_LEVEL_IDX, -1, -1):
        if compute_cp(ba, bd, bs, ia, idf, ista, CPM[i], shadow) <= cap:
            return i
    return -1

def all_combos_sorted(ba, bd, bs, cap, shadow=False):
    """Return list of 4096 stat products sorted desc."""
    sps = []
    for a in range(16):
        for de in range(16):
            for s in range(16):
                idx = find_max_idx(ba, bd, bs, a, de, s, cap, shadow)
                if idx >= 0:
                    # find_max_idx scans down from MAX_LEVEL_IDX, so idx is always in
                    # [-1, MAX_LEVEL_IDX]; the old `idx <= MAX_LEVEL_IDX else CPM[MAX_LEVEL_IDX]`
                    # ternary was unreachable dead code. (lockdown 2026-09-02)
                    cpm = CPM[idx]
                    sps.append(stat_product(ba, bd, bs, a, de, s, cpm, shadow))
                else:
                    sps.append(0)
    sorted_sp = sorted(sps, reverse=True)
    return sps, sorted_sp

# Pre-compute species rankings cache: (species_id, cap, shadow) -> (sps, sorted_sp)
ranking_cache = {}
def get_rankings(species_id, cap, shadow):
    key = (species_id, cap, shadow)
    if key in ranking_cache: return ranking_cache[key]
    p = pokemon_db.get(species_id)
    if not p:
        ranking_cache[key] = None
        return None
    bs = p['baseStats']
    sps, sorted_sp = all_combos_sorted(bs['atk'], bs['def'], bs['hp'], cap, shadow)
    ranking_cache[key] = (sps, sorted_sp, bs)
    return ranking_cache[key]

def compute_rank_for_iv(species_id, ia, idf, ista, cap, shadow):
    r = get_rankings(species_id, cap, shadow)
    if r is None: return None
    sps, sorted_sp, bs = r
    iv_idx = ia*256 + idf*16 + ista
    target_sp = sps[iv_idx]
    if target_sp == 0: return None
    rank = sorted_sp.index(target_sp) + 1
    pct = target_sp / sorted_sp[0] * 100 if sorted_sp[0] else 0
    return {'rank': rank, 'pct': pct, 'sp': target_sp}

def get_evolutions(species_id):
    p = pokemon_db.get(species_id)
    if not p: return [species_id]
    chain = [species_id]
    fam = p.get('family', {})
    for evo in fam.get('evolutions', []):
        if evo not in chain:
            chain.append(evo)
            for s in get_evolutions(evo)[1:]:
                if s not in chain: chain.append(s)
    return chain

# ----
conn = sqlite3.connect('pokemon.db')
c = conn.cursor()

# Add columns
cols = {r[1] for r in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(pokemon)').fetchall()}
new_cols = [
    ('ll_rank', 'INTEGER'), ('ll_pct', 'REAL'), ('ll_stage', 'TEXT'), ('ll_chain_ranks', 'TEXT'),
    ('gl_rank', 'INTEGER'), ('gl_pct', 'REAL'), ('gl_stage', 'TEXT'), ('gl_chain_ranks', 'TEXT'),
    ('ul_rank', 'INTEGER'), ('ul_pct', 'REAL'), ('ul_stage', 'TEXT'), ('ul_chain_ranks', 'TEXT'),
]
for col, typ in new_cols:
    if col not in cols:
        c.execute(f'ALTER TABLE pokemon ADD COLUMN {col} {typ}')
conn.commit()

rows = c.execute("""SELECT uid_hex, species_name, pokemon_id, form, fresh_costume,
    iv_atk, iv_def, iv_sta, fresh_alignment FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1""").fetchall()
print(f'Computing ranks for {len(rows)} pokemon...')

unknown_species = set()
done = 0
t0 = time.time()
for r in rows:
    uid_hex, sp, pid, form, costume, ia, idf, ista, align = r
    shadow = (align == 1)
    sid = to_pvpoke_id(sp, form or 0, costume or 0)
    if sid not in pokemon_db:
        # We cannot rank this specimen (its (species,form) has no gamemaster speciesId -- a
        # missing/wrong FORM_OVERRIDES entry). The old code just `continue`d, which LEFT ANY
        # PREVIOUSLY-COMPUTED RANKS IN PLACE: after an evolution or a mapping change the row
        # kept ranks belonging to a DIFFERENT form and every downstream PvP protection was
        # decided from stale numbers. NULL them instead so the state is honestly "unknown"
        # -- preflight_transfer alarms 'pvp_unknown' on a both-NULL-rank mon in the pile, so
        # unknown now means PROTECTED rather than silently mis-ranked. (lockdown 2026-09-02)
        unknown_species.add(f'{sp} f={form} -> "{sid}" (not in pvpoke gamemaster)')
        c.execute("""UPDATE pokemon SET
            ll_rank=NULL, ll_pct=NULL, ll_stage=NULL, ll_chain_ranks=NULL,
            gl_rank=NULL, gl_pct=NULL, gl_stage=NULL, gl_chain_ranks=NULL,
            ul_rank=NULL, ul_pct=NULL, ul_stage=NULL, ul_chain_ranks=NULL
            WHERE uid_hex=?""", (uid_hex,))
        continue
    chain = get_evolutions(sid)

    # For each league, find the BEST (lowest rank) across all stages
    best_ll = None; best_gl = None; best_ul = None
    ll_chain = []; gl_chain = []; ul_chain = []
    for stage_id in chain:
        ll = compute_rank_for_iv(stage_id, ia, idf, ista, LL_CAP, shadow)
        gl = compute_rank_for_iv(stage_id, ia, idf, ista, GL_CAP, shadow)
        ul = compute_rank_for_iv(stage_id, ia, idf, ista, UL_CAP, shadow)
        if ll:
            ll_chain.append(f"{stage_id}:{ll['rank']}({ll['pct']:.2f}%)")
            if best_ll is None or ll['rank'] < best_ll['rank']:
                best_ll = {**ll, 'stage': stage_id}
        if gl:
            gl_chain.append(f"{stage_id}:{gl['rank']}({gl['pct']:.2f}%)")
            if best_gl is None or gl['rank'] < best_gl['rank']:
                best_gl = {**gl, 'stage': stage_id}
        if ul:
            ul_chain.append(f"{stage_id}:{ul['rank']}({ul['pct']:.2f}%)")
            if best_ul is None or ul['rank'] < best_ul['rank']:
                best_ul = {**ul, 'stage': stage_id}

    c.execute("""UPDATE pokemon SET
        ll_rank=?, ll_pct=?, ll_stage=?, ll_chain_ranks=?,
        gl_rank=?, gl_pct=?, gl_stage=?, gl_chain_ranks=?,
        ul_rank=?, ul_pct=?, ul_stage=?, ul_chain_ranks=?
        WHERE uid_hex=?""",
        (best_ll['rank'] if best_ll else None,
         best_ll['pct']  if best_ll else None,
         best_ll['stage'] if best_ll else None,
         ';'.join(ll_chain) if ll_chain else None,
         best_gl['rank'] if best_gl else None,
         best_gl['pct']  if best_gl else None,
         best_gl['stage'] if best_gl else None,
         ';'.join(gl_chain) if gl_chain else None,
         best_ul['rank'] if best_ul else None,
         best_ul['pct']  if best_ul else None,
         best_ul['stage'] if best_ul else None,
         ';'.join(ul_chain) if ul_chain else None,
         uid_hex))
    done += 1
    if done % 500 == 0:
        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        print(f'  {done}/{len(rows)}  ({elapsed:.0f}s)')

conn.commit()
print(f'\nDone. {done} ranked.')
# LOUD, not a footnote: an unmapped (species,form) means every PvP keep axis is blind for those
# mons. Their rank columns are now NULL (see above) so preflight_transfer.py can alarm on them
# instead of releasing them un-judged.
#
# STILL exit 0 -- but the ORIGINAL justification is dead and must not be quoted again: 'enamorus'
# form 2803 IS mapped now (form_overrides_complete.py:174 -> 'enamorus_therian'), and the live bag
# has ZERO in_bag rows with gl_rank and ul_rank both NULL (re-derived 2026-09-07, 5728 rows: 0 NULL
# in gl_rank, ul_rank OR ll_rank). Nothing is unmapped today, so 'exiting would deadlock every
# pipeline run' is no longer true of anything.
#
# The exit code is nevertheless left ALONE here, because changing it would gate NOTHING: the crawl
# runs system/scripts/rank_cache.py (pogo_pipeline.py, the compute_ranks_legacy step), NOT this
# file, and rank_cache.main() likewise returns 0 on unknowns -- it does not even print this banner,
# just a plain 'Unknown species: N' count. So 'fail the pipeline on an unmapped form' is a decision
# about rank_cache.py, and making THIS script exit non-zero would only buy false confidence.
# Fix the mapping in form_overrides_complete.py to clear the banner. (lockdown 2026-09-02;
# banner re-verified against the live bag + the live pipeline 2026-09-07)
if unknown_species:
    print('\n' + '!' * 72)
    print(f'!! {len(unknown_species)} UNMAPPED (species,form) COMBO(S) -- ranks NULLed, PvP axes BLIND:')
    for u in sorted(unknown_species):
        print(f'!!   {u}')
    print('!! Add the missing entries to form_overrides_complete.py. Until then these mons carry')
    print('!! NULL gl/ul ranks and must be treated as PvP-UNKNOWN (= protected), never as "no rank".')
    print('!' * 72)
else:
    print('Unknown species (not in PvPoke): 0')
print(f'\nQuery: SELECT * FROM pokemon WHERE gl_rank IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gl_rank LIMIT 20')

# Stats
n_with_gl = c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND gl_rank IS NOT NULL').fetchone()[0]
n_top10 = c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND gl_rank<=10').fetchone()[0]
n_top100 = c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND gl_rank<=100').fetchone()[0]
ul_top100 = c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND ul_rank<=100').fetchone()[0]
print(f'\nWith GL rank: {n_with_gl}')
print(f'GL rank <=10: {n_top10}')
print(f'GL rank <=100: {n_top100}')
print(f'UL rank <=100: {ul_top100}')
```

`pogo_extract/compute_keepcodes.py`:

```py
"""Compute per-mon SUFFIXED nickname = "<species> <code>" (12-char cap), mirroring keep_policy:
  VF1/VF2/VF3 = variant_floor positions 1-3 (plain pool: non-shadow non-shiny), iv desc.
  GL / UL     = best gl_rank / best ul_rank per (pid,form) among NON-shiny rares.
  XXL         = xxl keepers (size==5): top-2 height + top-1 weight per (pid,form), non-shiny.
  O / F       = traded/lucky from ethanmateovz (O) / florandez (F).  [additive to any code]
  SHINIES     = suffixed by IV rank within their species (1..x), iv desc; + O/F if traded.
Every OTHER mon that currently has a non-species nickname -> CLEAR ("").  Mons with no code
and no old nickname -> left alone.  Name+code is compacted/truncated to fit 12 chars.
Writes keepcode_targets.json = [[uid_hex, nickname], ...]; prints the breakdown.
"""
import sqlite3, json, os, sys
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
from references import LEGENDARY_IDS, MYTHICAL_IDS, ULTRA_BEAST_IDS, PARADOX_IDS
RARE_PIDS = LEGENDARY_IDS | MYTHICAL_IDS | ULTRA_BEAST_IDS | PARADOX_IDS
DB = os.path.join(HERE, 'pokemon.db')


def build_nick(species, code):
    code = code.strip()
    if not code:
        return ''
    s = f"{species} {code}"
    if len(s) <= 12: return s
    c2 = code.replace(' ', '')
    s = f"{species} {c2}"
    if len(s) <= 12: return s
    s = f"{species}{c2}"
    if len(s) <= 12: return s
    keep = max(1, 12 - len(c2))
    return f"{species[:keep]}{c2}"


c = sqlite3.connect(DB); c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
rows = c.execute("""SELECT uid_hex,pokemon_id,species_name,form,fresh_alignment,fresh_shiny,
  fresh_costume,special_bg_id,natural_art_background,costume_decoration_id,fresh_bread_mode,
  iv_total,cp,gl_rank,ul_rank,pokemon_size_category,height_m,weight_kg,
  nickname,is_traded,is_traded_flag_v2,is_lucky,original_owner_name
  FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1""").fetchall()

# --- variant_floor positions (plain pool) ---
vg = defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:
    if r['fresh_alignment'] == 1 or r['fresh_shiny']:
        continue
    key = (r['pokemon_id'], r['form'] or 0, r['fresh_costume'] or 0, r['special_bg_id'] or 0,
           r['natural_art_background'] or 0, r['costume_decoration_id'] or 0, r['fresh_bread_mode'] or 0)
    vg[key].append(r)
vf_rank = {}
for key, lst in vg.items():
    _, _, _co, _bg, _ar, _de, _br = key
    _ds = bool(_de) and str(_de) != '0'
    cap = 8 if _br == 2 else (4 if (_br == 1 or _co or _bg or _ar or _ds) else 3)  # plain -> top-3 (2026-06-01)
    kept = sorted(lst, key=lambda x: (-(x['iv_total'] or 0), -(x['cp'] or 0)))[:cap]
    vfn = 0
    for r in kept:
        if (r['iv_total'] or 0) == 45:
            continue          # hundo -> labeled "100"; excluded from VF rank so the
                              # best NON-hundo becomes VF1 (no gap).
        vfn += 1
        if vfn <= 3:
            vf_rank[r['uid_hex']] = vfn

# --- best GL / best UL per (pid,form) among non-shiny rares ---
rg = defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:
    if (not r['fresh_shiny']) and r['pokemon_id'] in RARE_PIDS:
        rg[(r['pokemon_id'], r['form'] or 0)].append(r)
gl_set, ul_set = set(), set()
for lst in rg.values():
    glc = [r for r in lst if r['gl_rank'] is not None]
    ulc = [r for r in lst if r['ul_rank'] is not None]
    if glc: gl_set.add(min(glc, key=lambda r: r['gl_rank'])['uid_hex'])
    if ulc: ul_set.add(min(ulc, key=lambda r: r['ul_rank'])['uid_hex'])

# --- XXL keepers (non-shiny) ---
xg = defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:
    if (not r['fresh_shiny']) and (r['pokemon_size_category'] or 0) == 5:
        xg[(r['pokemon_id'], r['form'] or 0)].append(r)
xxl_set = set()
for lst in xg.values():
    for metric, n in (('height_m', 2), ('weight_kg', 1)):
        for r in sorted(lst, key=lambda x: -(x[metric] or 0))[:n]:
            xxl_set.add(r['uid_hex'])

# --- shiny IV rank within species ---
sh = defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:
    if r['fresh_shiny']:
        sh[r['species_name']].append(r)
shiny_rank = {}
for sp, lst in sh.items():
    for i, r in enumerate(sorted(lst, key=lambda x: (-(x['iv_total'] or 0), -(x['cp'] or 0))), 1):
        shiny_rank[r['uid_hex']] = i


def traded_code(r):
    if r['is_traded'] or r['is_traded_flag_v2'] or r['is_lucky']:
        o = (r['original_owner_name'] or '').strip().lower()
        if o == 'ethanmateovz': return 'O'
        if o == 'florandez': return 'F'
    return ''


targets, cnt = [], Counter()
nuke = 0
for r in rows:
    u = r['uid_hex']; sp = r['species_name']
    tc = traded_code(r)
    is_hundo = (r['iv_total'] or 0) == 45     # 15/15/15 -> label "100", not VF1/shiny-rank
    if r['fresh_shiny']:
        parts = ['100' if is_hundo else str(shiny_rank[u])]
        cnt['100' if is_hundo else 'shiny'] += 1
        if tc: parts.append(tc); cnt[tc] += 1
    else:
        parts = []
        if is_hundo:
            parts.append('100'); cnt['100'] += 1
        elif u in vf_rank:
            parts.append(f"VF{vf_rank[u]}"); cnt[f"VF{vf_rank[u]}"] += 1
        if u in gl_set:  parts.append("GL");  cnt['GL'] += 1
        if u in ul_set:  parts.append("UL");  cnt['UL'] += 1
        if u in xxl_set: parts.append("XXL"); cnt['XXL'] += 1
        if tc: parts.append(tc); cnt[tc] += 1
    if parts:
        targets.append([u, build_nick(sp, " ".join(parts))])
    else:
        has_old = bool((r['nickname'] or '').strip()) and r['nickname'] != sp
        if has_old:
            targets.append([u, ""]); nuke += 1

json.dump(targets, open(os.path.join(HERE, 'keepcode_targets.json'), 'w'), indent=0)
sets = sum(1 for _, n in targets if n)
print(f"TOTAL writes: {len(targets)}   (code-sets={sets}, nukes={nuke})")
print("per-code:", dict(sorted(cnt.items())))
nm = {r['uid_hex']: (r['species_name'], r['fresh_shiny']) for r in rows}
print("\nsamples (coded):")
shown = 0
for u, n in targets:
    if n and shown < 16:
        tag = 'shiny' if nm[u][1] else ''
        print(f"  {nm[u][0]:<13} -> {n!r}  {tag}"); shown += 1
print("sample nukes:", [nm[u][0] for u, n in targets if not n][:6])

```

`pogo_extract/correlate.py`:

```py
"""
Cross-correlate offset patterns with known cohorts to identify field meanings.

Cohorts from build_final.py / database:
- traded: tradedTimeMs > 0  (~ 120)
- best buddy: numAdditionalCpMultiplier > 0  (~ 232)
- hatched: byte at 225 == 1  (~ 374)
- adventure_effects_left > 0 at +496  (~ 21)
- special_bg_id > 0 at +440  (~ 92)
- location_bg_id > 0 at +480  (~ 14)
"""
import json, struct
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

EMPTY_LO = -2118004928

data = json.load(open('pokemon_v3.json'))
all_bytes = [bytes.fromhex(p['raw_proto']) for p in data if len(p.get('raw_proto', '')) >= 1024]
N = len(all_bytes)
print(f"{N} pokemon\n")

# Compute cohort masks for each pokemon
def is_traded(bs):
    return struct.unpack_from('<q', bs, 264)[0] > 0
def is_best_buddy(bs):
    return struct.unpack_from('<f', bs, 172)[0] > 0
def is_hatched(bs):
    return bs[225] != 0
def has_adv_effect(bs):
    return struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, 496)[0] > 0
def has_special_bg(bs):
    return struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, 440)[0] > 0
def has_location_bg(bs):
    return struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, 480)[0] > 0
def is_lucky(bs):
    return bs[272] != 0
def is_shadow(bs):
    # Need display alignment - skip in this proto-only context
    return False
def has_egg_target(bs):
    return struct.unpack_from('<f', bs, 92)[0] > 0

cohorts = {
    'traded': [is_traded(bs) for bs in all_bytes],
    'best_buddy': [is_best_buddy(bs) for bs in all_bytes],
    'hatched': [is_hatched(bs) for bs in all_bytes],
    'adv_effect': [has_adv_effect(bs) for bs in all_bytes],
    'special_bg': [has_special_bg(bs) for bs in all_bytes],
    'location_bg': [has_location_bg(bs) for bs in all_bytes],
    'lucky': [is_lucky(bs) for bs in all_bytes],
    'has_egg_target': [has_egg_target(bs) for bs in all_bytes],
}
for cn, mask in cohorts.items():
    print(f'  cohort {cn}: {sum(mask)}')
print()

# For each unmapped offset, count how many pokemon are nonzero AND in each cohort
KNOWN_OFFSETS = {32, 40, 44, 48, 52, 56, 60, 92, 104, 108, 112, 116, 120, 124, 128, 136, 160, 168, 172, 225, 248, 264, 272, 276, 440, 480, 496}
# 8-byte known: 64, 184, 256, 304, 360, 384 (string ptrs); 216 (display ptr); 32, 136, 160, 248, 264 (i64s)
KNOWN_PTR_OFFSETS = {64, 184, 256, 304, 360, 384, 216}

# An offset is "set" if int32 nonzero
candidates = []
for off in range(0, 508, 4):
    if off in KNOWN_OFFSETS: continue
    if off in KNOWN_PTR_OFFSETS or off+4 in KNOWN_PTR_OFFSETS: continue  # skip ptr halves

    set_mask = []
    for bs in all_bytes:
        if off + 4 > len(bs):
            set_mask.append(False)
            continue
        v = struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, off)[0]
        # for 8-byte ptr slots, treat empty-string sentinel as "not set"
        if v == EMPTY_LO:
            set_mask.append(False)
            continue
        set_mask.append(v != 0)

    set_count = sum(set_mask)
    if set_count < 5 or set_count > N - 5:
        continue

    # Compute conditional probabilities
    line = f"+{off:>3} (set={set_count:>4}): "
    for cn, mask in cohorts.items():
        cohort_size = sum(mask)
        if cohort_size == 0: continue
        # P(set | cohort) and P(cohort | set)
        both = sum(1 for i in range(N) if set_mask[i] and mask[i])
        pcs = both / cohort_size if cohort_size else 0
        pcoh_given_set = both / set_count if set_count else 0
        if pcs > 0.5 or pcoh_given_set > 0.5:
            line += f" {cn}={both}/{cohort_size}({pcs*100:.0f}%) "
    print(line)

```

`pogo_extract/correlate_finds.py`:

```py
"""Correlate offset stats with known field counts to nail down candidate fields."""
import json, struct, sqlite3
from collections import Counter

print('Loading...')
data = json.load(open('pokemon_v3.json'))
db = sqlite3.connect('pokemon.db')
c = db.cursor()

# Build uid -> known fields map
known = {}
c.execute('SELECT uid_hex, is_traded, is_lucky, is_hatched_from_egg, special_bg_id, location_bg_id, '
          'adventure_effects_left, costume, alignment, is_shiny, is_best_buddy, gender, weather_boosted, '
          'cp_multiplier, num_additional_cpm, level FROM pokemon')
for row in c.fetchall():
    uid_hex = row[0]
    known[uid_hex] = {
        'is_traded': bool(row[1]),
        'is_lucky': bool(row[2]),
        'is_hatched': bool(row[3]),
        'special_bg': row[4],
        'location_bg': row[5],
        'adv_left': row[6],
        'costume': row[7],
        'alignment': row[8],
        'is_shiny': bool(row[9]),
        'is_best_buddy': bool(row[10]),
        'gender': row[11],
        'weather_boosted': row[12],
        'cpm': row[13],
        'num_addl_cpm': row[14],
        'level': row[15],
    }
print(f'Known: {len(known)}')

# Pair each pokemon's raw_proto with its known fields
paired = []
for p in data:
    raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
    if len(raw) < 1000: continue
    uid = p.get('uid')
    if not uid: continue
    # uid in DB is uid_signed; raw uid is unsigned. Compute uid_hex from u64
    bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
    uid_int = struct.unpack_from('<Q', bs, 32)[0]
    uid_hex = f'{uid_int:016x}'
    if uid_hex not in known: continue
    paired.append((bs, known[uid_hex]))
print(f'Paired: {len(paired)}')

# For each known field, find offsets whose value correlates
# Approach: for each candidate offset, partition pokemon by nonzero@offset.
# Then check overlap with known fields.

PROTO_LEN = 512

def correlate(field_name, getter, expected_count):
    """For each offset, see what value at offset has best Jaccard with the boolean partition."""
    # field-positive set
    field_pos = set(i for i, (bs, k) in enumerate(paired) if getter(k))
    if len(field_pos) < 5:
        print(f'  Skip {field_name}: too few positive')
        return
    print(f'\n=== {field_name}: {len(field_pos)} positive (expected ~{expected_count}) ===')

    # Try each 4-byte int offset
    candidates = []
    for off in range(0, PROTO_LEN, 4):
        # Set of indexes with nonzero at offset
        offset_pos = set()
        for i, (bs, k) in enumerate(paired):
            if off + 4 > len(bs): continue
            v = struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, off)[0]
            if v != 0:
                offset_pos.add(i)
        if not offset_pos: continue

        intersect = len(field_pos & offset_pos)
        union = len(field_pos | offset_pos)
        if union == 0: continue
        jaccard = intersect / union
        # Also check if offset_pos is subset of field_pos or vice versa
        in_field = intersect / len(field_pos)
        in_offset = intersect / len(offset_pos) if offset_pos else 0

        if jaccard > 0.5 or (in_field > 0.7 and in_offset > 0.7):
            candidates.append((off, jaccard, len(offset_pos), in_field, in_offset))

    candidates.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
    for off, j, opcount, inf, ino in candidates[:10]:
        print(f'  +{off}: jaccard={j:.3f}, |offset|={opcount}, in_field={inf:.2f}, in_offset={ino:.2f}')

    # Also try bytes (booleans)
    print(f'  -- byte=1 candidates --')
    bcand = []
    for off in range(0, PROTO_LEN):
        offset_pos = set()
        for i, (bs, k) in enumerate(paired):
            if off >= len(bs): continue
            if bs[off] == 1:
                offset_pos.add(i)
        if not offset_pos: continue
        intersect = len(field_pos & offset_pos)
        union = len(field_pos | offset_pos)
        if union == 0: continue
        jaccard = intersect / union
        if jaccard > 0.5:
            bcand.append((off, jaccard, len(offset_pos)))
    bcand.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
    for off, j, oc in bcand[:5]:
        print(f'  byte +{off}: jaccard={j:.3f}, |offset|={oc}')

# Run correlations
correlate('is_traded', lambda k: k['is_traded'], 120)
correlate('is_lucky', lambda k: k['is_lucky'], 1)  # ?
correlate('is_hatched', lambda k: k['is_hatched'], 374)
correlate('has_special_bg (postcard)', lambda k: k['special_bg'] > 0, 92)
correlate('has_location_bg', lambda k: k['location_bg'] > 0, 14)
correlate('has_adv_effects', lambda k: k['adv_left'] > 0, 21)
correlate('is_best_buddy', lambda k: k['is_best_buddy'], 232)
correlate('is_shadow', lambda k: k['alignment'] == 1, 229)
correlate('is_purified', lambda k: k['alignment'] == 2, 63)

# Now look for offsets that have FLOAT distributions that match buddy_km_walked
# Buddy walked: 0 for most, small floats for a few
print('\n\n=== FLOAT distribution analysis - buddy_km_walked candidates ===')
for off in range(0, PROTO_LEN, 4):
    floats = []
    for bs, k in paired:
        if off + 4 > len(bs): continue
        v = struct.unpack_from('<f', bs, off)[0]
        floats.append(v)
    if not floats: continue
    nz_pos = [v for v in floats if v != 0 and not (v != v) and abs(v) < 1e10]
    if not nz_pos: continue

    # Plausible buddy: nonzero range 0.01 to 1000
    plausible = [v for v in nz_pos if 0.001 <= v <= 1000]
    plausible_pct = len(plausible) / len(nz_pos)

    # Distinguishing buddy_km from CPM: CPM ranges 0.094-0.85, buddy can go higher
    if plausible_pct > 0.95 and len(nz_pos) > 50:
        max_v = max(plausible) if plausible else 0
        # Check distribution
        small = sum(1 for v in plausible if v < 1)
        med = sum(1 for v in plausible if 1 <= v < 10)
        large = sum(1 for v in plausible if v >= 10)
        print(f'  +{off}: {len(nz_pos)} nz, max={max_v:.2f}, dist(small/med/large): {small}/{med}/{large}, samples: {sorted(set(round(v, 4) for v in plausible))[:5]}')

```
