`pogo_extract/costume_forms.py`:

```py
"""costume_forms.py -- which numeric `form` codes are COSTUMES, from the live game enum.

PoGo encodes a whole class of costumes directly in the PokemonDisplayProto.Form enum
(LaprasCostume2020, PikachuGofest2026CapBlue, CaterpieGofest2026, UmbreonGofest2024Mscarf ...)
-- SEPARATE from the `fresh_costume` field. Those specimens carry fresh_costume=0, so the
costume is invisible to any rule that only reads fresh_costume. This module reads the dumped
enum (form_enum.json, produced by system/scripts/game_read/classify_all_forms.py) and exposes
the set of costume form codes, so keep_policy (-> cosmetic top-4, NOT plain) and build_tagsets
(-> Event tag) treat a form-encoded costume as the cosmetic it is.

Classifier, on the enum NAME (ground truth):
  base     : '<Species>Normal'                              -> the plain form
  regional : contains Alola/Galar/Hisui/Paldea
  costume  : carries an event YEAR (19xx/20xx) OR a costume keyword
  form     : everything else (battle/natural/collectible -- Origin, Therian, Unown letters,
             Vivillon patterns, Flabebe colors ... none carry a year or costume keyword)

GAME-MASTER LAYER, ADD ONLY (2026-09-30, user: "do whats best and not lazy", shown five ways to decide it; LAW.md "WHAT COUNTS
AS A COSTUME"): the client game master (gamemaster_pokeminers.json) lists every form in formSettings.forms[] with its own
isCostume flag. A form is a costume if the NAME classifier above says so OR the game master flags it -- the flag can only ADD
protection, never take it away (the game leaves isCostume unset on event forms Niantic itself calls costumed: PsyduckSwim2025,
the four Copy2019 clones). On the 2026-09-30 enum (1,506 codes) and game master (1,449 forms) the flag adds MewtwoA,
GimmighoulCoinA1, PikachuKariyushi and PikachuDoctor (and Tshirt01-03, which TSHIRT also catches); 36 costumes only the name
rule knows stay costumes. 'FLYING' is a costume keyword for the Pikachu balloon outfits only: Arceus and Silvally use it as the
Flying TYPE (ArceusFlying, SilvallyFlying are plain forms). The game master lags the live enum, so a form the enum has and the
game master does not yet list can only be caught by name: 'TSHIRT' covers PikachuTshirt04-07.
COSTUME STATUS NEVER SILENTLY SHRINKS: with the game master file missing, unreadable or listing no forms, the LAST cached flags
(system/analysis/costume_gm_flags.json, whatever game master they were read from) stand in for it; only with neither does the
name rule work alone. GM_SOURCE / GM_NOTE / gm_layer_stamp() say which of the three happened (keep_policy stamps it into
pile_provenance.json, audit_gamemaster.py warns). Importing this module never raises and costs a few ms on a warm cache.

Re-dump the enum (run classify_all_forms.py) when new costumes ship; the set updates on import.
If form_enum.json is absent, COSTUME_FORMS is empty (safe fallback: old plain behavior).
(built 2026-06-04 -- after the LaprasCostume2020 / form-encoded-costume miss.
 last enum refresh 2026-09-03 -- 1498 entries, max known form id 3380.)
"""
import os
import json
import re
import time

_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
_ENUM = os.path.join(_ROOT, 'form_enum.json')
_GM = os.path.join(_ROOT, 'gamemaster_pokeminers.json')
_GM_CACHE = os.path.join(_ROOT, 'system', 'analysis', 'costume_gm_flags.json')   # formSettings flags, keyed by the game master's mtime
_norm = lambda x: re.sub(r'[^A-Z0-9]', '', str(x).upper())
_REGION = ('ALOLA', 'GALAR', 'HISUI', 'PALDEA')
_TYPE_FORM_SPECIES = ('ARCEUS', 'SILVALLY')   # every form of these is a TYPE form: 'ArceusFlying' = the Flying-type Arceus, not a balloon costume
# costume keywords for the (rare) costumes whose enum name carries no year
_KW = ('COSTUME', 'KURTA', 'JEJU', 'HORIZON', 'GOGGLE', 'MONOCLE', 'VISOR', 'FEDORA', 'BEANIE',
       'KIMONO', 'YUKATA', 'PONCHO', 'SOMBRERO', 'BANDANA', 'SANTA', 'WITCH', 'WEDDING', 'TUXEDO',
       'POPSTAR', 'ROCKSTAR', 'LIBRE', 'STARMOBILE', 'FOSSIL', 'FLOWERCROWN', 'STRAWHAT', 'SCARF',
       'ANNIV', 'FLYING', 'GLASSES', 'MASK', 'HOOD', 'EARMUFF', 'NIGHTCAP', 'BOWTIE', 'CROCHET',
       'TSHIRT')   # TSHIRT: Pikachu T-shirt outfits 01-07; the game master lists 01-03, 04-07 are in the enum but not (yet) in it
_YEAR = re.compile(r'(?:19|20)\d\d')


def classify(name):
    """-> 'base' | 'regional' | 'costume' | 'form' (battle/natural/collectible)."""
    if not name:
        return 'base'
    u = name.upper()
    if u.endswith('NORMAL'):
        return 'base'
    if any(r in u for r in _REGION):
        return 'regional'
    if _YEAR.search(u) or any(k in u for k in _KW if not (k == 'FLYING' and u.startswith(_TYPE_FORM_SPECIES))):
        return 'costume'
    return 'form'


LOAD_ERROR = None   # str reason the enum could not be read, else None (see enum_ok())

# WHERE THIS PROCESS'S GAME-MASTER FLAGS CAME FROM (set by gm_costume_flags() at import; audit_gamemaster.py reads it):
#   'game_master' -- the game master file on disk, parsed now or through its mtime-keyed cache (the healthy state)
#   'stale_cache' -- the file is missing / unreadable / lists no forms: the LAST cached flags stand in (costume status does not shrink)
#   'none'        -- neither: the name classifier alone decides (the pre-2026-09-30 behaviour, and the only one that can shrink)
GM_SOURCE = 'none'
GM_NOTE = None        # str why GM_SOURCE is not 'game_master', else None
GM_COUNTS = (0, 0)    # (forms the flags list, forms flagged isCostume)


def _read_cache(path):
    """-> (flags, gm_mtime) of the cached game-master flags; (None, None) when absent, unreadable or not a usable table.
    gm_mtime is None when the cache does not hold a number there (the flags are still usable as a stale fallback)."""
    try:
        c = json.load(open(path, encoding='utf-8'))
        flags = c['flags']
        if c.get('v') == 1 and isinstance(flags, dict) and flags:
            stamp = c.get('gm_mtime')
            return flags, (stamp if isinstance(stamp, (int, float)) else None)
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        pass
    return None, None


def _parse_gm(path):
    """{normalised form name: bool} from the game master's formSettings; {} when it cannot be read or lists no forms.
    A form printed as its enum NUMBER (0.381.2 / 0.395.1 print some: 3018 for GIMMIGHOUL_COIN_A1) is named through form_enum.json:
    keyed '3018' its flag would never meet the form's name, and a game-master-only costume would silently stop being one."""
    try:
        flags, enum = {}, None
        for t in json.load(open(path, encoding='utf-8')):
            for f in (((t.get('data') or {}).get('formSettings') or {}).get('forms') or []):
                nm = f.get('form')
                if isinstance(nm, int) and not isinstance(nm, bool):
                    if enum is None:
                        enum = {int(k): v for k, v in json.load(open(_ENUM, encoding='utf-8')).items()}
                    nm = enum.get(nm)
                if nm:
                    flags[_norm(nm)] = bool(f.get('isCostume'))
        return flags
    except Exception:
        return {}


def _write_cache(path, stamp, flags):
    """Atomic (tmp + os.replace). A read-only checkout or a missing directory just skips the cache: callers re-parse."""
    tmp = '%s.%d.tmp' % (path, os.getpid())
    try:
        with open(tmp, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
            json.dump({'v': 1, 'gm_mtime': stamp, 'flags': flags}, fh)
        os.replace(tmp, path)
    except OSError:
        try:
            os.remove(tmp)
        except OSError:
            pass


def _gm_layer(gm_path, cache_path):
    """-> (flags, source, note): the ladder documented on gm_costume_flags(). Pure of module state (the self-test drives it)."""
    try:
        stamp = os.path.getmtime(gm_path)
    except OSError:
        stamp = None
    cached, cached_stamp = _read_cache(cache_path)
    if stamp is not None:
        if cached is not None and cached_stamp is not None and abs(cached_stamp - stamp) < 0.01:   # tolerance as in evolvable_forms: a data-store restore moves the last bits
            return cached, 'game_master', None
        flags = _parse_gm(gm_path)
        if flags:
            _write_cache(cache_path, stamp, flags)
            return flags, 'game_master', None
        why = 'the game master (%s) is unreadable or lists no forms' % os.path.basename(gm_path)
    else:
        why = 'the game master (%s) is missing' % os.path.basename(gm_path)
    if cached is not None:
        try:
            when = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', time.localtime(cached_stamp)) if cached_stamp is not None else 'an unknown date'
        except (ValueError, OverflowError, OSError):
            when = 'an unknown date'
        return cached, 'stale_cache', '%s -- the flags cached from the game master of %s stand in' % (why, when)
    return {}, 'none', '%s and there are no cached flags -- the name rule alone decides' % why


def gm_costume_flags():
    """{normalised form name: bool} -- the client game master's OWN isCostume verdict for every form it lists in
    formSettings (a form it does not list is simply absent). COSTUME STATUS NEVER SILENTLY SHRINKS (2026-09-30), so the
    source is a ladder: (1) the game master itself -- the 19 MB file is parsed once and the flags cached next to the other
    analysis files, keyed by its mtime (evolvable_forms keeps its own table the same way; a read-only checkout just
    re-parses); (2) when it is missing, unreadable or lists no forms: the LAST cached flags, whatever game master they
    came from; (3) only with neither: {} (the name classifier alone). GM_SOURCE / GM_NOTE / GM_COUNTS record which rung
    answered, for audit_gamemaster.py and the pile provenance. Never raises (this module is imported by ~20 tools)."""
    global GM_SOURCE, GM_NOTE, GM_COUNTS
    try:
        flags, GM_SOURCE, GM_NOTE = _gm_layer(_GM, _GM_CACHE)
    except Exception as e:
        flags, GM_SOURCE, GM_NOTE = {}, 'none', 'unexpected %s: %s -- the name rule alone decides' % (type(e).__name__, e)
    GM_COUNTS = (len(flags), sum(1 for v in flags.values() if v))
    return flags


def gm_layer_stamp():
    """-> {'source', 'forms', 'costumes', 'note'}: which rung of the ladder above this process used (pile_provenance.json)."""
    return {'source': GM_SOURCE, 'forms': GM_COUNTS[0], 'costumes': GM_COUNTS[1], 'note': GM_NOTE}


def _costume_set(fmap, gm):
    """The costume form codes of an enum {code: name} given the game's flags. ADD ONLY: the name says costume OR the game
    says costume -- the game's "not a costume" never removes a form."""
    return {f for f, nm in fmap.items() if classify(nm) == 'costume' or gm.get(_norm(nm))}


def _load():
    global LOAD_ERROR
    try:
        fmap = {int(k): v for k, v in json.load(open(_ENUM, encoding='utf-8')).items()}
    except Exception as e:
        LOAD_ERROR = '%s: %s' % (type(e).__name__, e)
        return set(), {}
    if not fmap:
        LOAD_ERROR = 'form_enum.json parsed but is EMPTY'
        return set(), {}
    return _costume_set(fmap, gm_costume_flags()), fmap


COSTUME_FORMS, FORM_ENUM = _load()


# Highest form id the dumped enum knows about. Anything ABOVE this shipped AFTER the dump, so the
# classifier has no name for it and cannot judge it.
_MAX_KNOWN_FORM = max(FORM_ENUM) if FORM_ENUM else 0


def enum_ok():
    """True iff form_enum.json actually loaded. FAIL-LOUD HOOK (2026-09-02).

    is_costume_form()'s unknown-form guard answers True for any id above the dump's max. That is the
    right answer for a HANDFUL of ids that shipped after the dump, but when the dump is MISSING
    entirely _MAX_KNOWN_FORM collapses to 0 and the guard silently reclassifies EVERY non-zero form
    as a costume -- which empties the plain pool, disables the whole plain-line cap and the evolve
    comb-up, and (measured 2026-09-02 on the live bag) moves 62 mons INTO the irreversible Transfer
    pile and 22 out of it. A total load failure is not a data point to guess from, it is a reason to
    stop: callers that produce irreversible output (keep_policy) MUST check this and abort.
    Deliberately advisory, not an import-time raise -- costume_forms is imported by ~20 read-only
    tools that must keep working without the dump.
    """
    return bool(FORM_ENUM) and LOAD_ERROR is None


def enum_stamp():
    """(path, mtime, entry-count, max-known-id) -- for provenance/staleness reporting by callers."""
    try:
        mt = os.path.getmtime(_ENUM)
    except OSError:
        mt = None
    return {'path': _ENUM, 'mtime': mt, 'entries': len(FORM_ENUM),
            'max_known_form': _MAX_KNOWN_FORM, 'error': LOAD_ERROR, 'gm_layer': gm_layer_stamp()}


def is_unknown_form(form_code):
    """True iff this form id has NO NAME in the enum dump -- we have no verdict for it.

    MEMBERSHIP, not "above the max" (2026-09-23): a new form can be added below the old max id (an event reusing a
    gap), and the max test waved it through as plain. The walk now refreshes form_enum.json every scan, so an
    unnamed id means the refresh itself failed -- still protected."""
    f = form_code or 0
    return bool(FORM_ENUM) and f != 0 and f not in FORM_ENUM


def is_costume_form(form_code):
    """True iff this numeric form code is a form-encoded COSTUME (per the live enum).

    UNKNOWN-FORM GUARD (2026-09-02): a form id NEWER than the enum dump returns True -- protected, not
    plain. An unrecognised form is missing data, and the standing rule is that missing data means
    PROTECTED. The fallback over-protects (a genuine new battle/regional form is merely kept, which is
    recoverable) rather than under-protects (a new costume gets released, which is not).
    Re-dump the enum with system/scripts/game_read/classify_all_forms.py to clear the guard.

    HISTORY -- the guard was added because form_enum.json had been dumped 2026-06-04 (max id 3348) while
    the live bag held ids 3351/3352/3353. Unnamed, those were classified 'not a costume', judged as PLAIN
    Pikachu, given the pre-evo plain cap of 2 instead of the cosmetic cap, and SEVEN landed in the
    irreversible Transfer pile.
    VINDICATED 2026-09-03: the enum was re-dumped from the live game (1479 -> 1498 entries, max 3348 ->
    3380) and all three resolved to real costumes -- GimmighoulCoinA22026, PikachuPxp2026, PikachuWcs2026
    -- so the guard's protective verdict was exactly right and the pile did not move (80 uids, membership
    unchanged). Those ids are now classified by NAME; the guard remains for whatever ships above 3380.
    """
    f = form_code or 0
    return f in COSTUME_FORMS or is_unknown_form(f)


def blank_form_means_normal(species_name, costume_field=False, enum=None):
    """True when a blank (0) form can only be the species' Normal form: the live enum names a base ('...Normal') form for it
    and no alternative a blank could hide. 2026-11-02 (user: "why is the data missing? tf fix it."): a 2025 costume Noibat
    read form 0 beside the 2026 copies on NoibatNormal (3070), a GO Tour bandana Pikachu form 0 beside two on PikachuNormal
    -- an older catch stores its form unset: a complete read, not a missing one. A copy wearing its costume in the costume
    FIELD never also carries a costume FORM (bag-wide that day: 177 on a Normal form, 52 blank, 5 on a Pumpkaboo/Gourgeist
    size, none on a costume form), so for it costume forms are no alternative; a regional, size or battle form still is,
    and a species with none named keeps the hold. A name prefix that also matches another species (Mew / Mewtwo) only
    adds forms, so it can keep a hold but never lift one."""
    p = re.sub(r'[^0-9a-z]', '', (species_name or '').lower())
    fs = [('costume' if f in COSTUME_FORMS else classify(nm))         # the game master's own isCostume counts too (PikachuDoctor)
          for f, nm in (FORM_ENUM if enum is None else enum).items() if p and nm and nm.lower().startswith(p)]
    return 'base' in fs and all(k == 'base' or (costume_field and k == 'costume') for k in fs)


def _col(r, k):
    try:
        return r[k]
    except (KeyError, IndexError):
        return None


def card_folds_into_costume(r):
    """True for a NON-shiny, NON-shadow COSTUME copy (costume, costume form, decoration or art background).

    COSTUME + BACKGROUND = ONE LADDER (user 2026-09-24: "if a costume and the SAME costume with a back ground, dont
    count them seperate"). Such a copy competes only in its costume's top-N (keep_policy _vkey ignores the card),
    where backgrounds_first() puts it AHEAD of the costume-only copies; the per-card ladder no longer holds it.
    Plain, Max-only, shiny and shadow copies keep their card ladder. ONE definition: engine, audit_cull, preflight."""
    if _col(r, 'fresh_shiny') or _col(r, 'fresh_alignment') == 1:
        return False
    deco = _col(r, 'costume_decoration_id')
    return bool((_col(r, 'fresh_costume') or 0) or (_col(r, 'fresh_natural_art_bg') or 0)
                or (deco and str(deco) != '0')
                or is_costume_form(_col(r, 'fresh_form')) or is_costume_form(_col(r, 'form')))


def backgrounds_first(rows_sorted):
    """BACKGROUNDS FIRST (user 2026-09-24: "the ones where a costume with a background/card CAN take the slot of one
    thats just a costume" -> "Backgrounds first"): stable partition of an IV-sorted costume ladder -- every costume
    copy that carries a background card ahead of the costume-only copies, each side in the caller's own order. Rows
    that are not folded costume copies (a Max-only variant, anything shiny or shadow) keep their place in the tail."""
    bg = lambda r: card_folds_into_costume(r) and _col(r, 'fresh_has_location_card') == 1
    return [r for r in rows_sorted if bg(r)] + [r for r in rows_sorted if not bg(r)]


def form_name(form_code):
    return FORM_ENUM.get(form_code or 0)


def _selftest():
    """python costume_forms.py --selftest -- offline and self-contained: golden names for the rules, and synthetic game masters
    in a temp dir for every rung of the fail-safe ladder (2026-09-30). Needs neither the real game master nor the DB."""
    import shutil
    import tempfile
    global _GM, _GM_CACHE, _gm_layer
    n = 0
    for nm, want in (('ArceusFlying', 'form'), ('SilvallyFlying', 'form'), ('PikachuFlying03', 'costume'),   # Flying TYPE forms are plain
                     ('PikachuFlying5ThAnniv', 'costume'), ('PikachuTshirt07', 'costume'), ('PsyduckSwim2025', 'costume'),
                     ('MewtwoA', 'form'), ('GimmighoulCoinA1', 'form'), ('PikachuNormal', 'base'), ('YamaskNormal', 'base'),
                     ('RaichuAlolan', 'regional'), ('UnownA', 'form'), ('', 'base'), (None, 'base')):
        assert classify(nm) == want, (nm, classify(nm), want)
        n += 1
    fe = {900001: 'NoibatNormal', 900002: 'PikachuNormal', 900003: 'PikachuFlying03', 900004: 'MewNormal',   # ids no live enum uses
          900005: 'MewtwoA', 900006: 'RaichuNormal', 900007: 'RaichuAlola'}
    assert blank_form_means_normal('Noibat', enum=fe) and not blank_form_means_normal('Pikachu', enum=fe)   # a costume FORM exists ...
    assert blank_form_means_normal('Pikachu', True, fe)                     # ... but not for a costume-FIELD copy
    assert not blank_form_means_normal('Mew', True, fe) and not blank_form_means_normal('Raichu', True, fe)   # prefix collision / regional
    assert not blank_form_means_normal('Zubat', True, fe) and not blank_form_means_normal('', True, fe)       # nothing named = keep the hold
    n += 1
    enum = {1: 'FooBar2019', 2: 'FooPlain', 3: 'FooSkin', 4: 'ArceusFlying'}
    assert _costume_set(enum, {}) == {1}
    assert _costume_set(enum, {_norm('FOO_SKIN'): True}) == {1, 3}                                  # the game adds ...
    assert _costume_set(enum, {_norm('FOO_BAR_2019'): False, _norm('ARCEUS_FLYING'): False}) == {1}   # ... and never removes
    assert {f for f, nm in FORM_ENUM.items() if classify(nm) == 'costume'} <= COSTUME_FORMS            # add only, on the live enum too
    assert set(gm_layer_stamp()) == {'source', 'forms', 'costumes', 'note'} and enum_stamp()['gm_layer'] == gm_layer_stamp()
    n += 5
    forms = lambda *fl: [{'templateId': 'FORMS_POKEMON_X', 'data': {'formSettings': {'pokemon': 'X', 'forms': list(fl)}}},
                         {'templateId': 'V0001_POKEMON_BULBASAUR', 'data': {'pokemonSettings': {}}}]
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    save = (_GM, _GM_CACHE, _gm_layer)
    try:
        gm, cache = os.path.join(d, 'gm.json'), os.path.join(d, 'cache.json')

        def put(path, obj, mtime=None):
            with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                fh.write(obj if isinstance(obj, str) else json.dumps(obj))
            if mtime:
                os.utime(path, (mtime, mtime))
        skin = {'FOOSKIN': True, 'FOOPLAIN': False}
        put(gm, forms({'form': 'FOO_SKIN', 'isCostume': True}, {'form': 'FOO_PLAIN'}), 1.0e9)
        assert _gm_layer(gm, cache) == (skin, 'game_master', None)                 # no cache: parsed, then cached
        assert json.load(open(cache))['v'] == 1 and abs(json.load(open(cache))['gm_mtime'] - 1.0e9) < 0.01
        assert _gm_layer(gm, cache) == (skin, 'game_master', None)                 # warm cache
        put(gm, forms({'form': 'FOO_SKIN', 'isCostume': True}, {'form': 'FOO_PLAIN', 'isCostume': True}), 1.0e9 + 100)
        both = {'FOOSKIN': True, 'FOOPLAIN': True}
        assert _gm_layer(gm, cache) == (both, 'game_master', None)                 # a newer game master is re-read, not served from the old cache
        os.remove(gm)
        f, src, note = _gm_layer(gm, cache)                                        # MISSING -> the last cached flags stand in
        assert (f, src) == (both, 'stale_cache') and 'is missing' in note and '2001-09' in note, (f, src, note)
        for junk in ('{not json', '[]', '[{"templateId": "X"}]', '{"a": 1}', '5', 'null', '[5, "x"]'):
            put(gm, junk)                                                          # unreadable / lists no forms / not a template list
            f, src, note = _gm_layer(gm, cache)
            assert (f, src) == (both, 'stale_cache') and 'unreadable or lists no forms' in note, (junk, f, src)
        os.remove(cache)
        f, src, note = _gm_layer(gm, cache)                                        # neither: the name rule alone, and it says so
        assert (f, src) == ({}, 'none') and 'no cached flags' in note, (f, src, note)
        os.remove(gm)
        f, src, note = _gm_layer(gm, cache)
        assert (f, src) == ({}, 'none') and 'is missing' in note and 'no cached flags' in note, (f, src, note)
        put(gm, forms({'form': 'FOO_SKIN', 'isCostume': True}), 1.0e9 + 200)
        for junk in ('garbage', '[]', '5', 'null', '{"v": 1, "flags": 5}', '{"v": 1, "flags": {}}', '{"v": 2, "flags": {"X": true}}',
                     '{"v": 1, "gm_mtime": "x", "flags": {"X": true}}', '{"v": 1, "gm_mtime": null, "flags": {"X": true}}'):
            put(cache, junk)                                                       # an unusable cache is ignored, never an exception
            assert _gm_layer(gm, cache) == ({'FOOSKIN': True}, 'game_master', None), junk
        assert _gm_layer(gm, os.path.join(d, 'no', 'such', 'dir', 'cache.json'))[1:] == ('game_master', None)   # cache dir missing: still answers
        n += 13
        _GM, _GM_CACHE = gm, cache                                                 # the public wrapper records the rung it used
        put(cache, {'v': 1, 'gm_mtime': 5.0, 'flags': {'OLD': True, 'OLD2': False}})
        os.remove(gm)
        assert gm_costume_flags() == {'OLD': True, 'OLD2': False} and GM_SOURCE == 'stale_cache' and GM_COUNTS == (2, 1) and GM_NOTE
        assert gm_layer_stamp()['source'] == 'stale_cache' and gm_layer_stamp()['costumes'] == 1
        put(gm, forms({'form': 'FOO_SKIN', 'isCostume': True}), 1.0e9 + 300)
        assert gm_costume_flags() == {'FOOSKIN': True} and GM_SOURCE == 'game_master' and GM_NOTE is None and GM_COUNTS == (1, 1)

        def _boom(*_a):
            raise RuntimeError('boom')
        _gm_layer = _boom                                                          # a bug inside the ladder degrades, never raises at import
        assert gm_costume_flags() == {} and GM_SOURCE == 'none' and 'RuntimeError' in GM_NOTE
        n += 4
    finally:
        _GM, _GM_CACHE, _gm_layer = save
        shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
        gm_costume_flags()                                                         # put the module's own state back
    print('costume_forms selftest: %d checks OK (layer now: %s)' % (n, GM_SOURCE))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import sys
    if sys.argv[1:] == ['--selftest']:
        _selftest()
    else:
        print('usage: python costume_forms.py --selftest   (a library: importing it is all anything else needs)')
        sys.exit(2)
```

`pogo_extract/costume_names.py`:

```py
"""Field-costume id -> human name, from the live-dumped game Costume enum (costume_enum.json).

`fresh_costume` / `display_costume` hold a PokemonDisplayProto.Costume id (1,7,11,49...). The game
names them by the EVENT they shipped in (Halloween2021, Jan2020, Nightcap...). This is the platform's
single source for turning that id into a label -- import it ANYWHERE a costume is shown (Studio,
deep_read, audits, tag labels). Dump/refresh the enum with dump_costume_enum.py.

  costume_name(11)  -> 'Jan 2020'
  costume_name(67)  -> 'Nightcap'
  costume_name(61)  -> 'GO Tour 2023 Bandana'
  raw_name(11)      -> 'Jan2020Noevolve'   (exact enum token; 'Noevolve' = can't-evolve flag)
"""
import json
import os
import re

_HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
try:
    _ENUM = json.load(open(os.path.join(_HERE, 'costume_enum.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    if not isinstance(_ENUM, dict):
        _ENUM = {}
except Exception:
    _ENUM = {}   # enum not dumped yet -> graceful fallback to 'Costume #N'

# tokens the camel-splitter would otherwise mangle / abbreviate
_FIX = (('Gotour', 'GO Tour'), ('Gofest', 'GO Fest'), ('Tcg', 'TCG'))


def _humanize(s):
    if not s:
        return ''
    if s.endswith('Noevolve'):          # game flag, not part of the costume's identity
        s = s[:-8]
    s = s.replace('Noevolve', '')
    s = re.sub(r'(?<=[a-z])(?=[A-Z])', ' ', s)     # camelCase  -> camel Case
    s = re.sub(r'(?<=[A-Za-z])(?=\d)', ' ', s)     # word before year: Halloween2021 -> Halloween 2021
    s = re.sub(r'(?<=\d)(?=[A-Z])', ' ', s)        # year before word: 2023Bandana   -> 2023 Bandana
    s = s.strip()
    for a, b in _FIX:
        s = s.replace(a, b)
    return s


def raw_name(cid):
    """Exact enum token (e.g. 'Halloween2021Noevolve'); '' if unknown or Unset."""
    try:
        cid = int(cid or 0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return ''
    if not cid:
        return ''
    v = _ENUM.get(str(cid))
    return '' if (v is None or v == 'Unset') else v


def costume_name(cid):
    """Human label (e.g. 'Halloween 2021'); '' for none/Unset; 'Costume #N' if the id isn't in the enum."""
    try:
        cid = int(cid or 0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return ''
    if not cid:
        return ''
    v = _ENUM.get(str(cid))
    if v is None:
        return 'Costume #%d' % cid          # enum not dumped or id newer than the dump
    if v == 'Unset':
        return ''
    return _humanize(v) or ('Costume #%d' % cid)


def loaded():
    """True if the costume enum is present (87+ entries) -- lets callers warn if it needs a redump."""
    return len(_ENUM) > 3

```

`pogo_extract/cpm_table.py`:

```py
"""cpm_table.py -- THE single source of truth for the CP multiplier table, the level
cap index, and the league CP caps.

*** DO NOT RE-HARDCODE ANY VALUE FROM THIS FILE ANYWHERE ELSE. IMPORT IT. ***

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (defect D4, 2026-09-07)
--------------------------------------------
There used to be two different values for one number -- the level-50 CP multiplier:

    system/scripts/rank_cache.py:99      CPM[98] = 0.84029995     <- the ranker
    compute_all_ranks.py:33              CPM[98] = 0.84029995     <- the fallback ranker
    pvp_iv_rule.py:34                    CPM50   = 0.84029999     <- the viability gate

and five more copies in build_tagsets / preflight_transfer / audit_cull / granular_tags
(the last two SCRAPED the literal back out of compute_all_ranks.py's source text with a
regex, which is duplication with extra steps). Two literals that merely happen to match
are not a single source of truth: the next person to "correct" one of them silently
re-splits the brain, and the ranks that decide PvP protection move underneath the
irreversible Transfer pile. A shared constant beats two matching literals.

GROUND TRUTH FOR THE L50 VALUE
------------------------------
Neither old literal was right. The arbiter is the game itself: pokemon.db stores the raw
`cp_multiplier` + `additional_cpm` floats read straight out of PoGo's own memory, and on
66 level-50 specimens their sum is exactly

    0.8403000235557556  ==  float32(0.8403)      <- the value the game multiplies by

Both old literals (0.84029995 and 0.84029999) are float64 decimals that round to the
float32 *below* the game's value (0.8402999639511108) -- i.e. they were both failed
transcriptions of the same real constant, off by one ULP in the same direction.

CP+HP reconstruction could NOT tell the three apart (all reproduce every stored CP and HP
in the bag identically), so the raw stored float is the stronger arbiter and is what this
table now uses. Measured impact of adopting it, on the live 5,727-mon bag (sandboxed):

    Transfer pile ............. 26 uids, MEMBERSHIP IDENTICAL
    all 48 tagsets ............ MEMBERSHIP IDENTICAL
    rank<=5 protection boundary crossings ...... 0
    mons whose rank column shifts at all ....... 181  (cosmetic, see below)

WHY 181 RANKS SHIFT, AND WHY IT IS NOT SIGNAL
---------------------------------------------
For a species weak enough to sit at L50 under its league cap (magikarp/feebas/weedle in
Little League, many pre-evos in GL/UL) EVERY one of the 4096 spreads is evaluated at the
same level, so the CPM is a uniform scale factor and cannot reorder anything. It was
verified directly on magikarp: no floor((base_sta+iv)*cpm) value changes, and the
exact-integer ordering surrogate (atk+ia)*(def+id)*floor(...) is IDENTICAL under both
constants. What changes is only how float64 rounding merges or splits EXACT TIES
(3123 vs 2971 distinct stat-product values out of 4096), and rank is the leftmost index
of the tied value.

    *** KNOWN LATENT HAZARD -- NOT FIXED HERE, NEEDS A DECISION ***
    That means the published rank is decided by float rounding wherever spreads tie, and
    it can move by up to ~11 positions for a purely cosmetic constant edit. Today no mon
    crosses the rank<=5 gate that grants PvP protection (measured: 0 of 5,727), but the
    gate IS exposed to tie noise on a future bag. The durable fix is to rank on the exact
    integer surrogate instead of the float product. That changes the ranking metric, so it
    is deliberately NOT done here.

The rest of the table is left byte-identical to what the ranker has always used. The
entries are decimal roundings of the game's float32 values (deltas ~1e-9); replacing the
whole table with exact float32 was measured too -- pile and all 48 tagsets still
identical, 0 boundary crossings, but 416 rank columns churn for no decision benefit, so
it is NOT done without a deliberate call.

20 HALF LEVELS CORRECTED (2026-09-30, Benny's call: "1-4 fix it all")
------------------------------------------------------------------
The '~1e-9' above held for the whole levels only. 20 half-level entries -- L20.5-29.5 and
L41.5-50.5 -- sat up to 4.85e-6 (about 80 float32 steps) BELOW the game's ladder: a half
level is sqrt((a^2 + b^2) / 2) of its two whole-level neighbours, and the PokeMiners client
game master (playerLevel.cpMultiplier) gives those. They are now float32 of that value.
Arbiter check against the game's own stored floats (cp_multiplier + additional_cpm, bag of
2026-09-30): identical at 16 of the 19 half levels the bag holds; at L21.5 / L27.5 / L47.5
the game's float32 sum of the two stored parts lands one float32 step either side (it
depends on how the multiplier is split between caught level and power-ups). The other 81
entries are untouched. check_constant_drift.py now re-derives the whole ladder from the
game master whenever it is present and fails on any entry off by more than 1e-7.
"""

# Index i corresponds to level 1 + i/2  (i=0 -> L1.0, i=98 -> L50.0, i=100 -> L51.0).
# Immutable on purpose: consumers that need to mutate take a copy via cpm_list().
CPM = (
    0.094, 0.135137432, 0.16639787, 0.192650919, 0.21573247, 0.236572661,  # L1.0-L3.5
    0.25572005, 0.273530381, 0.29024988, 0.306057377, 0.3210876, 0.335445036,  # L4.0-L6.5
    0.34921268, 0.362457751, 0.37523559, 0.387592406, 0.39956728, 0.411193551,  # L7.0-L9.5
    0.42250001, 0.432926419, 0.44310755, 0.4530599578, 0.46279839, 0.472336083,  # L10.0-L12.5
    0.48168495, 0.4908558, 0.49985844, 0.508701765, 0.51739395, 0.525942511,  # L13.0-L15.5
    0.53435433, 0.542635767, 0.55079269, 0.558830576, 0.56675452, 0.574569153,  # L16.0-L18.5
    0.58227891, 0.589887907, 0.59740001, 0.6048236489, 0.61215729, 0.6194040775,  # L19.0-L21.5
    0.62656713, 0.6336491704, 0.64065295, 0.6475809813, 0.65443563, 0.6612192392,  # L22.0-L24.5
    0.667934, 0.6745818853, 0.68116492, 0.6876848936, 0.69414365, 0.7005428672,  # L25.0-L27.5
    0.7068842, 0.7131690979, 0.71939909, 0.7255756259, 0.7317, 0.734741009,  # L28.0-L30.5
    0.73776948, 0.740785574, 0.74378943, 0.746781211, 0.74976104, 0.752729087,  # L31.0-L33.5
    0.7556855, 0.758630378, 0.76156384, 0.764486065, 0.76739717, 0.770297266,  # L34.0-L36.5
    0.7731865, 0.776064962, 0.77893275, 0.781790055, 0.78463697, 0.787473578,  # L37.0-L39.5
    0.79030001, 0.792803968, 0.79530001, 0.7978039384, 0.8003, 0.802803874,  # L40.0-L42.5
    0.8053, 0.8078038692, 0.81029999, 0.8128038645, 0.81529999, 0.8178038001,  # L43.0-L45.5
    0.82029998, 0.8228037953, 0.82529997, 0.8278037906, 0.83029996, 0.8328037262,  # L46.0-L48.5
    0.83529995, 0.8378037214, 0.8403000235557556, 0.8428037167, 0.84529994,  # L49.0-L51.0
)

MAX_LEVEL_IDX = 98          # level 50.0 -- the highest level the ranker will evaluate (matches Pokemod)
LEVEL_50_IDX  = 98          # level 50.0
LEVEL_51_IDX  = 100         # level 51.0 -- present in the table, above the ranker's cap

#: The level-50 CP multiplier, DERIVED from the table so the scalar and the table entry
#: are the same object-value by construction and cannot drift (this was defect D4).
CPM50 = CPM[LEVEL_50_IDX]

# League CP caps. Game constants, NOT policy knobs -- keep_config.py says so explicitly
# ("Game constants (league CP caps 1500/2500, CPM) are NOT tunable here"), so they live
# here next to the CPM rather than in keep_config.json.
LL_CAP = 500                # Little League
GL_CAP = 1500               # Great League
UL_CAP = 2500               # Ultra League
ML_CAP = 10 ** 9            # Master League: NO cap -- every spread is ranked at the level ceiling (2026-09-23)
LEAGUE_CAPS = (LL_CAP, GL_CAP, UL_CAP)


def cpm_list():
    """A fresh MUTABLE copy of the table, for consumers that index/patch it locally.

    Handing out a copy (rather than the tuple itself) means a caller that temporarily
    patches its own CPM -- e.g. regress_pvp_keepers.py's D4 guard, which assigns
    rank_cache.CPM[MAX_LEVEL_IDX] and restores it -- cannot corrupt the canonical table
    for every other importer in the same process.
    """
    return list(CPM)


def level_for_index(i):
    """Level (float, half-steps) for a table index."""
    return 1.0 + i / 2.0


# ---- import-time self-checks: fail LOUD, never silently serve a broken table ----------
assert len(CPM) == 101, 'CPM table must hold L1.0..L51.0 in half-steps (101 entries), got %d' % len(CPM)
assert all(CPM[i] < CPM[i + 1] for i in range(len(CPM) - 1)), \
    'CPM table must be strictly increasing -- find_max_idx binary-searches on that assumption'
assert CPM50 == CPM[MAX_LEVEL_IDX], 'CPM50 must BE the table entry, not a second literal (defect D4)'
assert level_for_index(MAX_LEVEL_IDX) == 50.0, 'MAX_LEVEL_IDX must point at level 50.0'
assert CPM50 == 0.8403000235557556, (
    'CPM50 is no longer the value the game itself stores (float32(0.8403), verified against '
    '66 level-50 specimens\' cp_multiplier+additional_cpm in pokemon.db). If you are changing '
    'this deliberately, re-run the sandboxed pile/tagset impact measurement first -- this '
    'constant feeds the PvP ranks that decide the irreversible Transfer pile.')
assert LL_CAP < GL_CAP < UL_CAP
```

`pogo_extract/cull_cost_table.py`:

```py
"""CULL COST TABLE (read-only): for every keep rule -- how many mons it keeps, how many it is the ONLY reason for,
and how many slots one tightening step would free. Run after a cull; prints a table.  python cull_cost_table.py"""

import json
import os
import sqlite3
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True

import granular_tags as gt
import size_line as sl
import keep_config
from costume_forms import is_costume_form

rs = {k: set(v) for k, v in json.load(open('system/analysis/policy_reasons.json', encoding='utf-8')).items() if isinstance(v, list)}
pile = set(open('system/analysis/tagsets/Transfer.txt').read().split())
TD = os.path.join('system', 'analysis', 'tagsets')
T = lambda n: set(open(os.path.join(TD, n + '.txt')).read().split()) if os.path.exists(os.path.join(TD, n + '.txt')) else set()
c = sqlite3.connect('file:pokemon.db?mode=ro', uri=True)

def ordinal_free(group_rows, keyf, order, cap_new, sole_set):
    g = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in group_rows:
        g[keyf(r)].append(r)
    n = 0
    for lst in g.values():
        lst = sorted(lst, key=order)
        n += sum(1 for i, r in enumerate(lst) if i >= cap_new and r['uid_hex'] in sole_set)
    return n


K = list(kept.values())

deco = lambda r: r['costume_decoration_id'] if (r['costume_decoration_id'] and str(r['costume_decoration_id']) != '0') else 0

v3 = T('Variant_#3') & S('variant_floor')
v2 = T('Variant_#2') & S('variant_floor')
out.append(('Plain ladder', '3 (middle 2)', cnt['variant_floor'], sole['variant_floor'], 'cap 2 (middle 1): frees %d [the Variant #3 chips]; cap 1: +%d more' % (len(v3), len(v2))))
shg = [r for r in K if r['fresh_shiny']]
plain_sh = [r for r in shg if not spec(r) and r['iv_total'] != 45]

def _floor_free(floor):
    """plain shinies under `floor` that are sole-kept as shiny and not the best shiny of their form"""
    g = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in shg:
        g[(r['pokemon_id'], cf(r))].append(r)
    n = 0
    for lst in g.values():
        lst = sorted(lst, key=ivo)
        pl = [r for r in lst if not spec(r)]
        n += sum(1 for i, r in enumerate(pl) if i > 0 and (r['iv_total'] or 0) < floor and r['uid_hex'] in S('shiny'))
    return n
out.append(('Shiny', '6, at most 4 plain, plain floor %d/45' % _sfl, cnt['shiny'], sole['shiny'],
            'floor %d: frees %d; floor %d: frees %d  (special shinies in bag: %d)' % (_sfl + 3, _floor_free(_sfl + 3), _sfl + 5, _floor_free(_sfl + 5), sum(1 for r in shg if spec(r)))))
cos = [r for r in K if not r['fresh_shiny'] and r['fresh_alignment'] != 1 and r['iv_total'] != 45 and not ef.max_axis(r['fresh_bread_mode'])

            'cap 2: frees %d' % ordinal_free(cos, vkey, ivo, 2, S('variant_floor'))))

            'cap 4: frees %d; cap 3: frees %d' % (ordinal_free(gm, vkey, ivo, 4, S('variant_floor')), ordinal_free(gm, vkey, ivo, 3, S('variant_floor')))))

            'cap 5: frees %d; cap 4: frees %d; cap 3: frees %d' % tuple(ordinal_free(rar, lambda r: (r['pokemon_id'], cf(r)), ivo, n, S('rarity')) for n in (5, 4, 3))))

      and not __import__('costume_forms').card_folds_into_costume(r)]   # costume copies ride the costume ladder (2026-09-24)

            'cap %d: frees %d; cap %d: frees %d' % (_lcc - 1, ordinal_free(lc, lkey, ivo, _lcc - 1, S('location_card')), _lcc - 2, ordinal_free(lc, lkey, ivo, max(0, _lcc - 2), S('location_card')))))

            'cap 6: frees %d; cap 4: frees %d' % (ordinal_free(leg, lambda r: r['pokemon_id'], ivo, 6, S('legacy')), ordinal_free(leg, lambda r: r['pokemon_id'], ivo, 4, S('legacy')))))
xx = [r for r in K if 'xxl' in rs[r['uid_hex']]]
pts = {r['uid_hex']: (sl.best_points(r) or 0) for r in xx}   # the XXL keep's points: evolution counts (2026-09-24)
out.append(('XXL showcase winners', '>= %d pts, best 2' % int(sw['min_points']), cnt['xxl'], sole['xxl'],
            '>= 1000: frees %d; >= 1050: frees %d; best 1: frees %d' % (sum(1 for r in xx if r['uid_hex'] in S('xxl') and pts[r['uid_hex']] < 1000),
                                                                        sum(1 for r in xx if r['uid_hex'] in S('xxl') and pts[r['uid_hex']] < 1050),
                                                                        ordinal_free(xx, lambda r: r['pokemon_id'], lambda r: (-pts[r['uid_hex']], r['uid_hex']), 1, S('xxl')))))
sh_sole = S('shadow_best')
out.append(('Shadow (best ML + GL + UL)', '1 + 1 + 1, rank <= %d' % keep_config.pvp('shadow_rank_floor'), cnt['shadow_best'], sole['shadow_best'],
            'best ML only: frees up to %d' % sum(1 for r in K if r['uid_hex'] in sh_sole and (r['ml_rank'] or 99999) > 1)))
out.append(('Best ML (non-hundo copies)', 'rule', cnt['pvp_best_ml'], sole['pvp_best_ml'], 'drop it: frees %d' % sole['pvp_best_ml']))
out.append(('Best GL / Best UL (usable only)', 'rule', cnt['pvp_best_gl'] + cnt['pvp_best_ul'], sole['pvp_best_gl'] + sole['pvp_best_ul'],
            'sole-kept: GL %d, UL %d' % (sole['pvp_best_gl'], sole['pvp_best_ul'])))

nsp = len({rows[u]['pokemon_id'] for u, v in rs.items() if 'nundo' in v})
out.append(('Nundo', '1 per look', cnt['nundo'], sole['nundo'], '1 per species: frees ~%d' % max(0, cnt['nundo'] - nsp)))
out.append(('Last copy of a form', 'keep', onlydex, onlydex, 'off: frees %d' % onlydex))
out.append(('Evolve picks (held to evolve)', '-', cnt['evolve_1'] + cnt['evolve_2'] + cnt['shiny_ladder'], sole['evolve_1'] + sole['evolve_2'] + sole['shiny_ladder'], 'evolve them, then re-cull'))
out.append(('AE / Mighty / E+F / Protected / Favorite', 'keep', cnt['adventure_effect'] + cnt['mighty'] + cnt['origin'] + cnt['protected'] + cnt['favorite'],
            sole['adventure_effect'] + sole['mighty'] + sole['origin'] + sole['protected'] + sole['favorite'], '-'))
print('%-36s %-20s %6s %6s  %s' % ('RULE', 'CAP', 'KEEPS', 'ONLY', 'ONE STEP TIGHTER -> SLOTS FREED'))
for name, cap, k, so, tight in out:
    print('%-36s %-20s %6d %6d  %s' % (name, cap, k, so, tight))
print('\nbag %d | kept %d | pile %d | hundos %d (always kept)' % (len(rows), len(kept), len(pile), sum(1 for r in rows.values() if r['iv_total'] == 45)))
```

`pogo_extract/cull_engine.py`:

```py
"""Apply the cull ruleset to pokemon.db and produce the cull plan.

Decision logic: a pokemon is KEPT if ANY of these rules say keep.
A pokemon is TRANSFERRED only if NO rule says keep.

Rules (all evaluated as union):
  R-untouchable: hundo / nundo / lucky / best-buddy / shadow / purified /
                 powered-up / traded / mega-evolved / costume-decoration /
                 postcard / location-bg / adventure-effects / deployed-in-gym /
                 legendary / mythical / ultra-beast / paradox /
                 adventure-effect-species / legacy-move /
                 size-XXS / size-XL-or-XXL /
                 has-known-tag (5 known from runtime memory dump)
  R-shiny:       within species, rank <= 10 by IV%
  R-shadow:      within species, rank <= 2 by IV% (subsumed by R-untouchable since
                 alignment != 0 already keeps all shadows)
  R-bucket:      within (species, form), rank <= 3 by IV%

Tags partial: only 5 bindings extracted from runtime so far; full extraction pending.
"""
import sqlite3, csv, json, os
from references import (
    LEGENDARY_IDS, MYTHICAL_IDS, ULTRA_BEAST_IDS, PARADOX_IDS,
    ADVENTURE_EFFECT_IDS, has_legacy_move,
)

DB = 'pokemon.db'

# Known tag bindings from runtime memory dump (uid_to_tags.json)
TAGGED_UIDS = set()
TAG_BY_UID = {}  # uid_str -> tag_name
if os.path.exists('uid_to_tags.json'):
    try:
        d = json.load(open('uid_to_tags.json'))
        for uid_str, tags in d.items():
            TAGGED_UIDS.add(int(uid_str))
            TAG_BY_UID[int(uid_str)] = tags if isinstance(tags, list) else [tags]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"warn: could not load uid_to_tags.json: {e}")
print(f"Loaded {len(TAGGED_UIDS)} known tag bindings from runtime")

def untouchable_reasons(p):
    """Return list of reasons this pokemon is untouchable. Empty list = not L1."""
    rs = []
    if p['is_hundo']:                            rs.append("hundo")
    if p['is_zero']:                             rs.append("nundo")
    if p['is_lucky']:                            rs.append("lucky")
    if p['is_best_buddy']:                       rs.append("best_buddy")
    if p['is_deployed']:                         rs.append("deployed_in_gym")
    if (p['alignment'] or 0) != 0:               rs.append(f"alignment_{p['alignment_name'] or p['alignment']}")
    if (p['is_powered_up'] or 0) == 1:           rs.append("powered_up")
    # Use v2 is_traded_flag if available, else fall back to derived is_traded
    if (p['is_traded_flag_v2'] or 0) == 1 or (p['is_traded'] or 0) == 1:
        rs.append("traded")
    if (p['is_mega_evolved'] or 0) == 1:         rs.append("mega_evolved")
    if (p['special_bg_id'] or 0) > 0:            rs.append("postcard_special_bg")
    if (p['location_bg_id'] or 0) > 0:           rs.append("location_bg")
    if (p['adventure_effects_left'] or 0) > 0:   rs.append("adventure_effects_left")
    if p['costume_decoration_id']:               rs.append(f"costume_dec_{p['costume_decoration_id']}")

    # Size flag: XXS (1) or XL/XXL (5) - PoGo's special-size markers
    sc = p['pokemon_size_category'] or 0
    if sc == 1:                                  rs.append("size_XXS")
    elif sc == 5:                                rs.append("size_XL_or_XXL")

    # Known runtime tag bindings (only 5 so far, full extraction pending)
    uid_signed = p['uid']
    if uid_signed in TAGGED_UIDS:
        for t in TAG_BY_UID.get(uid_signed, []):
            rs.append(f"tag_{t}")

    pid = p['pokemon_id']
    if pid in LEGENDARY_IDS:                     rs.append("legendary")
    if pid in MYTHICAL_IDS:                      rs.append("mythical")
    if pid in ULTRA_BEAST_IDS:                   rs.append("ultra_beast")
    if pid in PARADOX_IDS:                       rs.append("paradox")
    if pid in ADVENTURE_EFFECT_IDS:              rs.append("adventure_effect_species")
    if has_legacy_move(pid, [p['move1'], p['move2'], p['move3']]):
        rs.append("legacy_move")
    return rs

def main():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    c = conn.cursor()

    # Add columns if missing
    cols = {r[1] for r in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(pokemon)").fetchall()}
    if 'cull_decision' not in cols:
        c.execute("ALTER TABLE pokemon ADD COLUMN cull_decision TEXT")
    if 'cull_reason' not in cols:
        c.execute("ALTER TABLE pokemon ADD COLUMN cull_reason TEXT")
    conn.commit()

    rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT * FROM pokemon").fetchall()]
    print(f"Loaded {len(rows)} pokemon")

    # Map uid -> set of keep-reasons
    keep_reasons = {}  # uid_hex -> list of reason strings
    def add_reason(uid, reason):
        keep_reasons.setdefault(uid, []).append(reason)

    # Rule: untouchable
    for p in rows:
        for r in untouchable_reasons(p):
            add_reason(p['uid_hex'], r)

    # Rule: top 10 shinies per species (by IV%, ties broken by CP)
    by_species_shiny = {}
    for p in rows:
        if p['is_shiny']:
            by_species_shiny.setdefault(p['pokemon_id'], []).append(p)
    for pid, lst in by_species_shiny.items():
        lst.sort(key=lambda x: (-(x['iv_total'] or 0), -(x['cp'] or 0)))
        for i, p in enumerate(lst[:10]):
            add_reason(p['uid_hex'], f"shiny_top10_rank{i+1}")

    # Rule: top 3 per (species, form) by IV%
    by_bucket = {}
    for p in rows:
        key = (p['pokemon_id'], p['form'] or 0)
        by_bucket.setdefault(key, []).append(p)
    for key, lst in by_bucket.items():
        lst.sort(key=lambda x: (-(x['iv_total'] or 0), -(x['cp'] or 0)))
        for i, p in enumerate(lst[:3]):
            add_reason(p['uid_hex'], f"top3_form_rank{i+1}")

    # Rule: top 2 shadows per species. (Subsumed: alignment != 0 already in
    # untouchable. Redundant but explicit.)
    by_species_shadow = {}
    for p in rows:
        if (p['alignment'] or 0) == 1:  # SHADOW
            by_species_shadow.setdefault(p['pokemon_id'], []).append(p)
    for pid, lst in by_species_shadow.items():
        lst.sort(key=lambda x: (-(x['iv_total'] or 0), -(x['cp'] or 0)))
        for i, p in enumerate(lst[:2]):
            add_reason(p['uid_hex'], f"shadow_top2_rank{i+1}")

    # Compose decisions
    keep_count = 0
    xfer_count = 0
    print("\nWriting decisions back to DB...")
    for p in rows:
        uid = p['uid_hex']
        reasons = keep_reasons.get(uid, [])
        if reasons:
            decision = "KEEP"
            reason_str = ";".join(reasons[:6])  # cap at 6 to keep cell short
            keep_count += 1
        else:
            decision = "TRANSFER"
            reason_str = "no_keep_rule_matched"
            xfer_count += 1
        c.execute("UPDATE pokemon SET cull_decision=?, cull_reason=? WHERE uid_hex=?",
                  (decision, reason_str, uid))
    conn.commit()

    print(f"\n=== FINAL ===")
    print(f"  Total: {len(rows)}")
    print(f"  KEEP:     {keep_count} ({keep_count/len(rows)*100:.1f}%)")
    print(f"  TRANSFER: {xfer_count} ({xfer_count/len(rows)*100:.1f}%)")

    print(f"\n=== Top species by transfer count ===")
    for row in c.execute("""SELECT species_name, COUNT(*) as n FROM pokemon
                            WHERE cull_decision='TRANSFER' GROUP BY species_name
                            ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 25""").fetchall():
        print(f"  {row[0]:25s} {row[1]}")

    print(f"\n=== Top INDIVIDUAL keep reasons (across all keepers) ===")
    # break out the joined reason strings
    reason_counts = {}
    for r in c.execute("SELECT cull_reason FROM pokemon WHERE cull_decision='KEEP'").fetchall():
        for tok in r[0].split(";"):
            reason_counts[tok] = reason_counts.get(tok, 0) + 1
    for tok, n in sorted(reason_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:30]:
        print(f"  {n:5d}  {tok}")

    print("\nExporting cull_plan.csv...")
    with open('cull_plan.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(['uid_hex','pokemon_id','species_name','form','cp',
                    'iv_pct','iv_total','iv_atk','iv_def','iv_sta',
                    'is_shiny','is_lucky','is_traded','alignment_name',
                    'level','nickname','cull_decision','cull_reason'])
        for r in c.execute("""SELECT uid_hex,pokemon_id,species_name,form,cp,
                                     iv_pct,iv_total,iv_atk,iv_def,iv_sta,
                                     is_shiny,is_lucky,is_traded,alignment_name,
                                     level,nickname,cull_decision,cull_reason
                              FROM pokemon
                              ORDER BY species_name, form, cull_decision, iv_pct DESC"""):
            w.writerow(r)
    print("  cull_plan.csv written")

    conn.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`pogo_extract/cull_engine_v2.py`:

```py
"""V2 cull engine using fresh proto data + all newly-discovered untouchable rules.

UNTOUCHABLES (any one => keep):
  Existing v1:
    - hundo / nundo
    - is_lucky
    - is_best_buddy (added_friendship_score >= 200000)
    - is_deployed (in_gym)
    - alignment != 0 (shadow OR purified)
    - is_powered_up
    - is_traded_flag_v2 / is_traded
    - is_mega_evolved (legacy flag)
    - special_bg_id, location_bg_id, adventure_effects_left (legacy fields)
    - costume_decoration_id
    - pokemon_size_category in (1, 5)  - XXS/XL/XXL
    - legendary/mythical/UB/paradox species
    - legacy moves
    - adventure_effect_species

  V2 NEW (from fresh proto poll):
    - fresh_bread_mode != 0       (DMAX/GMAX - 308 pokemon)
    - fresh_has_location_card = 1 (location bg + special bg - 104 pokemon)
    - fresh_costume != 0          (PokemonDisplayProto.Costume - 161 pokemon)
    - fresh_is_strong = 1         (IsStrongPokemon)
    - fresh_pokemon_badge != 0    (Adventure Effect badge - 17 pokemon)
    - fresh_current_temp_evolution != 0 (currently mega-evolved - 156)
    - fresh_has_mega_level = 1    (has MegaEvolutionLevel sub-message - 156)
    - fresh_tag_count > 0 AND fresh_tag_ids has non-CLAUDE_TX tag (user-tagged)

CAPS:
  - top 10 shinies/species (by IV%)
  - top 2 shadows/species (subsumed by alignment-untouchable)

UNIVERSAL:
  - top 3 per (species, form, costume) bucket by IV%
"""
import sqlite3, csv
from references import (
    LEGENDARY_IDS, MYTHICAL_IDS, ULTRA_BEAST_IDS, PARADOX_IDS,
    ADVENTURE_EFFECT_IDS, has_legacy_move,
)

DB = 'pokemon.db'
CLAUDE_TX = '15974071496501899036'

def untouchable_reasons(p):
    rs = []
    # Existing v1 rules
    if p['is_hundo']:                            rs.append("hundo")
    if p['is_zero']:                             rs.append("nundo")
    if p['is_lucky']:                            rs.append("lucky")
    if p['is_best_buddy']:                       rs.append("best_buddy")
    if p['is_deployed']:                         rs.append("deployed_in_gym")
    if (p['alignment'] or 0) != 0:               rs.append(f"alignment_{p['alignment_name'] or p['alignment']}")
    if (p['is_powered_up'] or 0) == 1:           rs.append("powered_up")
    if (p['is_traded_flag_v2'] or 0) == 1 or (p['is_traded'] or 0) == 1:
        rs.append("traded")
    if (p['is_mega_evolved'] or 0) == 1:         rs.append("mega_evolved_v1")
    if (p['special_bg_id'] or 0) > 0:            rs.append("postcard_special_bg")
    if (p['location_bg_id'] or 0) > 0:           rs.append("location_bg_v1")
    if (p['adventure_effects_left'] or 0) > 0:   rs.append("adventure_effects_left")
    if p['costume_decoration_id']:               rs.append(f"costume_dec_{p['costume_decoration_id']}")
    sc = p['pokemon_size_category'] or 0
    if sc == 1:                                  rs.append("size_XXS")
    elif sc == 5:                                rs.append("size_XL_or_XXL")

    # V2 NEW rules from fresh proto data
    if (p['fresh_bread_mode'] or 0) != 0:        rs.append(f"bread_mode_{p['fresh_bread_mode']}")
    if (p['fresh_has_location_card'] or 0) == 1: rs.append("location_card_v2")
    if (p['fresh_costume'] or 0) != 0:           rs.append(f"display_costume_{p['fresh_costume']}")
    if (p['fresh_is_strong'] or 0) == 1:         rs.append("is_strong_pokemon")
    if (p['fresh_pokemon_badge'] or 0) != 0:     rs.append(f"adventure_effect_{p['fresh_pokemon_badge']}")
    if (p['fresh_current_temp_evolution'] or 0) != 0: rs.append("currently_mega_evolved")
    if (p['fresh_has_mega_level'] or 0) == 1:    rs.append("has_mega_level")
    # Bucket: alignment from fresh poll (matches user 63 purified, 219 shadow)
    fa = p['fresh_alignment'] or 0
    if fa == 1: rs.append("fresh_shadow")
    elif fa == 2: rs.append("fresh_purified")

    # User-tagged (any tag besides CLAUDE_TX)
    tids = p['fresh_tag_ids'] or ''
    other_tags = [t for t in tids.split(';') if t and t != CLAUDE_TX]
    if other_tags:
        rs.append(f"user_tagged_{len(other_tags)}")

    # Species-based
    pid = p['pokemon_id']
    if pid in LEGENDARY_IDS:                     rs.append("legendary")
    if pid in MYTHICAL_IDS:                      rs.append("mythical")
    if pid in ULTRA_BEAST_IDS:                   rs.append("ultra_beast")
    if pid in PARADOX_IDS:                       rs.append("paradox")
    if pid in ADVENTURE_EFFECT_IDS:              rs.append("adventure_effect_species")
    if has_legacy_move(pid, [p['move1'], p['move2'], p['move3']]):
        rs.append("legacy_move")
    return rs

def main():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    c = conn.cursor()

    # Add v2 columns if missing
    cols = {r[1] for r in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(pokemon)").fetchall()}

        c.execute("ALTER TABLE pokemon ADD COLUMN cull_reason_v2 TEXT")
    conn.commit()

    rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT * FROM pokemon").fetchall()]
    print(f"Loaded {len(rows)} pokemon")

    keep_reasons = {}
    def add_reason(uid, reason):
        keep_reasons.setdefault(uid, []).append(reason)

    for p in rows:
        for r in untouchable_reasons(p):
            add_reason(p['uid_hex'], r)

    # Top 10 shinies/species
    by_species_shiny = {}
    for p in rows:
        if p['is_shiny']:
            by_species_shiny.setdefault(p['pokemon_id'], []).append(p)
    for pid, lst in by_species_shiny.items():
        lst.sort(key=lambda x: (-(x['iv_total'] or 0), -(x['cp'] or 0)))
        for i, p in enumerate(lst[:10]):
            add_reason(p['uid_hex'], f"shiny_top10_rank{i+1}")

    # Top 3 per (species, form, fresh_costume) by IV
    by_bucket = {}
    for p in rows:
        key = (p['pokemon_id'], p['form'] or 0, p['fresh_costume'] or 0)
        by_bucket.setdefault(key, []).append(p)
    for key, lst in by_bucket.items():
        lst.sort(key=lambda x: (-(x['iv_total'] or 0), -(x['cp'] or 0)))
        for i, p in enumerate(lst[:3]):
            add_reason(p['uid_hex'], f"top3_bucket_rank{i+1}")

    # Compose decisions
    keep_count = 0
    xfer_count = 0
    print("\nWriting decisions back to DB...")
    for p in rows:

        reasons = keep_reasons.get(uid, [])
        if reasons:
            decision = "KEEP"
            reason_str = ";".join(reasons[:8])
            keep_count += 1
        else:
            decision = "TRANSFER"
            reason_str = "no_keep_rule_matched"
            xfer_count += 1
        c.execute("UPDATE pokemon SET cull_decision_v2=?, cull_reason_v2=? WHERE uid_hex=?",
                  (decision, reason_str, uid))
    conn.commit()

    print(f"\n=== V2 FINAL ===")
    print(f"  Total: {len(rows)}")
    print(f"  KEEP:     {keep_count} ({keep_count/len(rows)*100:.1f}%)")
    print(f"  TRANSFER: {xfer_count} ({xfer_count/len(rows)*100:.1f}%)")

    print(f"\n=== Top species by transfer count ===")
    for row in c.execute("""SELECT species_name, COUNT(*) as n FROM pokemon
                            WHERE cull_decision_v2='TRANSFER' GROUP BY species_name
                            ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 25""").fetchall():
        print(f"  {row[0]:25s} {row[1]}")

    print(f"\n=== Top INDIVIDUAL keep reasons ===")
    reason_counts = {}
    for r in c.execute("SELECT cull_reason_v2 FROM pokemon WHERE cull_decision_v2='KEEP'").fetchall():
        for tok in r[0].split(";"):
            reason_counts[tok] = reason_counts.get(tok, 0) + 1
    for tok, n in sorted(reason_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:30]:
        print(f"  {n:5d}  {tok}")

    print("\nExporting cull_plan_v2.csv...")
    with open('cull_plan_v2.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:

        w.writerow(['uid_hex','pokemon_id','species_name','form','fresh_costume','cp',
                    'iv_pct','iv_total','iv_atk','iv_def','iv_sta',
                    'is_shiny','is_lucky','is_traded','alignment_name',

    print(f"  In V1.transfer but V2.keep: {n_v1_only}  (V2 saved them)")

    conn.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
```

`pogo_extract/cull_engine_v3.py`:

```py
"""V3 cull engine: v2 rules + revised XXL rule + dropped XXS/XL/user-tag protection.

Changes from v2:
  - XXL rule: per (species, form, costume) bucket, keep top 3 heaviest XXL pokemon.
    XXL pokemon outside top 3 weight are NOT protected by size.
  - XXS no longer untouchable (dropped).
  - XL no longer untouchable (dropped).
  - User-tag protection dropped entirely (most user tags deleted; rely on hard fields).

Untouchables (any one => keep):
  - Hundo / Nundo / Lucky / Best Buddy
  - Shadow / Purified / Powered up (numUpgrades > 0) / Traded
  - Mega-evolved (current_temp_evolution OR has_mega_level)
  - DMAX/GMAX (bread_mode != 0)
  - LocationCard (has_location_card=1)
  - Costume (display_costume != 0)
  - Adventure Effect (PokemonBadge != 0)
  - IsStrongPokemon
  - XXL top 3 heaviest in bucket
  - Legendary / Mythical / UB / Paradox / Adventure-Effect species
  - Legacy moves

Caps/universals:
  - Top 10 shinies/species (by IV)
  - Top 3 per (species, form, costume) bucket by IV
"""
import sqlite3, csv
from references import (
    LEGENDARY_IDS, MYTHICAL_IDS, ULTRA_BEAST_IDS, PARADOX_IDS,
    ADVENTURE_EFFECT_IDS, has_legacy_move,
)

DB = 'pokemon.db'

def untouchable_reasons(p, xxl_top3_uids):
    rs = []
    if p['is_hundo']:                            rs.append("hundo")
    if p['is_zero']:                             rs.append("nundo")
    if p['is_lucky']:                            rs.append("lucky")
    if p['is_best_buddy']:                       rs.append("best_buddy")
    if p['is_deployed']:                         rs.append("deployed_in_gym")
    if (p['fresh_alignment'] or 0) == 1:         rs.append("shadow")
    elif (p['fresh_alignment'] or 0) == 2:       rs.append("purified")
    if (p['is_traded_flag_v2'] or 0) == 1:       rs.append("traded")
    # User tags from authoritative binding service (excludes CLAUDE_TX)
    auth = p['auth_tag_names'] or ''
    user_tags = [t for t in auth.split(';') if t and t != 'CLAUDE_TX']
    if user_tags:                                rs.append(f"user_tag_{user_tags[0]}")

    if (p['fresh_bread_mode'] or 0) != 0:        rs.append(f"bread_{p['fresh_bread_mode']}")
    if (p['fresh_has_location_card'] or 0) == 1: rs.append("location_card")
    if (p['fresh_costume'] or 0) != 0:           rs.append(f"display_costume_{p['fresh_costume']}")
    if (p['fresh_is_strong'] or 0) == 1:         rs.append("is_strong")
    if (p['fresh_pokemon_badge'] or 0) != 0:     rs.append("adventure_effect")
    if (p['fresh_current_temp_evolution'] or 0) != 0: rs.append("current_mega_evolved")
    if (p['fresh_has_mega_level'] or 0) == 1:    rs.append("has_mega_level")

    # XXL top 3 heaviest in bucket
    if p['uid_hex'] in xxl_top3_uids:            rs.append("xxl_top3_heaviest")

    pid = p['pokemon_id']
    if pid in LEGENDARY_IDS:                     rs.append("legendary")
    if pid in MYTHICAL_IDS:                      rs.append("mythical")
    if pid in ULTRA_BEAST_IDS:                   rs.append("ultra_beast")
    if pid in PARADOX_IDS:                       rs.append("paradox")
    if pid in ADVENTURE_EFFECT_IDS:              rs.append("adventure_effect_species")
    if has_legacy_move(pid, [p['move1'], p['move2'], p['move3']]):
        rs.append("legacy_move")

    return rs

def main():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    c = conn.cursor()

    cols = {r[1] for r in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(pokemon)").fetchall()}
    if 'cull_decision_v3' not in cols:
        c.execute("ALTER TABLE pokemon ADD COLUMN cull_decision_v3 TEXT")
    if 'cull_reason_v3' not in cols:
        c.execute("ALTER TABLE pokemon ADD COLUMN cull_reason_v3 TEXT")
    conn.commit()

    rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT * FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1").fetchall()]
    print(f"Loaded {len(rows)} pokemon (in_bag=1)")

    # Build XXL top-3-heaviest set per (species, form, costume)
    xxl_groups = {}
    for p in rows:
        if (p['pokemon_size_category'] or 0) == 5:
            key = (p['pokemon_id'], p['form'] or 0, p['fresh_costume'] or 0)
            xxl_groups.setdefault(key, []).append(p)
    xxl_top3_uids = set()
    for key, lst in xxl_groups.items():
        lst.sort(key=lambda x: -(x['weight_kg'] or 0))
        for p in lst[:3]:
            xxl_top3_uids.add(p['uid_hex'])
    print(f"XXL pokemon: {sum(len(v) for v in xxl_groups.values())} in {len(xxl_groups)} species buckets")
    print(f"  XXL top-3-heaviest protected: {len(xxl_top3_uids)}")

    keep_reasons = {}
    def add_reason(uid, reason):
        keep_reasons.setdefault(uid, []).append(reason)

    for p in rows:
        for r in untouchable_reasons(p, xxl_top3_uids):
            add_reason(p['uid_hex'], r)

    # Top 10 shinies/species (by IV)
    by_species_shiny = {}
    for p in rows:
        if p['fresh_shiny']:
            by_species_shiny.setdefault(p['pokemon_id'], []).append(p)
    for pid, lst in by_species_shiny.items():
        lst.sort(key=lambda x: (-(x['iv_total'] or 0), -(x['cp'] or 0)))
        for i, p in enumerate(lst[:10]):
            add_reason(p['uid_hex'], f"shiny_top10_rank{i+1}")

    # Top 3 per (species, form, costume) by IV
    by_bucket = {}
    for p in rows:
        key = (p['pokemon_id'], p['form'] or 0, p['fresh_costume'] or 0)
        by_bucket.setdefault(key, []).append(p)
    for key, lst in by_bucket.items():
        lst.sort(key=lambda x: (-(x['iv_total'] or 0), -(x['cp'] or 0)))
        for i, p in enumerate(lst[:3]):
            add_reason(p['uid_hex'], f"top3_iv_rank{i+1}")

    keep_count = 0; xfer_count = 0
    for p in rows:
        uid = p['uid_hex']
        reasons = keep_reasons.get(uid, [])
        if reasons:
            decision = "KEEP"
            reason_str = ";".join(reasons[:8])
            keep_count += 1
        else:
            decision = "TRANSFER"
            reason_str = "no_keep_rule"
            xfer_count += 1
        c.execute("UPDATE pokemon SET cull_decision_v3=?, cull_reason_v3=? WHERE uid_hex=?",
                  (decision, reason_str, uid))
    conn.commit()

    print(f"\n=== V3 ({len(rows)} pokemon in bag) ===")
    print(f"  KEEP:     {keep_count} ({keep_count/len(rows)*100:.1f}%)")
    print(f"  TRANSFER: {xfer_count} ({xfer_count/len(rows)*100:.1f}%)")

    print(f"\n=== Top transfer species ===")
    for row in c.execute("""SELECT species_name, COUNT(*) as n FROM pokemon
                            WHERE cull_decision_v3='TRANSFER' AND in_bag=1
                            GROUP BY species_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 25"""):
        print(f"  {row[0]:25s} {row[1]}")

    print(f"\n=== Top keep reasons ===")
    reason_counts = {}
    for r in c.execute("SELECT cull_reason_v3 FROM pokemon WHERE cull_decision_v3='KEEP' AND in_bag=1").fetchall():
        for tok in r[0].split(";"):
            reason_counts[tok] = reason_counts.get(tok, 0) + 1
    for tok, n in sorted(reason_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:25]:
        print(f"  {n:5d}  {tok}")

    print("\nExporting cull_plan_v3.csv...")
    with open('cull_plan_v3.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(['uid_hex','pokemon_id','species_name','form','fresh_costume','cp',
                    'iv_pct','iv_total','iv_atk','iv_def','iv_sta','weight_kg',
                    'pokemon_size_category','is_shiny','is_lucky','is_traded',
                    'level','nickname','cull_decision_v3','cull_reason_v3'])
        for r in c.execute("""SELECT uid_hex,pokemon_id,species_name,form,fresh_costume,cp,
                                     iv_pct,iv_total,iv_atk,iv_def,iv_sta,weight_kg,
                                     pokemon_size_category,is_shiny,is_lucky,is_traded,
                                     level,nickname,cull_decision_v3,cull_reason_v3
                              FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1
                              ORDER BY species_name, form, fresh_costume, cull_decision_v3, iv_pct DESC"""):
            w.writerow(r)
    print("  cull_plan_v3.csv written")

    conn.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`pogo_extract/cull_report.py`:

```py
"""THE CULL REPORT, written by the cull itself (user 2026-09-24: "Why does it take you so long to make the report? it

Compares this walk with the walk of the LAST REPORT (system/analysis/last_report.json: its snapshot stamp, pile,
keep reasons and evolve targets), so "just caught / just evolved" means "since you last read a report" even when a
pass in between was cut off. Everything comes from files the pass already wrote: pokemon.db, policy_reasons.json,
tagsets/Transfer.txt, .db_snapshots/*.before_sync.*.gz, evolve_targets -- and, for the closing Power Up block (2026-09-30, report only), the
Power Up tag files, the game master's Power Up tables and this walk's candy.json / inventory.json.

  python cull_report.py            # print the report and remember this walk as the last reported one
  python cull_report.py --dry-run  # print it, remember nothing

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

# THE GAME'S OWN NAMES (2026-09-30, docs/memory/pogo-bag-pulse-sprites.md): DISPLAY ONLY. species_name, form ids and pvids stay the
# walk's own strings; only the words a person reads change ('Nidoran F' -> 'Nidoran♀', 'Mr Mime' -> 'Mr. Mime', 'Ho Oh' -> 'Ho-Oh').
# Every failure (no pogo_display, no names file, an id it cannot vouch for) prints what this report printed before.
```
