`pogo_extract/dump_bytes.py`:

```py
"""Dump raw bytes for several pokemon at all 8-byte aligned offsets to identify pointers vs data."""
import json, struct
from collections import defaultdict, Counter

data = json.load(open('pokemon_v3.json'))

# Pick samples: traded, mega-eligible, costume, lucky, normal, hatched
samples = []
def get_str(p, off):
    s = (p.get('strings') or {}).get(off)
    return s[1] if isinstance(s, list) else None

for p in data:
    if get_str(p, '0x100'):  # traded
        samples.append(('traded', p)); break
for p in data:
    if get_str(p, '0x40'):  # deployed
        samples.append(('deployed', p)); break
for p in data:
    if get_str(p, '0x130'):  # has season form string
        samples.append(('seasonform', p)); break
for p in data:
    raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
    if len(raw) >= 600:
        bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
        if struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, 280)[0] != 0:
            samples.append(('off280', p)); break
# Mega - look for hasMegaEvolved candidate
for p in data:
    raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
    if len(raw) >= 600:
        bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
        if bs[336] == 1:
            samples.append(('off336', p)); break
# Lucky
for p in data:
    raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
    if len(raw) >= 600:
        bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
        if bs[272] == 1:
            samples.append(('lucky', p)); break

# Normal hundo candidate
for p in data:
    raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
    if len(raw) >= 600:
        bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
        ivA = struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, 112)[0]
        ivD = struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, 116)[0]
        ivS = struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, 120)[0]
        if ivA == 15 and ivD == 15 and ivS == 15:
            samples.append(('hundo', p)); break

print("\n\n=== POKEMON HEX DUMPS ===")
for label, p in samples:
    raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
    if len(raw) < 600: continue
    bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
    print(f"\n--- {label} (id={p['pokemonId']}, addr={p.get('addr')}) ---")
    print(f"strings: {p.get('strings')}")
    for i in range(0, 512, 16):
        chunk = bs[i:i+16]
        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in chunk)
        ascii_str = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 <= b < 127 else '.' for b in chunk)
        # Decode as i32x4 and f32x4
        i32s = struct.unpack_from('<iiii', bs, i)
        f32s = struct.unpack_from('<ffff', bs, i)
        # Format
        f_str = ' '.join(f'{f:.3f}' if abs(f) < 1e6 and abs(f) > 0.001 else '   .   ' for f in f32s)
        print(f'+{i:03d}/0x{i:03x}: {hex_str}  {ascii_str}  ints={i32s}')

# Now - aggregate "bytes that look like pointer high words" to identify pointer fields
# In ARM64 mono heap, pointers are typically 0x70-0x90 range upper bytes
print("\n\n=== POINTER FIELD DETECTION ===")
print("Offsets where bytes 6,7 are commonly 0x7b or 0x80 (heap pointer):")
ptr_offsets = []
for off in range(0, 504, 8):
    cnt_ptrs = 0
    for p in data:
        raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
        if len(raw) < 1024: continue
        bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
        if off+8 > len(bs): continue
        # Check upper 16 bits (bytes 6-7 LE)
        b6 = bs[off+6]
        b7 = bs[off+7]
        # Real pointer: high bits are 0x00007a or similar
        if b7 == 0 and b6 in (0x7a, 0x7b, 0x7c, 0x7d, 0x7e, 0x7f, 0x80, 0x81, 0x82, 0x83):
            cnt_ptrs += 1
    if cnt_ptrs > 5:
        ptr_offsets.append((off, cnt_ptrs))
        print(f"  +{off:3d} (0x{off:03x}): {cnt_ptrs} pokemon have heap pointer")

print("\n\n=== STRING POINTERS ALREADY KNOWN ===")
# String offsets per the data: 0x40, 0xb8, 0x100, 0x130
# Convert to decimal
print(f"  0x40  = 64  (deployed fort)")
print(f"  0xb8  = 184 (nickname)")
print(f"  0x100 = 256 (original_owner)")
print(f"  0x130 = 304 (season form string)")

```

`pogo_extract/dump_costume_enum.py`:

```py
"""Dump the PoGo Costume enum (PokemonDisplayProto.Costume / HoloPokemonCostume) to
costume_enum.json as {id: name} -- the field-costume id->name map the platform lacks.

Mirrors dump_form_enum.py's IL2CPP literal-field walk, but instead of guessing the class
name it SCANS every class for one named *costume* and picks the richest enum. Falls back to
il2cpp_class_from_name candidates if image class-enumeration isn't exported on this build.
"""
import frida, json, subprocess

adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb', 'shell', 'pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
d = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
sess = d.attach(adb_pid)

js = r"""
rpc.exports = {
  dump: function() {
    var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
    var addrs = {};
    il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) addrs[e.name]=e.address; });
    function B(n,r,a){ if(!addrs[n]) return null; try{ return new NativeFunction(addrs[n],r,a); }catch(e){ return null; } }
    var dG=B('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
    var dGA=B('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
    var aGI=B('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
    var iGN=B('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
    var iGCC=B('il2cpp_image_get_class_count','uint32',['pointer']);
    var iGC=B('il2cpp_image_get_class','pointer',['pointer','uint32']);
    var cFN=B('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
    var cGN=B('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
    var cGNS=B('il2cpp_class_get_namespace','pointer',['pointer']);
    var cGF=B('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
    var fGN=B('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
    var fGF=B('il2cpp_field_get_flags','int',['pointer']);
    var fGSV=B('il2cpp_field_static_get_value','void',['pointer','pointer']);
    var tA=B('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']);
    if(tA) tA(dG());

    function dumpEnum(cls){
      var iter=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
      var f, res={};
      while((f=cGF(cls,iter)) && !f.isNull()){
        var flags=fGF(f);
        if((flags&0x10)===0) continue;   // STATIC
        if((flags&0x40)===0) continue;   // LITERAL (enum member)
        var vb=Memory.alloc(8); vb.writeS64(0);
        try{ fGSV(f,vb); res[vb.readS32()]=fGN(f).readCString(); }catch(e){}
      }
      return res;
    }

    var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var asms=dGA(dG(),sp); var na=sp.readS32();
    var imgs=[];
    for(var ai=0; ai<na; ai++) imgs.push(aGI(asms.add(ai*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()));

    var found={};
    // primary: scan every class for a name containing "costume"
    if(iGCC && iGC){
      for(var i=0;i<imgs.length;i++){
        var cc=iGCC(imgs[i]);
        for(var ci=0; ci<cc; ci++){
          var cls=iGC(imgs[i],ci);
          if(!cls||cls.isNull()) continue;
          var nm; try{ nm=cGN(cls).readCString(); }catch(e){ continue; }
          if(!nm || nm.toLowerCase().indexOf('costume')<0) continue;
          var en=dumpEnum(cls);
          if(Object.keys(en).length>3){
            var ns=''; try{ ns=cGNS(cls).readCString()||''; }catch(e){}
            found[(ns?ns+'.':'')+nm]={count:Object.keys(en).length, enum:en};
          }
        }
      }
    }
    // fallback: named candidates
    if(Object.keys(found).length===0 && cFN){
      var cand=[['','PokemonCostume'],['Holoholo.Rpc','HoloPokemonCostume'],['','HoloPokemonCostume'],
                ['','Costume'],['','PokemonDisplayProto/Costume'],['Holoholo.Rpc','PokemonDisplayProto/Costume']];
      for(var ii=0; ii<imgs.length; ii++){
        for(var k=0;k<cand.length;k++){
          var cls2=cFN(imgs[ii], Memory.allocUtf8String(cand[k][0]), Memory.allocUtf8String(cand[k][1]));
          if(!cls2||cls2.isNull()) continue;
          var en2=dumpEnum(cls2);
          if(Object.keys(en2).length>3) found[cand[k][1]]={count:Object.keys(en2).length, enum:en2};
        }
      }
    }
    return found;
  }
};
"""

script = sess.create_script(js)
script.load()
r = script.exports_sync.dump()
sess.detach()

print('costume-named enum classes found:', {k: v['count'] for k, v in r.items()})
if not r:
    print('NONE FOUND -- costume enum class not located'); raise SystemExit(1)
best = max(r.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]['count'])
enum = {str(k): v for k, v in best[1]['enum'].items()}
print('USING: %s  (%d members)' % (best[0], best[1]['count']))
json.dump(enum, open('costume_enum.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
print('--- sample (first 30 by id) ---')
for v, name in sorted(enum.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0]))[:30]:
    print('  %4s  %s' % (v, name))
print('wrote costume_enum.json (%d entries)' % len(enum))

```

`pogo_extract/dump_form_enum.py`:

```py
"""Dump HoloPokemonForm enum to JSON for form-id -> name mapping."""
import frida, json, subprocess
adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
d = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
sess = d.attach(adb_pid)

js = """
rpc.exports = {
    dump: function() {
        var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
        var addrs = {};
        il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) addrs[e.name] = e.address; });
        function safeBind(n,r,a){ if (!addrs[n]) return null; try { return new NativeFunction(addrs[n],r,a); } catch(e) { return null; } }
        var dG = safeBind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
        var dGA = safeBind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var aGI = safeBind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGN = safeBind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cFN = safeBind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
        var cGF = safeBind('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var fGN = safeBind('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var fGF = safeBind('il2cpp_field_get_flags','int',['pointer']);
        var fGSV = safeBind('il2cpp_field_static_get_value','void',['pointer','pointer']);
        var fGOFF = safeBind('il2cpp_field_get_offset','uint32',['pointer']);
        var tA = safeBind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']);
        if (tA) tA(dG());
        var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = dGA(dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();
        var imgList = [];
        for (var ai = 0; ai < na; ai++) {
            var img = aGI(asms.add(ai*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
            imgList.push({name: iGN(img).readCString(), ptr: img});
        }
        var candidates = [
            ['','PokemonForm'],
            ['','Form'],
            ['Holoholo.Rpc','HoloPokemonForm'],
            ['Holoholo.Rpc','PokemonForm'],
            ['','HoloPokemonForm'],
        ];
        for (var ii = 0; ii < imgList.length; ii++) {
            for (var ci = 0; ci < candidates.length; ci++) {
                var ns = candidates[ci][0]; var nm = candidates[ci][1];
                var nsArg = (ns === '') ? Memory.allocUtf8String('') : Memory.allocUtf8String(ns);
                var cls = cFN(imgList[ii].ptr, nsArg, Memory.allocUtf8String(nm));
                if (!cls || cls.isNull()) continue;
                var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
                var f, results = {};
                while ((f = cGF(cls, iter)) && !f.isNull()) {
                    var fName = fGN(f).readCString();
                    var flags = fGF(f);
                    if ((flags & 0x10) === 0) continue;
                    if ((flags & 0x40) === 0) continue;
                    var vbuf = Memory.alloc(8); vbuf.writeS64(0);
                    try { fGSV(f, vbuf); var v = vbuf.readS32(); results[v] = fName; } catch(e) {}
                }
                if (Object.keys(results).length > 0)
                    return {found: imgList[ii].name + '/' + ns + '/' + nm, count: Object.keys(results).length, enum: results};
            }
        }
        return {error:'not found', images: imgList.map(function(x){return x.name;})};
    }
};
"""
script = sess.create_script(js)
script.load()
r = script.exports_sync.dump()
if 'error' in r:
    print(r); sess.detach(); exit(1)
print(f"Found: {r.get('found')}, count: {r.get('count')}")
with open('form_enum.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(r['enum'], f, indent=2)
for v, name in sorted(r['enum'].items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])):
    n = name.upper()
    if any(x in n for x in ('VIVILLON','SCATTERBUG','SPEWPA','TANDEMAUS','MAUSHOLD','ROCKRUFF','LYCANROC')):
        print(f'  {v}: {name}')
sess.detach()
```

`pogo_extract/dump_friend_class_layout.py`:

```py
"""Dump fields/methods for FriendshipDataProto and BackgroundFriendDetailsCachingService."""
import frida, json, subprocess
adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','-s','100.98.158.56:5555','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
d = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
sess = d.attach(adb_pid)

js = """
rpc.exports = {
    dumpClass: function(image, ns, name) {
        var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
        var addrs = {};
        il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) addrs[e.name] = e.address; });
        function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(addrs[n],r,a); }
        var dG = bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
        var dGA = bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var aGI = bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGN = bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGCC = bind('il2cpp_image_get_class_count','int',['pointer']);
        var iGC = bind('il2cpp_image_get_class','pointer',['pointer','int']);
        var cGN = bind('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cGNS = bind('il2cpp_class_get_namespace','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cGF = bind('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var fGN = bind('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var fGOFF = bind('il2cpp_field_get_offset','uint32',['pointer']);
        var fGT = bind('il2cpp_field_get_type','pointer',['pointer']);
        var tGN = bind('il2cpp_type_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cGM = bind('il2cpp_class_get_methods','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var mGN = bind('il2cpp_method_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var mGPC = bind('il2cpp_method_get_param_count','int',['pointer']);
        var tA = bind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']);
        tA(dG());
        var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = dGA(dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();
        for (var ai = 0; ai < na; ai++) {
            var img = aGI(asms.add(ai*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
            if (iGN(img).readCString() !== image) continue;
            var cc = iGCC(img);
            for (var ci = 0; ci < cc; ci++) {
                var cls = iGC(img, ci);
                if (!cls || cls.isNull()) continue;
                if (cGN(cls).readCString() !== name) continue;
                if (ns && cGNS(cls).readCString() !== ns) continue;
                var fields = []; var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
                var f;
                while ((f = cGF(cls, iter)) && !f.isNull()) {
                    var tname = '?';
                    try { tname = tGN(fGT(f)).readCString(); } catch(e) {}
                    fields.push({name: fGN(f).readCString(), offset: fGOFF(f), type: tname});
                }
                var methods = []; var miter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); miter.writePointer(ptr(0));
                var m;
                while ((m = cGM(cls, miter)) && !m.isNull()) {
                    methods.push({name: mGN(m).readCString(), params: mGPC(m)});
                }
                return {found: true, fields: fields, methods: methods};
            }
        }
        return {found: false};
    }
};
"""
script = sess.create_script(js)
script.load()
for img, ns, nm in [
    ('holo-protos.dll','Holoholo.Rpc','CompleteQuestProto'),
    ('holo-protos.dll','Holoholo.Rpc','CompleteQuestOutProto'),
    ('holo-protos.dll','Holoholo.Rpc','RemoveQuestProto'),
]:
    print(f"\n=== {ns}.{nm} ({img}) ===")
    r = script.exports_sync.dump_class(img, ns, nm)
    if r['found']:
        print(' Fields:')
        for f in r['fields'][:30]:
            print(f"   +0x{f['offset']:03x}  {f['type']:50s} {f['name']}")
        print(' Methods:')
        for m in r['methods'][:30]:
            print(f"   {m['name']}({m['params']})")
    else:
        print('  NOT FOUND')
```

`pogo_extract/dump_hit3.py`:

```py
import frida, subprocess
adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
d = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
sess = d.attach(adb_pid)
js = """
rpc.exports = {
    big: function(addr, before, after) {
        var p = ptr(addr);
        try {
            var bytes = p.sub(before).readByteArray(before + after);
            var u8 = new Uint8Array(bytes);
            var lines = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < u8.length; i += 16) {
                var hex = '';
                var ascii = '';
                for (var j = 0; j < 16 && i+j < u8.length; j++) {
                    hex += ('0' + u8[i+j].toString(16)).slice(-2) + ' ';
                    ascii += (u8[i+j] >= 32 && u8[i+j] < 127) ? String.fromCharCode(u8[i+j]) : '.';
                }
                var off = (i - before).toString();
                lines.push('+' + off.padStart(5) + '  ' + hex.padEnd(48) + '  ' + ascii);
            }
            return lines.join('\\n');
        } catch(e) { return 'err: ' + e.message; }
    }
};
"""
script = sess.create_script(js)
script.load()
# Hit 3 - the third UID match for Machamp
import sys
addr = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '0x7252a3d318'
print(f'=== {addr} (-64, +256) ===')
print(script.exports_sync.big(addr, 64, 256))
sess.detach()
```

`pogo_extract/dump_il2cpp_meta.py`:

```py
"""Dump the LIVE game's complete il2cpp metadata: every class, method and field offset.

WHY. Every hook we write has to name a class and a method that actually exist in the build the
user is running. Our previous feature specs came from a 3-month-old copy of somebody else's
agent, and a hook aimed at a renamed or removed method is exactly how this project has frozen
the game before. This dump is ground truth for the CURRENT binary, so ports can be verified
against it instead of trusted.

SAFETY. This walks METADATA only (class/method/field descriptors). It never dereferences a
managed object, so the moving collector is not a concern. It attaches its own il2cpp thread,
which the runtime requires before any il2cpp_* call from a foreign thread.

Output: system/analysis/clone/il2cpp_meta.jsonl.gz  (one JSON object per class)
"""
import frida
import gzip
import json
import os
import sys
import threading

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT = os.path.join(HERE, "system", "analysis", "clone", "il2cpp_meta.jsonl.gz")
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)

JS = r"""
const EXPORTS = [
  'il2cpp_domain_get','il2cpp_thread_attach','il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies',
  'il2cpp_assembly_get_image','il2cpp_image_get_class_count','il2cpp_image_get_class',
  'il2cpp_image_get_name','il2cpp_class_get_name','il2cpp_class_get_namespace',
  'il2cpp_class_get_methods','il2cpp_method_get_name','il2cpp_method_get_param_count',
  'il2cpp_class_get_fields','il2cpp_field_get_name','il2cpp_field_get_offset',
  'il2cpp_class_get_parent','il2cpp_class_get_nested_types'
];
function resolve() {
  // Frida 17 removed Module.findExportByName, so go through the module object.
  const m = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
  if (m === null) throw new Error('libil2cpp.so not loaded');
  const want = new Set(EXPORTS), out = {};
  for (const e of m.enumerateExports()) if (want.has(e.name)) out[e.name] = e.address;
  const missing = EXPORTS.filter(n => !(n in out));
  if (missing.length) throw new Error('missing exports: ' + missing.join(','));
  return out;
}
const A = resolve();
const fn = (n, ret, args) => new NativeFunction(A[n], ret, args);
const domain_get        = fn('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
const thread_attach     = fn('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']);
const get_assemblies    = fn('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
const assembly_image    = fn('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
const image_class_count = fn('il2cpp_image_get_class_count','int',['pointer']);
const image_get_class   = fn('il2cpp_image_get_class','pointer',['pointer','int']);
const image_get_name    = fn('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
const class_name        = fn('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
const class_ns          = fn('il2cpp_class_get_namespace','pointer',['pointer']);
const class_methods     = fn('il2cpp_class_get_methods','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
const method_name       = fn('il2cpp_method_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
const method_pcount     = fn('il2cpp_method_get_param_count','int',['pointer']);
const class_fields      = fn('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
const field_name        = fn('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
const field_offset      = fn('il2cpp_field_get_offset','int',['pointer']);
const class_parent      = fn('il2cpp_class_get_parent','pointer',['pointer']);
const class_nested      = fn('il2cpp_class_get_nested_types','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
const cstr = p => (p.isNull() ? null : p.readUtf8String());

function dumpAll() {
  const domain = domain_get();
  thread_attach(domain);                       // required before any il2cpp_* from a foreign thread
  const nptr = Memory.alloc(8);
  const asmv = get_assemblies(domain, nptr);
  const ncount = nptr.readUInt();
  send({t: 'begin', assemblies: ncount});
  let batch = [], total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < ncount; i++) {
    const asm = asmv.add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
    if (asm.isNull()) continue;
    const img = assembly_image(asm);
    if (img.isNull()) continue;
    const imgName = cstr(image_get_name(img));
    const cc = image_class_count(img);
    /* il2cpp_image_get_class only yields TOP-LEVEL types. Nested ones (Button/ButtonClickedEvent,
       TextInputDialog/Data, Toggle/ToggleEvent -- every event and factory type the menu code
       touches) were absent from every dump before 2026-09-06, so a hook table naming one could not
       be checked against this oracle at all. Recurse into il2cpp_class_get_nested_types and record
       them as "Outer/Nested", which is exactly how Pokemod's own code spells them. */
    const emit = (k, namePrefix, depth) => {
      const rec = {img: imgName, ns: null, n: null, p: null, m: [], f: []};
      let nested = [];
      try {
        rec.ns = cstr(class_ns(k));
        const own = cstr(class_name(k));
        rec.n = namePrefix ? (namePrefix + '/' + own) : own;
        const par = class_parent(k);
        if (!par.isNull()) rec.p = cstr(class_name(par));
        const it = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(NULL);
        for (;;) {
          const meth = class_methods(k, it);
          if (meth.isNull()) break;
          rec.m.push([cstr(method_name(meth)), method_pcount(meth), meth.toString()]);
        }
        const it2 = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it2.writePointer(NULL);
        for (;;) {
          const fld = class_fields(k, it2);
          if (fld.isNull()) break;
          rec.f.push([cstr(field_name(fld)), field_offset(fld)]);
        }
        if (depth < 3) {
          const it3 = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it3.writePointer(NULL);
          for (;;) {
            const nk = class_nested(k, it3);
            if (nk.isNull()) break;
            nested.push(nk);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) { rec.err = String(e); }
      batch.push(rec); total++;
      if (batch.length >= 400) { send({t: 'batch', d: batch}); batch = []; }
      for (let n = 0; n < nested.length; n++) {
        try { emit(nested[n], rec.n, depth + 1); } catch (e) { /* one bad nested type is not fatal */ }
      }
    };

    for (let c = 0; c < cc; c++) {
      let k;
      try { k = image_get_class(img, c); } catch (e) { continue; }
      if (k === null || k.isNull()) continue;
      emit(k, null, 0);
    }
  }
  if (batch.length) send({t: 'batch', d: batch});
  send({t: 'done', classes: total});
}
rpc.exports.go = function () {
  // House rule: never touch il2cpp from the RPC thread. Hand off and return immediately.
  setImmediate(() => {
    try { dumpAll(); } catch (e) { send({t: 'fatal', e: String(e), stack: String(e.stack)}); }
  });
  return 'started';
};
"""

done = threading.Event()
state = {"classes": 0, "batches": 0, "err": None}
gz = gzip.open(OUT, "wt", encoding="utf-8")


def on_message(msg, data):
    if msg.get("type") == "error":
        state["err"] = str(msg.get("description")) + "\n" + str(msg.get("stack"))
        done.set()
        return
    p = msg.get("payload") or {}
    t = p.get("t")
    if t == "begin":
        print("  assemblies: %d" % p["assemblies"], flush=True)
    elif t == "batch":
        try:
            for rec in (p.get("d") or []):
                gz.write(json.dumps(rec, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
                state["classes"] += 1
        except Exception as e:
            state["err"] = "batch decode: %s" % e
            done.set()
            return
        state["batches"] += 1
        if state["batches"] % 10 == 0:
            print("  %d classes..." % state["classes"], flush=True)
    elif t == "done":
        print("  DONE %d classes" % p["classes"], flush=True)
        done.set()
    elif t == "fatal":
        state["err"] = str(p.get("e")) + "\n" + str(p.get("stack"))
        done.set()


dev = frida.get_device_manager().add_remote_device("127.0.0.1:27047")
ses = dev.attach("Gadget")
scr = ses.create_script(JS)
scr.on("message", on_message)
scr.load()
print("script loaded; starting dump", flush=True)
print(" ", scr.exports_sync.go(), flush=True)
done.wait(timeout=2400)
gz.close()
if state["err"]:
    print("ERROR:", state["err"][:2000])
    sys.exit(1)
print("wrote %s  (%d bytes, %d classes)" % (OUT, os.path.getsize(OUT), state["classes"]))

```

```py
"""Dump PokemonForm enum from holo-protos.dll via class iteration."""
import frida, json, subprocess
adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()

js = """
rpc.exports = {
    dump: function() {
        var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
        var addrs = {};
        il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) addrs[e.name] = e.address; });
        function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(addrs[n],r,a); }
        var dG = bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
        var dGA = bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var aGI = bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGN = bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGCC = bind('il2cpp_image_get_class_count','int',['pointer']);
        var iGC = bind('il2cpp_image_get_class','pointer',['pointer','int']);
        var cGN = bind('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cGNS = bind('il2cpp_class_get_namespace','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cGF = bind('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var fGN = bind('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var fGF = bind('il2cpp_field_get_flags','int',['pointer']);
        var fGSV = bind('il2cpp_field_static_get_value','void',['pointer','pointer']);
        var tA = bind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']);
        tA(dG());

        var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = dGA(dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();
        for (var ai = 0; ai < na; ai++) {
            var img = aGI(asms.add(ai*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
            var imgName = iGN(img).readCString();
            if (imgName !== 'holo-protos.dll') continue;
            var cc = iGCC(img);
            for (var ci = 0; ci < cc; ci++) {
                var cls = iGC(img, ci);
                if (!cls || cls.isNull()) continue;
                var name = cGN(cls).readCString();
                if (name !== 'Form') continue;
                var ns = cGNS(cls).readCString();
                var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
                var f, results = {};
                while ((f = cGF(cls, iter)) && !f.isNull()) {
                    var fName = fGN(f).readCString();
                    var flags = fGF(f);
                    if ((flags & 0x10) === 0) continue;
                    if ((flags & 0x40) === 0) continue;
                    var vbuf = Memory.alloc(8); vbuf.writeS64(0);
                    try { fGSV(f, vbuf); var v = vbuf.readS32(); results[v] = fName; } catch(e) {}
                }
                return {ns: ns, count: Object.keys(results).length, enum: results};
            }
        }
        return {error:'PokemonForm class not found'};
    }
};
"""
script = sess.create_script(js)
script.load()

    print(r); sess.detach(); exit(1)

with open('form_enum.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(r['enum'], f, indent=2)
print(f"Saved to form_enum.json")

fams = ('VIVILLON','SCATTERBUG','SPEWPA','TANDEMAUS','MAUSHOLD','ROCKRUFF','LYCANROC')
for v, name in sorted(r['enum'].items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])):
    n = name.upper()
    if any(x in n for x in fams):
        print(f'  {v}: {name}')
```

`pogo_extract/dump_quest_layouts.py`:

```py
"""STEP 0 (run this FIRST, once): dump authoritative IL2CPP field layouts for every
quest-related proto class in holo-protos.dll + the QuestService / QuestRpcService /
I18n surfaces in holo-game.dll.

This is the FOUNDATION for dump_research_full.py. The string-only metadata blob is
obfuscated and deduplicated, so field ORDER (=> offsets) cannot be trusted from it.
This script reflects the live runtime (il2cpp_class_get_fields / _field_get_offset /
_type_get_name) and writes the real offsets.

READ-ONLY. Invokes no game logic, only reflection. Writes JSON + MD locally.

Usage:
    python dump_quest_layouts.py

Outputs (next to this file):
    quest_layouts.json   {fqcn: {namespace,name,instSize,fields:[{name,type,offset,is_static}]}}
    quest_layouts.md     human-readable, sorted by instSize desc

After running, open quest_layouts.md and copy the real offsets into the OFF_* dicts
at the top of dump_research_full.py (they are pre-filled with the best static guesses,
each flagged `# VALIDATE`).
"""
import json, os, time
import pogo_il2cpp as pg

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT_JSON = os.path.join(HERE, 'quest_layouts.json')
OUT_MD = os.path.join(HERE, 'quest_layouts.md')

# Substring match on class name. Broad on purpose.
PROTO_FILTERS = [
    'QuestProto', 'QuestsProto', 'ClientQuestProto', 'QuestGoalProto',
    'QuestRewardProto', 'QuestConditionProto', 'QuestDisplayProto',
    'MultiPartQuestProto', 'QuestEncounterProto', 'QuestPokemonEncounterProto',
    'QuestSettingsProto', 'QuestBranchRewardProto', 'QuestStampProto',
    'QuestStampCardProto', 'SubquestDisplay', 'QuestHeaderDisplay',
    'ItemRewardProto', 'PokemonEncounterRewardProto', 'PokemonCandyRewardProto',
    'StardustRewardProto', 'PokemonEggRewardProto', 'LootTableRewardProto',
    'MegaResourceProto', 'PokemonIndividualStatRewardProto',
    # concrete quest-by-type payloads (each carries its own goal/condition shape):
    'CatchPokemonQuestProto', 'SpinPokestopQuestProto', 'EvolveIntoPokemonQuestProto',
    'GetStardustQuestProto', 'BattleQuestProto', 'TakeSnapshotQuestProto',
    'TravelRouteQuestProto', 'AddFriendQuestProto', 'TradePokemonQuestProto',
    'DailyBuddyAffectionQuestProto', 'SubmitSleepRecordsQuestProto',
    'BuddyEvolutionWalkQuestProto', 'PokemonReachCpQuestProto', 'SpendStardustQuestProto',
    'DaysWithARowQuestProto', 'DailyQuestProto',
]

# holo-game.dll service classes to dump (ns, class)
GAME_CLASSES = [
    ('Niantic.Holoholo.Quests', 'QuestService'),
    ('Niantic.Holoholo.Internationalization', 'I18n'),
]

JS = r"""
rpc.exports.dumpProtoLayouts = function(nameFilters) {
    _ensureInit();
    var exp = {};
    Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so').enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){
        if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_') === 0) exp[e.name] = e.address;
    });
    function bind(n, ret, args) { return exp[n] ? new NativeFunction(exp[n], ret, args) : null; }
    var iGCC = bind('il2cpp_image_get_class_count', 'int', ['pointer']);
    var iGC  = bind('il2cpp_image_get_class', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'int']);
    var cN   = bind('il2cpp_class_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']);
    var cNS  = bind('il2cpp_class_get_namespace', 'pointer', ['pointer']);
    var cIS  = bind('il2cpp_class_instance_size', 'int', ['pointer']);
    var cGF  = bind('il2cpp_class_get_fields', 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']);
    var fGN  = bind('il2cpp_field_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']);
    var fGO  = bind('il2cpp_field_get_offset', 'int', ['pointer']);
    var fGT  = bind('il2cpp_field_get_type', 'pointer', ['pointer']);
    var tGN  = bind('il2cpp_type_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']);
    var tAttr= bind('il2cpp_type_get_attrs', 'int', ['pointer']);
    var freeFn = bind('il2cpp_free', 'void', ['pointer']);

    function dumpImageClasses(img, matchFn) {
        var n = iGCC(img); var out = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            var k = iGC(img, i); if (k.isNull()) continue;
            var nm = cN(k).readCString(); if (!nm) continue;
            if (!matchFn(nm)) continue;
            var nsPtr = cNS(k); var ns = nsPtr.isNull() ? '' : nsPtr.readCString();
            var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
            var fields = [], f;
            while ((f = cGF(k, iter)) && !f.isNull()) {
                var name = fGN(f).readCString();
                var off = fGO(f);
                var typ = fGT(f); var tnPtr = tGN(typ);
                var typeName = tnPtr.readCString();
                try { if (freeFn) freeFn(tnPtr); } catch(e) {}
                var isStatic = ((tAttr ? tAttr(typ) : 0) & 0x10) !== 0;
                fields.push({name: name, type: typeName, offset: off, is_static: isStatic});
            }
            var key = ns ? (ns + '.' + nm) : nm;
            out[key] = {namespace: ns, name: nm, instSize: cIS(k), fields: fields};
        }
        return out;
    }

    var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = IL2.dGA(IL2.dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();
    var protoImg = null, gameImg = null;
    for (var a = 0; a < na; a++) {
        var im = IL2.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
        var nm = IL2.iGN(im).readCString();
        if (nm === 'holo-protos.dll') protoImg = im;
        if (nm === 'holo-game.dll')   gameImg = im;
    }
    if (!protoImg) return {err: 'holo-protos.dll not found'};

    var result = dumpImageClasses(protoImg, function(nm){
        for (var fi = 0; fi < nameFilters.length; fi++)
            if (nm.indexOf(nameFilters[fi]) >= 0) return true;
        return false;
    });
    // also pull the two game-dll service classes (methods listed separately below)
    if (gameImg) {
        var svc = dumpImageClasses(gameImg, function(nm){
            return nm === 'QuestService' || nm === 'I18n';
        });
        for (var k in svc) result[k] = svc[k];
    }
    return result;
};

// Enumerate method names + param counts for a (ns, class) in holo-game.dll, so we
// can see the exact GetQuestDisplayProto / GetPokemonEncounterForQuest signatures.
rpc.exports.dumpMethods = function(ns, cls) {
    _ensureInit();
    var exp = {};
    Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so').enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){
        if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_') === 0) exp[e.name] = e.address;
    });
    function bind(n, ret, args) { return exp[n] ? new NativeFunction(exp[n], ret, args) : null; }
    var cGM = bind('il2cpp_class_get_methods', 'pointer', ['pointer','pointer']);
    var mGN = bind('il2cpp_method_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']);
    var mGPC= bind('il2cpp_method_get_param_count', 'uint32', ['pointer']);
    var mGRT= bind('il2cpp_method_get_return_type', 'pointer', ['pointer']);
    var mGP = bind('il2cpp_method_get_param', 'pointer', ['pointer','uint32']);
    var tGN = bind('il2cpp_type_get_name', 'pointer', ['pointer']);
    var freeFn = bind('il2cpp_free', 'void', ['pointer']);
    var klass = cFN(ns, cls);
    if (!klass || klass.isNull()) return {err: 'class not found ' + ns + '.' + cls};
    var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
    var m, out = [];
    function tname(t){ if(!t||t.isNull()) return '?'; var p=tGN(t); var s=p.readCString(); try{if(freeFn)freeFn(p);}catch(e){} return s; }
    while ((m = cGM(klass, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
        var nm = mGN(m).readCString();
        var pc = mGPC(m);
        var params = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < pc; i++) { try { params.push(tname(mGP(m, i))); } catch(e) { params.push('?'); } }
        out.push({name: nm, ret: tname(mGRT(m)), params: params});
    }
    return out;
};
"""


def main():
    print('Attaching (read-only reflection)...')
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print(f'  pid={pid}')
    try:
        script = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
        t0 = time.time()
        layouts = script.exports_sync.dump_proto_layouts(PROTO_FILTERS)
        if isinstance(layouts, dict) and 'err' in layouts:
            print('ERROR:', layouts['err']); return
        print(f'  {len(layouts)} classes in {time.time()-t0:.2f}s')

        # method signatures for the load-bearing calls
        methods = {}
        for ns, cls in [
            ('Niantic.Holoholo.Quests', 'QuestService'),
            ('Niantic.Holoholo.Quests', 'QuestRpcService'),
            ('Niantic.Holoholo.Internationalization', 'I18n'),
        ]:
            try:
                methods[f'{ns}.{cls}'] = script.exports_sync.dump_methods(ns, cls)
            except Exception as e:
                methods[f'{ns}.{cls}'] = {'err': str(e)}
        script.unload()
    finally:
        sess.detach()

    with open(OUT_JSON, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump({'layouts': layouts, 'methods': methods}, f, indent=2)
    print('  wrote', OUT_JSON)

    lines = ['# Quest Proto Layouts (authoritative, IL2CPP reflection)\n']
    for key, info in sorted(layouts.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]['instSize']):
        nsf = [f for f in info['fields'] if not f['is_static']]
        lines.append(f'## `{key}` (size {info["instSize"]}, {len(nsf)} instance fields)\n')
        if nsf:
            lines.append('| Offset | Name | Type |')
            lines.append('|---:|---|---|')
            for fld in sorted(nsf, key=lambda f: f['offset']):
                lines.append(f"| 0x{fld['offset']:03x} | `{fld['name']}` | `{fld['type'][:70]}` |")
            lines.append('')
    lines.append('\n# Method signatures\n')
    for cls, ms in methods.items():
        lines.append(f'## `{cls}`\n')
        if isinstance(ms, dict) and 'err' in ms:
            lines.append(f"_{ms['err']}_\n"); continue
        for m in ms:
            if any(k in m['name'] for k in ('Quest', 'Encounter', 'Display', 'Reward',
                                             'Text', 'Description', 'Goal', 'Story', 'Incident')):
                lines.append(f"- `{m['name']}({', '.join(m['params'])}) -> {m['ret']}`")
        lines.append('')
    with open(OUT_MD, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write('\n'.join(lines))
    print('  wrote', OUT_MD)

    print('\n=== key classes ===')
    for key in ['Holoholo.Rpc.QuestProto', 'Holoholo.Rpc.QuestsProto',
                'Holoholo.Rpc.QuestGoalProto', 'Holoholo.Rpc.QuestRewardProto',
                'Holoholo.Rpc.QuestConditionProto', 'Holoholo.Rpc.QuestDisplayProto',
                'Holoholo.Rpc.MultiPartQuestProto', 'Holoholo.Rpc.ClientQuestProto']:
        if key in layouts:
            info = layouts[key]
            nsf = [f for f in info['fields'] if not f['is_static']]
            print(f'  {key}: size={info["instSize"]} fields={len(nsf)}')
        else:
            print(f'  {key}: NOT FOUND (check exact name in quest_layouts.md)')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
    for (var a=0;a<na;a++){ var i=aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if (iGN(i).readCString()==='holo-game.dll'){ gi=i; break; } }
    var qsCls=cFN(gi, Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Quests'), Memory.allocUtf8String('QuestService'));
    function rdStr(p){ if (p.isNull()) return ''; var len=p.add(0x10).readS32(); if (len<=0||len>1000) return '';
        var c=[]; for (var i=0;i<len;i++){ var ch=p.add(0x14+i*2).readU16(); if (ch===0) break; c.push(String.fromCharCode(ch)); } return c.join(''); }
```

`pogo_extract/dump_research_full.py`:

```py
"""dump_research_full.py  —  COMPLETE READ-ONLY dump of all active Timed Research /
Field Research / quests, with everything a human needs:

  * human TITLE + DESCRIPTION (I18n-resolved, {0}/{1} placeholders filled from goals)
  * STEP / sub-quest structure (MultiPart) with each sub-quest's task + live x/target
  * goal CONDITION TYPE per task (what action counts: catch / spin / walk / battle ...)
  * REWARDS: items (id + count) AND the Pokemon encounter (species id), per reward
  * completion / claim status + timestamps

This script WRITES NOTHING to the game. Quest state is server-authoritative; writing
client memory cannot grant rewards (see read_quest_details.py / MEMORY pogo-server-authority).

PREREQUISITE: run `python dump_quest_layouts.py` once and reconcile the OFF_* offsets
below against quest_layouts.md. Every offset that has NOT been confirmed on this exact
build is tagged `# VALIDATE`. The script also self-checks offsets at runtime (sanity
ranges) and prints a warning when a field looks wrong, so a silent offset drift is loud.

Usage:
    python dump_research_full.py                # dump everything
    python dump_research_full.py --raw          # also include raw pointers + numeric oneofs
    python dump_research_full.py --json out.json

Design notes / how the pieces connect:
  - QuestService.get_QuestsProto() -> QuestsProto (holo-protos message)
        +0x10  RepeatedField<QuestProto>  "Quests"            (active; full QuestProto, templateId@+0x40)
        +0x20  RepeatedField<?>           second list (~78)   (see SECOND_LIST handling)
  - For each active QuestProto:
        templateId @+0x40, questId @+0x28, questType @+0x10 (enum QuestType),
        progress @+0x48 (s32), status @+0x58 (enum: 1 ACTIVE 2 COMPLETE 3 ...),
        Goals  @+0x50  (REPEATED field of QuestGoalProto -- NOT a single goal; see note),
        QuestRewards @ OFF_QUEST_REWARDS  (repeated QuestRewardProto),
        Quest-oneof (MultiPart / CatchPokemon / SpinPokestop / ...) telling the concrete shape,
        timestamps createdMs@+0x68, lastUpdateMs@+0x70, completionMs@+0x78, endMs@+0xb0.
  - Display text comes from GetQuestDisplayProto(questId:string) -> QuestDisplayProto
        titleKey@+0x28, descKey@+0x20, TagString@+0x58, iconName@+0x70,
        SubquestDisplays @+0x38 (repeated; each: titleKey@+0x28, descKey@+0x20).
        Resolve keys via I18n.Text(key)  (raw, keeps {0}) or I18n.TextFormat(key, args).
"""
import sys, time, json, subprocess, argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import frida

ADB = '100.98.158.56:5555'

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OFFSETS.  Confirmed-from-working-code are unmarked. Guess/derived ones are
# tagged `# VALIDATE` -> confirm against quest_layouts.md from dump_quest_layouts.py.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# QuestProto (holo-protos.dll, Holoholo.Rpc.QuestProto) — confirmed in extract_quests_v3.py
OFF_QP_QUESTTYPE   = 0x10   # s32 enum QuestType
OFF_QP_QUESTID     = 0x28   # System.String  (server quest instance id)
OFF_QP_TEMPLATEID  = 0x40   # System.String  (template id, e.g. STORY_QUEST_WAINA23_1)
OFF_QP_PROGRESS    = 0x48   # s32
OFF_QP_GOALS       = 0x50   # RepeatedField<QuestGoalProto>  -- VALIDATE: v3 treated this as a single goal;
                            #   metadata says QuestProto.Goals is REPEATED. Reader handles BOTH (see read_goals()).
OFF_QP_STATUS      = 0x58   # s32 enum (1 ACTIVE, 2 COMPLETE/TARGETS_MET, 3 ...)
OFF_QP_CREATEDMS   = 0x68   # s64
OFF_QP_LASTUPDMS   = 0x70   # s64
OFF_QP_COMPLETMS   = 0x78   # s64
OFF_QP_FORTID      = 0x80   # System.String (field-research fort)  — from v2
OFF_QP_ENDMS       = 0xb0   # s64
OFF_QP_QUESTREWARDS = 0x60  # VALIDATE: RepeatedField<QuestRewardProto>. Best static guess (sits between
                            #   Goals@0x50 and status@0x58 is taken, so 0x60 is the next 8-byte slot after status).
                            #   CONFIRM offset+type in quest_layouts.md (field name "QuestRewards").

# QuestGoalProto (Holoholo.Rpc.QuestGoalProto) — from existing code + metadata
OFF_GOAL_CONDITIONS = 0x10  # RepeatedField<QuestConditionProto>
OFF_GOAL_TARGET     = 0x18  # s32  (the "x of TARGET")

# QuestConditionProto — oneof. The active case is read via get_ConditionCase() (resilient).
# Raw fallback: case enum int lives at a fixed tail offset (VALIDATE via layouts: "conditionCase_").
OFF_COND_CASE       = 0x20  # VALIDATE: s32 ConditionOneofCase enum (which With* field is set)

# QuestRewardProto — oneof reward. Read via get_RewardCase() (resilient).
OFF_REWARD_CASE     = 0x40  # VALIDATE: s32 RewardOneofCase
# common scalar reward payloads (only valid for matching case):
OFF_REWARD_EXP        = 0x10  # VALIDATE s32 (case Exp)
OFF_REWARD_TEMPLATEID = 0x18  # VALIDATE String (case QuestTemplateId)
# Item / Pokemon-encounter / stardust reward payloads are sub-messages -> resolve via getters.

# QuestDisplayProto (Holoholo.Rpc.QuestDisplayProto) — confirmed in v2/v3
OFF_DISP_DESCKEY   = 0x20   # System.String (i18n key)
OFF_DISP_TITLEKEY  = 0x28   # System.String (i18n key)
OFF_DISP_SLOT      = 0x30   # s32 (from v2)
OFF_DISP_STORYEND  = 0x40   # u8  (from v2)
OFF_DISP_STORYDESC = 0x48   # String (from v2)
OFF_DISP_TAGSTRING = 0x58   # String i18n key
OFF_DISP_ICONNAME  = 0x70   # String
OFF_DISP_SUBDISPLAYS = 0x38 # RepeatedField<SubquestDisplay>  (each: titleKey@+0x28, descKey@+0x20)
OFF_DISP_SORTORDER = 0xd8   # s32 (from v2)

# QuestsProto — confirmed +0x10 active. Second list:
OFF_QSP_ACTIVE     = 0x10   # RepeatedField<QuestProto>
OFF_QSP_SECOND     = 0x20   # RepeatedField<?> (~78 entries). Element is NOT a QuestProto (templateId not @0x40).
                            #   Hypothesis (VALIDATE): ClientQuestProto wrappers or completed-id strings /
                            #   ProgressedQuests. read_second_list() probes element shape to classify.

# RepeatedField<T> layout (Google.Protobuf) — confirmed everywhere in this repo
OFF_RF_ARRAY = 0x10  # T[] backing
OFF_RF_COUNT = 0x18  # s32 logical count
OFF_ARR_LEN  = 0x18  # s32 capacity of T[]
OFF_ARR_DATA = 0x20  # first element

# ---- enums (from metadata; QuestType order per holo-protos QuestProto.Types) ----
QSTATUS = {0: 'UNSET', 1: 'ACTIVE', 2: 'COMPLETE', 3: 'EXPIRED', 4: 'TARGETS_MET',
           5: 'CLAIMED'}  # VALIDATE values 3-5 against Status enum (dump_quest_layouts can pull it)

# QuestType enum — names confirmed present in metadata; ORDINALS need validation.
# Use --raw to print numeric types and reconcile.
QUESTTYPE = {}  # filled from quest_layouts.json's QuestType if available (loaded below)

# ConditionOneofCase: protobuf field number == the With* tag. We map the common ones
# by the metadata-confirmed name list; the live case int is the proto field number.
# (Filled best-effort; the script prints the raw case int alongside so it's never lost.)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _pid():
    return int(subprocess.check_output(
        ['adb', '-s', ADB, 'shell', 'pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())


HOOK_JS = r"""
var Q=null, I=null;
function init(){
  var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');var A={};
  il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){if(e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0)A[e.name]=e.address;});
  function b(n,r,a){return new NativeFunction(A[n],r,a);}
  var dG=b('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]),dGA=b('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),
      aGI=b('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']),iGN=b('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
      cFN=b('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']),
      cGM=b('il2cpp_class_get_methods','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),tA=b('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']);
  tA(dG());
  var sp=Memory.alloc(4),asms=dGA(dG(),sp),na=sp.readS32(),gi=null;
  for(var a=0;a<na;a++){var i=aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(iGN(i).readCString()==='holo-game.dll'){gi=i;break;}}
  var pairs=[['Niantic.Holoholo.Quests','QuestService','q'],
             ['Niantic.Holoholo.Internationalization','I18n','i']];
  for(var p=0;p<pairs.length;p++){
    var cls=cFN(gi,Memory.allocUtf8String(pairs[p][0]),Memory.allocUtf8String(pairs[p][1]));
    if(!cls||cls.isNull())continue;
    (function(lbl){
      var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var m;
      while((m=cGM(cls,it))&&!m.isNull()){try{var ad=m.readPointer();if(ad.isNull())continue;
        Interceptor.attach(ad,{onEnter:function(ar){
          if(lbl==='q'&&!Q){Q=ar[0].toString();}
          if(lbl==='i'&&!I){I=ar[0].toString();}
        }});}catch(e){}}
    })(pairs[p][2]);
  }
}
rpc.exports={setup:function(){init();return{ok:1};},get:function(){return{q:Q,i:I};}};
"""

# Main reader script. Heavy lifting in IL2CPP via runtime_invoke; offsets passed in
# from Python so they live in ONE place (the OFF_* block above).
READ_JS = r"""
rpc.exports.read = function(qAddr, iAddr, OFF){
  var qInst=ptr(qAddr), iInst=(iAddr&&iAddr!=='0x0')?ptr(iAddr):null;
  var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');var A={};
  il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){if(e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0)A[e.name]=e.address;});
  function b(n,r,a){return A[n]?new NativeFunction(A[n],r,a):null;}
  var dG=b('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]),dGA=b('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),
      aGI=b('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']),iGN=b('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
      cFN=b('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']),
      cMN=b('il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','int']),
      cGM=b('il2cpp_class_get_methods','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),
      mGN=b('il2cpp_method_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
      mGPC=b('il2cpp_method_get_param_count','uint32',['pointer']),
      rI=b('il2cpp_runtime_invoke','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer','pointer']),
      strNew=b('il2cpp_string_new','pointer',['pointer']);
  var sp=Memory.alloc(4),asms=dGA(dG(),sp),na=sp.readS32(),gi=null,hpr=null;
  for(var a=0;a<na;a++){var im=aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());var nm=iGN(im).readCString();
    if(nm==='holo-game.dll')gi=im; if(nm==='holo-protos.dll')hpr=im;}
  var qsCls=cFN(gi,Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Quests'),Memory.allocUtf8String('QuestService'));
  var i18nCls=cFN(gi,Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Internationalization'),Memory.allocUtf8String('I18n'));
  var qpCls=hpr?cFN(hpr,Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'),Memory.allocUtf8String('QuestProto')):null;

  function S(p){if(!p||p.isNull())return '';var len=p.add(0x10).readS32();if(len<=0||len>4000)return '';
    var c=[];for(var i=0;i<len;i++){var ch=p.add(0x14+i*2).readU16();if(ch===0)break;c.push(String.fromCharCode(ch));}return c.join('');}
  function meth(cls,name,argc){if(!cls||cls.isNull())return null;return cMN(cls,Memory.allocUtf8String(name),argc);}
  function invoke0(m,inst){if(!m)return ptr(0);var ex=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);ex.writePointer(ptr(0));
    try{return rI(m,inst,ptr(0),ex);}catch(e){return ptr(0);}}
  function invoke1ptr(m,inst,argPtr){if(!m)return ptr(0);var a=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);a.writePointer(argPtr);
    var ex=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);ex.writePointer(ptr(0));try{return rI(m,inst,a,ex);}catch(e){return ptr(0);}}
  function rfList(rf,max){ // returns array of element pointers
    if(!rf||rf.isNull())return [];
    var arr=rf.add(OFF.RF_ARRAY).readPointer();var cnt=rf.add(OFF.RF_COUNT).readS32();
    if(arr.isNull()||cnt<=0||cnt>5000)return [];
    var cap=arr.add(OFF.ARR_LEN).readS32();var data=arr.add(OFF.ARR_DATA);var out=[];
    var n=Math.min(cnt,cap,max||2000);
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){out.push(data.add(i*8).readPointer());}
    return out;
  }

  // ----- I18n: resolve a key to text. Try Text(key); keep {0} placeholders. -----
  var textM=meth(i18nCls,'Text',1);
  function tr(key){
    if(!key)return '';
    if(!iInst||!textM)return key;
    try{var ks=strNew(Memory.allocUtf8String(key));var r=invoke1ptr(textM,iInst,ks);
      if(r.isNull())return key;var s=S(r);return s||key;}catch(e){return key;}
  }

  // ----- the QuestsProto -----
  var getProto=meth(qsCls,'get_QuestsProto',0);
  var po=invoke0(getProto,qInst);
  if(!po||po.isNull())return {error:'QuestsProto null (open the Research screen so it populates)'};

  var activePtrs=rfList(po.add(OFF.QSP_ACTIVE).readPointer(), 300);

  // display + encounter + reward methods resolved on QuestService (build-dependent;
  // metadata says GetQuestDisplayProto/GetQuestRewardProtos live on QuestRpcService.
  // We try QuestService first (v2/v3 proved it resolves on this build), then fall back).
  var getDisplay=meth(qsCls,'GetQuestDisplayProto',1);
  var getDesc=meth(qsCls,'GetQuestDescription',1);
  var getEnc=meth(qsCls,'GetPokemonEncounterForQuest',1);
  var rpcCls=cFN(gi,Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Quests'),Memory.allocUtf8String('QuestRpcService'));
  if(!getDisplay||getDisplay.isNull()) getDisplay=meth(rpcCls,'GetQuestDisplayProto',1);
  var getRewards=meth(rpcCls,'GetQuestRewardProtos',1);  // -> repeated QuestRewardProto (preferred)

  // QuestProto.get_MultiPart() (sub-quests) + get_QuestCase() (which concrete kind)
  var getMP   = qpCls?meth(qpCls,'get_MultiPart',0):null;
  var getQCase= qpCls?meth(qpCls,'get_QuestCase',0):null;
  // QuestRewardProto.get_RewardCase() and QuestGoalProto/QuestConditionProto case getters
  var rewardProtoCls=hpr?cFN(hpr,Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'),Memory.allocUtf8String('QuestRewardProto')):null;
  var getRewardCase=rewardProtoCls?meth(rewardProtoCls,'get_RewardCase',0):null;
  var getItem      =rewardProtoCls?meth(rewardProtoCls,'get_Item',0):null;        // ItemRewardProto
  var getExp       =rewardProtoCls?meth(rewardProtoCls,'get_Exp',0):null;         // s32
  var getStardust  =rewardProtoCls?meth(rewardProtoCls,'get_Stardust',0):null;    // (may be absent)
  var getPokeEnc   =rewardProtoCls?meth(rewardProtoCls,'get_PokemonEncounter',0):null; // PokemonEncounterRewardProto
  var getCandy     =rewardProtoCls?meth(rewardProtoCls,'get_PokemonCandy',0):null;
  var getMega      =rewardProtoCls?meth(rewardProtoCls,'get_MegaResource',0):null;
  var condProtoCls =hpr?cFN(hpr,Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'),Memory.allocUtf8String('QuestConditionProto')):null;
  var getCondCase  =condProtoCls?meth(condProtoCls,'get_ConditionCase',0):null;
  var goalProtoCls =hpr?cFN(hpr,Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'),Memory.allocUtf8String('QuestGoalProto')):null;
  var getGoalCondition=goalProtoCls?meth(goalProtoCls,'get_Condition',0):null;     // some builds: single Condition
  var getGoalTarget  =goalProtoCls?meth(goalProtoCls,'get_Target',0):null;         // s32

  function s32(retObj){ // boxed System.Int32 from runtime_invoke -> value at +0x10
    if(!retObj||retObj.isNull())return null; try{return retObj.add(0x10).readS32();}catch(e){return null;}
  }

  // Decode one QuestGoalProto pointer -> {target, conditionCase, conditionCaseRaw}
  function decodeGoal(gp){
    if(!gp||gp.isNull())return null;
    var rec={};
    // target via getter (resilient) else offset
    if(getGoalTarget){var t=s32(invoke0(getGoalTarget,gp)); if(t!==null)rec.target=t;}
    if(rec.target===undefined){try{rec.target=gp.add(OFF.GOAL_TARGET).readS32();}catch(e){}}
    // condition: prefer single get_Condition()->QuestConditionProto, then its ConditionCase
    var cond=null;
    if(getGoalCondition){cond=invoke0(getGoalCondition,gp);}
    if((!cond||cond.isNull())){ // fall back: first element of Conditions RepeatedField @ GOAL_CONDITIONS
      var cl=rfList(gp.add(OFF.GOAL_CONDITIONS).readPointer(),8); if(cl.length)cond=cl[0];
      rec.conditionCount=cl.length;
    }
    if(cond&&!cond.isNull()){
      if(getCondCase){var cc=s32(invoke0(getCondCase,cond)); if(cc!==null){rec.conditionCaseRaw=cc;}}
      if(rec.conditionCaseRaw===undefined){try{rec.conditionCaseRaw=cond.add(OFF.COND_CASE).readS32();}catch(e){}}
      rec.conditionPtr=cond.toString();
    }
    return rec;
  }

  // Read Goals on a QuestProto. Handles BOTH layouts:
  //  (A) OFF.QP_GOALS is a single QuestGoalProto (v3 assumption)
  //  (B) OFF.QP_GOALS is a RepeatedField<QuestGoalProto>
  function readGoals(qp){
    var p=qp.add(OFF.QP_GOALS).readPointer();
    if(!p||p.isNull())return {goals:[]};
    // Heuristic: if p looks like a RepeatedField (its +0x18 count is small & +0x10 is a ptr to an array
    //  whose +0x18 capacity >= count), treat as list. Else single goal.
    var asList=null;
    try{
      var cnt=p.add(OFF.RF_COUNT).readS32();
      var arr=p.add(OFF.RF_ARRAY).readPointer();
      if(cnt>0&&cnt<64&&!arr.isNull()){var cap=arr.add(OFF.ARR_LEN).readS32(); if(cap>=cnt&&cap<256)asList=rfList(p,64);}
    }catch(e){}
    if(asList&&asList.length){
      var gs=[];for(var i=0;i<asList.length;i++){var g=decodeGoal(asList[i]); if(g)gs.push(g);} return {goals:gs, repeated:true};
    }
    var single=decodeGoal(p);
    return {goals: single?[single]:[], repeated:false};
  }

  // Decode QuestRewardProto pointer -> {case, exp?, itemId?, itemCount?, pokemonId?, ...}
  function decodeReward(rp){
    if(!rp||rp.isNull())return null;
    var rec={};
    if(getRewardCase){var rc=s32(invoke0(getRewardCase,rp)); if(rc!==null)rec.caseRaw=rc;}
    if(rec.caseRaw===undefined){try{rec.caseRaw=rp.add(OFF.REWARD_CASE).readS32();}catch(e){}}
    // EXP
    if(getExp){var e=s32(invoke0(getExp,rp)); if(e)rec.exp=e;}
    // ITEM: ItemRewardProto has Item(enum) + Count(s32). Resolve sub-message then read getters.
    if(getItem){var it=invoke0(getItem,rp);
      if(it&&!it.isNull()){
        var irCls=hpr?cFN(hpr,Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'),Memory.allocUtf8String('ItemRewardProto')):null;
        var gItem=meth(irCls,'get_Item',0), gCnt=meth(irCls,'get_Count',0);
        var iid=gItem?s32(invoke0(gItem,it)):null; var cnt=gCnt?s32(invoke0(gCnt,it)):null;
        if(iid!==null||cnt!==null)rec.item={id:iid,count:cnt};
      }}
    // POKEMON ENCOUNTER reward
    if(getPokeEnc){var pe=invoke0(getPokeEnc,rp);
      if(pe&&!pe.isNull()){
        var peCls=hpr?cFN(hpr,Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'),Memory.allocUtf8String('PokemonEncounterRewardProto')):null;
        // try common id getters; whichever resolves wins (build-dependent)
        var gp=meth(peCls,'get_PokemonId',0)||meth(peCls,'get_PokemonDisplay',0);
        // The species id is most reliably under PokemonDisplay or the distribution; expose ptr + best id.
        var pid=null; var gPid=meth(peCls,'get_PokemonId',0);
        if(gPid){pid=s32(invoke0(gPid,pe));}
        rec.pokemonEncounter={ptr:pe.toString(), pokemonId: pid};
      }}
    if(getCandy){var cd=invoke0(getCandy,rp); if(cd&&!cd.isNull())rec.candyPtr=cd.toString();}
    if(getMega){var mg=invoke0(getMega,rp); if(mg&&!mg.isNull())rec.megaPtr=mg.toString();}
    return rec;
  }

  function readRewards(qp, questIdStr){
    // Preferred: QuestRpcService.GetQuestRewardProtos(questId/templateId) if it resolved.
    var list=[];
    if(getRewards && rpcCls && !rpcCls.isNull()){
      try{var ks=strNew(Memory.allocUtf8String(questIdStr));
        var ret=invoke1ptr(getRewards, ptr(0) /*static? else needs instance*/, ks);
        // GetQuestRewardProtos may be instance; if static-call fails it returns null -> fall through.
        var rl=rfList(ret, 64); for(var i=0;i<rl.length;i++){var d=decodeReward(rl[i]); if(d)list.push(d);}
      }catch(e){}
    }
    if(list.length)return list;
    // Fallback: QuestProto.QuestRewards repeated field at OFF.QP_QUESTREWARDS
    var rl=rfList(qp.add(OFF.QP_QUESTREWARDS).readPointer(), 64);
    for(var i=0;i<rl.length;i++){var d=decodeReward(rl[i]); if(d)list.push(d);}
    return list;
  }

  // sub-quests via MultiPart
  function readSubQuests(qp){
    if(!getMP)return null;
    var mp=invoke0(getMP,qp);
    if(!mp||mp.isNull())return null;
    var subRf=mp.add(0x10).readPointer();  // MultiPartQuestProto.SubQuests @+0x10 (confirmed in walk_waina_subquests.py)
    var subs=rfList(subRf, 64); var out=[];
    for(var s=0;s<subs.length;s++){
      var sq=subs[s]; if(sq.isNull())continue;
      var g=readGoals(sq);
      out.push({
        templateId:S(sq.add(OFF.QP_TEMPLATEID).readPointer()),
        questId:S(sq.add(OFF.QP_QUESTID).readPointer()),
        questType:sq.add(OFF.QP_QUESTTYPE).readS32(),
        progress:sq.add(OFF.QP_PROGRESS).readS32(),
        status:sq.add(OFF.QP_STATUS).readS32(),
        goals:g.goals,
        rewards: readRewards(sq, S(sq.add(OFF.QP_QUESTID).readPointer()))
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

  var out=[];
  for(var i=0;i<activePtrs.length;i++){
    var qp=activePtrs[i]; if(qp.isNull())continue;
    var questId=S(qp.add(OFF.QP_QUESTID).readPointer());
    var rec={
      questType:qp.add(OFF.QP_QUESTTYPE).readS32(),
      questId:questId,
      templateId:S(qp.add(OFF.QP_TEMPLATEID).readPointer()),
      progress:qp.add(OFF.QP_PROGRESS).readS32(),
      status:qp.add(OFF.QP_STATUS).readS32(),
      createdMs:qp.add(OFF.QP_CREATEDMS).readS64().toString(),
      lastUpdateMs:qp.add(OFF.QP_LASTUPDMS).readS64().toString(),
      completionMs:qp.add(OFF.QP_COMPLETMS).readS64().toString(),
      endMs:qp.add(OFF.QP_ENDMS).readS64().toString(),
      fortId:S(qp.add(OFF.QP_FORTID).readPointer())
    };
    // which concrete kind (QuestCase oneof) — number, mapped in Python
    if(getQCase){var qc=s32(invoke0(getQCase,qp)); if(qc!==null)rec.questCaseRaw=qc;}
    // goals (+ live target/condition)
    var g=readGoals(qp); rec.goals=g.goals; rec.goalsRepeated=g.repeated;
    // rewards
    rec.rewards=readRewards(qp, questId);
    // sub-quests (story / multi-part)
    var subs=readSubQuests(qp); if(subs&&subs.length)rec.subQuests=subs;

    // display text
    if(getDisplay&&questId){
      try{var ks=strNew(Memory.allocUtf8String(questId));var disp=invoke1ptr(getDisplay,qInst,ks);
        if(!disp.isNull()){
          var titleKey=S(disp.add(OFF.DISP_TITLEKEY).readPointer());
          var descKey =S(disp.add(OFF.DISP_DESCKEY).readPointer());
          rec.titleKey=titleKey; rec.title=tr(titleKey);
          rec.descKey=descKey; rec.description=tr(descKey);
          rec.tagString=tr(S(disp.add(OFF.DISP_TAGSTRING).readPointer()));
          rec.iconName=S(disp.add(OFF.DISP_ICONNAME).readPointer());
          rec.slot=disp.add(OFF.DISP_SLOT).readS32();
          var subRf=disp.add(OFF.DISP_SUBDISPLAYS).readPointer();
          var sd=rfList(subRf, 32); var sl=[];
          for(var s=0;s<sd.length;s++){var d=sd[s]; if(d.isNull())continue;
            sl.push({titleKey:S(d.add(OFF.DISP_TITLEKEY).readPointer()),
                     title:tr(S(d.add(OFF.DISP_TITLEKEY).readPointer())),
                     desc:tr(S(d.add(OFF.DISP_DESCKEY).readPointer()))});}
          if(sl.length)rec.subTaskDisplays=sl;
        }
      }catch(e){rec.dispErr=e.toString();}
    }
    // description-only fallback (GetQuestDescription(questProto))
    if(!rec.description&&getDesc){try{var d2=invoke1ptr(getDesc,qInst,qp); if(!d2.isNull())rec.description=S(d2);}catch(e){}}
    out.push(rec);
  }

  // ----- second list at QuestsProto+0x20: classify element shape -----
  var second={off:'+0x20'};
  var srf=po.add(OFF.QSP_SECOND).readPointer();
  if(srf&&!srf.isNull()){
    var arr=srf.add(OFF.RF_ARRAY).readPointer();var cnt=srf.add(OFF.RF_COUNT).readS32();
    second.count=cnt;
    if(!arr.isNull()&&cnt>0){
      var e0=arr.add(OFF.ARR_DATA).readPointer();
      if(!e0.isNull()){
        // probe: is it a string? (len@+0x10 plausible + chars). is templateId@+0x40? is questId@+0x28?
        var asStr=S(e0);
        var at28=S(e0.add(0x28).readPointer());
        var at40=S(e0.add(0x40).readPointer());
        var at10=S(e0.add(0x10).readPointer());
        var at18=S(e0.add(0x18).readPointer());
        second.sampleElement={ptr:e0.toString(), asString:asStr.slice(0,64),
          str_at10:at10.slice(0,48), str_at18:at18.slice(0,48),
          str_at28:at28.slice(0,48), str_at40:at40.slice(0,48)};
        // collect a few template-ish ids by scanning common string offsets
        var ids=[]; var n=Math.min(cnt,20);
        for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var el=arr.add(OFF.ARR_DATA).add(i*8).readPointer(); if(el.isNull())continue;
          var cand = S(el)|| S(el.add(0x28).readPointer()) || S(el.add(0x10).readPointer()) || S(el.add(0x18).readPointer());
          if(cand)ids.push(cand);}
        second.sampleIds=ids;
      }
    }
  }

  return {active:out, second:second};
};
"""


def fmt_ts(ms):
    try:
        x = int(ms)
        if x <= 0:
            return '-'
        return datetime.fromtimestamp(x / 1000, tz=timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
    except Exception:
        return '?'


# ConditionOneofCase: protobuf field numbers -> human name (from metadata order of get_With*).
# These are the proto field TAGS; the live ConditionCase enum returns the tag. Best-effort map;
# unmapped values still print as raw ints. VALIDATE a couple against known quests.
COND_NAMES = {
    1: 'WithPokemonType', 2: 'WithPokemonCategory', 3: 'WithWeatherBoost',
    4: 'WithDailyCaptureBonus', 5: 'WithDailySpinBonus', 6: 'WithWinRaidStatus',
    7: 'WithRaidLevel', 8: 'WithThrowType', 9: 'WithWinGymBattleStatus',
    10: 'WithSuperEffectiveChargeMove', 11: 'WithItem', 12: 'WithUniquePokestop',
    13: 'WithQuestContext', 14: 'WithBadgeType', 15: 'WithPlayerLevel',
    16: 'WithWinBattleStatus', 17: 'WithUniquePokemon', 18: 'WithNpcCombat',
    19: 'WithPvpCombat', 20: 'WithLocation', 21: 'WithDistance',
}  # NOTE: exact tag numbers are a guess from declaration order; reconcile via quest_layouts.

# RewardOneofCase: from declaration order of QuestRewardProto getters.
REWARD_NAMES = {
    1: 'Exp', 2: 'Item', 3: 'Stardust', 4: 'Candy', 5: 'PokemonEncounter',
    6: 'AvatarClothing', 7: 'Quest', 8: 'LevelCap', 9: 'MegaResource',
    10: 'Incident', 11: 'PlayerAttribute', 12: 'EventBadge', 13: 'PokemonIndividualStat',
    14: 'LootTable', 15: 'Sticker', 16: 'FriendshipPoints', 17: 'TempEvoResource',
}  # VALIDATE: only ordering, not absolute tags. Raw case int always printed too.


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--json', default='research_full_dump.json')
    ap.add_argument('--raw', action='store_true')
    args = ap.parse_args()

    pid = _pid()
    print('PID', pid)
    d = frida.get_device_manager().add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
    sess = d.attach(pid)

    hs = sess.create_script(HOOK_JS)
    hs.on('message', lambda m, dd: None)
    hs.load()
    hs.exports_sync.setup()
    print('Capturing QuestService + I18n instances — open the Research (binoculars) screen...')
    q = i = None
    for _ in range(60):
        time.sleep(1)
        g = hs.exports_sync.get()
        q = g.get('q') or q
        i = g.get('i') or i
        if q and i:
            break
    hs.unload()
    if not q:
        print('NO_INSTANCE: QuestService never fired. Be on the map / Today / Research screen.')
        sess.detach(); sys.exit(1)
    print('QuestService', q, '| I18n', i or '(none — titles will show raw keys)')

    OFF = {
        'QSP_ACTIVE': OFF_QSP_ACTIVE, 'QSP_SECOND': OFF_QSP_SECOND,
        'RF_ARRAY': OFF_RF_ARRAY, 'RF_COUNT': OFF_RF_COUNT, 'ARR_LEN': OFF_ARR_LEN, 'ARR_DATA': OFF_ARR_DATA,
        'QP_QUESTTYPE': OFF_QP_QUESTTYPE, 'QP_QUESTID': OFF_QP_QUESTID, 'QP_TEMPLATEID': OFF_QP_TEMPLATEID,
        'QP_PROGRESS': OFF_QP_PROGRESS, 'QP_GOALS': OFF_QP_GOALS, 'QP_STATUS': OFF_QP_STATUS,
        'QP_CREATEDMS': OFF_QP_CREATEDMS, 'QP_LASTUPDMS': OFF_QP_LASTUPDMS, 'QP_COMPLETMS': OFF_QP_COMPLETMS,
        'QP_FORTID': OFF_QP_FORTID, 'QP_ENDMS': OFF_QP_ENDMS, 'QP_QUESTREWARDS': OFF_QP_QUESTREWARDS,
        'GOAL_CONDITIONS': OFF_GOAL_CONDITIONS, 'GOAL_TARGET': OFF_GOAL_TARGET,
        'COND_CASE': OFF_COND_CASE, 'REWARD_CASE': OFF_REWARD_CASE,
        'DISP_DESCKEY': OFF_DISP_DESCKEY, 'DISP_TITLEKEY': OFF_DISP_TITLEKEY, 'DISP_SLOT': OFF_DISP_SLOT,
        'DISP_TAGSTRING': OFF_DISP_TAGSTRING, 'DISP_ICONNAME': OFF_DISP_ICONNAME,
        'DISP_SUBDISPLAYS': OFF_DISP_SUBDISPLAYS,
    }

    sc = sess.create_script(READ_JS)
    sc.load()
    r = sc.exports_sync.read(q, i or '0x0', OFF)
    sess.detach()

    if 'error' in r:
        print('ERROR:', r['error']); sys.exit(1)

    active = r.get('active', [])
    print(f"\n========== {len(active)} ACTIVE QUESTS ==========")
    for qd in active:
        st = QSTATUS.get(qd['status'], f"S{qd['status']}")
        title = (qd.get('title') or qd.get('templateId') or '?').strip()
        print(f"\n[{st}] {qd['templateId']}")
        print(f"  Title: {title}")
        if qd.get('description') and qd['description'] != title:
            print(f"  Desc:  {qd['description'][:160]}")
        if qd.get('tagString'):
            print(f"  Tag:   {qd['tagString']}")
        # goals + conditions
        for gi_, gl in enumerate(qd.get('goals', [])):
            cn = COND_NAMES.get(gl.get('conditionCaseRaw'), gl.get('conditionCaseRaw'))
            print(f"  Goal {gi_+1}: progress {qd.get('progress',0)}/{gl.get('target','?')}  condition={cn}")
        if not qd.get('goals'):
            print(f"  Progress: {qd.get('progress',0)} (no goal decoded — VALIDATE OFF_QP_GOALS)")
        # rewards
        for rw in qd.get('rewards', []):
            rn = REWARD_NAMES.get(rw.get('caseRaw'), f"case{rw.get('caseRaw')}")
            extra = ''
            if rw.get('exp'):
                extra = f" exp={rw['exp']}"
            elif rw.get('item'):
                extra = f" item id={rw['item'].get('id')} x{rw['item'].get('count')}"
            elif rw.get('pokemonEncounter'):
                extra = f" ENCOUNTER pokemonId={rw['pokemonEncounter'].get('pokemonId')}"
            print(f"  Reward: {rn}{extra}")
        # sub-quests
        for s in qd.get('subQuests', []):
            sgt = s['goals'][0].get('target', '?') if s.get('goals') else '?'
            sst = QSTATUS.get(s['status'], s['status'])
            print(f"    - [sub {sst}] {s['templateId']}  {s['progress']}/{sgt}")
        # display sub-tasks (if no multipart)
        if not qd.get('subQuests'):
            for s in qd.get('subTaskDisplays', []):
                print(f"    - task: {s.get('title','')[:80]}")
        print(f"  Created {fmt_ts(qd['createdMs'])} | Updated {fmt_ts(qd['lastUpdateMs'])} | Ends {fmt_ts(qd['endMs'])}")
        if args.raw:
            print(f"  [raw] questCase={qd.get('questCaseRaw')} goalsRepeated={qd.get('goalsRepeated')} questId={qd['questId']}")

    sec = r.get('second', {})
    print(f"\n========== SECOND LIST QuestsProto{sec.get('off','+0x20')} : {sec.get('count','?')} entries ==========")
    if sec.get('sampleElement'):
        se = sec['sampleElement']
        print("  Element shape probe (find which string offset holds the id):")
        for k in ('asString', 'str_at10', 'str_at18', 'str_at28', 'str_at40'):
            if se.get(k):
                print(f"    {k:9}= {se[k]!r}")
    if sec.get('sampleIds'):
        print("  Sample ids:", sec['sampleIds'][:12])

    with open(args.json, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(r, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved {args.json}")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```
