```py
js = """
rpc.exports = {
    walkQuests: function(addr) {
        var inst = ptr(addr);
        var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
        var addrs = {};
        il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) addrs[e.name] = e.address; });
        function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(addrs[n],r,a); }
        var dG = bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
        var dGA = bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var aGI = bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGN = bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cFN = bind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
        var cMN = bind('il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','int']);
        var rI = bind('il2cpp_runtime_invoke','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer','pointer']);
        var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = dGA(dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();
        var gi = null;
        for (var a=0;a<na;a++){ var i=aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if (iGN(i).readCString()==='holo-game.dll'){ gi=i; break; } }
        var cls = cFN(gi, Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Quests'), Memory.allocUtf8String('QuestService'));

        function readUtf16Str(p) {
            if (p.isNull()) return '';
            var len = p.add(0x10).readS32();
            if (len <= 0 || len > 500) return '';
            var chars = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                var ch = p.add(0x14 + i*2).readU16();
                if (ch === 0) break;
                chars.push(String.fromCharCode(ch));
            }
            return chars.join('');
        }

        // Get QuestsProto
        var getProto = cMN(cls, Memory.allocUtf8String('get_QuestsProto'), 0);
        var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var protoObj = rI(getProto, inst, ptr(0), exc);
        if (protoObj.isNull()) return {error:'null'};

        function walkRepeated(rfPtr, isString) {
            if (rfPtr.isNull()) return [];
            var arr = rfPtr.add(0x10).readPointer();
            var count = rfPtr.add(0x18).readS32();
            if (arr.isNull() || count <= 0) return [];
            var maxLen = arr.add(0x18).readS32();
            var data = arr.add(0x20);
            var items = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < Math.min(count, maxLen, 1000); i++) {
                var p = data.add(i * 8).readPointer();
                if (isString) items.push(readUtf16Str(p));
                else items.push(p);
            }
            return items;
        }

        // Active quests RepeatedField<QuestProto> at +0x10
        var activeRf = protoObj.add(0x10).readPointer();
        var activePtrs = walkRepeated(activeRf, false);
        // Completed story quest IDs RepeatedField<String> at +0x18
        var completedRf = protoObj.add(0x18).readPointer();
        var completedIds = walkRepeated(completedRf, true);

        var active = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < activePtrs.length; i++) {
            var quest = activePtrs[i];
            if (quest.isNull()) continue;
            var rec = {
                questType: quest.add(0x10).readS32(),
                questId: readUtf16Str(quest.add(0x28).readPointer()),
                templateId: readUtf16Str(quest.add(0x40).readPointer()),
                progress: quest.add(0x48).readS32(),
                status: quest.add(0x58).readS32(),
                createdMs: quest.add(0x68).readS64().toString(),
                lastUpdateMs: quest.add(0x70).readS64().toString(),
                completionMs: quest.add(0x78).readS64().toString(),
                endMs: quest.add(0xb0).readS64().toString(),
            };
            // Goal target
            var goal = quest.add(0x50).readPointer();
            if (!goal.isNull()) {
                try { rec.goalTarget = goal.add(0x18).readS32(); } catch(e) {}
            }
            active.push(rec);
        }
        return {active: active, completedStoryIds: completedIds};

        var results = [];
        var n = Math.min(size, maxLen, 200);
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            var cqProto = data.add(i * 8).readPointer();
            if (cqProto.isNull()) continue;
            // ClientQuestProto: +0x10 Quest (QuestProto), +0x18 QuestDisplay (QuestDisplayProto)
            var quest = cqProto.add(0x10).readPointer();
            var display = cqProto.add(0x18).readPointer();
            if (quest.isNull()) continue;

            var rec = {};
            rec.questType = quest.add(0x10).readS32();
            rec.questId = readUtf16Str(quest.add(0x28).readPointer());
            rec.templateId = readUtf16Str(quest.add(0x40).readPointer());
            rec.progress = quest.add(0x48).readS32();
            rec.status = quest.add(0x58).readS32();
            rec.createdMs = quest.add(0x68).readS64().toString();
            rec.lastUpdateMs = quest.add(0x70).readS64().toString();
            rec.completionMs = quest.add(0x78).readS64().toString();
            rec.endMs = quest.add(0xb0).readS64().toString();

            // Goal proto at +0x50 - has currentValue and goalValue
            var goal = quest.add(0x50).readPointer();
            if (!goal.isNull()) {
                try {
                    // QuestGoalProto fields tbd; will probe later
                    rec.goalPtr = goal.toString();
                } catch(e) {}
            }

            if (!display.isNull()) {
                rec.title = readUtf16Str(display.add(0x28).readPointer());
                rec.description = readUtf16Str(display.add(0x20).readPointer());
                rec.slot = display.add(0x30).readS32();
                rec.iconName = readUtf16Str(display.add(0x70).readPointer());
                // SubquestDisplays at +0x38
                try {
                    var sub = display.add(0x38).readPointer();
                    if (!sub.isNull()) {
                        var subItems = sub.add(0x10).readPointer();
                        var subSize = sub.add(0x18).readS32();
                        if (!subItems.isNull() && subSize > 0) {
                            var subList = [];
                            var subData = subItems.add(0x20);
                            var subMax = subItems.add(0x18).readS32();
                            for (var s = 0; s < Math.min(subSize, subMax, 20); s++) {
                                var sd = subData.add(s * 8).readPointer();
                                if (sd.isNull()) continue;
                                subList.push({
                                    title: readUtf16Str(sd.add(0x28).readPointer()),
                                    desc: readUtf16Str(sd.add(0x20).readPointer())
                                });
                            }
                            rec.subQuests = subList;
                        }
                    }
                } catch(e) { rec.subErr = e.toString(); }
            }
            results.push(rec);
        }
        return {size: size, walked: results.length, quests: results};
    }
};
"""
script = sess.create_script(js)
script.load()

    0:'UNSET', 1:'FIRST_CATCH', 2:'CATCH', 3:'CATCH_NEW', 4:'CATCH_TYPE',
    5:'COMPLETE_BATTLE', 7:'PLAYER_LEVEL', 8:'COMPLETE_QUEST', 9:'TRANSFER_POKEMON',

import json as jsmod

    try:
        x = int(ms)
        if x <= 0: return '-'
        return datetime.fromtimestamp(x/1000, tz=timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    except: return '?'

print("\n=== ACTIVE QUESTS ===")

# Group completed IDs by prefix to summarize
from collections import Counter

for cid in completed:
    parts = cid.split('-')
    if len(parts) >= 3:
        prefix = '-'.join(parts[:-1])  # everything except step number
    else:
        prefix = cid
    prefix_count[prefix] += 1
print(f"{'Story':<70} {'#Steps'}")
for prefix, n in sorted(prefix_count.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1])[:50]:
    print(f"  {prefix[:67]:<70} {n}")

with open('quests_dump.json','w') as f: jsmod.dump(r, f, indent=2)
print(f"\nSaved to quests_dump.json")
sess.detach()
```

```py
                completionMs: quest.add(0x78).readS64().toString(),
                endMs: quest.add(0xb0).readS64().toString(),
                fortId: readUtf16Str(quest.add(0x80).readPointer()),
            };
            var goal = quest.add(0x50).readPointer();
            if (!goal.isNull()) {
                try { rec.goalTarget = goal.add(0x18).readS32(); } catch(e) {}
            }

            // Attempt to call GetQuestDisplayProto(questId)
            if (!getDisplay.isNull() && rec.questId) {
                try {
                    var qidStr = stringNew(Memory.allocUtf8String(rec.questId));
                    var argsArr = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
                    argsArr.writePointer(qidStr);
                    var ex = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); ex.writePointer(ptr(0));
                    var disp = rI(getDisplay, inst, argsArr, ex);
                    if (!disp.isNull()) {
                        rec.title = readUtf16Str(disp.add(0x28).readPointer());
                        rec.description = readUtf16Str(disp.add(0x20).readPointer());
                        rec.slot = disp.add(0x30).readS32();
                        rec.iconName = readUtf16Str(disp.add(0x70).readPointer());
                        rec.tagString = readUtf16Str(disp.add(0x58).readPointer());
                        rec.storyEnd = disp.add(0x40).readU8();
                        rec.storyEndDesc = readUtf16Str(disp.add(0x48).readPointer());
                        rec.sortOrder = disp.add(0xd8).readS32();
                        // Subquests at +0x38
                        try {
                            var subRf = disp.add(0x38).readPointer();
                            if (!subRf.isNull()) {
                                var subArr = subRf.add(0x10).readPointer();
                                var subCount = subRf.add(0x18).readS32();
                                if (!subArr.isNull() && subCount > 0) {
                                    var subData = subArr.add(0x20);
                                    var subList = [];
                                    for (var s = 0; s < Math.min(subCount, 20); s++) {
                                        var sd = subData.add(s * 8).readPointer();
                                        if (sd.isNull()) continue;
                                        subList.push({
                                            title: readUtf16Str(sd.add(0x28).readPointer()),
                                            desc: readUtf16Str(sd.add(0x20).readPointer())
                                        });
                                    }
                                    rec.subTasks = subList;
                                }
                            }
                        } catch(e) {}
                    }
                } catch(e) { rec.dispErr = e.toString(); }
            }
            results.push(rec);
        }
        return {active: results, completedIds: completedIds};
    }
};
"""
```

```py
            }
```

`pogo_extract/extract_settings_v2.py`:

```py
"""Single-pass: scan for PokemonSettingsProto klass byte pattern, read each instance's stats."""
import frida, subprocess, json

adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
d = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
sess = d.attach(adb_pid)

js = """
rpc.exports = {
    extract: function() {
        var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
        var exp = {};
        il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) exp[e.name] = e.address; });
        function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(exp[n],r,a); }
        var dG = bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
        var dGA = bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var aGI = bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGN = bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cFN = bind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
        var dom = dG();
        var sp = Memory.alloc(4);
        var asms = dGA(dom, sp); var na = sp.readS32();
        var protoImg = null;
        for (var a=0;a<na;a++){ var i=aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if (iGN(i).readCString()==='holo-protos.dll'){ protoImg=i; break; } }
        var psCls = cFN(protoImg, Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'), Memory.allocUtf8String('PokemonSettingsProto'));
        if (!psCls || psCls.isNull()) return {err:'no PSP class'};

        // Build klass byte pattern (little-endian)
        var bn = BigInt(psCls.toString());
        var pattern = '';
        for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            var b = Number((bn >> BigInt(i*8)) & 0xffn);
            pattern += ('0' + b.toString(16)).slice(-2) + ' ';
        }
        pattern = pattern.trim();

        // Single-pass scan
        var hits = [];
        var ranges = Process.enumerateRanges('rw-');
        for (var r = 0; r < ranges.length; r++) {
            if (ranges[r].size > 256*1024*1024) continue;
            try {
                Memory.scanSync(ranges[r].base, ranges[r].size, pattern).forEach(function(m){
                    hits.push(m.address);
                });
            } catch(e) {}
        }

        // For each hit, try to read PokemonSettingsProto fields
        var seen = {};
        var results = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < hits.length; i++) {
            try {
                var p = hits[i];
                // uniqueId_ (string ptr) at +0x10
                var uniqStr = p.add(0x10).readPointer();
                if (uniqStr.isNull()) continue;
                var len = uniqStr.add(0x10).readS32();
                if (len <= 0 || len > 100) continue;
                var chars = [];
                var ok = true;
                for (var ci = 0; ci < len; ci++) {
                    var c = uniqStr.add(0x14 + ci*2).readU16();
                    if (c < 32 || c > 126) { ok = false; break; }
                    chars.push(String.fromCharCode(c));
                }
                if (!ok) continue;
                var name = chars.join('');
                if (!/^[A-Z][A-Z_0-9]+$/.test(name)) continue;

                // form_ at +0x9c
                var form = p.add(0x9c).readS32();
                // stats_ pointer at +0x30
                var statsPtr = p.add(0x30).readPointer();
                if (statsPtr.isNull()) continue;
                var sta = statsPtr.add(0x10).readS32();
                var atk = statsPtr.add(0x14).readS32();
                var defe = statsPtr.add(0x18).readS32();
                if (sta < 1 || sta > 1000 || atk < 1 || atk > 1000 || defe < 1 || defe > 1000) continue;

                var key = name + '|' + form;
                if (seen[key]) continue;
                seen[key] = true;
                results.push({uniqueId: name, form: form, atk: atk, def: defe, sta: sta});
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        return {ok:true, klass: psCls.toString(), totalHits: hits.length, valid: results.length, results: results};
    }
};
"""
script = sess.create_script(js)
script.load()
print("Scanning for PokemonSettingsProto instances...")
r = script.exports_sync.extract()
print(f"Klass: {r.get('klass')}")
print(f"Total hits: {r.get('totalHits')}")
print(f"Valid extracted: {r.get('valid')}")

# Show samples
for entry in r.get('results', [])[:15]:
    print(f"  {entry['uniqueId']:35s} f={entry['form']:>5}  atk={entry['atk']:>3} def={entry['def']:>3} sta={entry['sta']:>3}")

# Save
with open('all_base_stats.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(r.get('results', []), f, indent=2)
print(f"\nSaved all_base_stats.json")
sess.detach()

```

`pogo_extract/extract_submessages.js`:

```js
/*
 * extract_submessages.js — read MegaEvolutionLevel and LocationCard sub-messages
 * for every PokemonProto in heap. Reads each sub-message's klass + dumps fields
 * via il2cpp_class_get_fields, then by-uid: dereference 0x50 / 0x58 / 0x88 of
 * the live PokemonDisplayProto and read sub-message fields by offset.
 *
 * Sub-message classes (in holo-protos.dll):
 *   Holoholo.Rpc.PokemonMegaEvolutionLevelProto   — pointer at +0x50 of display
 *   Holoholo.Rpc.LocationCardDisplayProto         — pointer at +0x58 of display
 *   Holoholo.Rpc.TempEvoLocationDisplayAttributes — pointer at +0x88 of display
 *
 * Driver flow:
 *   1) probeFields() to learn each class's layout
 *   2) buildProtoIndex() to map uid → live PokemonProto pointer
 *   3) extract({uidList}) returns per-uid {mega, locationCard, tempEvo} structs
 */

var fns = {};
var state = {ready: false, err: null};
var pokemonProtoClass = null;
var protoImage = null;
var displayClass = null;
var megaClass = null;
var locCardClass = null;
var locCardInnerClass = null;
var tempEvoClass = null;

function init() {
    if (state.ready) return true;
    if (state.err) return false;

    var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");
    if (!il2cpp) { state.err = "libil2cpp.so not loaded"; return false; }

    var exp = {};
    il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e) {
        if (e.name.indexOf("il2cpp_") === 0) exp[e.name] = e.address;
    });
    function bind(n, r, a) { return exp[n] ? new NativeFunction(exp[n], r, a) : null; }

    fns.dG  = bind("il2cpp_domain_get",'pointer',[]);
    fns.dGA = bind("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies",'pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
    fns.aGI = bind("il2cpp_assembly_get_image",'pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.iGN = bind("il2cpp_image_get_name",'pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.cFN = bind("il2cpp_class_from_name",'pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
    fns.cGM = bind("il2cpp_class_get_methods",'pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
    fns.mGN = bind("il2cpp_method_get_name",'pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.cGF = bind("il2cpp_class_get_fields",'pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
    fns.fGN = bind("il2cpp_field_get_name",'pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.fGT = bind("il2cpp_field_get_type",'pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.fGO = bind("il2cpp_field_get_offset",'uint32',['pointer']);
    fns.tGN = bind("il2cpp_type_get_name",'pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.tA  = bind("il2cpp_thread_attach",'pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.cN  = bind("il2cpp_class_get_name",'pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.cGNs = bind("il2cpp_class_get_namespace",'pointer',['pointer']);

    var dom = fns.dG();
    fns.tA(dom);

    var sp = Memory.alloc(4);
    var asms = fns.dGA(dom, sp);
    var na = sp.readS32();

    for (var a = 0; a < na; a++) {
        var img = fns.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
        if (fns.iGN(img).readCString() === "holo-protos.dll") { protoImage = img; break; }
    }
    if (!protoImage) { state.err = "holo-protos.dll not found"; return false; }

    pokemonProtoClass = fns.cFN(protoImage,
        Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc"),
        Memory.allocUtf8String("PokemonProto"));
    displayClass = fns.cFN(protoImage,
        Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc"),
        Memory.allocUtf8String("PokemonDisplayProto"));
    megaClass = fns.cFN(protoImage,
        Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc"),
        Memory.allocUtf8String("PokemonMegaEvolutionLevelProto"));
    locCardClass = fns.cFN(protoImage,
        Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc"),
        Memory.allocUtf8String("LocationCardDisplayProto"));
    // Try the inner type at +0x10 of LocationCardDisplayProto.
    locCardInnerClass = fns.cFN(protoImage,
        Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc"),
        Memory.allocUtf8String("LocationCard"));
    tempEvoClass = fns.cFN(protoImage,
        Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc"),
        Memory.allocUtf8String("TempEvoLocationDisplayAttributes"));
    if (!tempEvoClass || tempEvoClass.isNull()) {
        // Try alternate name
        tempEvoClass = fns.cFN(protoImage,
            Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc"),
            Memory.allocUtf8String("PokemonTempEvolutionLocationCardProto"));
    }

    if (!pokemonProtoClass || pokemonProtoClass.isNull()) { state.err = "PokemonProto class missing"; return false; }

    state.ready = true;
    return true;
}

function probeClass(klass, label) {
    if (!klass || klass.isNull()) return {ok:false, err:label + " class null"};
    var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
    var f, fields = [];
    while ((f = fns.cGF(klass, iter)) && !f.isNull()) {
        try {
            fields.push({
                name: fns.fGN(f).readCString(),
                type: fns.tGN(fns.fGT(f)).readCString(),
                offset: fns.fGO(f)
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }
    return {ok:true, klass: klass.toString(), fields: fields};
}

function buildKlassPattern(klass) {
    var bytes = [];
    var t = klass;
    for (var b = 0; b < 8; b++) {
        var v = t.and(0xFF).toInt32();
        bytes.push((v < 16 ? '0' : '') + v.toString(16));
        t = t.shr(8);
    }
    return bytes.join(' ');
}

function heapScan(klass, maxMatches) {
    var pat = buildKlassPattern(klass);
    var ranges = [];
    Process.enumerateRanges('rw-').forEach(function(r) {
        if (r.size > 64*1024*1024) return;
        if (r.size < 4096) return;
        if (r.file) return;
        ranges.push(r);
    });
    var matches = [];
    for (var ri = 0; ri < ranges.length; ri++) {
        try {
            var rs = Memory.scanSync(ranges[ri].base, ranges[ri].size, pat);
            for (var k = 0; k < rs.length; k++) matches.push(rs[k].address);
        } catch(e) {}
        if (maxMatches && matches.length > maxMatches) break;
    }
    return matches;
}

var protoIndex = null;
function buildProtoIndex() {
    var matches = heapScan(pokemonProtoClass, 20000);
    var idx = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) {
        try {
            var addr = matches[i];
            var pid = addr.add(40).readS32();
            if (pid < 1 || pid > 1100) continue;
            var lo = addr.add(32).readS32();
            var hi = addr.add(36).readS32();
            idx[lo + "," + hi] = addr;
        } catch(e) {}
    }
    return idx;
}

// Read a sub-message and dump every field by offset/type via the field metadata.
// fieldMeta: [{name, type, offset}, ...]
// enumTypes: optional Set of type strings that are known enums (read as i32).
function readSubMessage(subPtr, fieldMeta, enumTypes) {
    if (!subPtr || subPtr.isNull()) return null;

    // Sanity: the first 8 bytes of any il2cpp object must be a klass pointer.
    // Don't dereference if it looks invalid.
    try {
        var maybeKlass = subPtr.readPointer();
        if (maybeKlass.isNull()) return null;
    } catch(e) { return null; }

    var out = {addr: subPtr.toString()};
    for (var i = 0; i < fieldMeta.length; i++) {
        var f = fieldMeta[i];
        if (f.offset < 0x10) continue;  // klass + monitor header
        try {
            var t = f.type;
            // Strip namespace
            var simple = t.indexOf('.') >= 0 ? t.substring(t.lastIndexOf('.')+1) : t;
            if (t === "System.Int32" || t === "int" || simple === "Int32") {
                out[f.name] = subPtr.add(f.offset).readS32();
            } else if (t === "System.Int64" || t === "long" || simple === "Int64") {
                out[f.name] = subPtr.add(f.offset).readS64().toString();
            } else if (t === "System.UInt32" || simple === "UInt32") {
                out[f.name] = subPtr.add(f.offset).readU32();
            } else if (t === "System.UInt64" || simple === "UInt64") {
                out[f.name] = subPtr.add(f.offset).readU64().toString();
            } else if (t === "System.Single" || t === "float" || simple === "Single") {
                out[f.name] = subPtr.add(f.offset).readFloat();
            } else if (t === "System.Double" || t === "double" || simple === "Double") {
                out[f.name] = subPtr.add(f.offset).readDouble();
            } else if (t === "System.Boolean" || t === "bool" || simple === "Boolean") {
                out[f.name] = subPtr.add(f.offset).readU8() !== 0;
            } else if (t === "System.Byte" || simple === "Byte") {
                out[f.name] = subPtr.add(f.offset).readU8();
            } else if (t === "System.String" || simple === "String") {
                var sp = subPtr.add(f.offset).readPointer();
                if (sp.isNull()) { out[f.name] = null; continue; }
                var len = sp.add(0x10).readS32();
                if (len < 0 || len > 1000) { out[f.name] = "<bad string len " + len + ">"; continue; }
                var chars = [];
                for (var ci = 0; ci < len; ci++)
                    chars.push(String.fromCharCode(sp.add(0x14 + ci*2).readU16()));
                out[f.name] = chars.join('');
            } else if (t.indexOf("Enum") >= 0 || /Types\+/.test(t) || (enumTypes && enumTypes[t])) {
                // Enums are i32 in IL2CPP
                out[f.name] = subPtr.add(f.offset).readS32();
            } else {
                // For everything else (sub-messages, arrays, etc.) record
                // whether the pointer is non-null and where.
                try {
                    var p = subPtr.add(f.offset).readPointer();
                    if (p.isNull()) {
                        out[f.name] = null;
                    } else {
                        out[f.name + "_ptr"] = p.toString();
                        // Best-effort: also record raw i32/i64 as fallback
                        out[f.name + "_i32"] = subPtr.add(f.offset).readS32();
                        out[f.name + "_i64"] = subPtr.add(f.offset).readS64().toString();
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            }
        } catch(e) { out[f.name + "_err"] = e.message; }
    }
    return out;
}

rpc.exports = {
    initStatus: function() { init(); return {ready: state.ready, err: state.err}; },

    probeFields: function() {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err: state.err};
        return {
            ok: true,
            display:      probeClass(displayClass, "PokemonDisplayProto"),
            mega:         probeClass(megaClass, "PokemonMegaEvolutionLevelProto"),
            locCard:      probeClass(locCardClass, "LocationCardDisplayProto"),
            locCardInner: probeClass(locCardInnerClass, "LocationCard"),
            tempEvo:      probeClass(tempEvoClass, "TempEvoLocationDisplayAttributes"),
        };
    },

    indexPokemon: function() {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err: state.err};
        protoIndex = buildProtoIndex();
        return {ok:true, count: Object.keys(protoIndex).length};
    },

    /* Extract sub-message contents for every pokemon in heap.
     * enumTypes: dict of {type_string: true} for fields that should be read as i32.
     * Returns {uid_str: {mega:{...}, locationCard:{...}, locationCardInner:{...}, tempEvo:{...}, ...}} */
    extractAll: function(megaFields, locFields, locInnerFields, tempFields, enumTypes) {
        if (!init()) return {ok:false, err: state.err};
        if (!protoIndex) protoIndex = buildProtoIndex();

        var results = {};
        var stats = {total: 0, withDisplay: 0, withMega: 0, withLoc: 0, withTemp: 0};

        for (var key in protoIndex) {
            var proto = protoIndex[key];
            stats.total++;
            try {
                var lo = proto.add(32).readS32();
                var hi = proto.add(36).readS32();
                var uidNum = (BigInt(hi) << 32n) | (BigInt(lo) & 0xFFFFFFFFn);
                var uid = uidNum.toString();

                // pokemonDisplay_ at +0xd8 of PokemonProto
                var displayPtr = proto.add(0xd8).readPointer();
                if (displayPtr.isNull()) continue;
                stats.withDisplay++;

                var rec = {uid: uid, displayPtr: displayPtr.toString()};

                // Verify the displayPtr looks valid: its first 8 bytes must be a klass
                // pointer matching displayClass. If not, this is a stale or false PokemonProto.
                try {
                    var dispKlass = displayPtr.readPointer();
                    if (dispKlass.toString() !== displayClass.toString()) continue;
                } catch(e) { continue; }

                var megaPtr = displayPtr.add(0x50).readPointer();
                if (!megaPtr.isNull()) {
                    // Validate sub-message klass
                    try {
                        var mk = megaPtr.readPointer();
                        if (mk.toString() === megaClass.toString()) {
                            rec.megaPtr = megaPtr.toString();
                            rec.mega = readSubMessage(megaPtr, megaFields, enumTypes);
                            if (rec.mega) stats.withMega++;
                        }
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
                var locPtr = displayPtr.add(0x58).readPointer();
                if (!locPtr.isNull()) {
                    try {
                        var lk = locPtr.readPointer();
                        if (lk.toString() === locCardClass.toString()) {
                            rec.locPtr = locPtr.toString();
                            rec.locationCard = readSubMessage(locPtr, locFields, enumTypes);
                            if (rec.locationCard) stats.withLoc++;
                        }
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
                if (tempEvoClass && !tempEvoClass.isNull()) {
                    var tempPtr = displayPtr.add(0x88).readPointer();
                    if (!tempPtr.isNull()) {
                        try {
                            var tk = tempPtr.readPointer();
                            if (tk.toString() === tempEvoClass.toString()) {
                                rec.tempPtr = tempPtr.toString();
                                rec.tempEvo = readSubMessage(tempPtr, tempFields, enumTypes);
                                if (rec.tempEvo) stats.withTemp++;
                            }
                        } catch(e) {}
                    }
                }

                if (rec.mega || rec.locationCard || rec.tempEvo) {
                    results[uid] = rec;
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        return {ok:true, stats: stats, results: results};
    },
};

send({type:"ready", msg:"extract_submessages.js loaded"});

```

`pogo_extract/extract_submessages.py`:

```py
"""extract_submessages.py — read PokemonMegaEvolutionLevelProto + LocationCardDisplayProto
contents for every pokemon, populate DB columns + summarize.

Connects via ZygiskFrida gadget on port 27047 (PoGo MUST be already running).
"""
import frida, json, sqlite3, subprocess, sys, time

DB = 'pokemon.db'
SCRIPT = 'extract_submessages.js'

def log(m): print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] {m}", flush=True)

def attach_gadget():
    subprocess.run(["adb","forward","tcp:27047","tcp:27047"],
                   capture_output=True, timeout=10)
    mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
    d = mgr.add_remote_device("127.0.0.1:27047")
    return d.attach("Gadget")

def main():
    sess = attach_gadget()
    log("attached to Gadget")

    src = open(SCRIPT,"r",encoding="utf-8").read()
    script = sess.create_script(src)
    msgs = []
    def on_msg(m, data):
        if m.get("type") == "send":
            msgs.append(m["payload"])
            p = m["payload"]
            if p.get("type") == "status":
                log(f"  [JS] {p.get('msg')}")
        elif m.get("type") == "error":
            log(f"  [FRIDA-ERR] {m.get('description')}")
    script.on("message", on_msg)
    script.load()
    time.sleep(0.5)

    # init
    st = script.exports_sync.init_status()
    log(f"init: {st}")
    if not st.get("ready"):
        log(f"FAIL: {st}")
        return

    # probe class layouts
    log("probing class layouts...")
    probe = script.exports_sync.probe_fields()
    if not probe.get("ok"):
        log(f"probe failed: {probe}")
        return

    log("--- PokemonMegaEvolutionLevelProto ---")
    mega_fields = probe['mega']['fields']
    for f in mega_fields:
        log(f"  +0x{f['offset']:02x} {f['name']:30s} {f['type']}")

    log("--- LocationCardDisplayProto ---")
    loc_fields = probe['locCard']['fields']
    for f in loc_fields:
        log(f"  +0x{f['offset']:02x} {f['name']:30s} {f['type']}")

    log("--- LocationCard (inner) ---")
    loc_inner_fields = probe.get('locCardInner', {}).get('fields', []) or []
    for f in loc_inner_fields:
        log(f"  +0x{f['offset']:02x} {f['name']:30s} {f['type']}")

    log("--- TempEvoLocationDisplayAttributes ---")
    temp_fields = probe.get('tempEvo', {}).get('fields', []) or []
    for f in temp_fields:
        log(f"  +0x{f['offset']:02x} {f['name']:30s} {f['type']}")

    # save the schema so we know what columns to add to the DB
    with open('submessage_schema.json','w') as f:
        json.dump({
            'mega': mega_fields,
            'locationCard': loc_fields,
            'locationCardInner': loc_inner_fields,
            'tempEvo': temp_fields,
        }, f, indent=2)
    log("saved submessage_schema.json")

    # index pokemon protos
    log("indexing PokemonProto in heap...")
    idx = script.exports_sync.index_pokemon()
    log(f"index: {idx}")

    # Detect enum classes: heuristic = has a value__ field at +0x10 + other "fields"
    # at offset 0 (the enum constants). Pass these type names to the extractor so
    # it reads them as i32 instead of dereferencing as a sub-message pointer.
    def is_enum(probe_entry):
        if not probe_entry or not probe_entry.get('fields'): return False
        names = [f['name'] for f in probe_entry['fields']]
        return 'value__' in names

    enum_types = {}
    if is_enum(probe.get('locCardInner')):
        # probe response gave us the type literal as Holoholo.Rpc.LocationCard
        enum_types['Holoholo.Rpc.LocationCard'] = True
    log(f"enum types: {list(enum_types.keys())}")

    # extract sub-messages
    log("extracting sub-messages...")
    res = script.exports_sync.extract_all(mega_fields, loc_fields, loc_inner_fields, temp_fields, enum_types)
    if not res.get("ok"):
        log(f"extract failed: {res}")
        return
    stats = res['stats']
    results = res['results']
    log(f"stats: {stats}")
    log(f"got {len(results)} pokemon with non-null sub-messages")

    with open('submessage_results.json','w') as f:
        json.dump(res, f, indent=2)
    log("saved submessage_results.json")

    # populate DB
    log("populating DB columns...")
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    c = conn.cursor()

    # Build column list from probed fields. Prefix with mega_ / loc_ / temp_.
    def col_list(prefix, fields):
        out = []
        for f in fields:
            if f['offset'] < 0x10: continue
            t = f['type']
            simple = t.split('.')[-1]
            if simple in ('Int32','UInt32','Int64','UInt64','Byte','Boolean'):
                col_type = 'INTEGER'
            elif simple in ('Single','Double'):
                col_type = 'REAL'
            elif simple == 'String':
                col_type = 'TEXT'
            else:
                # sub-pointer: just 0/1 flag column
                col_type = 'INTEGER'
            out.append((prefix + f['name'].rstrip('_'), col_type, f['name'], simple))
        return out

    mega_cols = col_list('mega_', mega_fields)
    loc_cols = col_list('loc_', loc_fields)
    # loc_inner is the enum constant list, not real instance fields - don't add columns
    temp_cols = col_list('temp_', temp_fields)

    existing = {row[1] for row in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(pokemon)").fetchall()}
    all_cols = []
    for cols in [mega_cols, loc_cols, temp_cols]:
        for col_name, col_type, _, _ in cols:
            if col_name not in existing:
                c.execute(f"ALTER TABLE pokemon ADD COLUMN \"{col_name}\" {col_type}")
                log(f"  added {col_name} {col_type}")
            all_cols.append(col_name)

    # Reset all sub-message columns to NULL so stale data from previous runs is cleared.
    if all_cols:
        sql = "UPDATE pokemon SET " + ", ".join([f'"{c}"=NULL' for c in all_cols])
        c.execute(sql)
        log(f"  reset {len(all_cols)} columns to NULL")

    # Update rows. Match by uid (signed int64).
    n = 0
    for uid_str, rec in results.items():
        # Convert uid to signed int64 to match DB storage
        uid_unsigned = int(uid_str)
        if uid_unsigned >= (1 << 63):
            uid_signed = uid_unsigned - (1 << 64)
        elif uid_unsigned < -(1 << 63):
            uid_signed = uid_unsigned + (1 << 64)
        else:
            uid_signed = uid_unsigned

        sets = []
        vals = []
        for prefix, fields, sub in [
            ('mega_', mega_cols, rec.get('mega')),
            ('loc_',  loc_cols,  rec.get('locationCard')),
            ('temp_', temp_cols, rec.get('tempEvo')),
        ]:
            if not sub: continue
            for col_name, col_type, src_name, simple in fields:
                v = sub.get(src_name)
                if v is None and simple not in ('String',):
                    # Some types (sub-pointers) get suffixed with _ptr/_i32/_i64
                    v_ptr = sub.get(src_name + "_ptr")
                    if v_ptr is not None:
                        v = 1 if v_ptr != "0x0" else 0
                if v is None: continue
                if isinstance(v, bool): v = 1 if v else 0
                sets.append(f'"{col_name}"=?')
                vals.append(v)

        if not sets: continue
        vals.append(uid_signed)
        sql = f'UPDATE pokemon SET {", ".join(sets)} WHERE uid=?'
        c.execute(sql, vals)
        if c.rowcount > 0:
            n += 1

    conn.commit()
    log(f"updated {n} rows")

    # Build lookup: location card enum int -> name
    loc_card_names = {}  # int -> name
    for f in loc_inner_fields:
        if f['name'] == 'value__': continue
        # Each enum constant has its int value... but we don't have it in metadata.
        # Index by declaration order starting at 0 (Unset=0, then enumerated).
        loc_card_names[len(loc_card_names)] = f['name']

    # Save mapping so users can lookup by int
    with open('location_card_enum.json','w') as f:
        json.dump(loc_card_names, f, indent=2)
    log(f"saved location_card_enum.json ({len(loc_card_names)} cards)")

    # Summary
    log("\n=== SUMMARY ===")

    log(f"\nMega evolution levels (mega_Level distribution):")
    for r in c.execute('SELECT mega_Level, count(*) FROM pokemon WHERE mega_Level IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mega_Level ORDER BY 2 DESC'):
        log(f"  level={r[0]}: {r[1]} pokemon")

    log(f"\nMega Points distribution:")
    for r in c.execute('SELECT mega_Points, count(*) FROM pokemon WHERE mega_Points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mega_Points ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 30'):
        log(f"  points={r[0]}: {r[1]} pokemon")

    log(f"\nUnique location cards (loc_LocationCard enum int -> name):")
    for r in c.execute('SELECT loc_LocationCard, count(*) FROM pokemon WHERE loc_LocationCard IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loc_LocationCard ORDER BY 2 DESC'):
        ev = loc_card_names.get(r[0], f"?{r[0]}")
        log(f"  {r[0]:5d} ({ev}): {r[1]} pokemon")

    log("\nSample LocationCard pokemon (species, card_int, card_name):")
    for r in c.execute('SELECT species_name, loc_LocationCard FROM pokemon WHERE loc_LocationCard IS NOT NULL ORDER BY species_name LIMIT 25'):
        ev = loc_card_names.get(r[1], f"?{r[1]}")
        log(f"  {r[0]:20s} {r[1]:5d} {ev}")

    # Coverage check
    coverage_q = '''
        SELECT
            (SELECT count(*) FROM pokemon WHERE has_mega_evolution_level=1) AS flag_mega,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM pokemon WHERE mega_Level IS NOT NULL) AS got_mega,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM pokemon WHERE has_location_card=1) AS flag_loc,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM pokemon WHERE loc_LocationCard IS NOT NULL) AS got_loc
    '''
    cov = c.execute(coverage_q).fetchone()
    log(f"\nCoverage:")
    log(f"  has_mega_evolution_level=1: {cov[0]}, populated: {cov[1]} (missing: {cov[0]-cov[1]})")
    log(f"  has_location_card=1:        {cov[2]}, populated: {cov[3]} (missing: {cov[2]-cov[3]})")

    log("\nSample Mega pokemon (species, points, level):")
    for r in c.execute('SELECT species_name, mega_Points, mega_Level FROM pokemon WHERE has_mega_evolution_level=1 ORDER BY species_name LIMIT 20'):
        log(f"  {r[0]:20s} points={r[1]} level={r[2]}")

    conn.close()
    log("done")
    try: sess.detach()
    except: pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`pogo_extract/extract_tag_ids.py`:

```py
"""Extract pokemonTagIds_ (RepeatedField<UInt64> @ +0x180 of PokemonProto) for every
pokemon in pokemon.db, write a tag_ids column (semicolon-separated tag IDs).

Strategy:
  1. Connect to the ZygiskFrida-injected gadget on 127.0.0.1:27047 (port forwarded via adb).
  2. Load bulk_tag.js, call init + indexPokemon to build the heap proto index.
  3. Hook ALL TaggingRpcService methods so we capture a real instance when the user
     opens the tag manager (per the working recipe: capturing real instances yields
     fully-loaded RepeatedField structures since the tag manager forces materialization).
  4. Probe the RepeatedField layout against the known-tagged Cinderace
     (uid_hex c9094ad9544fd198, tagged "U" = tag id 6). Find which (countOff, itemsOff,
     dataOff) triple yields [6].
  5. Run extractAllTagIds with the discovered offsets.
  6. Update pokemon.db: add tag_ids column (TEXT), populate per-uid.
"""
import argparse, frida, json, os, sqlite3, sys, time

WD = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DB = os.path.join(WD, "pokemon.db")
JS = os.path.join(WD, "bulk_tag.js")
GADGET = "127.0.0.1:27047"

# Known-tagged Cinderace from prior runs - tagged "U" (tag id 6)
KNOWN_UID_HEX = "c9094ad9544fd198"
KNOWN_TAG_ID = "6"

def log(m): print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] {m}", flush=True)

def uid_hex_to_low_high(uid_hex):
    """uid_hex is the literal byte ordering as seen on heap (low32 then high32, little-endian within each).
    PokemonProto +32 is int32 low, +36 is int32 high. The hex string in pokemon.db
    is the uid as 8 bytes big-endian text, but the heap layout reads them as 2 signed int32s.
    See run_bulk_tag.py: low = uid & 0xFFFFFFFF, high = (uid >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF, then sign-correct."""
    # uid_hex is e.g. "c9094ad9544fd198" — that's the uid as a 64-bit unsigned in hex (big-endian textual).
    # But pokemon.db stores uid as signed int64 too; let's use uid_hex as a literal hex value.
    u = int(uid_hex, 16)
    low = u & 0xFFFFFFFF
    high = (u >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    if low > 0x7FFFFFFF: low -= 0x100000000
    if high > 0x7FFFFFFF: high -= 0x100000000
    return low, high

def uid_signed_to_low_high(uid):
    """uid is signed int64 as stored in DB."""
    u = uid & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    low = u & 0xFFFFFFFF
    high = (u >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    if low > 0x7FFFFFFF: low -= 0x100000000
    if high > 0x7FFFFFFF: high -= 0x100000000
    return low, high

def attach_gadget():
    mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
    d = mgr.add_remote_device(GADGET)
    # The gadget has one process: the host app (PoGo). Pick the first/only one.
    procs = d.enumerate_processes()
    if not procs:
        raise RuntimeError("no processes on gadget")
    p = procs[0]
    log(f"gadget device: pid={p.pid} name={p.name}")
    return d.attach(p.pid)

def make_handler(captured_status):
    def on_msg(msg, data):
        if msg.get("type") == "send":
            p = msg["payload"]
            t = p.get("type", "?")
            if t == "methods":
                captured_status["methods"] = p.get("data", [])
            else:
                m = p.get("msg", json.dumps(p))
                log(f"  [JS {t}] {str(m)[:300]}")
        elif msg.get("type") == "error":
            log(f"  [FRIDA-ERR] {msg.get('description')}")
    return on_msg

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("phase", choices=["probe", "extract", "all"], default="all", nargs="?",
                    help="probe = just dump RepeatedField for the known Cinderace; "
                         "extract = run full extraction (assumes offsets are already known); "
                         "all = probe then extract.")
    ap.add_argument("--hook-seconds", type=int, default=60,
                    help="seconds to leave hooks running while user opens tag manager")
    ap.add_argument("--count-off", type=lambda x:int(x,0), default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--items-off", type=lambda x:int(x,0), default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--data-off",  type=lambda x:int(x,0), default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--no-hook", action="store_true",
                    help="skip the hookForRealInstance step (use if proto index already populated)")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    sess = attach_gadget()
    src = open(JS, "r", encoding="utf-8").read()
    script = sess.create_script(src)
    captured = {"methods": []}
    script.on("message", make_handler(captured))
    script.load()
    log("script loaded")

    log("init...")
    st = script.exports_sync.init_status()
    log(f"  init: {st}")
    if not st.get("ready"):
        log(f"init failed: {st.get('err')}"); sys.exit(2)

    log("indexing pokemon protos in heap...")
    res = script.exports_sync.index_pokemon()
    log(f"  index: {res}")
    if not res.get("ok"):
        log("index failed"); sys.exit(2)

    # Enumerate PokemonTagProto instances to build snowflake-id -> name map.
    log("enumerating PokemonTagProto instances on heap...")
    tp = script.exports_sync.enumerate_tag_protos()
    snowflake_to_name = {}
    if tp.get("ok"):
        log(f"  found {tp.get('count')} unique tag protos (scanned {tp.get('scanned')})")
        for r in tp.get("results", []):
            name = r.get("name")
            if not name: continue
            # Save every candidate u64 under this name for later resolution.
            for k, v in r.items():
                if k.endswith("_u64") or k.endswith("_i64"):
                    snowflake_to_name.setdefault(v, set()).add(name)
        with open(os.path.join(WD, "_tag_proto_dump.json"), "w") as f:
            json.dump(tp.get("results", []), f, indent=2)
    else:
        log(f"  enumerate_tag_protos failed: {tp}")

    # Hook to force real-instance materialization (and refresh tag fields).
    if not args.no_hook:
        log(f"hooking ALL TaggingRpcService methods for {args.hook_seconds}s")
        h = script.exports_sync.hook_for_real_instance(args.hook_seconds)
        log(f"  hooked {h.get('hookedCount')} methods")
        log(f"INTERACT: open the in-game tag manager and scroll through pokemon for {args.hook_seconds}s.")
        for left in range(args.hook_seconds, 0, -10):
            log(f"  {left}s remaining")
            time.sleep(min(10, left))
        captured_pointers = script.exports_sync.get_captured()
        n = len(captured_pointers.get("captured", {}))
        log(f"  captured {n} this-pointer(s) on TaggingRpcService")

    # Re-index after interaction (heap may have grown).
    log("re-indexing protos after hook window...")
    res = script.exports_sync.index_pokemon()
    log(f"  re-index: {res}")

    if args.phase in ("probe", "all"):
        log(f"PROBE: dumping RepeatedField for known Cinderace {KNOWN_UID_HEX}")
        low, high = uid_hex_to_low_high(KNOWN_UID_HEX)
        log(f"  low={low} high={high}")
        dump = script.exports_sync.dump_repeated_field(low, high)
        if not dump.get("ok"):
            log(f"probe failed: {dump}"); sys.exit(2)

        # Find a trial with count==1 and items pointer dereferenceable + the data
        # variant whose first id is plausibly a snowflake tag ID (NOT zero, NOT a
        # pointer-shaped value). PokemonTagIds_ stores 64-bit PokemonTagProto.id
        # values (snowflake-shaped), so we look for a non-zero u64 below
        # 2^63 and not in a pointer range.
        trials = dump["dump"].get("trials", [])
        winner = None
        for t in trials:
            if t.get("count") != 1: continue
            for variant_key in ("ids_at_data_0x20", "ids_at_data_0x10", "ids_at_data_0x00"):
                ids = t.get(variant_key, [])
                if not ids: continue
                v = int(ids[0])
                # Heuristic: snowflake IDs are ~10^17 to 10^19; pointers > 10^19.
                if 1 <= v < 10**19 and v < 0x7fffffffffffffff:
                    data_off = int(variant_key.rsplit("_", 1)[-1], 16)
                    winner = (int(t["countOff"], 16), int(t["itemsOff"], 16), data_off, t.get("count"), v)
                    log(f"  WINNER: countOff={hex(winner[0])} itemsOff={hex(winner[1])} dataOff={hex(winner[2])} count={winner[3]} sample_id={winner[4]}")
                    break
            if winner: break

        if not winner:
            log("could not find plausible RepeatedField layout for Cinderace")
            print(json.dumps(trials, indent=2))
            if args.phase == "all":
                log("aborting full extraction"); sys.exit(2)
        else:
            with open(os.path.join(WD, "_tag_repeated_field_offsets.json"), "w") as f:
                json.dump({"countOff":winner[0], "itemsOff":winner[1], "dataOff":winner[2]}, f)

    # Resolve offsets for extraction.
    if args.phase == "extract" or args.phase == "all":
        if args.count_off is not None and args.items_off is not None and args.data_off is not None:
            count_off, items_off, data_off = args.count_off, args.items_off, args.data_off
        else:
            try:
                with open(os.path.join(WD, "_tag_repeated_field_offsets.json")) as f:
                    off = json.load(f)
                count_off, items_off, data_off = off["countOff"], off["itemsOff"], off["dataOff"]
            except Exception:
                log("no offsets known and --count-off/--items-off/--data-off not provided"); sys.exit(2)

        log(f"EXTRACT: countOff={hex(count_off)} itemsOff={hex(items_off)} dataOff={hex(data_off)}")
        result = script.exports_sync.extract_all_tag_ids(count_off, items_off, data_off)
        if not result.get("ok"):
            log(f"extract failed: {result}"); sys.exit(2)
        stats = result["stats"]
        results = result["results"]
        log(f"  stats: {stats}")
        log(f"  pokemon with >=1 tag: {len(results)}")

        # Save raw JSON snapshot for forensics.
        with open(os.path.join(WD, "tag_ids_extracted.json"), "w") as f:
            json.dump({"stats":stats, "uid_to_tag_ids":results}, f)
        log(f"  wrote tag_ids_extracted.json ({len(results)} tagged pokemon)")

        # Update pokemon.db.
        log("updating pokemon.db...")
        conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cols = [r[1] for r in cur.execute("PRAGMA table_info(pokemon)").fetchall()]
        if "tag_ids" not in cols:
            cur.execute("ALTER TABLE pokemon ADD COLUMN tag_ids TEXT")
            log("  added tag_ids column")

        # Build uid -> tag_ids string. Match by signed int64 uid.
        # uid in pokemon.db is signed int64; results keys are decimal-string uids
        # produced by JS as (BigInt(hi)<<32n)|(BigInt(lo)&0xFFFFFFFFn) — that's the
        # 64-bit value reinterpreted as unsigned. Convert to signed for join.
        updates = []
        for uid_unsigned_str, ids in results.items():
            u = int(uid_unsigned_str)
            if u >= 0x8000000000000000:
                u -= 0x10000000000000000
            updates.append((";".join(ids), u))

        # Clear old values first (re-runs).
        cur.execute("UPDATE pokemon SET tag_ids = NULL")
        cur.executemany("UPDATE pokemon SET tag_ids = ? WHERE uid = ?", updates)
        n_updated = sum(1 for _ in cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM pokemon WHERE tag_ids IS NOT NULL"))
        conn.commit()
        log(f"  rows updated: {n_updated}")

        # Summary report.
        log("=== SUMMARY ===")
        total = cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon").fetchone()[0]
        with_tag = cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE tag_ids IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0]
        log(f"  total pokemon: {total}")
        log(f"  pokemon with >=1 tag: {with_tag}")

        # Tag-ID distribution.
        from collections import Counter
        cnt = Counter()
        for (s,) in cur.execute("SELECT tag_ids FROM pokemon WHERE tag_ids IS NOT NULL"):
            for t in s.split(";"):
                cnt[t] += 1
        # Load tag definitions for label.
        try:
            tagdefs = json.load(open(os.path.join(WD, "tag_definitions.json")))
        except Exception:
            tagdefs = {}
        log("  tag distribution:")
        # Build snowflake -> name from earlier enumeration. The extracted tag
        # IDs are unsigned-decimal strings; snowflake_to_name has both signed
        # and unsigned forms collected from heap probes. Try both.
        sf2name = {}
        for tag_id in cnt:
            names = snowflake_to_name.get(tag_id, set())
            if not names:
                # Try signed-twin
                try:
                    u = int(tag_id)
                    if u >= 0x8000000000000000:
                        signed = u - 0x10000000000000000
                    elif u < 0:
                        signed = u + 0x10000000000000000
                    else:
                        signed = u
                    names = snowflake_to_name.get(str(signed), set())
                except: pass
            if names:
                sf2name[tag_id] = sorted(names)[0]
        for tag_id, n in sorted(cnt.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1]):
            name = sf2name.get(tag_id, "?")
            log(f"    tag {tag_id:>22} ({name:<18}): {n}")

        # Verify the known Cinderace.
        row = cur.execute("SELECT uid_hex, species_name, tag_ids FROM pokemon WHERE uid_hex=?",
                          (KNOWN_UID_HEX,)).fetchone()
        log(f"  CINDERACE check: {row}")
        conn.close()

    log("done. detaching.")
    try: sess.detach()
    except: pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```py
"""Find and tag the remaining 2 Evolve Me adds (Scatterbug Ocean + Tandemaus)."""
import frida, json, time, subprocess, sqlite3
adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
print(f'PID: {adb_pid}')
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
d = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
sess = d.attach(adb_pid)

BAG = '0x798ae7c780'
SVC = '0x798a77fd00'
ADD_UIDS_HEX = ['4c808fe3eb3d1cbe', '447d2d2b9ac25db8']

c = sqlite3.connect('pokemon.db').cursor()
def to_uid_str(uid):
    u = int(uid); return str(u if u >= 0 else u + 2**64)
def hex_to_uid_str(uh):
    r = c.execute("SELECT uid FROM pokemon WHERE uid_hex=?", (uh,)).fetchone()
    return to_uid_str(r[0]) if r else None
add_str = [hex_to_uid_str(u) for u in ADD_UIDS_HEX]
print(f"Looking for uid_strs: {add_str}")

# Re-walk bag and dump matching keys
js_walk = """
rpc.exports = {
    walkAndFind: function(bag, uids) {
        var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
        var exp = {};
        il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) exp[e.name] = e.address; });
        function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(exp[n],r,a); }
        var dG = bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
        var dGA = bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var aGI = bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGN = bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cFN = bind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
        var cMN = bind('il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','int']);
        var rI = bind('il2cpp_runtime_invoke','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer','pointer']);
        var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = dGA(dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();
        var gi = null;
        for (var a=0;a<na;a++){ var i=aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if (iGN(i).readCString()==='holo-game.dll'){ gi=i; break; } }
        var cls = cFN(gi, Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Internal'), Memory.allocUtf8String('PokemonBagImpl'));
        var ga = cMN(cls, Memory.allocUtf8String('get_AllPokemon'), 0);
        var inst = ptr(bag);
        var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var values = rI(ga, inst, ptr(0), exc);
        var lhm = values.add(0x10).readPointer();
        var list = lhm.add(0x18).readPointer();
        var head = list.add(0x10).readPointer();
        var count = list.add(0x18).readS32();
        var wanted = {}; for (var i = 0; i < uids.length; i++) wanted[uids[i]] = true;
        var found = {}; var allKeys = []; var node = head; var iters = 0;
        while (node && !node.isNull() && iters < count + 200) {
            try {
                var key = node.add(0x28).readU64().toString();
                allKeys.push(key);
                if (wanted[key]) found[key] = node.add(0x30).readPointer().toString();
                var next = node.add(0x18).readPointer();
                if (next.isNull() || next.equals(head)) break;
                node = next;
            } catch(e) { break; }
            iters++;
        }
        return {iters: iters, totalKeys: allKeys.length, found: found, sampleLastKeys: allKeys.slice(-5), sampleFirstKeys: allKeys.slice(0,5)};
    }
};
"""
walker = sess.create_script(js_walk)
walker.load()
r = walker.exports_sync.walk_and_find(BAG, add_str)
print(f"Walked iters={r['iters']} keys={r['totalKeys']}")
print(f"  first 5: {r['sampleFirstKeys']}")
print(f"  last 5: {r['sampleLastKeys']}")
print(f"Found: {r['found']}")
walker.unload()

# If found, tag them
if r['found']:
    script = sess.create_script(open('bulk_tag.js','r',encoding='utf-8').read())
    script.load()
    script.exports_sync.init_status()
    ftid = script.exports_sync.find_tag_id_by_name(SVC, 'Evolve Me')
    print(f"\ntag idx={ftid['idx']}")
    ptrs = list(r['found'].values())
    print(f"Tagging {len(ptrs)} ptrs...")
    res = script.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ftid['tagProtoAddr'], ptrs)
    print(f"  result: {res}")
    time.sleep(2)
    chk = script.exports_sync.get_pokemon_for_tag(SVC, ftid['idx'])
    print(f"\nFinal Evolve Me count: {chk.get('dump',{}).get('+0x18_listish',{}).get('count','?')}")
else:
    print("\n!! Neither uid found in bag walk - they might have evolved or been transferred")
    # Check current state
    for uh in ADD_UIDS_HEX:
        rr = c.execute("SELECT in_bag, species_name, form, iv_total FROM pokemon WHERE uid_hex=?", (uh,)).fetchone()
        print(f"  {uh}: {rr}")
sess.detach()
```

```py
"""Final round of digging."""
import json, struct, sqlite3, math
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

data = json.load(open('pokemon_v3.json'))
db = sqlite3.connect('pokemon.db')
c = db.cursor()

c.execute('SELECT uid_hex, pokemon_id, species_name, is_traded, is_lucky, is_hatched_from_egg, is_best_buddy, '
          'level, alignment, alignment_name, costume, original_owner, special_bg_id, location_bg_id, cp, '
          'origin_detail_name, num_additional_cpm, deployed_fort_id, weather_boosted '
          'FROM pokemon')
known = {row[0]: row for row in c.fetchall()}

paired = []
for p in data:
    raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
    if len(raw) < 1000: continue
    bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
    uid_int = struct.unpack_from('<Q', bs, 32)[0]
    uid_hex = f'{uid_int:016x}'
    if uid_hex not in known: continue
    paired.append((bs, known[uid_hex]))

# 336=is_mega_evolved (byte=1, 154 entries)
# 340=mega_level (1 or 2, 17/19 entries)
# 344=mega_cp (int, varies)
# 348=mega_cpm_extra (float, ~1.0)
# 352=mega_cpm (CPM-like float)

for bs, k in paired[:5]:
    if bs[336] == 1:
        v336 = bs[336]
        v340 = bs[340]
        v344 = struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, 344)[0]
        v348 = struct.unpack_from('<f', bs, 348)[0]

        # Display info
```

`pogo_extract/find_all_fields.py`:

```py
"""
Find offsets for ALL remaining fields by matching known PoGO counts:
- 374 hatched (hatchedFromEgg_)
- 284 event/costume
- 232 current best buddy
- 89 special background
- 19 adventure effect
- 14 location background
- buddyKmWalked_ (float)
- numUpgrades_ (int)
- battlesAttacked_, battlesDefended_ (int)
"""
import json, struct
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

data = json.load(open('pokemon_v3.json'))
print(f"Loaded {len(data)} pokemon")

TARGETS = [
    ('hatched', 374, 30),
    ('event', 284, 20),
    ('current_best_buddy', 232, 30),
    ('special_bg', 89, 15),
    ('gigantamax_capable', 84, 10),
    ('shadow', 229, 10),  # already known: alignment+1=SHADOW at +36, but might be cross-check
    ('mega_capable', 282, 30),
    ('dynamax', 224, 25),
    ('purified', 63, 10),
    ('adventure_effect', 19, 5),
    ('location_bg', 14, 4),
]

def search_byte_value(target, tol, val, source='proto'):
    """Find byte offsets where exactly `val` appears `target±tol` times."""
    found = []
    for off in range(0, 600 if source == 'proto' else 200):
        cnt = 0
        for p in data:
            raw = p.get('raw_proto' if source == 'proto' else 'display_raw') or ''
            if len(raw) < 100: continue
            bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
            if off < len(bs) and bs[off] == val:
                cnt += 1
        if target - tol <= cnt <= target + tol:
            found.append((off, cnt))
    return found

def search_int32(target, tol, val=None, source='proto'):
    """Find int32 offsets where value matches target count."""
    found = []
    rng = range(0, 600 if source == 'proto' else 200, 4)
    for off in rng:
        if val is not None:
            cnt = 0
            for p in data:
                raw = p.get('raw_proto' if source == 'proto' else 'display_raw') or ''
                if len(raw) < 100: continue
                bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
                if off + 4 > len(bs): continue
                v = struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, off)[0]
                if v == val: cnt += 1
            if target - tol <= cnt <= target + tol:
                found.append((off, cnt))
        else:
            # Find offsets with NONZERO count near target
            cnt = 0
            for p in data:
                raw = p.get('raw_proto' if source == 'proto' else 'display_raw') or ''
                if len(raw) < 100: continue
                bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
                if off + 4 > len(bs): continue
                v = struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, off)[0]
                if v != 0: cnt += 1
            if target - tol <= cnt <= target + tol:
                found.append((off, cnt))
    return found

print("\n=== Bool fields in PROTO (byte=1) ===")
for label, tgt, tol in TARGETS:
    matches = search_byte_value(tgt, tol, 1, 'proto')
    if matches:
        print(f"  [{label}={tgt}±{tol}]:")
        for off, cnt in matches[:5]:
            print(f"    PROTO byte +{off} == 1: {cnt}")

print("\n=== Bool fields in DISPLAY (byte=1) ===")
for label, tgt, tol in TARGETS:
    matches = search_byte_value(tgt, tol, 1, 'display')
    if matches:
        print(f"  [{label}={tgt}±{tol}]:")
        for off, cnt in matches[:3]:
            print(f"    DISPLAY byte +{off} == 1: {cnt}")

print("\n=== Int32=1 in PROTO ===")
for label, tgt, tol in TARGETS:
    matches = search_int32(tgt, tol, 1, 'proto')
    if matches:
        print(f"  [{label}={tgt}±{tol}]:")
        for off, cnt in matches[:3]:
            print(f"    PROTO int32 +{off} == 1: {cnt}")

print("\n=== Int32 NONZERO in PROTO (after offset 280) ===")
for label, tgt, tol in TARGETS:
    matches = []
    for off in range(280, 600, 4):
        cnt = 0
        for p in data:
            raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
            if len(raw) < 600: continue
            bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
            if off + 4 > len(bs): continue
            v = struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, off)[0]
            if v != 0: cnt += 1
        if tgt - tol <= cnt <= tgt + tol:
            matches.append((off, cnt))
    if matches:
        print(f"  [{label}={tgt}±{tol}]:")
        for off, cnt in matches[:3]:
            print(f"    PROTO int32 NONZERO +{off}: {cnt}")

# Also look for floats (buddy km walked - varies 0-thousands)
print("\n=== FLOAT fields with positive values (potential buddyKmWalked) ===")
float_offsets = defaultdict(int)
for p in data:
    raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
    if len(raw) < 600: continue
    bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
    for off in range(0, min(508, len(bs)), 4):
        if off in [104, 108, 124, 172, 348, 352, 376, 384]: continue  # known floats
        v = struct.unpack_from('<f', bs, off)[0]
        if 0.001 < v < 50000 and v == v:
            float_offsets[off] += 1

print("Float offsets with 30-1000 set values:")
for off, cnt in sorted(float_offsets.items()):
    if 30 < cnt < 1000:
        # Sample
        samples = []
        for p in data:
            raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
            if len(raw) < 600: continue
            bs = bytes.fromhex(raw)
            if off + 4 > len(bs): continue
            v = struct.unpack_from('<f', bs, off)[0]
            if 0.001 < v < 50000 and v == v:
                samples.append(round(v, 3))
                if len(samples) >= 5: break
        print(f"  +{off}: {cnt} pokemon. Samples: {samples}")
```

`pogo_extract/find_cities.py`:

```py
"""READ-ONLY: brute-force the templateId offset on BOTH QuestsProto lists
(+0x10 active, +0x20 the 78-entry container) to find completed City challenges
and any Mega Mewtwo / Expert / choice research. No writes."""
import sys, time, subprocess

ADB = '100.98.158.56:5555'

hook_js = r"""
var qInst=null;
function init(){var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');var A={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){if(e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0)A[e.name]=e.address;});

"""
hs = sess.create_script(hook_js); hs.on('message', lambda m, dd: None); hs.load(); hs.exports_sync.setup()
print('capturing QuestService...')
inst = None
for i in range(45):
    time.sleep(1)
    g = hs.exports_sync.get()
    if g.get('q'):
        inst = g['q']; break
hs.unload()
if not inst:
    print('NO_INSTANCE'); sess.detach(); sys.exit(1)
print('inst', inst)

js = r"""
rpc.exports = { scan: function(addr){
  var inst=ptr(addr);
  var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');var A={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){if(e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0)A[e.name]=e.address;});
  function b(n,r,a){return new NativeFunction(A[n],r,a);}
  var dG=b('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]),dGA=b('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),aGI=b('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']),iGN=b('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),cFN=b('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']),cMN=b('il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','int']),rI=b('il2cpp_runtime_invoke','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer','pointer']);
  var sp=Memory.alloc(4),asms=dGA(dG(),sp),na=sp.readS32(),gi=null;for(var a=0;a<na;a++){var i=aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(iGN(i).readCString()==='holo-game.dll'){gi=i;break;}}
  var qs=cFN(gi,Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Quests'),Memory.allocUtf8String('QuestService'));
  function rdStr(p){try{if(p.isNull())return '';var len=p.add(0x10).readS32();if(len<=0||len>120)return '';var c=[];for(var i=0;i<len;i++){var ch=p.add(0x14+i*2).readU16();if(ch<32||ch>126)return '';c.push(String.fromCharCode(ch));}return c.join('');}catch(e){return '';}}
  function tidOf(qp){ // brute-force: find a templateId-looking string at a pointer field
    var offs=[0x40,0x10,0x18,0x20,0x28,0x30,0x38,0x48,0x50,0x58,0x60];
    for(var k=0;k<offs.length;k++){try{var p=qp.add(offs[k]).readPointer();var s=rdStr(p);if(s.length>=5&&s.indexOf('_')>=0&&/^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$/.test(s))return {t:s,o:offs[k]};}catch(e){}}
    return null;
  }
  var getProto=cMN(qs,Memory.allocUtf8String('get_QuestsProto'),0);
  var ex=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);ex.writePointer(ptr(0));
  var po=rI(getProto,inst,ptr(0),ex); if(po.isNull())return {error:'null'};
  var res={};
  [0x10,0x20].forEach(function(field){
    try{
      var rf=po.add(field).readPointer(); if(rf.isNull())return;
      var cnt=rf.add(0x18).readS32(); var arr=rf.add(0x10).readPointer(); if(arr.isNull()||cnt<=0||cnt>3000)return;
      var items=[];
      for(var i=0;i<Math.min(cnt,200);i++){
        var qp=arr.add(0x20).add(i*8).readPointer(); if(qp.isNull())continue;
        var r=tidOf(qp); if(!r)continue;
        var st=-1,pr=-1; try{st=qp.add(0x58).readS32();pr=qp.add(0x48).readS32();}catch(e){}
        items.push({tid:r.t, st:st, pr:pr});
      }
      res['+0x'+field.toString(16)]={count:cnt, items:items};
    }catch(e){res['+0x'+field.toString(16)]={err:String(e)};}
  });
  return res;
}};
"""
sc = sess.create_script(js); sc.load()
r = sc.exports_sync.scan(inst)
sess.detach()
STAT = {0: 'inact', 1: 'active', 2: 'COMPLETE', 3: 'claimed', -1: '?'}
for field, info in r.items():
    if 'err' in info:
        print(f"\n{field}: ERR {info['err']}"); continue
    items = info.get('items', [])
    print(f"\n=== QuestsProto {field} : {info['count']} entries, {len(items)} tids decoded ===")
    # GO Fest / city / mewtwo / expert ones first
    key = [x for x in items if any(k in x['tid'].upper() for k in ['IRL_CITY', 'GOFEST', 'GO_FEST', 'MEWTWO', 'EXPERT', 'CHALLENGE', 'CITY', 'DISTRICT', 'TOKYO'])]
    print(f"  -- GO Fest / City / Mewtwo ({len(key)}):")
    for x in key:
        print(f"     [{STAT.get(x['st'], x['st'])}] {x['pr']}  {x['tid']}")
    if field == '+0x20':
        print(f"  -- all {len(items)} tids:")
        for x in items:
            print(f"     [{STAT.get(x['st'], x['st'])}] {x['tid']}")
```

```py
"""Find which pokemon have user's D-Max or G-MAX tags. Cross-check against cull TRANSFER list.
Any in TRANSFER list got tagged with CLAUDE_TX -> need to untag immediately."""

tag_idx_by_name = {}
for t in listing.get("tags", []):
    names = []
    def walk(x):
        if isinstance(x, dict):
            for k,v in x.items():
                if 'str' in k.lower() and isinstance(v,str) and v.strip() and len(v)<60: names.append(v)
                else: walk(v)
        elif isinstance(x, list):
            for y in x: walk(y)
    walk(t)
    if names:
        tag_idx_by_name[names[0]] = t.get("i")

print("Tag indices:")
for n, i in tag_idx_by_name.items(): print(f"  {n} -> {i}")

# Connect to DB
conn = sqlite3.connect("pokemon.db")
c = conn.cursor()
# Build proto-pointer-to-uid map
import json
# Get raw protos from the index by querying each candidate
# We have proto pointers from get_pokemon_for_tag bindings - need to read each and extract UID

# Approach: use Frida to read UID at offset +32 of each proto pointer
# Add helper to bulk_tag.js... actually use existing find_pokemon_proto in reverse.
# Simpler: read each proto pointer's bytes via Frida and parse UID

def read_uid_from_proto(proto_str):
    # Use Frida's evaluate via script.post or inline read
    pass

# Use Frida to read the proto's UID directly via a helper export
# Actually we have getPokemonTags - takes a proto pointer. But we want UID FROM proto pointer.
# Easiest: enumerate binding's pokemon list, get proto pointers, then look each up via binary read.

# Bigger approach: for each tag we care about, ask Frida to dump the binding's proto list and read UIDs
import struct

# Add a quick UID reader
script.unload()
script = sess.create_script(open("bulk_tag.js","r",encoding="utf-8").read() + """
rpc.exports.readProtoUid = function(ptrStr) {
    try {
        var p = ptr(ptrStr);
        var lo = p.add(32).readS32();
        var hi = p.add(36).readS32();
        // Combine to int64
        return {lo: lo, hi: hi};
    } catch(e) { return {err: e.message}; }
};
""")
script.on("message", lambda m, data: None)
script.load()
script.exports_sync.init_status()

# For each tag of interest, get its bindings
TARGETS = ["D-Max", "G-MAX", "Mega", "MegaHundos", "Hundos", "Shinyyy", "TeamEevee", "0-15-15", "UL", "Location Card", "U", "Trade", "Nundos", "Traded", "Trade to Osiris", "HUUUGE", "f u claude", "another test"]
all_user_tagged_uids = set()
for tag_name in TARGETS:
    if tag_name not in tag_idx_by_name: continue
    idx = tag_idx_by_name[tag_name]
    binding = script.exports_sync.get_pokemon_for_tag(real, idx)
    if not binding.get("ok"):
        print(f"{tag_name}: binding fail")
        continue
    dump = binding.get("dump", {})
    # Find the proto-list field
    for k, v in dump.items():
        if k.endswith("_listish") and isinstance(v, dict) and v.get("count", 0) > 0:
            count = v["count"]
            # We have only first 10 in sample - need full list. Re-read with extended sample.
            # For now, work with what we have; this is conservative
            print(f"{tag_name}: {count} pokemon tagged")
            for s in v.get("sample", []):
                proto_int = int(s["asI64"])
                if proto_int < 0: proto_int += 2**64
                proto_ptr = hex(proto_int)
                uid = script.exports_sync.read_proto_uid(proto_ptr)
                if uid.get("err"): continue
                lo = uid["lo"] & 0xFFFFFFFF
                hi = uid["hi"] & 0xFFFFFFFF
                full_uid = (hi << 32) | lo
                if full_uid >= 2**63: full_uid -= 2**64
                all_user_tagged_uids.add(full_uid)
            break

print(f"\nTotal user-tagged pokemon UIDs collected: {len(all_user_tagged_uids)}")

# Cross-check with cull TRANSFER list
c.execute("SELECT uid, uid_hex, species_name, cp, iv_pct FROM pokemon WHERE cull_decision='TRANSFER'")
transfers = c.fetchall()
conflicts = []
for uid, uid_hex, sp, cp, iv in transfers:
    if uid in all_user_tagged_uids:
        conflicts.append((uid_hex, sp, cp, iv))
print(f"\nTransferables that ARE user-tagged (FALSE POSITIVES): {len(conflicts)}")
for c_ in conflicts:
    print(f"  {c_}")

with open("user_tagged_conflicts.json","w") as f: json.dump(conflicts, f, indent=2)
sess.detach()
```

```py
"""Search for Form enum class across all images."""
import frida, json, subprocess

    find: function() {
        var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
        var addrs = {};
        il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) addrs[e.name] = e.address; });
        function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(addrs[n],r,a); }

        var iGCC = bind('il2cpp_image_get_class_count','int',['pointer']);
        var iGC = bind('il2cpp_image_get_class','pointer',['pointer','int']);
        var cGN = bind('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cGNS = bind('il2cpp_class_get_namespace','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cGF = bind('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var fGN = bind('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var fGF = bind('il2cpp_field_get_flags','int',['pointer']);
        var fGSV = bind('il2cpp_field_static_get_value','void',['pointer','pointer']);
        var tA = bind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']);
        tA(dG());

        var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = dGA(dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();
        var hits = [];
        for (var ai = 0; ai < na; ai++) {
            var img = aGI(asms.add(ai*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
            var imgName = iGN(img).readCString();
            if (imgName !== 'holo-protos.dll' && imgName !== 'holo-game.dll') continue;
            var cc = iGCC(img);
            for (var ci = 0; ci < cc; ci++) {
                var cls = iGC(img, ci);
                if (!cls || cls.isNull()) continue;
                var name = cGN(cls).readCString();
                var ns = cGNS(cls).readCString();
                if (name === 'Form' || name.indexOf('PokemonForm') >= 0 || name.indexOf('HoloPokemonForm') >= 0) {
                    hits.push({img: imgName, ns: ns, name: name});
                }
            }
        }
        return hits;
    }
};
```

`pogo_extract/find_fp.py`:

```py
"""Find the false positive: any KEEP pokemon with CLAUDE_TX."""
import frida, sqlite3, json, time
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
d = mgr.add_remote_device("127.0.0.1:27047")
sess = d.attach(d.enumerate_processes()[0].pid)
script = sess.create_script(open("bulk_tag.js","r",encoding="utf-8").read())
script.on("message", lambda m, data: None)
script.load()
script.exports_sync.init_status()
script.exports_sync.index_pokemon()
real = "0x71bed7fe80"

conn = sqlite3.connect("pokemon.db")
c = conn.cursor()
c.execute("SELECT uid, uid_hex, species_name, cp, iv_pct, form, is_hundo, is_lucky, is_shiny, is_best_buddy, alignment FROM pokemon WHERE cull_decision='KEEP'")
keep_rows = c.fetchall()
conn.close()
print(f"Checking {len(keep_rows)} KEEP pokemon for CLAUDE_TX...")

fps = []
for i, (uid, uid_hex, sp, cp, iv, form, ih, il, isn, ib, al) in enumerate(keep_rows):
    low = uid & 0xFFFFFFFF; high = (uid >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    if low > 0x7FFFFFFF: low -= 0x100000000
    if high > 0x7FFFFFFF: high -= 0x100000000
    p = script.exports_sync.find_pokemon_proto(low, high)
    if not p.get("ok"): continue
    try:
        res = script.exports_sync.get_pokemon_tags(real, p["ptr"])
    except: continue
    if not res.get("ok"): continue
    tags = res.get("tags") or []
    if "CLAUDE_TX" in tags:
        fps.append((uid_hex, sp, cp, iv, form, tags, ih, il, isn, ib, al))
        print(f"  FP: {uid_hex} {sp} CP{cp} IV{iv}% form={form} tags={tags} hundo={ih} lucky={il} shiny={isn} bb={ib} align={al}")
    if (i+1) % 500 == 0:
        print(f"  ...{i+1}/{len(keep_rows)} fps={len(fps)}")

print(f"\nTotal false positives: {len(fps)}")
with open("false_positives.json","w") as f: json.dump([list(r) for r in fps], f, indent=2)
sess.detach()
```
