                        ('branches', lambda g: strip(g, 'evolutionBranch'), 'evolution edges'),
                        ('flags', lambda g: strip(g, 'isTransferable'), 'isTransferable true'),
                        ('moves', lambda g: strip(g, 'quickMoves'), 'quick move lists'),
                        ('classes', lambda g: strip(g, 'pokemonClass'), 'legendary species'),
                        ('forms', lambda g: [t for t in g if not t['templateId'].startswith('FORMS_PAD')], 'forms'),
                        ('quests', lambda g: [t for t in g if 'evolutionQuestTemplate' not in t['data']], 'evolution quests'))
                for nm, mut, label in muts:
                    r = same(P0, put('big_%s.json' % nm, mut(big)))
                    ok(r['verdict'] == 'UNREADABLE_NEW' and 'damaged' in r['reason'] and label in r['reason'] and not r['flips'],
                       'canary %s: a candidate missing its %s is refused, never installed: %s %s' % (nm, label, r['verdict'], r['reason'][:160]))
                r = same(P0, put('big_forms_ok.json', dict((m_[0], m_[1]) for m_ in muts)['forms'](big)), canary=False)
                ok(r['verdict'] == 'CLEAR' and [d[0] for d in r['drops']] == ['forms'],
                   '--accept-smaller (canary=False) lets a smaller file through to every other check: %s %s' % (r['verdict'], r['drops']))
                r = same(P0, put('big_grown.json', big + _padding(5, start=100)))
                ok(r['verdict'] == 'CLEAR' and not r['flips'], 'growth never trips the canary: %s %s' % (r['verdict'], r['reason'][:120]))
                r = same(P0, put('big_minus3.json', big[:-10] + big[-1:]))          # 3 species (and their templates) retired
                ok(r['verdict'] == 'CLEAR', 'a small real shrink (3 of 83 species retired) passes: %s %s' % (r['verdict'], r['reason'][:120]))
            finally:
                globals()['CANARY_MIN'] = 10 ** 9
            # 4. the stamp: APK from the folder name, the batch match, the timestamp, the meta file
            ok(parse_apk('gm_v2_apk4270_2026.08.28-17.35.50') == '0.427.0' and parse_apk('gm_v2_apk3951_x') == '0.395.1'
               and parse_apk('nonsense') is None, 'parse_apk')
            ts = 1787902550208                                                    # 2026-08-28 07:35:50 UTC, the real batch
            tree = {'truncated': False, 'tree': [{'path': 'previous_game_masters/gm_v2_apk4270_2026.08.28-17.35.50', 'type': 'tree'},
                                                 {'path': 'previous_game_masters/gm_v2_apk4270_2026.08.28-17.35.50/game_master.json', 'type': 'blob'},
                                                 {'path': 'previous_game_masters/gm_v2_apk4070_2026.04.17-10.48.50', 'type': 'tree'}]}
            ok(apk_from_tree(tree, ts) == ('0.427.0', 'gm_v2_apk4270_2026.08.28-17.35.50'), 'apk_from_tree +10:00')
            t11 = {'truncated': False, 'tree': [{'path': 'previous_game_masters/gm_v2_apk4270_2026.08.28-18.35.50', 'type': 'tree'}]}
            ok(apk_from_tree(t11, ts)[0] == '0.427.0', 'apk_from_tree +11:00 (an Australian summer)')
            ok(apk_from_tree(dict(tree, truncated=True), ts) == (None, None), 'a truncated tree must give no apk')
            ok(apk_from_tree({'tree': tree['tree']}, ts) == (None, None), 'a tree that does not say truncated:false must give no apk')
            ok(apk_from_tree(tree, ts + 60000) == (None, None) and apk_from_tree('junk', ts) == (None, None), 'no nearest-folder guess')
            ok(parse_ts(b'1787902550208\n') == ts, 'parse_ts')
            for junk in ('', 'abc', '12', '99999999999999'):
                try:
                    parse_ts(junk)
                    ok(False, 'parse_ts must refuse %r' % junk)
                except ValueError:
                    ok(True, 'parse_ts refuses junk')
            mp = os.path.join(td, 'x.meta')
            ok(read_meta(mp) is None and write_meta(mp, new_meta(ts, 'ab' * 32, '0.427.0', 'f', 1787990000, False)) and
               read_meta(mp)['apk'] == '0.427.0' and read_meta(mp)['batch_utc'] == '2026-08-28 07:35:50', 'meta round trip')
            put('x.meta', '{"batch_ts": "x"}')
            ok(read_meta(mp) is None, 'a meta of the wrong shape is unreadable, not a crash')
            ok(open(mp, 'rb').read().isascii() and open(__file__, 'rb').read().isascii(), 'ASCII only (the repo guards cp1252)')
            # 5. the audit WARN (I2.7): every cause on its own, never a crash
            now = ts / 1000.0 + 33 * 86400
            m = dict(new_meta(ts, 'a', '0.427.0', 'f', now - 3600, False), checked_ts=int(now - 3600), checked_at='2026-09-30 06:00:00')
            gv = {'version': '0.429.1'}
            ok(len(freshness_findings(None, gv, now)) == 1 and 'no readable stamp' in freshness_findings(None, gv, now)[0][1], 'no stamp')
            ok(len(freshness_findings({'batch_ts': 'x'}, gv, now)) == 1, 'garbage stamp')
            f = freshness_findings(m, gv, now)
            ok(len(f) == 1 and 'phone runs 0.429.1' in f[0][1] and 'nothing newer' in f[0][1] and 'refresh_gamemaster.py' in f[0][2], 'APK skew: %s' % f)
            ok(freshness_findings(m, {'version': '0.427.0'}, now) == [] and freshness_findings(m, None, now) == [], 'no skew, or no game version')
            ok(freshness_findings(dict(m, apk=None), gv, now) == [], 'apk unknown (lookup blocked) and freshly checked: no noise')
            _lt = lambda s: time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', time.localtime(s))    # how dumpsys prints lastUpdateTime
            f = freshness_findings(dict(m, apk=None, source='alexelgt'), dict(gv, updated=_lt(ts / 1000.0 + 86400)), now)
            ok(len(f) == 1 and 'older than the game update' in f[0][1] and 'alexelgt' in f[0][1], 'no APK, batch before the game update: %s' % f)
            ok(freshness_findings(dict(m, apk=None), dict(gv, updated=_lt(ts / 1000.0 - 86400)), now) == [], 'no APK, batch after the update: no noise')
            f = freshness_findings(m, dict(gv, updated=_lt(ts / 1000.0 + 86400)), now)
            ok(len(f) == 1 and 'phone runs 0.429.1' in f[0][1], 'a known APK is judged by the APK alone (one WARN, not two): %s' % f)
            f = freshness_findings(dict(m, checked_ts=int(now - 20 * 86400), downloaded_ts=int(now - 20 * 86400)), {'version': '0.427.0'}, now)
            ok(len(f) == 1 and 'not been compared' in f[0][1], 'not checked for 20 days: %s' % f)
            f = freshness_findings(dict(m, batch_ts=int((now - 200 * 86400) * 1000), batch_utc='2026-03-13 00:00:00'), {'version': '0.427.0'}, now)
            ok(len(f) == 1 and 'stopped publishing' in f[0][1], 'batch older than 150 days: %s' % f)
            f = freshness_findings(dict(m, rejected={'batch_utc': '2026-09-29 00:00:00', 'at': '2026-09-30 06:00:00', 'reason': 'boom'}), {'version': '0.427.0'}, now)
            ok(len(f) == 1 and 'REJECTED' in f[0][1] and 'boom' in f[0][1], 'a rejected batch is named: %s' % f)
            # 6. the orchestrator, end to end in the temp dir (needs refresh_gamemaster; --selftest passes it in)
            if rgm is not None:
                _orchestrator_tests(rgm, td, put, rows, enum, ok)
            # 7. the real files, only where they exist (skipped cleanly on CI / a fresh clone)
            _live_check(rows, ok)
    finally:
        globals()['MIN_POKEMON_SETTINGS'], globals()['MIN_BAG_ROWS'], globals()['CANARY_MIN'] = saved
    stat1 = {p: (os.stat(p).st_size, os.stat(p).st_mtime_ns) if os.path.exists(p) else None for p in live}
    ok(stat0 == stat1, 'the self-test touched a live file: %s' % [p for p in live if stat0[p] != stat1[p]])
    print('gm_guard selftest: OK (%d checks)' % n[0])
    return 0


def _orchestrator_tests(rgm, td, put, rows, enum, ok):
    ts_a, ts_b = 1787902550208, 1790000000000
    NOW = ts_b / 1000.0 + 3600
    tree = {'truncated': False, 'tree': [{'path': 'previous_game_masters/gm_v2_apk4010_%s' % time.strftime('%Y.%m.%d-%H.%M.%S', time.gmtime(ts_b / 1000.0 + 36000)), 'type': 'tree'}]}
    dbp = os.path.join(td, 'pokemon.db')
    con = sqlite3.connect(dbp)
    con.execute('CREATE TABLE pokemon (%s, in_bag)' % ROW_COLS)
    for r in rows:
        con.execute('INSERT INTO pokemon VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,1)', [r[k] for k in ROW_COLS.replace(' ', '').split(',')])
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    served = {'json': None, 'ts': str(ts_b), 'n_json': 0, 'ts_seq': None, 'no_tree': False, 'ax_ts': None, 'ax_json': None, 'n_ax': 0}

    def fetch(url, timeout=30):
        if url.startswith(AX_TS_URL) and served['ax_ts']:
            return json.dumps({'batchId': served['ax_ts'], 'uploadTime': served['ax_ts']}).encode()
        if url.startswith(AX_JSON_URL) and served['ax_json']:
            served['n_ax'] += 1
            return served['ax_json'].encode()
        if url.startswith(PM_TS_URL):
            if served['ts_seq']:
                return served['ts_seq'].pop(0).encode()
            if served['ts'] is None:
                raise OSError('offline')
            return served['ts'].encode()
        if url.startswith(PM_JSON_URL):
            served['n_json'] += 1
            return served['json'].encode()
        if url.startswith(PM_TREE_URL):
            if served['no_tree']:
                raise OSError('the tree API is refused')
            return json.dumps(tree).encode()
        raise OSError('unexpected url ' + url)
    saved = (rgm.REVIEW, rgm._pm_engine_inputs, rgm.PM, rgm.PM_META, rgm.GM, rgm.DB)
    rgm._pm_engine_inputs = lambda: (_MOVES, enum)

    def run(argv=(), review=None):
        rgm.REVIEW = review or os.path.join(td, 'review.json')
        buf = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
            rc = rgm.pokeminers_phase(list(argv), fetch=fetch, now=NOW, gm_path=gmp, meta_path=mtp, db_path=dbp)
        return rc, buf.getvalue()

    def reset(gm_variant, with_meta=True, ts=ts_a):
        for p in (gmp, mtp, rgm.REVIEW):
            if os.path.exists(p):
                os.remove(p)
        for f in os.listdir(td):
            if '.bak-' in f or f.endswith('.download') or f.endswith('.pending.json'):
                os.remove(os.path.join(td, f))
        put('gm.json', _fixture_gm(gm_variant))
        if with_meta:
            write_meta(mtp, new_meta(ts, sha256_file(gmp), '0.400.0', 'gm_v2_apk4000_x', NOW - 86400, False))
    gmp, mtp = os.path.join(td, 'gm.json'), os.path.join(td, 'gm.json.meta')
    try:
        # FLIPS: HELD, NOT INSTALLED (2026-09-30): the judged bytes wait as gm.pending.json beside the untouched file, the SAME
        # record is written, rc 2 with no tail; review_gate stops every run; --ack installs exactly the held bytes (backup + stamp)
        reset(None)
        old_bytes, old_meta = open(gmp, 'rb').read(), open(mtp, 'rb').read()
        held = os.path.join(td, 'gm.pending.json')
        served['json'] = json.dumps(_fixture_gm('move'))
        rc, out = run()
        rec = json.load(open(rgm.REVIEW, encoding='utf-8'))
        ok(rc == (2, False), 'FLIPS must exit 2 and install nothing (no tail owed), got %s' % (rc,))
        ok(rec['crossed'] == ['u_eev_swift'] and rec['nulled'] == [] and rec['kind'] == 'client_gm' and rec['target'] == 'pokeminers'
           and rec['lines'][0].startswith('CLIENT GAME MASTER') and rec['lines'][1].startswith('HELD, NOT INSTALLED')
           and rec['staged'] == 'gm.pending.json' and rec['backup'] is None and rec['batch_ts'] == ts_b and 'status' not in rec,
           'the record has the rows the gate reads and names the held file: %s' % {k: rec.get(k) for k in ('crossed', 'nulled', 'staged', 'backup')})
        ok(open(gmp, 'rb').read() == old_bytes and open(mtp, 'rb').read() == old_meta and os.path.exists(held)
           and sha256_file(held) == rec['meta_new']['sha256'] and not [f for f in os.listdir(td) if f.startswith('gm.json.bak-')],
           'held, not installed: the installed file and its stamp are untouched, no backup yet')
        ok(not os.path.exists(gmp + '.download') and json.dumps(rec).isascii() and 'HELD' in out and 'NEEDS A HUMAN' in out and '--reject' in out,
           'no temp file left; ASCII record; the run says the batch is held and names --ack / --reject')
        buf = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
            g = rgm.review_gate([])
            ok(g == 2 and 'REVIEW PENDING' in buf.getvalue() and 'CLIENT GAME MASTER' in buf.getvalue() and '--reject' in buf.getvalue(),
               'review_gate stops every run, prints the rows and both ways out')
            ok(rgm.review_gate(['--ack']) == 0 and not os.path.exists(rgm.REVIEW), '--ack clears the record')
        baks = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(td) if f.startswith('gm.json.bak-'))
        ok(len(baks) == 1 and open(os.path.join(td, baks[0]), 'rb').read() == old_bytes and not os.path.exists(held)
           and sha256_file(gmp) == read_meta(mtp)['sha256'] == rec['meta_new']['sha256'], '--ack installs exactly the held bytes; backup = the old bytes')
        ok(read_meta(mtp)['batch_ts'] == ts_b and read_meta(mtp)['tail_pending'] is True and read_meta(mtp)['apk'] == '0.401.0'
           and os.path.exists(mtp + '.bak-' + baks[0].split('.bak-', 1)[1]), 'meta of the installed batch, tail owed; the old stamp is backed up: %s' % read_meta(mtp))
        # the batch is upstream's latest now: no second download, only the check time moves
        n0 = served['n_json']
        rc, out = run()
        ok(rc == (None, True) and served['n_json'] == n0 and 'nothing to download' in out, 'same batch: no re-download (%s)' % (rc,))
        # a second install the same day never overwrites the first backup
        served['ts'], served['json'] = str(ts_b + 5000), json.dumps(_fixture_gm('evo_cost'))
        rc, out = run(review=os.path.join(td, 'review2.json'))
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            rgm.review_gate(['--ack'])                       # a held batch installs on --ack (a CLEAR one already did)
        ok(len([f for f in os.listdir(td) if f.startswith('gm.json.bak-')]) == 2, 'a same-day second install gets its own backup')
        served['ts'] = str(ts_b)
        # --reject: the held batch is dropped, the installed file stays, and that batch is DECLINED: no run downloads or stops on it
        # again; --reject never clears a pvpoke rank review; a NEWER batch is judged as usual
        reset(None)
        b_old, m_old = open(gmp, 'rb').read(), read_meta(mtp)
        served['ts'], served['json'] = str(ts_b), json.dumps(_fixture_gm('move'))
        rc, out = run()
        ok(rc == (2, False) and os.path.exists(os.path.join(td, 'gm.pending.json')), 'held for --reject: %s' % (rc,))
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            ok(rgm.review_gate(['--reject']) == 0 and not os.path.exists(rgm.REVIEW), '--reject clears the record')
        ok(open(gmp, 'rb').read() == b_old and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(td, 'gm.pending.json'))
           and (read_meta(mtp).get('declined') or {}).get('batch_ts') == ts_b and read_meta(mtp)['sha256'] == m_old['sha256'],
           '--reject keeps the installed file, drops the held one, declines the batch: %s' % read_meta(mtp).get('declined'))
        n0 = served['n_json']
        rc, out = run()
        ok(rc == (None, False) and served['n_json'] == n0 and 'declined' in out and not os.path.exists(rgm.REVIEW),
           'a declined batch is never downloaded or stopped on again: %s %s' % (rc, out[-160:]))
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            ok(rgm.review_gate(['--reject']) == 0, '--reject with nothing pending is a no-op')
        with open(rgm.REVIEW, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump({'since': 'x', 'crossed': ['u'], 'nulled': [], 'lines': ['x']}, f)
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            ok(rgm.review_gate(['--reject']) == 2 and os.path.exists(rgm.REVIEW), '--reject never clears a pvpoke rank review')
        os.remove(rgm.REVIEW)
        served['ts'] = str(ts_b + 7000)
        rc, out = run()
        ok(rc == (2, False) and served['n_json'] == n0 + 1, 'a NEWER batch is judged as usual after a decline: %s' % (rc,))
        # --ack when the held file is gone (another machine held it) or changed: NOTHING installed, the record cleared
        os.remove(os.path.join(td, 'gm.pending.json'))
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            ok(rgm.review_gate(['--ack']) == 0 and not os.path.exists(rgm.REVIEW) and open(gmp, 'rb').read() == b_old,
               '--ack without the held bytes installs nothing and clears the record')
        served['ts'] = str(ts_b)
        # an interrupted-refresh record that names the client GM rolls back the CLIENT file, never pvpoke's
        pv = os.path.join(td, 'pvpoke.json')
        put('pvpoke.json', '{"pokemon": []}')
        rgm.GM, rgm.PM = pv, gmp
        bak = os.path.join(td, 'gm.json.bak-rollback')
        put('gm.json.bak-rollback', _fixture_gm())
        with open(rgm.REVIEW, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump({'status': 'in progress', 'since': 'x', 'backup': 'gm.json.bak-rollback', 'target': 'pokeminers'}, f)
        buf = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
            ok(rgm.review_gate(['--ack']) == 0, 'rollback --ack')
        ok(open(gmp, 'rb').read() == open(bak, 'rb').read() and open(pv).read() == '{"pokemon": []}', 'the rollback restored the client GM and left pvpoke alone')
        # CLEAR: a change nobody holds installs silently (backup + stamp, tail owed, no record)
        reset(None)
        served['ts'], served['json'] = str(ts_b), json.dumps(_fixture_gm('unbagged'))
        rc, out = run()
        ok(rc == (None, True) and not os.path.exists(rgm.REVIEW) and read_meta(mtp)['batch_ts'] == ts_b and sha256_file(gmp) == read_meta(mtp)['sha256'],
           'CLEAR installs without a stop: %s' % (rc,))
        # IDS AS NUMBERS at download: the batch is named BEFORE it is judged, and the NAMED bytes are what is stamped and installed
        reset(None)
        numbered, n_num = _numbered(_fixture_gm('unbagged'), enum)
        served['ts'], served['json'] = str(ts_b), json.dumps(numbered)
        rc, out = run()
        m = read_meta(mtp)
        ok(rc == (None, True) and json.load(open(gmp, encoding='utf-8')) == _fixture_gm('unbagged') and m.get('ids_named') == n_num
           and sha256_file(gmp) == m['sha256'] and 'enum numbers' in out and not os.path.exists(rgm.REVIEW) and not os.path.exists(gmp + '.download'),
           'a batch printing ids as numbers is named, judged CLEAR and installed named: %s %s %s' % (rc, m.get('ids_named'), out[-200:]))
        # THE CANARY in the orchestrator: a batch under 90% of the installed file on a count is refused (WARN, remembered for the
        # audit, nothing installed); on Benny's word --accept-smaller lets it through to every other check, and it installs
        globals()['CANARY_MIN'] = 10
        try:
            big = _fixture_gm() + _padding(60)
            reset(None)
            put('gm.json', big)
            write_meta(mtp, new_meta(ts_a, sha256_file(gmp), '0.400.0', 'gm_v2_apk4000_x', NOW - 86400, False))
            b_big = open(gmp, 'rb').read()
            served['ts'], served['json'] = str(ts_b), json.dumps([t for t in big if 'evolutionQuestTemplate' not in t['data']])
            rc, out = run()
            ok(rc == (None, False) and open(gmp, 'rb').read() == b_big and 'looks damaged' in out and 'evolution quests 60 -> 0' in out
               and read_meta(mtp).get('rejected', {}).get('batch_ts') == ts_b and not os.path.exists(gmp + '.download'),
               'the canary refuses a damaged batch and remembers it: %s %s' % (rc, out[-200:]))
            f = freshness_findings(read_meta(mtp), {'version': '0.400.0'}, NOW)
            ok(len(f) == 1 and 'REJECTED' in f[0][1] and '--accept-smaller' in f[0][1], 'the audit WARN names the way in: %s' % f)
            rc, out = run(['--accept-smaller'])
            ok(rc == (None, True) and open(gmp, 'rb').read() != b_big and 'let through by hand' in out and 'rejected' not in read_meta(mtp)
               and read_meta(mtp)['batch_ts'] == ts_b and not os.path.exists(rgm.REVIEW),
               '--accept-smaller installs it through every other check: %s %s' % (rc, out[-200:]))
        finally:
            globals()['CANARY_MIN'] = 10 ** 9
        # SAME: a file installed before the stamp existed is adopted, not re-diffed; no tail owed
        reset(None, with_meta=False)
        served['json'] = open(gmp, encoding='utf-8').read()
        rc, out = run()
        ok(rc == (None, False) and read_meta(mtp)['tail_pending'] is False and read_meta(mtp)['batch_ts'] == ts_b and not os.path.exists(rgm.REVIEW),
           'an unstamped file that IS upstream is adopted: %s' % (rc,))
        # the timestamp moved but the bytes did not (a stale CDN edge): not adopted, asked again next run
        reset(None)
        served['json'] = open(gmp, encoding='utf-8').read()
        before = open(mtp, 'rb').read()
        rc, out = run()
        ok(rc == (None, False) and open(mtp, 'rb').read() == before and 'NOT adopted' in out, 'ts moved, content same: kept, stamp untouched')
        # FAIL CLOSED / SOFT: a truncated download, an unreachable upstream, upstream moving mid-download -- nothing installed
        reset(None)
        served['json'] = json.dumps(_fixture_gm('move'))[:400]
        b0 = (open(gmp, 'rb').read(), os.stat(gmp).st_mtime_ns, open(mtp, 'rb').read())
        m0 = read_meta(mtp)
        rc, out = run()
        m1 = read_meta(mtp)
        ok(rc == (None, False) and (open(gmp, 'rb').read(), os.stat(gmp).st_mtime_ns) == b0[:2] and not os.path.exists(rgm.REVIEW)
           and not os.path.exists(gmp + '.download') and 'NOT installed' in out and 'WARN' in out, 'a truncated candidate is never installed: %s' % out[-160:])
        ok(m1.get('rejected', {}).get('batch_ts') == ts_b and all(m1[k] == m0[k] for k in ('batch_ts', 'sha256', 'apk', 'downloaded_ts')),
           'the rejection is remembered (for the offline WARN) and the stamp of what IS installed is untouched: %s' % m1.get('rejected'))
        served['json'] = open(gmp, encoding='utf-8').read()
        served['ts'] = str(ts_a)                                  # the batch is upstream's latest again: the rejection is stale
        rc, out = run()
        ok('rejected' not in read_meta(mtp), 'a good check clears a stale rejection')
        served['ts'] = str(ts_b)
        served['json'] = json.dumps(_fixture_gm('move'))[:400]
        served['ts'] = None
        rc, out = run()
        ok(rc == (None, False) and open(gmp, 'rb').read() == b0[0] and 'WARN' in out, 'upstream unreachable: WARN, nothing changes')
        served['ts'], served['ts_seq'], served['json'] = str(ts_b), [str(ts_b), str(ts_b + 1)], json.dumps(_fixture_gm('move'))
        rc, out = run()
        ok(rc == (None, False) and open(gmp, 'rb').read() == b0[0] and 'published while' in out, 'upstream moved mid-download: nothing installed')
        served['ts_seq'] = None
        # STOP: an empty bag (or an unreadable installed file) is never "no flips": nothing installed, the record is written
        con = sqlite3.connect(dbp)
        con.execute('UPDATE pokemon SET in_bag=0')
        con.commit()
        con.close()
        reset(None)
        served['json'] = json.dumps(_fixture_gm('move'))
        rc, out = run()
        rec = json.load(open(rgm.REVIEW, encoding='utf-8'))
        ok(rc == (2, False) and open(gmp, 'rb').read() == b0[0] and 'no flips' in rec['reason'] and rec['crossed'] == [], 'an empty bag STOPs, installs nothing: %s' % (rc,))
        # the record cannot be written -> not installed (never a silent install)
        con = sqlite3.connect(dbp)
        con.execute('UPDATE pokemon SET in_bag=1')
        con.commit()
        con.close()
        reset(None)
        rc, out = run(review=os.path.join(td, 'no_such_dir', 'review.json'))
        ok(rc == (1, False) and open(gmp, 'rb').read() == b0[0] and 'NOT installed' in out, 'FLIPS without a writable record must not install: %s' % (rc,))
        # --force on an unchanged, stamped file re-verifies it (identical bytes -> stamp refreshed, install time kept)
        reset(None)
        served['json'] = open(gmp, encoding='utf-8').read()
        served['ts'] = str(ts_a)
        d0 = read_meta(mtp)['downloaded_ts']
        rc, out = run(['--force'])
        ok(rc == (None, False) and read_meta(mtp)['downloaded_ts'] == d0 and read_meta(mtp)['checked_ts'] == int(NOW), '--force re-verifies without reinstalling')

        # main(): an unknown flag runs NOTHING (rc 2); a crash inside the guard is loud, non-fatal for full_audit, installs nothing

def _live_check(rows, ok):
    """The 22 flips, reproduced from the REAL 0.407 / 0.427 game masters and the real bag -- only where those exist, and
    cross-checked against an independent count from the raw templates (the number moves with every walk, so it is printed,
    never asserted). Also: the size repro on the real files (every XXL copy flagged when the held species' base sizes shrink), the
    costume axis on that pair (printed), and ids as numbers: 0.427 numbered and named back is CLEAR, 0.395.1's are all named."""
    clone = os.environ.get('GM_GUARD_PM_CLONE', '/home/user/pokeminers/game_masters')
    p407 = os.path.join(clone, 'previous_game_masters', 'gm_v2_apk4070_2026.04.17-10.48.50', 'game_master.json')
    p427 = os.path.join(clone, 'latest', 'latest.json')
    p395 = os.path.join(clone, 'previous_game_masters', 'gm_v2_apk3951_2026.02.05-06.35.49', 'game_master.json')
    db = os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db')
    mmp, fep = os.path.join(ROOT, 'move_id_to_name.json'), os.path.join(ROOT, 'form_enum.json')
    if not all(os.path.exists(p) for p in (p407, p427, db, mmp, fep)) or os.path.getsize(db) < 1000000:
        print('gm_guard selftest: live 0.407 -> 0.427 check skipped (%s / pokemon.db not on this machine)' % clone)
        return
    move_map = json.load(open(mmp, encoding='utf-8'))
    enum = {int(k): v for k, v in json.load(open(fep, encoding='utf-8')).items()}
    bag = load_rows(db)
    r = assess(p407, p427, bag, move_map, enum)
    # ONLY the rows whose held move LEAVES 'no normal roll' (the direction `want` counts below): one (species, move) pair flips the
    # other way on this very pair (Cramorant DRILL_PECK: plain -> no normal roll), so a bag holding such a Cramorant would
    # otherwise fail this check in a data session although nothing is wrong
    got = len({f['uid'] for f in r['flips'] if f['axis'] == 'moves' and f['old'] == 'no normal roll' and f['new'] != 'no normal roll'})

    def pools(path):                      # independent of detect_legacy: raw templates -> dex -> normal-roll move names
        out = defaultdict(set)
        for t in json.load(open(path, encoding='utf-8')):
            s = (t.get('data') or {}).get('pokemonSettings')
            m = re.match(r'V(\d{4})_POKEMON_', t.get('templateId', ''))
            if s and m:
                for k in ('quickMoves', 'cinematicMoves', 'nonTmCinematicMoves'):
                    for x in s.get(k) or []:
                        nm = move_map.get(str(x)) if isinstance(x, int) else x
                        if nm:
                            out[int(m.group(1))].add(nm)
        return out
    a, b = pools(p407), pools(p427)
    want = 0
    for row in bag:
        for k in SLOTS:
            nm = move_map.get(str(row[k])) if row[k] else None
            if nm and a.get(row['pokemon_id']) and nm not in a[row['pokemon_id']] and nm in b.get(row['pokemon_id'], ()):
                want += 1
                break
    ok(r['verdict'] == 'FLIPS' and got == want, 'live: reused detect_legacy pools flip %d in-bag rows, the raw templates say %d' % (got, want))
    _c = sqlite3.connect('file:%s?mode=ro' % db.replace('\\', '/'), uri=True)
    try:
        walk = _c.execute('SELECT MAX(last_scanned) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1').fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        _c.close()
    if walk == '2026-09-30T01:42:49':                 # the walk the 22 was measured on (2026-09-30); later bags differ
        ok(got == 22, 'live: on the 2026-09-30 01:42:49 walk exactly 22 in-bag rows flip on a held move, got %d' % got)
    print('gm_guard selftest: live 0.407 -> 0.427: %d in-bag rows lose "no normal roll" on a held move (evolve axis %d rows, size axis %d rows, '
          'costume axis %d rows, %s)' % (got, r['axes'].get('evolve', 0), r['axes'].get('size', 0), r['axes'].get('costume', 0), r['verdict']))
    # THE SIZE REPRO ON THE REAL FILES (2026-09-30, review): the base height / weight of every species that has an XXL copy in the bag,
    # scaled x0.6 in a copy of 0.427 -- what moved an XXL Ponyta out of the keep (its projection as a Rapidash falls 1082 -> 735, so
    # best_points 983 is under min_points) while the first version of the guard said CLEAR. Every one of those XXL rows must be flagged.
    _c = sqlite3.connect('file:%s?mode=ro' % db.replace('\\', '/'), uri=True)
    try:
        xxl = dict(_c.execute('SELECT uid_hex, pokemon_id FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND pokemon_size_category=5').fetchall())
    finally:
        _c.close()
    if xxl:
        gm, held = json.load(open(p427, encoding='utf-8')), set(xxl.values())
        for t in gm:
            s = (t.get('data') or {}).get('pokemonSettings')
            m = re.match(r'V(\d{4})_POKEMON_', t.get('templateId', ''))
            if s and m and int(m.group(1)) in held:
                for k in ('pokedexHeightM', 'pokedexWeightKg'):
                    if s.get(k):
                        s[k] = round(s[k] * 0.6, 3)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='gm_guard_live_') as td:
            cand = os.path.join(td, 'scaled_0427.json')
            with open(cand, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump(gm, f)
            del gm
            r2 = assess(p427, cand, bag, move_map, enum)
        flagged = {f['uid'] for f in r2['flips'] if f['axis'] == 'size'}
        ok(r2['verdict'] == 'FLIPS' and set(xxl) <= flagged,
           'live: 0.427 with the held XXL species\' base sizes x0.6 must flag every XXL row on the size axis (%d of %d, %s)' % (
               len(set(xxl) & flagged), len(xxl), r2['verdict']))
        print('gm_guard selftest: live size check: base sizes x0.6 flag %d in-bag rows, all %d XXL copies among them' % (len(flagged), len(xxl)))
    # IDS AS NUMBERS ON THE REAL FILES (2026-09-30): 0.427 with every id turned into the enum number a batch like 0.395.1 prints, named
    # back by normalize_file, is the same game master -- every reader loads it and no in-bag verdict moves; and every number the real
    # 0.395.1 prints is named (it crashed evolvable_forms before)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='gm_guard_ids_') as td:
        twin, n_num = _numbered(json.load(open(p427, encoding='utf-8')), enum)
        cand = os.path.join(td, 'numbered_0427.json')
        with open(cand, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(twin, f)
        del twin
        named = normalize_file(cand, enum, p427)
        same_content = json.load(open(cand, encoding='utf-8')) == json.load(open(p427, encoding='utf-8'))
        r3 = assess(p427, cand, bag, move_map, enum)
        ok(named == (n_num, 0) and same_content and r3['verdict'] == 'CLEAR' and not r3['flips'] and not r3['nulled'] and not r3['diff'],
           'live: 0.427 with its %d ids as numbers, named back, must be the same content and CLEAR: %s %s %s' % (
               n_num, named, same_content, r3['verdict']))
        print('gm_guard selftest: live ids: 0.427 with %d ids as numbers named back to the same content, judged %s' % (n_num, r3['verdict']))
        if os.path.exists(p395):
            c395 = os.path.join(td, '0395.json')
            shutil.copyfile(p395, c395)
            n395 = normalize_file(c395, enum, p427)
            ok(n395[0] > 1000 and n395[1] == 0, 'live: every number 0.395.1 prints must be named: %s' % (n395,))
            print('gm_guard selftest: live ids: 0.395.1 prints %d ids as numbers, %d named, %d left' % (sum(n395), n395[0], n395[1]))
    ok(assess(p427, p427, bag, move_map, enum)['verdict'] == 'SAME', 'live: identical is SAME')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    if '--selftest' in sys.argv:
        sys.exit(selftest())
    print(__doc__)

"""Granular tag membership: turn each coarse keep reason into a SPECIFIC, self-explaining tag.

User 2026-09-02: "your labels dont make sense ... i need the reason theyre kept" and then "you have the
ability to make up to 100 tags ... im sure you can label 1st 2nd 3rd, best ul, best gl, actually ranked
ul and gl, etc. cmon."

Before this, one tag ('Variant Floor') covered 1,939 mons and said nothing useful on a tag chip, and
'Shadow Best' hid the fact that the engine keeps THREE different shadows (best IV, best GL, best UL).
Here every reason is spread into tags a player can act on, named in the user's vocabulary rather than
engine identifiers ('Last Copy', not 'dex_only_copy'; 'Safety Hold', not 'rank_unknown').

LABELS ONLY. This module derives tag membership from decisions keep_policy ALREADY made -- it reads
policy_reasons.json and never changes a keep/transfer verdict. build_tagsets asserts the Transfer pile is
untouched, and the ordinals here are computed with the SAME sort the engine uses
(-iv, -cp, uid_hex) so a tag's "#1" is the same mon the engine ranked first.
"""
import collections
import json
import math
import os
import re
import sqlite3
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(HERE, 'system', 'scripts'))

import keep_config
from costume_forms import is_costume_form            # noqa: F401  (kept: callers rely on the import chain)
import evolvable_forms
from pvp_iv_rule import pvid, VIABILITY_MARGIN
import pattern_pools   # pattern-pooled lines: Variant ordinals run over the whole pattern pool (2026-09-08)
from references import LEGENDARY_IDS, MYTHICAL_IDS, ULTRA_BEAST_IDS, PARADOX_IDS

_REGSUF = ('_alolan', '_galarian', '_hisuian', '_paldean')
_IV = lambda r: (r['iv_total'] or 0)
# THE engine sort. Must stay identical to keep_policy.topn or a tag's "#1" stops being the engine's #1.
_RANK = lambda r: (-_IV(r), -(r.get('cp') or 0), r['uid_hex'])

# Colours are PokemonTagColor and are valid 0-8 ONLY. 9 makes AddTag report success while the tag never
# materialises -- that cost three wrong diagnoses on 2026-09-02 (a 14-tag account cap, a name filter and a
# creation rate limit, none of which were real).
_COLOURS = 9

# ===========================================================================
# THE TAG VOCABULARY -- every tag build() can EVER emit, whether or not any mon
# qualifies for it today.
#
# WHY THIS EXISTS (D5, 2026-09-07). prune_tags.PLAN used to be derived from
# `build(...)`'s RETURN VALUE -- i.e. from the tags that happened to have >=1
# member on the day it ran. So a tag whose membership fell to zero silently
# DROPPED OUT of the push plan while its tagset file stayed on disk and
# set_db_tags_from_files kept mirroring that frozen file into auth_tag_names
# (that script consumes every .txt, PLAN or not). Result: a tag that is live on
# the phone, live in the DB mirror, has a file -- and is invisible to prune,
# which is the only thing that could ever correct it.
#
# 'Safety Hold' is the proven case: emitted 2026-09-03 for one Enamorus, pushed,
# then that mon's reasons changed to dex_only_copy/rarity/variant_floor. build()
# stopped emitting it, so build_tagsets stopped rewriting Safety_Hold.txt (it
# only writes files for tags build() RETURNS) and prune stopped managing it. On
# 2026-09-07 it looked exactly like a dead legacy tag and was nearly deleted;
# only a file-existence check saved it.
#
# So the plan is now derived from this VOCABULARY, which does not move with the
# data. Every label build() writes comes from a constant below, and build()
# asserts its own output is a subset of all_tags() before returning -- add a new
# label to build() without registering it here and the next run fails loudly
# instead of shipping another half-managed tag.
# ===========================================================================
# League CP caps: game constants, imported from cpm_table.py (single source of truth).
from cpm_table import GL_CAP, UL_CAP

VARIANT_LABELS = ('Variant #1', 'Variant #2', 'Variant #3')
VARIANT_OVERFLOW = 'Variant #4+'
SHINY_SOLE = 'Shiny - Only One'
