`pogo_extract/hook_ui_text.py`:

```py
"""Hook Unity UI Text setters to capture Pokemod's rank rendering.

When user opens a pokemon detail page, Pokemod injects a 'PvP Rank: X' text
into the UI. We hook ALL setters that take a string to find which one Pokemod
uses, capturing the rank value + proto pointer in same call stack.
"""
import frida, subprocess, time

adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
d = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
sess = d.attach(adb_pid)

js = """
var captured = [];
var fns = {};

function init() {
    var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
    var exp = {};
    il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) exp[e.name] = e.address; });
    function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(exp[n],r,a); }
    fns.dG = bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
    fns.dGA = bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
    fns.aGI = bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.iGN = bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.cFN = bind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
    fns.cGM = bind('il2cpp_class_get_methods','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
    fns.mGN = bind('il2cpp_method_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.tA = bind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.sN_get = bind('il2cpp_string_new','pointer',['pointer']);
}

function readDotNetString(strPtr) {
    try {
        if (strPtr.isNull()) return null;
        var len = strPtr.add(0x10).readS32();
        if (len <= 0 || len > 500) return null;
        var chars = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            chars.push(String.fromCharCode(strPtr.add(0x14 + i*2).readU16()));
        }
        return chars.join('');
    } catch(e) { return null; }
}

rpc.exports = {
    /* Hook IL2CPP string allocation - capture any string containing 'Rank' */
    hookStringAlloc: function() {
        init();
        var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
        var exp = {};
        il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) exp[e.name] = e.address; });
        // Hook il2cpp_string_new (UTF-8 input) and il2cpp_string_new_utf16
        Interceptor.attach(exp.il2cpp_string_new, {
            onEnter: function(args) { this.input = args[0]; },
            onLeave: function(retval) {
                try {
                    var s = this.input.readCString();
                    if (s && /Rank|rank|League|league|Pvp|PvP/.test(s)) {
                        send({type:'sa', msg: s + ' -> ' + retval.toString()});
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            }
        });
        if (exp.il2cpp_string_new_utf16) {
            Interceptor.attach(exp.il2cpp_string_new_utf16, {
                onEnter: function(args) { this.input = args[0]; this.len = args[1].toInt32(); },
                onLeave: function(retval) {
                    try {
                        if (this.len <= 0 || this.len > 500) return;
                        var chars = [];
                        for (var i = 0; i < this.len; i++) {
                            chars.push(String.fromCharCode(this.input.add(i*2).readU16()));
                        }
                        var s = chars.join('');
                        if (/Rank|rank|League|league/.test(s)) {
                            send({type:'sa', msg: 'utf16: ' + s + ' -> ' + retval.toString()});
                        }
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
            });
        }
        // Also hook il2cpp_string_new_len
        if (exp.il2cpp_string_new_len) {
            Interceptor.attach(exp.il2cpp_string_new_len, {
                onEnter: function(args) {
                    this.input = args[0];
                    this.len = args[1].toInt32();
                },
                onLeave: function(retval) {
                    try {
                        if (this.len <= 0 || this.len > 500) return;
                        var s = this.input.readUtf8String(this.len);
                        if (s && /Rank|rank|League|league/.test(s)) {
                            send({type:'sa', msg: 'len: ' + s + ' -> ' + retval.toString()});
                        }
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
            });
        }
        return {ok:true, msg:'hooked'};
    },

    /* Hook TMP_Text and Text setters */
    hookTmpText: function() {
        init();
        var sp = Memory.alloc(4);
        var asms = fns.dGA(fns.dG(), sp);
        var na = sp.readS32();
        var unityImg = null, tmpImg = null;
        for (var a=0;a<na;a++){
            var img = fns.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
            var nm = fns.iGN(img).readCString();
            if (nm === 'UnityEngine.UI.dll') unityImg = img;
            if (nm === 'Unity.TextMeshPro.dll') tmpImg = img;
        }
        var hooked = 0;
        function hookTextSetter(img, ns, cls, propName) {
            try {
                var clsP = fns.cFN(img, Memory.allocUtf8String(ns), Memory.allocUtf8String(cls));
                if (!clsP || clsP.isNull()) return;
                var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
                var m;
                while ((m = fns.cGM(clsP, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
                    var nm = fns.mGN(m).readCString();
                    if (nm === 'set_text' || nm === propName) {
                        var addr = m.readPointer();
                        if (addr.isNull()) continue;
                        Interceptor.attach(addr, {
                            onEnter: function(args) {
                                try {
                                    var s = readDotNetString(args[1]);
                                    if (s && /Rank|rank|League|league/.test(s)) {
                                        send({type:'ut', msg: cls + '.set_text: ' + s});
                                    }
                                } catch(e) {}
                            }
                        });
                        hooked++;
                    }
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        function readDotNetString(strPtr) {
            try {
                if (strPtr.isNull()) return null;
                var len = strPtr.add(0x10).readS32();
                if (len <= 0 || len > 500) return null;
                var chars = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                    chars.push(String.fromCharCode(strPtr.add(0x14 + i*2).readU16()));
                }
                return chars.join('');
            } catch(e) { return null; }
        }
        if (unityImg) {
            hookTextSetter(unityImg, 'UnityEngine.UI', 'Text', 'set_text');
        }
        if (tmpImg) {
            hookTextSetter(tmpImg, 'TMPro', 'TMP_Text', 'set_text');
            hookTextSetter(tmpImg, 'TMPro', 'TextMeshPro', 'set_text');
            hookTextSetter(tmpImg, 'TMPro', 'TextMeshProUGUI', 'set_text');
        }
        return {ok:true, hooked: hooked};
    }
};
"""
script = sess.create_script(js)
def on(m, data):
    p = m.get('payload', {})
    if isinstance(p, dict) and 'msg' in p:
        print(f"  [{p.get('type','?')}] {p['msg']}")
script.on('message', on)
script.load()

print("Hooking il2cpp string alloc...")
print(script.exports_sync.hook_string_alloc())
print("\nHooking UI text setters...")
print(script.exports_sync.hook_tmp_text())
print("\n>>> Open PoGo, tap any pokemon to see its detail page (Pokemod renders 'PvP Rank: X' at bottom)")
print(">>> Capturing for 60 seconds...")
time.sleep(60)
print("\nDone. Detaching.")
sess.detach()
```

`pogo_extract/il2cpp_cache_helper.js`:

```js
/* il2cpp_cache_helper.js
 *
 * Frida-side helper for cached IL2CPP lookups. The Python caller injects a
 * CACHE constant before this code (string-format substitution) containing:
 *   { exports: { name: rva, ... },
 *     field_offsets: { "Holoholo.Rpc.PokemonProto": {fieldName: int, ...}, ... },
 *     image_hints: { "Niantic.Holoholo.Internal.PokemonBagImpl": "holo-game.dll", ... }
 *   }
 *
 * Pattern (Python side):
 *     helper = open("il2cpp_cache_helper.js").read()
 *     blob = "var CACHE = " + cache.to_js_literal() + ";\n" + helper + script_body
 *     sess.create_script(blob)
 *
 * After this loads, `IL2CPP` is available in the script with:
 *   IL2CPP.fn.<api>            -- prebound NativeFunctions for cached exports
 *   IL2CPP.getClass(qn)        -- resolve Il2CppClass*, memoized
 *   IL2CPP.getMethod(qn, n, c) -- resolve MethodInfo*, single-call
 *   IL2CPP.getFieldOffset(qn, name) -- cached managed-field offset
 *   IL2CPP.ensureDomain()      -- attach current thread once
 */

var IL2CPP = (function() {
    if (typeof CACHE === "undefined") throw new Error("il2cpp_cache_helper: CACHE not injected");
    var EXPORT_RVAS = CACHE.exports;
    var FIELD_OFFSETS = CACHE.field_offsets || {};
    var IMAGE_HINTS = CACHE.image_hints || {};

    var mod = Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");
    if (!mod) throw new Error("libil2cpp.so not mapped yet");
    var base = mod.base;

    var fn = {};
    function bind(name, ret, args) {
        var rva = EXPORT_RVAS[name];
        if (rva === undefined) return null;
        return new NativeFunction(base.add(rva), ret, args);
    }
    fn.domain_get = bind("il2cpp_domain_get", "pointer", []);
    fn.domain_get_assemblies = bind("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies", "pointer", ["pointer","pointer"]);
    fn.assembly_get_image = bind("il2cpp_assembly_get_image", "pointer", ["pointer"]);
    fn.image_get_name = bind("il2cpp_image_get_name", "pointer", ["pointer"]);
    fn.image_get_class_count = bind("il2cpp_image_get_class_count", "int", ["pointer"]);
    fn.image_get_class = bind("il2cpp_image_get_class", "pointer", ["pointer","int"]);
    fn.class_from_name = bind("il2cpp_class_from_name", "pointer", ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
    fn.class_get_name = bind("il2cpp_class_get_name", "pointer", ["pointer"]);
    fn.class_get_namespace = bind("il2cpp_class_get_namespace", "pointer", ["pointer"]);
    fn.class_get_method_from_name = bind("il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name", "pointer", ["pointer","pointer","int"]);
    fn.class_get_methods = bind("il2cpp_class_get_methods", "pointer", ["pointer","pointer"]);
    fn.class_get_field_from_name = bind("il2cpp_class_get_field_from_name", "pointer", ["pointer","pointer"]);
    fn.class_get_fields = bind("il2cpp_class_get_fields", "pointer", ["pointer","pointer"]);
    fn.method_get_name = bind("il2cpp_method_get_name", "pointer", ["pointer"]);
    fn.field_get_offset = bind("il2cpp_field_get_offset", "int", ["pointer"]);
    fn.field_get_name = bind("il2cpp_field_get_name", "pointer", ["pointer"]);
    fn.field_get_value_object = bind("il2cpp_field_get_value_object", "pointer", ["pointer","pointer"]);
    fn.runtime_invoke = bind("il2cpp_runtime_invoke", "pointer", ["pointer","pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
    fn.thread_attach = bind("il2cpp_thread_attach", "pointer", ["pointer"]);
    fn.string_chars = bind("il2cpp_string_chars", "pointer", ["pointer"]);
    fn.string_length = bind("il2cpp_string_length", "int", ["pointer"]);
    fn.array_length = bind("il2cpp_array_length", "int", ["pointer"]);

    var _domain = null;
    var _images = {};
    var _classes = {};
    var _strCache = {};

    function utf8(s) {
        var hit = _strCache[s];
        if (hit) return hit;
        var p = Memory.allocUtf8String(s);
        _strCache[s] = p;
        return p;
    }

    function ensureDomain() {
        if (_domain) return _domain;
        var d = fn.domain_get();
        if (d.isNull()) throw new Error("il2cpp_domain_get returned NULL");
        fn.thread_attach(d);
        _domain = d;
        return d;
    }

    function loadAllImages() {
        if (Object.keys(_images).length > 0) return;
        var dom = ensureDomain();
        var sp = Memory.alloc(4);
        var asms = fn.domain_get_assemblies(dom, sp);
        var n = sp.readS32();
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            var img = fn.assembly_get_image(asms.add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
            if (img.isNull()) continue;
            _images[fn.image_get_name(img).readCString()] = img;
        }
    }

    function getImage(dllName) {
        loadAllImages();
        return _images[dllName] || null;
    }

    function getClass(qualifiedName) {
        var hit = _classes[qualifiedName];
        if (hit) return hit;
        var lastDot = qualifiedName.lastIndexOf(".");
        var ns = lastDot >= 0 ? qualifiedName.substring(0, lastDot) : "";
        var cls = lastDot >= 0 ? qualifiedName.substring(lastDot + 1) : qualifiedName;
        var nsP = utf8(ns);
        var clsP = utf8(cls);
        var hint = IMAGE_HINTS[qualifiedName];
        var dlls = hint ? [hint, "holo-game.dll", "holo-protos.dll", "Assembly-CSharp.dll"]
                        : ["holo-game.dll", "holo-protos.dll", "Assembly-CSharp.dll"];
        for (var i = 0; i < dlls.length; i++) {
            var img = getImage(dlls[i]);
            if (!img) continue;
            var k = fn.class_from_name(img, nsP, clsP);
            if (!k.isNull()) {
                _classes[qualifiedName] = k;
                return k;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function getMethod(qualifiedName, methodName, argc) {
        var k = getClass(qualifiedName);
        if (!k) return null;
        var m = fn.class_get_method_from_name(k, utf8(methodName), argc);
        return m.isNull() ? null : m;
    }

    function getFieldOffset(qualifiedName, fieldName) {
        var bucket = FIELD_OFFSETS[qualifiedName];
        if (bucket && bucket[fieldName] !== undefined) return bucket[fieldName];
        var k = getClass(qualifiedName);
        if (!k) return -1;
        var f = fn.class_get_field_from_name(k, utf8(fieldName));
        if (f.isNull()) return -1;
        return fn.field_get_offset(f);
    }

    return {
        fn: fn,
        base: base,
        ensureDomain: ensureDomain,
        getImage: getImage,
        getClass: getClass,
        getMethod: getMethod,
        getFieldOffset: getFieldOffset,
        _stats: function() {
            return {
                exportsBound: Object.keys(fn).filter(function(k){return fn[k];}).length,
                imagesLoaded: Object.keys(_images).length,
                classesResolved: Object.keys(_classes).length,
                fieldOffsetsCached: Object.keys(FIELD_OFFSETS).length,
            };
        }
    };
})();

```

`pogo_extract/il2cpp_dump.py`:

```py
"""
IL2CPP Pokemon Inventory Extractor.

Attaches to running PoGO process via frida-server, resolves IL2CPP classes,
and dumps all Pokemon data before anti-cheat kills the session (~10-20s window).

Usage: python il2cpp_dump.py
"""
import frida
import sys
import json
import time
import threading

DEVICE_ADDR = '127.0.0.1:31337'  # frida-server via ADB port forward
POGO_PACKAGE = 'com.nianticlabs.pokemongo'

results = []
done_event = threading.Event()
error_msg = None

def on_message(message, data):
    global error_msg
    if message['type'] == 'send':
        payload = message['payload']
        if isinstance(payload, dict):
            msg_type = payload.get('type', '')
            if msg_type == 'status':
                print(f"  [status] {payload['msg']}")
            elif msg_type == 'error':
                print(f"  [ERROR] {payload['msg']}")
                error_msg = payload['msg']
            elif msg_type == 'fields':
                print(f"  [fields] {json.dumps(payload['data'], indent=2)}")
                results.append(payload)
            elif msg_type == 'pokemon':
                results.append(payload)
                count = len([r for r in results if r.get('type') == 'pokemon'])
                if count % 100 == 0:
                    print(f"  [pokemon] {count} extracted so far...")
            elif msg_type == 'done':
                print(f"  [DONE] {payload.get('msg', '')}")
                done_event.set()
            else:
                print(f"  [{msg_type}] {payload}")
        else:
            print(f"  [msg] {payload}")
    elif message['type'] == 'error':
        print(f"  [script error] {message.get('description', message)}")
        error_msg = message.get('description', str(message))

def main():
    # Connect to frida-server
    print(f"Connecting to frida-server at {DEVICE_ADDR}...")
    mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
    device = mgr.add_remote_device(DEVICE_ADDR)
    print(f"  Device: {device.name}")

    # Find PoGO process
    print("Looking for Pokemon GO process...")
    try:
        # Try by name first
        proc = device.get_process(POGO_PACKAGE)
        pid = proc.pid
        print(f"  Found: PID {pid}")
    except frida.ProcessNotFoundError:
        # Try by PID directly if hidden from enumeration
        print("  Not found via name (anti-cheat hides it)")
        pid_input = input("  Enter PoGO PID manually (from 'adb shell pidof'): ").strip()
        pid = int(pid_input)

    # Attach
    print(f"Attaching to PID {pid}...")
    session = device.attach(pid)
    print("  Attached! Loading script...")

    # Read the IL2CPP extraction script
    with open('il2cpp_extract.js', 'r') as f:
        script_source = f.read()

    # Create and load script
    script = session.create_script(script_source)
    script.on('message', on_message)
    script.load()
    print("  Script loaded. Waiting for results (30s game load + extraction)...")

    # Wait for completion or timeout
    try:
        done_event.wait(timeout=90)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nInterrupted by user")

    # Save results
    if results:
        outfile = 'il2cpp_results.json'
        with open(outfile, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
        print(f"\nSaved {len(results)} results to {outfile}")
    else:
        print("\nNo results collected")
        if error_msg:
            print(f"Last error: {error_msg}")

    # Cleanup
    try:
        session.detach()
    except:
        pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`pogo_extract/il2cpp_extract.js`:

```js
/*
 * Pokemon GO IL2CPP inventory extraction via Frida.
 *
 * Strategy:
 * 1. Resolve IL2CPP API functions from libil2cpp.so exports
 * 2. Find PokemonProto class and its fields
 * 3. Enumerate all Pokemon in the bag
 * 4. Send data back via Frida send() messages
 *
 * Must be injected with spawn (before anti-cheat):
 *   frida-inject -D <device> -f com.nianticlabs.pokemongo -s il2cpp_extract.js --no-pause
 * Or via our spawn_inject.py wrapper.
 */

// Resolve IL2CPP exports
var il2cpp = Process.getModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");
var exports_map = {};
var needed = [
    "il2cpp_domain_get",
    "il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies",
    "il2cpp_assembly_get_image",
    "il2cpp_class_from_name",
    "il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name",
    "il2cpp_class_get_fields",
    "il2cpp_class_get_field_from_name",
    "il2cpp_field_get_name",
    "il2cpp_field_get_offset",
    "il2cpp_field_get_value",
    "il2cpp_field_get_value_object",
    "il2cpp_runtime_invoke",
    "il2cpp_thread_attach",
    "il2cpp_domain_get",
    "il2cpp_string_chars",
    "il2cpp_string_length",
    "il2cpp_string_new",
    "il2cpp_object_new",
    "il2cpp_array_length",
    "il2cpp_image_get_class_count",
    "il2cpp_image_get_class",
    "il2cpp_class_get_name",
    "il2cpp_class_get_namespace",
    "il2cpp_class_get_type",
    "il2cpp_type_get_name",
    "il2cpp_method_get_param_count",
];

var il2cpp_exports = il2cpp.enumerateExports();
for (var i = 0; i < il2cpp_exports.length; i++) {
    var e = il2cpp_exports[i];
    if (needed.indexOf(e.name) >= 0) {
        exports_map[e.name] = e.address;
    }
}

send({type: "status", msg: "IL2CPP exports resolved: " + Object.keys(exports_map).length + "/" + needed.length});

// Check we have the critical ones
var missing = [];
for (var j = 0; j < needed.length; j++) {
    if (!exports_map[needed[j]]) missing.push(needed[j]);
}
if (missing.length > 0) {
    send({type: "error", msg: "Missing IL2CPP exports: " + missing.join(", ")});
}

// Bind IL2CPP API functions
var il2cpp_domain_get = new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_domain_get"], 'pointer', []);
var il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies = new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies"], 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']);
var il2cpp_thread_attach = new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_thread_attach"], 'pointer', ['pointer']);
var il2cpp_class_from_name = new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_class_from_name"], 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer', 'pointer']);
var il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name = new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name"], 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer', 'int']);
var il2cpp_class_get_field_from_name = new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_class_get_field_from_name"], 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']);
var il2cpp_field_get_offset = new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_field_get_offset"], 'int', ['pointer']);
var il2cpp_field_get_value_object = new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_field_get_value_object"], 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']);
var il2cpp_runtime_invoke = new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_runtime_invoke"], 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer', 'pointer', 'pointer']);
var il2cpp_string_chars = exports_map["il2cpp_string_chars"] ? new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_string_chars"], 'pointer', ['pointer']) : null;
var il2cpp_string_length = exports_map["il2cpp_string_length"] ? new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_string_length"], 'int', ['pointer']) : null;
var il2cpp_array_length = new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_array_length"], 'int', ['pointer']);
var il2cpp_image_get_class_count = exports_map["il2cpp_image_get_class_count"] ? new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_image_get_class_count"], 'int', ['pointer']) : null;
var il2cpp_image_get_class = exports_map["il2cpp_image_get_class"] ? new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_image_get_class"], 'pointer', ['pointer', 'int']) : null;
var il2cpp_class_get_name = exports_map["il2cpp_class_get_name"] ? new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_class_get_name"], 'pointer', ['pointer']) : null;
var il2cpp_class_get_namespace = exports_map["il2cpp_class_get_namespace"] ? new NativeFunction(exports_map["il2cpp_class_get_namespace"], 'pointer', ['pointer']) : null;

// Helper: read IL2CPP string object (C# System.String layout: vtable ptr, length at +0x10, chars at +0x14)
function readIl2cppString(strObj) {
    if (strObj.isNull()) return null;
    // IL2CPP string layout: [MethodTable*][m_stringLength (int32 at offset 0x10)][m_firstChar (at offset 0x14)]
    var len = strObj.add(0x10).readS32();
    if (len <= 0 || len > 100) return null;
    var chars = strObj.add(0x14).readUtf16String(len);
    return chars;
}

// Helper: read int32 field from IL2CPP object
function readInt32Field(obj, offset) {
    return obj.add(offset).readS32();
}

// Helper: read float field
function readFloatField(obj, offset) {
    return obj.add(offset).readFloat();
}

// Helper: read bool field
function readBoolField(obj, offset) {
    return obj.add(offset).readU8() !== 0;
}

// Helper: read int64 field
function readInt64Field(obj, offset) {
    var low = obj.add(offset).readU32();
    var high = obj.add(offset + 4).readS32();
    return high * 0x100000000 + low;
}

// Helper: read pointer field (object reference)
function readPtrField(obj, offset) {
    return obj.add(offset).readPointer();
}

// Wait for game to be fully loaded, then extract
function waitAndExtract() {
    send({type: "status", msg: "Waiting 30s for game to fully load..."});

    setTimeout(function() {
        try {
            extract();
        } catch(e) {
            send({type: "error", msg: "Extract failed: " + e.message + "\n" + e.stack});
        }
    }, 30000);
}

function extract() {
    // Attach current thread to IL2CPP
    var domain = il2cpp_domain_get();
    send({type: "status", msg: "Domain: " + domain});

    if (domain.isNull()) {
        send({type: "error", msg: "il2cpp_domain_get returned NULL - game not loaded yet"});
        return;
    }

    il2cpp_thread_attach(domain);
    send({type: "status", msg: "Thread attached to IL2CPP domain"});

    // Get assemblies
    var sizePtr = Memory.alloc(4);
    var assemblies = il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies(domain, sizePtr);
    var numAssemblies = sizePtr.readS32();
    send({type: "status", msg: "Assemblies: " + numAssemblies});

    // We need to find the image that contains Holoholo.Rpc namespace
    // First, let's find il2cpp_assembly_get_image
    var il2cpp_assembly_get_image = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < il2cpp_exports.length; i++) {
        if (il2cpp_exports[i].name === "il2cpp_assembly_get_image") {
            il2cpp_assembly_get_image = new NativeFunction(il2cpp_exports[i].address, 'pointer', ['pointer']);
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!il2cpp_assembly_get_image) {
        send({type: "error", msg: "il2cpp_assembly_get_image not found"});
        return;
    }

    // Also find il2cpp_image_get_name
    var il2cpp_image_get_name = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < il2cpp_exports.length; i++) {
        if (il2cpp_exports[i].name === "il2cpp_image_get_name") {
            il2cpp_image_get_name = new NativeFunction(il2cpp_exports[i].address, 'pointer', ['pointer']);
            break;
        }
    }

    // Search assemblies for Holoholo.Rpc.PokemonProto
    var targetImage = null;
    var nsPtr = Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc");
    var classNamePtr = Memory.allocUtf8String("PokemonProto");

    for (var a = 0; a < numAssemblies; a++) {
        var assembly = assemblies.add(a * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
        var image = il2cpp_assembly_get_image(assembly);

        // Try to find PokemonProto in this image
        var klass = il2cpp_class_from_name(image, nsPtr, classNamePtr);
        if (!klass.isNull()) {
            targetImage = image;
            send({type: "status", msg: "Found PokemonProto in assembly #" + a});
            if (il2cpp_image_get_name) {
                var imgName = il2cpp_image_get_name(image).readCString();
                send({type: "status", msg: "Image name: " + imgName});
            }
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!targetImage) {
        send({type: "error", msg: "Could not find Holoholo.Rpc.PokemonProto in any assembly"});
        return;
    }

    // Now find PokemonProto class and its fields
    var pokemonProtoClass = il2cpp_class_from_name(targetImage, nsPtr, classNamePtr);
    send({type: "status", msg: "PokemonProto class: " + pokemonProtoClass});

    // Get field offsets for PokemonProto
    var fields = {};
    var fieldNames = [
        "pokemonId_", "cp_", "stamina_", "staminaMax_", "move1_", "move2_", "move3_",
        "individualAttack_", "individualDefense_", "individualStamina_",
        "heightM_", "weightKg_", "nickname_", "pokeball_",
        "cpMultiplier_", "numAdditionalCpMultiplier_",
        "creationTimeMs_", "pokemonDisplay_",
        "isLucky_", "isBad_", "move2IsPurifiedExclusive_",
        "deployedFortId_"
    ];

    for (var f = 0; f < fieldNames.length; f++) {
        var fnPtr = Memory.allocUtf8String(fieldNames[f]);
        var field = il2cpp_class_get_field_from_name(pokemonProtoClass, fnPtr);
        if (!field.isNull()) {
            var offset = il2cpp_field_get_offset(field);
            fields[fieldNames[f]] = offset;
        }
    }

    send({type: "status", msg: "PokemonProto fields resolved: " + JSON.stringify(fields)});

    // Now we need to find PokemonBagImpl or the singleton that holds the inventory
    // Try: Niantic.Holoholo.Internal.PokemonBagImpl
    var bagNsPtr = Memory.allocUtf8String("Niantic.Holoholo.Internal");
    var bagClassPtr = Memory.allocUtf8String("PokemonBagImpl");
    var pokemonBagClass = il2cpp_class_from_name(targetImage, bagNsPtr, bagClassPtr);

    if (pokemonBagClass.isNull()) {
        // Try other namespaces
        var altNs = ["Niantic.Holoholo", "Niantic.Holoholo.Inventory", ""];
        for (var n = 0; n < altNs.length; n++) {
            var nsP = Memory.allocUtf8String(altNs[n]);
            pokemonBagClass = il2cpp_class_from_name(targetImage, nsP, bagClassPtr);
            if (!pokemonBagClass.isNull()) {
                send({type: "status", msg: "Found PokemonBagImpl in namespace: " + altNs[n]});
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    if (pokemonBagClass.isNull()) {
        send({type: "status", msg: "PokemonBagImpl not found directly, searching all classes..."});

        // Enumerate classes in the image to find it
        if (il2cpp_image_get_class_count && il2cpp_image_get_class && il2cpp_class_get_name && il2cpp_class_get_namespace) {
            var classCount = il2cpp_image_get_class_count(targetImage);
            send({type: "status", msg: "Searching " + classCount + " classes..."});

            var found_classes = [];
            for (var c = 0; c < classCount; c++) {
                var cls = il2cpp_image_get_class(targetImage, c);
                if (cls.isNull()) continue;
                var name = il2cpp_class_get_name(cls).readCString();
                if (name && (name.indexOf("PokemonBag") >= 0 || name.indexOf("AllPokemon") >= 0)) {
                    var ns = il2cpp_class_get_namespace(cls).readCString();
                    found_classes.push(ns + "." + name);
                }
            }
            send({type: "status", msg: "Bag-related classes: " + JSON.stringify(found_classes)});
        }
        return;
    }

    // Find GetAllPokemon method
    var getAllMethodName = Memory.allocUtf8String("GetAllPokemon");
    var getAllMethod = il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name(pokemonBagClass, getAllMethodName, 0);

    if (getAllMethod.isNull()) {
        send({type: "status", msg: "GetAllPokemon(0 params) not found, trying with 1 param..."});
        getAllMethod = il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name(pokemonBagClass, getAllMethodName, 1);
    }

    if (getAllMethod.isNull()) {
        send({type: "error", msg: "GetAllPokemon method not found on PokemonBagImpl"});
        // List available methods
        var methodNames = ["GetAllPokemon", "get_AllPokemon", "GetPokemons", "get_Pokemons", "get_allPokemon"];
        for (var m = 0; m < methodNames.length; m++) {
            var mPtr = Memory.allocUtf8String(methodNames[m]);
            for (var p = 0; p <= 3; p++) {
                var meth = il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name(pokemonBagClass, mPtr, p);
                if (!meth.isNull()) {
                    send({type: "status", msg: "Found method: " + methodNames[m] + " (params=" + p + ")"});
                }
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    send({type: "status", msg: "GetAllPokemon method: " + getAllMethod});

    // TODO: We need the PokemonBagImpl singleton instance
    // This requires finding how to get the instance (likely via dependency injection / ServiceLocator)
    // For now, report what we found
    send({type: "status", msg: "READY: PokemonProto class and fields located. Need instance access strategy."});
    send({type: "fields", data: fields});
}

// Delay start to allow game to load
waitAndExtract();
```

```js
/*
 * Full Pokemon extraction: find PokemonBagImpl instance and dump all pokemon.
 *
 * Strategy: Find the instance via static fields, GC handle scanning, or
 * by hooking get_AllPokemon and waiting for the game to call it.
 */

var il2cpp = Process.getModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");
var exports_map = {};

    if (!exports_map[name]) return null;
    return new NativeFunction(exports_map[name], ret, args);
}

var il2cpp_string_chars = bind("il2cpp_string_chars", 'pointer', ['pointer']);
var il2cpp_class_get_static_field_data = bind("il2cpp_class_get_static_field_data", 'pointer', ['pointer']);
var il2cpp_method_get_from_reflection = bind("il2cpp_method_get_from_reflection", 'pointer', ['pointer']);
var il2cpp_image_get_class_count = bind("il2cpp_image_get_class_count", 'int', ['pointer']);
var il2cpp_image_get_class = bind("il2cpp_image_get_class", 'pointer', ['pointer', 'int']);
var il2cpp_class_get_name = bind("il2cpp_class_get_name", 'pointer', ['pointer']);
var il2cpp_class_get_namespace = bind("il2cpp_class_get_namespace", 'pointer', ['pointer']);
var il2cpp_class_get_fields = bind("il2cpp_class_get_fields", 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']);
var il2cpp_field_get_name = bind("il2cpp_field_get_name", 'pointer', ['pointer']);

var domain = il2cpp_domain_get();
il2cpp_thread_attach(domain);

var sizePtr = Memory.alloc(4);
var assemblies = il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies(domain, sizePtr);
var numAssemblies = sizePtr.readS32();

// Find holo-game.dll image
var gameImage = null;

    var assembly = assemblies.add(a * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();

    if (imgName === "holo-game.dll") gameImage = image;
    if (imgName === "holo-protos.dll") protoImage = image;

send({type: "status", msg: "Images found: game=" + (gameImage ? "yes" : "no") + " proto=" + (protoImage ? "yes" : "no")});

// Get PokemonBagImpl class
var bagNs = Memory.allocUtf8String("Niantic.Holoholo.Internal");
var bagName = Memory.allocUtf8String("PokemonBagImpl");
var pokemonBagClass = il2cpp_class_from_name(gameImage, bagNs, bagName);

// Get PokemonProto class (for field offsets)
var protoNs = Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc");
var protoName = Memory.allocUtf8String("PokemonProto");
var pokemonProtoClass = il2cpp_class_from_name(protoImage, protoNs, protoName);

send({type: "status", msg: "PokemonBagImpl: " + pokemonBagClass + ", PokemonProto: " + pokemonProtoClass});

// PokemonProto field offsets (from previous run)
var FIELDS = {
    id: 32,          // int64 - unique ID
    pokemonId: 40,   // int32 - species (dex number)
    cp: 44,          // int32
    stamina: 48,     // int32
    move1: 56,       // int32 (enum)
    move2: 60,       // int32 (enum)
    move3: 276,      // int32 (enum)
    ivAtk: 112,      // int32
    ivDef: 116,      // int32
    ivSta: 120,      // int32
    heightM: 104,    // float
    weightKg: 108,   // float
    cpMultiplier: 124, // float
    nickname: 184,   // pointer to Il2CppString
    pokeball: 128,   // int32 (enum)
    creationTimeMs: 160, // int64
    pokemonDisplay: 216, // pointer to PokemonDisplayProto
    isLucky: 272,    // bool
    deployedFortId: 64,  // pointer to string

// Strategy 1: Check if PokemonBagImpl has static field data (singleton pattern)
if (il2cpp_class_get_static_field_data) {
    var staticData = il2cpp_class_get_static_field_data(pokemonBagClass);
    send({type: "status", msg: "Static field data ptr: " + staticData});

    // Static fields with offset 0 from our earlier scan: cuhv, cuhw, cuhx, cuhy, cuhz
    // These are likely at staticData + 0, +8, +16, +24, +32
    if (staticData && !staticData.isNull()) {
        for (var si = 0; si < 5; si++) {
            var val = staticData.add(si * 8).readPointer();
            send({type: "status", msg: "  static[" + si + "] = " + val});
            if (!val.isNull()) {
                // Could be our instance! Check if it's a valid object
                try {
                    var objClass = il2cpp_object_get_class(val);
                    if (objClass && !objClass.isNull()) {
                        var cn = il2cpp_class_get_name(objClass).readCString();
                        send({type: "status", msg: "    -> class: " + cn});
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            }
        }
    }
}

// Strategy 2: Hook get_AllPokemon and intercept when game calls it
// The method is at a known address from previous run
var getAllMethod = il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name(pokemonBagClass, Memory.allocUtf8String("get_AllPokemon"), 0);
var getCountMethod = il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name(pokemonBagClass, Memory.allocUtf8String("get_Count"), 0);

send({type: "status", msg: "get_AllPokemon method: " + getAllMethod});
send({type: "status", msg: "get_Count method: " + getCountMethod});

if (getAllMethod && !getAllMethod.isNull()) {
    // In IL2CPP, MethodInfo has the method pointer at offset 0
    var methodPtr = getAllMethod.readPointer();
    send({type: "status", msg: "get_AllPokemon native code at: " + methodPtr});

    // Hook it
    Interceptor.attach(methodPtr, {
        onEnter: function(args) {
            // args[0] = this (PokemonBagImpl instance)
            this.instance = args[0];
            send({type: "status", msg: "get_AllPokemon called! instance=" + this.instance});
        },
        onLeave: function(retval) {
            // retval is the collection/list of PokemonProto objects
            if (retval.isNull()) {
                send({type: "status", msg: "get_AllPokemon returned null"});
                return;
            }

            send({type: "status", msg: "get_AllPokemon returned: " + retval});

            // Try to read it as a List<T> or array
            // IL2CPP List<T> has: [vtable, _items (array), _size (int32)]
            // offset: _items at 0x10, _size at 0x18
            try {
                var itemsArray = retval.add(0x10).readPointer();
                var size = retval.add(0x18).readS32();
                send({type: "status", msg: "List size: " + size + ", items array: " + itemsArray});

                if (size > 0 && size < 10000 && !itemsArray.isNull()) {
                    extractPokemon(itemsArray, size);
                }
            } catch(e) {
                send({type: "status", msg: "List read failed, trying IReadOnlyList..."});
                // Maybe it's returning something else (IReadOnlyList, array, etc)
                try {
                    // Try as raw array: length at +0x18, elements start at +0x20
                    var arrLen = retval.add(0x18).readS32();
                    send({type: "status", msg: "Trying as array, length field: " + arrLen});
                    if (arrLen > 0 && arrLen < 10000) {
                        extractPokemonFromArray(retval, arrLen);
                    }
                } catch(e2) {
                    send({type: "error", msg: "Could not read return value: " + e2.message});
                }
            }
        }
    });

    send({type: "status", msg: "Hook installed on get_AllPokemon. Waiting for game to call it..."});
    send({type: "status", msg: "Open Pokemon inventory in game to trigger the call!"});

    // Also hook get_Count to capture the instance
    if (getCountMethod && !getCountMethod.isNull()) {
        var countMethodPtr = getCountMethod.readPointer();
        Interceptor.attach(countMethodPtr, {
            onEnter: function(args) {
                this.instance = args[0];
            },
            onLeave: function(retval) {
                var count = retval.toInt32();
                send({type: "status", msg: "get_Count called! count=" + count + " instance=" + this.instance});

                // Now call get_AllPokemon ourselves using this instance
                if (count > 0) {
                    send({type: "status", msg: "Invoking get_AllPokemon on captured instance..."});
                    var excPtr = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
                    excPtr.writePointer(ptr(0));
                    var result = il2cpp_runtime_invoke(getAllMethod, this.instance, ptr(0), excPtr);
                    var exc = excPtr.readPointer();
                    if (!exc.isNull()) {
                        send({type: "error", msg: "runtime_invoke threw exception"});
                    } else if (!result.isNull()) {
                        send({type: "status", msg: "Direct invoke result: " + result});
                        // The result should be processed by our hook above
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        send({type: "status", msg: "Also hooked get_Count"});
    }
}

function extractPokemon(itemsArray, size) {
    send({type: "status", msg: "Extracting " + size + " pokemon..."});
    var pokemon = [];

    // Array elements start at offset 0x20 (after vtable, typeinfo, bounds, max_length)
    var elemStart = itemsArray.add(0x20);

    for (var i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        var objPtr = elemStart.add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
        if (objPtr.isNull()) continue;

        try {
            var poke = readPokemonProto(objPtr);
            pokemon.push(poke);

            if (pokemon.length % 500 === 0) {
                send({type: "progress", count: pokemon.length, total: size});
            }
        } catch(e) {
            send({type: "status", msg: "Error reading pokemon #" + i + ": " + e.message});
        }
    }

    send({type: "pokemon_data", count: pokemon.length, data: pokemon});
    send({type: "done", msg: "Extracted " + pokemon.length + " pokemon!"});
}

function extractPokemonFromArray(arr, size) {
    send({type: "status", msg: "Extracting " + size + " pokemon from array..."});
    var pokemon = [];
    var elemStart = arr.add(0x20);

    for (var i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        var objPtr = elemStart.add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
        if (objPtr.isNull()) continue;
        try {
            pokemon.push(readPokemonProto(objPtr));
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    send({type: "pokemon_data", count: pokemon.length, data: pokemon});
    send({type: "done", msg: "Extracted " + pokemon.length + " pokemon!"});
}

function readPokemonProto(ptr) {
    var p = {};
    p.id = readInt64(ptr, FIELDS.id);
    p.pokemonId = ptr.add(FIELDS.pokemonId).readS32();
    p.cp = ptr.add(FIELDS.cp).readS32();
    p.stamina = ptr.add(FIELDS.stamina).readS32();
    p.move1 = ptr.add(FIELDS.move1).readS32();
    p.move2 = ptr.add(FIELDS.move2).readS32();
    p.move3 = ptr.add(FIELDS.move3).readS32();
    p.ivAtk = ptr.add(FIELDS.ivAtk).readS32();
    p.ivDef = ptr.add(FIELDS.ivDef).readS32();
    p.ivSta = ptr.add(FIELDS.ivSta).readS32();
    p.heightM = ptr.add(FIELDS.heightM).readFloat();
    p.weightKg = ptr.add(FIELDS.weightKg).readFloat();
    p.cpMultiplier = ptr.add(FIELDS.cpMultiplier).readFloat();
    p.pokeball = ptr.add(FIELDS.pokeball).readS32();
    p.creationTimeMs = readInt64(ptr, FIELDS.creationTimeMs);
    p.isLucky = ptr.add(FIELDS.isLucky).readU8() !== 0;

    // Read nickname (Il2CppString*)
    var nickPtr = ptr.add(FIELDS.nickname).readPointer();
    if (!nickPtr.isNull()) {
        try {
            var len = nickPtr.add(0x10).readS32();
            if (len > 0 && len < 50) {
                p.nickname = nickPtr.add(0x14).readUtf16String(len);
            } else {
                p.nickname = "";
            }
        } catch(e) { p.nickname = ""; }
    } else {
        p.nickname = "";
    }

    // Read deployed fort id
    var fortPtr = ptr.add(FIELDS.deployedFortId).readPointer();
    if (!fortPtr.isNull()) {
        try {
            var flen = fortPtr.add(0x10).readS32();
            if (flen > 0 && flen < 100) {
                p.deployedFortId = fortPtr.add(0x14).readUtf16String(flen);
            } else {
                p.deployedFortId = "";
            }
        } catch(e) { p.deployedFortId = ""; }
    } else {
        p.deployedFortId = "";
    }

    // Calculate level from cpMultiplier
    p.level = cpMultiplierToLevel(p.cpMultiplier);

    return p;
}

function readInt64(base, offset) {
    // Read as two 32-bit parts for JavaScript safety
    var low = base.add(offset).readU32();
    var high = base.add(offset + 4).readU32();
    // Return as string to avoid precision loss
    if (high === 0) return low;
    return "0x" + high.toString(16) + low.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function cpMultiplierToLevel(cpm) {
    // CPM to level lookup (approximate)
    var cpms = [0.094,0.135,0.166,0.192,0.215,0.236,0.255,0.273,0.290,0.306,
                0.321,0.335,0.349,0.362,0.375,0.387,0.399,0.411,0.422,0.432,
                0.443,0.453,0.462,0.472,0.481,0.490,0.499,0.508,0.517,0.525,
                0.534,0.542,0.550,0.558,0.566,0.574,0.582,0.589,0.597,0.604,
                0.612,0.619,0.626,0.633,0.640,0.647,0.654,0.661,0.667,0.674,
                0.681,0.688,0.694,0.700,0.706,0.713,0.719,0.725,0.731,0.737,
                0.743,0.749,0.755,0.761,0.767,0.773,0.779,0.784,0.790,0.796,
                0.801,0.807,0.812,0.818,0.823,0.829,0.834,0.840,0.845,0.850,
                0.855,0.860,0.865,0.870,0.875,0.880,0.885,0.890,0.894,0.899];
    var closest = 1;
    var minDiff = 999;
    for (var i = 0; i < cpms.length; i++) {
        var diff = Math.abs(cpm - cpms[i]);
        if (diff < minDiff) {
            minDiff = diff;
            closest = i + 1;  // levels are 1-indexed, half levels are i+0.5
        }
    }
    return closest * 0.5 + 0.5;  // Approximate
}
```

```js
for (var sc = 0; sc < serviceLocatorClasses.length; sc++) {
    var nsP = Memory.allocUtf8String(serviceLocatorClasses[sc].ns);
    var cnP = Memory.allocUtf8String(serviceLocatorClasses[sc].name);
    var cls = il2cpp_class_from_name(gameImage, nsP, cnP);
    if (!cls.isNull()) {
        send({type: "status", msg: "Found: " + serviceLocatorClasses[sc].ns + "." + serviceLocatorClasses[sc].name});
        foundContainer = {cls: cls, ns: serviceLocatorClasses[sc].ns, name: serviceLocatorClasses[sc].name};
    }
}

// Check PokemonBagImpl static fields
var staticData = il2cpp_class_get_static_field_data(pokemonBagClass);
send({type: "status", msg: "PokemonBagImpl static data: " + staticData});

if (staticData && !staticData.isNull()) {
    // The static fields cuhv-cuhz had offset 0 in our scan
    // In IL2CPP, static field data is a separate block. Let's read first few pointers.
    for (var si = 0; si < 8; si++) {
        try {
            var val = staticData.add(si * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
            if (!val.isNull()) {
                try {
                    var objClass = il2cpp_object_get_class(val);
                    if (objClass && !objClass.isNull()) {
                        var cn = il2cpp_class_get_name(objClass).readCString();
                        var cns = il2cpp_class_get_namespace(objClass).readCString();
                        send({type: "status", msg: "  static[" + si + "] = " + val + " -> " + cns + "." + cn});
                    } else {
                        send({type: "status", msg: "  static[" + si + "] = " + val + " (not an object)"});
                    }
                } catch(e) {
                    send({type: "status", msg: "  static[" + si + "] = " + val + " (read error: " + e.message + ")"});
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }
}

// Alternative approach: find the DiContainer / Zenject container
// Zenject stores bindings in dictionaries. Let's check common patterns.
var zenjectNames = [
    {ns: "Zenject", name: "DiContainer"},
    {ns: "Zenject", name: "SceneContext"},
    {ns: "Zenject", name: "ProjectContext"},
    {ns: "VContainer", name: "LifetimeScope"},
    {ns: "VContainer", name: "Container"},
];

for (var zi = 0; zi < zenjectNames.length; zi++) {
    for (var a = 0; a < numAssemblies; a++) {
        var assembly = assemblies.add(a * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
        var image = il2cpp_assembly_get_image(assembly);
        var nsP = Memory.allocUtf8String(zenjectNames[zi].ns);
        var cnP = Memory.allocUtf8String(zenjectNames[zi].name);
        var cls = il2cpp_class_from_name(image, nsP, cnP);
        if (!cls.isNull()) {
            var imgName = il2cpp_image_get_name(image).readCString();
            send({type: "status", msg: "DI: " + zenjectNames[zi].ns + "." + zenjectNames[zi].name + " in " + imgName});
            break;
        }
    }
}

// Let's also look at instance fields of PokemonBagImpl to understand the data structure
// Field "cuhl" at offset 16 - likely the dictionary/list holding pokemon
// Let's look for the allPokemon field directly
var allPokemonField = il2cpp_class_get_field_from_name(pokemonBagClass, Memory.allocUtf8String("cuhl"));
send({type: "status", msg: "cuhl field: offset " + (allPokemonField.isNull() ? "N/A" : il2cpp_field_get_offset(allPokemonField))});

// Actually, the cleanest approach given we can't find the instance:
// Search the GC heap for objects of type PokemonBagImpl
// IL2CPP objects start with a klass pointer. We know pokemonBagClass address.
// We can scan memory ranges for this pointer value.

send({type: "status", msg: "Attempting GC heap scan for PokemonBagImpl instances..."});
send({type: "status", msg: "Looking for klass pointer: " + pokemonBagClass});

// Scan all readable memory regions for objects with vtable pointing to our class
var ranges = Process.enumerateRanges('r--');
var instancesFound = [];

// The klass pointer is at offset 0 of every IL2CPP object
var targetKlass = pokemonBagClass;
var patternBytes = [];
// Convert pointer to byte pattern
var targetAddr = targetKlass;
for (var b = 0; b < Process.pointerSize; b++) {
    patternBytes.push(targetAddr.and(0xFF).toInt32());
    targetAddr = targetAddr.shr(8);
}
var pattern = patternBytes.map(function(b) { return (b < 16 ? '0' : '') + b.toString(16); }).join(' ');
send({type: "status", msg: "Scanning for pattern: " + pattern});

var scanCount = 0;
for (var r = 0; r < ranges.length; r++) {
    var range = ranges[r];
    // Only scan heap-like regions (rw- with reasonable size)
    if (range.protection !== 'rw-') continue;
    if (range.size > 500 * 1024 * 1024) continue; // Skip huge regions
    if (range.size < 4096) continue;

    scanCount++;
    var matches = Memory.scanSync(range.base, range.size, pattern);
    for (var mi = 0; mi < matches.length; mi++) {
        instancesFound.push(matches[mi].address);
    }

    if (instancesFound.length > 0 && scanCount > 100) break; // Found some, stop early
}

send({type: "status", msg: "Memory scan: checked " + scanCount + " regions, found " + instancesFound.length + " potential instances"});

if (instancesFound.length > 0 && instancesFound.length < 20) {
    // Validate each potential instance
    var getAllMethod = il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name(pokemonBagClass, Memory.allocUtf8String("get_AllPokemon"), 0);
    var getCountMethod = il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name(pokemonBagClass, Memory.allocUtf8String("get_Count"), 0);

    for (var ii = 0; ii < instancesFound.length && ii < 5; ii++) {
        var instanceAddr = instancesFound[ii];
        send({type: "status", msg: "Trying instance at " + instanceAddr + "..."});

        try {
            // Try calling get_Count on this instance
            var excPtr = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
            excPtr.writePointer(ptr(0));
            var countResult = il2cpp_runtime_invoke(getCountMethod, instanceAddr, ptr(0), excPtr);
            var exc = excPtr.readPointer();

            if (exc.isNull() && countResult && !countResult.isNull()) {
                // Unbox int32 result: value at object+0x10
                var count = countResult.add(0x10).readS32();
                send({type: "status", msg: "  get_Count() = " + count});

                if (count > 0 && count < 10000) {
                    send({type: "status", msg: "  VALID INSTANCE! Calling get_AllPokemon..."});

                    excPtr.writePointer(ptr(0));
                    var allResult = il2cpp_runtime_invoke(getAllMethod, instanceAddr, ptr(0), excPtr);
                    exc = excPtr.readPointer();

                    if (exc.isNull() && allResult && !allResult.isNull()) {
                        send({type: "status", msg: "  get_AllPokemon returned: " + allResult});
                        extractFromList(allResult, count);
                        break;
                    } else {
                        send({type: "status", msg: "  get_AllPokemon failed (exc=" + exc + ")"});
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (!exc.isNull()) {
                    send({type: "status", msg: "  Exception thrown"});
                } else {
                    send({type: "status", msg: "  Returned null or invalid"});
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {
            send({type: "status", msg: "  Error: " + e.message});
        }
    }
} else if (instancesFound.length >= 20) {
    send({type: "status", msg: "Too many matches - might be false positives. Try different approach."});
}

function extractFromList(listObj, expectedCount) {
    send({type: "status", msg: "Reading list structure..."});

    // System.Collections.Generic.List<T> layout in IL2CPP:
    // +0x00: klass pointer
    // +0x08: monitor
    // +0x10: _items (T[] array)
    // +0x18: _size (int32)
    var itemsArray = listObj.add(0x10).readPointer();
    var size = listObj.add(0x18).readS32();

    send({type: "status", msg: "List _items=" + itemsArray + " _size=" + size});

    if (size <= 0 || size > 10000 || itemsArray.isNull()) {
        // Maybe it's IReadOnlyList/wrapper, try other offsets
        send({type: "status", msg: "Trying alternative list layouts..."});

        // Try: could be a wrapper around a List
        for (var off = 0x10; off <= 0x30; off += 8) {
            try {
                var inner = listObj.add(off).readPointer();
                if (!inner.isNull()) {
                    var innerItems = inner.add(0x10).readPointer();
                    var innerSize = inner.add(0x18).readS32();
                    if (innerSize > 0 && innerSize < 10000 && !innerItems.isNull()) {
                        send({type: "status", msg: "Found inner list at offset " + off + " with " + innerSize + " items"});
                        itemsArray = innerItems;
                        size = innerSize;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        }
    }

    if (size <= 0 || itemsArray.isNull()) {
        send({type: "error", msg: "Could not find valid items array"});
        return;
    }

    send({type: "status", msg: "Extracting " + size + " pokemon from array..."});

    // IL2CPP array: [klass(8)][monitor(8)][bounds(8)][max_length(8)][elements...]
    // Elements start at offset 0x20 on 64-bit
    var elemStart = itemsArray.add(0x20);
    var pokemon = [];
    var errors = 0;

    for (var i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        var objPtr = elemStart.add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
        if (objPtr.isNull()) continue;

        try {
            var p = {};
            p.id = readInt64(objPtr, FIELDS.id);
            p.pokemonId = objPtr.add(FIELDS.pokemonId).readS32();
            p.cp = objPtr.add(FIELDS.cp).readS32();
            p.stamina = objPtr.add(FIELDS.stamina).readS32();
            p.move1 = objPtr.add(FIELDS.move1).readS32();
            p.move2 = objPtr.add(FIELDS.move2).readS32();
            p.move3 = objPtr.add(FIELDS.move3).readS32();
            p.ivAtk = objPtr.add(FIELDS.ivAtk).readS32();
            p.ivDef = objPtr.add(FIELDS.ivDef).readS32();
            p.ivSta = objPtr.add(FIELDS.ivSta).readS32();
            p.heightM = objPtr.add(FIELDS.heightM).readFloat();
            p.weightKg = objPtr.add(FIELDS.weightKg).readFloat();
            p.cpMultiplier = objPtr.add(FIELDS.cpMultiplier).readFloat();
            p.pokeball = objPtr.add(FIELDS.pokeball).readS32();
            p.creationTimeMs = readInt64(objPtr, FIELDS.creationTimeMs);
            p.isLucky = objPtr.add(FIELDS.isLucky).readU8() !== 0;

            // Nickname
            var nickPtr = objPtr.add(FIELDS.nickname).readPointer();
            if (!nickPtr.isNull()) {
                try {
                    var len = nickPtr.add(0x10).readS32();
                    if (len > 0 && len < 50) {
                        p.nickname = nickPtr.add(0x14).readUtf16String(len);
                    } else { p.nickname = ""; }
                } catch(e) { p.nickname = ""; }
            } else { p.nickname = ""; }

            // Deployed fort
            var fortPtr = objPtr.add(FIELDS.deployedFortId).readPointer();
            if (!fortPtr.isNull()) {
                try {
                    var flen = fortPtr.add(0x10).readS32();
                    if (flen > 0 && flen < 100) {
                        p.deployedFortId = fortPtr.add(0x14).readUtf16String(flen);
                    } else { p.deployedFortId = ""; }
                } catch(e) { p.deployedFortId = ""; }
            } else { p.deployedFortId = ""; }

            pokemon.push(p);

            if (pokemon.length % 500 === 0) {
                send({type: "progress", count: pokemon.length, total: size});
            }
        } catch(e) {
            errors++;
            if (errors <= 3) {
                send({type: "status", msg: "Error reading pokemon #" + i + ": " + e.message});
            }
        }
    }

    send({type: "status", msg: "Extraction complete: " + pokemon.length + " pokemon, " + errors + " errors"});

    // Send in batches to avoid message size limits
    var batchSize = 200;
    for (var b = 0; b < pokemon.length; b += batchSize) {
        var batch = pokemon.slice(b, b + batchSize);
        send({type: "pokemon_batch", batch: b / batchSize, data: batch});
    }

    send({type: "pokemon_data", count: pokemon.length, data: pokemon});
    send({type: "done", msg: "Extracted " + pokemon.length + " pokemon successfully!"});
}

function readInt64(base, offset) {
    var low = base.add(offset).readU32();
    var high = base.add(offset + 4).readU32();
    if (high === 0) return low;
    return (high * 4294967296) + low;
}
```

`pogo_extract/il2cpp_extract_v3.js`:

```js
/*
 * Pokemon extraction v3: Find PokemonProto instances directly via targeted heap scan.
 * Avoids whole-process memory scan that crashed v2.
 *
 * Strategy:
 * - Only scan memory regions with [anon:libc_malloc] or empty filename (Mono heap)
 * - Skip regions > 64MB (avoid backing maps, file regions)
 * - Process scan results in chunks to avoid OOM
 */

// Wait for libil2cpp.so to be loaded
var il2cpp = null;
for (var retries = 0; retries < 30; retries++) {
    try {
        il2cpp = Process.getModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");
        if (il2cpp) break;
    } catch(e) {
        // Module not loaded yet, wait
    }
    Thread.sleep(1);
}
if (!il2cpp) {
    send({type: "error", msg: "libil2cpp.so not loaded after 30s"});
    send({type: "done", msg: "FAILED"});
    throw new Error("libil2cpp not loaded");
}
send({type: "status", msg: "libil2cpp.so loaded at " + il2cpp.base});

var exports_map = {};
var il2cpp_exports = il2cpp.enumerateExports();
for (var i = 0; i < il2cpp_exports.length; i++) {
    if (il2cpp_exports[i].name.indexOf("il2cpp_") === 0)
        exports_map[il2cpp_exports[i].name] = il2cpp_exports[i].address;
}

function bind(name, ret, args) {
    if (!exports_map[name]) return null;
    return new NativeFunction(exports_map[name], ret, args);
}

var il2cpp_domain_get = bind("il2cpp_domain_get", 'pointer', []);
var il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies = bind("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies", 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']);
var il2cpp_assembly_get_image = bind("il2cpp_assembly_get_image", 'pointer', ['pointer']);
var il2cpp_image_get_name = bind("il2cpp_image_get_name", 'pointer', ['pointer']);
var il2cpp_class_from_name = bind("il2cpp_class_from_name", 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer', 'pointer']);
var il2cpp_thread_attach = bind("il2cpp_thread_attach", 'pointer', ['pointer']);

var domain = il2cpp_domain_get();
il2cpp_thread_attach(domain);

var sizePtr = Memory.alloc(4);
var assemblies = il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies(domain, sizePtr);
var numAssemblies = sizePtr.readS32();

var protoImage = null;
for (var a = 0; a < numAssemblies; a++) {
    var assembly = assemblies.add(a * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
    var image = il2cpp_assembly_get_image(assembly);
    var imgName = il2cpp_image_get_name(image).readCString();
    if (imgName === "holo-protos.dll") protoImage = image;
}

var pokemonProtoClass = il2cpp_class_from_name(protoImage,
    Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc"),
    Memory.allocUtf8String("PokemonProto"));

send({type: "status", msg: "PokemonProto class: " + pokemonProtoClass});

// Field offsets (confirmed earlier)
var FIELDS = {
    id: 32, pokemonId: 40, cp: 44, stamina: 48,
    move1: 56, move2: 60, move3: 276,
    ivAtk: 112, ivDef: 116, ivSta: 120,
    heightM: 104, weightKg: 108, cpMultiplier: 124,
    nickname: 184, pokeball: 128,
    creationTimeMs: 160, isLucky: 272, deployedFortId: 64
};

// Build the byte pattern for the klass pointer (little-endian)
var ptrVal = pokemonProtoClass;
var patternBytes = [];
var tmp = ptrVal;
for (var b = 0; b < 8; b++) {
    var byte = tmp.and(0xFF).toInt32();
    patternBytes.push((byte < 16 ? '0' : '') + byte.toString(16));
    tmp = tmp.shr(8);
}
var pattern = patternBytes.join(' ');
send({type: "status", msg: "Pattern: " + pattern});

// Get only HEAP regions - filter by name
var allRanges = Process.enumerateRanges('rw-');
send({type: "status", msg: "Total rw- regions: " + allRanges.length});

// Get range details with file backing info
var ranges = [];
var modulesByName = {};
Process.enumerateModules().forEach(function(m) {
    modulesByName[m.path] = m;
});

// Filter: only anonymous (no file backing) regions of reasonable size
var heapRanges = [];
allRanges.forEach(function(r) {
    if (r.size > 64 * 1024 * 1024) return; // Skip > 64MB
    if (r.size < 4096) return; // Skip < 4KB
    if (r.file) return; // Skip file-backed
    heapRanges.push(r);
});

send({type: "status", msg: "Filtered heap regions: " + heapRanges.length});

// Sample a few to verify
for (var i = 0; i < Math.min(5, heapRanges.length); i++) {
    send({type: "status", msg: "  range[" + i + "]: " + heapRanges[i].base + " size=" + heapRanges[i].size});
}

// Scan in batches with try/catch for safety
var allMatches = [];
var scanned = 0;
var failed = 0;

for (var ri = 0; ri < heapRanges.length; ri++) {
    var r = heapRanges[ri];
    try {
        var matches = Memory.scanSync(r.base, r.size, pattern);
        for (var m = 0; m < matches.length; m++) {
            allMatches.push(matches[m].address);
        }
        scanned++;
    } catch(e) {
        failed++;
    }

    if (ri % 50 === 0 && ri > 0) {
        send({type: "status", msg: "  scanned " + ri + "/" + heapRanges.length + " regions, " + allMatches.length + " matches so far"});
    }

    // Stop early if we have enough matches
    if (allMatches.length > 5000) {
        send({type: "status", msg: "  Found enough matches (" + allMatches.length + "), stopping scan"});
        break;
    }
}

send({type: "status", msg: "Scan complete: " + allMatches.length + " matches in " + scanned + " regions (" + failed + " failed)"});

// Validate matches by reading PokemonProto fields and checking sanity
var pokemon = [];
var seen = {};
var errors = 0;

for (var i = 0; i < allMatches.length; i++) {
    var addr = allMatches[i];

    try {
        // Quick sanity check: pokemonId should be 1-1100, cp should be 10-9999
        var pokemonId = addr.add(FIELDS.pokemonId).readS32();
        var cp = addr.add(FIELDS.cp).readS32();
        var ivAtk = addr.add(FIELDS.ivAtk).readS32();
        var ivDef = addr.add(FIELDS.ivDef).readS32();
        var ivSta = addr.add(FIELDS.ivSta).readS32();

        // Validate: realistic pokemon
        if (pokemonId < 1 || pokemonId > 1100) continue;
        if (cp < 10 || cp > 9999) continue;
        if (ivAtk < 0 || ivAtk > 15) continue;
        if (ivDef < 0 || ivDef > 15) continue;
        if (ivSta < 0 || ivSta > 15) continue;

        var p = {addr: addr.toString()};
        p.id = readInt64(addr, FIELDS.id);
        p.pokemonId = pokemonId;
        p.cp = cp;
        p.stamina = addr.add(FIELDS.stamina).readS32();
        p.move1 = addr.add(FIELDS.move1).readS32();
        p.move2 = addr.add(FIELDS.move2).readS32();
        p.move3 = addr.add(FIELDS.move3).readS32();
        p.ivAtk = ivAtk;
        p.ivDef = ivDef;
        p.ivSta = ivSta;
        p.heightM = addr.add(FIELDS.heightM).readFloat();
        p.weightKg = addr.add(FIELDS.weightKg).readFloat();
        p.cpMultiplier = addr.add(FIELDS.cpMultiplier).readFloat();
        p.pokeball = addr.add(FIELDS.pokeball).readS32();
        p.creationTimeMs = readInt64(addr, FIELDS.creationTimeMs);
        p.isLucky = addr.add(FIELDS.isLucky).readU8() !== 0;

        // Filter validation: cpMultiplier should be 0.094 to 0.9
        if (p.cpMultiplier < 0.05 || p.cpMultiplier > 0.95) continue;
        // height/weight should be reasonable
        if (p.heightM <= 0 || p.heightM > 30) continue;
        if (p.weightKg <= 0 || p.weightKg > 1000) continue;

        // Dedupe by ID
        var idKey = String(p.id);
        if (seen[idKey]) continue;
        seen[idKey] = true;

        // Read nickname
        try {
            var nickPtr = addr.add(FIELDS.nickname).readPointer();
            if (!nickPtr.isNull()) {
                var len = nickPtr.add(0x10).readS32();
                if (len > 0 && len < 50) {
                    p.nickname = nickPtr.add(0x14).readUtf16String(len);
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {}

        pokemon.push(p);
    } catch(e) {
        errors++;
    }
}

send({type: "status", msg: "Validated: " + pokemon.length + " unique pokemon, " + errors + " errors"});

// Send in batches to avoid message size limits
var batchSize = 100;
for (var b = 0; b < pokemon.length; b += batchSize) {
    var batch = pokemon.slice(b, b + batchSize);
    send({type: "pokemon_batch", offset: b, total: pokemon.length, data: batch});
}

send({type: "pokemon_data", count: pokemon.length, data: pokemon});
send({type: "done", msg: "Extracted " + pokemon.length + " pokemon!"});

function readInt64(base, offset) {
    var low = base.add(offset).readU32();
    var high = base.add(offset + 4).readU32();
    if (high === 0) return low;
    return (high * 4294967296) + low;
}
```

```js
                "Niantic.Holoholo.Inventory", ""];

        for (var ni = 0; ni < searchNs.length && !found; ni++) {
            var nsP = Memory.allocUtf8String(searchNs[ni]);
            var cnP = Memory.allocUtf8String(searchNames[si]);

            if (!cls.isNull()) {
                var imgName = il2cpp_image_get_name(image).readCString();
                found = {cls: cls, name: searchNames[si], ns: searchNs[ni], image: imgName, imagePtr: image};
                send({type: "status", msg: "FOUND: " + searchNs[ni] + "." + searchNames[si] + " in " + imgName});
            }
        }
    }
}

if (!found) {
    // Brute force: scan all classes in all assemblies
    send({type: "status", msg: "Not found via class_from_name, brute-force scanning..."});
    for (var a = 0; a < numAssemblies; a++) {
        var assembly = assemblies.add(a * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
        var image = il2cpp_assembly_get_image(assembly);
        var classCount = il2cpp_image_get_class_count(image);

        for (var c = 0; c < classCount; c++) {
            var cls = il2cpp_image_get_class(image, c);
            if (cls.isNull()) continue;
            var cname = il2cpp_class_get_name(cls).readCString();
            if (cname && cname.indexOf("PokemonBag") >= 0) {
                var cns = il2cpp_class_get_namespace(cls).readCString();
                var imgName = il2cpp_image_get_name(image).readCString();
                send({type: "status", msg: "BruteForce found: " + cns + "." + cname + " in " + imgName});
                if (cname === "PokemonBagImpl") {
                    found = {cls: cls, name: cname, ns: cns, image: imgName, imagePtr: image};
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

if (found) {
    send({type: "status", msg: "Examining " + found.ns + "." + found.name + "..."});

    // Enumerate all fields
    var iterPtr = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    iterPtr.writePointer(ptr(0));
    var allFields = [];
    while (true) {
        var field = il2cpp_class_get_fields(found.cls, iterPtr);
        if (field.isNull()) break;
        var fname = il2cpp_field_get_name(field).readCString();
        var foffset = il2cpp_field_get_offset(field);
        allFields.push({name: fname, offset: foffset});
    }
    send({type: "bag_fields", data: allFields});

    // Look for methods
    var methodNames = ["GetAllPokemon", "get_AllPokemon", "get_Pokemons", "GetPokemons",
                       "get_allPokemon", "get_Pokemon", "get_Items", "GetAll",
                       "get_AllPokemonDict", "get_PokemonById", "GetPokemonById",
                       "get_Count", "GetCount", "get_PokemonList", "GetPokemonList"];
    var foundMethods = [];
    for (var m = 0; m < methodNames.length; m++) {
        var mPtr = Memory.allocUtf8String(methodNames[m]);
        for (var p = 0; p <= 2; p++) {
            var meth = il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name(found.cls, mPtr, p);
            if (meth && !meth.isNull()) {
                foundMethods.push({name: methodNames[m], params: p, ptr: meth.toString()});
            }
        }
    }
    send({type: "bag_methods", data: foundMethods});

    // Check parent class too
    var parent = il2cpp_class_get_parent(found.cls);
    if (parent && !parent.isNull()) {
        var parentName = il2cpp_class_get_name(parent).readCString();
        var parentNs = il2cpp_class_get_namespace(parent).readCString();
        send({type: "status", msg: "Parent class: " + parentNs + "." + parentName});
    }

for (var ib = 0; ib < iPokemonBagNames.length; ib++) {
    for (var a = 0; a < numAssemblies; a++) {
        var assembly = assemblies.add(a * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
        var image = il2cpp_assembly_get_image(assembly);
        for (var ni = 0; ni < searchNs.length; ni++) {
            var nsP = Memory.allocUtf8String(searchNs[ni]);
            var cnP = Memory.allocUtf8String(iPokemonBagNames[ib]);
            var cls = il2cpp_class_from_name(image, nsP, cnP);
            if (!cls.isNull()) {
                var imgName = il2cpp_image_get_name(image).readCString();
                send({type: "status", msg: "Interface: " + searchNs[ni] + "." + iPokemonBagNames[ib] + " in " + imgName});

                // Get methods on interface
                var ifMethods = ["GetAllPokemon", "get_AllPokemon", "get_Pokemons", "GetPokemons"];
                for (var m = 0; m < ifMethods.length; m++) {
                    var mPtr = Memory.allocUtf8String(ifMethods[m]);
                    for (var p = 0; p <= 1; p++) {
                        var meth = il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name(cls, mPtr, p);
                        if (meth && !meth.isNull()) {
                            send({type: "status", msg: "  Interface method: " + ifMethods[m] + "(params=" + p + ")"});
                        }
                    }
                }
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

send({type: "done", msg: "Bag search complete"});
```

```js
/*
 * Quick IL2CPP class resolution - no delay.
 * For attaching to already-running PoGO (with Pokemod handling anti-cheat).

// Resolve IL2CPP exports
var il2cpp = Process.getModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");
var exports_map = {};

var il2cpp_exports = il2cpp.enumerateExports();
for (var i = 0; i < il2cpp_exports.length; i++) {
    var e = il2cpp_exports[i];
    if (e.name.indexOf("il2cpp_") === 0) {
        exports_map[e.name] = e.address;
    }
}

send({type: "status", msg: "Resolved " + Object.keys(exports_map).length + " il2cpp exports"});

// Bind critical functions
function bind(name, ret, args) {
    if (!exports_map[name]) { send({type: "error", msg: "Missing: " + name}); return null; }
    return new NativeFunction(exports_map[name], ret, args);
}

var il2cpp_domain_get = bind("il2cpp_domain_get", 'pointer', []);
var il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies = bind("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies", 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']);

    if (!pokemonProtoClass) {

                    var cns = il2cpp_class_get_namespace(cls).readCString();
                    bagMatches.push({ns: cns, name: cname, ptr: cls.toString()});
                }

            send({type: "bag_candidates", data: bagMatches});
        } else {
            // Look for GetAllPokemon or similar methods
            var methodNames = ["GetAllPokemon", "get_AllPokemon", "GetPokemons", "get_Pokemons",
                              "get_allPokemon", "GetAll", "get_All", "get_Pokemon", "get_Items"];
            var foundMethods = [];

                for (var p = 0; p <= 2; p++) {

                    if (meth && !meth.isNull()) {
                        foundMethods.push({name: methodNames[m], params: p, ptr: meth.toString()});
                    }
                }
            }
            send({type: "methods", data: foundMethods});

            // Also check for a static Instance field or similar singleton accessor
            var singletonFields = ["instance_", "_instance", "s_instance", "Instance"];
```
