```py
sess = d.attach(pid)

js = """
var fns={}, gi=null, cls=null;
function initIL2() {
    var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
    var exp = {}; il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) exp[e.name] = e.address; });
    function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(exp[n],r,a); }
    fns.dG=bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
    fns.dGA=bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
    fns.aGI=bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.iGN=bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
    fns.cFN=bind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
    fns.tA=bind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']); fns.tA(fns.dG());
    var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var asms=fns.dGA(fns.dG(),sp); var na=sp.readS32();
    for (var a=0;a<na;a++){ var i=fns.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if (fns.iGN(i).readCString()==='holo-game.dll'){gi=i;break;} }
    cls=fns.cFN(gi, Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Internal'), Memory.allocUtf8String('PokedexImpl'));
}
initIL2();

rpc.exports = {
    scanChunk: function(startHi, sizeBytes) {
        var hits = [];
        var startAddr = ptr(startHi); var endAddr = startAddr.add(sizeBytes);
        Process.enumerateRanges({protection:'rw-'}).forEach(function(r){
            if (hits.length > 50) return;
            var rEnd = r.base.add(r.size);
            if (r.base.compare(endAddr) >= 0 || rEnd.compare(startAddr) <= 0) return;
            var p = r.base.compare(startAddr) > 0 ? r.base : startAddr;
            var e = rEnd.compare(endAddr) < 0 ? rEnd : endAddr;
            while (p.compare(e) < 0 && hits.length < 50) {
                try { if (p.readPointer().equals(cls)) hits.push(p.toString()); } catch(e2) {}
                p = p.add(8);
            }
        });
        return {hits: hits};
    },
    probeCount: function(addr) {
        // Strict probe: validate every pointer is heap-resident before deref
        try {
            var inst = ptr(addr);
            // 0. klass slot at +0 still equals target class
            if (!inst.readPointer().equals(cls)) return {err:'klass mismatch'};
            // 1. dict pointer
            var dict = inst.add(0x10).readPointer();
            if (dict.isNull() || dict.and(7).compare(0) !== 0) return {err:'bad dict'};
            try { dict.readU8(); } catch(e) { return {err:'dict unreadable'}; }
            // 2. dict's klass at +0
            var dictKlass = dict.readPointer();
            if (dictKlass.isNull() || dictKlass.and(7).compare(0) !== 0) return {err:'bad dict klass'};
            try { dictKlass.readU8(); } catch(e) { return {err:'dict klass unreadable'}; }
            // 3. entries array
            var entries = dict.add(0x18).readPointer();
            if (entries.isNull() || entries.and(7).compare(0) !== 0) return {err:'bad entries'};
            try { entries.readU8(); } catch(e) { return {err:'entries unreadable'}; }
            // 4. count plausible
            var count = entries.add(0x18).readS32();
            if (count < 500 || count > 4000) return {err:'count oor', count: count};
            // 5. first proto valid
            var firstProto = entries.add(0x20).add(16).readPointer();
            if (firstProto.isNull() || firstProto.and(7).compare(0) !== 0) return {err:'bad first proto'};
            try { firstProto.readU8(); } catch(e) { return {err:'first proto unreadable'}; }
            return {count: count};
        } catch(e) { return {err: e.toString()}; }
    },
    readHundos: function(addr) {
        function readUtf16Str(strPtr) {
            if (strPtr.isNull()) return '';
            var len = strPtr.add(0x10).readS32();
            if (len <= 0 || len > 200) return '';
            var chars = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) chars.push(String.fromCharCode(strPtr.add(0x14 + i*2).readU16()));
            return chars.join('');
        }
        var inst = ptr(addr);
        var dictAll = inst.add(0x10).readPointer();
        var entries = dictAll.add(0x18).readPointer();
        var maxLen = entries.add(0x18).readS32();
        var data = entries.add(0x20);
        var results = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < maxLen; i++) {
            var ep = data.add(i * 24);
            var hashCode = ep.readS32();
            if (hashCode < 0) continue;
            var pidv = ep.add(8).readS32();
            var protoPtr = ep.add(16).readPointer();
            if (protoPtr.isNull()) continue;
            var hundoAcq = false, shinyHundoAcq = false;
            var mapField = protoPtr.add(0x80).readPointer();
            if (!mapField.isNull()) {
                var list = mapField.add(0x18).readPointer();
                if (!list.isNull()) {
                    var head = list.add(0x10).readPointer();
                    var lcount = list.add(0x18).readS32();
                    var node = head; var iters = 0;
                    while (node && !node.isNull() && iters < lcount + 50) {
                        try {
                            var kvpVal = node.add(0x30).readPointer();
                            if (!kvpVal.isNull()) {
                                var catEnum = kvpVal.add(0x10).readS32();
                                var acq = kvpVal.add(0x15).readU8();
                                if (catEnum === 14 && acq) hundoAcq = true;
                                if (catEnum === 102 && acq) shinyHundoAcq = true;
                            }
                            var next = node.add(0x18).readPointer();
                            if (next.isNull() || next.equals(head)) break;
                            node = next;
                        } catch(e) { break; }
                        iters++;
                    }
                }
            }
            results.push({pid: pidv, hundo: hundoAcq, shinyHundo: shinyHundoAcq});
        }
        return {count: results.length, entries: results};
    }
};
"""
sc = sess.create_script(js); sc.load()

# Stage 1: heap scan for PokedexImpl candidates
print("Heap-scanning for PokedexImpl...")
all_hits = []
base = 0x7000000000
chunk = 0x10000000
for offset in range(0, 0x1000000000, chunk):
    try:
        r = sc.exports_sync.scan_chunk(base + offset, chunk)
        if r['hits']:
            all_hits.extend(r['hits'])
            if len(all_hits) > 30: break
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  scan fail at 0x{base+offset:x}: {e}")
        break
print(f"Found {len(all_hits)} candidates")

# Stage 2: probe each candidate for cugr dict count
print("\nProbing candidates (all results)...")
best = None; best_count = 0
result_buckets = {'err': 0, 'zero': 0, 'small': 0, 'good': 0, 'big': 0}
all_probes = []
for cand in all_hits:
    try:
        r = sc.exports_sync.probe_count(cand)
        if 'err' in r:
            result_buckets['err'] += 1
            continue
        cnt = r.get('count', 0)
        all_probes.append((cand, cnt))
        if cnt == 0: result_buckets['zero'] += 1
        elif cnt < 500: result_buckets['small'] += 1
        elif cnt < 4000: result_buckets['good'] += 1
        else: result_buckets['big'] += 1
        if 500 <= cnt < 4000 and cnt > best_count:
            best = cand; best_count = cnt
    except Exception as e:
        pass
print(f"  buckets: {result_buckets}")
print(f"  top 10 by count:")
for cand, cnt in sorted(all_probes, key=lambda x: -x[1])[:10]:
    print(f"    {cand}: count={cnt}")
print(f"\nChosen PokedexImpl: {best} (count={best_count})")
if not best:
    print("FAILED"); sess.detach(); exit(1)

# Stage 3: read hundo state
print("\nReading hundo state...")
r = sc.exports_sync.read_hundos(best)
print(f"Walked {r['count']} entries")
by_pid = {e['pid']: e for e in r['entries']}

# Save snapshot -- QUARANTINED filename (audit F11): this legacy heap-scan reader emits a SLIM schema
# ({pid,hundo,shinyHundo} -- no times/forms/purified). Writing the CANONICAL pokedex_hundos_live.json
# with it silently corrupts every downstream consumer (account_report reads 0 caught; evo_hundo_gap
# disagrees). Use read_pokedex_liveness.py / the pipeline for the canonical file.
with open('pokedex_hundos_live.heapscan.json','w') as f:
    json.dump({'pid_when_scanned': pid, 'addr': best, 'count': r['count'], 'entries': r['entries']}, f)
print("Saved pokedex_hundos_live.heapscan.json (slim schema -- NOT the canonical file; "
      "run read_pokedex_liveness.py or the pipeline for pokedex_hundos_live.json)")

# Stage 4: check the 18 candidates
targets = {
    452:'Drapion', 18:'Pidgeot', 331:'Cacnea', 486:'Regigigas', 131:'Lapras',
    460:'Abomasnow', 497:'Serperior', 334:'Altaria', 143:'Snorlax', 365:'Walrein',
    82:'Magneton', 277:'Swellow', 38:'Ninetales', 8:'Wartortle', 380:'Latias',
    344:'Claydol', 566:'Archen', 524:'Roggenrola'
}
print(f"\n{'Species':<15} {'pid':>4} {'dex_hundo':>10} {'shiny_hundo':>12} {'new?':>6}")
print('-'*60)
new_count = 0
for pid_t, name in sorted(targets.items()):
    e = by_pid.get(pid_t, {})
    h = e.get('hundo', False); sh = e.get('shinyHundo', False)
    is_new = not h
    if is_new: new_count += 1
    print(f"{name:<15} {pid_t:>4} {('YES' if h else 'no'):>10} {('YES' if sh else 'no'):>12} {('NEW!' if is_new else ''):>6}")
print(f"\nCandidates that would be NEW dex hundo: {new_count}")
sess.detach()
```

`pogo_extract/read_pokedex_liveness.py`:

```py
"""Use IL2CPP liveness API for fast PokedexImpl lookup (zero false positives).
Per agent recommendation: il2cpp_unity_liveness_calculation_from_statics walks live objects of a class."""
import frida, json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.stdout.reconfigure(line_buffering=True)
subprocess.run(['adb','connect','100.98.158.56:5555'], capture_output=True)
subprocess.run(['adb','-s','100.98.158.56:5555','forward','tcp:27047','tcp:27047'], capture_output=True)
pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','-s','100.98.158.56:5555','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
print(f"PID: {pid}")
mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
d = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
sess = d.attach(pid)

js = r"""
var IL2 = null, CLS = null;
function init() {
    var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
    var exp = {}; il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) exp[e.name] = e.address; });
    function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(exp[n],r,a); }
    IL2 = {
        dG: bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]),
        dGA: bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),
        aGI: bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']),
        iGN: bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
        cFN: bind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']),
        tA: bind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']),
        // Liveness API:
        livenessAlloc: exp['il2cpp_unity_liveness_allocate_struct'] ? bind('il2cpp_unity_liveness_allocate_struct','pointer',['pointer','int','pointer','pointer','pointer']) : null,
        livenessFromStatics: exp['il2cpp_unity_liveness_calculation_from_statics'] ? bind('il2cpp_unity_liveness_calculation_from_statics','void',['pointer']) : null,
        livenessFinalize: exp['il2cpp_unity_liveness_finalize'] ? bind('il2cpp_unity_liveness_finalize','void',['pointer']) : null,
        livenessFreeStruct: exp['il2cpp_unity_liveness_free_struct'] ? bind('il2cpp_unity_liveness_free_struct','void',['pointer']) : null,
        stopWorld: exp['il2cpp_stop_gc_world'] ? bind('il2cpp_stop_gc_world','void',[]) : null,
        startWorld: exp['il2cpp_start_gc_world'] ? bind('il2cpp_start_gc_world','void',[]) : null,
        alloc: bind('il2cpp_alloc','pointer',['size_t']),
        free: bind('il2cpp_free','void',['pointer']),
    };
    IL2.tA(IL2.dG());
    var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = IL2.dGA(IL2.dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();
    var gi = null;
    for (var a=0;a<na;a++){ var i=IL2.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if (IL2.iGN(i).readCString()==='holo-game.dll'){gi=i;break;} }
    CLS = IL2.cFN(gi, Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Internal'), Memory.allocUtf8String('PokedexImpl'));
    return {ok:true, hasLiveness: !!(IL2.livenessAlloc && IL2.livenessFromStatics)};
}

rpc.exports = {
    init: init,
    findPokedexInstances: function() {
        if (!CLS) init();
        if (!IL2.livenessAlloc) return {err: 'liveness API not exported in this libil2cpp.so'};
        var hits = [];
        var onObjects = new NativeCallback(function(objects, count, userData) {
            for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                hits.push(objects.add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer().toString());
            }
        }, 'void', ['pointer','int','pointer']);
        var realloc = new NativeCallback(function(handle, size, userData) {
            if (!handle.isNull() && size.compare(0) === 0) { IL2.free(handle); return ptr(0); }
            return IL2.alloc(size);
        }, 'pointer', ['pointer','size_t','pointer']);
        try {
            if (IL2.stopWorld) IL2.stopWorld();
            var state = IL2.livenessAlloc(CLS, 0, onObjects, ptr(0), realloc);
            IL2.livenessFromStatics(state);
            if (IL2.livenessFinalize) IL2.livenessFinalize(state);
            if (IL2.startWorld) IL2.startWorld();
            if (IL2.livenessFreeStruct) IL2.livenessFreeStruct(state);
        } catch(e) {
            if (IL2.startWorld) { try { IL2.startWorld(); } catch(e2){} }
            return {err: 'liveness threw: ' + e.toString()};
        }
        return {hits: hits};
    },
    readHundos: function(addr) {
        function readUtf16Str(strPtr) { if (strPtr.isNull()) return ''; var len = strPtr.add(0x10).readS32(); if (len <= 0 || len > 200) return ''; var chars = []; for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) chars.push(String.fromCharCode(strPtr.add(0x14 + i*2).readU16())); return chars.join(''); }
        var inst = ptr(addr);
        var dictAll = inst.add(0x10).readPointer();
        var entries = dictAll.add(0x18).readPointer();
        var maxLen = entries.add(0x18).readS32();
        var data = entries.add(0x20);
        var results = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < maxLen; i++) {
            var ep = data.add(i * 24);
            var hashCode = ep.readS32();
            if (hashCode < 0) continue;
            var pidv = ep.add(8).readS32();
            var protoPtr = ep.add(16).readPointer();
            if (protoPtr.isNull()) continue;
            // FULL schema, matching pogo_pipeline.pipelineReadDex -- this file is shared state;
            // a slim {pid,hundo} overwrite silently emptied account_report's caught set (2026-06-09).
            var timesCaptured = protoPtr.add(0x18).readS32();
            var capturedForms = [];
            try {
                var cf = protoPtr.add(0x50).readPointer();
                if (!cf.isNull()) {
                    var cfn = cf.add(0x18).readS32();
                    // CLAMP not cutoff -- Pikachu is at 46 forms; <60 dropped the whole list (audit F20)
                    if (cfn > 0 && cfn < 1000) {
                        var cfx = Math.min(cfn, 256);
                        var cfi = cf.add(0x10).readPointer();
                        for (var ci = 0; ci < cfx; ci++) capturedForms.push(cfi.add(0x20 + ci*4).readS32());
                    }
                }
            } catch(e) {}
            var hundoAcq = false, shinyHundoAcq = false, purifiedAcq = false;
            var mapField = protoPtr.add(0x80).readPointer();
            if (!mapField.isNull()) {
                var list = mapField.add(0x18).readPointer();
                if (!list.isNull()) {
                    var head = list.add(0x10).readPointer();
                    var lcount = list.add(0x18).readS32();
                    var node = head; var iters = 0;
                    while (node && !node.isNull() && iters < lcount + 50) {
                        try {
                            var kvpVal = node.add(0x30).readPointer();
                            if (!kvpVal.isNull()) {
                                var catEnum = kvpVal.add(0x10).readS32();
                                var acq = kvpVal.add(0x15).readU8();
                                if (catEnum === 14 && acq) hundoAcq = true;
                                if (catEnum === 102 && acq) shinyHundoAcq = true;
                                if (catEnum === 16 && acq) purifiedAcq = true;
                            }
                            var next = node.add(0x18).readPointer();
                            if (next.isNull() || next.equals(head)) break;
                            node = next;
                        } catch(e) { break; }
                        iters++;
                    }
                }
            }
            results.push({pid: pidv, times: timesCaptured, forms: capturedForms, hundo: hundoAcq, shinyHundo: shinyHundoAcq, purified: purifiedAcq});
        }
        return {count: results.length, entries: results};
    }
};
"""
sc = sess.create_script(js); sc.load()
init_r = sc.exports_sync.init()
print(f"Init: {init_r}")
if not init_r.get('hasLiveness'):
    print("Liveness API not available - libil2cpp.so doesn't export the needed symbols")
    sess.detach(); exit(1)

print("Calling liveness API for PokedexImpl instances...")
r = sc.exports_sync.find_pokedex_instances()
print(f"Result: {r}")
if r.get('err'):
    sess.detach(); exit(1)
hits = r['hits']
print(f"Found {len(hits)} live PokedexImpl instance(s)")
if not hits:
    print("No live instances - dex not yet initialized?")
    sess.detach(); exit(1)

# Read hundos from the first (only) instance
inst = hits[0]
print(f"Reading from {inst}...")
hr = sc.exports_sync.read_hundos(inst)
print(f"Walked {hr['count']} entries")

by_pid = {e['pid']: e for e in hr['entries']}
targets = {
    452:'Drapion', 18:'Pidgeot', 331:'Cacnea', 486:'Regigigas', 131:'Lapras',
    460:'Abomasnow', 497:'Serperior', 334:'Altaria', 143:'Snorlax', 365:'Walrein',
    82:'Magneton', 277:'Swellow', 38:'Ninetales', 8:'Wartortle', 380:'Latias',
    344:'Claydol', 566:'Archen', 524:'Roggenrola'
}
print(f"\n{'Species':<15} {'pid':>4} {'live_dex_hundo':>14} {'new_to_dex?':>12}")

    h = e.get('hundo', False)
    is_new = not h
    if is_new: new_count += 1
    print(f"{name:<15} {pid_t:>4} {('YES' if h else 'no'):>14} {('NEW!' if is_new else ''):>12}")

# Write with the SAME contract as pogo_pipeline.step_read_dex: stash .prev, full entries,
# and regenerate the caught-state derivatives so downstream tools never see schema drift.
import os, shutil

    shutil.copyfile('pokedex_hundos_live.json', 'pokedex_hundos_live.prev.json')

    json.dump(caught_forms, f)
```

```py
"""V2: Walk all 10 PokedexImpl dicts; per-regional-dex hundo status.

Each cug{r,s,t,u,v,w,x,y,z} + cuha = a regional dex dict per PoGo's grouping.
"""
import frida, json, time, subprocess
adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','-s','100.98.158.56:5555','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())

var inst = null;
function init() {
    var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
    var addrs = {};
    il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) addrs[e.name] = e.address; });
    function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(addrs[n],r,a); }
    var dG = bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
    var dGA = bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
    var aGI = bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
    var iGN = bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
    var cFN = bind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
    var cGM = bind('il2cpp_class_get_methods','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
    var tA = bind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']);
    tA(dG());
    var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = dGA(dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();
    var gi = null;
    for (var a=0;a<na;a++){ var i=aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if (iGN(i).readCString()==='holo-game.dll'){ gi=i; break; } }

    var iter = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
    var m;
    while ((m = cGM(cls, iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
        try {
            var addr = m.readPointer();
            if (addr.isNull()) continue;
            Interceptor.attach(addr, {
                onEnter: function(args) {
                    if (!inst) { inst = args[0].toString(); send({type:'h', msg:'inst '+inst}); }
                }
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }
}
rpc.exports = { setup: function() { init(); return {ok:true}; }, get: function() { return {inst: inst}; } };
"""
hs = sess.create_script(hook_js)
def on(m, data):
    p = m.get('payload', {})
    if isinstance(p, dict) and 'msg' in p: print(f"  {p['msg']}")

js = """
rpc.exports = {
    walkAllRegional: function(addr) {
        var inst = ptr(addr);
        function readUtf16Str(strPtr) {
            if (strPtr.isNull()) return '';
            var len = strPtr.add(0x10).readS32();
            if (len <= 0 || len > 200) return '';
            var chars = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) chars.push(String.fromCharCode(strPtr.add(0x14 + i*2).readU16()));
            return chars.join('');
        }

        function readEntry(protoPtr) {
            if (protoPtr.isNull()) return null;
            var entryNum = protoPtr.add(0x10).readS32();
            var timesCaptured = protoPtr.add(0x18).readS32();
            var timesEncountered = protoPtr.add(0x14).readS32();
            var capturedShiny = protoPtr.add(0x40).readU8();
            // Walk CategoryStatus MapField at +0x80
            var hundoAcq = false;
            var shinyHundoAcq = false;
            var threeStarAcq = false;
            var hundoTimestamp = '0';
            var mapField = protoPtr.add(0x80).readPointer();
            if (!mapField.isNull()) {
                var list = mapField.add(0x18).readPointer();
                if (!list.isNull()) {
                    var head = list.add(0x10).readPointer();
                    var lcount = list.add(0x18).readS32();
                    var node = head; var iters = 0;
                    while (node && !node.isNull() && iters < lcount + 50) {
                        try {
                            var kvpVal = node.add(0x30).readPointer();
                            if (!kvpVal.isNull()) {
                                var catEnum = kvpVal.add(0x10).readS32();
                                var acq = kvpVal.add(0x15).readU8();
                                var ts = kvpVal.add(0x18).readU64().toString();
                                if (catEnum === 14 && acq) { hundoAcq = true; hundoTimestamp = ts; }
                                if (catEnum === 102 && acq) shinyHundoAcq = true;
                                if (catEnum === 13 && acq) threeStarAcq = true;
                            }
                            var next = node.add(0x18).readPointer();
                            if (next.isNull() || next.equals(head)) break;
                            node = next;
                        } catch(e) { break; }
                        iters++;
                    }
                }
            }
            return {pid: entryNum, captured: timesCaptured, encountered: timesEncountered,
                    shiny: capturedShiny, hundo: hundoAcq, hundoTs: hundoTimestamp,
                    shinyHundo: shinyHundoAcq, threeStar: threeStarAcq};
        }

        var labels = ['cugr','cugs','cugt','cugu','cugv','cugw','cugx','cugy','cugz','cuha'];
        var offsets = [0x10,0x18,0x20,0x28,0x30,0x38,0x40,0x48,0x50,0x58];
        var out = {};
        for (var di = 0; di < labels.length; di++) {
            var dictPtr = inst.add(offsets[di]).readPointer();
            if (dictPtr.isNull()) { out[labels[di]] = []; continue; }
            var entries = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
            var maxLen = entries.add(0x18).readS32();
            var data = entries.add(0x20);
            var arr = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < maxLen; i++) {
                var ep = data.add(i * 24);
                var hashCode = ep.readS32();
                if (hashCode < 0) continue;
                var key = ep.add(8).readS32();
                var protoPtr = ep.add(16).readPointer();
                if (protoPtr.isNull()) continue;
                var e = readEntry(protoPtr);
                if (e) { e.dictKey = key; arr.push(e); }
            }
            out[labels[di]] = arr;
        }
        return out;
    }
};
"""
script = sess.create_script(js)
script.load()
r = script.exports_sync.walk_all_regional(inst)
print(f"\nWalked dicts:")
for k, v in r.items():
    print(f"  {k}: {len(v)} entries")

with open('pokedex_regional.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(r, f, indent=2)
print(f"\nSaved pokedex_regional.json")
sess.detach()
```

`pogo_extract/read_real_nicks.py`:

```py
"""Read the REAL nickname via Holoholo.Rpc.PokemonProto::get_Nickname (resolved from
holo-protos.dll), vs offset 184 (what the crawl/extractor reads). Self-contained il2cpp
binding so it doesn't depend on the helper's game-image-only cFN.
Usage: python read_real_nicks.py [uid_hex ...]   (defaults to first 18 of fill_names.json)
"""
import sys, os, json, sqlite3, time
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'system', 'scripts'))
import pogo_il2cpp as pg

RAW_JS = r"""
var il2 = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
var exp = {}; il2.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if(e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) exp[e.name]=e.address; });
function bind(n,r,a){ return exp[n] ? new NativeFunction(exp[n], r, a) : null; }
var dG=bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]), dGA=bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
var aGI=bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']), iGN=bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
var cFN=bind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
var cGM=bind('il2cpp_class_get_methods','pointer',['pointer','pointer']), mGN=bind('il2cpp_method_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
var mGPC=bind('il2cpp_method_get_param_count','int',['pointer']);
var rInv=bind('il2cpp_runtime_invoke','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer','pointer']), tA=bind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']);
var dom=dG(); tA(dom);
var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var asms=dGA(dom,sp); var na=sp.readS32();
var protoImg=null;
for(var i=0;i<na;i++){ var img=aGI(asms.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if(iGN(img).readCString()==='holo-protos.dll'){protoImg=img;break;} }
var pmCls = protoImg ? cFN(protoImg, Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'), Memory.allocUtf8String('PokemonProto')) : ptr(0);
var getNick=null;
if(pmCls && !pmCls.isNull()){ var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var m;
  while((m=cGM(pmCls,it))&&!m.isNull()){ if(mGN(m).readCString()==='get_Nickname' && mGPC(m)===0){ getNick=m; break; } } }
function _readStr(s){ if(!s||s.isNull())return ''; try{var len=s.add(0x10).readS32(); if(len<0||len>200)return '<bad'+len+'>'; return s.add(0x14).readUtf16String(len);}catch(e){return '<err>';} }
function readReal(protoStr){ if(!getNick)return '<no get_Nickname method>';
  var exc=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
  var s=rInv(getNick, ptr(protoStr), ptr(0), exc);
  if(!exc.readPointer().isNull())return '<exc>';
  return _readStr(s); }
function read184(protoStr){ try{ var np=ptr(protoStr).add(184).readPointer(); return _readStr(np);}catch(e){return '<err>';} }
rpc.exports.diag=function(){ return {protoImg: protoImg?protoImg.toString():null, pmCls: pmCls?pmCls.toString():null, getNick: getNick?getNick.toString():null}; };
rpc.exports.readReal=readReal;
rpc.exports.read184=read184;
"""

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
c = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(HERE, 'pokemon.db')); c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
nm = {r['uid_hex']: r['species_name'] for r in c.execute('SELECT uid_hex,species_name FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1')}

script.load()
print("diag:", script.exports_sync.diag())
print(f"resolved {len(protos)}/{len(uids)} protos\n")
print(f"{'species':<13} {'REAL get_Nickname':<22} {'offset184 (crawl read)'}")
print('-' * 70)
try:
    for dec, proto in protos.items():
        uh = dec2hex[dec]
        real = script.exports_sync.read_real(proto)
        ov = script.exports_sync.read184(proto)
        flag = '  <-- DIFFER' if real != ov else ''
        print(f"{nm.get(uh, '?'):<13} {repr(real):<22} {repr(ov)}{flag}")
finally:
    script.unload()
    sess.detach()
```

```py
        WHERE species_name='Scatterbug' AND form=? AND in_bag=1
```

`pogo_extract/reattach_capture.py`:

```py
"""
Reattach to already-running PoGO (spawned via Frida earlier).
Install SSL hook and capture inventory when user opens Pokemon storage.
"""
import frida
import sys
import time
import os

FRIDA_HOST = "127.0.0.1:31337"
OUTPUT_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "captures")
os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

SSL_HOOK_SCRIPT = """
var MIN_SIZE = 50000;
var sessionData = {};
var captureCount = 0;
var totalBytesRead = 0;
var capturing = true;

function findExport(moduleName, exportName) {
    var mods = Process.enumerateModules();
    for (var i = 0; i < mods.length; i++) {
        if (mods[i].name === moduleName) {
            var exports = mods[i].enumerateExports();
            for (var j = 0; j < exports.length; j++) {
                if (exports[j].name === exportName) {
                    return exports[j].address;
                }
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

var ssl_read_addr = findExport("libssl.so", "SSL_read");
if (!ssl_read_addr) {
    send({type: 'error', msg: 'SSL_read not found!'});
} else {
    send({type: 'info', msg: 'SSL_read at ' + ssl_read_addr + ' - hooking...'});

    Interceptor.attach(ssl_read_addr, {
        onEnter: function(args) {
            this.ssl = args[0].toString();
            this.buf = args[1];
            this.num = args[2].toInt32();
        },
        onLeave: function(retval) {
            try {
                if (!capturing) return;
                var size = retval.toInt32();
                if (size <= 0) return;
                totalBytesRead += size;
                if (!sessionData[this.ssl]) {
                    sessionData[this.ssl] = {chunks: [], total: 0};
                }
                var data = this.buf.readByteArray(size);
                if (!data) return;
                sessionData[this.ssl].chunks.push(data);
                sessionData[this.ssl].total += size;
                if (sessionData[this.ssl].total >= MIN_SIZE) {
                    captureCount++;
                    var totalSize = sessionData[this.ssl].total;
                    var combined = new Uint8Array(totalSize);
                    var offset = 0;
                    for (var i = 0; i < sessionData[this.ssl].chunks.length; i++) {
                        var arr = new Uint8Array(sessionData[this.ssl].chunks[i]);
                        combined.set(arr, offset);
                        offset += arr.length;
                    }
                    send({type: 'data', id: captureCount, size: totalSize, ssl: this.ssl}, combined.buffer);
                    sessionData[this.ssl] = {chunks: [], total: 0};
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        }
    });

    send({type: 'info', msg: 'Hook active! Open Pokemon storage now.'});
}

rpc.exports = {
    status: function() {
        return {totalBytesRead: totalBytesRead, captureCount: captureCount, activeSessions: Object.keys(sessionData).length};
    },
    flush: function() {
        capturing = false;
        var flushed = 0;
        Object.keys(sessionData).forEach(function(ssl) {
            if (sessionData[ssl].total > 5000) {
                flushed++;
                captureCount++;
                var totalSize = sessionData[ssl].total;
                var combined = new Uint8Array(totalSize);
                var offset = 0;
                for (var i = 0; i < sessionData[ssl].chunks.length; i++) {
                    var arr = new Uint8Array(sessionData[ssl].chunks[i]);
                    combined.set(arr, offset);
                    offset += arr.length;
                }
                send({type: 'data', id: captureCount, size: totalSize, ssl: ssl, final: true}, combined.buffer);
                sessionData[ssl] = {chunks: [], total: 0};
            }
        });
        return {flushed: flushed, totalBytes: totalBytesRead, captures: captureCount};
    }
};
"""

captures = []

def on_message(message, data):
    if message['type'] == 'send':
        payload = message['payload']
        if isinstance(payload, str):
            print(f"[*] {payload}", flush=True)
        elif payload.get('type') == 'info':
            print(f"[*] {payload['msg']}", flush=True)
        elif payload.get('type') == 'error':
            print(f"[!] {payload['msg']}", flush=True)
        elif payload.get('type') == 'data':
            cid = payload['id']
            size = payload['size']
            tag = "final" if payload.get('final') else "capture"
            filename = f"{tag}_{cid}_{size}b.bin"
            filepath = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename)
            with open(filepath, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(data)
            captures.append({'file': filepath, 'size': size})
            print(f"[+] SAVED: {filename} ({size} bytes)", flush=True)
    elif message['type'] == 'error':
        print(f"[!] Error: {message.get('description', '')}", flush=True)

def main():
    # Get current PoGO PID
    import subprocess
    r = subprocess.run(["adb", "shell", "ps -A | grep com.nianticlabs.pokemongo$"],
                      capture_output=True, text=True)
    pid = int(r.stdout.split()[1])
    print(f"PoGO PID: {pid}", flush=True)

    device = frida.get_device_manager().add_remote_device(FRIDA_HOST)
    print("Attaching...", flush=True)
    session = device.attach(pid)

    print("Installing SSL hook...", flush=True)
    script = session.create_script(SSL_HOOK_SCRIPT)
    script.on('message', on_message)
    script.load()
    time.sleep(1)

    print(flush=True)
    print("=" * 60, flush=True)
    print("  READY! Open Pokemon storage NOW (Pokeball > Pokemon)", flush=True)
    print("  Capturing for 90 seconds...", flush=True)
    print("=" * 60, flush=True)
    print(flush=True)

    try:
        for i in range(90):
            time.sleep(1)
            if i > 0 and i % 10 == 0:
                try:
                    s = script.exports_sync.status()
                    print(f"  [{i}s] read={s['totalBytesRead']}B captures={s['captureCount']} sessions={s['activeSessions']}", flush=True)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"  [{i}s] Lost: {e}", flush=True)
                    break
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass

    print("\nFlushing...", flush=True)
    try:
        r = script.exports_sync.flush()
        print(f"Flush: {r}", flush=True)
    except:
        pass

    print(f"\nTotal: {len(captures)} captures", flush=True)
    for c in captures:
        print(f"  {os.path.basename(c['file'])} ({c['size']}B)", flush=True)

    try:
        session.detach()
    except:
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```py
"""
Re-decode existing pokemon_full.json with the now-known offsets.
Builds the FINAL comprehensive DB with all fields decoded.
"""
import json, sqlite3, os, struct
from datetime import datetime, timezone

POGO_LAUNCH_MS = 1467590400000

# Known PokemonProto offsets (verified against live memory)
PROTO_FIELDS = {
    'klass':                  (0,   'ptr'),    # IL2CPP class pointer
    'monitor':                (8,   'ptr'),
    'pokemonRequirementsPtr': (16,  'ptr'),    # ptr to UnknownFieldSet or similar
    'id_':                    (32,  'i64u'),   # uid (uint64)
    'pokemonId_':             (40,  'i32'),    # species
    'cp_':                    (44,  'i32'),
    'stamina_':               (48,  'i32'),
    'staminaMax_':            (52,  'i32'),
    'move1_':                 (56,  'i32'),
    'move2_':                 (60,  'i32'),
    'deployedFortId_':        (64,  'str'),
    'heightM_':               (104, 'f32'),
    'weightKg_':              (108, 'f32'),
    'individualAttack_':      (112, 'i32'),
    'individualDefense_':     (116, 'i32'),
    'individualStamina_':     (120, 'i32'),
    'cpMultiplier_':          (124, 'f32'),
    'pokeball_':              (128, 'i32'),
    'capturedCellId_':        (136, 'i64u'),  # S2 cell where caught
    'creationTimeMs_':        (160, 'i64'),
    'originDetail_':          (168, 'i32'),   # enum: 1=POKESTOP, 2=GYM, 3=PHOTOBOMBED, etc.
    'numAdditionalCpMultiplier_': (172, 'f32'),  # best buddy boost
    'nickname_':              (184, 'str'),
    'pokemonDisplay_':        (216, 'ptr_display'),
    'isLucky_':               (272, 'bool'),
    'move3_':                 (276, 'i32'),
    'capturePoint':           (320, 'i64u'),  # Possibly other cell
    'captureLat':             (324, 'f32'),
    'captureLng':             (332, 'f32'),
}

# Origin detail enum (Holoholo.Rpc.PokemonOriginDetail)
ORIGIN_DETAIL_NAMES = {
    0: 'UNSET', 1: 'POKESTOP', 2: 'GYM', 3: 'PHOTOBOMBED', 4: 'GO_SNAPSHOT',
    5: 'GO_BATTLE_LEAGUE', 6: 'BATTLE_RAID', 7: 'INCENSE', 8: 'GIFT',
    9: 'ROUTE', 10: 'ADVENTURE_SYNC', 11: 'POKEMON_HOME', 12: 'BREAD',
    13: 'TRADE', 14: 'EGG_HATCH', 15: 'TUTORIAL'
}

# Pokeball enum
POKEBALL_NAMES = {0: 'UNKNOWN', 1: 'POKEBALL', 2: 'GREATBALL', 3: 'ULTRABALL', 4: 'MASTERBALL', 5: 'PREMIERBALL'}

# Gender enum
GENDER_NAMES = {0: 'UNSET', 1: 'MALE', 2: 'FEMALE', 3: 'GENDERLESS'}

# CPM -> level
CPM_TABLE = [
    (0.094,1),(0.135137432,1.5),(0.16639787,2),(0.192650919,2.5),(0.21573247,3),(0.236572661,3.5),

def cpm_to_level(cpm):
    if not cpm or cpm <= 0: return None
    return min(CPM_TABLE, key=lambda x: abs(x[0] - cpm))[1]

def s2_cell_to_latlng(cell_id):
    """Convert S2 cell ID to approximate lat/lng (S2 level 17 cells are ~150m)."""
    if not cell_id: return None, None
    # Simplified S2 decoding - full impl would use s2 library
    # The face is high 3 bits
    face = (cell_id >> 60) & 0xF
    return None, None  # TODO: use s2sphere lib

def parse_proto(raw_hex):
    """Parse a raw 320-byte hex string into a fields dict."""
    if not raw_hex or len(raw_hex) < 600: return {}
    data = bytes.fromhex(raw_hex)
    if len(data) < 320: return {}

    fields = {}
    for name, (off, kind) in PROTO_FIELDS.items():
        try:
            if off + (8 if kind in ['i64', 'i64u', 'ptr', 'ptr_display'] else 4) > len(data):
                continue
            if kind == 'i32':
                fields[name] = struct.unpack_from('<i', data, off)[0]
            elif kind == 'i64':
                fields[name] = struct.unpack_from('<q', data, off)[0]
            elif kind == 'i64u':
                fields[name] = struct.unpack_from('<Q', data, off)[0]
            elif kind == 'f32':
                fields[name] = struct.unpack_from('<f', data, off)[0]
            elif kind == 'bool':
                fields[name] = bool(data[off])
            elif kind == 'ptr' or kind == 'ptr_display':
                fields[name] = struct.unpack_from('<Q', data, off)[0]
            elif kind == 'str':
                fields[name] = struct.unpack_from('<Q', data, off)[0]  # ptr value (string contents not in raw)
        except: pass
    return fields

def main():
    print("Loading pokemon_full.json...")
    raw = json.load(open('pokemon_full.json'))
    print(f"  {len(raw)} entries")

    db_path = 'pokemon.db'
    if os.path.exists(db_path): os.remove(db_path)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    c = conn.cursor()

    c.execute('''CREATE TABLE pokemon (
        uid_hex TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        uid INTEGER,
        pokemon_id INTEGER,
        cp INTEGER,
        stamina INTEGER,
        stamina_max INTEGER,
        move1 INTEGER,
        move2 INTEGER,
        move3 INTEGER,
        iv_atk INTEGER,
        iv_def INTEGER,
        iv_sta INTEGER,
        iv_total INTEGER,
        iv_pct REAL,
        is_hundo BOOLEAN,
        is_zero BOOLEAN,
        height_m REAL,
        weight_kg REAL,
        cp_multiplier REAL,
        num_additional_cpm REAL,
        level REAL,
        is_best_buddy BOOLEAN,
        pokeball INTEGER,
        pokeball_name TEXT,
        creation_time_ms INTEGER,
        creation_date TEXT,
        is_lucky BOOLEAN,
        nickname TEXT,
        deployed_fort_id TEXT,
        is_deployed BOOLEAN,
        captured_cell_id INTEGER,
        captured_cell_hex TEXT,
        origin_detail INTEGER,
        origin_detail_name TEXT,
        gender INTEGER,
        gender_name TEXT,
        costume INTEGER,
        form INTEGER,
        is_shiny BOOLEAN,
        alignment INTEGER,
        weather_boosted INTEGER,
        addr TEXT,
        display_raw TEXT,
        raw_proto_hex TEXT
    )''')

    inserted = 0
    skipped = 0
    seen = set()

    for p in raw:
        if not p.get('raw_proto'):
            skipped += 1; continue

        # Re-parse with full field set
        fields = parse_proto(p['raw_proto'])

        uid = fields.get('id_', 0)
        if uid == 0:
            skipped += 1; continue
        create_ms = fields.get('creationTimeMs_', 0)
        if create_ms < POGO_LAUNCH_MS:
            skipped += 1; continue

        uid_hex = f"{uid:016x}"
        if uid_hex in seen:
            skipped += 1; continue
        seen.add(uid_hex)

        pokemon_id = fields.get('pokemonId_', 0)
        cp = fields.get('cp_', 0)
        stamina = fields.get('stamina_', 0)
        stamina_max = fields.get('staminaMax_', 0)
        move1 = fields.get('move1_', 0)
        move2 = fields.get('move2_', 0)
        move3 = fields.get('move3_', 0)
        iv_atk = fields.get('individualAttack_', 0)
        iv_def = fields.get('individualDefense_', 0)
        iv_sta = fields.get('individualStamina_', 0)
        iv_t = iv_atk + iv_def + iv_sta
        iv_pct = round(iv_t / 45 * 100, 1)
        height = fields.get('heightM_', 0)
        weight = fields.get('weightKg_', 0)
        cpm = fields.get('cpMultiplier_', 0)
        num_addl_cpm = fields.get('numAdditionalCpMultiplier_', 0)
        level = cpm_to_level(cpm + (num_addl_cpm or 0))
        pokeball = fields.get('pokeball_', 0)
        captured_cell = fields.get('capturedCellId_', 0)
        captured_cell_hex = f"{captured_cell:016x}" if captured_cell else None
        # SQLite INTEGER is signed 64-bit, convert
        captured_cell_signed = captured_cell if captured_cell < 2**63 else captured_cell - 2**64
        origin = fields.get('originDetail_', 0)
        is_lucky = fields.get('isLucky_', False)

        deployed_fort_ptr = fields.get('deployedFortId_', 0)
        # Empty string ptr (System.String.Empty) sentinel value
        EMPTY_STR_PTR = 0x7b81c1cf40
        is_deployed = (deployed_fort_ptr != 0 and deployed_fort_ptr != EMPTY_STR_PTR)

        # Display fields (from previously enriched data)
        gender = costume = form = alignment = weather = 0
        is_shiny = False
        if 'display' in p and p['display']:
            d = p['display']
            gender = d.get('0x14', 0)
            # IL2CPP field order in PokemonDisplayProto:
            # gender(0x14), costume(0x18), shiny(0x1c?), form(0x20?), weather, alignment
            # Based on samples, 0x1c is often form (Unown=20)
            costume = d.get('0x18', 0)  # might be 0
            form = d.get('0x1c', 0)
            # shiny is bool - check b_0x18 OR b_0x20
            is_shiny = bool(d.get('b_0x20', 0)) or bool(d.get('b_0x24', 0))
            alignment = d.get('0x24', 0) or 0
            weather = d.get('0x28', 0) or 0

        try:
            dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(create_ms/1000, tz=timezone.utc).isoformat()
        except: dt = None

        uid_signed = uid if uid < 2**63 else uid - 2**64

        placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * 44)
        c.execute(f'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO pokemon VALUES ({placeholders})', (
            uid_hex, uid_signed, pokemon_id, cp, stamina, stamina_max,
            move1, move2, move3,
            iv_atk, iv_def, iv_sta, iv_t, iv_pct,
            iv_t == 45, iv_t == 0,
            height, weight, cpm, num_addl_cpm, level, num_addl_cpm > 0,
            pokeball, POKEBALL_NAMES.get(pokeball),
            create_ms, dt, is_lucky,
            p.get('nickname'),
            hex(deployed_fort_ptr) if deployed_fort_ptr else None, is_deployed,
            captured_cell_signed, captured_cell_hex,
            origin, ORIGIN_DETAIL_NAMES.get(origin),
            gender, GENDER_NAMES.get(gender), costume, form, is_shiny, alignment, weather,
            p['addr'], json.dumps(p.get('display', {})), p.get('raw_proto')
        ))
        # 44 cols expected
        inserted += 1

    # Indexes
    for col in ['pokemon_id', 'cp', 'iv_total', 'level', 'is_lucky', 'is_hundo',
                'creation_date', 'gender', 'is_shiny', 'pokeball', 'origin_detail',
                'is_deployed', 'is_best_buddy']:
        c.execute(f'CREATE INDEX idx_{col} ON pokemon({col})')

    conn.commit()

    # Stats
    print(f"\nInserted: {inserted}, filtered: {skipped}")
    print(f"\n=== Stats ===")
    queries = [
        ('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon', 'Total'),
        ('SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pokemon_id) FROM pokemon', 'Species'),
        ('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE is_hundo', 'Hundos'),
        ('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE is_zero', 'Zeros'),
        ('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE is_lucky', 'Lucky'),
        ('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE is_shiny', 'Shiny (estimated)'),
        ('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE is_best_buddy', 'Best Buddy'),
        ('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE is_deployed', 'Deployed in gyms'),
        ('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE captured_cell_id != 0', 'Have location'),
        ('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE level >= 30', 'Level 30+'),
        ('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE level >= 40', 'Level 40+'),
    ]
    for q, label in queries:
        c.execute(q); print(f'  {label}: {c.fetchone()[0]}')

    print(f"\n=== Origin distribution ===")
    c.execute('SELECT origin_detail_name, COUNT(*) FROM pokemon GROUP BY origin_detail_name ORDER BY 2 DESC')
    for n, cnt in c.fetchall(): print(f'  {n or "UNSET"}: {cnt}')

    print(f"\n=== Best Buddies (top 10 by num_additional_cpm) ===")
    c.execute('SELECT pokemon_id, cp, level, num_additional_cpm FROM pokemon WHERE is_best_buddy ORDER BY num_additional_cpm DESC LIMIT 10')
    for r in c.fetchall(): print(f'  #{r[0]} CP{r[1]} L{r[2]} +cpm={r[3]:.4f}')

    print(f"\nDB: pokemon.db ({os.path.getsize(db_path)/1024:.0f} KB)")
    conn.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
"""Recreate Hundos + From Florandez tags and re-tag all members."""
import frida, json, time, subprocess, sqlite3, sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(line_buffering=True)

# Get UIDs to tag
hundos = [r[0] for r in c.execute("SELECT uid_hex FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND iv_total=45").fetchall()]
florandez = [r[0] for r in c.execute("SELECT uid_hex FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND (is_traded_flag_v2=1 OR is_lucky=1) AND lower(original_owner_name)='florandez'").fetchall()]
print(f"Hundos to tag: {len(hundos)}", flush=True)
print(f"From Florandez to tag: {len(florandez)}", flush=True)

# Walk bag for proto pointers

    u = int(uid); return str(u if u >= 0 else u + 2**64)
all_uids = list(set(hundos + florandez))
uid_strs = []
for uh in all_uids:
    r = c.execute("SELECT uid FROM pokemon WHERE uid_hex=?", (uh,)).fetchone()
    if r: uid_strs.append((uh, to_uid_str(r[0])))

js_walk = """
rpc.exports = {
    findProtos: function(bag, uids) {
        var il2cpp = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
        var exp = {};
        il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) exp[e.name] = e.address; });
        function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(exp[n],r,a); }
        var dG = bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
        var dGA = bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
        var aGI = bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
        var iGN = bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
        var cFN = bind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
        var cMN = bind('il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','int']);
        var rI = bind('il2cpp_runtime_invoke','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer','pointer']);
        var sp = Memory.alloc(4); var asms = dGA(dG(), sp); var na = sp.readS32();
        var gi = null;
        for (var a=0;a<na;a++){ var i=aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if (iGN(i).readCString()==='holo-game.dll'){ gi=i; break; } }
        var cls = cFN(gi, Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Internal'), Memory.allocUtf8String('PokemonBagImpl'));
        var ga = cMN(cls, Memory.allocUtf8String('get_AllPokemon'), 0);
        var inst = ptr(bag);
        var exc = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
        var values = rI(ga, inst, ptr(0), exc);
        var lhm = values.add(0x10).readPointer();
        var list = lhm.add(0x18).readPointer();
        var head = list.add(0x10).readPointer();
        var count = list.add(0x18).readS32();
        var wanted = {}; for (var i = 0; i < uids.length; i++) wanted[uids[i]] = true;
        var found = {}; var node = head; var iters = 0;
        while (node && !node.isNull() && iters < count + 200) {
            try {
                var key = node.add(0x28).readU64().toString();
                if (wanted[key]) found[key] = node.add(0x30).readPointer().toString();
                var next = node.add(0x18).readPointer();
                if (next.isNull() || next.equals(head)) break;
                node = next;
            } catch(e) { break; }
            iters++;
        }
        return {found: found};
    }
};
"""
walker = sess.create_script(js_walk); walker.load()
r = walker.exports_sync.find_protos(BAG, [u[1] for u in uid_strs])

# Create both tags

    res = bulk.exports_sync.add_tag_on_instance(SVC, tag_name, color)
    print(f"  result: {res}", flush=True)
    time.sleep(1.5)

# Re-tag members
for tag_name, uids in [('Hundos', hundos), ('From Florandez', florandez)]:
    print(f"\n=== Tagging {len(uids)} as '{tag_name}' ===", flush=True)
    ftid = bulk.exports_sync.find_tag_id_by_name(SVC, tag_name)
    if not ftid.get('ok'):
        print(f"  FAIL: tag '{tag_name}' not found after creation", flush=True)
        continue
    ptrs = [hex_to_proto[uh] for uh in uids if uh in hex_to_proto]
    print(f"  {len(ptrs)} ptrs to tag, tagProto={ftid['tagProtoAddr']} idx={ftid['idx']}", flush=True)
    if not ptrs: continue
    # warm-up
    bulk.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ftid['tagProtoAddr'], ptrs[:1])
    time.sleep(0.8)
    for i in range(0, len(ptrs), 30):
        chunk = ptrs[i:i+30]
        res = bulk.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ftid['tagProtoAddr'], chunk)
        ok = 'ok' if res.get('ok') else f"FAIL {res.get('err')}"
        print(f"  batch {i//30+1} ({len(chunk)}): {ok} built={res.get('built',0)}", flush=True)
        time.sleep(0.4)
    time.sleep(2)
    chk = bulk.exports_sync.get_pokemon_for_tag(SVC, ftid['idx'])
    print(f"  Final {tag_name} count: {chk.get('dump',{}).get('+0x18_listish',{}).get('count','?')}", flush=True)

sess.detach()
```

`pogo_extract/reconcile_from_drift.py`:

```py
"""Apply tag_drift.json: per tag, add the 'add' uids and remove the 'remove' uids.
Bag-walk proto resolution, warm-up untag, self-healing reconnect."""
import frida, sys, time, json, sqlite3
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import pogo_il2cpp as pg, pogo_pipeline as pl

drift = json.load(open('tag_drift.json'))
c = sqlite3.connect('pokemon.db').cursor()
def us(uh):
    r=c.execute('SELECT uid FROM pokemon WHERE uid_hex=?',(uh,)).fetchone()
    if not r: return None
    u=int(r[0]); return str(u if u>=0 else u+2**64)

# gather all uids needed
all_uids=set()
for t,d in drift.items():
    all_uids |= set(d['add']) | set(d['remove'])

for attempt in range(10):
    try:
        sess,pid=pg.get_session(); s=pl.step_singletons(sess); SVC=s['svc']; BAG=s['bag']
        umap={uh:us(uh) for uh in all_uids if us(uh)}
        found=pg.find_protos_for_uids(sess, BAG, list(umap.values()))
        proto={uh:found[u] for uh,u in umap.items() if u in found}
        bt=sess.create_script(open('bulk_tag.js','r',encoding='utf-8').read()); bt.on('message',lambda m,d:None); bt.load(); bt.exports_sync.init_status()
        for tag,d in drift.items():
            ft=bt.exports_sync.find_tag_id_by_name(SVC, tag)
            if not ft.get('ok'):
                print(f'{tag}: tag missing, skip'); continue
            adds=[proto[uh] for uh in d['add'] if uh in proto]
            rems=[proto[uh] for uh in d['remove'] if uh in proto]
            if adds:
                bt.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ft['tagProtoAddr'], adds[:1]); time.sleep(0.5)
                for i in range(0,len(adds),60): bt.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ft['tagProtoAddr'], adds[i:i+60]); time.sleep(0.3)
            if rems:
                try: bt.exports_sync.bulk_untag_one(SVC, rems[0], ft['tagProtoAddr']); time.sleep(0.5)  # warm-up
                except: pass
                for rnd in range(2):
                    for p in rems:
                        try: bt.exports_sync.bulk_untag_one(SVC, p, ft['tagProtoAddr'])
                        except: pass
                        time.sleep(0.18)
            time.sleep(1)
            chk=bt.exports_sync.get_pokemon_for_tag(SVC, ft['idx'])
            print(f"{tag}: +{len(adds)} -{len(rems)} -> server now {chk.get('dump',{}).get('+0x18_listish',{}).get('count')}")
        sess.detach(); break
    except (frida.InvalidOperationError, frida.TransportError, frida.ProcessNotFoundError, frida.ServerNotRunningError, RuntimeError) as e:
        print(f'[retry {attempt+1}] {type(e).__name__}'); time.sleep(4)
```

`pogo_extract/reconcile_gamemaster.py`:

```py
"""MAKE THE GAME AUTHORITATIVE OVER pvpoke (user 2026-09-20: "Dig into the game further and double check
every thing" / "leverage it if it means improvement").

pvpoke's gamemaster is a community file about the PvP metagame; `gamemaster_pokeminers.json` is the client's
OWN game master. Where they disagree, the game is right, and this project ranks, caps and culls on pvpoke's
copy. Measured on the live bag, pvpoke was wrong in two ways that reach a keep decision:

  BASE STATS   1 of 1,191 stat lines disagreed -- dugtrio def 136 (pvpoke) vs 134 (the game) -- and 14 in-bag
               rows rank on it. A wrong base stat is a wrong stat product is a wrong league rank.
  EVOLUTIONS   pvpoke's `family.evolutions` MISSES edges the game has: corsola_galarian has no family at all
               (the game evolves it to Cursola), zygarde has none (-> zygarde_complete), poltchageist's edge is
               recorded BACKWARDS on sinistcha. rank_cache._reachable() trims stages the game forbids, so
               pvpoke claiming too much is already handled -- but it can only ever REMOVE, so an edge pvpoke
               LACKS is invisible: that mon is ranked as if it were a final stage and its real later stage is
               never scored. That is the under-protection direction, the one that releases a keeper.

ADDITIVE ONLY on edges. Nothing is ever deleted: `_reachable()` is the remover and it reads the game directly,
so removing here would only risk dropping a stage on a mapping miss. Base stats ARE overwritten, but only when
the pvpoke id matched a game template by NAME (never by a dex-only guess), and every change is printed.

  python reconcile_gamemaster.py [--dry-run]
"""
import json, os, re, sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
norm = lambda x: re.sub(r'[^A-Z0-9]', '', str(x).upper())


def game_tables():
    """norm(form|pokemonId) -> {'stats': (a,d,s), 'evo': [(form_key, species_key), ...]}

    A VARIANT template must never fill in the BASE species key. Letting CORSOLA_GALARIAN's branch answer for
    'CORSOLA' handed a Kantonian Corsola a Cursola stage, and FARFETCHD_GALARIAN handed a Kantonian
    Farfetch'd a Sirfetch'd -- five wrong edges on the first draft of this file. The base key is filled only
    by a template with no form at all, or by <SPECIES>_NORMAL, which IS the base form."""
    out, owners, by_id = {}, {}, {}
    for t in json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, 'gamemaster_pokeminers.json'), encoding='utf-8')):
        s = (t.get('data') or {}).get('pokemonSettings')
        if not s or not re.match(r'V\d{4}_POKEMON_', t.get('templateId', '')):
            continue
        st = s.get('stats') or {}
        rec = {'stats': (st.get('baseAttack'), st.get('baseDefense'), st.get('baseStamina')),
               'evo': [(norm(b.get('form') or ''), norm(b.get('evolution')))
                       for b in (s.get('evolutionBranch') or []) if b.get('evolution')]}
        is_normal = bool(s.get('form')) and norm(s['form']) == norm(s['pokemonId']) + 'NORMAL'
        keys = [(norm(s['form']), True)] if s.get('form') else []
        if s.get('form'):
            owners.setdefault(norm(s['form']), set()).add(norm(s['pokemonId']))
            by_id.setdefault(norm(s['pokemonId']), dict(rec, strong=False))
        if not s.get('form') or is_normal:
            keys.append((norm(s['pokemonId']), is_normal))
        for k, strong in keys:
            if k not in out:
                out[k] = dict(rec); out[k]['strong'] = strong
            else:
                # <SPECIES>_NORMAL OUTRANKS THE FORMLESS TEMPLATE (2026-09-20). The game ships both for many
                # species and they are NOT always equal: V0051_POKEMON_DUGTRIO says baseDefense 134 while
                # V0051_POKEMON_DUGTRIO_NORMAL says 136, and every Kantonian Dugtrio in the bag is form 61 =
                # DugtrioNormal, whose stored CP only reconstructs at 136. Taking whichever template the file
                # listed first "corrected" pvpoke to the stale number and audit_invariants BLOCKed it -- which
                # is the check doing its job. The form the game actually assigns is the authority.
                if strong and not out[k].get('strong'):
                    out[k] = dict(rec); out[k]['strong'] = True
                elif not out[k]['evo'] and rec['evo']:
                    out[k]['evo'] = rec['evo']
    # A FORM NAME SHARED BY TWO SPECIES answers for neither (2026-09-26): NIDORAN_NORMAL is the form of BOTH Nidorans, and
    # the first template won -- Nidoran M was handed Nidoran F's branch (an edge nidoran_male -> nidorina). Drop the
    # shared key; each species then answers by its own pokemonId (NIDORANMALE / NIDORANFEMALE).
    for k, ids in owners.items():
        if len(ids) > 1:
            out.pop(k, None)
            for i in ids:
                out.setdefault(i, by_id[i])
    return out


def bag_bridge():
    """norm(live Form enum name) -> the pvpoke speciesId this project ranks that form as.

    Name matching alone cannot connect pvpoke's 'zygarde' to the game's ZYGARDE_FIFTY_PERCENT, or
    'poltchageist' to POLTCHAGEIST_COUNTERFEIT -- and those are exactly the two rows whose real evolution
    pvpoke is missing. The bag knows the answer: to_pvpoke_id() is the mapping the ranker itself uses, and the
    Form enum names the same form the game does. Covers every form actually held, which is the set that can
    cost a keeper."""
    import sqlite3
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(HERE, 'system', 'scripts'))
    import rank_cache as rc
    enum = {int(k): v for k, v in json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, 'form_enum.json'), encoding='utf-8')).items()}
    con = sqlite3.connect('file:%s?mode=ro' % os.path.join(HERE, 'pokemon.db').replace(chr(92), '/'), uri=True)
    try:
        pairs = con.execute('SELECT DISTINCT species_name, form FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1').fetchall()
    finally:
        con.close()
    out = {}
    for sp, form in pairs:
        sid = rc.to_pvpoke_id(sp, form, 0)
        k = norm(enum.get(int(form or 0), ''))
        if sid and k:
            out.setdefault(k, sid)
    return out


def pv_key(sid):
    """The game keys a pvpoke speciesId could be spelled as, best first."""
    return [norm(sid),
            norm(sid.replace('_alolan', '_alola').replace('_paldean', '_paldea')),
            norm(sid + '_normal'),
            norm(sid.replace('_alolan', '_alola') + '_normal')]


def main():
    G = game_tables()
    BRIDGE = bag_bridge()
    path = os.path.join(HERE, 'pvpoke_gamemaster.json')
    gm = json.load(open(path, encoding='utf-8'))
    by_sid = {p['speciesId']: p for p in gm['pokemon']}

    # game key -> pvpoke speciesId, preferring the shortest id (plain 'corsola' over a costume spelling)
    k2sid = dict(BRIDGE)
    for p in gm['pokemon']:
        if '_shadow' in p['speciesId']:
            continue
        for k in pv_key(p['speciesId']):
            if k in G and (k not in k2sid or len(p['speciesId']) < len(k2sid[k])):
                k2sid[k] = p['speciesId']
    sid2keys = {}
    for k, v in BRIDGE.items():
        sid2keys.setdefault(v, []).append(k)

    stat_fix, edge_add, unmapped, reversed_fix = [], [], [], []
    for p in gm['pokemon']:
        sid = p['speciesId']
        if '_shadow' in sid:
            continue
        g = next((G[k] for k in pv_key(sid) if k in G), None)
        # ...and the form(s) the BAG says this id is, which is how zygarde finds ZYGARDE_FIFTY_PERCENT
        gevo = list(g['evo']) if g else []
        for k in sid2keys.get(sid, []):
            for e in (G.get(k) or {}).get('evo', []):
                if e not in gevo:
                    gevo.append(e)
        if not g and not gevo:
            continue
        g = g or {'stats': (None, None, None)}
        # ---- base stats: the game is the authority
        b = p.get('baseStats') or {}
        cur = (b.get('atk'), b.get('def'), b.get('hp'))
        if None not in g['stats'] and None not in cur and g['stats'] != cur:
            stat_fix.append((sid, cur, g['stats']))
            b['atk'], b['def'], b['hp'] = g['stats']
        # ---- evolution edges: ADD what the game has and pvpoke lacks
        want = []
        for fk, spk in gevo:
            # the form key names the exact target (OINKOLOGNE_FEMALE); the species key is the fallback for a
            # target pvpoke models as one entry (DUDUNSPARCE_TWO/THREE are both pvpoke's 'dudunsparce')
            t = (k2sid.get(fk) or k2sid.get(re.sub('NORMAL$', '', fk)) or k2sid.get(spk)
                 or k2sid.get(re.sub('NORMAL$', '', spk)))
            if t is None:
                unmapped.append((sid, fk or spk))
            elif t != sid and t not in want:
                want.append(t)
        if not want:
            continue
        fam = p.get('family') or {}
        have = list(fam.get('evolutions') or [])
        new = [t for t in want if t not in have]
        if new:
            # A REVERSED EDGE IS NOT AN EDGE. pvpoke files poltchageist's evolution on sinistcha, pointing back
            # at poltchageist; adding the real direction on top of that makes a 2-cycle that recursed the ranker
            # to death. Only ever drop the reverse when the GAME has no such branch -- then it is not pvpoke
            # modelling something we missed, it is pvpoke being backwards.
            for t in new:
                tp = by_sid.get(t) or {}
                tfam = tp.get('family') or {}
                if sid in (tfam.get('evolutions') or []):
                    gt = next((G[k] for k in pv_key(t) if k in G), None)
                    gtk = [a or b for a, b in ((gt or {}).get('evo') or [])]
                    if not any(k2sid.get(k) == sid or k2sid.get(re.sub('NORMAL$', '', k)) == sid for k in gtk):
                        tfam['evolutions'] = [e for e in tfam['evolutions'] if e != sid]
                        reversed_fix.append((t, sid))
            edge_add.append((sid, have, new))
            fam['evolutions'] = have + new
            fam.setdefault('id', 'FAMILY_%s' % norm(sid))
            p['family'] = fam

    print('BASE STATS corrected from the game: %d' % len(stat_fix))
    for sid, a, b in sorted(stat_fix):
        print('   %-28s pvpoke %-18s -> GAME %s' % (sid, a, b))
    print('REVERSED edges dropped (the game declares the opposite direction): %d' % len(reversed_fix))
    for t, sid in sorted(reversed_fix):
        print('   %-28s no longer claims %r as an evolution' % (t, sid))
    print('EVOLUTION EDGES added (additive only, never removed): %d' % len(edge_add))
    for sid, have, new in sorted(edge_add):
        print('   %-28s %s + %s' % (sid, have or '[]', new))
    if unmapped:
        seen = sorted({'%s -> %s' % (s, k) for s, k in unmapped})
        print('game targets with NO pvpoke entry (left alone, cannot be ranked): %d  e.g. %s'
              % (len(seen), '; '.join(seen[:6])))
    if '--dry-run' in sys.argv:
        print('--dry-run: pvpoke_gamemaster.json NOT written.')
        return 0
    if not stat_fix and not edge_add and not reversed_fix:
        print('nothing to reconcile -- pvpoke already agrees with the game.')
        return 0
    tmp = path + '.tmp'
    with open(tmp, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(gm, f, ensure_ascii=False)
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    print('pvpoke_gamemaster.json rewritten (%d stat fix, %d edge add) -- re-run the ranker.'
          % (len(stat_fix), len(edge_add)))
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

```

`pogo_extract/reconcile_gl.py`:

```py
"""GL tag rule: per species (pokemon_id), individuals with gl_rank<=10, keep top 3 (lowest gl_rank, gl_pct tiebreak).
Apply across ALL species. Reconcile server GL tag to this target. Self-healing, bag-walk proto resolution."""
import frida, sys, time, sqlite3
from collections import defaultdict
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import pogo_il2cpp as pg, pogo_pipeline as pl

_LEAGUE = (sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'GL').upper()
_CFG = {'GL': ('GL','gl_rank','gl_pct'), 'UL': ('UL','ul_rank','ul_pct'), 'LL': ('LL','ll_rank','ll_pct')}
TAGNAME, RANK_COL, PCT_COL = _CFG[_LEAGUE]
CAP = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 2

def has_tag(auth, name):
    return auth and name in [t for t in auth.split(';') if t]

c = sqlite3.connect('pokemon.db').cursor()
rows = c.execute(f"SELECT uid_hex, uid, pokemon_id, species_name, {RANK_COL}, {PCT_COL}, auth_tag_names FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND {RANK_COL} IS NOT NULL AND {RANK_COL}<=10").fetchall()
bypid = defaultdict(list)
for r in rows: bypid[r[2]].append(r)
target = set()
for pid, lst in bypid.items():
    lst.sort(key=lambda x:(x[4], -(x[5] or 0)))
    for r in lst[:CAP]: target.add(r[0])

allrows = c.execute("SELECT uid_hex, auth_tag_names FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1").fetchall()
server = {uh for uh, auth in allrows if has_tag(auth, TAGNAME)}
to_add = target - server
to_remove = server - target
print(f"target={len(target)} server={len(server)} add={len(to_add)} remove={len(to_remove)}")

def us(uh):
    u=int(c.execute('SELECT uid FROM pokemon WHERE uid_hex=?',(uh,)).fetchone()[0]); return str(u if u>=0 else u+2**64)

for attempt in range(10):
    try:
        sess, pid = pg.get_session()
        s = pl.step_singletons(sess); SVC=s['svc']; BAG=s['bag']
        allu = list(to_add | to_remove)
        found = pg.find_protos_for_uids(sess, BAG, [us(u) for u in allu])
        print(f"resolved {len(found)}/{len(allu)} protos")
        bt = sess.create_script(open('bulk_tag.js','r',encoding='utf-8').read())
        bt.on('message', lambda m,d:None); bt.load(); bt.exports_sync.init_status()
        ft = bt.exports_sync.find_tag_id_by_name(SVC, TAGNAME)
        add_protos = [found[us(u)] for u in to_add if us(u) in found]
        if add_protos:
            bt.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ft['tagProtoAddr'], add_protos[:1]); time.sleep(0.6)
            built=0
            for i in range(0, len(add_protos), 60):
                r = bt.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ft['tagProtoAddr'], add_protos[i:i+60])
                built += r.get('built',0); time.sleep(0.3)
            print(f"added {built}/{len(add_protos)}")
        for u in to_remove:
            if us(u) in found:
                bt.exports_sync.bulk_untag_one(SVC, found[us(u)], ft['tagProtoAddr']); time.sleep(0.25)
        time.sleep(1.5)
        chk = bt.exports_sync.get_pokemon_for_tag(SVC, ft['idx'])
        cnt = chk.get('dump',{}).get('+0x18_listish',{}).get('count')
        print(f"server {TAGNAME} now={cnt} (target {len(target)})")
        sess.detach()
        break
    except (frida.InvalidOperationError, frida.TransportError, frida.ProcessNotFoundError, frida.ServerNotRunningError) as e:
        print(f"[retry {attempt+1}] {type(e).__name__}"); time.sleep(4)

```

```py
"""Reconcile DB against authoritative full_inventory_v2 (5031 pokemon, 222 shadows).

    species = species_lookup.get(pid, f'pid{pid}')

    is_zero = 1 if iv_atk==0 and iv_def==0 and iv_sta==0 else 0
    is_traded = 1 if trad != 0 else 0

    tag_ids = ';'.join(rec.get('tagIds',[]))
    tag_count = rec.get('tagCount',0)

    if align == 1: shadow_inserted += 1

    c.execute("""INSERT INTO pokemon
        (uid_hex, uid, pokemon_id, species_name, cp, level, form,
         iv_atk, iv_def, iv_sta, iv_total, iv_pct,
         is_shiny, is_lucky, is_traded, is_hundo, is_zero,
         alignment, alignment_name, costume_decoration_id,
         move1, move2, move3,
         is_powered_up, is_traded_flag_v2,
         in_bag,

         fresh_current_temp_evolution, fresh_has_mega_level, fresh_has_location_card,
         fresh_bread_mode, fresh_is_strong, fresh_shiny,

        (uid_hex, uid, pid, species, cp, level, form,

    has_mega = 1 if rec.get('megaBytes') else 0

        fresh_alignment=?, fresh_shiny=?, fresh_costume=?, fresh_bread_mode=?,

total_in_bag = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1").fetchone()[0]
shadow_in_bag = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND fresh_alignment=1").fetchone()[0]

print(f"  Shadow: {shadow_in_bag}")

print(f"  Shiny: {shiny_in_bag}")

ghost_count = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=0").fetchone()[0]
print(f"\n  Ghost rows (transferred): {ghost_count}")
```

```py
    pb = rec.get('protoBytes')
    db_b = rec.get('displayBytes')
    if not pb or not db_b: continue
    bs = bytes.fromhex(pb)
    dbs = bytes.fromhex(db_b)

    pid = i32(bs, 0x28)
    cp = i32(bs, 0x2c)
    iv_atk = i32(bs, 0x70)
    iv_def = i32(bs, 0x74)
    iv_sta = i32(bs, 0x78)
    cpm = f32(bs, 0x7c)
    level = cpm_to_level(cpm)
    is_lucky = byte(bs, 0x110)
    favorite = byte(bs, 0xb0)
    num_upgrades = i32(bs, 0xa8)
    move1 = i32(bs, 0x38); move2 = i32(bs, 0x3c); move3 = i32(bs, 0x114)
    trad = i32(bs, 0xfc)
    iv_total = iv_atk + iv_def + iv_sta
    iv_pct = iv_total * 100 / 45.0

    costume = i32(dbs, 0x10)
    is_shiny = byte(dbs, 0x18)
    form = i32(dbs, 0x1c)
    align = i32(dbs, 0x24)
    badge = i32(dbs, 0x28)
    cur_temp_evo = i32(dbs, 0x2c)
    bread_mode = i32(dbs, 0x60)
    is_strong = byte(dbs, 0x64)
    has_loc = 1 if rec.get('locBytes') else 0
    has_mega = 1 if rec.get('megaBytes') else 0

    align_name = {0:'NORMAL',1:'SHADOW',2:'PURIFIED'}.get(align,str(align))
    species = species_lookup.get(pid, f'pid{pid}')
    is_hundo = 1 if iv_atk==15 and iv_def==15 and iv_sta==15 else 0
    is_zero = 1 if iv_atk==0 and iv_def==0 and iv_sta==0 else 0
    is_traded = 1 if trad != 0 else 0

    tag_ids = ';'.join(rec.get('tagIds',[]))
    tag_count = rec.get('tagCount',0)

    if align == 1: shadow_inserted += 1

    c.execute("""INSERT INTO pokemon
        (uid_hex, uid, pokemon_id, species_name, cp, level, form,
         iv_atk, iv_def, iv_sta, iv_total, iv_pct,
         is_shiny, is_lucky, is_traded, is_hundo, is_zero,
         alignment, alignment_name, costume_decoration_id,
         move1, move2, move3,
         is_powered_up, is_traded_flag_v2,
         in_bag,
         fresh_in_heap, fresh_costume, fresh_form, fresh_alignment, fresh_pokemon_badge,
         fresh_current_temp_evolution, fresh_has_mega_level, fresh_has_location_card,
         fresh_bread_mode, fresh_is_strong, fresh_shiny,
         fresh_tag_count, fresh_tag_ids)
        VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?, ?,?,?,?,?, ?,?,?,?,?, ?,?,?, ?,?,?, ?,?, ?, ?,?,?,?,?, ?,?,?, ?,?,?, ?,?)""",
        (uid_hex, uid, pid, species, cp, level, form,
         iv_atk, iv_def, iv_sta, iv_total, iv_pct,
         is_shiny, is_lucky, is_traded, is_hundo, is_zero,
         align, align_name, costume,
         move1, move2, move3,
         1 if num_upgrades>0 else 0, is_traded,
         1,
         1, costume, form, align, badge,
         cur_temp_evo, has_mega, has_loc,
         bread_mode, is_strong, is_shiny,
         tag_count, tag_ids))
    inserted += 1
_tick(f"INSERT loop done ({inserted} new rows, {shadow_inserted} shadows)")

# Re-update fresh_* for ALL in-bag pokemon (refresh from authoritative data)
_p = time.time()
_n = 0
for uid_str, rec in results.items():
    _n += 1
    uid_unsigned = int(uid_str)
    uid_hex = f"{uid_unsigned & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF:016x}"
    db_b = rec.get('displayBytes')
    if not db_b: continue
    dbs = bytes.fromhex(db_b)
    align = i32(dbs, 0x24)
    is_shiny = byte(dbs, 0x18)
    costume = i32(dbs, 0x10)
    bread_mode = i32(dbs, 0x60)
    badge = i32(dbs, 0x28)
    is_strong = byte(dbs, 0x64)
    has_loc = 1 if rec.get('locBytes') else 0
    has_mega = 1 if rec.get('megaBytes') else 0
    cur_temp_evo = i32(dbs, 0x2c)
    tag_ids = ';'.join(rec.get('tagIds', []))

    c.execute("""UPDATE pokemon SET
        fresh_alignment=?, fresh_shiny=?, fresh_costume=?, fresh_bread_mode=?,
        fresh_pokemon_badge=?, fresh_is_strong=?, fresh_has_location_card=?,
        fresh_has_mega_level=?, fresh_current_temp_evolution=?, fresh_tag_ids=?
        WHERE uid_hex=?""",
        (align, is_shiny, costume, bread_mode, badge, is_strong,
         has_loc, has_mega, cur_temp_evo, tag_ids, uid_hex))
_tick(f"fresh_* refresh loop done ({_n} UPDATEs in {time.time()-_p:.2f}s = {(time.time()-_p)*1000/max(1,_n):.2f}ms/row)")

_p = time.time()
conn.commit()
_tick(f"conn.commit ({time.time()-_p:.2f}s)")

print(f"\nInserted {inserted} new pokemon ({shadow_inserted} shadows)")

# Verify final counts
total_in_bag = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1").fetchone()[0]
shadow_in_bag = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND fresh_alignment=1").fetchone()[0]
purified_in_bag = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND fresh_alignment=2").fetchone()[0]
shiny_in_bag = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND fresh_shiny=1").fetchone()[0]
print(f"\n=== FINAL DB STATE (in_bag=1) ===")
print(f"  Total: {total_in_bag}")
print(f"  Shadow: {shadow_in_bag}")
print(f"  Purified: {purified_in_bag}")
print(f"  Shiny: {shiny_in_bag}")

ghost_count = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=0").fetchone()[0]
print(f"\n  Ghost rows (transferred): {ghost_count}")

conn.close()
_tick("done")
```
