d = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')
sess = d.attach(pid)

# Method ptrs from prior introspection.
# PokedexImpl (Niantic.Holoholo.Internal):
# 2p Void: yoq, yor, yot, you, yov
# (also yos returns bool, not relevant)

# Resolve them dynamically rather than hardcoding ptrs.
js = r"""
var fns={};
var il2cpp=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
var exp={}; il2cpp.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if (e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0) exp[e.name]=e.address; });
function bind(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(exp[n],r,a); }
fns.dG=bind('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]);
fns.dGA=bind('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
fns.aGI=bind('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']);
fns.iGN=bind('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
fns.cFN=bind('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']);
fns.cGM=bind('il2cpp_class_get_methods','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
fns.mGN=bind('il2cpp_method_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
fns.mGPC=bind('il2cpp_method_get_param_count','int',['pointer']);
fns.mGRT=bind('il2cpp_method_get_return_type','pointer',['pointer']);
fns.tGN=bind('il2cpp_type_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
fns.tA=bind('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer']); fns.tA(fns.dG());

function getImg(name) {
    var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var asms=fns.dGA(fns.dG(),sp); var na=sp.readS32();
    for (var a=0;a<na;a++){ var i=fns.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if (fns.iGN(i).readCString()===name) return i; }
    return null;
}
function getCls(imgName, ns, name) {
    var img=getImg(imgName);
    if (!img) return null;
    return fns.cFN(img, Memory.allocUtf8String(ns), Memory.allocUtf8String(name));
}
function listMethods(cls) {
    var out=[]; var iter=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); iter.writePointer(ptr(0));
    var m;
    while ((m=fns.cGM(cls,iter)) && !m.isNull()) {
        try {
            var n=fns.mGN(m).readCString(); var pc=fns.mGPC(m); var r=fns.mGRT(m);
            var rn=''; try{rn=fns.tGN(r).readCString();}catch(e){}
            out.push({name:n, params:pc, ret:rn, ptr:m.readPointer()});
        } catch(e){}
    }
    return out;
}

// Read C# string at ptr (System.String layout: vtable +0x10 len, +0x14 chars utf-16)
function readUtf16(p) {
    if (!p || p.isNull()) return '';
    try {
        var len = p.add(0x10).readS32();
        if (len < 0 || len > 200) return '';
        var s = '';
        for (var i=0;i<len;i++) s += String.fromCharCode(p.add(0x14 + i*2).readU16());
        return s;
    } catch(e) { return '<bad>'; }
}

var hookLog = [];
function logHook(label, args, this_obj, nargs) {
    try {
        var entry = {ts: Date.now(), label: label, this: this_obj ? this_obj.toString() : null, args:[]};
        for (var i=0;i<nargs;i++) {
            var a = args[i];
            entry.args.push(a ? a.toString() : 'null');
        }
        hookLog.push(entry);
        send({type:'hook', e: entry});
    } catch(e) { send({type:'err', msg:e.toString()}); }
}

rpc.exports = {
    hookAll: function() {
        var hookCount = 0;
        // PokedexImpl 2p Void methods
        var pdex = getCls('holo-game.dll', 'Niantic.Holoholo.Internal', 'PokedexImpl');
        if (pdex && !pdex.isNull()) {
            var methods = listMethods(pdex);
            send({type:'status', msg:'PokedexImpl methods: '+methods.length});
            for (var i=0;i<methods.length;i++) {
                var m = methods[i];
                if (m.ret !== 'System.Void') continue;
                if (m.params < 1 || m.params > 4) continue;
                if (m.name === '.ctor' || m.name === '.cctor' || m.name.indexOf('add_') === 0 || m.name.indexOf('remove_') === 0) continue;
                if (m.ptr.isNull()) continue;
                (function(label, p, np) {
                    try {
                        Interceptor.attach(p, {
                            onEnter: function(args) { logHook('PokedexImpl.'+label, args, args[0], np+1); }
                        });
                        hookCount++;
                    } catch(e) { send({type:'err', msg:'hook PokedexImpl.'+label+': '+e.toString()}); }
                })(m.name, m.ptr, m.params);
            }
        }

        // PokedexCollectionService obfuscated mutators
        var pcs = getCls('holo-game.dll', 'Niantic.Holoholo', 'PokedexCollectionService');
        if (pcs && !pcs.isNull()) {
            var methods = listMethods(pcs);
            send({type:'status', msg:'PokedexCollectionService methods: '+methods.length});
            for (var i=0;i<methods.length;i++) {
                var m = methods[i];
                if (m.ret !== 'System.Void') continue;
                if (m.params < 1 || m.params > 4) continue;
                if (m.name === '.ctor' || m.name === '.cctor') continue;
                if (m.ptr.isNull()) continue;
                (function(label, p, np) {
                    try {
                        Interceptor.attach(p, {
                            onEnter: function(args) { logHook('PokedexCollectionSvc.'+label, args, args[0], np+1); }
                        });
                        hookCount++;
                    } catch(e) {}
                })(m.name, m.ptr, m.params);
            }
        }

        // Inventory delta entry point (the platform handler)
        var nic = getCls('holo-game.dll', 'Niantic.Platform', 'NianticInventoryCache`2');
        if (nic && !nic.isNull()) {
            var methods = listMethods(nic);
            send({type:'status', msg:'NianticInventoryCache methods: '+methods.length});
            for (var i=0;i<methods.length;i++) {
                var m = methods[i];
                if (m.name === 'HandleInventoryDelta' || m.name === 'DoInventoryUpdateEvent') {
                    if (m.ptr.isNull()) continue;
                    (function(label, p, np) {
                        try {
                            Interceptor.attach(p, {
                                onEnter: function(args) { logHook('NIC.'+label, args, args[0], np+1); }
                            });
                            hookCount++;
                        } catch(e) {}
                    })(m.name, m.ptr, m.params);
                }
            }
        }

        // Cutscene IsFirstCapture
        var rtc = getCls('holo-game.dll', 'Niantic.Holoholo.Cutscenes', 'RegisterToPokedexCutscene');
        if (rtc && !rtc.isNull()) {
            var methods = listMethods(rtc);
            for (var i=0;i<methods.length;i++) {
                var m = methods[i];
                if (m.name !== 'IsFirstCapture' && m.name !== 'DiscoverPokemonIcon') continue;
                if (m.ptr.isNull()) continue;
                (function(label, p, np) {
                    try {
                        Interceptor.attach(p, {
                            onEnter: function(args) { logHook('RTPC.'+label, args, args[0], np+1); }
                        });
                        hookCount++;
                    } catch(e) {}
                })(m.name, m.ptr, m.params);
            }
        }

        // Category notification gui
        var pcn = getCls('holo-game.dll', 'Niantic.Holoholo', 'PokedexCategoryNotificationGuiController');
        if (pcn && !pcn.isNull()) {
            var methods = listMethods(pcn);
            for (var i=0;i<methods.length;i++) {
                var m = methods[i];
                if (m.name !== 'Initialize') continue;
                if (m.ptr.isNull()) continue;
                (function(label, p, np) {
                    try {
                        Interceptor.attach(p, {
                            onEnter: function(args) { logHook('PCN.'+label, args, args[0], np+1); }
                        });
                        hookCount++;
                    } catch(e) {}
                })(m.name, m.ptr, m.params);
            }
        }

        return {hooks: hookCount};
    },
    flush: function() { var c = hookLog.slice(); hookLog = []; return c; }
};
"""
sc = sess.create_script(js)
def on(m, data):
    p = m.get('payload', {})
    if isinstance(p, dict):
        t = p.get('type')
        if t == 'status': print(f"  [status] {p.get('msg')}")
        elif t == 'err':  print(f"  [ERR] {p.get('msg')}")
        elif t == 'hook':
            e = p.get('e', {})
            print(f"  [{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] HOOK {e.get('label')}  this={e.get('this')}  args={e.get('args')}")
sc.on('message', on)
sc.load()
r = sc.exports_sync.hook_all()
print(f"\nHooks installed: {r}")
print("\nWaiting 60s. CATCH a pokemon NOW (preferably a brand-new species, costume, lucky, etc).")
print("CTRL+C to exit early.\n")
try:
    for i in range(60):
        time.sleep(1)
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    print("\nInterrupted")
sess.detach()

`pogo_extract/restore_db.py`:

```py
"""Restore pokemon.db from a snapshot.

Usage:
    python restore_db.py                       # interactive: list + prompt
    python restore_db.py latest                # most recent snapshot
    python restore_db.py 2026-05-19_143022     # by timestamp prefix
    python restore_db.py a1b2c3d4e5f60718      # by schema hash (first match)
    python restore_db.py cull_v8               # by tag (most recent match)
    python restore_db.py --list                # just list snapshots, no restore

Safety: takes a snapshot of the CURRENT db (tag=pre_restore) before
overwriting, so a bad restore is itself reversible.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import sys, shutil, gzip
from pathlib import Path
from db_safety import list_snapshots, snapshot, SnapshotInfo


def _resolve(selector: str, snaps: list[SnapshotInfo]) -> SnapshotInfo | None:
    if not snaps:
        return None
    if selector == 'latest':
        return snaps[0]
    # timestamp prefix
    for s in snaps:
        if s.timestamp.strftime('%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S').startswith(selector):
            return s
    # schema hash
    for s in snaps:
        if s.schema_hash == selector:
            return s
    # tag (most recent match - snaps already sorted desc by ts)
    for s in snaps:
        if s.tag == selector:
            return s
    # substring on filename, last resort
    for s in snaps:
        if selector in s.path.name:
            return s
    return None


def _print_list(snaps: list[SnapshotInfo]) -> None:
    if not snaps:
        print("(no snapshots)")
        return
    print(f"{'#':>3}  {'when':<19}  {'tag':<24}  {'schema':<16}  {'size':>8}")
    for i, s in enumerate(snaps):
        print(f"{i:>3}  {s.timestamp:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}  {s.tag:<24}  "
              f"{s.schema_hash:<16}  {s.size_bytes/1024:>6.0f} KB")


def restore(snap: SnapshotInfo, db_path: Path = Path('pokemon.db')) -> None:
    if db_path.exists():
        print(f"snapshotting current {db_path.name} before restore...")
        snapshot('pre_restore', db_path)
    tmp = db_path.with_suffix(db_path.suffix + '.restoring')
    with gzip.open(snap.path, 'rb') as fi, open(tmp, 'wb') as fo:
        shutil.copyfileobj(fi, fo)
    # atomic swap
    import os
    os.replace(tmp, db_path)
    print(f"restored {snap.path.name} -> {db_path.name}")


def main() -> int:
    snaps = list_snapshots()
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if args and args[0] in ('--list', '-l', 'list'):
        _print_list(snaps)
        return 0
    if not args:
        _print_list(snaps)
        if not snaps:
            return 1
        sel = input("\nselect by index, tag, or timestamp (empty=cancel): ").strip()
        if not sel:
            print("cancelled")
            return 0
        if sel.isdigit() and int(sel) < len(snaps):
            target = snaps[int(sel)]
        else:
            target = _resolve(sel, snaps)
    else:
        target = _resolve(args[0], snaps)
    if not target:
        print(f"no snapshot matched {args[0] if args else ''!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    print(f"about to restore: {target.path.name}")
    print(f"  taken {target.timestamp:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}  tag={target.tag}  schema={target.schema_hash}")
    confirm = input("type 'yes' to proceed: ").strip().lower()
    if confirm != 'yes':
        print("cancelled")
        return 0
    restore(target)
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

```

`pogo_extract/robust_tag.py`:

"""Self-healing tag driver. Survives PoGo PID drift / session death by reconnecting
and resuming from server-confirmed state. Idempotent.

Usage: python robust_tag.py
  - Ensures 'Legacy' tag exists, tags all legacy_accurate.json members
  - Pulls legacy + regional_pull_uids.json members out of REVIEW
Every operation re-verifies against live server state, so re-running is safe.

def adb(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['adb','-s',ADB,*args], capture_output=True, text=True)

def connect():
    subprocess.run(['adb','connect',ADB], capture_output=True)
    adb('forward','tcp:27047','tcp:27047')
    pid = int(adb('shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo').stdout.strip())
    dev = frida.get_device_manager().add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:27047')

  return {found:f};

def new_script(sess):
    sc = sess.create_script(DRIVER_JS + "\n" + SCAN_JS)
    sc.load()
    sc.exports_sync.init_status()
    return sc

def uid_to_str(u):
    u = int(u); return str(u if u >= 0 else u + 2**64)

c = sqlite3.connect('pokemon.db').cursor()
legacy = json.load(open('legacy_accurate.json'))
legacy_uids = [it['uid_hex'] for it in legacy]
regional_pull = json.load(open('regional_pull_uids.json'))
uid_hex_to_dec = {}
for uh in set(legacy_uids) | set(regional_pull):
    row = c.execute("SELECT uid FROM pokemon WHERE uid_hex=?", (uh,)).fetchone()
    if row: uid_hex_to_dec[uh] = uid_to_str(row[0])

def run():
    attempt = 0
    while attempt < 12:
        attempt += 1
        try:
            sess, pid = connect()
            print(f"[attempt {attempt}] attached PID={pid}")
            sc = new_script(sess)
            sb = sc.exports_sync.scan_svc_bag()
            SVC, BAG = sb['svc'], sb['bag']
            print(f"  svc={SVC} ({sb['svcTags']} tags) bag={BAG} ({sb['bagCount']})")
            if not SVC or not BAG: raise RuntimeError("svc/bag not found")

            # ensure Legacy tag
            ft = sc.exports_sync.find_tag_id_by_name(SVC, 'Legacy')
            if not ft.get('ok'):
                sc.exports_sync.add_tag_on_instance(SVC, 'Legacy', 5); time.sleep(1.5)
                ft = sc.exports_sync.find_tag_id_by_name(SVC, 'Legacy')
            print(f"  Legacy idx={ft.get('idx')}")

            # resolve protos for all needed uids
            dec_list = list(uid_hex_to_dec.values())
            fr = sc.exports_sync.find_protos(BAG, dec_list)
            found = fr['found']  # dec -> proto
            print(f"  resolved {len(found)}/{len(dec_list)} protos")

            # which legacy are NOT yet tagged Legacy (server-confirmed via auth_tag_names is stale; just tag all, idempotent)
            leg_protos = [found[uid_hex_to_dec[uh]] for uh in legacy_uids if uid_hex_to_dec.get(uh) in found]
            sc.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ft['tagProtoAddr'], leg_protos[:1]); time.sleep(0.6)  # warm-up
            built = 0
            for i in range(0, len(leg_protos), 30):
                rr = sc.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ft['tagProtoAddr'], leg_protos[i:i+30])
                built += rr.get('built', 0); time.sleep(0.25)
            chk = sc.exports_sync.get_pokemon_for_tag(SVC, ft['idx'])
            leg_count = chk.get('dump',{}).get('+0x18_listish',{}).get('count','?')
            print(f"  Legacy tagged built={built}, server count={leg_count}")

            # pull legacy + regional from REVIEW
            ftr = sc.exports_sync.find_tag_id_by_name(SVC, 'REVIEW')
            pull = set(legacy_uids) | set(regional_pull)
            pulled = 0
            for uh in pull:
                dec = uid_hex_to_dec.get(uh)
                if dec not in found: continue
                try:
                    rr = sc.exports_sync.bulk_untag_one(SVC, found[dec], ftr['tagProtoAddr'])
                    if rr.get('ok'): pulled += 1
                except: pass
            chk2 = sc.exports_sync.get_pokemon_for_tag(SVC, ftr['idx'])
            rev_count = chk2.get('dump',{}).get('+0x18_listish',{}).get('count','?')
            print(f"  pulled from REVIEW attempts done, server REVIEW count={rev_count}")
            print(f"DONE. Legacy={leg_count} REVIEW={rev_count}")
            sess.detach()
            return True
        except (frida.InvalidOperationError, frida.TransportError, frida.ProcessNotFoundError, frida.ServerNotRunningError, RuntimeError) as e:
            print(f"  [attempt {attempt}] disconnect: {type(e).__name__}: {e}; reconnecting...")
            time.sleep(4)
    print("FAILED after retries")
    return False

run()

`pogo_extract/run_capture.py`:

```py
"""
Frida-based SSL capture for Pokemon GO inventory extraction.
Attaches to the running PoGO process, hooks SSL_read, captures large responses.
"""
import frida
import sys
import time
import os

FRIDA_HOST = "127.0.0.1:31337"
POGO_PID = 25460
SCRIPT_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "ssl_dump.js")
CAPTURE_DURATION = 60  # seconds to capture

captures = []
total_bytes = 0

def on_message(message, data):
    global total_bytes
    if message['type'] == 'send':
        payload = message['payload']
        if payload['type'] == 'info':
            print(f"[*] {payload['msg']}")
        elif payload['type'] == 'error':
            print(f"[!] {payload['msg']}")
        elif payload['type'] == 'capture':
            captures.append(payload)
            print(f"[+] CAPTURED: {payload['file']} ({payload['size']} bytes)")
        elif payload['type'] == 'write':
            pass  # SSL_write notifications (request sizes)
    elif message['type'] == 'error':
        print(f"[!] Script error: {message.get('description', message)}")

def main():
    print(f"Connecting to frida-server at {FRIDA_HOST}...")
    device = frida.get_device_manager().add_remote_device(FRIDA_HOST)

    print(f"Attaching to PID {POGO_PID} (Pokemon GO)...")
    session = device.attach(POGO_PID)

    print("Loading SSL hook script...")
    with open(SCRIPT_PATH, "r") as f:
        script_source = f.read()

    script = session.create_script(script_source)
    script.on('message', on_message)
    script.load()

    print()
    print("=" * 60)
    print("  HOOK ACTIVE - SSL_read is being monitored")
    print("  ")
    print("  NOW: Open your Pokemon storage in Pokemon GO")
    print("       (tap the Pokeball > Pokemon)")
    print("  ")
    print(f"  Capturing for {CAPTURE_DURATION} seconds...")
    print("=" * 60)
    print()

    try:
        for i in range(CAPTURE_DURATION):
            time.sleep(1)
            if i > 0 and i % 10 == 0:
                status = script.exports_sync.status()
                print(f"  [{i}s] bytes_read={status['totalBytesRead']}, captures={status['captureCount']}, sessions={status['activeSessions']}")
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nInterrupted by user.")

    print("\nStopping capture...")
    result = script.exports_sync.stop()
    print(f"Result: {result}")

    print(f"\nTotal captures: {len(captures)}")
    for c in captures:
        print(f"  {c['file']} - {c['size']} bytes")

    session.detach()
    print("\nDone. Pull captures with: adb pull /sdcard/pogo_capture/")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

`pogo_extract/run_full_inventory.py`:

```py
"""Get the COMPLETE pokemon inventory via PokemonBagImpl.get_AllPokemon."""
import frida, json, time, subprocess

adb_pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['adb','-s','100.98.158.56:5555','shell','pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo']).decode().strip())
print(f"PoGo PID: {adb_pid}")

sess = d.attach(adb_pid)
script = sess.create_script(open("full_inventory.js","r",encoding="utf-8").read())

captured_msgs = []
def on(m, data):
    p = m.get("payload",{})
    if isinstance(p,dict):
        msg = p.get("msg","")
        captured_msgs.append(msg)
        if "captured bag" in msg or "captured" in msg:
            print(f"  [hook] {msg}")
script.on("message", on)
script.load()
print(script.exports_sync.init_status())

# First try heap scan for bag instance
print("\nHeap scan for PokemonBagImpl...")
sr = script.exports_sync.scan_for_bag_instance()
print(f"  hits: {sr.get('hits')}")

# Hook bag methods
print("\nInstalling hooks on PokemonBagImpl...")
hr = script.exports_sync.hook_for_bag_instance()
print(f"  hooked {hr.get('hookedCount')} methods")

print(">>> Interact with PoGo (open inventory, scroll, anything) - waiting up to 60s for hook to fire...")
bag_inst = None
for i in range(60):
    time.sleep(1)
    bi = script.exports_sync.get_bag_instance()
    if bi.get("bag"):
        bag_inst = bi["bag"]
        break

# Fallback: try heap-scan hits directly
if not bag_inst:
    print("\nHook didn't fire, trying heap-scan candidates...")
    for cand in sr.get('hits', []):
        print(f"  trying {cand}")
        script.exports_sync.set_bag_instance(cand)
        try:
            r = script.exports_sync.get_all_pokemon(cand)
            if r.get("ok") and r.get("listSize") and r["listSize"] > 1000:
                print(f"  CANDIDATE WORKS: count={r.get('count')} listSize={r['listSize']}")
                bag_inst = cand
                break
            else:
                print(f"    no: {r}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"    exc: {e}")

if not bag_inst:
    print("FAILED to get bag instance")
    sess.detach()
    exit(1)

print(f"\nUsing bag instance: {bag_inst}")
r = script.exports_sync.get_all_pokemon(bag_inst)
print(f"Result: count={r.get('count')} listSize={r.get('listSize')}")
print(f"Layout tried: {json.dumps(r.get('layoutTried'), indent=2)}")

if not r.get("listSize") or r["listSize"] < 100:
    print("Bag list is too small or wrong layout")
    sess.detach()
    exit(1)

# Find the right offsets
size_off = 0x18; items_off = 0x10
for trial in r.get('layoutTried', []):
    if trial.get('sz', 0) > 1000:
        size_off = trial['tr']['sizeOff']
        items_off = trial['tr']['itemsOff']
        break

print(f"\nUsing size_off=0x{size_off:x}, items_off=0x{items_off:x}")
print("Dumping all proto pointers...")
dr = script.exports_sync.dump_all_proto_ptrs(bag_inst, size_off, items_off, 0x20)
if not dr.get("ok"):
    print(f"FAILED: {dr}")
    sess.detach()
    exit(1)
print(f"Got {dr.get('count')} proto pointers")

ptrs = dr["ptrs"]
print(f"\nReading proto data in batches of 500...")
all_results = {}
for i in range(0, len(ptrs), 500):
    chunk = ptrs[i:i+500]
    rb = script.exports_sync.read_proto_batch(chunk)
    if rb.get("ok"):
        all_results.update(rb["results"])
        print(f"  batch {i//500+1}: {len(rb['results'])} entries (total: {len(all_results)})")
    else:
        print(f"  batch {i//500+1} FAILED")

print(f"\nTotal pokemon read: {len(all_results)}")

# Save
with open("full_inventory.json","w") as f:
    json.dump({"count": len(all_results), "results": all_results}, f)
print("Saved full_inventory.json")

sess.detach()

`pogo_extract/run_nickname_search.py`:

```py
"""Run nickname_search.js against PoGo and save results."""
import frida
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time

results = {"class_matches": [], "method_matches": [], "status": [], "img_done": [], "errors": []}
done = False


def get_pogo_pid():
    r = subprocess.run(
        ["adb", "shell", "su", "-c", "pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo"],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    s = r.stdout.strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    return int(s.split()[0])


def unfreeze_pogo(pid):
    path = f"/sys/fs/cgroup/apps/uid_10468/pid_{pid}/cgroup.freeze"
    subprocess.run(["adb", "shell", "su", "-c", f"echo 0 > {path}"], capture_output=True)

def on_message(message, data):
    global done
    if message.get("type") == "send":
        payload = message["payload"]
        ptype = payload.get("type")
        if ptype == "status":
            print("[STATUS]", payload.get("msg"))
            results["status"].append(payload.get("msg"))
        elif ptype == "img_done":
            results["img_done"].append(payload)
            if payload.get("classMatches", 0) > 0 or payload.get("methodMatches", 0) > 0 or payload["idx"] % 10 == 0:
                print(f"[IMG {payload['idx']}/{payload['total']}] {payload['name']} cls={payload['classes']} cm={payload['classMatches']} mm={payload['methodMatches']}")
        elif ptype == "img_err":
            print(f"[IMG-ERR] {payload['name']}: {payload['err']}")
            results["errors"].append(payload)
        elif ptype == "class_matches":
            results["class_matches"] = payload.get("data", [])
            print(f"[CLASSES] {len(results['class_matches'])} matched")
        elif ptype == "method_matches":
            results["method_matches"] = payload.get("data", [])
            print(f"[METHODS] {len(results['method_matches'])} matched")
        elif ptype == "done":
            print("[DONE]", payload.get("msg"))
            done = True
        elif ptype == "error":
            print("[ERR]", payload.get("msg"))
            results["errors"].append(payload.get("msg"))
    elif message.get("type") == "error":
        print("[FRIDA-ERR]", message.get("description"))
        results["errors"].append(message.get("description"))


def main():
    # Use the remote device (forwarded via adb) to match the existing pipeline.
    mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
    try:
        d = mgr.add_remote_device("127.0.0.1:31337")
    except Exception:
        d = frida.get_usb_device(timeout=30)
    print(f"Device: {d.name}")

    pid = get_pogo_pid()
    if pid is None:
        raise RuntimeError("PoGo not running")
    print(f"PoGo PID: {pid}")
    unfreeze_pogo(pid)

    last_err = None
    for attempt in range(5):
        try:
            unfreeze_pogo(pid)
            session = d.attach(pid)
            print(f"Attached to PID {pid} (attempt {attempt+1})")
            break
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = e
            print(f"attach attempt {attempt+1} failed: {e}; retry in 3s")
            time.sleep(3)
    else:
        raise last_err

    with open("nickname_search.js", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        src = f.read()

    script = session.create_script(src)
    script.on("message", on_message)
    script.load()

    timeout = 180
    waited = 0
    while not done and waited < timeout:
        time.sleep(1)
        waited += 1
        # Re-unfreeze every 2s to keep the process running
        if waited % 2 == 0:
            unfreeze_pogo(pid)

    with open("nickname_search_results.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    print(f"Saved nickname_search_results.json: {len(results['class_matches'])} classes, {len(results['method_matches'])} methods")
    session.detach()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

`pogo_extract/run_rename_attach.py`:

```py
"""Attach to currently-running PoGo (already injected by Pokemod) and rename a ditto.

Prerequisites: user manually launched Pokemod -> tapped Start Service ->
got into game -> opened Pokemon storage so heap is populated.
"""
import frida, json, subprocess, sys, time

UID_TEST = 0x31c43fb6a058ea49  # CP 500 ditto, 28.9% IV
NICK_TEST = "TEST_RENAME"

def log(msg):
    print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] {msg}", flush=True)

def get_pid():
    r = subprocess.run(['adb','shell','pidof','com.nianticlabs.pokemongo'],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    s = r.stdout.strip()
    return int(s.split()[0]) if s else None

def on_msg(message, data):
    if message.get("type") == "send":
        p = message["payload"]
        log(f"  [JS {p.get('type','msg').upper()}] {str(p.get('msg', json.dumps(p)))[:400]}")
    elif message.get("type") == "error":
        log(f"  [FRIDA-ERR] {message.get('description')}")

def main():
    pid = get_pid()
    if not pid:
        log("PoGo not running. Open Pokemod and tap Start Service first.")
        return
    log(f"PoGo PID: {pid}")

    subprocess.run(['adb','forward','tcp:27042','tcp:27042'], capture_output=True, timeout=5)
    time.sleep(0.5)

    mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
    try:
        dev = mgr.add_remote_device("127.0.0.1:27042")
        log("Using remote device 127.0.0.1:27042")
    except Exception:
        dev = frida.get_usb_device(timeout=10)
        log(f"Using USB device: {dev.name}")

    session = None
    for attempt in range(15):
        cur = get_pid()
        if not cur:
            time.sleep(0.5); continue
        try:
            session = dev.attach(cur)
            log(f"Attached PID={cur} (attempt {attempt+1})")
            pid = cur
            break
        except Exception as e:
            if attempt % 3 == 0:
                log(f"  attempt {attempt+1} (pid={cur}): {e}")
            time.sleep(1)
    if not session:
        log("ERROR: Could not attach"); return

    log("Loading rename_pokemon.js...")
    src = open("rename_pokemon.js","r",encoding="utf-8").read()
    script = session.create_script(src)
    script.on("message", on_msg)
    script.load()
    log("Script loaded")

    # Probe init status
    log("Probing init...")
    for i in range(20):
        st = script.exports_sync.init_status()
        log(f"  init: {st}")
        if st.get("ready"): break
        time.sleep(2)

    # Probe heap
    log("Probing heap...")
    last = -1
    for i in range(8):
        r = script.exports_sync.count_pokemon()
        n = r.get("count", 0) if isinstance(r, dict) else 0
        log(f"  PokemonProtos: {n}")
        if n > 1000 and n == last: break
        last = n
        time.sleep(3)

    uid = UID_TEST; nick = NICK_TEST
    low = uid & 0xFFFFFFFF
    high = (uid >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    if low > 0x7FFFFFFF: low -= 0x100000000
    if high > 0x7FFFFFFF: high -= 0x100000000
    log(f"\n=== Rename uid 0x{uid:016x} -> {nick!r} ===")
    result = script.exports_sync.rename(low, high, nick)
    log(f"RESULT: {json.dumps(result, indent=2)}")

    log("\nKeeping session 15s for promise to resolve...")
    time.sleep(15)
    try: session.detach()
    except: pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

`pogo_extract/run_script.py`:

```py
"""Generic runner: attach to PoGO and run a JS script."""
import frida, sys, json, threading

import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['adb', '-s', '100.98.158.56:5555', 'shell', 'su -c "pidof com.nianticlabs.pokemongo"'],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
POGO_PID = int(result.stdout.strip().split()[0])
print(f"PoGO PID: {POGO_PID}")

results = []
done = threading.Event()

def on_message(msg, data):
    if msg['type'] == 'send':
        p = msg['payload']
        if isinstance(p, dict):
            t = p.get('type','')
            if t == 'error':
                print(f"  [ERROR] {p['msg']}")
            elif t == 'done':
                print(f"  [DONE] {p.get('msg','')}")
                done.set()
            elif t == 'pokemon_data':
                print(f"  [pokemon_data] Got {p.get('count', 0)} pokemon!")
                # Save pokemon data immediately
                with open('pokemon_dump.json', 'w') as pf:
                    json.dump(p.get('data', []), pf, indent=2)
                print(f"  Saved to pokemon_dump.json")
            elif t == 'progress':
                print(f"  [progress] {p.get('count', 0)}/{p.get('total', '?')}")
            else:
                content = p.get('msg', p.get('data', p))
                if isinstance(content, (dict, list)):
                    print(f"  [{t}] {json.dumps(content, indent=2)[:2000]}")
                else:
                    print(f"  [{t}] {content}")
            results.append(p)
        else:
            print(f"  {p}")
    elif msg['type'] == 'error':
        print(f"  [SCRIPT ERROR] {msg.get('description','?')}")
        if 'stack' in msg:
            print(f"  {msg['stack'][:500]}")

script_file = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'il2cpp_find_bag.js'
print(f"Loading {script_file}...")

mgr = frida.get_device_manager()
dev = mgr.add_remote_device('127.0.0.1:31337')
session = dev.attach(POGO_PID)

with open(script_file) as f:
    source = f.read()

script = session.create_script(source)
script.on('message', on_message)
script.load()
print("Running...")

timeout = 120 if 'extract_full' in script_file else 60
done.wait(timeout=timeout)
if not done.is_set():
    print("  [TIMEOUT] Script did not signal completion")

with open(script_file.replace('.js', '_results.json'), 'w') as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2)

try:
    session.detach()
except:
    pass
print("Done.")

`pogo_extract/scan_heap_for_uids.py`:

```py
"""
Stream-scan PoGo memory for known pokemon UIDs.
Uses /proc/PID/mem via dd | gzip on the phone, scans on host.
"""
import os
import sys
import re
import struct
import pickle
import json
import subprocess
import argparse

PID = 11836
ADB = ["adb", "-s", "100.98.158.56:5555"]
WORKDIR = "/c/Users/Blanco/Desktop/Claude Operations/Phone Maintenance/pogo_extract"

def parse_maps(maps_text):
    """Yield (start, end, perms, name) for each region."""
    for line in maps_text.splitlines():
        parts = line.split(maxsplit=5)
        if len(parts) < 5:
            continue
        addr_range = parts[0]
        perms = parts[1]
        name = parts[5] if len(parts) > 5 else ""
        try:
            start_hex, end_hex = addr_range.split("-")
            start = int(start_hex, 16)
            end = int(end_hex, 16)
        except Exception:
            continue
        yield start, end, perms, name

def read_region(pid, start, length):
    """Read [start, start+length) from /proc/PID/mem via adb su dd."""
    blocks = (length + 4095) // 4096
    skip = start // 4096
    cmd = ADB + ["shell", f"su -c 'dd if=/proc/{pid}/mem bs=4096 skip={skip} count={blocks} 2>/dev/null | gzip -1'"]
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        return None
    import gzip, io
    try:
        data = gzip.decompress(p.stdout)
    except Exception as e:
        return None
    if len(data) < length:
        return data
    return data[:length]

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--maps", default=os.path.join(WORKDIR, "pogo_maps_current.txt"))
    ap.add_argument("--uids", default=os.path.join(WORKDIR, "uid_bytes.pkl"))
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=os.path.join(WORKDIR, "uid_hits_fresh.pkl"))
    ap.add_argument("--max-region", type=int, default=256*1024*1024)
    ap.add_argument("--min-region", type=int, default=4096)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    with open(args.uids, "rb") as f:
        d = pickle.load(f)
    uid_bytes = d["uid_bytes"]
    uid_to_uid = d["uid_to_uid"]
    print(f"Loaded {len(uid_bytes)} UID byte patterns")

    with open(args.maps) as f:
        maps_text = f.read()

    regions = []
    for start, end, perms, name in parse_maps(maps_text):
        if "rw" not in perms:
            continue
        # Skip libil2cpp.so writable section (no UID data there)
        if "libil2cpp" in name or "/" in name:
            continue
        if "[" in name:
            # skip [stack], [heap], [vvar], etc - keep [anon] though, but here unnamed-only
            continue
        size = end - start
        if size < args.min_region or size > args.max_region:
            continue
        regions.append((start, end, size, name))

    regions.sort(key=lambda r: r[2], reverse=True)
    total = sum(r[2] for r in regions)
    print(f"Will scan {len(regions)} regions, total {total/1048576:.1f} MB")

    hits = []  # list of (region_start, offset, uid, value_at_offset)
    for ridx, (start, end, size, name) in enumerate(regions):
        sys.stdout.write(f"[{ridx+1}/{len(regions)}] 0x{start:x}-0x{end:x} ({size/1048576:.1f}MB) ")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        # Read in 4MB chunks to avoid memory pressure
        chunk_size = 4 * 1024 * 1024
        offset = 0
        region_hits = 0
        while offset < size:
            this_size = min(chunk_size, size - offset)
            data = read_region(PID, start + offset, this_size)
            if data is None:
                sys.stdout.write("X")
                sys.stdout.flush()
                offset += this_size
                continue
            # Scan 8-byte aligned positions for UID match
            for i in range(0, len(data) - 7, 8):
                w = data[i:i+8]
                if w in uid_bytes:
                    uid = uid_to_uid[w]
                    # Capture surrounding 64 bytes for context
                    ctx_start = max(0, i - 16)
                    ctx_end = min(len(data), i + 48)
                    ctx = data[ctx_start:ctx_end]
                    abs_addr = start + offset + i
                    hits.append({
                        "region_start": start,
                        "abs_addr": abs_addr,
                        "uid": uid,
                        "ctx": ctx.hex(),
                        "ctx_offset": i - ctx_start,
                    })
                    region_hits += 1
            offset += this_size
            sys.stdout.write(".")
            sys.stdout.flush()
        sys.stdout.write(f" {region_hits} hits\n")

        # checkpoint
        if (ridx+1) % 10 == 0:
            with open(args.out, "wb") as f:
                pickle.dump(hits, f)

    with open(args.out, "wb") as f:
        pickle.dump(hits, f)
    print(f"Total hits: {len(hits)}")
    # Distinct UIDs
    distinct = set(h["uid"] for h in hits)
    print(f"Distinct UIDs hit: {len(distinct)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`pogo_extract/scan_offsets.py`:

```py
"""Comprehensive offset analysis on pokemon_v3.json - find candidate fields."""
import json, struct, math
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

POGO_LAUNCH_MS = 1467590400000  # 2016-07-06
NOW_MS = 1746662400000  # ~2025

KNOWN = {32, 36, 40, 44, 48, 52, 56, 60, 92, 104, 108, 112, 116, 120, 124, 128, 132,
         136, 140, 144, 160, 164, 168, 172, 224, 248, 252, 264, 268, 272, 276,
         440, 480, 496}
# also string pointers at: 0x40=64, 0xb8=184, 0x100=256, 0x130=304, 0x168=360, 0x180=384

print('Loading pokemon_v3.json...')
data = json.load(open('pokemon_v3.json'))
print(f'Loaded {len(data)} pokemon')

# Build raw_proto bytes list
protos = []
for p in data:
    raw = p.get('raw_proto', '')
    if len(raw) < 1000: continue  # 512 bytes hex = 1024 chars
    protos.append(bytes.fromhex(raw))
print(f'Valid protos: {len(protos)}')

PROTO_LEN = 512

# For each 4-byte offset, gather stats
print('\n=== Per-offset 4-byte analysis ===')
print('off |  nzcnt | distinct |       min      max | floats? | tstamp? | sample')

results = []
for off in range(0, PROTO_LEN, 4):
    int_vals = []
    float_vals = []
    nz = 0
    distinct = set()
    for bs in protos:
        if off + 4 > len(bs): continue
        i = struct.unpack_from('<i', bs, off)[0]
        f = struct.unpack_from('<f', bs, off)[0]
        int_vals.append(i)
        float_vals.append(f)
        if i != 0: nz += 1
        distinct.add(i)
    if nz == 0: continue

    nzint = [v for v in int_vals if v != 0]
    minv, maxv = min(nzint), max(nzint)

    # Float plausibility: all non-zero values look like reasonable floats?
    nzfloat = [f for i, f in zip(int_vals, float_vals) if i != 0]
    plausible_float = 0
    for f in nzfloat:
        if math.isnan(f) or math.isinf(f): continue
        if 0.001 <= abs(f) <= 1e6:
            plausible_float += 1
    float_pct = plausible_float / len(nzfloat) if nzfloat else 0

    # Timestamp plausibility: int64 at this offset OR int32 millis since launch?
    # Also check int64 at this offset

    samples = sorted(distinct - {0})[:5]
    floats_sample = sorted([round(f, 3) for f in set(float_vals) if f != 0 and not math.isnan(f) and not math.isinf(f)])[:5]

    results.append({
        'off': off,
        'nz': nz,
        'distinct': len(distinct),
        'min': minv,
        'max': maxv,
        'float_pct': float_pct,
        'samples': samples,
        'floats': floats_sample,
    })

    flag = '*' if off in KNOWN else ' '
    print(f'{flag}{off:3d} | {nz:6d} | {len(distinct):8d} | {minv:10d} {maxv:10d} | {float_pct*100:5.1f}% | {samples[:3]} | floats: {floats_sample[:3]}')

# Now i64 offsets
print('\n=== Per-offset 8-byte (int64) analysis ===')
i64_results = []
for off in range(0, PROTO_LEN, 4):
    if off + 8 > PROTO_LEN: break
    i64_vals = []
    nz = 0
    distinct = set()
    for bs in protos:
        if off + 8 > len(bs): continue
        v = struct.unpack_from('<q', bs, off)[0]
        i64_vals.append(v)
        if v != 0: nz += 1
        distinct.add(v)
    if nz == 0: continue

    nzv = [v for v in i64_vals if v != 0]
    minv, maxv = min(nzv), max(nzv)

    # Timestamp candidates
    ts_count = sum(1 for v in nzv if POGO_LAUNCH_MS <= v <= NOW_MS)

    samples = sorted(distinct - {0})[:3]

    if ts_count > 5 or len(distinct) > 10:
        flag = '*' if off in KNOWN else ' '
        print(f'{flag}+{off:3d} | nz={nz:5d} | distinct={len(distinct):6d} | ts_match={ts_count:5d} | min/max={minv}/{maxv}')
        if ts_count > 5:
            print(f'        samples: {samples}')

# String offsets
print('\n=== String pointer scanner: any offset that holds 0x70..-aligned ptr ===')
# String pointers are 8-byte aligned and look like 0x7xxxxxxxxx
ptr_offset_counts = defaultdict(int)
for bs in protos:
    for off in range(0, len(bs), 8):
        if off + 8 > len(bs): break
        v = struct.unpack_from('<Q', bs, off)[0]
        # Heuristic: pointer in lib region (top byte 0x7b or 0x7c or 0x7d or 0x7e or 0x7f)
        if 0x700000000000 <= v <= 0x800000000000:
            ptr_offset_counts[off] += 1
print('Offsets where pointer-like values appear most often:')
for off, cnt in sorted(ptr_offset_counts.items()):
    if cnt > 100:
        print(f'  +{off}: {cnt} pointer-like values')

```

`pogo_extract/scan_uid_streaming.py`:

```py
"""Stream from adb shell dd and search for known UID patterns to locate klass pointer."""
import subprocess, struct, sys, os, re

KNOWN_UIDS = {
    -6689107601798619759: 'Growlithe',
    2614813629814984889: 'Corsola',
    4844408966494081688: 'Xerneas',
    5263403840049189255: 'Geodude',
    -7232814157734274823: 'Zapdos'
}
UID_PATTERNS = {struct.pack('<q', uid): name for uid, name in KNOWN_UIDS.items()}

PID = sys.argv[1]
ADB = ['adb', '-s', '100.98.158.56:5555']

# Read maps
maps_text = subprocess.check_output(ADB + ['shell', f'su -c "cat /proc/{PID}/maps"'], text=True)
candidates = []
for line in maps_text.splitlines():
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) < 5: continue
    if 'rw-p' not in parts[1]: continue
    sm = parts[0].split('-')
    start = int(sm[0], 16); end = int(sm[1], 16)
    if start < 0x6000000000 or start > 0x8000000000: continue
    size = end - start
    if size < 0x1000: continue
    rest = ' '.join(parts[5:]) if len(parts) > 5 else ''
    if 'dalvik' in rest or 'stack' in rest: continue
    if rest.startswith('/'): continue
    candidates.append((start, end, rest))

# Sort: try ones near 0x737f and 0x74f first (where prior anchors lived)
def priority(c):
    s = c[0]
    if 0x737f000000 <= s < 0x7380000000: return 0
    if 0x74f0000000 <= s < 0x74f4000000: return 1
    if 0x73000000 <= s < 0x76000000: return 2
    return 3
candidates.sort(key=priority)

print(f'Scanning {len(candidates)} regions, {sum(e-s for s,e,_ in candidates)/1024/1024:.1f} MB total', flush=True)

found = {}
for i, (start, end, label) in enumerate(candidates):
    size = end - start
    # Stream the region
    cmd = ADB + ['shell', f'su -c "dd if=/proc/{PID}/mem bs=4096 skip={start//4096} count={size//4096} status=none 2>/dev/null"']
    try:
        data = subprocess.check_output(cmd, timeout=120)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'  [{i}/{len(candidates)}] {hex(start)} ERR: {e}', flush=True)
        continue
    if len(data) < 32:
        continue
    region_hits = 0
    for pat, name in UID_PATTERNS.items():
        idx = 0
        while True:
            x = data.find(pat, idx)
            if x < 0: break
            if x >= 0x10:
                bind_off = x - 0x10
                klass = struct.unpack_from('<Q', data, bind_off)[0]
                tag_id = struct.unpack_from('<i', data, bind_off + 0x18)[0]
                if 0x6000000000 < klass < 0x8000000000 and 0 <= tag_id <= 30:
                    addr = start + bind_off
                    key = (name, klass, tag_id)
                    if key not in found:
                        found[key] = addr
                        print(f'  HIT {name} addr=0x{addr:x} klass=0x{klass:x} tag={tag_id}', flush=True)
                        region_hits += 1
            idx = x + 1
    if region_hits or i % 50 == 0:
        print(f'  [{i+1}/{len(candidates)}] {hex(start)} ({size/1024/1024:.2f} MB) hits={region_hits}', flush=True)
    # Stop early if we have multiple hits
    if len(found) >= 5:
        print('Found enough samples to determine klass; stopping early', flush=True)
        break

print('\n=== Results ===')
from collections import Counter
klass_counter = Counter(k[1] for k in found.keys())
for k, c in klass_counter.most_common(5):
    print(f'klass=0x{k:x}: {c} bindings')

```

`pogo_extract/script_review.md`:

```md
# Script Review: cull_v9 / pogo_pipeline / audit_all_tags / reconcile_from_drift

Reviewed: 2026-05-21. DB queries used to confirm each finding is real, not speculative.

---

## CRITICAL

### C1 - cull_v9.py:151-159: xxl_top3 uses top-3 weight only; spec requires top-2-weight UNION top-2-height

**File/line:** `cull_v9.py`, `build_ctx()`, lines 151-159 (the xxl_groups loop).

**Problem:** The `xxl_top3_uids` bucket sorts by `-weight_kg` and takes `lst[:3]`. Height is never considered. The spec (and `audit_all_tags.py` `rule_jumbo`) define JUMBO as top-2-weight UNION top-2-height per `(pokemon_id, form, fresh_costume)` bucket.

**Why it is wrong:** Two divergences from spec:
1. cull uses N=3 (heaviest) but spec says N=2 for weight.
2. cull does not include the top-2-tallest dimension at all.

**DB confirmation:** In the bucket `(710, 2644, 0)` (Pumpkaboo XXL, 5 pokemon):
- Heaviest three: `70dfce9b` (17.48 kg), `28146ba5` (15.43 kg), `1e10371a` (15.21 kg).
- Tallest two: `5a8d0b0f` (0.783 m), `70dfce9b` (0.774 m).
- Spec JUMBO set: `{70dfce9b, 28146ba5, 5a8d0b0f}` (union of top-2w and top-2h).
- cull xxl_top3 set: `{70dfce9b, 28146ba5, 1e10371a}` (top-3 weight only).
- `1e10371a` is wrongly protected (3rd heaviest, not tall); `5a8d0b0f` is wrongly unprotected (2nd tallest, not in weight-top-3).
- Same pattern confirmed in Gourgeist `(711, 2648, 0)`: `6abb2d6b` (33.25 kg, 1.557 m) is cull-protected but not JUMBO-spec; the 2nd-tallest is already covered by weight-top-2 there.
- Currently `5a8d0b0f` (Pumpkaboo) is saved by `user_tag_JUMBO` and `preevo_top2_rank2`, so no wrong transfer today. But if the JUMBO tag is removed by drift reconcile, only `preevo_top2_rank2` remains -- fragile.

**Fix in `cull_v9.py` `build_ctx()`:**
```python
# replace the xxl_top3 block with:
xxl_top2_weight_height = set()
for lst in xxl_groups.values():
    for p in sorted(lst, key=lambda x: -(x['weight_kg'] or 0))[:2]:
        xxl_top2_weight_height.add(p['uid_hex'])
    for p in sorted(lst, key=lambda x: -(x['height_m'] or 0))[:2]:
        xxl_top2_weight_height.add(p['uid_hex'])
ctx['xxl_top3_uids'] = xxl_top2_weight_height  # key name can stay for compat
```
Update the rule name/label from `xxl_top3_heaviest` to `jumbo_top2` for clarity.

---

## HIGH

### H1 - cull_v9.py: No NULL-rank protection rule; spec says NULLs must be treated as PROTECTED

**File/line:** `cull_v9.py`, `build_ctx()` `qualify()` function (lines 205-219), and `PROTECTION_RULES` (no rule covers this case).

**Problem:** When `compute_all_ranks.py` fails to produce rank data for a species (e.g., new form not yet in the ranker), all three rank columns (`gl_rank`, `ul_rank`, `ll_rank`) are NULL. The `qualify()` function correctly skips NULL-rank rows (`if r is None or r > 10: continue`), so these pokemon never enter `gl_qualify_uids` / `ul_qualify_uids`. No other rule catches them. They can be TRANSFERRED.

**Why it is wrong:** The spec states "NULLs must be treated as PROTECTED (never culled on missing data)." The intent is: if the ranker didn't run for a species, we must not assume it has no good PVP value.

**DB confirmation:** Flittle (pid=955, speciesId=`flittle`) has 3 in-bag instances, all with `gl_rank IS NULL`, `ul_rank IS NULL`, `ll_rank IS NULL`. One (`ea8ce6055b7a61d5`, iv_total=39, form=3268) has `cull_decision_v9='TRANSFER'` with reason `no_keep_rule`. The other two are saved only by `preevo_top2_rank1/2` (iv_total=41). The transferred one is rank 3 in the preevo bucket and has no other protection.

**Fix in `cull_v9.py`:** Add a rule (or a check inside the existing rank rules) that protects any pokemon where ALL three rank columns are NULL:
```python
Rule('null_rank_protection',
     lambda p, _: 'null_rank_uncomputed'
         if p['gl_rank'] is None and p['ul_rank'] is None and p['ll_rank'] is None else None,
     'gl_rank IS NULL AND ul_rank IS NULL AND ll_rank IS NULL'),
```
Insert this rule early in `PROTECTION_RULES` (before the `gl_pvp`/`ul_pvp` rules). Alternatively, scope it to species where at least one other in-bag member of the same `pokemon_id` HAS a rank (so it catches rank-compute failures, not legitimately unranked species). The broader blanket version is safer per spec.

---

## MEDIUM

### M1 - cull_v9.py:98 sanity SQL for user_tag is a string-equality check, not a tag-membership check

**File/line:** `cull_v9.py`, `PROTECTION_RULES`, `Rule('user_tag', ...)` sanity_sql (line 98).

**Problem:** The sanity SQL is:
```sql
auth_tag_names IS NOT NULL AND auth_tag_names NOT IN ('','CLAUDE_TX','Traded')
```
This checks if the raw `auth_tag_names` string is not one of three literal values. It does NOT handle multi-tag strings containing only excluded tags (e.g., `auth_tag_names='CLAUDE_TX;Traded'`). Such a string passes `NOT IN` (the combined string is not in the exclusion list), so the sanity check would report the pokemon as expected-to-be-protected -- but the rule correctly returns `None` (all tags are excluded), so the pokemon may be TRANSFER. This would cause a false sanity alarm.

**DB confirmation:** No pokemon currently has `auth_tag_names='CLAUDE_TX;Traded'` (verified by query), so this is latent. However there are 5 pokemon with `auth_tag_names='CLAUDE_TX'` that are correctly being transferred -- those are handled correctly because `'CLAUDE_TX' IN ('','CLAUDE_TX','Traded')`.

**Fix:** Replace the sanity SQL with a more accurate approximation, or just leave it as a known gap since it only generates false-positive sanity noise (never a wrong cull decision):
```python
# More precise: check that after removing excluded tags, something remains
"auth_tag_names IS NOT NULL AND auth_tag_names != '' "
"AND replace(replace(auth_tag_names,'CLAUDE_TX',''),'Traded','') != replace(auth_tag_names,'CLAUDE_TX;Traded','') "
```
Or simply widen the sanity SQL to exclude any row where all tags are in the excluded set (SQLite doesn't support this elegantly -- a comment noting the limitation is acceptable).

---

## LOW

### L1 - reconcile_from_drift.py:33-34: warm-up call overlaps with loop start; adds[0] is sent twice

**File/line:** `reconcile_from_drift.py`, lines 33-34.

**Problem:**
```python
bt.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ft['tagProtoAddr'], adds[:1]); time.sleep(0.5)   # warm-up: sends adds[0]
for i in range(0, len(adds), 60):                                                    # loop: sends adds[0..59] first
    bt.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ft['tagProtoAddr'], adds[i:i+60]); time.sleep(0.3)
```
`adds[0]` is tagged in the warm-up, then again in the first loop iteration (`adds[0:60]`). If `bulk_tag_many` is idempotent (adding to a set), this causes no incorrect result, but it is a logic error and adds an extra round-trip for every tag operation.

**Fix:**
```python
bt.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ft['tagProtoAddr'], adds[:1]); time.sleep(0.5)
for i in range(1, len(adds), 60):  # start at 1, not 0
    bt.exports_sync.bulk_tag_many(SVC, ft['tagProtoAddr'], adds[i:i+60]); time.sleep(0.3)
```

### L2 - audit_all_tags.py: rule_jumbo bucket key uses `p['form']` not `p['fresh_form']`; inconsistent with cull

**File/line:** `audit_all_tags.py`, `rule_jumbo()` line 35: `g[(p['pokemon_id'], p['form'] or 0, p['fresh_costume'] or 0)]`.

**Problem:** The bucket key mixes a persisted column (`form`) with a fresh column (`fresh_costume`). `cull_v9.build_ctx()` xxl_groups uses `p['form']` for form and `p['fresh_costume']` for costume (same as audit). However `form` vs `fresh_form` can differ if a form-change event happened between pipeline runs without a full reconcile -- both scripts use `p['form']` (not `p['fresh_form']`), so they are consistent with each other. This is only a concern if `form` and `fresh_form` diverge; in the current DB they are the same for all in-bag pokemon. Flag as low priority to align both scripts to use `fresh_form` for consistency with other fresh_* fields.

**DB check:** `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND form != fresh_form` returns 0. No current impact.

---

## Verified Correct

The following areas were audited and found correct:

- **GL/UL strict parameter:** `qualify(..., 1425, False)` correctly uses `>=` for GL; `qualify(..., 2425, True)` correctly uses `>` for UL.
- **NULL rank skip in qualify():** `if r is None or r > 10: continue` correctly excludes NULL-rank rows from PVP candidate sets. This is correct for the qualify function itself; the missing protection rule is a separate issue (H1 above).
- **Sort order (rank/pct tiebreak):** Both `cull_v9` and `audit_all_tags` sort by `(rank_col ASC, -pct_col DESC)` -- consistent, correct.
- **GL/UL qualify set identity:** cull and audit produce identical `gl_qualify_uids` / `ul_qualify_uids` sets (verified by set difference = empty on live DB).
- **has_tag parsing in audit_all_tags.py:** `name in [t for t in a.split(';') if t]` correctly handles semicolon-delimited tag strings including tags with spaces (e.g., `'From Ethan'`, `'Adventure Eff'`).
- **Tag drift direction:** `add = ruleset - srv` (missing from server, needs adding); `rem = srv - ruleset` (stale on server, needs removing). Correct.
- **uid_hex / uid conversion in reconcile:** `u + 2**64` for negative signed int correctly produces the unsigned 64-bit representation matching uid_hex. Verified against live data.
- **CP formula consistency:** Both scripts use `CPM_L50 = 0.84029999` and the identical formula. No divergence.
- **Pipeline step ordering:** tag refresh runs before cull, so `auth_tag_names` is populated before `cull_v9` reads it.
- **ll_rank threshold:** `_rank('ll_rank')` uses `PVP_RANK_KEEP = 15`; GL/UL `qualify()` uses hard-coded `10`. Correct per spec.

`pogo_extract/set_nicknames.py`:

```py
"""set_nicknames.py — bulk-SET custom nicknames to target values (the keep-codes).

Same PROVEN engine as clear_nicknames.py (class-PRIME + real nickname_ field reflection
+ fresh bag-walk each pass + read-back verify). Reads targets from keepcode_targets.json
([[uid_hex, nickname], ...]; empty nickname = clear to species). Loop-until-dry: each pass
re-walks, sets only mons whose CURRENT real nickname != target, until none mismatch.

Throttle handling: if a pass makes NO progress (sets didn't commit -> Niantic rename
throttle), it stops and tells you to restart PoGo and re-run (re-running auto-resumes,
since it only touches mismatches). Restarting PoGo resets the server throttle.

Usage:
  python set_nicknames.py                 # full run, delay 0.3, loop-until-dry
  python set_nicknames.py --delay 0.4 --max-pass 6
  python set_nicknames.py --limit 300     # cap writes this run
"""
import sys, os, json, time, argparse
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = HERE
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

EXTRA_JS = r"""
var _EXP=null, _SN=null;
function _exp(){ if(_EXP)return _EXP; _EXP={}; Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so').enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){if(e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0)_EXP[e.name]=e.address;}); return _EXP; }
function _strnew(s){ var e=_exp(); var f=new NativeFunction(e['il2cpp_string_new'],'pointer',['pointer']); return f(Memory.allocUtf8String(s)); }
function _imgByName(nm){ _ensureInit(); var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var asms=IL2.dGA(IL2.dG(),sp); var na=sp.readS32(); for(var a=0;a<na;a++){ var img=IL2.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if(IL2.iGN(img).readCString()===nm) return img; } return null; }
function _rdStr(p){ try{ if(!p||p.isNull())return ''; var len=p.add(0x10).readS32(); if(len<=0||len>64)return ''; var c=[]; for(var i=0;i<len;i++){ c.push(String.fromCharCode(p.add(0x14+i*2).readU16())); } return c.join(''); }catch(e){ return ''; } }

rpc.exports.findOffsets = function(protoStr){
  _ensureInit(); var e=_exp();
  var OGC=new NativeFunction(e['il2cpp_object_get_class'],'pointer',['pointer']);
  var CGN=new NativeFunction(e['il2cpp_class_get_name'],'pointer',['pointer']);
  var CGF=new NativeFunction(e['il2cpp_class_get_fields'],'pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
  var FGN=new NativeFunction(e['il2cpp_field_get_name'],'pointer',['pointer']);
  var FGO=new NativeFunction(e['il2cpp_field_get_offset'],'uint32',['pointer']);
  var p=ptr(protoStr); var cls=OGC(p);
  var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  var nickOff=-1, pidOff=-1, ooNickOff=-1;
  while((f=CGF(cls,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ var nm=FGN(f).readCString(); var off=FGO(f); var lo=nm.toLowerCase();
    if(lo==='nickname_'||lo==='nickname') nickOff=off;
    else if(lo==='originalownernickname_'||lo==='originalownernickname') ooNickOff=off;
    if(lo==='pokemonid_'||lo==='pokemonid') pidOff=off;
  }catch(er){} }
  return {cls:CGN(cls).readCString(), nickOff:nickOff, pidOff:pidOff, ooNickOff:ooNickOff};
};

rpc.exports.readNicks = function(arrJson, nickOff){
  var arr=JSON.parse(arrJson); var out=[];
  for(var i=0;i<arr.length;i++){ var p=ptr(arr[i]); out.push(_rdStr(p.add(nickOff).readPointer())); }
  return out;
};
rpc.exports.readOne = function(protoStr, nickOff){ return _rdStr(ptr(protoStr).add(nickOff).readPointer()); };

rpc.exports.prime = function(){
  _ensureInit(); var out=[];
  function pr(img, ns, cls){ try{ if(!img){out.push(ns+'.'+cls+' NOIMG'); return;} var k=IL2.cFN(img, Memory.allocUtf8String(ns), Memory.allocUtf8String(cls)); if(k&&!k.isNull()){ if(IL2.rcInit) IL2.rcInit(k); out.push(ns+'.'+cls+' OK'); } else out.push(ns+'.'+cls+' NOTFOUND'); }catch(er){ out.push(ns+'.'+cls+' threw '+er.message); } }
  var protos=_imgByName('holo-protos.dll');
  pr(GAME_IMAGE,'Niantic.Holoholo.Internal','PokemonBagImpl');
  pr(protos,'Holoholo.Rpc','NicknamePokemonProto');
  pr(protos,'Holoholo.Rpc','NicknamePokemonOutProto');
  return out;
};

// SET ONE nickname: bag.NicknamePokemon(proto, name)
//
// NOTE: NicknamePokemon returns IPromise<NicknamePokemonOutProto> — it is
// ASYNCHRONOUS. runtime_invoke only KICKS OFF the rename; the server round-trip
// and the local nickname_ field update happen LATER, pumped by the game's
// scheduler on the Unity main thread. So {ok:true} here means "dispatched", NOT
// "committed". The Python side MUST pump (sleep) and then re-read nickname_ to
// confirm. `ret` is the promise object pointer (non-null = dispatch succeeded).
rpc.exports.setOne = function(bagStr, protoStr, nameStr){
  _ensureInit();
  var bagCls=cFN('Niantic.Holoholo.Internal','PokemonBagImpl');
  var m=cMN(bagCls,'NicknamePokemon',2);
  if(!m||m.isNull()) return {ok:false,err:'no NicknamePokemon method'};
  var s=_strnew(nameStr);
  var args=Memory.alloc(2*Process.pointerSize);
  args.writePointer(ptr(protoStr));
  args.add(Process.pointerSize).writePointer(s);
  var exc=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
  var ret=rI(m, ptr(bagStr), args, exc);
  var ep=exc.readPointer();
  if(!ep.isNull()){
    var e=_exp(); var CGN=new NativeFunction(e['il2cpp_class_get_name'],'pointer',['pointer']);
    var k=ep.readPointer(); return {ok:false, err:'exc', excClass: CGN(k).readCString()};
  }
  // ret is the IPromise object; null would mean dispatch never produced a promise.
  return {ok:true, promise: ret.isNull()? null : ret.toString()};
};

// Is the player's nickname privilege blocklisted (shadowban)? If true, the
// server silently rejects every rename — explains "ok:true, never commits".
rpc.exports.isBlocklisted = function(){
  _ensureInit();
  try {
    var psCls = cFN('Niantic.Holoholo','PlayerService');
    if(!psCls || psCls.isNull()) return {ok:false, err:'no PlayerService class'};
    // PlayerService is a singleton; find a live instance via liveness.
    var inst = liveness_find_instances(psCls);
    if(inst.err || !inst.hits || !inst.hits.length) return {ok:false, err:'no PlayerService instance'};
    var m = cMN(psCls,'get_IsNicknameBlocklisted',0);
    if(!m || m.isNull()) return {ok:false, err:'no get_IsNicknameBlocklisted'};
    var ret = rI(m, ptr(inst.hits[0]), ptr(0), null);
    // runtime_invoke boxes the System.Boolean return; the unboxed byte sits at
    // +0x10 of the boxed object (object header is 0x10 on arm64 il2cpp).
    if(ret.isNull()) return {ok:true, blocklisted:false};
    var b = ret.add(0x10).readU8();
    return {ok:true, blocklisted: b !== 0};
  } catch(e){ return {ok:false, err:e.toString()}; }
};
"""


class Engine:
    """A live (session, bag, script, nick_off) bundle. Rebuildable after a
    PoGo restart (PID changes -> everything must be re-resolved)."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.sess = self.pid = self.bag = self.sc = None
        self.nick_off = -1

    def attach_and_prime(self, fresh_session=None, fresh_pid=None):
        """Resolve session, the LIVE bag (re-proven via pick_singleton's >100
        walk), the helper script, the nickname_ offset, and prime the classes."""
        if fresh_session is not None:
            self.sess, self.pid = fresh_session, fresh_pid
        else:
            self.sess, self.pid = pg.get_session()
        print("attached pid", self.pid, flush=True)
        # pick_singleton(PokemonBagImpl) already rejects any candidate whose walk
        # has <100 mons, so this is the live bag, not a stale husk. (Addresses H2.)
        self.bag = pg.pick_singleton(self.sess, "Niantic.Holoholo.Internal", "PokemonBagImpl")
        bm0 = pg.walk_bag_protos(self.sess, self.bag)
        print("bag mons:", len(bm0), flush=True)
        if len(bm0) < 100:
            raise RuntimeError(f"bag walk only {len(bm0)} — not ready / stale")
        self.sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(self.sess, EXTRA_JS)
        off = self.sc.exports_sync.find_offsets(next(iter(bm0.values())))
        self.nick_off = off["nickOff"]
        if self.nick_off < 0:
            raise RuntimeError("nickname_ field not found")
        print(f"nickname_@{hex(self.nick_off)}  "
              f"(originalOwnerNickname_@{hex(off['ooNickOff'])} untouched)", flush=True)
        print("priming:", self.sc.exports_sync.prime(), flush=True)
        try:
            bl = self.sc.exports_sync.is_blocklisted()
            if bl.get("ok") and bl.get("blocklisted"):
                print("  !! WARNING: IsNicknameBlocklisted = TRUE — server will "
                      "silently reject renames (nickname shadowban).", flush=True)
            else:
                print("  IsNicknameBlocklisted:", bl, flush=True)
        except Exception as e:
            print("  blocklist probe skipped:", e, flush=True)

    def cur_nick(self, uid):
        """Fresh re-walk -> real nickname_ for one uid (or None if uid gone)."""
        bm = pg.walk_bag_protos(self.sess, self.bag)
        p = bm.get(uid)
        return (self.sc.exports_sync.read_one(p, self.nick_off) if p else None), bm

    def set_one_verified(self, uid, name, pump=1.6, polls=4, dispatch_retries=2):
        """Mirror the PROVEN single-mon path: dispatch the rename, PUMP the
        scheduler (NicknamePokemon is async -> returns a promise), then re-walk
        and read the REAL nickname_ field. Only report committed if it equals
        the target. Returns 'ok' | 'noop' | 'fail'.

        Each dispatch is followed by up to `polls` re-reads spaced `pump`s apart,
        so a slow server round-trip still counts as success instead of a false
        throttle. (This is exactly why the single test worked and fire-the-batch
        did not: the batch never pumped/verified per mon.)"""
        # Already correct? (idempotent resume — skip without spending a rename.)
        before, bm = self.cur_nick(uid)
        if before is None:
            return "noop"          # uid not in bag (traded/evolved away)
        if before == name:
            return "noop"
        proto = bm[uid]
        for attempt in range(dispatch_retries + 1):
            try:
                r = self.sc.exports_sync.set_one(self.bag, proto, name)
            except Exception as e:
                r = {"ok": False, "err": f"threw {e}"}
            if not r.get("ok"):
                # Dispatch itself failed (exception/method) — re-walk proto (may
                # have reallocated) and retry.
                bm = pg.walk_bag_protos(self.sess, self.bag)
                proto = bm.get(uid, proto)
                if attempt < dispatch_retries:
                    time.sleep(0.6); continue
                print(f"    dispatch fail uid {uid}: {r}", flush=True)
                return "fail"
            # Dispatched OK — now PUMP + verify the real field.
            for _ in range(polls):
                time.sleep(pump)
                after, bm = self.cur_nick(uid)
                if after == name:
                    return "ok"
                proto = bm.get(uid, proto)   # keep proto fresh for any re-dispatch
            # Not committed after polling this dispatch; re-dispatch (unless out
            # of attempts) — promise may have been dropped under contention.
        return "fail"

    def close(self):
        try:
            if self.sc: self.sc.unload()
        except Exception: pass
        try:
            if self.sess: self.sess.detach()
        except Exception: pass


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("mode", nargs="?", default="set", choices=["set", "test"])
    ap.add_argument("--delay", type=float, default=0.4,
                    help="gap between mons AFTER a verified commit (default 0.4)")
    ap.add_argument("--pump", type=float, default=1.6,
                    help="seconds to let the async rename promise resolve before re-reading")
    ap.add_argument("--polls", type=int, default=4, help="re-reads per dispatch")
    ap.add_argument("--pid", type=int, default=0, help="only this pokemon_id (e.g. 1=Bulbasaur)")
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="cap committed writes this run")
    ap.add_argument("--throttle-run", type=int, default=8,
                    help="consecutive verify-fails that mean 'throttled' -> restart PoGo")
    ap.add_argument("--max-restarts", type=int, default=6)
    ap.add_argument("--no-restart", action="store_true",
                    help="on throttle, stop instead of auto-restarting PoGo")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    targets = {str(int(u, 16)): n for u, n in json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "keepcode_targets.json")))}
    print(f"targets: {len(targets)}")

    import sqlite3
    pidmap = {}
    try:
        _c = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(ROOT, "pokemon.db"))
        pidmap = {str(int(uh, 16)): (pid if pid is not None else 99999)
                  for uh, pid in _c.execute("SELECT uid_hex, pokemon_id FROM pokemon")}
        _c.close()
    except Exception as _e:
        print("pidmap load failed (writes will not be #-ordered):", _e)

    if a.pid:
        targets = {u: n for u, n in targets.items() if pidmap.get(u) == a.pid}
        print(f"FILTERED to pokemon_id {a.pid}: {len(targets)} targets -> {sorted(targets.values())}")

    eng = Engine()
    eng.attach_and_prime()
    try:
        # ---- TEST: prove the per-mon write+verify on ONE mismatched mon ----
        if a.mode == "test":
            bm = pg.walk_bag_protos(eng.sess, eng.bag)
            uids = [u for u in targets if u in bm]
            cur = eng.sc.exports_sync.read_nicks(json.dumps([bm[u] for u in uids]), eng.nick_off)
            pick = next((uids[i] for i in range(len(uids)) if cur[i] != targets[uids[i]]), None)
            if not pick:
                print("no mismatched mon to test on (all already correct)"); return
            print(f"\nTEST — uid {pick}: want {targets[pick]!r}")
            res = eng.set_one_verified(pick, targets[pick], pump=a.pump, polls=a.polls)
            after, _ = eng.cur_nick(pick)
            print(f"  RESULT: {res}  (nickname_ now {after!r}, wanted {targets[pick]!r})")
            return

        # ---- BULK: per-mon write->pump->verify, with throttle-restart-resume ----
        committed = noop = 0
        consec_fail = 0
        restarts = 0
        # Pre-filter: ONE walk to find which targets still mismatch, so a RESUME
        # skips already-correct mons fast (instead of a per-mon walk for each of
        # the ~1550 already done before a crash).
        _bm = pg.walk_bag_protos(eng.sess, eng.bag)
        _uids = [u for u in targets if u in _bm]
        _cur = eng.sc.exports_sync.read_nicks(json.dumps([_bm[u] for u in _uids]), eng.nick_off)
        _todo = {u: targets[u] for i, u in enumerate(_uids) if _cur[i] != targets[u]}
        print(f"pre-filter: {len(_todo)} of {len(_uids)} in-bag targets still need setting", flush=True)
        order = sorted(_todo.items(), key=lambda kv: (pidmap.get(kv[0], 99999), kv[0]))
        idx = 0
        while idx < len(order):
            uid, name = order[idx]
            try:
                res = eng.set_one_verified(uid, name, pump=a.pump, polls=a.polls)
            except Exception as e:
                # Gadget connection dropped (PoGo churn/crash) — reconnect & resume
                # the SAME mon. Light re-attach first; full restart if PoGo is down.
                print(f"\n=== CONNECTION LOST at idx {idx} (committed {committed}): "
                      f"{type(e).__name__}: {e} === reconnecting...", flush=True)
                try: eng.close()
                except Exception: pass
                eng = Engine()
                try:
                    eng.attach_and_prime()
                except Exception as e2:
                    print(f"    re-attach failed ({e2}); full PoGo restart...", flush=True)
                    fs, fp = pg.restart_pogo_and_wait()
                    eng = Engine(); eng.attach_and_prime(fresh_session=fs, fresh_pid=fp)
                consec_fail = 0
                continue
            if res == "ok":
                committed += 1; consec_fail = 0
                if committed <= 20 or committed % 25 == 0:
                    print(f"  [{committed}] uid {uid} -> {name!r} ✓", flush=True)
                time.sleep(a.delay)
            elif res == "noop":
                noop += 1; consec_fail = 0
            else:  # fail
                consec_fail += 1
                print(f"  verify-fail ({consec_fail}/{a.throttle_run}) uid {uid} want {name!r}", flush=True)

            if a.limit and committed >= a.limit:
                print(f"\n--limit {a.limit} reached."); break

            if consec_fail >= a.throttle_run:
                # THROTTLE: per-mon writes stopped committing. The reliable reset
                # is a PoGo restart (documented: ~1065 cleared before throttle, a
                # restart reset it). Restart with a readiness gate, rebuild the
                # engine on the FRESH pid+bag, and RESUME at the same index.
                if a.no_restart:
                    print(f"\nTHROTTLED at idx {idx} (committed {committed}). "
                          f"--no-restart set; re-run to resume."); break
                if restarts >= a.max_restarts:
                    print(f"\nTHROTTLED and hit --max-restarts {a.max_restarts}; "
                          f"committed {committed}. Re-run later to resume."); break
                restarts += 1
                print(f"\n=== THROTTLE detected (committed {committed}). "
                      f"Restarting PoGo [{restarts}/{a.max_restarts}] + waiting for "
                      f"readiness, then resuming at idx {idx} ===", flush=True)
                eng.close()
                fs, fp = pg.restart_pogo_and_wait()   # blocks until libil2cpp+bag ready
                eng = Engine(); eng.attach_and_prime(fresh_session=fs, fresh_pid=fp)
                consec_fail = 0
                continue   # retry SAME mon on the fresh, un-throttled session
            idx += 1

        # ---- FINAL VERIFY (authoritative: fresh walk, real nickname_) ----
        bm = pg.walk_bag_protos(eng.sess, eng.bag)
        uids = [u for u in targets if u in bm]
        cur = eng.sc.exports_sync.read_nicks(json.dumps([bm[u] for u in uids]), eng.nick_off)
        remaining = [(u, targets[u], cur[i]) for i, u in enumerate(uids) if cur[i] != targets[u]]
        print(f"\nTOTAL committed this run: {committed}  (noop/already-correct: {noop})")
        print(f"still mismatched: {len(remaining)}/{len(uids)} in-bag targets", flush=True)
        if a.pid or len(uids) <= 40 or remaining:
            print("\nPER-MON VERIFY (real nickname_ read-back):")
            show = remaining if len(remaining) > 40 else \
                   [(u, targets[u], cur[i]) for i, u in enumerate(uids)]
            for u, want, got in show[:60]:
                ok = "OK ✓" if got == want else "✗ MISMATCH"
                print(f"  want {want!r:<16} got {got!r:<16} {ok}")
            if len(remaining) > 60:
                print(f"  ... and {len(remaining)-60} more mismatched")
    finally:
        eng.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

`pogo_extract/shiny_cull.py`:

```py
"""Shiny cull: top 8 per (species, form) bucket, except fully-protected chains.

Protected chains (keep ALL shinies):
  - Magikarp/Gyarados (129, 130)
  - Eevee + all evolutions (133, 134, 135, 136, 196, 197, 470, 471, 700)
  - Pichu/Pikachu/Raichu (172, 25, 26)
  - Flabebe/Floette/Florges (669, 670, 671)
"""
import sqlite3, json

PROTECTED_PIDS = {
    # Magikarp/Gyarados
    129, 130,
    # Eevee chain
    133, 134, 135, 136, 196, 197, 470, 471, 700,
    # Pikachu chain
    172, 25, 26,
    # Flabebe chain
    669, 670, 671,
    # Rayquaza
    384,
    # Zacian
    888,
}
TOP_N = 6

conn = sqlite3.connect('pokemon.db')
c = conn.cursor()

rows = c.execute('''SELECT uid_hex, uid, pokemon_id, species_name, form, fresh_costume,
                           cp, iv_pct, level, is_lucky, is_powered_up, is_traded_flag_v2
                    FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND fresh_shiny=1''').fetchall()
print(f'Total shinies: {len(rows)}')

# Bucket by (species, form) - costume IGNORED for shiny rule
buckets = {}
for r in rows:
    pid = r[2]
    if pid in PROTECTED_PIDS:
        continue  # all kept regardless
    key = (pid, r[4] or 0)
    buckets.setdefault(key, []).append(r)

# Within each bucket rank by IV%, CP. Below rank 8 = transferable
xfer = []
for key, lst in buckets.items():
    lst.sort(key=lambda x: (-(x[7] or 0), -(x[6] or 0)))
    for i, r in enumerate(lst):
        if i >= TOP_N:
            xfer.append(r)

protected = sum(1 for r in rows if r[2] in PROTECTED_PIDS)
print(f'  Protected chains (keep all): {protected}')
print(f'  Other shinies (top {TOP_N}/bucket): {len(rows) - protected}')
print(f'  Below-rank-{TOP_N} in non-protected = TRANSFER candidates: {len(xfer)}')

if xfer:
    print()
    print('=== Transfer candidates ===')
    for r in xfer:
        flags = []
        if r[9]: flags.append('LUCKY')
        if r[10]: flags.append('POWERED')
        if r[11]: flags.append('TRADED')
        print(f'  {r[3]:14s} f={r[4]:>4} CP{r[6]:5d} IV{r[7]:5.1f}% L{r[8]:.1f} {" ".join(flags)}')

# Save list
out = []
for r in xfer:
    out.append({'uid_hex': r[0], 'uid': r[1], 'species': r[3],
                'form': r[4], 'cp': r[6], 'iv': r[7]})
with open('shiny_xfer_list.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2)
print(f'\nWrote shiny_xfer_list.json ({len(out)} entries)')
