```py
"""build_map.py -- generate system/analysis/system_map.html, the visual map of
how every keep-reason flows into the three views (CULL / PURPOSE / TAGS).

Reproducible: re-run after any crawl/profile to refresh the live numbers. Pulls
reasons from cull_v9 (the engine) and the mapping from keep_engine (the spec),
so the picture can never disagree with the code.
"""
import sys, os, sqlite3, json, html
from collections import Counter

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, '..', '..'))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)          # cull_v9, references
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)          # keep_engine
os.chdir(ROOT)                    # cull_v9 reads json files relative to cwd
import cull_v9, keep_engine
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, 'system', 'analysis', 'system_map.html')
PURPOSE_COLORS = {'PVP': '#e74c3c', 'MEGA': '#9b59b6', 'ADVENTURE': '#16a085',
                  'MAX': '#e67e22', 'COLLECTION': '#2980b9', 'RESERVE': '#7f8c8d',
                  'TRADE': '#f1c40f', 'TRANSFER': '#34495e'}


def main():
    conn = sqlite3.connect('pokemon.db'); conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    rows, ctx = cull_v9._load_rows_and_ctx(conn.cursor())
    n = len(rows)

    # per-mon reasons -> purpose; reason-dimension histogram
    dim = Counter()                      # reason-prefix -> mons protected
    purpose_ct = Counter()
    cull_transfer = set()
    tagged = set()
    for p in rows:
        reasons = cull_v9.is_protected(p, ctx)
        seen = set()
        for r in reasons:
            pref = keep_engine.reason_prefix(r)
            if pref not in seen:         # count each dimension once per mon
                dim[pref] += 1; seen.add(pref)
        pur = keep_engine.classify_purpose(reasons, p['iv_total'])
        purpose_ct[pur] += 1
        if not reasons:
            cull_transfer.add(p['uid_hex'])
        if (p['auth_tag_names'] or '').strip(';'):
            tagged.add(p['uid_hex'])

    # OLD purpose (pre-unification) from the existing profile, for the before/after
    old_transfer = set()
    try:
        prof = json.load(open('system/analysis/deep_profiles.json', encoding='utf-8'))
        old_transfer = {p['uid'] for p in prof if p.get('purpose') == 'TRANSFER'}
    except Exception:
        pass
    both = cull_transfer & old_transfer
    cull_only = cull_transfer - old_transfer
    old_only = old_transfer - cull_transfer

    # ---- build the dimension matrix rows (purpose-priority then count) ----
    def meta_for(pref):
        if pref == 'user_tag':
            m = {'purpose': '(tag-derived)', 'native': False, 'tag': 'various'}
        else:
            m = keep_engine.REASON_META.get(pref, {'purpose': '?', 'native': False, 'tag': None})
        lab, desc = keep_engine.REASON_LABELS.get(pref, (pref, ''))
        return {'pref': pref, 'purpose': m['purpose'], 'native': m['native'],
                'tag': m.get('tag') or '', 'label': lab, 'desc': desc}
    rowdata = []
    for pref, cnt in dim.items():
        m = meta_for(pref); m['cnt'] = cnt; rowdata.append(m)
    rowdata.sort(key=lambda r: (keep_engine._PRIO.get(r['purpose'], 99), -r['cnt']))

    def esc(x): return html.escape(str(x))
    def bar(label, cnt, color):
        pct = 100.0 * cnt / max(n, 1)
        return (f'<div class="barrow"><span class="blab">{esc(label)}</span>'
                f'<span class="btrack"><span class="bfill" style="width:{pct:.1f}%;'
                f'background:{color}"></span></span><span class="bval">{cnt}</span></div>')

    purpose_bars = ''.join(
        bar(p, purpose_ct.get(p, 0), PURPOSE_COLORS[p]) for p in keep_engine.PURPOSE_PRIORITY)

    matrix_rows = ''
    for r in rowdata:
        pc = PURPOSE_COLORS.get(r['purpose'], '#bbb')
        nat = ('<span class="yes">native filter</span>' if r['native']
               else '<span class="no">needs tag</span>')
        matrix_rows += (
            f'<tr><td><span class="rlabel">{esc(r["label"])}</span>'
            f'<div class="rcode">{esc(r["pref"])}</div></td>'
            f'<td class="rdesc">{esc(r["desc"])}</td>'
            f'<td class="num">{r["cnt"]}</td>'
            f'<td><span class="pchip" style="background:{pc}">{esc(r["purpose"])}</span></td>'
            f'<td>{nat}</td><td class="tag">{esc(r["tag"])}</td></tr>')

    # tag -> reasons (which dimensions feed each custom tag)
    tag_feed = {}
    for r in rowdata:
        if r['tag'] and r['tag'] != 'various':
            for t in r['tag'].split(' / '):
                tag_feed.setdefault(t.strip(), []).append(f'{r["label"]} ({r["cnt"]})')
    tag_rows = ''.join(
        f'<tr><td class="tag">{esc(t)}</td><td>{esc(", ".join(v))}</td></tr>'
        for t, v in sorted(tag_feed.items()))

    HTML = f"""<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Collection System Map</title>
<style>
 body{{font:14px/1.5 -apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;margin:0;background:#0f1419;color:#e6e6e6}}
 .wrap{{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px 24px 80px}}
 h1{{font-size:26px;margin:0 0 4px}} h2{{font-size:18px;margin:36px 0 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #2a3441;padding-bottom:6px}}
 .sub{{color:#8b98a5;margin:0 0 24px}}
 .flow{{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}}
 .engine{{flex:1 1 100%;background:#1a2330;border:1px solid #2a3441;border-radius:10px;padding:16px 18px;text-align:center}}
 .engine b{{color:#ffd479;font-size:15px}} .engine .dims{{color:#8b98a5;font-size:12.5px;margin-top:6px}}
 .arrow{{flex:1 1 100%;text-align:center;color:#5a6b7a;font-size:20px;margin:2px 0}}
 .view{{flex:1 1 30%;min-width:240px;background:#1a2330;border:1px solid #2a3441;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px}}
 .view h3{{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:15px}} .view p{{margin:0;color:#9fb0bf;font-size:13px}}
 .v-cull h3{{color:#e74c3c}} .v-purpose h3{{color:#2980b9}} .v-tag h3{{color:#16a085}}
 .venn{{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;background:#1a2330;border:1px solid #2a3441;border-radius:10px;padding:18px 20px}}
 .venncol{{flex:1 1 360px}} .vstat{{display:flex;gap:10px;margin:6px 0;align-items:baseline}}
 .vstat .nbig{{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;min-width:54px;text-align:right}}
 .grn{{color:#2ecc71}} .org{{color:#e67e22}} .red{{color:#e74c3c}} .gry{{color:#8b98a5}}
 .barrow{{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:5px 0}}
 .blab{{min-width:96px;font-size:13px}} .btrack{{flex:1;background:#222d3a;border-radius:4px;height:18px;overflow:hidden}}
 .bfill{{display:block;height:100%}} .bval{{min-width:42px;text-align:right;color:#cdd9e3;font-size:13px}}
 table{{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:8px}}
 th,td{{text-align:left;padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #232e3b;font-size:13px}}
 th{{color:#8b98a5;font-weight:600}} .num{{text-align:right;color:#cdd9e3;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}}
 .rname{{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;color:#cfe3ff}}
 .rlabel{{font-weight:600;color:#eaf2fb;font-size:13.5px}} .rcode{{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;color:#5f7488;font-size:10.5px;margin-top:1px}}
 .rdesc{{color:#9fb0bf;font-size:12.5px;max-width:400px}}
 .pchip{{color:#fff;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600}}
 .yes{{color:#2ecc71}} .no{{color:#e67e22}} .tag{{color:#ffd479;font-size:12.5px}}
 .note{{background:#15202b;border-left:3px solid #ffd479;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;color:#c9d6e0;margin:14px 0}}
</style></head><body><div class="wrap">
<h1>Collection System Map</h1>
<p class="sub">{n:,} in-bag specimens &middot; one keep-reason engine, three views &middot; generated by build_map.py</p>

<h2>The model</h2>
<div class="flow">
  <div class="engine"><b>ONE KEEP-REASON ENGINE</b> &nbsp;(cull_v9 registry &rarr; {len(dim)} dimensions)
    <div class="dims">hundo &middot; shiny &middot; legendary &middot; GL/UL top-2 &middot; mega &middot; XXL &middot; species-top-3 &middot; shadow &middot; legacy &middot; dex-gap &middot; adventure &middot; tagged &hellip;</div></div>
  <div class="arrow">&darr; &nbsp; projects into three views &nbsp; &darr;</div>
```

```py
"""check_constant_drift.py -- GUARD: every game constant has exactly ONE definition.

WHY THIS EXISTS (defect D4, 2026-09-07)
---------------------------------------
The level-50 CP multiplier existed as two different values for one number --
rank_cache.py's CPM[98] said 0.84029995 while pvp_iv_rule.py's CPM50 said 0.84029999 --
plus five more copies, two of which were REGEX SCRAPES of another file's source text.
Neither literal was the value the game actually stores (float32(0.8403)). That constant
feeds the PvP stat-product ranks, the ranks feed the rank<=5 keep gate, and that gate
decides the ONE irreversible output: the Transfer pile a human then releases by hand.

A drift like that is invisible: both files parse, both run, both produce plausible ranks.
The only thing that catches it is a check that asserts there is ONE definition. Two
literals that merely happen to match are NOT a single source of truth -- the next person
to "correct" one of them silently re-splits the brain.

WHAT IT CHECKS
--------------
  RUNTIME : import each live consumer and assert the constant it exposes IS the canonical
            one from cpm_table.py. Catches drift that only appears once modules load.
  SOURCE  : AST-scan the live engine files for a RE-HARDCODED CPM ladder, L50/L51
            multiplier, league CP cap, or level-cap index (MAX_LEVEL_IDX). Catches a
            literal pasted back in before it can ever diverge, and catches the
            source-scrape antipattern returning.

            This scan is a set of NAMED rules, not a proof of full coverage: it knows the
            four shapes below. A game constant in a shape none of them models is NOT
            covered, and the clean verdict does not claim otherwise.

Read-only. No device contact, no DB writes. ~2s.
Exit 0 and print "ALL GAME CONSTANTS SINGLE-SOURCED" when clean, else exit 1.

NOTE ON compute_all_ranks.py: it is scanned by AST but deliberately NOT imported -- it has
no `if __name__ == '__main__'` guard, so importing it RE-RANKS THE WHOLE BAG and writes
pokemon.db as a side effect of the import.
"""
import ast
import os
import re
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(HERE))
if ROOT not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
if HERE not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, HERE)

import cpm_table  # the single source of truth

CANON = os.path.join(ROOT, 'cpm_table.py')

# Files the live pipeline actually runs. A re-hardcoded constant in one of these is a
# BLOCKING failure. Everything else in the tree is reported as INFO (historical one-shot
# scripts keep their own frozen copies; they do not decide today's pile).
LIVE = [
    'system/scripts/rank_cache.py',       # the ranker pogo_pipeline runs
    'compute_all_ranks.py',               # its fallback ranker
    'pvp_iv_rule.py',                     # the GL/UL keep rule + viability gate
    'system/scripts/keep_policy.py',      # builds the pile
    'system/scripts/build_tagsets.py',    # writes the tagset files
    'system/scripts/preflight_transfer.py',  # pre-flights the irreversible pile
    'granular_tags.py',                   # the 23-tag scheme
    'audit_cull.py',                      # the 8-layer cull audit
    'cull_v9.py',                         # advisory, but pogo_pipeline imports and RUNS it in-process
    'pogo_pipeline.py',                   # its CPM_TABLE was collapsed onto cpm_table.CPM (2026-09-30): keep it scanned
]

# KNOWN OUTSTANDING -- a real live duplicate that is NOT yet collapsed, listed by name so it
# is printed on EVERY run instead of quietly allowlisted. Reported as WARN (does not fail the
# guard) purely because it was owned by another agent editing in parallel when this landed.
# Collapse it and delete the entry.
PENDING = {}     # pogo_pipeline.py's CPM_TABLE was collapsed onto cpm_table.CPM on 2026-09-30

# Modules that are SAFE to import (no side effects at module scope) and the canonical
# attribute each must agree with.
RUNTIME = [
    ('pvp_iv_rule', {'CPM50': 'CPM50', 'GL_CAP': 'GL_CAP', 'UL_CAP': 'UL_CAP'}),
    ('rank_cache', {'MAX_LEVEL_IDX': 'MAX_LEVEL_IDX', 'GL_CAP': 'GL_CAP', 'UL_CAP': 'UL_CAP'}),
    ('build_tagsets', {'CPM50': 'CPM50'}),
    ('granular_tags', {'GL_CAP': 'GL_CAP', 'UL_CAP': 'UL_CAP'}),
]

CAP_VALUES = {500, 1500, 2500}

# Rule (2b): the LEVEL-LADDER constants that live in cpm_table.py -- MAX_LEVEL_IDX (the
# highest rung the ranker evaluates), LEVEL_50_IDX, LEVEL_51_IDX. Matched on BOTH the name
# (case-folded substring) and the value, because a re-hardcoded `MAX_LEVEL_IDX = 98` is an
# int whose name holds neither 'CPM' nor a trailing '_CAP' -- it slips past every other rule
# in this file. Values: 98/100 are the TABLE INDICES, 50/51 the levels they stand for.
LEVEL_NAME_RE = re.compile(r'MAX_LEVEL|MAX_LEVEL_IDX|LEVEL_CAP|LEVEL_50|LEVEL_51|MAXIDX')
LEVEL_IDX_VALUES = {50, 51, 98, 100}

FAILURES = []
INFO = []


def fail(msg, why):
    FAILURES.append((msg, why))
    print('   *** DRIFT  %s' % msg)
    print('              -> %s' % why)


def ok(msg):
    print('   ok        %s' % msg)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _floats(node):
    """The float constants in a list/tuple literal, or None if it is not one.

    Handles BOTH ladder shapes: a flat list of multipliers (the ranker's CPM) and a list of
    (cpm, level) PAIRS (pogo_pipeline/build_db's reverse cpm_to_level table). The pair form
    was a blind spot -- a scanner that only understood flat lists reported "clean" on a file
    holding a complete second copy of the ladder.
    """
    if not isinstance(node, (ast.List, ast.Tuple)):
        return None
    out = []
    for e in node.elts:
        if isinstance(e, ast.Constant) and isinstance(e.value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(e.value, bool):
            out.append(float(e.value))
        elif isinstance(e, ast.Tuple) and e.elts and isinstance(e.elts[0], ast.Constant) \
                and isinstance(e.elts[0].value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(e.elts[0].value, bool):
            out.append(float(e.elts[0].value))   # (cpm, level) pair -> take the multiplier
        else:
            return None
    return out


def scan_source(rel):
    """Report re-hardcoded CPM ladders / L50 multipliers / league caps / level-cap
    indices in one file. Four named rules -- see the module docstring: this is coverage of
    known shapes, not a proof that no constant is duplicated."""
    path = os.path.join(ROOT, rel)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        INFO.append('%s: not found (skipped)' % rel)
        return []
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(open(path, encoding='utf-8').read())
    except SyntaxError as e:
        return [('%s does not parse (%s)' % (rel, e), 'A guard cannot clear a file it cannot read.')]

    hits = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        # (1) a CPM ladder pasted back in: a long run of float literals in the CPM range
        vals = _floats(node)
        if vals and len(vals) >= 20 and all(0.09 <= v <= 0.90 for v in vals):
            hits.append(('%s re-hardcodes a %d-entry CPM ladder' % (rel, len(vals)),
                         'Import it: `from cpm_table import CPM` (or cpm_list() for a mutable copy).'))
        # (2) NAME = <float literal> where NAME looks like a CP multiplier
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Constant) \
                and isinstance(node.value.value, float):
            for tg in node.targets:
                if isinstance(tg, ast.Name) and 'CPM' in tg.id.upper():
                    hits.append(('%s hardcodes %s = %r' % (rel, tg.id, node.value.value),
                                 'Import it: `from cpm_table import CPM50`.'))
        # (2b) NAME = <int literal> where NAME is a LEVEL-LADDER constant. This is the hole
        #      the other three rules leave open: `MAX_LEVEL_IDX = 98` is an int (rule 1 wants
        #      a >=20-entry float list, rule 2 wants a float), its name holds no 'CPM'
        #      (rule 2) and does not end in '_CAP' (rule 3) -- and even `LEVEL_CAP = 50` gets
        #      past rule 3, whose CAP_VALUES are the league caps {500,1500,2500}, not 50. So a
        #      re-hardcoded level cap scanned CLEAN while the guard printed its all-good
        #      verdict. It matters because MAX_LEVEL_IDX is the highest rung the ranker
        #      evaluates: drift in it moves EVERY rank, and the ranks feed the rank<=5 gate
        #      that decides the irreversible Transfer pile.
        #      SCOPE: the plain `NAME = <int>` form only. A tuple unpack
        #      (`LEVEL_50_IDX, LEVEL_51_IDX = 98, 100`) or an annotated assignment
        #      (`MAX_LEVEL_IDX: int = 98`) is NOT caught -- said out loud rather than implied
        #      away, because a guard that overstates its reach is how D4 survived.
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Constant) \
                and isinstance(node.value.value, int) \
                and node.value.value in LEVEL_IDX_VALUES:
            for tg in node.targets:
                if isinstance(tg, ast.Name) and LEVEL_NAME_RE.search(tg.id.upper()):
                    hits.append(('%s hardcodes %s = %r' % (rel, tg.id, node.value.value),
                                 'Import it: `from cpm_table import MAX_LEVEL_IDX`. '
                                 '(cpm_table.py owns MAX_LEVEL_IDX / LEVEL_50_IDX / '
                                 'LEVEL_51_IDX -- import the one you need, never re-type '
                                 'it; level 50.0 is level_for_index(MAX_LEVEL_IDX).)'))
        # (3) league CP caps as literals in an assignment
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
            names = [tg.id for tg in node.targets if isinstance(tg, ast.Name)]
            names += [e.id for tg in node.targets if isinstance(tg, ast.Tuple)
                      for e in tg.elts if isinstance(e, ast.Name)]
            if any(n.endswith('_CAP') for n in names):
                lits = []
                if isinstance(node.value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value.value, int):
                    lits = [node.value.value]
                elif isinstance(node.value, ast.Tuple):
                    lits = [e.value for e in node.value.elts
                            if isinstance(e, ast.Constant) and isinstance(e.value, int)]
                if any(v in CAP_VALUES for v in lits):
                    hits.append(('%s hardcodes a league CP cap (%s = %s)'
                                 % (rel, '/'.join(names), lits),
                                 'Import it: `from cpm_table import GL_CAP, UL_CAP, LL_CAP`.'))
        # (4) the source-scrape antipattern returning
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) \
                and node.func.attr in ('search', 'findall') and node.args:
            a0 = node.args[0]
            if isinstance(a0, ast.Constant) and isinstance(a0.value, str) and 'CPM' in a0.value:
                hits.append(('%s REGEX-SCRAPES a CPM literal out of source text' % rel,
                             'Import it from cpm_table instead; a scrape breaks silently when the '
                             'literal it reads moves or becomes an import.'))
    return hits


def main():
    print('=' * 78)
    print('CONSTANT-DRIFT GUARD -- one definition per game constant (defect D4)')
    print('=' * 78)
    print('\ncanonical: cpm_table.py  CPM50=%r  caps=%s  MAX_LEVEL_IDX=%d'
          % (cpm_table.CPM50, cpm_table.LEAGUE_CAPS, cpm_table.MAX_LEVEL_IDX))

    print('\n[1] RUNTIME -- every consumer exposes the canonical value')
    for modname, attrs in RUNTIME:
        try:
            mod = __import__(modname)
        except Exception as e:
            fail('cannot import %s (%s)' % (modname, e),
                 'A consumer that will not load cannot be proven to share the constant.')
            continue
        for attr, canon_attr in attrs.items():
            want = getattr(cpm_table, canon_attr)
            got = getattr(mod, attr, '<missing>')
            if got == want:
                ok('%s.%s == cpm_table.%s (%r)' % (modname, attr, canon_attr, want))
            else:
                fail('%s.%s = %r but cpm_table.%s = %r' % (modname, attr, got, canon_attr, want),
                     'One number, two values -- this is defect D4 exactly. Make %s import it.' % modname)

    # rank_cache holds a mutable COPY of the ladder; it must still match element-wise.
    try:
        import rank_cache as _rk
        if list(_rk.CPM) == list(cpm_table.CPM):
            ok('rank_cache.CPM is element-wise identical to the canonical ladder')
        else:
            fail('rank_cache.CPM differs from cpm_table.CPM',
                 'The ranker is not using the canonical ladder; every rank it writes is suspect.')
        if _rk.CPM is cpm_table.CPM:
            fail('rank_cache.CPM IS the canonical tuple object',
                 'Consumers that patch their own CPM (regress_pvp_keepers.py does) would corrupt '
                 'the canonical table for the whole process. Use cpm_table.cpm_list().')
        else:
            ok('rank_cache.CPM is a private copy -- a consumer cannot corrupt the canonical table')
    except Exception as e:
        fail('cannot verify rank_cache.CPM (%s)' % e, 'The live ranker must be checkable.')

    print('\n[2] SOURCE -- no live engine file re-hardcodes a constant')
    for rel in LIVE:
        hits = scan_source(rel)
        if not hits:
            ok('%s: no re-hardcoded CPM ladder / L50-L51 multiplier / league CP cap / '
               'level-cap index, and no CPM source-scrape' % rel)
        for msg, why in hits:
            fail(msg, why)

    print('\n[3] KNOWN OUTSTANDING duplicates (reported every run, not allowlisted away)')
    if not PENDING:
        ok('none')
    for rel, why in sorted(PENDING.items()):
        hits = scan_source(rel)
        if hits:
            print('   !! WARN     %s' % rel)
            print('              -> %s' % why)
        else:
            fail('%s is listed in PENDING but no longer duplicates anything' % rel,
                 'It was fixed -- delete its PENDING entry so this guard stays honest.')

    print('\n[4] canonical file sanity')
    if not os.path.exists(CANON):
        fail('cpm_table.py is MISSING', 'Every consumer imports it; without it nothing ranks.')
    else:
        ok('cpm_table.py present and its import-time self-checks passed')

    print('\n[5] the ladder against the GAME (2026-09-30): the client game master\'s playerLevel.cpMultiplier')
    _gm = os.path.join(ROOT, 'gamemaster_pokeminers.json')
    if not os.path.exists(_gm):
        print('   -- skipped: no gamemaster_pokeminers.json here (CI has no game data; sessions pull it)')
    else:
        try:
            import json as _json, math as _math
            _cp = next(t['data']['playerLevel']['cpMultiplier'] for t in _json.load(open(_gm, encoding='utf-8'))
                       if 'playerLevel' in (t.get('data') or {}))
            _bad = []
            for _i, _v in enumerate(cpm_table.CPM):
                _lv = cpm_table.level_for_index(_i)
                _a = _cp[int(_lv) - 1]
                _g = _a if _lv == int(_lv) else _math.sqrt((_a * _a + _cp[int(_lv)] ** 2) / 2)   # the game's half-level rule
                if abs(_v - _g) > 1e-7:
                    _bad.append('L%s %.9f vs %.9f' % (_lv, _v, _g))
            if _bad:
                fail('%d cpm_table entries differ from the game master by > 1e-7: %s' % (len(_bad), '; '.join(_bad[:6])),
                     'Rebuild them from playerLevel.cpMultiplier (a half level is sqrt((a^2+b^2)/2) of its neighbours) and '
                     're-derive the ranks; 20 half levels were off by up to 4.85e-6 until 2026-09-30.')
            else:
                ok('all %d entries within 1e-7 of the game master ladder (whole levels as listed, half levels '
                   'sqrt((a^2+b^2)/2))' % len(cpm_table.CPM))
        except Exception as _e:
            fail('cannot read the game master ladder (%s)' % _e, 'A present but unreadable game master proves nothing.')

    print('\n' + '=' * 78)
    if FAILURES:
        print('VERDICT: %d CONSTANT-DRIFT FAILURE(S) -- a game constant has more than one '
              'definition' % len(FAILURES))
        print('=' * 78)
        return 1
    print('VERDICT: ALL GAME CONSTANTS SINGLE-SOURCED')
    print('=' * 78)
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/check_freshness.py`:

```py
"""check_freshness.py -- fast bag-vs-DB freshness reporter.

Walks the LIVE PokemonBagImpl bag via Frida/IL2CPP and compares the set of
UIDs to the pokemon.db in_bag=1 rows.  Prints a concise freshness report:

    live bag size, DB in_bag size, new catches (live_only), gone (db_only),
    agreement %, DB file age, and a FRESH / RE-CRAWL NEEDED verdict.

Exit code 0 = fresh (zero drift), 1 = stale (drift detected).
Does NOT modify the DB -- read-only.

Usage:
    python system/scripts/check_freshness.py          # default pokemon.db
    python system/scripts/check_freshness.py other.db  # explicit path
"""
import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import time

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Resolve project root so we can import pogo_il2cpp regardless of cwd.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
_SCRIPT_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
_PROJECT_ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(_SCRIPT_DIR, '..', '..'))
sys.path.insert(0, _PROJECT_ROOT)

import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402


def _db_path_from_argv():
    """Return DB path: first CLI arg or <project_root>/pokemon.db."""
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        return sys.argv[1]
    return os.path.join(_PROJECT_ROOT, 'pokemon.db')


def _fmt_age(seconds):
    """Human-readable age string from seconds."""
    if seconds < 60:
        return f'{seconds:.0f}s'
    if seconds < 3600:
        return f'{seconds / 60:.1f}m'
    if seconds < 86400:
        return f'{seconds / 3600:.1f}h'
    return f'{seconds / 86400:.1f}d'


def main():
    db_file = _db_path_from_argv()
    if not os.path.isfile(db_file):
        print(f'ERROR: DB not found: {db_file}')
        return 2

    # -- DB read (fast, no Frida needed yet) --------------------------------
    conn = sqlite3.connect(f'file:{db_file}?mode=ro', uri=True)
    db_uids = {r[0] for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT uid_hex FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag = 1"
    )}

    # -- DB file age --------------------------------------------------------
    db_mtime = os.path.getmtime(db_file)
    db_age_s = time.time() - db_mtime
    db_age_str = _fmt_age(db_age_s)

    # -- Live bag walk via Frida --------------------------------------------
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print(f'Attached to PID {pid}')
    try:
        bag_addr = pg.pick_singleton(
            sess, 'Niantic.Holoholo.Internal', 'PokemonBagImpl'
        )
        live_map = pg.walk_bag_protos(sess, bag_addr)
        _graph = dict(getattr(sess, '_pogo_graph', None) or {})   # H03: the graph the walk above read, and its clock
    finally:
        sess.detach()

    # -- Convert decimal UIDs to 16-char hex --------------------------------
    live_uids = {f'{int(u) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF:016x}' for u in live_map}

    # -- Set comparison -----------------------------------------------------
    live_only = live_uids - db_uids    # new catches not in DB
    db_only   = db_uids - live_uids    # transferred since scan
    overlap   = live_uids & db_uids

    total_union = len(live_uids | db_uids)
    agreement = 100.0 * len(overlap) / max(1, total_union)

    # -- Report -------------------------------------------------------------
    print()
    print(f'Live bag size    : {len(live_uids)}')
    print(f'DB in_bag size   : {len(db_uids)}')
    print(f'DB file age      : {db_age_str} ({time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", time.localtime(db_mtime))})')
    print(f'New (live only)  : {len(live_only)}')
    print(f'Gone (DB only)   : {len(db_only)}')
    print(f'Agreement        : {agreement:.1f}%')
    print()

    # THE BAG WE COMPARED AGAINST MUST ITSELF BE LIVE (H03, 2026-09-29). A walk of the game's abandoned service graph
    # returns the same frozen uid set a frozen recrawl wrote -- this tool printed FRESH for exactly the state the
    # 05:06 / 05:09 / 05:11 culls were in. The graph's inventory age (phone clock) is printed with every verdict; past 5 min
    # it is flagged -- a quiet game is that old as often as a frozen one (review 2026-09-29: the catcher log shows 19 live
    # gaps > 5 min in 9,006 catches), so age alone never decides; the cull's walk tripwires judge a frozen graph (rc 8).
    try:
        _ts, _now = int(_graph.get('ts')), int(_graph.get('now'))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        _ts = _now = None
    print('Graph            : %s service graph(s); inventory of the walked graph updated %s before this read'
          % (_graph.get('bags') or '?', ('%.0f s' % ((_now - _ts) / 1000.0)) if (_ts and _now) else '? (unreadable)'))
    if _ts and _now and _now - _ts > 5 * 60 * 1000:
        print('  [WARN] that inventory is %.0f min old: a quiet game, or a frozen graph (then a re-crawl reads the same '
              'copy -- the cull stops itself with rc 8 when the catcher log proves it)' % ((_now - _ts) / 60000.0))
    if not live_only and not db_only:
        print('VERDICT: FRESH')
        conn.close()
        return 0

    print(f'VERDICT: RE-CRAWL NEEDED: '
          f'{len(live_only)} new, {len(db_only)} gone '
          f'-> run `python pogo_pipeline.py`')
    # Show a few samples so the user sees what drifted
    if live_only:
        sample = sorted(live_only)[:10]
        print(f'  sample new UIDs: {", ".join(sample)}')
    if db_only:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT uid_hex, species_name, cp FROM pokemon "
            "WHERE uid_hex IN ({}) LIMIT 10".format(
                ','.join('?' for _ in db_only)
            ),
            tuple(db_only),
        ).fetchall()
        if rows:
            print('  sample gone:')
            for uid, name, cp in rows:
                print(f'    {uid}  {name or "?"} CP{cp or "?"}')
    conn.close()
    return 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```

```py
"""clear_nicknames.py — clear custom Pokemon nicknames in bulk.

Calls Niantic.Holoholo.Internal.PokemonBagImpl.NicknamePokemon(PokemonProto, "")
with an EMPTY string. An empty nickname reverts a Pokemon to its default species
name — the same effect as clearing the name field in-game. Server-authoritative
(real RPC), mirrors the bulk_tag.js il2cpp_runtime_invoke pattern.

Modes:
  scan                  READ-ONLY. Count + sample the mons that have a custom nickname.
  test                  Scan, then clear exactly ONE nickname and verify via a fresh
                        bag re-walk (proves the mechanism, fully reversible).
  clear [--delay S]     Bulk: loop-until-dry. Each pass re-walks the bag, clears every
                        mon that STILL has a custom nickname (throttled by --delay,
                        default 0.15s), until a pass finds none (or --max-pass reached).
                        --limit N caps how many to clear (for a partial run).

Requires PoGo FOREGROUNDED (IL2CPP needs the app un-frozen).

def display(s):
    try:
        return repr(s)
    except Exception:
        return ascii(s)


def pid_names():
    try:
        c = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(ROOT, "pokemon.db"))
        return {r[0]: r[1] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT DISTINCT pokemon_id, species_name FROM pokemon WHERE pokemon_id IS NOT NULL")}
    except Exception:
        return {}


_AUTO_ONLY = False
_NAMES = {}


def _is_auto(nick, pidv):
    """The old rename-based labels: species name truncated, then 'VF<n>' (variant floor ordinal) or '100' (hundo),
    12 characters max. The prefix must be the start of THIS mon's species name, so a user's own name never matches."""
    import re
    m = re.match(r'^(.*?)\s?(VF\d|100)$', nick or '')
    if not m or not m.group(1):
        return False
    norm = lambda s: re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', (s or '').lower())
    pre = norm(m.group(1))
    # ANY species name, not only this mon's: an evolved mon keeps its pre-evolution's label ("Meowth VF2" on a
    # Persian, "Abra 100" on a Kadabra) -- 35 of those survived the first clear (2026-09-17)
    return bool(pre) and any(norm(n).startswith(pre) for n in _NAMES.values())


def read_custom(sc, bagmap, nick_off, pid_off):
    """Return list of (uid, proto, nickname, pid) for mons with a non-empty nickname (auto-label names only with
    --auto-only)."""
    uids = list(bagmap.keys())
    protos = [bagmap[u] for u in uids]
    data = sc.exports_sync.read_nicks(json.dumps(protos), nick_off, pid_off)
    return [(uids[i], protos[i], data[i][0], data[i][1]) for i in range(len(uids))
            if data[i][0] and (not _AUTO_ONLY or _is_auto(data[i][0], data[i][1]))]


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("mode", choices=["scan", "test", "clear"])
    ap.add_argument("--delay", type=float, default=0.15, help="seconds between clears (default 0.15)")
    ap.add_argument("--max-pass", type=int, default=4, help="max loop-until-dry passes (default 4)")
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="cap number cleared (0=all)")
    ap.add_argument("--auto-only", action="store_true",
                    help="only the old auto-label names '<species prefix>VF<n>' / '<species prefix>100' (2026-09-17)")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    names = pid_names()
    global _AUTO_ONLY, _NAMES
    _AUTO_ONLY, _NAMES = a.auto_only, names
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached pid", pid)
    try:
        bag = pg.pick_singleton(sess, "Niantic.Holoholo.Internal", "PokemonBagImpl")
        bagmap = pg.walk_bag_protos(sess, bag)
        print("bag mons:", len(bagmap))
        if not bagmap:
            print("FATAL: empty bag (is PoGo foregrounded?)")
            return
        sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, EXTRA_JS)
        try:
            protos = list(bagmap.values())
            off = sc.exports_sync.find_offsets(protos[0])
            nick_off, pid_off = off["nickOff"], off["pidOff"]
            print(f"PokemonProto={off['cls']}  nickname_@"
                  f"{hex(nick_off) if nick_off >= 0 else '??'}  "
                  f"PokemonId@{hex(pid_off) if pid_off >= 0 else '??'}  "
                  f"(originalOwnerNickname_@{hex(off['ooNickOff']) if off['ooNickOff'] >= 0 else '??'} — NOT touched)")
            if nick_off < 0:
                print("FATAL: nickname_ field not found")
                return

            custom = read_custom(sc, bagmap, nick_off, pid_off)
            print(f"\n{len(custom)} of {len(bagmap)} bag mons have a custom nickname.\n")
            print("sample (first 25):")
            for u, p, nk, pidv in custom[:25]:
                print(f"  {names.get(pidv, '#' + str(pidv)):<16} {display(nk)}")

            if a.mode == "scan":
                return

            print("\npriming classes:", sc.exports_sync.prime())

            if a.mode == "test":
                if not custom:
                    print("no custom nicknames to test on")
                    return
                u, p, nk, pidv = custom[0]
                print(f"\nTEST — clearing ONE: {names.get(pidv, '#' + str(pidv))} {display(nk)} (uid {u})")
                try:
                    r = sc.exports_sync.clear_one(bag, p)
                    print("  clear_one ->", r)
                except Exception as e:
                    print("  clear_one THREW:", e)
                    return
                time.sleep(2.5)
                bm2 = pg.walk_bag_protos(sess, bag)  # fresh — handles proto realloc
                np_ = bm2.get(u)
                if not np_:
                    print("  uid not found on re-walk")
                    return
                newnk = sc.exports_sync.read_one(np_, nick_off)
                print(f"  nickname after (fresh re-walk): {display(newnk)}")
                print("  RESULT:", "CLEARED ✓ (reverts to species name)" if not newnk
                      else f"STILL SET: {display(newnk)}")
                return

            if a.mode == "clear":
                total_ok = 0
                for pno in range(a.max_pass):
                    bm = pg.walk_bag_protos(sess, bag)  # fresh protos each pass
                    todo = read_custom(sc, bm, nick_off, pid_off)
                    if a.limit:
                        todo = todo[:a.limit]
                    print(f"\npass {pno + 1}: {len(todo)} custom nicknames to clear")
                    if not todo:
                        print("  none left — done.")
                        break
                    okc = errc = 0
                    for i, (u, p, nk, pidv) in enumerate(todo):
                        try:
                            r = sc.exports_sync.clear_one(bag, p)
                            if r.get("ok"):
                                okc += 1
                            else:
                                errc += 1
                                if errc <= 3:
                                    print("    err:", r)
                        except Exception as e:
                            errc += 1
                            if errc <= 3:
                                print("    threw:", e)
                        time.sleep(a.delay)
                        if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
                            print(f"    {i + 1}/{len(todo)}  (ok={okc} err={errc})")
                    total_ok += okc
                    print(f"  pass {pno + 1} done: ok={okc} err={errc}")
                    if a.limit:
                        break
                    time.sleep(1.0)

                bm = pg.walk_bag_protos(sess, bag)
                remaining = len(read_custom(sc, bm, nick_off, pid_off))
                print(f"\nTOTAL cleared this run: {total_ok}   remaining custom nicknames: {remaining}")
        finally:
            sc.unload()
    finally:
        sess.detach()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/deep_audit.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""DEEP audit -- goes beyond the 12-tag invariant check.

1. FORM CENSUS: every distinct (species, form) code in the bag resolved against the live
   PokemonDisplayProto.Form enum (form_enum.json) and classed base/regional/costume/form.
2. FALSE-NEGATIVE costume hunt: any 'form'-class code whose enum NAME contains a costume word
   (a costume costume_forms.py might have missed -> would sit untagged in the plain cull).
3. FALSE-POSITIVE hunt: any 'costume'-class code whose name contains a battle-form word.
4. REGIONAL-LEAK hunt: regional-named forms carrying a base-region tag (Raichu-class).
5. The full 12-tag invariant triple-check + completeness + transfer-safety + disjointness +
   accounting + enum-completeness + nonzero-merged + mis-fold.
"""
import sqlite3, json, sys, os
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(HERE))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT); sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
from references import LEGENDARY_IDS, MYTHICAL_IDS, ULTRA_BEAST_IDS, PARADOX_IDS
RARE = LEGENDARY_IDS | MYTHICAL_IDS | ULTRA_BEAST_IDS | PARADOX_IDS
from pvp_iv_rule import pvid, maxcp, GL_CAP, UL_CAP, VIABILITY_MARGIN
from costume_forms import is_costume_form, FORM_ENUM, classify
from costume_forms import _TYPE_FORM_SPECIES   # the ONE list of species whose forms are TYPE forms (Arceus, Silvally): 'Flying' there is a type
import keep_policy as kp

DB = os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db')
legacy = set(e['uid_hex'] for e in json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'legacy_accurate.json'), encoding='utf-8')))
gm = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'pvpoke_gamemaster.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
BS = {p['speciesId']: p.get('baseStats', {}) for p in gm['pokemon']}
seen = set(e['pid'] for e in json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokedex_hundos_live.json')))['entries'])
is_pre, term, dist, _ = kp.build_evo_graph(gm, seen)
GT = {415: {1: set(), 2: {416}}, 757: {1: set(), 2: {758}}, 361: {1: {362}, 2: {478, 362}},
      281: {1: {475, 282}, 2: {282}}, 280: {1: {475, 282}, 2: {282}}, 412: {1: {414}, 2: {413}}}


def reach(r):
    gt = GT.get(r['pokemon_id'])
    if gt is not None:
        return gt.get(r['gender'], set())
    sid = pvid(r['species_name'], r['form'] or 0)
    return term.get(sid, set()) if is_pre.get(sid) else set()


def main():
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB); c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    rows = c.execute("SELECT * FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1").fetchall()
    pr = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'system', 'analysis', 'policy_reasons.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    RM = pr['reasons'] if (isinstance(pr, dict) and isinstance(pr.get('reasons'), dict)) else pr
    keptu = set(r['uid_hex'] for r in rows if isinstance(RM.get(r['uid_hex']), list) and RM.get(r['uid_hex']))
    allu = set(r['uid_hex'] for r in rows); xferu = allu - keptu

    def T(r):
        return set(t for t in (r['auth_tag_names'] or '').split(';') if t)

    # ===== 1. FORM CENSUS =====
    formrec = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0, 0, 0])   # (pid,ff) -> [tot,kept,event,xfer]
    for r in rows:
        ff = r['fresh_form'] or 0; k = (r['pokemon_id'], ff); formrec[k][0] += 1
        if r['uid_hex'] in keptu: formrec[k][1] += 1
        if 'Event' in T(r): formrec[k][2] += 1
        if r['uid_hex'] in xferu: formrec[k][3] += 1
    byclass = Counter()
    for (pid, ff), v in formrec.items():
        byclass[(classify(FORM_ENUM.get(ff)) if ff else 'base')] += v[0]
    print("FORM-CLASS CENSUS (specimens):", dict(byclass), "| distinct codes:", len(formrec))

    # FULL-ENUM verification: classify EVERY game form (not just in-bag) so a year-less costume the
    # classifier would miss is caught BEFORE the user ever catches one.
    ACC_FULL = ('HAT', 'HOOD', 'MASK', 'GLASSES', 'SCARF', 'HELMET', 'WIG', 'OUTFIT', 'DRESS', 'TUXEDO',
                'KIMONO', 'YUKATA', 'PONCHO', 'SOMBRERO', 'BANDANA', 'VISOR', 'MONOCLE', 'GOGGLE', 'BEANIE',
                'FEDORA', 'FLOWERCROWN', 'STRAWHAT', 'EARMUFF', 'BOWTIE', 'CROCHET', 'FLYING', 'ANNIV',
                'PARTY', 'WITCH', 'SANTA', 'HALLOWEEN', 'HOLIDAY', 'DIWALI', 'GOFEST', 'GOTOUR', 'WCS',
                'JEJU', 'KURTA', 'HORIZON', 'POPSTAR', 'ROCKSTAR', 'LIBRE', 'STARMOBILE', 'FOSSIL')
    # FLYING TYPE-FORM GUARD (2026-09-30, costume option 5): Arceus and Silvally use 'Flying' as the TYPE (ArceusFlying, SilvallyFlying are plain
    # forms), exactly as costume_forms.classify() reads them -- without the same exemption here this hunt would report them as missed costumes
    # and print ISSUES ABOVE for a classifier that is right. Non-gating like the rest of this script.
    fullmiss = [n for f, n in FORM_ENUM.items() if classify(n) == 'form' and n and 'CROWNED' not in n.upper()
                and any(w in n.upper() for w in ACC_FULL if not (w == 'FLYING' and n.upper().startswith(_TYPE_FORM_SPECIES)))]
    print(f"FULL-ENUM costume misses (game-wide form-class w/ costume word): {fullmiss or 'none'}")

    BROAD = ('HAT', 'CAP', 'HOOD', 'MASK', 'GLASSES', 'SCARF', 'HELMET', 'WIG', 'COSTUME', 'OUTFIT',
             'DRESS', 'TUXEDO', 'KIMONO', 'YUKATA', 'PONCHO', 'SOMBRERO', 'BANDANA', 'VISOR', 'MONOCLE',
             'GOGGLE', 'BEANIE', 'FEDORA', 'HOLIDAY', 'PARTY', 'WITCH', 'SANTA', 'WEDDING', 'KURTA',
             'JEJU', 'HORIZON', 'FOSSIL', 'STARMOBILE', 'POPSTAR', 'ROCKSTAR', 'LIBRE', 'FLOWERCROWN',
             'EARS', 'HORNS', 'CROWN', 'SWIM', 'DIWALI', 'GOFEST', 'GOTOUR', 'WCS', 'ANNIV')
    # NB: bare SPRING/SUMMER/WINTER/FALL are NATURAL seasonal forms (Deerling/Sawsbuck), NOT
    # costumes -- excluded from the hunt; season COSTUMES carry a year and are caught already.
    BATTLE = ('ORIGIN', 'THERIAN', 'CROWNED', 'ATTACK', 'DEFENSE', 'SPEED', 'BLADE', 'SHIELD', 'ZEN',
              'HERO', 'STRIKE', 'AMPED', 'LOWKEY', 'INCARNATE', 'ALTERED', 'PRIMAL', 'MEGA', 'GMAX',
              'DYNAMAX', 'SUNSHINE', 'RAINY', 'SNOWY', 'SUNNY')
    fn = []; fp = []; leak = set()
    for (pid, ff), v in formrec.items():
        if not ff:
            continue
        nm = FORM_ENUM.get(ff); cls = classify(nm); u = (nm or '').upper()
        if cls == 'form' and nm and any(w in u for w in BROAD) and 'CROWNED' not in u:
            fn.append((nm, v[0], v[2]))
        if cls == 'costume' and nm and any(w in u for w in BATTLE):
            fp.append((nm, v[0]))
    for r in rows:
        ff = r['fresh_form'] or 0
        if ff and classify(FORM_ENUM.get(ff)) == 'regional' and (r['form_region'] or '').strip().lower() in ('', 'normal', 'kantonian', 'none', 'null'):
            leak.add((r['species_name'], FORM_ENUM.get(ff)))
    print("FALSE-NEG costume candidates ('form'-class w/ costume word):", fn or "none")
    print("FALSE-POS ('costume'-class w/ battle word):", fp or "none")
    print(f"REGIONAL-LEAK (regional name, base-region tag): {len(leak)} {sorted(leak)[:8]}")

    # ===== 2. 12-TAG TRIPLE-CHECK =====
    viol = defaultdict(list); count = defaultdict(int); misfold = 0; merged = 0; enum_missing = set()
    KEEP = {'GL IV', 'UL IV', 'XXL', 'Hundo', 'Nundo', 'Event', 'Best Buddy', 'Traded by E+F', 'Legacy Moves', 'Evolve 1', 'Evolve 2'}
    EF = lambda r: (r['is_traded'] == 1 or r['is_traded_flag_v2'] == 1 or r['is_lucky'] == 1) and (r['original_owner_name'] or '').strip().lower() in ('ethanmateovz', 'florandez')
    for r in rows:
        tg = T(r); iv = r['iv_total'] or 0; nm = r['species_name']; u = r['uid_hex']; ff = r['fresh_form'] or 0
        for t in tg:
            count[t] += 1
        if ff and ff not in FORM_ENUM: enum_missing.add(ff)
        if is_costume_form(r['form']) and not is_costume_form(ff): misfold += 1
        if ff and (r['form'] or 0) != ff: merged += 1
        if 'Hundo' in tg and iv != 45: viol['Hundo'].append(nm)
        if 'Nundo' in tg and not (r['iv_atk'] == 0 and r['iv_def'] == 0 and r['iv_sta'] == 0): viol['Nundo'].append(nm)
        if 'XXL' in tg and (r['pokemon_size_category'] or 0) != 5: viol['XXL'].append(nm)
        if 'Event' in tg and not (r['fresh_costume'] or r['special_bg_id'] or r['natural_art_background'] or r['fresh_has_location_card'] or is_costume_form(ff)): viol['Event'].append(nm)
        if 'Best Buddy' in tg and r['was_best_buddy_badge'] != 1: viol['Best Buddy'].append(nm)
        if 'Legacy Moves' in tg and u not in legacy: viol['Legacy Moves'].append(nm)
        for lab, sc, rc, cap in [('GL IV', 'gl_stage', 'gl_rank', GL_CAP), ('UL IV', 'ul_stage', 'ul_rank', UL_CAP)]:
            if lab in tg:
                stg = r[sc]; rk = r[rc]
                if not stg or maxcp(stg, BS) <= cap + VIABILITY_MARGIN: viol[lab].append(nm + 'UC')
                elif rk is None or rk > 5: viol[lab].append(f"{nm}rk{rk}")
                elif iv == 45: viol[lab].append(nm + 'H')
                elif pvid(nm, r['form'] or 0) == stg and (r['cp'] or 0) > cap: viol[lab].append(nm + 'OC')
        for ev, want in (('Evolve 1', 1), ('Evolve 2', 2)):
            if ev in tg:
                if not reach(r): viol[ev].append(nm)
                elif iv in (0, 45): viol[ev].append(f"{nm}iv{iv}")
                elif r['pokemon_id'] in RARE: viol[ev].append(nm + 'R')
                elif r['pokemon_id'] not in GT and dist.get(pvid(nm, r['form'] or 0), 0) != want: viol[ev].append(nm)
        if 'Transfer' in tg:
            bad = [x for x, cond in [('SH', r['fresh_shiny']), ('H', iv == 45), ('N', r['iv_atk'] == 0 and r['iv_def'] == 0 and r['iv_sta'] == 0), ('BB', r['was_best_buddy_badge'] == 1), ('CO', is_costume_form(ff)), ('OR', EF(r))] if cond]
            if bad: viol['Transfer-SAFETY'].append(f"{nm}:{'+'.join(bad)}")
            if tg & KEEP: viol['Transfer-DISJOINT'].append(nm)

    def comp(lab, tag, pred):
        q = [r for r in rows if pred(r)]; miss = [r for r in q if tag not in T(r)]
        return f"{lab} {count[tag]}/{len(q)}" + (" MISS!" + ",".join(m['species_name'] for m in miss[:4]) if miss else " ok")
    print("completeness:", comp('Hundo', 'Hundo', lambda r: (r['iv_total'] or 0) == 45), "|",
          comp('Nundo', 'Nundo', lambda r: r['iv_atk'] == 0 and r['iv_def'] == 0 and r['iv_sta'] == 0 and r['pokemon_id']), "|",
          comp('BB', 'Best Buddy', lambda r: r['was_best_buddy_badge'] == 1), "|",
          comp('Traded', 'Traded by E+F', EF))
    print(f"nonzero-merged {merged} | misfold {misfold} | forms-missing-from-enum {len(enum_missing)}")
    print(f"accounting: in_bag={len(allu)} kept={len(keptu)} xfer={len(xferu)} sum={len(keptu)+len(xferu)} overlap={len(keptu&xferu)}")
    anyv = False
    for t in ['Hundo', 'Nundo', 'XXL', 'Event', 'Best Buddy', 'Legacy Moves', 'GL IV', 'UL IV', 'Evolve 1', 'Evolve 2', 'Transfer-SAFETY', 'Transfer-DISJOINT']:
        if viol.get(t):
            anyv = True; print(f"  VIOL {t}: {len(viol[t])} " + "; ".join(viol[t][:8]))
    ok = not (anyv or merged or misfold or enum_missing or fn or fp or fullmiss or len(keptu & xferu))
    print("*** " + ("ISSUES ABOVE" if not ok else "ALL CLEAN (deep)") + " ***")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
"""DEEP per-specimen profiler. For EVERY in-bag mon, derive its full story:
identity, combat, PvP viability per league, current-vs-ideal moves + TM type,
and every actionable nuance (evolve-to-meta, lucky-trade, trade-evolve, power-up,
purify, transfer, collection significance). Deterministic over fresh DB +
PVPoke gamemaster/rankings. Writes system/analysis/deep_profiles.json and prints
a digest. Run AFTER pogo_pipeline.py (always re-crawl first).
"""
import sqlite3, json, re, os, sys, datetime

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(HERE))   # pogo_extract/

                         'elite': set(p.get('eliteMoves', [])), 'score_tags': p.get('tags', [])} for p in gm['pokemon']}

       'UL': {e['speciesId']: (e.get('moveset'), e.get('score')) for e in J('_ul2500.json')}}

             588:'Escavalier',616:'Accelgor',708:'Trevenant',710:'Gourgeist'}
LUCKY_OLD_MS = 1546300800000  # 2019-01-01

def mv(mid): return (MOVES.get(mid,'') or '').replace('_FAST','') if mid else None
def nm(x): return re.sub(r'[^A-Z0-9]','',(x or '').upper())
def form_name(pid, form):
    return (FC.get(f'{pid}_{form or 0}') or {}).get('form_name','')
def chain_rank(chain, species_id):
    if not chain: return None
    for seg in chain.split(';'):
        sid,_,rest = seg.partition(':')
        if sid==species_id:
            try: return int(rest.split('(')[0])
            except: return None
    return None
def tm_class(spid, move):
    p=POOL.get(spid)
    if not p: return '?'
    if move in p['elite']: return 'ELITE'
    if move in p['fast'] or move in p['charged']: return 'normal'
    return 'NA'

c = sqlite3.connect(f'file:{DB}?mode=ro', uri=True)
cur = c.execute("""SELECT uid_hex,pokemon_id,species_name,form,gender,cp,level,iv_atk,iv_def,iv_sta,iv_total,
 is_zero,fresh_shiny,is_lucky,is_legendary,is_mythical,is_ultra_beast,is_paradox,was_best_buddy_badge,
 fresh_has_location_card,fresh_alignment,fresh_bread_mode,fresh_costume,pokemon_size_category,can_mega_evolve,
 gl_rank,ul_rank,ll_rank,gl_stage,ul_stage,gl_chain_ranks,ul_chain_ranks,adventure_effects_left,
 creation_time_ms,hatched_from_egg,is_traded,is_traded_flag_v2,original_owner_name,move1,move2,move3,
 auth_tag_names,weather_boost,buddy_km_walked,has_mega_evolved,marked_remote_tradable,
 mega_Level,mega_Points,bread_mode,fresh_bread_count,bread_max_level
 FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1""")
COL={n:i for i,n in enumerate([d[0] for d in cur.description])}
rows=cur.fetchall(); c.close()
def g(r,k): return r[COL[k]]

# nuance pre-pass + cost helpers
from collections import Counter as _Ctr, defaultdict as _dd
_spcount=_Ctr((g(r,'pokemon_id'), g(r,'form') or 0) for r in rows)   # for OnlyOne / dupes
_mega=_dd(list)
for _r in rows:
    if g(_r,'can_mega_evolve')==1: _mega[g(_r,'pokemon_id')].append(_r)
megabest={pid:set(id(x) for x in sorted(lst,key=lambda r:g(r,'cp'),reverse=True)[:1]) for pid,lst in _mega.items()}
def _power_up_opp(lv, shadow, purified, lucky, pid, form):
    """'power-up->L50 (264 candy+296XL/492,600 dust)': the price from `lv` to L50 is the GAME MASTER's own, game_opportunities.power_up_cost
    (2026-09-30). This file used to keep a hand table -- L40 -> L50 at 340,000 dust / 290 XL where the game says 250,000 / 296, L20 -> L50
    at 840,000 dust where it says 475,000 -- with no candy, no shadow / purified / lucky multiplier and no species override (Eternatus).
    query.py powerup shows what is inside the ( ); an unknown price says so instead of guessing."""
    c = _go.power_up_cost(lv, 50.0, shadow=shadow, purified=purified, lucky=lucky, dex=pid, form=form)
    if not c:
        return 'power-up->L50 (cost unknown)'
    return 'power-up->L50 (%s%dXL/%s dust)' % ('%d candy+' % c['candy'] if c['candy'] else '', c['xl'], format(c['dust'], ','))
KEEP_FLAGS={'Legendary','Mythical','UltraBeast','Paradox','BestBuddy','Background','HUNDO','NUNDO',
            'Shadow','Purified','Costume','XXL','Gigantamax','Dynamax','SHUNDO','ShinyShadow'}

profiles=[]
for r in rows:
    pid=g(r,'pokemon_id'); form=g(r,'form') or 0
    fa=g(r,'fresh_alignment'); shadow=(fa==1)
    align='Shadow' if fa==1 else 'Purified' if fa==2 else 'Normal'
    cur_moves=[mv(g(r,'move1')),mv(g(r,'move2')),mv(g(r,'move3'))]
    cur_set={nm(x) for x in cur_moves if x}
    # PvP viability: best chain rank per league + whether species is in rankings (meta)
    p={'uid':g(r,'uid_hex'),'species':g(r,'species_name'),'form_name':form_name(pid,form),
       'align':align,'gender':{1:'M',2:'F',3:'-'}.get(g(r,'gender'),'?'),
       'shiny':bool(g(r,'fresh_shiny')),'lucky':bool(g(r,'is_lucky')),
       'iv':f"{g(r,'iv_atk')}/{g(r,'iv_def')}/{g(r,'iv_sta')}",'ivt':g(r,'iv_total'),
       'level':g(r,'level'),'cp':g(r,'cp'),'moves':[x for x in cur_moves if x],
       'tags':[t for t in (g(r,'auth_tag_names') or '').split(';') if t],'flags':[],'opps':[]}
    # collection flags
    for k,lab in [('is_legendary','Legendary'),('is_mythical','Mythical'),('is_ultra_beast','UltraBeast'),
                  ('is_paradox','Paradox'),('was_best_buddy_badge','BestBuddy'),('fresh_has_location_card','Background')]:
        if g(r,k)==1: p['flags'].append(lab)
    if g(r,'iv_total')==45: p['flags'].append('HUNDO')
    if g(r,'is_zero')==1 and pid!=0: p['flags'].append('NUNDO')
    if shadow: p['flags'].append('Shadow')
    if fa==2: p['flags'].append('Purified')
    if (g(r,'fresh_costume') or 0)!=0: p['flags'].append('Costume')
    if g(r,'pokemon_size_category')==5: p['flags'].append('XXL')
    if g(r,'fresh_bread_mode')==2: p['flags'].append('Gigantamax')
    elif g(r,'fresh_bread_mode')==1: p['flags'].append('Dynamax')
    _bml=g(r,'bread_max_level') or 0          # highest Max/GMax move level (breadMoves_)
    if _bml: p['max_move_level']=_bml; p['flags'].append(f"MaxMoveL{_bml}")
    if g(r,'hatched_from_egg')==1: p['flags'].append('Hatched')
    if g(r,'is_traded')==1 or g(r,'is_traded_flag_v2')==1:
        oo=g(r,'original_owner_name'); p['flags'].append(f"Traded{('<'+oo) if oo else ''}")
    if p['shiny'] and g(r,'iv_total')==45: p['flags'].append('SHUNDO')
    if p['shiny'] and shadow: p['flags'].append('ShinyShadow')
    if _spcount[(pid,form)]==1: p['flags'].append('OnlyOne')
    if g(r,'marked_remote_tradable')==1: p['flags'].append('RemoteTradable')
    if g(r,'has_mega_evolved')==1: p['flags'].append('MegaBuilt')
    if (g(r,'buddy_km_walked') or 0)>0 and 'BestBuddy' not in p['flags']: p['flags'].append('WasBuddy')
    if g(r,'mega_Level'): p['flags'].append(f"MegaL{g(r,'mega_Level')}"); p['mega_points']=g(r,'mega_Points')
    if (g(r,'adventure_effects_left') or 0)>0: p['flags'].append('AdventureEffect'); p['ae_left']=g(r,'adventure_effects_left')
    if id(r) in megabest.get(pid,()): p['flags'].append('MegaBest')
    # best league by lowest chain rank among GL/UL (rank already chain-aware)
    glr,ulr=g(r,'gl_rank'),g(r,'ul_rank')
    best_lg,best_rank=None,None
    for lg,rk in [('GL',glr),('UL',ulr)]:
        if rk is not None and (best_rank is None or rk<best_rank): best_lg,best_rank=lg,rk
    p['gl_rank'],p['ul_rank']=glr,ulr
    p['pvp']=None
    if best_lg and best_rank is not None and best_rank<=50:
        stage=g(r,'gl_stage') if best_lg=='GL' else g(r,'ul_stage')
        ms,score=REC[best_lg].get(stage,(None,None))
        viable = score is not None and score>=80   # PVPoke meta-relevant species
        p['pvp']={'league':best_lg,'rank':best_rank,'species_id':stage,'meta':viable}
        if ms:
            miss=[(m,tm_class(stage,m)) for m in ms if nm(m) not in cur_set]
            if miss: p['pvp']['need_moves']=[f"{m}[{cl}]" for m,cl in miss]
            if shadow and any(nm(x)=='FRUSTRATION' for x in cur_moves if x): p['pvp'].setdefault('need_moves',[]).append('clear FRUSTRATION[ELITE]')
        # evolve-to-meta: a REAL evolution (different National Dex #), not a form
        # variant (Hisuian/Galarian/Castform-weather share the current dex).
        stage_dex = SPDEX.get(stage)
        if stage and stage_dex and stage_dex != pid:
            p['opps'].append(f"evolve→{stage} (best {best_lg})")
            p['pvp']['evolve_to'] = stage
    # opportunities (trade-for-evos intentionally excluded — user has the candy)
    lv=g(r,'level')
    if (glr==1 or ulr==1 or g(r,'iv_total')==45) and lv<50:
        p['opps'].append(_power_up_opp(lv, shadow, fa==2, g(r,'is_lucky')==1, pid, form))
    if shadow:
        p['opps'].append('purify option (gains Return, ~10% cheaper to max)')
    if (g(r,'is_legendary')==1 or g(r,'is_mythical')==1) and g(r,'is_lucky')!=1:
        p['opps'].append('lucky-trade (half dust to max)')
    if g(r,'can_mega_evolve')==1 and 'CanMega' not in p['flags']: p['flags'].append('CanMega')
    special = any(f in KEEP_FLAGS for f in p['flags'])
    p['fodder']= (not p['tags']) and (not p['pvp']) and (not special) and ('OnlyOne' not in p['flags'])
    if p['fodder']: p['opps'].append('safe to transfer (duplicate, no value)')
    profiles.append(p)

# ---- assign PURPOSE via the unified keep-engine (SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH) ----
# Purpose is now a VIEW of cull_v9's keep-reason registry (mapped by keep_engine),
# so it can never drift from the cull decision or the tag rules again. This
# replaced three parallel purpose/keep implementations that disagreed on ~197 mons
# (shadow, best-buddy column, species top-N sort, Reserve-tag sync) on 2026-05-28.
_cc = sqlite3.connect(DB); _cc.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
_crows, _cctx = cull_v9._load_rows_and_ctx(_cc.cursor())
UID_REASONS = {r['uid_hex']: cull_v9.is_protected(r, _cctx) for r in _crows}
_cc.close()
for p in profiles:
    reasons = UID_REASONS.get(p['uid'], [])
    p['keep_reasons'] = reasons                                    # the "why kept" audit trail
    p['purpose'] = keep_engine.classify_purpose(reasons, p['ivt'])

# ---- agent-audit corrections: now a VALIDATION SET, not overrides -----------
# The 40-agent audit (purpose_corrections.json, 2026-05-28) PATCHED the old
# hand-written purpose logic. That logic is gone, replaced by the unified engine
# which fixes those bugs at the source. Applying the corrections as per-mon
# overrides would reintroduce purpose<->cull drift (the exact thing unification
# kills), so we DON'T override. Instead we cross-check: how many past judgments
# does the engine already satisfy? The rest are engine-tuning candidates. The
# file is preserved for that mining; nothing is silently lost.
_corr_path=os.path.join(ROOT,'system','analysis','purpose_corrections.json')
if os.path.exists(_corr_path):
    _by_uid={p['uid']:p for p in profiles}
    _match=_diff=_gone=0; _diffs=[]
    for _c in json.load(open(_corr_path,encoding='utf-8')):
        _p=_by_uid.get(_c['uid'])
        if not _p: _gone+=1; continue
        if _p['purpose']==_c['to']: _match+=1
        else: _diff+=1; _diffs.append((_c.get('species'),_c['to'],_p['purpose']))
    tot=_match+_diff
    print(f"Audit cross-check: engine matches {_match}/{tot} past judgments "
          f"({100*_match//max(tot,1)}%); {_diff} differ -> engine-tuning candidates, {_gone} uid gone.")
    json.dump([{'species':s,'audit_to':a,'engine':e} for s,a,e in _diffs],
              open(os.path.join(ROOT,'system','analysis','engine_tuning_candidates.json'),'w'),indent=1)

os.makedirs(os.path.join(ROOT,'system','analysis'),exist_ok=True)
json.dump(profiles,open(os.path.join(ROOT,'system','analysis','deep_profiles.json'),'w'),indent=1)
from collections import Counter as _PC
_pc=_PC(p['purpose'] for p in profiles)
print('\nPURPOSE (every mon has one):', dict(_pc), '  total',sum(_pc.values()))

# ---- digest ----
def dt(ms): return datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ms/1000,datetime.UTC).date() if ms else None
print(f"DEEP PROFILE — {len(profiles)} in-bag mons\n")
pvp=[p for p in profiles if p['pvp']]
meta=[p for p in pvp if p['pvp'].get('meta')]
print(f"PvP-ranked (best chain-rank ≤50): {len(pvp)}  | of meta-relevant species: {len(meta)}")

      f"shiny-shadow {sum('ShinyShadow' in p['flags'] for p in profiles)} | remote-tradable {sum('RemoteTradable' in p['flags'] for p in profiles)} | "
      f"can-mega {sum('CanMega' in p['flags'] for p in profiles)}")

      f"shadow {sum('Shadow' in p['flags'] for p in profiles)} | legendary {sum('Legendary' in p['flags'] for p in profiles)} | "
      f"lucky {sum(p['lucky'] for p in profiles)} | costume {sum('Costume' in p['flags'] for p in profiles)}")

    print(f"  {p['species']:<16} {p['align'][:4]:<4} {p['iv']}({p['ivt']}) L{p['level']} cp{p['cp']}  {';'.join(p['opps'])}")
print("\nEvolve-to-meta gems:")
for p in sorted(ev,key=lambda x:x['pvp']['rank'])[:10]:
    print(f"  {p['species']:<14} {p['iv']} rank {p['pvp']['rank']} {p['pvp']['league']}  -> {[o for o in p['opps'] if o.startswith('evolve')][0]}")
print(f"\nWrote system/analysis/deep_profiles.json ({len(profiles)} profiles).")
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/derive_ae_roster.py`:

```py
"""derive_ae_roster.py -- turn the game's LIVE Adventure-Effect registry into a species roster and check it
against what the cull actually protects. Offline; never touches the phone.

WHY (user, 2026-09-08: the AE roster "should be scanned every time"). keep_config.adventure_effect_pids was a
hand list. On 2026-09-08 the live registry (AdventureEffectService.adventureEffects, read in-walk by
pogo_pipeline.step_read_ae_registry into system/analysis/ae_registry_live.json) held 11 effects against the
9 the list knew: Mega Mewtwo X (Dynamic Punch+) and Mega Mewtwo Y (Future Sight+) were new. Mewtwo happened to
be protected by rarity keep-all, so nothing was exposed -- by luck, not by design. This script removes the luck.

HOW A MOVE BECOMES A SPECIES (three independent sources, unioned; every attribution is printed with its source):
  1. the registry's own desc_key ("dialga_move_content", "dusk_mane_move_content", "zacian_move_content"...)
  2. the HoloPokemonMove enum NAME for temp-evolution moves ("VmMoveTempEvolutionMegaXV0150PokemonMewtwo" -> 150)
  3. the PokeMiners / client game master: any pokemonSettings whose cinematicMoves / eliteCinematicMoves /
     nonTmCinematicMoves / formChange.moveReassignment.replacementMoves contain the move (by NAME or numeric id)

OUTPUT: system/analysis/ae_roster_derived.json {species:[dex...], by_species:{dex:[moves]}, unprotected:[dex...]}
EXIT: 0 = every derived species is protected (in adventure_effect_pids, or rarity_keep_all, or protected_keep_all)
      2 = a derived species is NOT protected by anything -> keep_config needs the pid (a human decision); the
          engine also unions the derived set defensively (see keep_policy AE_IDS), so this is belt AND braces.
      1 = no usable registry json (never guess a roster from memory)
"""
import sys, os, re, json, glob, time
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, '..', '..'))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
REG = os.path.join(ROOT, 'system', 'analysis', 'ae_registry_live.json')
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, 'system', 'analysis', 'ae_roster_derived.json')
MAX_AGE_DAYS = 14

# desc_key / enum-name hints -> dex. Kept tiny and obvious; source 3 does the general work.
HINTS = {'dialga': 483, 'palkia': 484, 'dusk_mane': 800, 'dawn_wings': 800, 'necrozma': 800, 'kyurem': 646,
         'ice_burn': 646, 'freeze_shock': 646, 'zacian': 888, 'zamazenta': 889, 'eternatus': 890, 'dynamax_cannon': 890,
         # Mega Mewtwo X / Y (2026-09-20). These used to resolve from the temp-evo ENUM NAME
         # ('VmMoveTempEvolutionMegaXV0150PokemonMewtwo' -> 150); the live read now returns a bare MOVE_495 / MOVE_496,
         # so that source went blind and Mewtwo silently dropped out of the derived roster. The desc_key still reads
         # correctly, so it is the fallback. (Mewtwo is rarity keep-all, so nothing was ever at risk.)
         'dynamic_punch_+': 150, 'future_sight_+': 150}


def load_gm():
    """Prefer the client game master PokeMiners publishes; fall back to nothing (source 3 then contributes 0)."""
    for cand in (os.path.join(ROOT, 'gamemaster_pokeminers.json'),
                 os.path.join(os.environ.get('SCRATCH', ''), 'gm_pokeminers.json')):
        if cand and os.path.exists(cand):
            try:
                return json.load(open(cand, encoding='utf-8'))
            except Exception:
                pass
    return []


def species_from_gm(gm, move_names, move_ids):
    hits = {}
    for t in gm:
        d = t.get('data', {}); ps = d.get('pokemonSettings')
        if not ps:
            continue
        m = re.match(r'V(\d{4})_POKEMON_', t.get('templateId', ''))
        if not m:
            continue
        dex = int(m.group(1))
        pool = set()
        for k in ('cinematicMoves', 'eliteCinematicMoves', 'nonTmCinematicMoves', 'eliteCinematicMove'):
            v = ps.get(k) or []
            pool |= set(v if isinstance(v, list) else [v])
        for fc in ps.get('formChange') or []:
            for mr in (fc.get('moveReassignment') or {}).get('cinematicMoves') or []:
                pool |= set(mr.get('replacementMoves') or []) | set(mr.get('existingMoves') or [])
        for mv in pool:
            if (isinstance(mv, str) and mv in move_names) or (isinstance(mv, int) and mv in move_ids):
                hits.setdefault(dex, set()).add(str(mv))
    return hits


def registry_vs_walk(reg, db=os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db')):
    """(read_this_walk, walk_stamp, read_local): was ae_registry_live.json written by the walk being judged? (H04)

    The in-walk read is fail-soft -- a failed read leaves the OLD json in place -- and this script rewrites
    ae_roster_derived.json on every pass, so the derived file's age (all audit_invariants looked at) proved nothing and
    the last line said "every live Adventure-Effect species is protected" over a registry of any age. The walk stamp is
    pokemon.db MAX(last_scanned) (local time, taken before the registry step of the same walk); 'generated' is UTC.
    None = cannot tell (no walk stamp / unparseable time). Third value: the registry read time in LOCAL time."""
    try:
        import calendar, sqlite3
        _c = sqlite3.connect('file:%s?mode=ro' % db.replace(chr(92), '/'), uri=True)
        try:
            ws = _c.execute('SELECT MAX(last_scanned) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1').fetchone()[0]
        finally:
            _c.close()
        if not ws:
            return None, None, None
        w = time.mktime(time.strptime(str(ws)[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'))
        try:
            g = calendar.timegm(time.strptime(str(reg.get('generated'))[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'))
        except Exception:
            return None, str(ws), None                   # the walk's time is known; the registry's is not (R-B review)
        return g >= w - 5, str(ws), time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', time.localtime(g))
    except Exception:
        return None, None, None


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(REG):
        print('NO REGISTRY: %s missing -- run a recrawl (pogo_pipeline reads it in-walk). Refusing to guess.' % REG)
        return 1
    reg = json.load(open(REG, encoding='utf-8'))
    age = (time.time() - os.path.getmtime(REG)) / 86400.0
    effects = reg.get('effects', [])
    print('registry: %d effects, %.1f days old (generated %s)' % (len(effects), age, reg.get('generated')))
    if age > MAX_AGE_DAYS:
        print('  WARN registry older than %d days -- a recrawl refreshes it' % MAX_AGE_DAYS)
    _this_walk, _walk, _read_local = registry_vs_walk(reg)
    # the line full_audit shows is the LAST one: a registry the judged walk did not re-read must say so THERE
    _stale = ('WARN: AE registry NOT read by this walk (registry %s, walk %s)'
              % ((_read_local or '?')[:16], (_walk or '?')[:16])) if _this_walk is False else (
        # CANNOT TELL IS NOT "OK" EITHER (R-B review): no walk stamp, or no parseable 'generated' in the registry
        'WARN: AE registry vs walk: cannot tell (generated %s, walk %s)' % (str(reg.get('generated'))[:20], (_walk or '?')[:16])
        if _this_walk is None else '')
    if _stale:
        print('  %s. The in-walk read is fail-soft: look for "[ae_registry] read FAILED" in the recrawl log.' % _stale)

    by_species = {}
    def attr(dex, move, src):
        by_species.setdefault(dex, set()).add('%s [%s]' % (move, src))

    move_names = set(); move_ids = set()
    _eff_names = []                                   # gm_name per effect, to find the ones nothing claims
    for e in effects:
        mv = e.get('move') or ('MOVE_%s' % e.get('move_id')); mid = e.get('move_id')
        move_ids.add(mid)
        # normalise the live enum name (V0394MoveRoarOfTime) to the game-master id (ROAR_OF_TIME)
        gm_name = re.sub(r'^V\d{4}Move', '', mv)
        gm_name = re.sub(r'(?<!^)(?=[A-Z])', '_', gm_name).upper()
        _eff_names.append((e, gm_name))
        move_names.add(gm_name); move_names.add(mv)
        # source 1: desc_key hints
        dk = (e.get('desc_key') or '').lower()
        for hint, dex in HINTS.items():
            if hint in dk or hint in gm_name.lower():
                attr(dex, gm_name, 'desc_key' if hint in dk else 'move-name')
        # source 2: temp-evo enum names carry the dex
        m = re.search(r'V(\d{4})Pokemon', mv)
        if m:
            attr(int(m.group(1)), mv, 'enum-name')

    gm = load_gm()
    for dex, moves in species_from_gm(gm, move_names, move_ids).items():
        for mv in moves:
            attr(dex, mv, 'game-master')
    print('game master templates consulted: %d' % len(gm))

    # FORM LEVEL (user 2026-09-09: "if it doesnt have the adventure effect, i dont want it tagged"). The in-game
    # 'Adventure Effect' filter counts the FORMS that carry the effect (Origin Dialga/Palkia, Black/White Kyurem,
    # Crowned Zacian/Zamazenta, Dusk Mane/Dawn Wings Necrozma, Eternatus), not every copy of the species: an
    # Altered Dialga can know Roar of Time and still has no effect. PvPoke's game master lists the effect move
    # only in the movepool of the form that has it, so: speciesIds whose charged/elite/legacy pool contains a
    # live-registry move = the AE-capable forms. keep_policy / preflight / audit_cull key rule 8 on THIS set
    # (via pvid(species, form)) and fall back to the species list only when this file is missing or stale.
    species_ids = {}
    try:
        _pv = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'pvpoke_gamemaster.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
        for p in _pv['pokemon']:
            pool = set(p.get('chargedMoves') or []) | set(p.get('eliteMoves') or []) | set(p.get('legacyMoves') or [])
            hit = sorted(pool & move_names)
            if hit:
                species_ids[p['speciesId']] = hit
    except Exception as _e:
        print('WARN: could not derive form-level speciesIds from pvpoke_gamemaster.json (%s)' % _e)
    print('\nADVENTURE-EFFECT FORMS (PvPoke speciesIds, %d):' % len(species_ids))
    for s, mv in sorted(species_ids.items()):
        print('   %-26s %s' % (s, ', '.join(mv)))

    import keep_config as kc
    ae = set(kc.ae_pids())
    rk = set(getattr(kc, 'rarity_keep_all', lambda: [])()) | set(getattr(kc, 'rarity_ladder_pids', lambda: [])())   # Mewtwo's
    #      league ladder (2026-09-26) keeps every special copy; its "effects" are the Mega X/Y evolutions no copy knows
    pk = set(getattr(kc, 'protected_pids', lambda: [])())
    derived = sorted(by_species)
    unprotected = [d for d in derived if d not in ae and d not in rk and d not in pk]
    print('\nDERIVED ADVENTURE-EFFECT SPECIES (%d):' % len(derived))
    for d in derived:
        tag = 'AE roster' if d in ae else ('rarity keep-all' if d in rk else ('protected keep-all' if d in pk else '*** UNPROTECTED ***'))
        print('   #%-4d %-22s %s' % (d, tag, '; '.join(sorted(by_species[d]))[:110]))
    stale = sorted(ae - set(derived))
    if stale:
        print('in keep_config but NOT derived from the live registry (review, over-protection only): %s' % stale)
    json.dump({'schema': 2, 'generated': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()), 'registry_generated': reg.get('generated'),
               'species': derived, 'by_species': {str(k): sorted(v) for k, v in by_species.items()},
               'species_ids': species_ids,          # FORM level: PvPoke speciesId -> AE moves (schema 2, 2026-09-09)
               'unprotected': unprotected, 'configured': sorted(ae),
               'registry_this_walk': _this_walk, 'walk': _walk},     # H04: False = judged on an older registry read
              open(OUT, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=1)
    print('-> %s' % os.path.relpath(OUT, ROOT))
    if unprotected:
        print('*** %d derived species have NO protection in keep_config: %s -- add to adventure_effect_pids ***' % (len(unprotected), unprotected))
        return 2
    # AN ENTRY NOTHING CLAIMS IS UNCHECKED, NOT PROTECTED (2026-09-20). `unprotected` can only list species this
    # script managed to map, so a live effect whose move maps to NO species never reached it -- and the OK below
    # printed anyway. It first fired on MOVE_495/496 -- Mega Mewtwo X/Y's moves, which had only lost their enum NAME;
    # a desc_key HINT fixed that. (I first mis-called them 'moves no species learns yet': normal learnsets never list
    # temp-evolution moves, so searching them proves nothing.) A future unmapped entry gets the same treatment:
    # WARN every pass so a HINT gets added; BLOCK only when something in the bag actually carries one.
    _claimed = {v.split(' [')[0] for vs in by_species.values() for v in vs}
    _orph = [e for e, gn in _eff_names if gn not in _claimed]
    if _orph:
        _ids = sorted({int(e['move_id']) for e in _orph if e.get('move_id') is not None})
        print('*** WARN: %d live Adventure-Effect entr%s map to NO species, so protection cannot be checked: %s'
              % (len(_orph), 'y' if len(_orph) == 1 else 'ies',
                 ', '.join('%s (%s)' % (e.get('move') or e.get('move_id'), e.get('desc_key')) for e in _orph)))
        try:
            import sqlite3
            _c = sqlite3.connect('file:%s?mode=ro' % os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db').replace(chr(92), '/'), uri=True)
            _q = ','.join('?' * len(_ids))
            _n = _c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND (move1 IN (%s) OR move2 IN (%s) OR move3 IN (%s))'
                            % (_q, _q, _q), _ids * 3).fetchone()[0] if _ids else 0
            _c.close()
        except Exception as _e:
            print('*** cannot check bag exposure (%s) -- treating as exposed' % _e); _n = 1
        if _n:
            print('*** %d in-bag mon(s) CARRY an unmapped Adventure-Effect move -- add a HINT for it before culling ***' % _n)
            return 2
        # The LAST line is the only one full_audit.py shows, so the warning has to BE that line or nobody sees it
        # (2026-09-20: it printed above an 'OK' and was swallowed every cull).
        print('WARN: %d Adventure-Effect entr%s unmapped (%s) -- not carried by any bag mon; add a HINT'
              % (len(_orph), 'y' if len(_orph) == 1 else 'ies', ', '.join(str(i) for i in _ids)))
        if _stale:
            print('%s +%d unmapped' % (_stale, len(_orph)))           # <= 110 chars: full_audit cuts there
        return 0
    if _stale:                                   # NOT "every LIVE species": the judged walk did not read the registry
        print(_stale)                                              # <= 110 chars: full_audit cuts there
        return 0
    print('OK: every live Adventure-Effect species is protected.')
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```
