```py
def main():
    print('[*] connecting (Tailscale 100.98.158.56:5555)...')
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print(f'[*] attached pid={pid}')

    # capture singletons via hook
    hs = sess.create_script(pg.JS_PREAMBLE + '\n' + HOOK_JS)
    hs.on('message', lambda m, d: None)
    hs.load()
    hs.exports_sync.hook_setup()
    print('[*] Open the Today/Research screen so QuestService + I18n fire (up to 60s)...')
    q = i = None
    for _ in range(60):
        time.sleep(1)
        g = hs.exports_sync.hook_get()
        if g.get('q'):
            q = g['q']
        if g.get('i'):
            i = g['i']
        if q and i:
            break
    hs.unload()
    if not q:
        print('[!] NO QuestService instance captured. Interact with the Research UI and retry.')
        sess.detach()
        sys.exit(1)
    if not i:
        print('[!] WARNING: no I18n instance — titles will show raw i18n keys.')
    print(f'[*] QuestService={q}  I18n={i}')

    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, READER_JS)
    res = sc.exports_sync.read_research(q, i or '0', PROBE)
    sc.unload()
    sess.detach()

    if 'error' in res:
        print('[!]', res['error'])
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"\n=== ACTIVE RESEARCH ({res['questCount']}) ===")
    print(f"[reward list getter in use: {res.get('rewardGetterUsed')}]")
    KEY = ('GOFEST', 'MEWTWO', 'IRL_CITY', 'DISTRICT', 'TOKYO', 'APAC', 'WAINA', '2026')

    def show_quest(q, indent='  '):
        flag = '  <<<' if any(k in (q.get('templateId') or '').upper() for k in KEY) else ''
        gtxt = ''
        gs = q.get('goals', {})
        if gs.get('goals'):
            tgts = [str(g.get('target')) for g in gs['goals'] if g.get('target') is not None]
            if tgts:
                gtxt = ' target=' + '/'.join(tgts)
        print(f"{indent}[{STATUS.get(q['status'], q['status'])}] type={q['questType']} prog={q['progress']}{gtxt} {q['templateId']}{flag}")
        if q.get('title'):
            print(f"{indent}    title: {q['title']}")
        if q.get('desc') and q['desc'] != q.get('title'):
            print(f"{indent}    desc:  {q['desc']}")
        for st in q.get('subTasks', []) or []:
            print(f"{indent}    step:  {st}")
        for rw in q.get('rewards', []) or []:
            t = rw.get('type')
            if t == 'POKEMON_ENCOUNTER':
                ex = []
                if rw.get('form'):
                    ex.append(f"form={rw['form']}")
                if rw.get('shiny'):
                    ex.append('SHINY')
                if rw.get('shinyProb'):
                    ex.append(f"shinyP={rw['shinyProb']}")
                if rw.get('featured'):
                    ex.append('FEATURED')
                print(f"{indent}    REWARD ENCOUNTER pid={rw.get('pid')} {' '.join(ex)}")
            elif t == 'MEGA_ENERGY':
                print(f"{indent}    REWARD MEGA_ENERGY pid={rw.get('pid')} tevo={TEVO.get(rw.get('tempEvoId'), rw.get('tempEvoId'))} amt={rw.get('amount')}")
            elif t == 'ITEM':
                print(f"{indent}    REWARD ITEM id={rw.get('itemId')} x{rw.get('count')}")
            else:
                print(f"{indent}    REWARD {t} {json.dumps({k: v for k, v in rw.items() if k not in ('cls', 'type', 'wrapCls', 'caseInt')})}")
        for sq in q.get('subQuests', []) or []:
            show_quest(sq, indent + '    ')

    for q in res['active']:
        show_quest(q)

    if res.get('probe'):
        print('\n--- PROBE: raw oneof getters on quest#0 reward#0 (lock RewardOneofCase int map) ---')
        print(json.dumps(res['probe'], indent=2))

    print('\n--- secondListProbe (QuestsProto+0x20 element class) [DEVICE] ---')
    print(json.dumps(res.get('secondListProbe'), indent=2))

    print(f"\n=== completedIds ({len(res['completedIds'])}) — event-relevant ===")
    for c in res['completedIds']:
        if any(k in c.upper() for k in KEY):
            print('  ', c)

    if JSON_OUT:
        with open(JSON_OUT, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
            json.dump(res, fh, indent=2)
        print(f"\n[*] wrote {JSON_OUT}")
    print('\n[NOTE] TEMP_EVOLUTION ordinals + reward getter name are [DEVICE]-flagged; verify vs --probe.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Dump the live PokemonDisplayProto.Form enum (id->name), then resolve the Tauros /
Rotom form IDs in the collection to DEFINITIVELY answer whether the GO Fest shiny
debuts (Aqua Paldean Tauros, Wash Rotom) are caught. READ-ONLY, no guessing."""
import sys, os, sqlite3
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r'''
var P=null, CGN,CGF,FGN,FGFlags,FSGV,CGNT,FGT,CFT,TGN;
function _p(){ if(CGN) return; _ensureInit(); var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
  function nf(n,r,a){return new NativeFunction(il.getExportByName(n),r,a);}
  CGN=nf('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
  CGF=nf('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
  FGN=nf('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
  FGFlags=nf('il2cpp_field_get_flags','int',['pointer']);
  FSGV=nf('il2cpp_field_static_get_value','void',['pointer','pointer']);
  CGNT=nf('il2cpp_class_get_nested_types','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
  FGT=nf('il2cpp_field_get_type','pointer',['pointer']);
  CFT=nf('il2cpp_class_from_type','pointer',['pointer']);
  TGN=nf('il2cpp_type_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
  var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var asms=IL2.dGA(IL2.dG(),sp); var na=sp.readS32();
  for(var a=0;a<na;a++){ var im=IL2.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if(IL2.iGN(im).readCString()==='holo-protos.dll'){ P=im; break; } }
}
function dumpLits(cls){ var out={}; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  while((f=CGF(cls,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ var fl=FGFlags(f); if((fl&0x10)&&(fl&0x40)){ var nm=FGN(f).readCString(); if(nm!=='value__'){ var b=Memory.alloc(8); b.writeU64(0); FSGV(f,b); out[b.readS32()]=nm; } } }catch(e){} } return out; }

rpc.exports.dumpForm = function(){ _p(); if(!P) return {err:'no holo-protos'};
  var disp=IL2.cFN(P, Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'), Memory.allocUtf8String('PokemonDisplayProto'));
  if(!disp||disp.isNull()) return {err:'no PokemonDisplayProto class'};
  var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f, formType=null, fieldName=null, fields=[];
  while((f=CGF(disp,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ var nm=FGN(f).readCString(); fields.push(nm); var lo=nm.toLowerCase(); if(lo==='form_'||lo==='form'){ formType=FGT(f); fieldName=nm; } }catch(e){} }
  if(!formType){ var it2=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it2.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f2;
    while((f2=CGF(disp,it2))&&!f2.isNull()){ try{ var nm2=FGN(f2).readCString(); if(nm2.toLowerCase().indexOf('form')>=0){ formType=FGT(f2); fieldName=nm2; break; } }catch(e){} } }
  if(!formType) return {err:'no form field', fields:fields};
  var tn=TGN(formType).readCString();
  var formCls=CFT(formType); if(!formCls||formCls.isNull()) return {err:'no class from form type '+tn};
  var m=dumpLits(formCls);
  return {ok:true, typeName:tn, fieldName:fieldName, count:Object.keys(m).length, map:m};
};
'''


def main():
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
    print('[*] connecting...')
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print('[*] attached', pid)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    r = sc.exports_sync.dump_form()
    sc.unload()
    sess.detach()
    if not r.get('ok'):
        print('[!] Form enum dump failed:', r.get('err'), '| nested types seen:', r.get('nested'))
        return
    fmap = {int(k): v for k, v in r['map'].items()}
    print(f"[*] Form enum: {r['count']} entries")

    c = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db'))
    c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    cols = [x[1] for x in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(pokemon)')]
    shinyc = 'is_shiny' if 'is_shiny' in cols else ('shiny' if 'shiny' in cols else None)

    for pid_, nm in {128: 'Tauros', 479: 'Rotom', 25: 'Pikachu', 10: 'Caterpie'}.items():
        print(f'\n=== {nm} ({pid_}) by form (name resolved from live enum) ===')
        q = (f"SELECT display_form f, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN {shinyc} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sh "
             f"FROM pokemon WHERE pokemon_id=? GROUP BY display_form ORDER BY n DESC")
        for row in c.execute(q, (pid_,)):
            fid = row['f']
            fname = fmap.get(fid, '??') if fid is not None else '(null/base)'
            print(f"   form={str(fid):>6} {fname:30s} count={row['n']:3d} shiny={row['sh'] or 0}")

    print('\n=== GO FEST SHINY-DEBUT VERDICT ===')
    for label, kw in [('Aqua Paldean Tauros', ('TAUROS', 'AQUA')),
                      ('Wash Rotom', ('ROTOM', 'WASH'))]:
        forms = [(i, n) for i, n in fmap.items() if all(k in n.upper() for k in kw)]
        if not forms:
            print(f'{label}: NO matching form in enum (kw={kw}) -> cannot resolve')
            continue
        for fid, fn in forms:
            row = c.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN {shinyc} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sh "
                            f"FROM pokemon WHERE display_form=?", (fid,)).fetchone()
            have = row[0]
            shiny = row[1] or 0
            verdict = 'SHINY DEBUT CAUGHT' if shiny > 0 else ('have non-shiny' if have else 'NOT CAUGHT AT ALL')
            print(f'{label}  [{fn} = form {fid}]: have {have}, shiny {shiny}  -> {verdict}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/enumerate_nearby.py`:

```py
"""#2 Step A (READ-ONLY): enumerate nearby WildMapPokemon instances and read encounterId/pokemonId/cp/
spawn/visible via simple property getters. Verifies the auto-catcher's target enumeration works and
shows what's catchable right now. No catches, no encounters opened."""
import sys, os, json
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
 function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
 H={dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),OGC:b("il2cpp_object_get_class","pointer",["pointer"]),CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),cMN:b("il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","int"]),rI:b("il2cpp_runtime_invoke","pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer","pointer"]),tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"]),dGet:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[])};
 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}
function inv0(inst,name){var h=H_();var k=h.OGC(ptr(inst));if(k.isNull())return null;var m=h.cMN(k,Memory.allocUtf8String(name),0);if(!m||m.isNull())return null;var exc=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);exc.writePointer(ptr(0));var ret=h.rI(m,ptr(inst),ptr(0),exc);if(!exc.readPointer().isNull())return null;return ret;}
function rstr(p){try{if(p.isNull())return null;var len=p.add(0x10).readS32();if(len<0||len>200)return null;return p.add(0x14).readUtf16String(len);}catch(e){return null;}}
rpc.exports.clsName=function(inst){var h=H_();try{return h.CGN(h.OGC(ptr(inst))).readCString();}catch(e){return null;}};
rpc.exports.wmp=function(inst){
 var out={};
 try{var r=inv0(inst,"get_EncounterId");out.encId=r?r.add(0x10).readU64().toString():null;}catch(e){}
 try{var r=inv0(inst,"get_PokemonId");out.pid=r?r.add(0x10).readS32():null;}catch(e){}
 try{var r=inv0(inst,"get_Cp");out.cp=r?r.add(0x10).readS32():null;}catch(e){}
 try{var r=inv0(inst,"get_VisibleOnMap");out.vis=r?!!r.add(0x10).readU8():null;}catch(e){}
 try{var r=inv0(inst,"get_SpawnPointId");out.spawn=rstr(r);}catch(e){}
 return out;
};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
        sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
        try:
            for cls in ["WildMapPokemon", "MapPokemon"]:
                r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton("Niantic.Holoholo.Map", cls)
                hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
                print(f"\n== {cls}: {len(hits)} instance(s) ==")
                shown = 0
                seen = set()
                for h in hits:
                    if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != cls:
                        continue
                    info = sc.exports_sync.wmp(h)
                    # a real spawn has a pokemon id (or cp, or is visible) — encounterId may be 0 until requested
                    if not (info.get("pid") or info.get("cp") or info.get("vis")):
                        continue
                    key = info.get("encId") or h
                    if key in seen:
                        continue
                    seen.add(key)
                    print(f"   @{h}  enc={info.get('encId')} pid={info.get('pid')} cp={info.get('cp')} vis={info.get('vis')} spawn={info.get('spawn')}")
                    shown += 1
                    if shown >= 25:
                        break
                if shown == 0:
                    print("   (no instances with a pokemonId/cp/visible — no active spawns near you right now)")
        finally:
            try: sc.unload(); finder.unload()
            except Exception: pass
    finally:
        try: sess.detach()
        except Exception: pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/explore_sfida.py`:

```py
"""READ-ONLY deep reflector for PoGo's Go Plus ("Sfida"/PGP) subsystem.

Iterates holo-game.dll classes, finds every Sfida/Pgp/GoPlus/autocatch/wearable
class, and dumps each one's fields (name@offset:type) + methods (ret name(params)).
Saves the full map to system/analysis/pokemod/sfida_classes.json and prints the
timing/range-relevant members (interval, range, distance, radius, scan, catch,
spin, delay, period, cooldown, countdown, etc.) so we can find the cadence/range
knobs the virtual Go Plus rides on. WRITES NOTHING to the game.
"""
import sys, os, json, re
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))  # game_read -> scripts -> system -> root
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "analysis", "pokemod", "sfida_classes.json")

EXTRA_JS = r"""
var _R=null;
function _refl(){ if(_R) return _R; _ensureInit(); var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so'); var e={};
  il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
  function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
  _R={
    IGCC:b('il2cpp_image_get_class_count','uint32',['pointer']),
    IGC: b('il2cpp_image_get_class','pointer',['pointer','uint32']),
    CN:  b('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
    CNS: b('il2cpp_class_get_namespace','pointer',['pointer']),
    CGF: b('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),
    FGN: b('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
    FGT: b('il2cpp_field_get_type','pointer',['pointer']),
    FGO: b('il2cpp_field_get_offset','uint32',['pointer']),
    CGM: b('il2cpp_class_get_methods','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),
    MGN: b('il2cpp_method_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
    MGPC:b('il2cpp_method_get_param_count','int',['pointer']),
    MGP: b('il2cpp_method_get_param','pointer',['pointer','int']),
    MGRT:b('il2cpp_method_get_return_type','pointer',['pointer']),
    TGN: b('il2cpp_type_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
  };
  return _R;
}
function _cs(p){ try{return p.isNull()?'':p.readCString();}catch(e){return '';} }

rpc.exports.findClasses = function(rx){
  _ensureInit(); var R=_refl(); var re=new RegExp(rx,'i');
  var n=R.IGCC(GAME_IMAGE); var out=[];
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ var k=R.IGC(GAME_IMAGE,i); if(k.isNull())continue; var nm=_cs(R.CN(k)); if(nm && re.test(nm)){ out.push({ns:_cs(R.CNS(k)), name:nm, addr:k.toString()}); } }
  return out;
};

rpc.exports.dumpClassByAddr = function(addrStr){
  _ensureInit(); var R=_refl(); var k=ptr(addrStr);
  var rec={ns:_cs(R.CNS(k)), name:_cs(R.CN(k)), fields:[], methods:[]};
  var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  while((f=R.CGF(k,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ rec.fields.push(_cs(R.FGN(f))+'@0x'+R.FGO(f).toString(16)+':'+_cs(R.TGN(R.FGT(f)))); }catch(e){} }
  var it2=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it2.writePointer(ptr(0)); var m;
  while((m=R.CGM(k,it2))&&!m.isNull()){ try{ var nm=_cs(R.MGN(m)); var pc=R.MGPC(m); var ps=[]; for(var i=0;i<pc;i++){ var p=R.MGP(m,i); ps.push(p&&!p.isNull()?_cs(R.TGN(p)):'?'); } rec.methods.push(_cs(R.TGN(R.MGRT(m)))+' '+nm+'('+ps.join(',')+')'); }catch(e){} }
  return rec;
};
"""

KW = re.compile(r"interval|range|distance|radius|\btime|scan|catch|spin|delay|period|cooldown|tick|loop|\brate|countdown|nearby|enabled|encounter|throw|sec\b|_ms\b|millis|duration|frequency|throttle", re.I)


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached pid", pid)
    try:
        sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, EXTRA_JS)
        try:
            matches = sc.exports_sync.find_classes(r"sfida|pgp|goplus|gotcha|autocatch|wearable")
            matches.sort(key=lambda m: (m["ns"], m["name"]))
            print(f"\n=== {len(matches)} matching classes in holo-game.dll ===")
            for m in matches:
                print(f"  {m['ns']}.{m['name']}")

            full = {}
            for m in matches:
                d = sc.exports_sync.dump_class_by_addr(m["addr"])
                full[f"{m['ns']}.{m['name']}"] = d
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
            with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(full, f, indent=1)
            print(f"\nfull dump -> {OUT}")

            # curated behavioral classes to spotlight
            CUR = re.compile(r"SoftSfida|PgpService|PgpDevice|ScannedSfida|SfidaSession|AutoCatch|SfidaScan|Wearables.*(Service|Controller|Manager)", re.I)
            for key, d in full.items():
                if not CUR.search(d["name"]):
                    continue
                print(f"\n================ {key} ================")
                print(f"  [{len(d['fields'])} fields, {len(d['methods'])} methods]")
                hf = [x for x in d["fields"] if KW.search(x)]
                hm = [x for x in d["methods"] if KW.search(x)]
                print("  -- timing/range FIELDS --")
                for x in (hf or ["(none matched keywords)"]):
                    print(f"     {x}")
                print("  -- timing/range METHODS --")
                for x in (hm or ["(none matched keywords)"]):
                    print(f"     {x}")
        finally:
            sc.unload()
    finally:
        sess.detach()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/extract_pokemod_js.py`:

```py
"""Runtime RE: the Pokemod agent (main_agent/vpgp_agent) is a browserify-bundled JS app,
decrypted in PoGo memory. Locate the range(s) holding the bundle (browserify marker
'(require,module,exports)') and walk them out to .js files so the source — including the
PokemodSettings module + VPGP catch/spin logic — can be read. READ-ONLY."""
import sys, os
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402
OUTDIR = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "analysis", "pokemod")

JS = r"""
function hexOf(s){var h=[];for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++){var c=s.charCodeAt(i).toString(16);h.push(c.length<2?"0"+c:c);}return h.join(" ");}
rpc.exports.findStr=function(needle){
  var pat=hexOf(needle);var out=[];
  Process.enumerateRanges("r--").forEach(function(r){ if(r.file||r.size<1024||r.size>268435456)return;
    try{var h=Memory.scanSync(r.base,r.size,pat);if(h.length){out.push({rbase:r.base.toString(),rsize:r.size,hits:h.length});}}catch(e){}});
  return out;
};
rpc.exports.walkAll=function(baseStr,size){
  var base=ptr(baseStr);var out=[];var i=0;var total=Math.min(size,12582912);var iter=0;
  while(i<total && iter<12000000){iter++;
    var s=null;try{s=base.add(i).readUtf8String();}catch(e){s=null;}
    if(s===null||s.length===0){i+=1;continue;}
    out.push(s);
    var adv=1;try{adv=unescape(encodeURIComponent(s)).length+1;}catch(e){adv=s.length+1;}
    i+=adv;
    if(out.length>600000)break;
  }
  return {strings:out,iters:iter};
};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        rngs = {}
        for mk in ["(require,module,exports)", "PokemodSettings", "toast.vpgp"]:
            for r in sc.exports_sync.find_str(mk):
                rngs.setdefault(r["rbase"], r)
        rngs = {rb: r for rb, r in rngs.items() if r["rsize"] < 16 * 1024 * 1024}
        print(f"{len(rngs)} JS-bundle candidate ranges")
        os.makedirs(OUTDIR, exist_ok=True)
        for rb, r in rngs.items():
            res = sc.exports_sync.walk_all(rb, r["rsize"])
            blob = "\n".join(res["strings"])
            fn = os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"agent_js_{rb}.js")
            with open(fn, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(blob)
            print(f"  {rb} size {r['rsize']}: {len(res['strings'])} strings, {len(blob)} bytes -> {os.path.basename(fn)}")
        sess.detach()
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()

```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/find_goplus_range.py`:

```py
"""Locate the ~40m Go-Plus / interaction range field by NAME (proto field names are NOT
obfuscated). Search holo-protos.dll classes for interaction/range/plus/fort/gym/radius
fields, then read live values to find the ~40 gate. READ-ONLY."""

import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

var H=null;

   }catch(e){}}}
 return out;
};
"""

    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/find_vpgp_config.py`:

```py
"""Runtime RE: dump the Pokemod VPGP3 agent's DECRYPTED config string table from
PoGo live memory. readByteArray returns null on Vector-mapped ranges, but
readUtf8String works, so we WALK each config range string-by-string. Locates ranges
via distinctive markers (reconnect_when_in_set / vpgp / auto_*), excludes the huge GC
heaps, dumps every null-terminated string, saves to disk, prints config-looking ones.
READ-ONLY."""
import sys, os, re
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "system", "analysis", "pokemod", "vpgp_mem.txt")

JS = r"""
function hexOf(s){var h=[];for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++){var c=s.charCodeAt(i).toString(16);h.push(c.length<2?"0"+c:c);}return h.join(" ");}
rpc.exports.findStr=function(needle){
  var pat=hexOf(needle);var out=[];
  Process.enumerateRanges("r--").forEach(function(r){ if(r.file||r.size<256||r.size>268435456)return;
    try{var h=Memory.scanSync(r.base,r.size,pat);if(h.length){out.push({rbase:r.base.toString(),rsize:r.size,hits:h.length,addr:h[0].address.toString()});}}catch(e){}});
  return out;
};
rpc.exports.diag=function(addrStr){
  var a=ptr(addrStr);var r={};
  try{r.utf8=a.readUtf8String(80);}catch(e){r.utf8err=e.message;}
  try{var b=a.readByteArray(48);r.ba=b?("got "+b.byteLength+" bytes"):"null";}catch(e){r.baerr=e.message;}
  try{r.u8=a.readU8();}catch(e){r.u8err=e.message;}
  return r;
};
rpc.exports.walkStrings=function(baseStr,size,minLen){
  var base=ptr(baseStr);var out=[];var i=0;var total=Math.min(size,4194304);var iter=0;
  while(i<total && iter<3000000){ iter++;
    var s=null;try{s=base.add(i).readUtf8String();}catch(e){s=null;}
    if(s===null||s.length===0){i+=1;continue;}
    if(s.length>=minLen)out.push(s);
    var adv=1;try{adv=unescape(encodeURIComponent(s)).length+1;}catch(e){adv=s.length+1;}
    i+=adv;
    if(out.length>40000)break;
  }
  return {strings:out,iters:iter};
};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        markers = ["reconnect_when_in_set", "vpgp", "Spacial", "auto_spin", "auto_catch",
                   "catch_delay", "spin_delay", "spin_when", "catch_when"]
        ranges = {}
        diag_addr = None
        for mk in markers:
            for r in sc.exports_sync.find_str(mk):
                ranges.setdefault(r["rbase"], r)
                if mk == "reconnect_when_in_set" and not diag_addr:
                    diag_addr = r["addr"]
        if diag_addr:
            print("diag @", diag_addr, "->", sc.exports_sync.diag(diag_addr))
        small = {rb: r for rb, r in ranges.items() if r["rsize"] < 8 * 1024 * 1024}
        print(f"\nwalking {len(small)} small ranges (excluded {len(ranges)-len(small)} huge GC heaps):")
        allstr = []
        for rb, r in small.items():
            res = sc.exports_sync.walk_strings(rb, r["rsize"], 3)
            print(f"  {rb} size {r['rsize']}: {len(res['strings'])} strings ({res['iters']} iters)")
            allstr += res["strings"]
        sess.detach()
        seen = set(); uniq = []
        for s in allstr:
            if s not in seen:
                seen.add(s); uniq.append(s)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
        with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write("\n".join(uniq))
        print(f"\ndumped {len(uniq)} unique strings -> {OUT}")
        rx = re.compile(r"(catch|spin|delay|interval|range|ball|berry|throw|radius|cooldown|reconnect|vpgp|vgp|auto|enabl|disabl|\bmax|\bmin|speed|fast|slow|distance|encounter|when_in|setting|config|mode|tick|rate|_ms|_s\b|spawn|stop|nearby|button|haptic|notif|sleep|scan)", re.I)
        cfg = [s for s in uniq if rx.search(s) and 2 < len(s) < 80]
        print(f"\n=== {len(cfg)} config-looking strings ===")
        for s in cfg[:300]:
            print("  ", s)
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/live_watch.py`:

```py
"""TRACK-1 live watch: sample the on-phone catcher log every ~12s for 3 min, compute
per-interval deltas + rates, flag anomalies / errors / reconnects. Read-only (no Frida,
no gadget contention) — just tails the log over adb."""
import subprocess, time, re

LOG = "/data/data/com.termux/files/home/pogo/system/analysis/pokemod/catch_loop.log"
DEV = "100.98.158.56:5555"
DUR = 180

def tail(n=6):
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", DEV, "shell", f"su -c 'tail -n {n} {LOG}'"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
        return r.stdout.splitlines()
    except Exception as e:
        return [f"<tail error: {e}>"]

FIELDS = [("run", r"run (\d+)s"), ("dust", r"now (\d+) dust"), ("gain", r"\+(\d+) this run"),
          ("rate", r"\((\d+)/min\)"), ("fired", r"fired=(\d+)"), ("caught", r"caught=(\d+)"),
          ("esc", r"esc=(\d+)"), ("flee", r"flee=(\d+)"), ("miss", r"miss=(\d+)"),
          ("skip", r"skipPhantom=(\d+)"), ("q", r"q=(\d+)"), ("vis", r"vis=(\d+)"),
          ("inr", r"inr=(\d+)"), ("P", r"P=(\d+)"), ("G", r"G=(\d+)"), ("U", r"U=(\d+)"), ("pc", r"pc=(\d+)")]

def parse(line):
    d = {}
    for k, p in FIELDS:
        m = re.search(p, line)
        if m:
            d[k] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(r"skipPhantom=\d+ (\{[^}]*\})", line)
    if m:
        d["skipd"] = m.group(1)
    m = re.search(r"tally=(\{[^}]*\})", line)
    if m:
        d["tally"] = m.group(1)
    return d

print("=== TRACK-1 LIVE WATCH (3 min) ===", flush=True)
t0 = time.time()
prev = None
seen = set()
while time.time() - t0 < DUR:
    lines = tail(6)
    for ln in lines:
        s = ln.strip()
        if any(x in s for x in ("link drop", "waiting for PoGo", "connected pid", "stopped (all balls", "Traceback", "reconnect")):
            if s not in seen:
                seen.add(s)
                print(f"  [EVENT @ +{int(time.time()-t0)}s] {s}", flush=True)
    summ = [ln for ln in lines if ("run " in ln and "caught=" in ln)]
    cur = parse(summ[-1]) if summ else None
    if cur and prev:
        dC = cur.get('caught', 0) - prev.get('caught', 0)
        dFL = cur.get('flee', 0) - prev.get('flee', 0)
        dSK = cur.get('skip', 0) - prev.get('skip', 0)
        dF = cur.get('fired', 0) - prev.get('fired', 0)
        dD = cur.get('dust', 0) - prev.get('dust', 0)
        dP = cur.get('P', 0) - prev.get('P', 0)
        fl = ""
        if dFL > 0:
            fl += f"  !!FLEE+{dFL}"
        if cur.get('q', 0) > 5:
            fl += f"  !Q={cur['q']}"
        if dF == 0 and cur.get('q', 0) > 0:
            fl += "  !STALL(q>0,no-throw)"
        if cur.get('P', 999) < 10:
            fl += "  !BALLS_LOW"
        print(f"  +{int(time.time()-t0):>3}s | dCaught={dC} dFlee={dFL} dSkip={dSK} dFired={dF} | dDust={dD} dPoke={dP} | q={cur.get('q')} vis={cur.get('vis')} pc={cur.get('pc')} skip={cur.get('skipd')} tally={cur.get('tally')}{fl}", flush=True)
    elif cur:
        print(f"  baseline | caught={cur.get('caught')} flee={cur.get('flee')} skip={cur.get('skip')} dust={cur.get('dust')} P={cur.get('P')} q={cur.get('q')}", flush=True)
    if cur:
        prev = cur
    time.sleep(12)

print("=== END ===", flush=True)
if prev:
    print(f"FINAL | caught={prev.get('caught')} flee={prev.get('flee')} skipPhantom={prev.get('skip')} {prev.get('skipd')} dust={prev.get('dust')} balls(P/G/U)={prev.get('P')}/{prev.get('G')}/{prev.get('U')}", flush=True)
print(f"distinct events: {len(seen)}", flush=True)
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/measure_catch_timing.py`:

```py
"""EMPIRICAL: is VPGP's catch rate network-bound (server round-trips) or device-paced?
Hooks EncounterProto.WriteTo + CatchPokemonProto.WriteTo with timestamps. Computes:
  - inter-catch interval (gap between consecutive catch requests) = the throughput cadence
  - encounter->catch gap (same encounterId) ~= encounter round-trip latency
If interval ~= a couple round-trips -> network-bound (better connection helps, safely).
If interval >> round-trip -> fixed pacing (network won't help). READ-ONLY."""
import sys, time, os, statistics
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
 function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
 H={dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]),iGN:b("il2cpp_image_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),cFN:b("il2cpp_class_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer"]),cMN:b("il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","int"]),cGF:b("il2cpp_class_get_fields","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),fGN:b("il2cpp_field_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),fGO:b("il2cpp_field_get_offset","uint32",["pointer"]),tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"])};

function fo(o,subs){for(var k in o){var lk=k.toLowerCase();for(var i=0;i<subs.length;i++)if(lk===subs[i]||lk===subs[i]+"_")return o[k];}for(var k in o){var lk=k.toLowerCase();for(var i=0;i<subs.length;i++)if(lk.indexOf(subs[i])>=0)return o[k];}return -1;}

 var h=H_();var pim=img("holo-protos.dll");if(!pim)return{err:"no holo-protos"};

};
rpc.exports.results=function(){return {enc:enc,cat:cat};};

def med(xs):
    return statistics.median(xs) if xs else None


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        st = sc.exports_sync.setup()
        print("setup:", st)
        if st.get("err"):
            return
        secs = 60
        print(f"\ncollecting {secs}s — keep VPGP catching...")
        time.sleep(secs)
        r = sc.exports_sync.results()
        sess.detach()
        cat = sorted(r["cat"], key=lambda x: x["t"])
        enc = sorted(r["enc"], key=lambda x: x["t"])
        print(f"\nencounter reqs: {len(enc)}   catch reqs: {len(cat)}")
        series = cat if len(cat) >= 2 else enc
        label = "catch" if len(cat) >= 2 else "encounter"
        if len(series) < 2:
            print("Too few events to time. Re-run while VPGP is actively catching.")
            return
        print(f"(timing on {label} requests; Go Plus catches via the Sfida action log, not CatchPokemonProto)")
        intervals = [series[i]["t"] - series[i - 1]["t"] for i in range(1, len(series))]
        cat = series
        encmap = {}
        for e in enc:
            encmap.setdefault(e["enc"], []).append(e["t"])
        gaps = []
        for c in cat:
            ts = [t for t in encmap.get(c["enc"], []) if t <= c["t"]]
            if ts:
                gaps.append(c["t"] - max(ts))
        span = (cat[-1]["t"] - cat[0]["t"]) / 1000.0
        rate = (len(cat) - 1) / span if span > 0 else 0
        print("\n=== catch timing ===")
        print(f"  inter-catch interval: median={med(intervals):.0f}ms  min={min(intervals)}ms  max={max(intervals)}ms")
        print(f"  encounter->catch gap (~encounter RTT): median={med(gaps):.0f}ms  (n={len(gaps)})" if gaps else "  encounter->catch gap: n/a")
        print(f"  effective rate: {rate:.2f} catches/sec  (~{rate*60:.0f}/min)")
        print(f"  all intervals (ms): {[int(x) for x in intervals]}")
        mi = med(intervals)
        print("\n=== read ===")
        if mi and mi < 800:
            print(f"  ~{mi:.0f}ms/catch — dominated by server round-trips. A LOWER-LATENCY connection would speed this up (safe). Request RATE is the ban-risky lever — don't.")
        else:
            print(f"  ~{mi:.0f}ms/catch — slower than a raw round-trip, so there's built-in pacing between catches; a faster network won't help much, and forcing the rate up is the ban vector.")
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/measure_vpgp_catch_reach.py`:

```py
"""EMPIRICAL (corrected): measure the REAL VPGP Go-Plus catch reach via the action log.
  - WildMapPokemon.Initialize(WildPokemonProto) -> record every on-map mon {encId:(lat,lng,pid)}
  - PgpActivityMonitor.xek(ActionLogEntry) [=HandleActionLog] -> invoke get_CatchPokemon();

import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""

rpc.exports.results=function(){return {monPos:monPos,catches:catches,pidOff2:pidOff2};};
"""


def hav(a, b):
    R = 6371000.0
    dp = math.radians(b[0] - a[0]); dl = math.radians(b[1] - a[1])
    x = math.sin(dp / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(math.radians(a[0])) * math.cos(math.radians(b[0])) * math.sin(dl / 2) ** 2
    return 2 * R * math.asin(min(1, math.sqrt(x)))


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        st = sc.exports_sync.setup()
        print("setup:", st)
        secs = 75
        print(f"\ncollecting {secs}s — WALK so fresh mons appear; let VPGP catch...")
        time.sleep(secs)
        r = sc.exports_sync.results()
        sess.detach()
        mons = r["monPos"]; cats = r["catches"]
        print(f"\non-map mons seen: {len(mons)}   action-log catches: {len(cats)}   (catch PokemonId offset: {r['pidOff2']})")
        if len(mons) < 4:
            print("too few mons to estimate center — walk more / re-run."); return
        center = (statistics.median([p["lat"] for p in mons.values()]),
                  statistics.median([p["lng"] for p in mons.values()]))
        vis = sorted(hav(center, (p["lat"], p["lng"])) for p in mons.values())
        # caught distance = nearest on-map mon of the caught species
        print("  catches (enc,pid):", [(c.get("enc"), c.get("pid")) for c in cats])
        caught_d = []
        by_enc = 0
        for c in cats:
            p = mons.get(c.get("enc")) if c.get("enc") else None
            if p:
                caught_d.append(hav(center, (p["lat"], p["lng"]))); by_enc += 1
            else:
                cands = [hav(center, (q["lat"], q["lng"])) for q in mons.values() if q["pid"] == c["pid"]]
                if cands:
                    caught_d.append(min(cands))
        caught_d.sort()
        print(f"  matched: {by_enc} by encId, {len(caught_d)-by_enc} by species, {len(cats)-len(caught_d)} unmatched")

        def rep(name, ds):
            if not ds:
                print(f"  {name}: none"); return
            print(f"  {name}: n={len(ds)}  median={ds[len(ds)//2]:.0f}m  MAX={max(ds):.0f}m")
        print("\n=== distance from player-center ===")
        rep("VISIBLE mons", vis)
        rep("CAUGHT by Go Plus (action log)", caught_d)
        print(f"     caught dists: {[round(x) for x in caught_d]}")
        if caught_d and vis:
            print(f"\n>>> visible reaches ~{max(vis):.0f}m; Go-Plus CATCH reaches ~{max(caught_d):.0f}m. "
                  f"{'REACH IS GATED BELOW VISIBILITY (your observation confirmed).' if max(vis)-max(caught_d) > 35 else 'catch ~ visible.'}")
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/measure_vpgp_range.py`:

```py
def hav(a, b):
    R = 6371000.0

    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        st = sc.exports_sync.setup()
        print("setup:", st)
        if st.get("err"):
            return
        secs = 90
        print(f"\ncollecting {secs}s — keep PoGo on the map with VPGP catching...")
        time.sleep(secs)
        res = sc.exports_sync.results()
        sess.detach()
        mons = res["monPos"]
        print(f"\nwild mons seen: {len(mons)}   engage events: {len(res['engaged'])}")
        if len(mons) < 5:
            print("Too few mons captured — GetMapObjects may not have refreshed. Move a bit / re-run.")
            return
        lats = [p["lat"] for p in mons.values()]
        lngs = [p["lng"] for p in mons.values()]
        center = (statistics.median(lats), statistics.median(lngs))
        print(f"estimated player center: {center[0]:.6f}, {center[1]:.6f}")

        def dist(enc):
            p = mons.get(enc)
            return hav(center, (p["lat"], p["lng"])) if p else None

        vis = sorted(hav(center, (p["lat"], p["lng"])) for p in mons.values())
        eng = sorted(d for d in (dist(e["enc"]) for e in res["engaged"]) if d is not None)

        def rep(name, ds):
            if not ds:
                print(f"  {name}: none"); return
            print(f"  {name}: n={len(ds)}  median={ds[len(ds)//2]:.0f}m  p90={ds[int(len(ds)*0.9)]:.0f}m  MAX={max(ds):.0f}m")
        print("\n=== distance from player-center ===")
        rep("VISIBLE mons", vis)
        rep("ENGAGED by VPGP", eng)
        print(f"     engaged distances: {[round(x) for x in eng]}")
        print("\n(player-center is estimated as the median of visible spawns; expect +/-15-30m. "
              "Default encounter range ~40m; SpawnBooster sets 140.)")
        if eng:
            vmax = max(vis); emax = max(eng)
            if emax > 70:
                print(f"\n>>> VERDICT: VPGP engages mons out to ~{emax:.0f}m — catch range DOES extend (not visibility-only).")
            elif vmax > 90 and emax < 60:
                print(f"\n>>> VERDICT: visible to ~{vmax:.0f}m but VPGP only engages within ~{emax:.0f}m — VISIBILITY-ONLY; catch range NOT extended.")
            else:
                print(f"\n>>> VERDICT: engaged max ~{emax:.0f}m (visible ~{vmax:.0f}m) — inconclusive, re-run with more catches.")
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/measure_vpgp_reach2.py`:

```py
"""EMPIRICAL v2: measure VPGP Go-Plus catch reach via the TARGET handler (not the action log).
  - WildMapPokemon.Initialize(self, WildPokemonProto) -> pos[self_ptr]=(lat,lng)  [every visible mon]
  - PgpActivityMonitor.xeh(self, IMapPlace, IMapPokemon) -> targets.push(arg2_ptr)  [mons the Go-Plus engages]
Target ptr == the WildMapPokemon instance ptr, so we look up its recorded position.
max(targeted distance) = catch reach;  max(visible distance) = how far you can SEE.
If targeted maxes well below visible -> the reach gate is confirmed + quantified. READ-ONLY."""
import sys, time, math, os, statistics
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
 function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
 H={dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]),iGN:b("il2cpp_image_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),cFN:b("il2cpp_class_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer"]),cMN:b("il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","int"]),cGM:b("il2cpp_class_get_methods","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),mGN:b("il2cpp_method_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),mGPC:b("il2cpp_method_get_param_count","int",["pointer"]),mGP:b("il2cpp_method_get_param","pointer",["pointer","int"]),tGN:b("il2cpp_type_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),cGF:b("il2cpp_class_get_fields","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),fGN:b("il2cpp_field_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),fGO:b("il2cpp_field_get_offset","uint32",["pointer"]),tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"])};
 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}
function img(name){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()===name)return im;}return null;}
function ffield(cls,sub){var h=H_();var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var f;var ex=-1,su=-1;while((f=h.cGF(cls,it))&&!f.isNull()){try{var nm=h.fGN(f).readCString().toLowerCase();var off=h.fGO(f);if(nm===sub||nm===sub+"_"){if(ex<0)ex=off;}else if(nm.indexOf(sub)>=0){if(su<0)su=off;}}catch(e){}}return ex>=0?ex:su;}
function fparam(cls,name,sub){var h=H_();var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var m;while((m=h.cGM(cls,it))&&!m.isNull()){try{if(h.mGN(m).readCString()===name&&h.mGPC(m)===1){var pt=h.mGP(m,0);if(pt&&!pt.isNull()&&h.tGN(pt).readCString().indexOf(sub)>=0)return m;}}catch(e){}}return null;}
var pos={},targets=[],OFF={};
rpc.exports.setup=function(){
 var h=H_();var pim=img("holo-protos.dll"),gim=img("holo-game.dll");
 var WP=h.cFN(pim,Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc"),Memory.allocUtf8String("WildPokemonProto"));
 OFF.lat=ffield(WP,"latitude");OFF.lng=ffield(WP,"longitude");

 var mInit=WMP.isNull()?null:fparam(WMP,"Initialize","WildPokemonProto");

 var st={};
 if(mInit&&!mInit.isNull()){var ad=mInit.readPointer();if(!ad.isNull()){Interceptor.attach(ad,{onEnter:function(a){try{var self=a[0].toString();var p=a[1];var la=p.add(OFF.lat).readDouble(),lo=p.add(OFF.lng).readDouble();if(la!==0&&Math.abs(la)<=90)pos[self]={lat:la,lng:lo};}catch(e){}}});st.init=true;}}
 if(mXeh&&!mXeh.isNull()){var ad2=mXeh.readPointer();if(!ad2.isNull()){Interceptor.attach(ad2,{onEnter:function(a){try{var t=a[2];if(t.isNull())return;targets.push({ptr:t.toString(),t:Date.now()});}catch(e){}}});st.xeh=true;}}
 return {OFF:OFF,hooks:st,haveInit:!(mInit===null||(mInit&&mInit.isNull())),haveXeh:!(mXeh===null||(mXeh&&mXeh.isNull()))};
};
rpc.exports.results=function(){return {pos:pos,targets:targets};};
"""


def hav(a, b):
    R = 6371000.0
    dp = math.radians(b[0] - a[0]); dl = math.radians(b[1] - a[1])
    x = math.sin(dp / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(math.radians(a[0])) * math.cos(math.radians(b[0])) * math.sin(dl / 2) ** 2
    return 2 * R * math.asin(min(1, math.sqrt(x)))


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        st = sc.exports_sync.setup()
        print("setup:", st)
        secs = 70
        print(f"\ncollecting {secs}s — WALK normally and let VPGP catch...")
        time.sleep(secs)
        r = sc.exports_sync.results()
        sess.detach()
        pos = r["pos"]; targets = r["targets"]
        print(f"\nvisible mons (Initialize): {len(pos)}   Go-Plus target events (xeh): {len(targets)}")
        if len(pos) < 4:
            print("too few mons — walk more / re-run."); return
        center = (statistics.median([p["lat"] for p in pos.values()]),
                  statistics.median([p["lng"] for p in pos.values()]))
        vis = sorted(hav(center, (p["lat"], p["lng"])) for p in pos.values())
        # de-dupe target ptrs, match to recorded positions
        seen, tgt_d, matched = set(), [], 0
        for t in targets:
            if t["ptr"] in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(t["ptr"])
            p = pos.get(t["ptr"])
            if p:
                tgt_d.append(hav(center, (p["lat"], p["lng"]))); matched += 1
        tgt_d.sort()
        print(f"unique targets: {len(seen)}   matched to a position: {matched}")

        def rep(name, ds):
            if not ds:
                print(f"  {name}: none"); return
            print(f"  {name}: n={len(ds)}  median={ds[len(ds)//2]:.0f}m  MAX={max(ds):.0f}m")
        print("\n=== distance from player-center ===")
        rep("VISIBLE mons", vis)
        rep("GO-PLUS TARGETED (caught reach)", tgt_d)
        if tgt_d:
            print(f"     targeted dists: {[round(x) for x in tgt_d]}")
        if tgt_d and vis:
            gate = max(tgt_d)
            print(f"\n>>> you SEE to ~{max(vis):.0f}m; Go-Plus TARGETS to ~{gate:.0f}m. "
                  f"{'GATE CONFIRMED: catch reach < visible by %.0fm.' % (max(vis)-gate) if max(vis)-gate>30 else 'catch ~ visible (reach is NOT the limiter).'}")
        else:
            print("\n(no targets matched — xeh ptr may differ from WildMapPokemon; will reflect position instead.)")
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of("IapService")
    iap = None
    if ns:
        r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "IapService")
        best = None
        for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []):
            if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != "IapService":
                continue
            v = sc.exports_sync.read_i(h, "get_Stardusts")
            if v is not None and (best is None or v > best[1]):
                best = (h, v)
        iap = best[0] if best else None
    if not iap:
        print("no IapService"); sess.detach(); return

    def dust():
        return sc.exports_sync.read_i(iap, "get_Stardusts")

    print("sampling stardust...")
    pts = []
    for i in range(SAMPLES):
        d = dust(); t = time.time(); pts.append((t, d))
        if i > 0:
            dt = t - pts[i - 1][0]; dd = d - pts[i - 1][1]
            print(f"  {d:>8}  (+{dd} in {dt:.0f}s = {dd/dt*60:.0f}/min)")
        else:
            print(f"  {d:>8}  (start)")
        if i < SAMPLES - 1:
            time.sleep(INTERVAL)
    span = pts[-1][0] - pts[0][0]; gain = pts[-1][1] - pts[0][1]
    rate = gain / span * 60 if span > 0 else 0
    print(f"\nRATE: +{gain} over {span:.0f}s = {rate:.0f} stardust/min")
    if rate > 0:
        remain = GOAL - pts[-1][1]
        print(f"To 1,000,000: {remain:,} to go => ~{remain/rate/60:.1f} h at this rate (current {pts[-1][1]:,})")
    sess.detach()


main()
```

```py
"""PERSISTENT catch logger — runs continuously in the background, self-reconnecting through a lossy
link, appending every event to catch_log.txt so nothing in the gaps is missed:
  - VGP3 / Go-Plus catch   (hook PgpActivityMonitor.xek)

};
"""


def main():
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(LOG), exist_ok=True)
    f = open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8")

    def w(s):
        f.write(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {s}\n"); f.flush()

    w("===== logger session start =====")
    while True:
        try:
            sess, pid = pg.get_session()
            finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
            sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)

            def on_msg(m, d):
                if m.get("type") == "send":
                    p = m.get("payload", {})
                    if p.get("k") == "vgp3":
                        w("CATCH vgp3/go-plus")
                    elif p.get("k") == "manual":
                        w(f"CATCH manual ball={ITEM.get(p.get('ball'), p.get('ball'))}")
            sc.on("message", on_msg)

            info = sc.exports_sync.find_item_bag()
            ib = None
            if info:
                r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(info["ns"], info["cls"])
                for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []):
                    if sc.exports_sync.count(h, 1) >= 0:
                        ib = h; break
            st = sc.exports_sync.hook()
            w(f"attached pid={pid} hooks={st} itembag={'ok' if ib else 'NO'}")
            last = None
            while True:
                time.sleep(4)
                if ib:
                    inv = {ITEM[i]: sc.exports_sync.count(ib, i) for i in (1, 2, 3)}
                    if inv != last:
                        w(f"INV {inv}"); last = inv
        except Exception as e:
            w(f"--- link drop: {str(e)[:80]} — reconnecting ---")
            time.sleep(3)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/phase2_capture_v2.py`:

```py
ITEMS = {1: "Poke", 2: "Great", 3: "Ultra"}


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
        sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, MY_JS)
        try:
            ns = sc.exports_sync.class_ns("holo-game.dll", "ItemBag") or "Niantic.Holoholo.Internal"
            r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "ItemBag")
            hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
            ib = None
            for h in hits:
                if sc.exports_sync.count(h, 1) >= 0:
                    ib = h; break
            print(f"ItemBag ns={ns}, instance={ib}")
            if ib is None:
                print("could not read ItemBag counts (no good instance)"); return
            sc.exports_sync.hook_xek()
            before = {i: sc.exports_sync.count(ib, i) for i in ITEMS}
            print("balls BEFORE:", {ITEMS[i]: before[i] for i in ITEMS})
            print(f"\n*** Catch a batch for {HOLD}s — include deliberate BUTTON-PRESSES. ***")
            time.sleep(HOLD)
            after = {i: sc.exports_sync.count(ib, i) for i in ITEMS}
            cat = sc.exports_sync.catches()
            sess.detach()
            print("balls AFTER: ", {ITEMS[i]: after[i] for i in ITEMS})
            print(f"\ncatches (xek): {cat}")
            print("consumed:", {ITEMS[i]: before[i] - after[i] for i in ITEMS if before[i] >= 0 and after[i] >= 0})
            du = before[3] - after[3]; dp = before[1] - after[1]
            if du > 0 and dp == 0:
                print(">>> ULTRA used, Poke steady — WAINA throws Ultra. The earlier Poke must have been a non-button/auto catch.")
            elif dp > 0 and du == 0:
                print(">>> POKE used, Ultra steady — even your real WAINA throws Poke. The Ball=Ultra pref ISN'T driving it; something else (the button path?) is.")
            elif du > 0 and dp > 0:
                print(f">>> MIXED: {du} Ultra + {dp} Poke — button-presses vs auto likely explain the split. Tell me how many you button-pressed.")
        finally:
            try: sc.unload(); finder.unload()
            except Exception: pass
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/probe_holo_exports.py`:

```py
"""Find the exact libholoholo.so EXPORT names for the envelope + catch serializers we need to hook.
READ-ONLY one-shot."""
import sys, os, json
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

PATTERNS = {
    "GarProxy": ["GarProxy"],
    "ProxyRequest": ["ProxyRequest"],
    "any_InternalSerialize": ["_InternalSerialize"],
    "SfidaCapture_methods": ["SfidaCaptureRequest"],
    "SfidaUpdate_methods": ["SfidaUpdateRequest"],
    "MakeProtobufAction": ["MakeProtobufAction"],
    "RpcManager_send": ["RpcManager"],
    "EnqueueRpc": ["Enqueue"],
}

rpc.exports.search=function(patsJson){

 var ex=mod.enumerateExports();

  }
 }
 return {counts:counts, matches:out};
};
"""
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/probe_pokeball.py`:

```py
"""READ-ONLY probe of Niantic.Holoholo.Encounter.Pokeball.

Pokemod's Headshot/PerfectedThrow rebinds `HitGround` and `HitKillZone` to a System.Action that
calls SetActive(true) -- that is the hook that recovers a ball which lands, and it is the one I have
never implemented. Before building a delegate by hand I need the real shape: are HitGround /
HitKillZone FIELDS or events, what is their declared type, what does Initialize look like, and
where is SetActive declared. Guessing these is what produced four hung encounters.
"""
import os, sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
/* Resolve exactly the way Pokemod does: by FULL namespace + class name, via
   il2cpp_class_from_name. The preamble already exposes cFN(ns, cls) for this. Searching by bare
   class name across images was my own invention and is not how their `use(...)` works. */
var EX=null;

  _ensureInit();
  var h=IL2;var out={};
  var want=[["Niantic.Holoholo.Encounter","Pokeball"],
            ["Niantic.Holoholo.Encounter","Reticle"],
            ["Niantic.Holoholo.Encounter","EncounterPokemon"]];
  want.forEach(function(pair){
    var ns=pair[0],cn=pair[1];
    var k=null;try{k=cFN(ns,cn);}catch(e){}
    if(!k||k.isNull()){out[cn]={err:"class_from_name failed"};return;}
    var info={ns:ns,fields:[],methods:[]};
    /* Frida 17 has no Module.findExportByName -- the rest of this codebase resolves exports with
       Process.findModuleByName(...).enumerateExports(), so do the same. */
    if(!EX){EX={};Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so").enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){
      if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)EX[x.name]=x.address;});}
    function nf(n,r,a){return new NativeFunction(EX[n],r,a);}
    var fGet=nf("il2cpp_class_get_fields","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
    var fName=nf("il2cpp_field_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]);
    var fType=nf("il2cpp_field_get_type","pointer",["pointer"]);
    var fOff=nf("il2cpp_field_get_offset","uint32",["pointer"]);
    var tName=nf("il2cpp_type_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]);
    var mPC=nf("il2cpp_method_get_param_count","uint32",["pointer"]);
    var mP=nf("il2cpp_method_get_param","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]);
    var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var f;
    while((f=fGet(k,it))&&!f.isNull()){try{
      var tn="";try{tn=tName(fType(f)).readCString();}catch(e){}
      info.fields.push(fName(f).readCString()+"@"+fOff(f)+":"+tn);
    }catch(e){}}
    var it2=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it2.writePointer(ptr(0));var m;
    while((m=h.cGM(k,it2))&&!m.isNull()){try{
      var mn=h.mGN(m).readCString();
      if(!/Initialize|SetActive|HitGround|HitKillZone|Launch|OnCollision|Invulnerable|NormalizedSize|Bullseye|CanPerform/i.test(mn))continue;
      var pc=mPC(m),ps=[];
      for(var q=0;q<pc;q++){try{ps.push(tName(mP(m,q)).readCString());}catch(e){ps.push("?");}}
      info.methods.push(mn+"("+ps.join(", ")+")");
    }catch(e){}}
    out[cn]=info;
  });
  return out;
};
"""



def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        r = sc.exports_sync.probe() or {}
        for cls, info in r.items():
            print(f"\n===== {cls}  ns={info.get('ns')}  image={info.get('image')}")
            print("  -- fields --")
            for f in info.get("fields", []):
                print("    ", f)
            print("  -- methods of interest --")
            for m in info.get("methods", []):
                print("    ", m)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass
```

```py
"""READ-ONLY: dump live AdventureEffectService state (active effect type + applied bonus
data) and follow the applied-bonus object. Run before vs during Spacial Rend to see the
delta (which proves whether the server granted extra encounter/interaction reach)."""
import sys, os
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

EXTRA_JS = r"""
var _E=null;
function _e(){ if(_E)return _E; var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so'); var e={};
  il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
  function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
  _E={OGC:b('il2cpp_object_get_class','pointer',['pointer']),CGN:b('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
      CGF:b('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),FGN:b('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
      FGT:b('il2cpp_field_get_type','pointer',['pointer']),FGO:b('il2cpp_field_get_offset','uint32',['pointer']),
      TGN:b('il2cpp_type_get_name','pointer',['pointer'])};
  return _E;
}
function _cs(p){ try{return p.isNull()?'':p.readCString();}catch(e){return '';} }
function _rd(inst,off,ty){
  try{
    if(ty==='System.Single')return inst.add(off).readFloat();
    if(ty==='System.Double')return inst.add(off).readDouble();
    if(ty.indexOf('Int64')>=0||ty.indexOf('UInt64')>=0)return inst.add(off).readS64().toString();
    if(ty.indexOf('Int32')>=0||ty.indexOf('UInt32')>=0)return inst.add(off).readS32();
    if(ty.indexOf('Int16')>=0||ty.indexOf('UInt16')>=0)return inst.add(off).readS16();
    if(ty==='System.Boolean')return !!inst.add(off).readU8();
    if(ty==='System.Byte'||ty==='System.SByte')return inst.add(off).readU8();
    var p=inst.add(off).readPointer(); return 'ptr:'+p;
  }catch(e){return '(err)';}
}
function _dump(inst){
  var E=_e(); if(ptr(inst).isNull())return {err:'null'};
  var k=E.OGC(ptr(inst)); var out=[]; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  while((f=E.CGF(k,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ var nm=_cs(E.FGN(f)); var o=E.FGO(f); var ty=_cs(E.TGN(E.FGT(f))); out.push(nm+'@0x'+o.toString(16)+':'+ty+' = '+_rd(ptr(inst),o,ty)); }catch(e){} }
  return {cls:_cs(E.CGN(k)), fields:out};
}
rpc.exports.dumpObj=function(instStr){ _ensureInit(); return _dump(instStr); };
rpc.exports.readPtr=function(instStr,off){ try{return ptr(instStr).add(off).readPointer().toString();}catch(e){return '0x0';} };
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
        sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, EXTRA_JS)
        try:
            ns, cls = "Niantic.Holoholo.AdventureEffect", "AdventureEffectService"
            r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, cls)
            hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
            print(f"{ns}.{cls}: {len(hits)} instance(s)  {r.get('err','') if isinstance(r,dict) else ''}")
            for h in hits[:2]:
                d = sc.exports_sync.dump_obj(h)
                print(f"\n== instance @{h}  ({d.get('cls')}) ==")
                for line in d.get("fields", []):
                    print("  ", line)
                def _follow(addr, depth, indent):
                    sd = sc.exports_sync.dump_obj(addr)
                    print(indent + f"({sd.get('cls')})")
                    for s in sd.get("fields", []):
                        print(indent, s)
                    if depth <= 0:
                        return
                    for s in sd.get("fields", []):
                        low = s.lower()
                        if "ptr:0x" in s and "ptr:0x0" not in s and "parser@" not in low and any(k in low for k in ["effect", "bonus", "appliedadventure", "activeeffect"]):
                            try:
                                o2 = int(s.split("@0x")[1].split(":")[0], 16)
                            except Exception:
                                continue
                            sub2 = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(addr, o2)
                            if sub2 and sub2 != "0x0" and int(sub2, 16) > 0x100000:
                                print(indent + "  -> " + s.split("@")[0].strip() + " @" + sub2)
                                _follow(sub2, depth - 1, indent + "     ")
                for line in d.get("fields", []):
                    low = line.lower()
                    if ("bonus" in low or "appliedadventure" in low or "activeadventureeffectproto" in low) and "ptr:0x" in line and "ptr:0x0" not in line:
                        off = int(line.split("@0x")[1].split(":")[0], 16)
                        sub = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(h, off)
                        if sub and sub != "0x0":
                            print(f"   -> {line.split('@')[0].strip()} @{sub}:")
                            _follow(sub, 3, "        ")
                b = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(h, 0xa8)
                if b and b != "0x0":
                    eff = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(b, 0x28)
                    if eff and eff != "0x0":
                        val = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(eff, 0x10)
                        if val and val != "0x0":
                            vd = sc.exports_sync.dump_obj(val)
                            print(f"   *** SPACIAL REND bonus value ({vd.get('cls')}): ***")
                            for s in vd.get("fields", []):
                                print("        ", s)
        finally:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    try:
        finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
        sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, MY_JS)
        try:
            info = sc.exports_sync.find_item_bag()
            if not info:
                print("no GetItemCount class found"); return
            print(f"inventory class: {info['ns']}.{info['cls']}")
            r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(info["ns"], info["cls"])
            hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
            ib = next((h for h in hits if sc.exports_sync.count(h, 1) >= 0), None)
            if ib is None:
                print(f"found {len(hits)} {info['cls']} instances but none readable"); return
            counts = {ITEMS[i]: sc.exports_sync.count(ib, i) for i in ITEMS}
            print("BALLS:", counts)
        finally:
            try: sc.unload(); finder.unload()
            except Exception: pass
    finally:
        try: sess.detach()
        except Exception: pass


main()
```

```py
def find_max(sc, finder, cls, getter):
    ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of(cls)
    if not ns:
        return None
    r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, cls)
    best = None; bestv = None
    for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []):
        if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != cls:
            continue
        v = sc.exports_sync.read_i(h, getter)
        if v is not None and (bestv is None or v > bestv):
            best = h; bestv = v
    return best


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    iap = find_max(sc, finder, "IapService", "get_Stardusts")
    pb = find_max(sc, finder, "PokemonBagImpl", "get_PokemonOnlyCount")
    d = sc.exports_sync.read_i(iap, "get_Stardusts") if iap else None
    b = sc.exports_sync.read_i(pb, "get_PokemonOnlyCount") if pb else None
    print(f"STARDUST={d} BOX={b}")
    sess.detach()


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/read_interaction_ranges.py`:

```py
"""Read LIVE interaction-range values to confirm the ~40m Go-Plus gate:
  - ClientMapObjectsInteractionRangeSettingsProto (InteractionRangeMeters / Far / Remote)
  - FortSettingsProto.InteractionRangeMeters
  - SpawnPokemonService.spawn/despawnInteractionRangeMultiplier
Heap-scans for each class's instances and prints the range fields. READ-ONLY."""
import sys, os
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
 function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
 H={dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]),iGN:b("il2cpp_image_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),iGCC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class_count","uint32",["pointer"]),iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]),CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"])};
 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}
function img(name){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()===name)return im;}return null;}
function findClass(imageName,clsName){var h=H_();var im=img(imageName);if(!im)return null;var cnt=h.iGCC(im);for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++){var k=h.iGC(im,i);if(k.isNull())continue;try{if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===clsName)return k;}catch(e){}}return null;}
function kp(k){var b=[];var t=ptr(k);for(var i=0;i<8;i++){var v=t.and(0xff).toInt32();b.push((v<16?"0":"")+v.toString(16));t=t.shr(8);}return b.join(" ");}
rpc.exports.scanClass=function(imageName,clsName,offs){
 var h=H_();var k=findClass(imageName,clsName);if(!k)return{err:"no class "+clsName};
 var pat=kp(k);var out=[];
 Process.enumerateRanges("rw-").forEach(function(r){if(r.file||r.size<256||r.size>134217728)return;
   try{var hs=Memory.scanSync(r.base,r.size,pat);for(var i=0;i<hs.length&&out.length<60;i++){var p=hs[i].address;
     var rec={addr:p.toString(),vals:{}};for(var j=0;j<offs.length;j++){try{rec.vals[offs[j]]=p.add(offs[j]).readDouble();}catch(e){rec.vals[offs[j]]="err";}}
     out.push(rec);}}catch(e){}});
 return {cls:clsName,count:out.length,hits:out};
};
"""


def show(label, image, cls, offs, names):
    return label, image, cls, offs, names


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        jobs = [
            ("ClientMapObjectsInteractionRangeSettingsProto", "holo-protos.dll",
             "ClientMapObjectsInteractionRangeSettingsProto", [0x10, 0x18, 0x20],
             ["InteractionRangeMeters", "FarInteractionRangeMeters", "RemoteInteractionRangeMeters"]),
            ("FortSettingsProto", "holo-protos.dll", "FortSettingsProto", [0x10, 0x30, 0x48],
             ["InteractionRangeMeters", "FarInteractionRangeMeters", "RemoteInteractionRangeMeters"]),
            ("SpawnPokemonService", "holo-game.dll", "SpawnPokemonService", [0x20, 0x28],
             ["despawnInteractionRangeMultiplier", "spawnInteractionRangeMultiplier"]),
        ]
        for label, image, cls, offs, names in jobs:
            print(f"\n===== {label} ({image}) =====")
            r = sc.exports_sync.scan_class(image, cls, [hex(o) for o in offs])
            if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("err"):
                print("  ", r["err"]); continue
            hits = r.get("hits", [])
            # show distinct value-tuples (filter implausible)
            seen = set()
            shown = 0
            for h in hits:
                vals = h["vals"]
                tup = tuple(round(vals.get(hex(o), -1), 3) if isinstance(vals.get(hex(o)), (int, float)) else vals.get(hex(o)) for o in offs)
                # plausibility: first value in (0,1000)
                v0 = vals.get(hex(offs[0]))
                if not isinstance(v0, (int, float)) or not (0 < v0 < 5000):
                    continue
                if tup in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(tup)
                parts = [f"{names[i]}={vals.get(hex(offs[i]))}" for i in range(len(offs))]
                print(f"  @{h['addr']}  " + "  ".join(parts))
                shown += 1
                if shown >= 8:
                    break
            if shown == 0:
                print(f"  ({r.get('count',0)} raw hits, none plausible)")
        sess.detach()
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```
