`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/read_inventory.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""READ-ONLY inventory reader for PoGo live IL2CPP state.

Walks the InventoryCache dictionary (one dict holds the whole bag) and emits:
  - key-case histogram (so you see which oneof cases are present)
  - full item id -> count map  (case==2: ItemProto Item@+0x10 / Count@+0x14)   [CONFIRMED live]
  - per-family candy + XL      (case==10: PokemonFamilyProto Candy@+0x14 / XlCandy@+0x20) [CONFIRMED]
  - per-family MEGA ENERGY     (MegaEvolutionResources RepeatedField @ +0x18) -- the per-element
                                energy offset is the ONE unknown; this DUMPS the element class +
                                reflected fields + raw bytes + candidate ints so one run locks it. [DEVICE]
  - currencies stardust/coins  (IapService.get_Stardusts/get_Coins/get_PurchasedCoins) [stardust CONFIRMED]
  - a labelled WATCH subset (raid passes, rare candy, mega-energy families)

WRITES NOTHING. Writes _read_inventory_out.json only if --json given.

InventoryCache/IapService may be multi-instance; pick_singleton returns the FIRST hit for these
(no tuned probe). The script reports all liveness hits and picks the InventoryCache whose dict
walk yields the most entries (the _pick_real_bag idiom).

GOTCHA: family id == BASE species dex number. Mega Charizard energy is under family 4 (Charmander),
Mega Gyarados under 129 (Magikarp), Mega Mewtwo under 150. Do NOT query 6/94/130.

Usage:
    python read_inventory.py
    python read_inventory.py --json _read_inventory_out.json
    python read_inventory.py --mega-family 150   # focus the mega-energy element dump on a family
"""
import sys
import os
import json

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))))
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JSON_OUT = sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--json') + 1] if '--json' in sys.argv else None
MEGA_FAMILY = int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--mega-family') + 1]) if '--mega-family' in sys.argv else None

# item ids worth labelling in the watch subset (names from inventory_subsystem_recon.md;
# numeric ids are [DEVICE]-soft except where confirmed). 1150 = OtherEvolutionStoneA (confirmed).
WATCH_LABELS = {
    1: 'PokeBall', 2: 'GreatBall', 3: 'UltraBall', 4: 'MasterBall',
    101: 'Potion', 102: 'SuperPotion', 103: 'HyperPotion', 104: 'MaxPotion',
    201: 'Revive', 202: 'MaxRevive', 301: 'LuckyEgg', 401: 'IncenseOrdinary',
    501: 'TroyDisk', 602: 'XlRareCandy?', 705: 'RareCandy?', 1150: 'OtherEvolutionStoneA',
    1201: 'RemoteRaidPass?', 1202: 'PremiumRaidPass?', 1301: 'StarPiece',
}

READER_JS = r"""
var PROTO_IMAGE=null, OGC=null, CGN=null, CGF=null, FGN=null, FGO=null, FGTy=null, TGN=null;
function _proto(){ if(PROTO_IMAGE) return; _ensureInit();
  var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so'); function nf(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(il.getExportByName(n),r,a); }
  OGC=nf('il2cpp_object_get_class','pointer',['pointer']); CGN=nf('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
  CGF=nf('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']); FGN=nf('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
  FGO=nf('il2cpp_field_get_offset','uint32',['pointer']); FGTy=nf('il2cpp_field_get_type','pointer',['pointer']);
  TGN=nf('il2cpp_type_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
  var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var asms=IL2.dGA(IL2.dG(),sp); var na=sp.readS32();
  for(var a=0;a<na;a++){ var im=IL2.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
    if(IL2.iGN(im).readCString()==='holo-protos.dll'){ PROTO_IMAGE=im; break; } } }
function clsName(o){ try{ if(!o||o.isNull()) return null; return CGN(OGC(o)).readCString(); }catch(e){ return null; } }
function inv0(instPtr,name){ _proto(); if(!instPtr||instPtr.isNull()) return {ok:false};
  var m=cMN(OGC(instPtr),name,0); if(!m||m.isNull()) return {ok:false};
  try{ var ex=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); ex.writePointer(ptr(0)); var r=rI(m,instPtr,ptr(0),ex); return {ok:true,ret:r}; }catch(e){ return {ok:false,err:e.toString()}; } }
function box32(p){ try{ if(!p||p.isNull()) return null; return p.add(0x10).readS32(); }catch(e){ return null; } }

// get the backing dictionary from InventoryCache.GetCurrentItems()
function getDict(invAddr){
  var inv=ptr(invAddr);
  var m=cMN(IL2.cFN(GAME_IMAGE, Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Collections'), Memory.allocUtf8String('InventoryCache')),'GetCurrentItems',0);
  if(!m||m.isNull()) return null;
  var ex=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); ex.writePointer(ptr(0));
  var coll=rI(m,inv,ptr(0),ex); if(coll.isNull()) return null;
  return coll.add(0x10).readPointer();   // _dictionary @ +0x10
}

// quick count for picking the real InventoryCache
rpc.exports.dictCount = function(invAddr){
  _proto(); try{ var dict=getDict(invAddr); if(!dict||dict.isNull()) return {ok:false,why:'no dict'};
    var entries=dict.add(0x18).readPointer(); if(entries.isNull()) return {ok:false,why:'no entries'};
    return {ok:true, n: entries.add(0x18).readS32()}; }catch(e){ return {ok:false, err:e.toString()}; }
};

rpc.exports.readInventory = function(invAddr, megaFamily){
  _proto();
  var dict=getDict(invAddr); if(!dict||dict.isNull()) return {error:'null dict'};
  var entries=dict.add(0x18).readPointer(); var count=entries.add(0x18).readS32();
  var caseHist={}, items={}, families={}, megaDump=null, samples={};
  for(var i=0;i<count;i++){
    var e=entries.add(0x20).add(i*0x18);   // entry array begins at entries+0x20, stride 0x18
    var hash=e.add(0x0).readS32(); if(hash<0) continue;
    var key=e.add(0x8).readPointer(); var val=e.add(0x10).readPointer();
    if(key.isNull()||val.isNull()) continue;
    var kcase=key.add(0x18).readS32();
    caseHist[kcase]=(caseHist[kcase]||0)+1;
    if(kcase===2){ // ITEM
      var vi=inv0(val,'get_Item'); if(vi.ok&&vi.ret&&!vi.ret.isNull()){
        var id=vi.ret.add(0x10).readS32(); var ct=vi.ret.add(0x14).readS32(); items[id]=ct; }
    } else if(kcase===10){ // POKEMON FAMILY (candy/xl/mega energy)
      var vf=inv0(val,'get_PokemonFamily'); if(vf.ok&&vf.ret&&!vf.ret.isNull()){ var fp=vf.ret;
        var fam=fp.add(0x10).readS32(); var candy=fp.add(0x14).readS32(); var xl=fp.add(0x20).readS32();
        var rec={candy:candy, xl:xl, megaEnergy:[]};
        // MegaEvolutionResources RepeatedField @ +0x18
        try{ var rf=fp.add(0x18).readPointer(); if(rf&&!rf.isNull()){ var arr=rf.add(0x10).readPointer(); var mc=rf.add(0x18).readS32();
          if(arr&&!arr.isNull()&&mc>0&&mc<50){ for(var m2=0;m2<mc;m2++){ var el=arr.add(0x20).add(m2*8).readPointer(); if(el.isNull()) continue;
            // try getters first (likely absent), then candidate raw ints
            var teId=inv0(el,'get_TemporaryEvolutionId'); var amt=inv0(el,'get_Amount');
            var maxe=inv0(el,'get_MaxEnergyCount');
            var em={tempEvoId: teId.ok?box32(teId.ret):null,
                    amount: amt.ok?box32(amt.ret):(maxe.ok?box32(maxe.ret):null),
                    raw:{}};
            [0x10,0x14,0x18,0x1c,0x20].forEach(function(o){ try{ em.raw['i@'+o.toString(16)]=el.add(o).readS32(); }catch(e){} });
            rec.megaEnergy.push(em);
            // one-time deep dump (class + reflected fields + bytes) for offset locking
            if(!megaDump && (megaFamily===0 || fam===megaFamily)){ megaDump={family:fam, elemCls:clsName(el), fields:[], bytes:''};
              var fcls=OGC(el); var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
              while((f=CGF(fcls,it)) && !f.isNull()){ try{ megaDump.fields.push({name:FGN(f).readCString(), off:FGO(f), type:TGN(FGTy(f)).readCString()}); }catch(e){} }
              try{ var bb=el.readByteArray(0x40); megaDump.bytes=Array.prototype.map.call(new Uint8Array(bb),function(b){return ('0'+b.toString(16)).slice(-2);}).join(' '); }catch(e){}
            }
          } } } }catch(e){ rec.megaErr=e.toString(); }
        families[fam]=rec; }
    } else { // sample one value of each other case for later decode
      if(!samples[kcase]){ var sc={cls:clsName(val), bytes:''}; try{ var bb=val.readByteArray(0x30);
        sc.bytes=Array.prototype.map.call(new Uint8Array(bb),function(b){return ('0'+b.toString(16)).slice(-2);}).join(' '); }catch(e){} samples[kcase]=sc; }
    }
  }
  return {entryCount:count, caseHist:caseHist, items:items, families:families, megaDump:megaDump, otherCaseSamples:samples};
};

// currencies via IapService
rpc.exports.readCurrencies = function(iapAddr){
  _proto(); var p=ptr(iapAddr); var out={};
  var cls=IL2.cFN(GAME_IMAGE, Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo.Storefront'), Memory.allocUtf8String('IapService'));
  ['get_Stardusts','get_Coins','get_PurchasedCoins'].forEach(function(nm){
    try{ var m=cMN(cls,nm,0); if(!m||m.isNull()){ out[nm]=null; return; }
      var ex=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); ex.writePointer(ptr(0)); var r=rI(m,p,ptr(0),ex);
      out[nm]= (r&&!r.isNull()) ? r.add(0x10).readS32() : null; }catch(e){ out[nm]='err:'+e.toString(); }
  });
  return out;
};
"""


def _pick_real_inventory(sess, sc, ns, cls):
    """Return the InventoryCache instance with the largest dict; report all hits."""
    probe = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    try:
        r = probe.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, cls)
    finally:
        probe.unload()
    if 'err' in r:
        return None, []
    hits = r.get('hits', [])
    best, best_n = None, -1
    for h in hits:
        try:
            d = sc.exports_sync.dict_count(h)
            n = d.get('n', -1) if d.get('ok') else -1
            if n > best_n:
                best, best_n = h, n
        except Exception:
            pass
    return best, hits


def main():
    print('[*] connecting...')
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print(f'[*] attached pid={pid}')
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, READER_JS)

    inv, inv_hits = _pick_real_inventory(sess, sc, 'Niantic.Holoholo.Collections', 'InventoryCache')
    print(f'[*] InventoryCache liveness hits: {inv_hits}; chosen: {inv}')
    if not inv:
        print('[!] no usable InventoryCache instance.')
        sc.unload()
        sess.detach()
        sys.exit(1)

    res = sc.exports_sync.read_inventory(inv, MEGA_FAMILY if MEGA_FAMILY is not None else 0)

    # currencies (first IapService hit)
    curr = None
    iprobe = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    try:
        ir = iprobe.exports_sync.find_singleton('Niantic.Holoholo.Storefront', 'IapService')
        ihits = ir.get('hits', []) if 'err' not in ir else []
    finally:
        iprobe.unload()
    if ihits:
        curr = sc.exports_sync.read_currencies(ihits[0])

    sc.unload()
    sess.detach()

    if 'error' in res:
        print('[!]', res['error'])
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"\n=== INVENTORY ({res['entryCount']} dict entries) ===")
    print('\n--- key-case histogram (oneof TypeCase) ---')
    for k in sorted(res['caseHist'], key=lambda x: int(x)):
        tag = {'2': 'Item', '4': 'PlayerStats', '5': 'PlayerCurrency', '10': 'PokemonFamily'}.get(str(k), '?')
        print(f'  case {k:>3} ({tag}): {res["caseHist"][k]}')

    items = {int(k): v for k, v in res['items'].items()}
    print(f'\n--- ITEMS ({len(items)}) [id -> count] ---')
    for iid in sorted(items):
        lbl = WATCH_LABELS.get(iid, '')
        print(f'  {iid:>5}  x{items[iid]:<6} {lbl}')

    print('\n--- WATCH subset (passes / candy / stones) ---')
    for iid in sorted(items):
        if iid in WATCH_LABELS:
            print(f'  {WATCH_LABELS[iid]:24s} id={iid} x{items[iid]}')

    fams = {int(k): v for k, v in res['families'].items()}
    print(f'\n--- FAMILIES candy/XL/mega ({len(fams)}) ---')
    for fam in sorted(fams):
        r = fams[fam]
        meflag = ''
        if r.get('megaEnergy'):
            meflag = '  MEGA_ENERGY=' + json.dumps(r['megaEnergy'])
        print(f'  fam {fam:>4}  candy={r["candy"]:<6} xl={r["xl"]:<6}{meflag}')

    if res.get('megaDump'):
        print('\n--- MEGA ENERGY element dump (LOCK THE OFFSET HERE) [DEVICE] ---')
        md = res['megaDump']
        print(f"  family={md['family']}  elemCls={md['elemCls']}")
        print('  reflected fields (name @ offset : type):')
        for f in md.get('fields', []):
            print(f"    {f['name']:28s} @{hex(f['off'])}  {f['type']}")
        print(f"  first-element bytes[0x40]: {md.get('bytes')}")
        print('  -> the energy quantity is one of the int@ candidates printed in megaEnergy.raw above;')
        print('     match it to the in-game Mega Energy number for this family to lock the offset.')

    if res.get('otherCaseSamples'):
        print('\n--- other-case value samples (RaidTickets/Incubators/EventPasses/...) [DEVICE] ---')
        for k, s in res['otherCaseSamples'].items():
            print(f'  case {k}: cls={s.get("cls")} bytes={s.get("bytes")}')

    if curr:
        print('\n--- CURRENCIES (IapService) ---')
        print(f'  Stardust:      {curr.get("get_Stardusts")}')
        print(f'  Coins:         {curr.get("get_Coins")}')
        print(f'  PurchasedCoins:{curr.get("get_PurchasedCoins")}')

    if JSON_OUT:
        with open(JSON_OUT, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
            json.dump({'inventory': res, 'currencies': curr}, fh, indent=2)
        print(f'\n[*] wrote {JSON_OUT}')
    print('\n[NOTE] item enum numeric ids + the mega-energy element offset are [DEVICE]-flagged. '
          'Lock the mega offset from the element dump, then it is permanent for this binary.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/read_item_bag.py`:

```py
"""READ-ONLY item bag dump: every item id, its enum name, and how many you hold.

Built because spins started returning FortSearchOutProto Result=4 (INVENTORY_FULL) -- the item
bag is full, so ~38% of PokeStop spins award nothing. Any cleanup policy has to be based on the
real bag, not on assumptions about what is in it.

Nothing here writes: it calls GetItemCount(itemId) only. The enum names come from the live
ItemId enum (same field-enumeration trick used for the Form enum) so they cannot drift with a
game update the way a hardcoded table would.
"""
import os, sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};
 il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
 function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
 H={dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),
    aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]),iGCC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class_count","uint32",["pointer"]),
    iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]),iGN:b("il2cpp_image_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
    CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),CGNS:b("il2cpp_class_get_namespace","pointer",["pointer"]),
    cGF:b("il2cpp_class_get_fields","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),fGN:b("il2cpp_field_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
    fGSV:b("il2cpp_field_static_get_value","void",["pointer","pointer"]),
    cMN:b("il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","int"]),
    OGC:b("il2cpp_object_get_class","pointer",["pointer"]),
    rI:b("il2cpp_runtime_invoke","pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer","pointer"]),
    tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"])};
 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}
function eachClass(cb){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();
 for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());var cnt=h.iGCC(im);
  for(var j=0;j<cnt;j++){var k=h.iGC(im,j);if(!k.isNull())cb(k);}}}

/* the ItemId enum: name -> int, read live so a game update cannot silently rename things */
rpc.exports.itemEnum=function(){var h=H_();var out={};
 eachClass(function(k){var nm;try{nm=h.CGN(k).readCString();}catch(e){return;}
  if(nm!=="Item"&&nm!=="ItemId")return;
  var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var f;
  while((f=h.cGF(k,it))&&!f.isNull()){try{
    var fn=h.fGN(f).readCString(); if(fn==="value__")continue;
    var buf=Memory.alloc(8);buf.writeU64(0);h.fGSV(f,buf);out[fn]=buf.readS32();
  }catch(e){}}});
 return out;};
rpc.exports.count=function(ibStr,item){var h=H_();var ib=ptr(ibStr);
 var m=h.cMN(h.OGC(ib),Memory.allocUtf8String("GetItemCount"),1);if(!m||m.isNull())return -1;
 var arg=Memory.alloc(4);arg.writeS32(item);var args=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);args.writePointer(arg);
 var exc=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);exc.writePointer(ptr(0));
 var ret=h.rI(m,ib,args,exc);if(!exc.readPointer().isNull())return -2;if(ret.isNull())return -3;
 try{return ret.add(0x10).readS32();}catch(e){return -4;}};
rpc.exports.findItemBag=function(){var h=H_();var hits=[];
 eachClass(function(k){try{var nm=h.CGN(k).readCString();if(/^I[A-Z]/.test(nm))return;
  var m=h.cMN(k,Memory.allocUtf8String("GetItemCount"),1);if(m&&!m.isNull())hits.push(nm);}catch(e){}});
 return hits;};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)   # already loaded by the helper
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    try:
        ib = pg.pick_singleton(sess, "Niantic.Holoholo.Internal", "ItemBagImpl")
        print("ItemBagImpl @", ib)
        enum = sc.exports_sync.item_enum() or {}
        print(f"ItemId enum entries: {len(enum)}")
        byval = {}
        for name, val in enum.items():
            byval.setdefault(int(val), name)
        ids = sorted(byval) if byval else list(range(0, 2500))
        rows = []
        for i in ids:
            n = sc.exports_sync.count(ib, i)
            if isinstance(n, int) and n > 0:
                rows.append((i, byval.get(i, f"item_{i}"), n))
        total = sum(r[2] for r in rows)
        print(f"\n{'id':>6}  {'name':<34} {'count':>6}")
        print("-" * 50)
        for i, nm, n in sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[2]):
            print(f"{i:>6}  {nm:<34} {n:>6}")
        print("-" * 50)
        print(f"{'TOTAL':>42} {total:>6}")
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/read_mapsettings.py`:

```py
"""READ-ONLY: read LIVE MapSettingsProto.PokemonVisibleRange / EncounterRangeMeters
from PoGo memory. Pokemod's SpawnBooster module forces both to 140 (vs ~40 default);
reading them confirms whether the range boost is active right now. Reflects the proto
for field offsets, heap-scans for instances, reads the values."""
import sys, os, json
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var F=null;
function init(){ if(F)return F; var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so'); var e={};
  il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
  function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
  F={dG:b('il2cpp_domain_get','pointer',[]),dGA:b('il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),
     aGI:b('il2cpp_assembly_get_image','pointer',['pointer']),iGN:b('il2cpp_image_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
     cFN:b('il2cpp_class_from_name','pointer',['pointer','pointer','pointer']),
     cGF:b('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),fGN:b('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
     fGT:b('il2cpp_field_get_type','pointer',['pointer']),fGO:b('il2cpp_field_get_offset','uint32',['pointer']),
     tGN:b('il2cpp_type_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),tA:b('il2cpp_thread_attach','pointer',['pointer'])};
  F.tA(F.dG());
  return F;
}
function protoImg(){var f=init();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var asms=f.dGA(f.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var img=f.aGI(asms.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(f.iGN(img).readCString()==='holo-protos.dll')return img;}return null;}
function klassPattern(k){var bytes=[];var t=k;for(var i=0;i<8;i++){var v=t.and(0xff).toInt32();bytes.push((v<16?'0':'')+v.toString(16));t=t.shr(8);}return bytes.join(' ');}

rpc.exports.go=function(){
  var f=init(); var img=protoImg(); if(!img)return{err:'no holo-protos'};
  var k=f.cFN(img,Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'),Memory.allocUtf8String('MapSettingsProto'));
  if(!k||k.isNull())return{err:'no MapSettingsProto class'};
  // reflect fields
  var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var fld;var fields=[];var visOff=-1,encOff=-1,visT='',encT='';
  while((fld=f.cGF(k,it))&&!fld.isNull()){try{var nm=f.fGN(fld).readCString();var off=f.fGO(fld);var ty=f.tGN(f.fGT(fld)).readCString();
    fields.push(nm+'@0x'+off.toString(16)+':'+ty);var lo=nm.toLowerCase();
    if(lo.indexOf('visiblerange')>=0||lo.indexOf('visible_range')>=0||lo==='pokemonvisiblerange_'){visOff=off;visT=ty;}
    if(lo.indexOf('encounterrange')>=0||lo.indexOf('encounter_range')>=0){encOff=off;encT=ty;}
  }catch(e){}}
  // heap scan for instances
  var pat=klassPattern(k);var matches=[];
  Process.enumerateRanges('rw-').forEach(function(r){if(r.file||r.size<4096||r.size>64*1024*1024)return;
    try{var hs=Memory.scanSync(r.base,r.size,pat);for(var i=0;i<hs.length&&matches.length<200;i++)matches.push(hs[i].address);}catch(e){}});
  function rd(p,off,ty){try{if(off<0)return null;if(ty==='System.Single')return p.add(off).readFloat();if(ty==='System.Double')return p.add(off).readDouble();if(ty.indexOf('Int')>=0)return p.add(off).readS32();return p.add(off).readFloat();}catch(e){return null;}}
  var samples=[];var seen={};
  for(var i=0;i<matches.length;i++){var p=matches[i];var v=rd(p,visOff,visT);var en=rd(p,encOff,encT);
    if(v===null&&en===null)continue;var key=String(v)+'|'+String(en);if(seen[key])continue;seen[key]=true;samples.push({addr:p.toString(),visible:v,encounter:en});}
  return {cls:'MapSettingsProto', visOff:'0x'+(visOff>=0?visOff.toString(16):'?')+':'+visT, encOff:'0x'+(encOff>=0?encOff.toString(16):'?')+':'+encT, matches:matches.length, samples:samples, fields:fields};
};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        r = sc.exports_sync.go()
        sess.detach()
        if r.get("err"):
            print("ERR:", r["err"]); return
        print("PokemonVisibleRange field:", r["visOff"])
        print("EncounterRangeMeters field:", r["encOff"])
        print("instances scanned:", r["matches"])
        print("\n=== distinct (visible, encounter) range values found live ===")
        for s in r["samples"][:30]:
            print(f"  visible={s['visible']}  encounter={s['encounter']}   @{s['addr']}")
        print("\nall MapSettingsProto fields:")
        for x in r["fields"]:
            print("  ", x)
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
"""READ-ONLY: dump ALL live MapSettingsProto tunable values (despawn range, nearby-hide,
refresh, ranges) so we know current state before tweaking despawn / max-show."""
import sys, os
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
 function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
 H={dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]),iGN:b("il2cpp_image_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),cFN:b("il2cpp_class_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer"]),tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"])};
 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}
function kp(k){var b=[];var t=k;for(var i=0;i<8;i++){var v=t.and(0xff).toInt32();b.push((v<16?"0":"")+v.toString(16));t=t.shr(8);}return b.join(" ");}
rpc.exports.go=function(){
 var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();var img=null;
 for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()==="holo-protos.dll"){img=im;break;}}
 var k=h.cFN(img,Memory.allocUtf8String("Holoholo.Rpc"),Memory.allocUtf8String("MapSettingsProto"));
 if(k.isNull())return{err:"no class"};
 var pat=kp(k);var out=[];
 Process.enumerateRanges("rw-").forEach(function(r){if(r.file||r.size<4096||r.size>67108864)return;
   try{var hs=Memory.scanSync(r.base,r.size,pat);for(var i=0;i<hs.length&&out.length<300;i++){var p=hs[i].address;
     try{var vis=p.add(0x10).readDouble();if(isNaN(vis)||vis<0||vis>100000)continue;
       out.push({addr:p.toString(),visible:vis,pokenav:p.add(0x18).readDouble(),encounter:p.add(0x20).readDouble(),minRefresh:p.add(0x28).readFloat(),maxRefresh:p.add(0x2c).readFloat(),minDist:p.add(0x30).readFloat(),minNearbyHideSightings:p.add(0x40).readS32(),despawnRange:p.add(0x60).readDouble()});
     }catch(e){}}}catch(e){}});
 return out;
};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        r = sc.exports_sync.go()
        sess.detach()
        if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("err"):
            print("ERR", r["err"]); return
        good = [s for s in r if 20 <= s["visible"] <= 400 and 20 <= s["encounter"] <= 400]
        print(f"{len(r)} heap matches, {len(good)} plausible MapSettings instances:")
        for s in good[:6]:
            print(f"  @{s['addr']}  visible={s['visible']}  encounter={s['encounter']}  despawnRange={s['despawnRange']}  "
                  f"minNearbyHideSightings={s['minNearbyHideSightings']}  refresh={s['minRefresh']}/{s['maxRefresh']}  minDist={s['minDist']}  pokenav={s['pokenav']}")
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()

            pass
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/read_medals.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""READ-ONLY medals/badges reader for PoGo live IL2CPP state.

Reads PlayerStatsProto.EventBadges (RepeatedField<HoloBadgeType> @ +0xB8, DEVICE-recon
2026-05-21) -> the list of EARNED event/dynamic medals (incl. GO Fest 2026 district
medals like "Friendship District"), names them by dumping the live HoloBadgeType enum
(2026 district constants are NOT in any static dump -> must read the live binary), and
prints the progress-medal counters (KmWalked, NumPokemonCaptured, ...).

WRITES NOTHING.

PlayerService capture: liveness via pick_singleton('Niantic.Holoholo','PlayerService').
pick_singleton returns the FIRST hit for this class (no tuned probe) -> if get_PlayerStats
returns junk, there were >1 instances; the script prints all liveness hits so you can
retry against the populated one. PlayerService must be live -> be on the map or open the
Trainer profile before running.

Validation flags (see GAME_READ_CAPABILITIES.md §3):
  [DEVICE] confirm EventBadges offset in TODAY's binary (script re-reads by NAME, self-heals;
           sanity-check the printed offset)
  [DEVICE] confirm the live HoloBadgeType enum contains 2026 Tokyo/district/Friendship
           constants and capture their exact names+ints (the headline unknown)
  [DEVICE] confirm district completion writes EventBadges (vs a BadgeData inventory item)

Usage:
    python read_medals.py
    python read_medals.py --json medals_out.json
    python read_medals.py --all-badges     # print the entire HoloBadgeType enum dump too
"""
import sys
import os
import json

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))))
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JSON_OUT = sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--json') + 1] if '--json' in sys.argv else None
ALL_BADGES = '--all-badges' in sys.argv

# EventBadges fallback offset if the by-name lookup fails (DEVICE-recon 2026-05-21)
EVENTBADGES_FALLBACK = 0xB8

READER_JS = r"""
var PROTO_IMAGE = null, OGC = null, CGN = null, CGF = null, FGN = null, FGO = null,
    FGFlags = null, FGType = null, FSGV = null, CGFcount = null;
function _proto() {
  if (PROTO_IMAGE) return;
  _ensureInit();
  var il = Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
  function nf(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(il.getExportByName(n),r,a); }
  OGC=nf('il2cpp_object_get_class','pointer',['pointer']);
  CGN=nf('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
  CGF=nf('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
  FGN=nf('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
  FGO=nf('il2cpp_field_get_offset','uint32',['pointer']);
  FGFlags=nf('il2cpp_field_get_flags','int',['pointer']);
  FSGV=nf('il2cpp_field_static_get_value','void',['pointer','pointer']);
  var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var asms=IL2.dGA(IL2.dG(),sp); var na=sp.readS32();
  for(var a=0;a<na;a++){ var im=IL2.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());
    if(IL2.iGN(im).readCString()==='holo-protos.dll'){ PROTO_IMAGE=im; break; } }
}
function clsName(o){ try{ if(!o||o.isNull()) return null; return CGN(OGC(o)).readCString(); }catch(e){ return null; } }
function protoCls(ns,nm){ _proto(); return IL2.cFN(PROTO_IMAGE, Memory.allocUtf8String(ns), Memory.allocUtf8String(nm)); }
function inv0(instPtr,name){ _proto(); if(!instPtr||instPtr.isNull()) return {ok:false};
  var m=cMN(OGC(instPtr),name,0); if(!m||m.isNull()) return {ok:false};
  try{ var ex=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); ex.writePointer(ptr(0)); var r=rI(m,instPtr,ptr(0),ex); return {ok:true,ret:r}; }catch(e){ return {ok:false,err:e.toString()}; } }
function box32(p){ try{ if(!p||p.isNull()) return null; return p.add(0x10).readS32(); }catch(e){ return null; } }
function boxF(p){ try{ if(!p||p.isNull()) return null; return p.add(0x10).readFloat(); }catch(e){ return null; } }

// dump a static-literal enum (value->name) from holo-protos.dll
rpc.exports.dumpEnum = function(ns, name){
  _proto();
  var cls=protoCls(ns,name); if(!cls||cls.isNull()) return {err:'enum class not found: '+ns+'.'+name};
  var out={}; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  while((f=CGF(cls,it)) && !f.isNull()){
    try{ var fl=FGFlags(f); if(!((fl&0x10) && (fl&0x40))) continue;  // STATIC && LITERAL
      var nm=FGN(f).readCString(); if(nm==='value__') continue;
      var buf=Memory.alloc(8); buf.writeU64(0); FSGV(f,buf); out[buf.readS32()]=nm;
    }catch(e){}
  }
  return {ok:true, count:Object.keys(out).length, map:out};
};

// read PlayerStatsProto: discover field offsets by NAME (self-healing), read EventBadges RF + counters
rpc.exports.readStats = function(statsAddr){
  _proto();
  var p=ptr(statsAddr); var cls=OGC(p); var rec={cls:clsName(p), fields:{}, counters:{}, eventBadges:[]};
  // field name -> offset table for PlayerStatsProto
  var offByName={}; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  while((f=CGF(cls,it)) && !f.isNull()){ try{ var nm=FGN(f).readCString(); offByName[nm]=FGO(f); }catch(e){} }
  rec.eventBadgesOffset = (offByName['EventBadges']!==undefined) ? offByName['EventBadges'] : null;
  var ebOff = (rec.eventBadgesOffset!==null) ? rec.eventBadgesOffset : __EB_FALLBACK__;
  // walk RepeatedField<HoloBadgeType> (int enum): array@+0x10 count@+0x18 elem@array+0x20+i*4
  try{ var rf=p.add(ebOff).readPointer(); if(rf&&!rf.isNull()){ var arr=rf.add(0x10).readPointer(); var cnt=rf.add(0x18).readS32();
    if(arr&&!arr.isNull()&&cnt>0&&cnt<5000) for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++) rec.eventBadges.push(arr.add(0x20).add(i*4).readS32()); } }catch(e){ rec.ebErr=e.toString(); }
  // a few key counters by name (int unless float-named)
  var floats={'KmWalked':1,'KmWalkedPastActiveDay':1};
  ['Level','Experience','KmWalked','NumPokemonCaptured','NumPokemonEncountered','NumUniquePokedexEntries',
   'NumEvolutions','PokeStopVisits','NumEggsHatched','NumBattleAttackWon','NumChallengeQuestsCompleted',
   'NumTrades','NumPokemonPurified','NumGruntsDefeated','NumBestBuddies','NumTotalMegaEvolutions',
   'NumForeverFriendsEarned','BigMagikarpCaught','SmallRattataCaught','NumBerriesFed'].forEach(function(nm){
    if(offByName[nm]===undefined) return; var o=offByName[nm];
    try{ rec.counters[nm]= floats[nm] ? p.add(o).readFloat() : (nm==='Experience'? p.add(o).readS64().toString() : p.add(o).readS32()); }catch(e){}
  });
  return rec;
};
""".replace('__EB_FALLBACK__', str(EVENTBADGES_FALLBACK))


def main():
    print('[*] connecting...')
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print(f'[*] attached pid={pid}')
    print('[*] resolving PlayerService (be on map / Trainer profile)...')

    # get all liveness hits so we can report/retry on multi-instance
    probe = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    try:
        hitres = probe.exports_sync.find_singleton('Niantic.Holoholo', 'PlayerService')
    finally:
        probe.unload()
    if 'err' in hitres:
        print('[!] PlayerService:', hitres['err'])
        sess.detach()
        sys.exit(1)
    hits = hitres.get('hits', [])
    print(f'[*] PlayerService liveness hits: {hits}')
    if not hits:
        print('[!] no PlayerService instance — open the Trainer profile and retry.')
        sess.detach()
        sys.exit(1)

    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, READER_JS)

    # enum dump (the live HoloBadgeType -> names, incl. 2026 districts)
    enum = sc.exports_sync.dump_enum('Holoholo.Rpc', 'HoloBadgeType')
    badge_names = {}
    if enum.get('ok'):
        badge_names = {int(k): v for k, v in enum['map'].items()}
        print(f"[*] HoloBadgeType enum: {enum['count']} members")
    else:
        print('[!] enum dump failed:', enum.get('err'))

    # try each hit; use the first that yields a populated PlayerStatsProto (sane Level).
    # call get_PlayerStats on each instance to obtain the PlayerStatsProto ptr.
    stats = None
    used_inst = None
    GETSTATS_JS = r"""
    rpc.exports.getStatsPtr = function(svcAddr){
      _ensureInit();
      var p=ptr(svcAddr); var m=cMN(IL2.cFN(GAME_IMAGE, Memory.allocUtf8String('Niantic.Holoholo'), Memory.allocUtf8String('PlayerService')),'get_PlayerStats',0);
      if(!m||m.isNull()) return {ok:false, why:'no get_PlayerStats'};
      try{ var ex=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); ex.writePointer(ptr(0)); var r=rI(m,p,ptr(0),ex); return {ok:true, ptr: r.isNull()?null:r.toString()}; }catch(e){ return {ok:false, err:e.toString()}; }
    };
    """
    gs_sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, GETSTATS_JS)
    for h in hits:
        gp = gs_sc.exports_sync.get_stats_ptr(h)
        if gp.get('ok') and gp.get('ptr'):
            st = sc.exports_sync.read_stats(gp['ptr'])
            lvl = st.get('counters', {}).get('Level')
            if lvl and 1 <= lvl <= 90:
                stats = st
                used_inst = h
                break
    gs_sc.unload()
    sc.unload()
    sess.detach()

    if not stats:
        print('[!] could not get a populated PlayerStatsProto from any PlayerService instance.')
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f'\n[*] using PlayerService {used_inst}')
    print(f"[*] EventBadges field offset (by name): {hex(stats['eventBadgesOffset']) if stats.get('eventBadgesOffset') is not None else 'NOT FOUND -> used fallback ' + hex(EVENTBADGES_FALLBACK)}")

    print('\n=== PROGRESS-MEDAL COUNTERS ===')
    for k, v in stats.get('counters', {}).items():
        print(f'  {k:32s} {v}')

    eb = stats.get('eventBadges', [])
    print(f'\n=== EARNED EVENT/DYNAMIC MEDALS (EventBadges, {len(eb)}) ===')
    EVENT_KEY = ('gofest', 'district', 'friendship', 'city', 'safari', 'gotour', 'gowa', 'tour', '2026', 'tokyo')
    named = []
    for v in eb:
        nm = badge_names.get(v, f'??({v})')
        named.append({'int': v, 'name': nm})
        print(f'  {v:>12}  {nm}')
    hot = [n for n in named if any(k in n['name'].lower() for k in EVENT_KEY)]
    print(f'\n=== GO Fest / district / event-relevant medals ({len(hot)}) ===')
    for n in hot:
        print(f"  {n['int']:>12}  {n['name']}")

    if ALL_BADGES and badge_names:
        print(f'\n=== FULL HoloBadgeType enum ({len(badge_names)}) ===')
        for v in sorted(badge_names):
            print(f'  {v:>12}  {badge_names[v]}')

    if JSON_OUT:
        with open(JSON_OUT, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
            json.dump({'instance': used_inst, 'eventBadgesOffset': stats.get('eventBadgesOffset'),
                       'counters': stats.get('counters'), 'eventBadges': named,
                       'holoBadgeTypeEnum': badge_names}, fh, indent=2)
        print(f'\n[*] wrote {JSON_OUT}')
    print('\n[NOTE] 2026 district medal names come from the LIVE enum dump; if a known-earned '
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/read_mewtwo_locationcard.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""READ-ONLY: recover the GO Fest 2026 Mewtwo location-card enum (fills a DB gap).

For target UIDs (the two GO Fest 2026 Mewtwo), walk the live bag proto, read
PokemonDisplayProto.LocationCard sub-message, and map the enum via location_card_enum.json.

The two Mewtwo (uid 7411975807261094796 CP2363/IV41, uid 5744441765404633224 CP2362/IV41)
MUST be in the heap -> open each one's detail screen in PoGo first, or this returns
'not in bag walk'. Expected enum: 248/249/250 (LcSpecialbackground2026Mewtwo001/002/003)
or 245 (Lc2026TokyoGofest001 if Tokyo-local).

WRITES NOTHING. After this confirms the enum, re-run a targeted fresh_poll + parse_fresh
so fresh_loc_card_enum persists in pokemon.db.

Validation flags (see gofest_data_model.md §4):
  [DEVICE] PokemonProto.PokemonDisplay @ +0xd8 ; displayProto.LocationCard @ +0x58 ;
           LocationCard enum @ locBytes+0x10 (all from parse_fresh.py; proven there, re-confirm)

Usage:
    python read_mewtwo_locationcard.py
    python read_mewtwo_locationcard.py 7411975807261094796 5744441765404633224
"""
import sys
import os
import json

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
PROJ = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(HERE))   # pogo_extract/
sys.path.insert(0, PROJ)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

DEFAULT_UIDS = ['7411975807261094796', '5744441765404633224']  # signed
TARGET_UIDS = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a.isdigit()] or DEFAULT_UIDS

# location_card_enum.json lives at pogo_extract root (per gofest_data_model.md)
ENUM_PATH = os.path.join(PROJ, 'location_card_enum.json')
ENUM = {}
if os.path.exists(ENUM_PATH):
    ENUM = {int(k): v for k, v in json.load(open(ENUM_PATH)).items()}
else:
    print(f'[!] {ENUM_PATH} not found; enum names will be numeric only.')

READ_JS = r"""
rpc.exports.readLoc = function(protoStr){
  var p = ptr(protoStr);
  var disp = p.add(0xd8).readPointer();          // PokemonProto.PokemonDisplay  [DEVICE]
  if (disp.isNull()) return {ok:false, why:'no display (mon not in heap?)'};
  var loc = disp.add(0x58).readPointer();         // displayProto.LocationCard sub-message [DEVICE]
  if (loc.isNull()) return {ok:false, why:'no LocationCard set'};
  var enumVal = loc.add(0x10).readS32();          // LocationCard enum @ +0x10 (parse_fresh.py)
  return {ok:true, enumVal:enumVal};
};
"""


def main():
    print('[*] connecting...')
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print(f'[*] attached pid={pid}')

    bag = pg.pick_singleton(sess, 'Niantic.Holoholo.Internal', 'PokemonBagImpl')
    print(f'[*] PokemonBagImpl={bag}')

    # bag_walk keys are UNSIGNED uint64 strings; convert the signed targets
    want = {str(int(u) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF): int(u) for u in TARGET_UIDS}
    protos = pg.find_protos_for_uids(sess, bag, list(want.keys()))
    print(f'[*] found {len(protos)} of {len(want)} target protos in the bag walk')

    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, READ_JS)
    print('\nuid (signed)            | card enum | card name')
    print('------------------------+-----------+------------------------------')
    for us, signed in want.items():
        pp = protos.get(us)
        if not pp:
            print(f'{signed:<23} | (not in bag walk / out of heap — open its detail screen)')
            continue
        r = sc.exports_sync.read_loc(pp)
        if not r.get('ok'):
            print(f'{signed:<23} | -- {r.get("why")}')
            continue
        ev = r['enumVal']
        print(f'{signed:<23} | {ev:<9} | {ENUM.get(ev, "??(%d)" % ev)}')
    sc.unload()
    sess.detach()
    print('\n[expect] 248/249/250 (LcSpecialbackground2026Mewtwo001/002/003) or 245 (Lc2026TokyoGofest001).')
    print('[then] re-run fresh_poll + parse_fresh with these mons in heap to persist fresh_loc_card_enum.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
def fmt(ms):
    try:
        ms = int(ms)
    except Exception:
        return None
    if 1_400_000_000_000 <= ms <= 2_000_000_000_000:           # plausible epoch ms (2014-2033)
        dt = datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(ms / 1000)
        jst = dt + datetime.timedelta(hours=9)
        fut = ' <<<< FUTURE' if ms > dev_ms else ''
        return f'{jst:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} JST{fut}'
    if 1_400_000_000 <= ms <= 2_000_000_000:                    # epoch seconds
        dt = datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(ms)
        jst = dt + datetime.timedelta(hours=9)
        fut = ' <<<< FUTURE' if ms * 1000 > dev_ms else ''
        return f'{jst:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} JST{fut}'
    return None


print('\n=== per-quest timestamps (non-trivial only) ===')
for q in r['quests']:
    tss = {k: fmt(v) for k, v in q['ts'].items()}
    tss = {k: v for k, v in tss.items() if v}
    gofest = 'GOFEST' in q['tid'].upper() or 'IRL_CITY' in q['tid'].upper()
    if tss or gofest:
        mark = '  [GOFEST]' if gofest else ''
        print(f"\n[{q['status']}] {q['tid']}{mark}")
        for k, v in tss.items():
            print(f'    {k} = {v}')
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/read_sfida_state.py`:

```py
"""READ-ONLY: dump LIVE field values of PoGo's Go Plus subsystem services to find
the active path + current cadence/range values. For each target service it finds
live instances (liveness API) and reads every field by type (Single->float etc.),
so the bubbleDelay / captureDelay / delay-period / scanning / connected-device
state is shown with real numbers. WRITES NOTHING.
"""
import sys, os, json
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

EXTRA_JS = r"""
var _R=null;
function _refl(){ if(_R) return _R; _ensureInit(); var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so'); var e={};
  il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
  function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
  _R={CGF:b('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),FGN:b('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),
      FGT:b('il2cpp_field_get_type','pointer',['pointer']),FGO:b('il2cpp_field_get_offset','uint32',['pointer']),
      TGN:b('il2cpp_type_get_name','pointer',['pointer'])};
  return _R;
}
function _cs(p){ try{return p.isNull()?'':p.readCString();}catch(e){return '';} }
function _rdCSStr(p){ try{ if(p.isNull())return null; var len=p.add(0x10).readS32(); if(len<0||len>256)return '(len?'+len+')'; var c=[]; for(var i=0;i<len;i++)c.push(String.fromCharCode(p.add(0x14+i*2).readU16())); return c.join(''); }catch(e){return '(err)';} }
function _rdField(inst,off,ty){
  try{
    if(ty==='System.Single') return inst.add(off).readFloat();
    if(ty==='System.Double') return inst.add(off).readDouble();
    if(ty==='System.Int32'||ty==='System.UInt32') return inst.add(off).readS32();
    if(ty==='System.Int64'||ty==='System.UInt64') return inst.add(off).readS64().toString();
    if(ty==='System.Boolean') return !!inst.add(off).readU8();
    if(ty==='System.Byte'||ty==='System.SByte') return inst.add(off).readU8();
    if(ty==='System.String') return _rdCSStr(inst.add(off).readPointer());
    var p=inst.add(off).readPointer();
    // generic RepeatedField/List count probe
    var cnt=null; try{ if(!p.isNull()){ var c=p.add(0x18).readS32(); if(c>=0&&c<100000)cnt=c; } }catch(e){}
    return 'ptr:'+p+(cnt!==null?(' (count@0x18='+cnt+')'):'');
  }catch(e){ return '(read err)'; }
}

rpc.exports.dumpInstance = function(ns, cls, instStr){
  _ensureInit(); var R=_refl(); var k=cFN(ns,cls); if(k.isNull()) return {err:'class not found'};
  var inst=ptr(instStr); var out=[];
  var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  while((f=R.CGF(k,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ var nm=_cs(R.FGN(f)); var off=R.FGO(f); var ty=_cs(R.TGN(R.FGT(f))); out.push({n:nm,o:'0x'+off.toString(16),t:ty,v:_rdField(inst,off,ty)}); }catch(e){} }
  return {fields:out};
};
"""

TARGETS = [
    ("Niantic.Holoholo.Services.SoftSfidaService", "SoftSfidaForegroundService"),
    ("Niantic.Holoholo.Services.SoftSfidaService", "SoftSfidaService"),
    ("Niantic.Holoholo.Pgp", "PgpService"),
    ("Niantic.Holoholo.Pgp", "PgpDeviceService"),
    ("PokemonGoPlus", "PgpState"),
    ("PokemonGoPlus", "PgpStateInternal"),
]


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached pid", pid)
    try:
        finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)          # has findSingleton
        sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, EXTRA_JS)     # has dumpInstance
        try:
            for ns, cls in TARGETS:
                r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, cls)
                hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
                err = r.get("err") if isinstance(r, dict) else None
                print(f"\n================ {ns}.{cls} ================")
                if err:
                    print("  find err:", err); continue
                print(f"  live instances: {len(hits)}")
                for h in hits[:2]:
                    d = sc.exports_sync.dump_instance(ns, cls, h)
                    if d.get("err"):
                        print("   dump err:", d["err"]); continue
                    for fld in d["fields"]:
                        ty = fld["t"]
                        interesting = (ty in ("System.Single", "System.Double", "System.Int32",
                                              "System.UInt32", "System.Int64", "System.Boolean")
                                       or "Settings" in ty or "Device" in ty or "List" in ty
                                       or "RepeatedField" in ty)
                        mark = " *" if interesting else ""
                        print(f"     {fld['n']}@{fld['o']}:{ty} = {fld['v']}{mark}")
        finally:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
    finally:
        sess.detach()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```py
def dump(sc, ns, cls, addr, label):
    print(f"\n================ {label}  ({ns}.{cls} @ {addr}) ================")
    if not addr or addr == "0x0":
        print("  (null)")
        return
    d = sc.exports_sync.dump_at(ns, cls, addr)
    if d.get("err"):
        print("  err:", d["err"]); return
    for line in d["fields"]:
        print("  ", line)


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached pid", pid)
    try:
        finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
        sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, EXTRA_JS)
        try:
            r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton("Niantic.Holoholo.Pgp", "PgpService")
            hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
            svc = None
            for h in hits:
                dev = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(h, 0xF0)   # cunk = connected ScannedWearableDevice
                if dev and dev != "0x0":
                    svc = h; break
            if not svc:
                svc = hits[0] if hits else None
            print("PgpService (real, device-connected):", svc)
            if not svc:
                print("no PgpService instance"); return
            waina = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(svc, 0x118)
            dev = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(svc, 0xF0)
            api = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(svc, 0xE8)
            dump(sc, "PokemonGoPlus", "PgpWainaDeviceReadSettings", waina, "WAINA AUTO-MODE / READ SETTINGS")
            dump(sc, "PokemonGoPlus", "ScannedWearableDevice", dev, "CONNECTED VIRTUAL DEVICE")
            dump(sc, "PokemonGoPlus", "PgpApi", api, "PGP API")
        finally:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
    finally:
        sess.detach()

    main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/read_waina_prefs.py`:

```py
"""Read live WainaPreferences (Go Plus + / wearable preferences) to find the ball-selection field
and its current value (POKE_BALL=1, GREAT_BALL=2, ULTRA_BALL=3). Confirms whether VGP3's catch ball
is a settable preference. Also dumps any 'auto throw' / ball Item fields. READ-ONLY."""
import sys, os, json
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

ITEM = {0: "UNKNOWN", 1: "POKE_BALL", 2: "GREAT_BALL", 3: "ULTRA_BALL", 4: "MASTER_BALL", 5: "PREMIER_BALL"}

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});

 H={dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]),iGN:b("il2cpp_image_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),iGCC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class_count","uint32",["pointer"]),iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]),CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),OGC:b("il2cpp_object_get_class","pointer",["pointer"]),CGF:b("il2cpp_class_get_fields","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),FGN:b("il2cpp_field_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),FGO:b("il2cpp_field_get_offset","uint32",["pointer"]),FGT:b("il2cpp_field_get_type","pointer",["pointer"]),TGN:b("il2cpp_type_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"])};
 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}
function img(name){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()===name)return im;}return null;}
function findClass(imageName,clsName){var h=H_();var im=img(imageName);if(!im)return null;var cnt=h.iGCC(im);for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++){var k=h.iGC(im,i);if(k.isNull())continue;try{if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===clsName)return k;}catch(e){}}return null;}
function kp(k){var b=[];var t=ptr(k);for(var i=0;i<8;i++){var v=t.and(0xff).toInt32();b.push((v<16?"0":"")+v.toString(16));t=t.shr(8);}return b.join(" ");}
function _cs(p){try{return p.isNull()?'':p.readCString();}catch(e){return '';}}
function _rd(inst,off,ty){try{
  if(ty==='System.Single')return inst.add(off).readFloat();
  if(ty==='System.Double')return inst.add(off).readDouble();
  if(ty.indexOf('Int64')>=0||ty.indexOf('UInt64')>=0)return inst.add(off).readS64().toString();
  if(ty.indexOf('Int32')>=0||ty.indexOf('UInt32')>=0)return inst.add(off).readS32();
  if(ty.indexOf('Item')>=0)return 'Item:'+inst.add(off).readS32();
  if(ty==='System.Boolean')return !!inst.add(off).readU8();
  return 'ptr:'+inst.add(off).readPointer();}catch(e){return '(err)';}}
function dumpObj(s){var h=H_();if(ptr(s).isNull())return{err:'null'};var k=h.OGC(ptr(s));var out=[];var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var f;while((f=h.CGF(k,it))&&!f.isNull()){try{var nm=_cs(h.FGN(f));var o=h.FGO(f);var ty=_cs(h.TGN(h.FGT(f)));out.push(nm+'@0x'+o.toString(16)+':'+ty+' = '+_rd(ptr(s),o,ty));}catch(e){}}return{cls:_cs(h.CGN(k)),fields:out};}
rpc.exports.dumpObj=function(s){return dumpObj(s);};
rpc.exports.findInstances=function(imageName,clsName){
 var h=H_();var k=findClass(imageName,clsName);if(!k)return{err:"no class "+clsName};
 var pat=kp(k);var out=[];
 Process.enumerateRanges("rw-").forEach(function(r){if(r.file||r.size<256||r.size>134217728)return;try{var hs=Memory.scanSync(r.base,r.size,pat);for(var i=0;i<hs.length&&out.length<20;i++)out.push(hs[i].address.toString());}catch(e){}});
 return {hits:out};
};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        for cls in ["WainaPreferences", "PlayerPreferencesProto", "GlobalSettingsProto"]:
            r = sc.exports_sync.find_instances("holo-protos.dll", cls)
            if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("err"):
                print(f"\n== {cls}: {r['err']}")
                continue
            hits = r.get("hits", [])
            print(f"\n== {cls}: {len(hits)} candidate instance(s) ==")
            shown = 0
            seen_sig = set()
            for h in hits:
                d = sc.exports_sync.dump_obj(h)
                if d.get("cls") != cls:
                    continue
                # only show ones with ball/throw/item fields, dedupe by field signature
                fields = d.get("fields", [])
                ball_fields = [f for f in fields if any(k in f.lower() for k in ["ball", "item", "throw", "auto"])]
                if not ball_fields and cls == "WainaPreferences":
                    pass  # still show waina
                sig = tuple(f.split("=")[0] for f in fields)
                if sig in seen_sig:
                    continue
                seen_sig.add(sig)
                print(f"  @{h}:")
                for f in fields:
                    mark = ""
                    if "Item:" in f:
                        try:
                            v = int(f.split("Item:")[1].strip())
                            mark = f"   <-- {ITEM.get(v, '?')}"
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                    if any(k in f.lower() for k in ["ball", "throw", "item"]):
                        print(f"      {f}{mark}")
                shown += 1
                if shown >= 3:
                    break
            if shown == 0:
                print("  (no valid instances)")
        sess.detach()
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
"""#2 main-thread PUMP recon (READ-ONLY): find a per-frame, main-thread method to drive the catch
sequence from (so SendEncounterRequest/AttemptCapture run on Unity's main thread, not a Frida thread).
Hooks candidate Update/Tick/LateUpdate methods on core controllers and measures call rate over a window."""
import sys, os, time, json
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))

import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});

 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}
function img(name){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()===name)return im;}return null;}

rpc.exports.candidates=function(){var h=H_();var im=img("holo-game.dll");var cnt=h.iGCC(im);var out=[];var re=/Controller|Manager|View|Camera|Overworld|World|Avatar|Input|GameLoop|MapExploration|MainScreen|Hud/;for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++){var k=h.iGC(im,i);if(k.isNull())continue;var cn;try{cn=h.CGN(k).readCString();}catch(e){continue;}if(!re.test(cn))continue;var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var m;while((m=h.cGM(k,it))&&!m.isNull()){try{var nm=h.mGN(m).readCString();if((nm==="Update"||nm==="LateUpdate"||nm==="Tick")&&h.mGPC(m)===0)out.push(cn+"|"+nm);}catch(e){}}if(out.length>=40)break;}return out;};

def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        cands = sc.exports_sync.candidates()
        print(f"candidate per-frame methods: {len(cands)}")
        cands = cands[:14]
        sc.exports_sync.arm(cands)
        time.sleep(3.0)
        rates = sc.exports_sync.rates()
        print("\n=== call counts over 3s (high = per-frame main-thread pump) ===")
        for r in sorted(rates, key=lambda s: -int(s.split("= ")[-1])):
            print("  ", r)
        sess.detach()
    finally:
        try: sess.detach()
        except Exception: pass
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/recon_asymmetry.py`:

```py
"""RECON (READ-ONLY): triple-check the catch-vs-spin asymmetry at the proto schema level,
live from libil2cpp metadata (not from any cached file). Dumps the field list of the
request+response protos for BOTH the catch path and the spin path, so we can see directly
whether a player coordinate is present (and therefore range-checkable) on each.
Pure schema read. No hooks on live data, no writes."""
import sys, os
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so"); var e={};
 il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){ if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0) e[x.name]=x.address; });
 function b(n,r,a){ return e[n]? new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a): null; }
 H={ dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]), dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),
     aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]), iGCC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class_count","uint32",["pointer"]),
     iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]), CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
     cGF:b("il2cpp_class_get_fields","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]), fGN:b("il2cpp_field_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]), fGO:b("il2cpp_field_get_offset","uint32",["pointer"]),
     tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"]) };
 H.tA(H.dG()); return H; }
function eachClass(cb){ var h=H_(); var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp); var n=sp.readS32();
 for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); var cnt=h.iGCC(im);
   for(var j=0;j<cnt;j++){ var k=h.iGC(im,j); if(!k.isNull()) cb(k); } } }
function findClass(name){ var h=H_(); var f=null; eachClass(function(k){ if(f)return; try{ if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===name) f=k; }catch(e){} }); return f; }
function fieldsList(k){ var h=H_(); var out=[]; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  while((f=h.cGF(k,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ out.push(h.fGN(f).readCString()+" @0x"+h.fGO(f).toString(16)); }catch(e){} } return out; }
rpc.exports.fields=function(clsName){ var k=findClass(clsName); if(!k) return null; return fieldsList(k); };
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.load()
    print(f"attached {pid}\n")
    targets = [
        ("SPIN request", "FortSearchProto"),
        ("SPIN response", "FortSearchOutProto"),
        ("CATCH request", "CatchPokemonProto"),
        ("CATCH response", "CatchPokemonOutProto"),
        ("ENCOUNTER request", "EncounterProto"),
        ("ENCOUNTER response", "EncounterOutProto"),
    ]
    coord_terms = ("lat", "lng", "longitude", "latitude")
    for label, cls in targets:
        fl = sc.exports_sync.fields(cls)
        if fl is None:
            print(f"### {label}: {cls}  -> [class not found]\n")
            continue
        coords = [f for f in fl if any(t in f.lower() for t in coord_terms)]
        print(f"### {label}: {cls}   ({len(fl)} fields)")
        for f in fl:
            mark = "  <== COORDINATE" if any(t in f.lower() for t in coord_terms) else ""
            print(f"      {f}{mark}")
        print(f"   >> player/fort COORDINATE fields: {coords if coords else 'NONE'}\n")
    sc.unload(); sess.detach()


main()

```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/recon_badge.py`:

```py
"""RECON (READ-ONLY): read the REAL Berry Master tier thresholds from the device's loaded BadgeSettingsProto
(target[] per tier) instead of trusting web/canonical numbers. Dumps HoloBadgeType to find the berry-feed
badge, then finds BadgeSettingsProto instances and prints the matching target array. WRITES NOTHING."""
import sys, os
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

READER_JS = r"""
var PROTO_IMAGE=null,OGC=null,CGN=null,CGF=null,FGN=null,FGO=null,FGFlags=null,FSGV=null;
function _proto(){ if(PROTO_IMAGE)return; _ensureInit(); var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so'); function nf(n,r,a){return new NativeFunction(il.getExportByName(n),r,a);}
 OGC=nf('il2cpp_object_get_class','pointer',['pointer']); CGN=nf('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']); CGF=nf('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']); FGN=nf('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']); FGO=nf('il2cpp_field_get_offset','uint32',['pointer']); FGFlags=nf('il2cpp_field_get_flags','int',['pointer']); FSGV=nf('il2cpp_field_static_get_value','void',['pointer','pointer']);
 var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var asms=IL2.dGA(IL2.dG(),sp); var na=sp.readS32(); for(var a=0;a<na;a++){var im=IL2.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if(IL2.iGN(im).readCString()==='holo-protos.dll'){PROTO_IMAGE=im;break;}} }
function protoCls(ns,nm){_proto(); return IL2.cFN(PROTO_IMAGE,Memory.allocUtf8String(ns),Memory.allocUtf8String(nm));}
function clsName(o){try{if(!o||o.isNull())return null;return CGN(OGC(o)).readCString();}catch(e){return null;}}
function rfInts(rf){var out=[];try{if(!rf||rf.isNull())return out;var arr=rf.add(0x10).readPointer();var cnt=rf.add(0x18).readS32();if(arr&&!arr.isNull()&&cnt>0&&cnt<32)for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++)out.push(arr.add(0x20).add(i*4).readS32());}catch(e){}return out;}
rpc.exports.dumpEnum=function(ns,name){ _proto(); var cls=protoCls(ns,name); if(!cls||cls.isNull())return {err:'no '+name}; var out={}; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f; while((f=CGF(cls,it))&&!f.isNull()){try{var fl=FGFlags(f); if(!((fl&0x10)&&(fl&0x40)))continue; var nm=FGN(f).readCString(); if(nm==='value__')continue; var buf=Memory.alloc(8); buf.writeU64(0); FSGV(f,buf); out[buf.readS32()]=nm;}catch(e){}} return {map:out}; };
rpc.exports.readBadge=function(addr){ _proto(); var p=ptr(addr); var cls=OGC(p); var off={}; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
 while((f=CGF(cls,it))&&!f.isNull()){try{off[FGN(f).readCString()]=FGO(f);}catch(e){}}
 var bt=null,btn=null; ['BadgeType','badgeType','Type','badgeTypeId'].forEach(function(n){if(off[n]!==undefined&&bt===null){try{bt=p.add(off[n]).readS32();btn=n;}catch(e){}}});
 var tgt=[],tn=null; ['Target','target','Targets','targets','TargetValue'].forEach(function(n){ if(off[n]!==undefined&&tgt.length===0){var t=rfInts(p.add(off[n]).readPointer());if(t.length){tgt=t;tn=n;}} });
 return {cls:clsName(p), fields:Object.keys(off), badgeType:bt, btField:btn, targets:tgt, tField:tn};
};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, READER_JS)
    try:
        en = sc.exports_sync.dump_enum('Holoholo.Rpc', 'HoloBadgeType')
        berry_ids = {}
        if isinstance(en, dict) and en.get('map'):
            for k, v in en['map'].items():
                if 'berr' in v.lower() or 'feed' in v.lower():
                    berry_ids[int(k)] = v
        print("berry/feed badge enum entries:", berry_ids)

        r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton('Holoholo.Rpc', 'BadgeSettingsProto')
        hits = (r.get('hits', []) if isinstance(r, dict) else [])
        print(f"BadgeSettingsProto instances: {len(hits)}")
        printed_sample = False
        matches = []
        allrows = []
        for h in hits:
            b = sc.exports_sync.read_badge(h)
            if not printed_sample:
                print("  sample fields:", b.get('fields'))
                print("  btField:", b.get('btField'), " tField:", b.get('tField'))
                printed_sample = True
            bt = b.get('badgeType'); tg = b.get('targets') or []
            allrows.append((bt, tuple(tg)))
            if bt in berry_ids and tg:
                matches.append((berry_ids[bt], bt, tg))
        print()
        if matches:
            for name, bt, tg in matches:
                print(f">>> {name} (type {bt})  TIER TARGETS = {tg}")
        else:
            print("no BadgeSettingsProto matched a berry/feed badge type; distinct (type,targets) seen:")
            for row in sorted(set(allrows))[:40]:
                print("   ", row)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()

```

```py
def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        for img in ["holo-game.dll", "holo-protos.dll"]:
            ms = sc.exports_sync.method_scan("UseItem|UseEncounterItem|UseCaptureItem|Berry|Razz|Pinap|UseItemCapture|UseItemEncounter", img)
            print(f"\n=== methods /UseItem|Berry|Razz|Pinap/ in {img} ===", flush=True)
            for m in sorted(set(ms or [])):
                print("   ", m, flush=True)
        print("\n=== classes /UseItem.*Proto|Berry/ in holo-protos.dll ===", flush=True)
        for c in sorted(set(sc.exports_sync.class_scan("UseItem.*Proto|Berry|CaptureItem", "holo-protos.dll") or [])):
            print("   ", c, flush=True)
        print("\n=== MapPokemon methods (does the fast-catch object expose a berry call?) ===", flush=True)
        for m in (sc.exports_sync.dump_methods("MapPokemon", "holo-game.dll") or []):
            print("   ", m, flush=True)
        print("\n=== ItemBagImpl UseItem*/Predict signatures (how to call the berry) ===", flush=True)
        for m in (sc.exports_sync.full_methods("ItemBagImpl", "holo-game.dll", "UseItemForEncounter|UseItemOnPokemon|PredictUseItem") or []):
            print("   ", m, flush=True)
        # Item enum -> berry IDs
        for en, image in [("Item", "holo-protos.dll"), ("ItemId", "holo-protos.dll")]:
            ev = sc.exports_sync.enum_vals(en, image)
            if ev:
                berries = [x for x in ev if any(k in x.upper() for k in ["RAZZ", "PINAP", "NANAB", "BERRY"])]
                print(f"\n=== {en} berry IDs [{image}] ===", flush=True)
                for x in berries:
                    print("   ", x, flush=True)
                break
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
"""#2 RECON (READ-ONLY): map the game's managed encounter+catch API so the Ultra auto-catcher can
DRIVE the game's own (signed) catch path instead of forging RPCs.
Dumps methods of the encounter/catch classes VGP3 hooks, and searches holo-game.dll for catch/encounter
service methods + how nearby wild Pokemon (with encounter ids) are enumerated."""

function img(name){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()===name)return im;}return null;}

def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        for cls in ["EncounterInteractionState", "EncounterState", "EncounterPokemon"]:
            r = sc.exports_sync.methods("holo-game.dll", cls)
            print(f"\n===== {cls} =====")
            if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("methods"):
                for m in r["methods"]:
                    if any(k in m.lower() for k in ["catch", "throw", "ball", "encounter", "attempt", "capture", "start", "begin", "result"]):
                        print("  ", m)
            else:
                print("  ", r)
        for sub in ["AttemptCatch", "ThrowPokeball", "CatchPokemon", "SendCatch", "StartEncounter", "RequestEncounter"]:
            r = sc.exports_sync.search_methods("holo-game.dll", sub)
            hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
            print(f"\n== methods ~ '{sub}' ({len(hits)}) ==")
            for h in hits[:20]:
                print("  ", h)
        print("\n== Encounter service classes ==")
        for c in sorted(set(sc.exports_sync.search_classes("holo-game.dll", "EncounterService") + sc.exports_sync.search_classes("holo-game.dll", "CatchService"))):
            print("  ", c)
        sess.detach()
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
                # for methods, only show interesting ones to keep it readable

                    continue
                print("   ", x)
    finally:

            sc.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass

            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/recon_cells.py`:

```py
"""RECON (READ-ONLY): drill into GMO map cells and read every fort the server
serves -- position + Enabled/Closed/Visited/Type/Cooldown -- to see whether
spinnable stops actually exist at your spot. Pure read."""
import sys, os, time, math
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

# your last-known player position (from the spin recon)
PLAT, PLNG = 41.89181, -87.59935

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so"); var e={};
 il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){ if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0) e[x.name]=x.address; });
 function b(n,r,a){ return e[n]? new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a): null; }
 H={ dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]), dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),
     aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]), iGCC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class_count","uint32",["pointer"]),
     iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]), CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
     cGF:b("il2cpp_class_get_fields","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]), fGN:b("il2cpp_field_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]), fGO:b("il2cpp_field_get_offset","uint32",["pointer"]),
     cGM:b("il2cpp_class_get_methods","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]), mGN:b("il2cpp_method_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
     OGC:b("il2cpp_object_get_class","pointer",["pointer"]), tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"]) };
 H.tA(H.dG()); return H; }
function eachClass(cb){ var h=H_(); var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp); var n=sp.readS32();
 for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); var cnt=h.iGCC(im);
   for(var j=0;j<cnt;j++){ var k=h.iGC(im,j); if(!k.isNull()) cb(k); } } }
function findClass(name){ var h=H_(); var f=null; eachClass(function(k){ if(f)return; try{ if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===name) f=k; }catch(e){} }); return f; }
function fieldsOf(k){ var h=H_(); var out=[]; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f; while((f=h.cGF(k,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ out.push({n:h.fGN(f).readCString(), o:h.fGO(f)}); }catch(e){} } return out; }
function rep(self, off){ try{ var rf=self.add(off).readPointer(); if(rf.isNull())return null; var cnt=rf.add(0x18).readS32(); var arr=rf.add(0x10).readPointer(); if(cnt<0||cnt>100000||arr.isNull())return null; return {cnt:cnt, arr:arr}; }catch(e){ return null; } }
function elem(r, i){ return r.arr.add(0x20 + i*8).readPointer(); }

var LOG=[]; function L(s){ LOG.push(s); }
rpc.exports.drain=function(){ var o=LOG; LOG=[]; return o; };

rpc.exports.install=function(){ var h=H_(); var gk=findClass("GetMapObjectsOutProto"); if(!gk) return "no GMO";
 var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var m; var hk=0;
 while((m=h.cGM(gk,it))&&!m.isNull()){ try{ if(h.mGN(m).readCString()!=="MergeFrom")continue; var code=m.readPointer(); if(!code||code.isNull())continue;
   Interceptor.attach(code,{ onEnter:function(a){ this.s=a[0]; }, onLeave:function(){ try{ var self=this.s; if(!self||self.isNull())return;
     var cells=rep(self,0x10); if(!cells||cells.cnt===0)return;
     // identify the fort field in a cell by element class containing "Fort"
     var c0=elem(cells,0); if(!c0||c0.isNull())return; var cellCls=h.OGC(c0); var cf=fieldsOf(cellCls);
     var fortOff=null, fortElem=null, summary=[];
     for(var i=0;i<cf.length;i++){ var r=rep(c0,cf[i].o); if(r&&r.cnt>0){ var e0=elem(r,0); var ec=""; try{ ec=h.CGN(h.OGC(e0)).readCString(); }catch(e){} summary.push(cf[i].n+"="+r.cnt+"("+ec+")"); if(ec.indexOf("Fort")>=0 && fortOff===null){ fortOff=cf[i].o; fortElem=ec; } } }
     L("cell["+cellCls?"":""+"] sample fields: "+summary.join(", "));
     if(fortOff===null){ L("NO FORT FIELD FOUND in cells"); return; }
     // sum forts across all cells + read each fort
     var total=0, en=0, cl=0, lines=[];
     for(var ci=0; ci<cells.cnt; ci++){ var cell=elem(cells,ci); if(!cell||cell.isNull())continue; var fr=rep(cell,fortOff); if(!fr||fr.cnt===0)continue;
       for(var fi=0; fi<fr.cnt; fi++){ var ft=elem(fr,fi); if(!ft||ft.isNull())continue; total++;
         try{ var lat=ft.add(0x20).readDouble(), lng=ft.add(0x28).readDouble(); var enabled=ft.add(0x3c).readU8(); var closed=ft.add(0x88).readU8(); var ftype=ft.add(0x40).readS32(); var visited=ft.add(0xa0).readU8(); var cd=ft.add(0x68).readS64().toString();
           if(enabled)en++; if(closed)cl++;
           if(lines.length<25) lines.push(lat.toFixed(6)+","+lng.toFixed(6)+" en="+enabled+" cl="+closed+" type="+ftype+" vis="+visited+" cdMs="+cd);
         }catch(e){}
       } }
     L("FORTS served by server: total="+total+" enabled="+en+" closed="+cl+" (elem="+fortElem+")");
     for(var li=0; li<lines.length; li++) L("  fort: "+lines[li]);
   }catch(e){ L("err "+e); } } }); hk++; }catch(e){} }
 return "hooked "+hk; };
"""


def hav(a1, o1, a2, o2):
    R = 6371000
    p1 = math.radians(a1); p2 = math.radians(a2)
    dp = math.radians(a2-a1); dl = math.radians(o2-o1)
    x = math.sin(dp/2)**2 + math.cos(p1)*math.cos(p2)*math.sin(dl/2)**2
    return 2*R*math.asin(min(1, math.sqrt(x)))


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    sc = sess.create_script(JS)
    sc.load()
    print("install:", sc.exports_sync.install(), flush=True)
    print(f">>> watching 50s for a cell-bearing GMO (player ref {PLAT},{PLNG}) <<<", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    got = False
    while time.time() - t0 < 50:
        time.sleep(3)
        for line in (sc.exports_sync.drain() or []):
            if line.startswith("  fort: "):
                try:
                    body = line.split("fort: ")[1]
                    coord = body.split(" ")[0]
                    la, lo = float(coord.split(",")[0]), float(coord.split(",")[1])
                    d = hav(PLAT, PLNG, la, lo)
                    print(f"  fort @ {d:6.0f} m  | {body}", flush=True)
                except Exception:
                    print("  ", line, flush=True)
            else:
                print("  ", line, flush=True)
                if "FORTS served" in line:
                    got = True
        if got and time.time() - t0 > 20:
            break
    try:
        sc.unload(); sess.detach()
    except Exception:
        pass


main()
```
