```py
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        print("install:", sc.exports_sync.install(), flush=True)
        ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of("IapService")
        r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "IapService") if ns else {}
        best = None
        for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []):
            if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != "IapService":
                continue
            coins = sc.exports_sync.call0i(h, "get_Coins")
            dv = sc.exports_sync.call0i(h, "get_Stardusts")
            if coins is None or coins < 0:
                continue
            key = (coins, dv if (dv is not None and dv >= 0) else -1)
            if best is None or key > best[1]:
                best = (h, key)
        iap = best[0] if best else None

        def bal():
            return sc.exports_sync.call0i(iap, "get_Stardusts") if iap else -1

        # PHASE A — align to a balance COMMIT so the baseline carries no pre-existing backlog
        print(f"server-backed IapService={iap} (coins={best[1][0] if best else '?'})", flush=True)
        print("aligning to a sync boundary (waiting for one balance commit, discarding backlog)...", flush=True)
        sc.exports_sync.get_events()
        prevb = bal()
        ta = time.time()
        while time.time() - ta < 35:
            time.sleep(0.4)
            sc.exports_sync.get_events()  # discard awards earned before our clean baseline
            b = bal()
            if b >= 0 and prevb >= 0 and b > prevb:
                break
            if b >= 0:
                prevb = b
        sc.exports_sync.get_events()  # final discard -> counter starts clean
        b0 = bal()
        print(f"aligned. clean baseline B0={b0}\nmeasuring ~100s (each line = a server balance commit)...\n", flush=True)
        # PHASE B — count EVERY server award; watch the balance commit in batches
        award_sum = 0
        n = 0
        last = b0
        t0 = time.time()
        while time.time() - t0 < 100:
            time.sleep(0.4)
            for a in (sc.exports_sync.get_events() or []):
                award_sum += a
                n += 1
            b = bal()
            if b >= 0 and b != last:
                print(f"  commit {last}->{b} (+{b-last}) | cumulative server awards={award_sum} over n={n} catches", flush=True)
                last = b
        # PHASE C — let the final batch commit so the balance reflects every counted award
        print("\nwaiting for the final commit to settle...", flush=True)
        stable = 0
        lastb = bal()
        for _ in range(60):
            time.sleep(0.4)
            b = bal()
            if b >= 0 and b == lastb:
                stable += 1
            else:
                stable = 0
                lastb = b
            if stable >= 20:
                break
        final = bal()
        gain = final - b0 if (final >= 0 and b0 >= 0) else None
        print(f"\n===== RESULT over {n} catches (clean sync boundaries) =====", flush=True)
        print(f"  sum of SERVER awards : {award_sum}", flush=True)
        print(f"  balance gain         : {b0} -> {final} = {gain}", flush=True)
        if gain is not None:
            diff = gain - award_sum
            tol = max(300, int(award_sum * 0.03))
            if abs(diff) <= tol:
                v = "EVERY CATCH CREDITED — balance gained exactly the server awards (no loss, no inflation)"
            elif diff > tol:
                v = f"balance gained {diff} MORE than awards — inflation OR leftover backlog (re-check)"
            else:
                v = f"balance gained {-diff} LESS than awards — POSSIBLE LOST CREDIT (investigate)"
            print(f"  VERDICT: {v}  (diff={diff}, tol=+/-{tol})", flush=True)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/recon_encsettings_dict.py`:

```py
"""RECON (READ-ONLY) stage 2: from the live GameMasterData, reach EncounterSettingsProto.
- Walk crlp : Dictionary<System.Type, IMessage> @0xd8 (the global proto bag) and report
  every value's class -> locate EncounterSettingsProto and read its fields.
- Also introspect crkt : IGlobalSettings @0x28 for an encounter-settings getter.
Attaches alongside the running catcher; touches nothing.
GM_ADDR is re-resolved each run via EncounterState @0x150 (ptr drifts across processes).
"""
import sys, os, time
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});

 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}

function cname(o){try{var h=H_();return (h.CGNS(h.OGC(ptr(o))).readCString()||"")+"."+h.CGN(h.OGC(ptr(o))).readCString();}catch(e){return null;}}
rpc.exports.clsName=function(inst){return cname(inst);};
rpc.exports.readPtr=function(inst,off){try{var p=ptr(inst).add(off).readPointer();return p.isNull()?null:p.toString();}catch(e){return ""+e;}};

// Walk a System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<K,V> object. Standard layout:
//   +0x18 entries[]   +0x20 count(int)   entry stride 0x18: [0]=hashCode(i32) [0x8]=key(ptr) [0x10]=value(ptr) ...
// (key/value order can be [key@0x10,val@0x18] for some; we report both candidates' class.)
// Returns list of {idx, kcls, v10cls, v18cls, v10, v18}.
rpc.exports.walkDict=function(dictAddr){var h=H_();var d=ptr(dictAddr);var out={entries:[]};
 try{
  var entries=d.add(0x18).readPointer();
  var count=d.add(0x20).readS32();
  out.count=count;
  if(entries.isNull()){out.err="null entries";return out;}
  // array data starts at +0x20 (Il2Cpp Array: +0x18 length, +0x20 first element)
  var alen=entries.add(0x18).readS32();
  out.arrlen=alen;
  var base=entries.add(0x20);
  var n=Math.min(count<0?alen:count, alen, 4000);
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var e=base.add(i*0x18);var rec={idx:i};
    try{rec.hash=e.add(0x0).readS32();}catch(_){}
    var p8=null,p10=null,p18=null;
    try{p8=e.add(0x8).readPointer();}catch(_){}
    try{p10=e.add(0x10).readPointer();}catch(_){}
    try{p18=e.add(0x18).readPointer();}catch(_){}
    if(p8&&!p8.isNull()){rec.c8=cname(p8);rec.p8=p8.toString();}
    if(p10&&!p10.isNull()){rec.c10=cname(p10);rec.p10=p10.toString();}
    out.entries.push(rec);}
 }catch(e){out.err=""+e;}
 return out;};

// Dump methods of class-of-instance (walk parents). [{name,argc,ret}]
rpc.exports.dumpMethodsOfInst=function(inst){var h=H_();var k=h.OGC(ptr(inst));var out=[];var guard=0;

  while((m=h.cGM(k,it))&&!m.isNull()&&out.length<400){try{var rt="?";try{rt=h.tGN(h.mGRT(m)).readCString();}catch(e){}out.push({name:h.mGN(m).readCString(),argc:h.mGPC(m),ret:rt});}catch(e){}}
  try{k=h.cGParent(k);}catch(e){break;} guard++;}
 return out;};
rpc.exports.instFields=function(inst){var h=H_();var out=[];var k=h.OGC(ptr(inst));var guard=0;
 while(k&&!k.isNull()&&guard<8){var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var f;
  while((f=h.cGF(k,it))&&!f.isNull()&&out.length<200){try{var tn="?";try{tn=h.tGN(h.fGT(f)).readCString();}catch(e){}out.push({off:h.fGO(f),name:h.fGN(f).readCString(),type:tn});}catch(e){}}
  try{k=h.cGParent(k);}catch(e){break;} guard++;}
 return out;};

rpc.exports.readEncSettings=function(s){var p=ptr(s);try{return {
   GlobalStardustMultiplier:p.add(0x60).readFloat(),
   GlobalCandyMultiplier:p.add(0x64).readFloat(),
   SpinBonusThreshold:p.add(0x10).readFloat(),
   ExcellentThrowThreshold:p.add(0x14).readFloat(),
   GreatThrowThreshold:p.add(0x18).readFloat(),
   NiceThrowThreshold:p.add(0x1c).readFloat(),
   CriticalReticleThreshold:p.add(0x68).readFloat(),
   CriticalReticleCatchMultiplier:p.add(0x6c).readFloat()
 };}catch(e){return {err:""+e};}};
"""

ENC_NS = "Niantic.Holoholo.Encounter"
ENC_CLS = "EncounterState"


def resolve_gm(finder, sc):
    """Re-find a live EncounterState and read its IGameMasterData @0x150."""
    for _ in range(8):
        r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ENC_NS, ENC_CLS)
        hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
        for h in hits:
            cn = sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h)
            if cn and cn.endswith("." + ENC_CLS):
                gm = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(h, 0x150)
                if gm and gm.startswith("0x"):
                    return h, gm
        time.sleep(1.0)
    return None, None


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        es, gm = resolve_gm(finder, sc)
        print(f"EncounterState={es}  GameMasterData={gm} ({sc.exports_sync.cls_name(gm) if gm else None})", flush=True)
        if not gm:
            print("NO GameMasterData.", flush=True); return

        # --- A. Walk crlp : Dictionary<Type, IMessage> @0xd8 (global proto bag) ---
        dictp = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(gm, 0xd8)
        print(f"\ncrlp Dictionary<Type,IMessage> @0xd8 = {dictp}", flush=True)
        enc_proto = None
        if dictp and dictp.startswith("0x"):
            res = sc.exports_sync.walk_dict(dictp)
            print(f"  count={res.get('count')} arrlen={res.get('arrlen')} err={res.get('err')}", flush=True)
            ents = res.get("entries", []) if isinstance(res, dict) else []
            print(f"  --- proto-bag values ({len(ents)} entries) ---", flush=True)
            for e in ents:
                c10 = e.get("c10")
                line = f"   idx{e.get('idx')} hash={e.get('hash')} key={e.get('c8')} val={c10} @ {e.get('p10')}"
                if c10 and "EncounterSettings" in c10:
                    line += "   <<<<< ENCOUNTERSETTINGS"
                    enc_proto = e.get("p10")
                print(line, flush=True)

        # --- B. Introspect crkt : IGlobalSettings @0x28 ---
        gs = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(gm, 0x28)
        print(f"\ncrkt IGlobalSettings @0x28 = {gs} ({sc.exports_sync.cls_name(gs) if gs else None})", flush=True)
        if gs and gs.startswith("0x"):
            ms = sc.exports_sync.dump_methods_of_inst(gs) or []
            print(f"  --- IGlobalSettings impl methods returning Encounter/Settings ({len(ms)} total) ---", flush=True)
            for m in ms:
                rl = m["ret"].lower()
                if "encounter" in rl or "settings" in rl or "global" in rl:
                    print(f"     {m['name']} ({m['argc']}) -> {m['ret']}", flush=True)
            fs = sc.exports_sync.inst_fields(gs) or []
            print(f"  --- IGlobalSettings impl fields with Encounter/Settings type ---", flush=True)
            for f in fs:
                tl = f["type"].lower()
                if "encounter" in tl or "settings" in tl:
                    print(f"     +0x{f['off']:x} {f['name']} : {f['type']}", flush=True)

        # --- C. If we found the proto, READ THE FIELDS ---
        if enc_proto:
            print(f"\n=== LIVE EncounterSettingsProto @ {enc_proto} ===", flush=True)
            vals = sc.exports_sync.read_enc_settings(enc_proto)
            print("FIELDS:", vals, flush=True)
        else:
            print("\n(No EncounterSettingsProto found in proto bag — see IGlobalSettings leads above.)", flush=True)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/recon_encsettings_gm.py`:

```py
ENC_NS = "Niantic.Holoholo.Encounter"
ENC_CLS = "EncounterState"


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        # 1. Find a live EncounterState
        es = None
        for _ in range(8):
            r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ENC_NS, ENC_CLS)
            if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("err"):
                print("find_singleton err:", r["err"], flush=True)
                break
            hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
            for h in hits:
                cn = sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h)
                if cn and cn.endswith("." + ENC_CLS):
                    es = h
                    break
            if es:
                break
            time.sleep(1.5)
        print(f"\nlive {ENC_CLS}: {es}", flush=True)
        if not es:
            print("NO live EncounterState found.", flush=True)
            return

        # 2. Dump its fields to confirm dqvp @0x150 and find candidate settings holders
        flds = sc.exports_sync.inst_fields(es) or []
        print(f"\n--- {ENC_CLS} fields ({len(flds)}) ---", flush=True)
        for f in flds:
            print(f"   +0x{f['off']:x} {f['name']} : {f['type']}", flush=True)

        # 3. Read the IGameMasterData pointer @0x150 (and confirm what field is there)
        gm = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(es, 0x150)
        print(f"\nfield @0x150 (expected dqvp:IGameMasterData) = {gm}", flush=True)
        if gm and gm.startswith("0x"):
            gmcls = sc.exports_sync.cls_name(gm)
            print(f"   class of @0x150 obj = {gmcls}", flush=True)
            # Dump the game-master object's methods + fields
            ms = sc.exports_sync.dump_methods_of_inst(gm) or []
            print(f"\n--- game-master obj methods ({len(ms)}) ---", flush=True)
            for m in ms:
                rl = m['ret'].lower()
                tag = "  <== ENC/SETTINGS" if ('encounter' in rl or 'setting' in rl) else ""
                print(f"   {m['name']} ({m['argc']}) -> {m['ret']}{tag}", flush=True)
            gflds = sc.exports_sync.inst_fields(gm) or []
            print(f"\n--- game-master obj fields ({len(gflds)}) ---", flush=True)
            for f in gflds:
                tl = f['type'].lower()
                tag = "  <== ENC/SETTINGS" if ('encounter' in tl or 'setting' in tl) else ""
                print(f"   +0x{f['off']:x} {f['name']} : {f['type']}{tag}", flush=True)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/recon_enum.py`:

```py
"""RECON (READ-ONLY): read the ACTUAL enum constant names+values out of this client's
libil2cpp metadata (ground truth), instead of trusting the published POGOProtos numbering.
Resolves a proto field -> its enum type -> every literal constant (name = value).
Pure metadata read."""
import sys, os
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so"); var e={};
 il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){ if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0) e[x.name]=x.address; });
 function b(n,r,a){ return e[n]? new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a): null; }
 H={ dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]), dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),
     aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]), iGCC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class_count","uint32",["pointer"]),
     iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]), CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
     cGF:b("il2cpp_class_get_fields","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]), fGN:b("il2cpp_field_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
     fGT:b("il2cpp_field_get_type","pointer",["pointer"]), cFT:b("il2cpp_class_from_type","pointer",["pointer"]),
     fSGV:b("il2cpp_field_static_get_value","void",["pointer","pointer"]),
     fGFL:b("il2cpp_field_get_flags","uint32",["pointer"]), tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"]) };
 H.tA(H.dG()); return H; }
function eachClass(cb){ var h=H_(); var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp); var n=sp.readS32();
 for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); var cnt=h.iGCC(im);
   for(var j=0;j<cnt;j++){ var k=h.iGC(im,j); if(!k.isNull()) cb(k); } } }
function findClass(name){ var h=H_(); var f=null; eachClass(function(k){ if(f)return; try{ if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===name) f=k; }catch(e){} }); return f; }

// resolve PROTO.FIELD -> enum class, then dump every literal constant (name = int value)
rpc.exports.enumvals=function(protoName, fieldName){ var h=H_(); var k=findClass(protoName); if(!k) return ["[no proto] "+protoName];
  var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f; var target=null;
  while((f=h.cGF(k,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ if(h.fGN(f).readCString()===fieldName){ target=f; break; } }catch(e){} }
  if(!target) return ["[no field] "+protoName+"."+fieldName];
  var ek=h.cFT(h.fGT(target));
  var out=["ENUM "+protoName+"."+fieldName+"  ("+h.CGN(ek).readCString()+"):"];
  var it2=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it2.writePointer(ptr(0)); var ef; var buf=Memory.alloc(8);
  while((ef=h.cGF(ek,it2))&&!ef.isNull()){ try{ var nm=h.fGN(ef).readCString(); var fl=h.fGFL(ef);
    if(nm==="value__" || (fl & 0x10)===0) continue;   // skip backing field + non-static
    buf.writeU64(0); var val="?";
    try{ h.fSGV(ef, buf); val=buf.readS32(); }catch(e){ val="(unreadable)"; }
    out.push("    "+val+"  =  "+nm);
  }catch(e){} }
  return out; };
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.load()
    print(f"attached {pid}\n")
    for proto, field in [("FortSearchOutProto", "Result"),
                         ("CatchPokemonOutProto", "Status"),
                         ("EncounterOutProto", "Status")]:
        for line in sc.exports_sync.enumvals(proto, field):
            print(line)
        print()
    sc.unload(); sess.detach()


main()
```

```py
STATUS = {0: "Error", 1: "Caught", 2: "Escape", 3: "FLEE", 4: "Missed", 5: "ItemReplace"}


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        print("install:", sc.exports_sync.install(), flush=True)
        for cls in ["EncounterPokemon", "MapPokemon"]:
            for image in ["holo-game.dll"]:
                ms = sc.exports_sync.methods(cls, image, "dodge|jump|attack|flee|move|agitat|idle|behavi|animat")
                if ms:
                    print(f"\n=== {cls} behaviour methods ===", flush=True)
                    for m in ms:
                        print("   ", m, flush=True)
        print("\n=== watching catch results (status / throwsRemaining / missPercent) ===", flush=True)
        tally = {}
        t0 = time.time()
        n = 0
        while time.time() - t0 < 60 and n < 60:
            time.sleep(1.0)
            for e in (sc.exports_sync.get_events() or []):
                n += 1
                st = STATUS.get(e.get("status"), e.get("status"))
                tally[st] = tally.get(st, 0) + 1
                if st in ("FLEE", "Escape", "Missed", "Error"):
                    print(f"   {st}: throwsRemaining={e.get('thr')} missPct={e.get('miss'):.3f}", flush=True)
        print(f"\n=== tally over {n} results: {tally} ===", flush=True)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/recon_gmo.py`:

```py
"""RECON (READ-ONLY): resolve the gmoForts=0 ambiguity that decides the vGP question.
The spincapture script only updates the fort count when n>0, so an EMPTY GMO and a
MISSING GMO both read as 0. Here the GMO hook logs EVERY fire: cell count, total forts,
enabled forts, and the nearest served fort's distance from the avatar. That distinguishes:
  - server serves forts (forts>0)  -> vGP has stuff to spin; its silence is a vGP-layer bug
  - server serves 0 forts (forts=0) -> nothing interactable; vGP silence + manual OUT_OF_RANGE
    are the SAME position-desync root cause
Still captures spins (manual vs SoftSfida/Wearable) + result. Pure read. No writes."""
import sys, os, time, datetime
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")

     cGF:b("il2cpp_class_get_fields","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]), fGN:b("il2cpp_field_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]), fGO:b("il2cpp_field_get_offset","uint32",["pointer"]),
     cGM:b("il2cpp_class_get_methods","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]), mGN:b("il2cpp_method_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
     OGC:b("il2cpp_object_get_class","pointer",["pointer"]), tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"]) };

rpc.exports.install=function(){ var h=H_();
 // GMO: log EVERY fire (cells, forts, enabled, nearest-fort distance from avatar)
 hookM("GetMapObjectsOutProto",["MergeFrom", function(self){
   var cells=rep(self,0x10);
   if(!cells){ if(LASTGMO!=="nocells"){LASTGMO="nocells"; L("GMO <no cells field>");} return; }
   if(cells.cnt===0){ if(LASTGMO!=="c0"){LASTGMO="c0"; L("GMO cells=0 forts=0 enabled=0");} return; }
   var fortOff=null;
   for(var ci=0; ci<cells.cnt && fortOff===null; ci++){ var cell=elem(cells,ci); if(!cell||cell.isNull())continue;
     var cf=fieldsOf(cell);
     for(var i=0;i<cf.length;i++){ var r=rep(cell,cf[i].o); if(r&&r.cnt>0){ var e0=elem(r,0); var ec=""; try{ec=h.CGN(h.OGC(e0)).readCString();}catch(e){} if(ec.indexOf("Fort")>=0){ fortOff=cf[i].o; break; } } }
   }
   var n=0, en=0, fresh={}, sLat=0, sLng=0;
   if(fortOff!==null){
     for(var cj=0;cj<cells.cnt;cj++){ var cell2=elem(cells,cj); if(!cell2||cell2.isNull())continue; var fr=rep(cell2,fortOff); if(!fr||fr.cnt===0)continue;
       for(var fi=0;fi<fr.cnt;fi++){ var ft=elem(fr,fi); if(!ft||ft.isNull())continue; var id=readStr(ft.add(0x10).readPointer()); if(!id)continue;

   }
   if(n>0){ GMO=fresh; GMON=n; }
   var ds=""; if(n>0 && LASTP){ var dlat=(sLat-LASTP.lat)*111000.0, dlng=(sLng-LASTP.lng)*111000.0*Math.cos(sLat*Math.PI/180); ds=" nearFort="+sLat.toFixed(5)+","+sLng.toFixed(5)+" distFromAvatar="+Math.sqrt(dlat*dlat+dlng*dlng).toFixed(0)+"m"; }
   var summary="forts="+n+" enabled="+en; var key=summary+(LASTP?"|P":"");
   if(key!==LASTGMO){ LASTGMO=key; L("GMO cells="+cells.cnt+" "+summary+ds); }
 }]);
 // spin request: tapped fort id + hidden flags + positions
 hookM("FortSearchProto",["WriteTo", function(self){ try{
   var id=readStr(self.add(0x10).readPointer());
   var plat=self.add(0x18).readDouble(), plng=self.add(0x20).readDouble(), flat=self.add(0x28).readDouble(), flng=self.add(0x30).readDouble();
   LASTP={lat:plat,lng:plng};
   var elig=self.add(0x40).readU8(), wear=self.add(0x41).readU8(), sfida=self.add(0x42).readU8();
   var inGmo = (id && GMO[id]) ? "YES" : "NO";
   var src = (sfida? "GOPLUS(softSfida)" : (wear? "WEARABLE" : "MANUAL"));
   L("SPIN_REQ ["+src+"] id="+id+" inServerGMO="+inGmo+" (gmoForts="+GMON+") player="+plat.toFixed(6)+","+plng.toFixed(6)+" fort="+flat.toFixed(6)+","+flng.toFixed(6));
 }catch(e){ L("reqerr "+e); } }]);
 hookM("FortSearchOutProto",["MergeFrom", function(self){ try{ L("SPIN_RESULT="+self.add(0x10).readS32()); }catch(e){} }]);
 return "installed (logs every GMO + spin source)"; };
"""

RESULT = {0: "NO_RESULT_SET", 1: "SUCCESS", 2: "OUT_OF_RANGE", 3: "IN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD",
          4: "INVENTORY_FULL", 5: "EXCEEDED_DAILY_LIMIT", 6: "POI_INACCESSIBLE"}


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < 600:
        sc = None; sess = None
        try:
            sess, pid = pg.get_session()
            sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.load()
            print(f"[{datetime.datetime.now():%H:%M:%S}] attached {pid}:", sc.exports_sync.install(), flush=True)
            print(">>> Watching GMO fort count + spins (manual vs Go Plus). <<<", flush=True)
            while time.time() - t0 < 600:
                time.sleep(2)
                for line in (sc.exports_sync.drain() or []):
                    if line.startswith("SPIN_RESULT="):
                        v = int(line.split("=")[1]); print(f"  >>> RESULT: {RESULT.get(v, v)}", flush=True)
                    else:
                        print("  ", line, flush=True)
        except Exception as e:
            try:
                sc.unload(); sess.detach()
            except Exception:
                pass
            print(f"  [{datetime.datetime.now():%H:%M:%S}] reconnect ({str(e)[:50]})", flush=True)
            time.sleep(5); continue


main()
```

```py
"""

GRADE = {0: "Miss", 1: "Normal", 2: "Nice", 3: "Great", 4: "EXCELLENT"}


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        print("setup:", sc.exports_sync.setup())
        print("\n--- EncounterSettingsProto fields (multipliers + thresholds) ---")
        for f in (sc.exports_sync.fields("EncounterSettingsProto", "holo-protos.dll") or []):
            print("   ", f)
        import time
        ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of("EncounterSettingsProto")
        settings = None
        for _ in range(15):
            r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "EncounterSettingsProto")
            settings = next((h for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else [])
                             if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) == "EncounterSettingsProto"), None)
            if settings:
                break
            time.sleep(2)
        print(f"\nlive EncounterSettingsProto: {settings}")
        if settings:
            print("thresholds:", sc.exports_sync.thresh(settings))
            print("\nReticleSize -> Grade:")
            for x in [0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.85, 1.0, 1.3, 1.7, 2.0]:
                g = sc.exports_sync.grade_of(x, settings)
                print(f"  reticle {x:>4} -> {GRADE.get(g, g)}")
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
        print("watching ~45s of normal map play (catcher stopped) — which objects get captured?\n", flush=True)

        while time.time() - t0 < 45:

            caps = sc.exports_sync.caps() or {}

                print(f"  {k}: CAPTURED ({v.get('n')} calls) ptr={v.get('ptr')}  -> hook-capture VIABLE", flush=True)

            else:
                print(f"  {k}: {v}", flush=True)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass
```

```py
    print("attached", pid)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)

        print("\n== /incense/i classes (holo-game.dll) ==")

        for c in cls:
            print("   ", c)

        print("\n--- IncenseMapPokemon : interface methods (open/capture/getters) ---")
        im = sc.exports_sync.dump("IncenseMapPokemon", "holo-game.dll") or []
        for m in im:
            if any(t in m for t in IFACE):
                print("   ", m)

        print("\n--- MapPokemon (wild) : same filter, for comparison ---")
        wm = sc.exports_sync.dump("MapPokemon", "holo-game.dll") or []
        for m in wm:
            if any(t in m for t in ("Encounter", "Capture", "Send", "Try", "Visible", "get_Location", "get_PokemonId")):
                print("   ", m)

        print("\n--- MapPlaceDirectoryService : incense / AllPokemon accessors ---")
        ms = sc.exports_sync.dump("MapPlaceDirectoryService", "holo-game.dll") or []
        for m in ms:
            if "ncense" in m or "AllPokemon" in m or "Attracted" in m:
                print("   ", m)

        for c in cls:
            short = c.split(".")[-1]
            if "Service" in short or "Manager" in short or short == "IncenseMapPokemon":
                continue
        for c in cls:
            short = c.split(".")[-1]
            if ("Service" in short) or ("Manager" in short):
                dm = sc.exports_sync.dump(short, "holo-game.dll") or []
                hits = [m for m in dm if ("Pokemon" in m or "ncense" in m or m.startswith("get_"))]
                if hits:
                    print(f"\n--- {short} : pokemon/incense accessors ---")
                    for m in hits[:30]:
                        print("   ", m)

        print("\n--- IncenseEncounterOutProto fields (Status offset) ---")
        for f in (sc.exports_sync.fields("IncenseEncounterOutProto", "holo-protos.dll") or []):
            print("   ", f)
        print("\n--- GetIncensePokemonOutProto fields ---")
        for f in (sc.exports_sync.fields("GetIncensePokemonOutProto", "holo-protos.dll") or []):
            print("   ", f)

        print("\n--- IncenseMapPokemon FULL method list (first 90) ---")
        for m in im[:90]:
            print("   ", m)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass
```

```py
function eachClass(cb){ var h=H_(); var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp); var n=sp.readS32();
 for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); var cnt=h.iGCC(im);
   for(var j=0;j<cnt;j++){ var k=h.iGC(im,j); if(!k.isNull()) cb(k); } } }
function findClass(name){ var h=H_(); var f=null; eachClass(function(k){ if(f)return; try{ if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===name) f=k; }catch(e){} }); return f; }
function mInfo(k,name,argc){ var h=H_(); if(!k)return null; var m=h.cMN(k,Memory.allocUtf8String(name),argc); return (m&&!m.isNull())?m:null; }

var MAPAVATAR=null;
var EXC=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
rpc.exports.install=function(){ var h=H_();
 var k=findClass("MapAvatar"); if(!k) return "no MapAvatar class";
 var m=mInfo(k,"get_Location",0); if(!m) return "no get_Location";
 Interceptor.attach(m.readPointer(),{ onEnter:function(a){ MAPAVATAR=a[0]; } });
 return "hooked";
};
rpc.exports.readloc=function(){ var h=H_(); if(!MAPAVATAR||MAPAVATAR.isNull()) return null;
 var m=mInfo(h.OGC(MAPAVATAR),"get_Location",0); if(!m) return null;
 EXC.writePointer(ptr(0));
 var lr=h.rI(m,MAPAVATAR,ptr(0),EXC); if(!lr||lr.isNull()) return null;
 return {lat:lr.add(0x10).readDouble(), lng:lr.add(0x18).readDouble(), box:lr.toString()};
};
"""


def hav(a, b):
    R = 6371000
    p1 = math.radians(a[0]); p2 = math.radians(b[0])
    dp = math.radians(b[0]-a[0]); dl = math.radians(b[1]-a[1])
    x = math.sin(dp/2)**2 + math.cos(p1)*math.cos(p2)*math.sin(dl/2)**2
    return 2*R*math.asin(min(1, math.sqrt(x)))


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    sc = sess.create_script(JS)
    sc.load()
    print("install:", sc.exports_sync.install(), flush=True)
    time.sleep(1.5)
    print("\n--- AVATAR POSITION (runtime_invoke read, sampling 12s) ---", flush=True)
    samples = []
    for i in range(13):
        time.sleep(1)
        s = sc.exports_sync.readloc()
        if s and s.get("lat") is not None:
            samples.append((s["lat"], s["lng"]))
            print(f"  t={i:2d}s  lat={s['lat']:.7f}  lng={s['lng']:.7f}", flush=True)
        else:
            print(f"  t={i:2d}s  (avatar not captured yet)", flush=True)
    if len(samples) >= 2:
        moved = max(hav(samples[0], p) for p in samples)
        print(f"\n  >>> position drift over window: {moved:.1f} m", flush=True)
        print(f"  >>> first: {samples[0]}", flush=True)
        print(f"  >>> last:  {samples[-1]}", flush=True)
    try:
        sc.unload(); sess.detach()
    except Exception:
        pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/recon_pokestop.py`:

```py
"""RECON (READ-ONLY): why can't PokeStops be spun? Reads account flags
(Warn/Banned/WasSuspended/WarnExpireMs from GetPlayerOutProto) and the live
PokeStop spin result (FortSearchOutProto.Result + CooldownComplete) by hooking
each proto's MergeFrom and reading the (public) field offsets directly. Pure read."""
import sys, os, time, datetime
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so"); var e={};
 il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){ if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0) e[x.name]=x.address; });
 function b(n,r,a){ return e[n]? new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a): null; }
 H={ dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),
     dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),
     aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]),
     iGCC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class_count","uint32",["pointer"]),
     iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]),
     CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
     cGM:b("il2cpp_class_get_methods","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),
     mGN:b("il2cpp_method_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
     mGPC:b("il2cpp_method_get_param_count","uint32",["pointer"]),
     tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"]) };
 H.tA(H.dG()); return H; }
function eachClass(cb){ var h=H_(); var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp); var n=sp.readS32();
 for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); var cnt=h.iGCC(im);
   for(var j=0;j<cnt;j++){ var k=h.iGC(im,j); if(!k.isNull()) cb(k); } } }
function findClass(name){ var h=H_(); var f=null; eachClass(function(k){ if(f)return; try{ if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===name) f=k; }catch(e){} }); return f; }

var LOG=[]; function L(s){ LOG.push(s); }
rpc.exports.drain=function(){ var o=LOG; LOG=[]; return o; };

function readField(self,r){
 if(r.size===1) return self.add(r.off).readU8();
 if(r.size===4) return self.add(r.off).readS32();
 return self.add(r.off).readS64().toString();
}
function hookMerge(cls, reads){
 var h=H_(); var k=findClass(cls); if(!k){ L("[noclass] "+cls); return; }
 var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var names=[]; var hooked=0;
 while(true){ var m=h.cGM(k,it); if(!m||m.isNull())break; var nm; try{ nm=h.mGN(m).readCString(); }catch(e){ continue; }
   names.push(nm);
   if(nm==="MergeFrom"){ var code=m.readPointer(); if(code&&!code.isNull()){
     (function(){ var rd=reads, cn=cls; Interceptor.attach(code,{ onEnter:function(a){ this.s=a[0]; },
       onLeave:function(){ try{ var self=this.s; if(!self||self.isNull())return; var p=[];
         for(var i=0;i<rd.length;i++){ p.push(rd[i].label+"="+readField(self,rd[i])); }
         L(cn+" || "+p.join("  ")); }catch(e){} } }); hooked++; })();
   } } }
 L("[methods "+cls+"] "+names.join(","));
 L("[hooked "+hooked+" MergeFrom on "+cls+"]");
}

rpc.exports.install=function(){ H_();
 hookMerge("FortSearchOutProto",[{off:0x10,size:4,label:"Result"},{off:0x30,size:4,label:"XpAwarded"},{off:0x38,size:8,label:"CooldownCompleteMs"}]);
 hookMerge("GetPlayerOutProto",[{off:0x20,size:1,label:"Banned"},{off:0x21,size:1,label:"Warn"},{off:0x22,size:1,label:"WasCreated"},{off:0x24,size:1,label:"WasSuspended"},{off:0x25,size:1,label:"SuspMsgAck"},{off:0x28,size:8,label:"WarnExpireMs"}]);
 return "installed";
};
"""

RESULT = {0: "NO_RESULT_SET", 1: "SUCCESS (got items)", 2: "OUT_OF_RANGE (too far)",
          3: "IN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD (soft-ban / spun too recently)", 4: "INVENTORY_FULL (bag full)",
          5: "EXCEEDED_DAILY_LIMIT (daily spin cap)", 6: "POI_INACCESSIBLE"}


def ms_to_str(ms):
    try:
        ms = int(ms)
        if ms <= 0:
            return "0 (none)"
        dt = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000.0)
        return f"{ms} ({dt:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S} local)"
    except Exception:
        return str(ms)


def interpret(line):
    if line.startswith("FortSearchOutProto || "):
        kv = dict(p.split("=", 1) for p in line.split("|| ")[1].split("  "))
        r = int(kv.get("Result", -1))
        print(f"  >>> POKESTOP SPIN -> {RESULT.get(r, r)} | XP={kv.get('XpAwarded')} | cooldownComplete={ms_to_str(kv.get('CooldownCompleteMs',0))}", flush=True)
    elif line.startswith("GetPlayerOutProto || "):
        kv = dict(p.split("=", 1) for p in line.split("|| ")[1].split("  "))
        print("  >>> ACCOUNT FLAGS:", flush=True)
        print(f"        Warn (marked) = {kv.get('Warn')}   Banned = {kv.get('Banned')}   WasSuspended = {kv.get('WasSuspended')}", flush=True)
        print(f"        WarnExpireMs  = {ms_to_str(kv.get('WarnExpireMs',0))}", flush=True)
    else:
        print("  ", line, flush=True)


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    sc = sess.create_script(JS)
    sc.load()
    print("install:", sc.exports_sync.install(), flush=True)
    print("\n>>> NOW: open your Trainer PROFILE (reads account flags), then SPIN A POKESTOP. Watching 240s. <<<\n", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < 240:
        time.sleep(2)
        for line in (sc.exports_sync.drain() or []):
            interpret(line)
    try:
        sc.unload(); sess.detach()
    except Exception:
        pass


main()
```

```py
function img(name){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()===name)return im;}return null;}

"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        names = set()
        for image in ["holo-game.dll", "holo-protos.dll"]:
            for rx in ["Quest", "Research", "Reward"]:
                cl = sc.exports_sync.list_classes(rx, image)
                for c in (cl or []):
                    names.add((image, c))
                print(f"\n== {image} /{rx}/ -> {len(cl or [])}")
                for c in sorted(set(cl or [])):
                    print("   ", c)
        # method dump for likely service/manager classes
        import re
        svc_re = re.compile(r"(Quest|Research).*(Manager|Service|Repository|Repo|Controller|Data|Store|Cache|Provider|Model)", re.I)
        cands = []
        for image, full in names:
            cls = full.split(".")[-1]
            if svc_re.search(cls) and cls.startswith(("Quest", "Research")) and not cls.startswith("I"):
                cands.append((image, cls))
        cands = sorted(set(cands))[:8]
        print(f"\n==== method dumps for {len(cands)} service candidates ====")
        for image, cls in cands:
            ms = sc.exports_sync.cls_methods(cls, image)
            print(f"\n--- {cls} ({image}) ---")
            for m in (ms or []):
                print("   ", m)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
        "QuestState", "QuestStorage", "QuestRepository"]

def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        print("\n#### holder candidates (holo-game.dll) ####")
        rx = "QuestState|QuestService|QuestStorage|QuestRepository|QuestStore|QuestData|QuestList|QuestInventory|QuestManager|QuestCache"
        for c in sorted(set(sc.exports_sync.list_classes(rx, "holo-game.dll") or [])):
            print("   ", c)
        for image, lst in [("holo-game.dll", GAME), ("holo-protos.dll", PROTOS)]:
            for cls in lst:
                res = sc.exports_sync.dump(cls, image)
                if not res:
                    print(f"\n--- {cls} ({image}) : NOT FOUND")
                    continue
                for r in res:
                    print(f"\n--- {r['ns']}.{cls} ({image}) [{len(r['methods'])} methods] ---")
                    for m in r["methods"]:
                        print("   ", m)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload()
```

```py
   if(gpe){ try{ var enc=inv(gpe,qs,[cur]); if(enc && !enc.isNull()) dangling++; }catch(e2){} }
 }
 return {total:total,dangling:dangling,gpeMissing:danglingErr};
};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of("QuestService")
        print("QuestService ns:", ns)
        if not ns:
            print("QuestService not found"); return
        r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "QuestService")
        hits = [h for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else [])
                if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) == "QuestService"]
        print(f"QuestService hits: {len(hits)}")
        best = None
        for h in hits:
            if not sc.exports_sync.has_get_quests(h):
                continue
            c = sc.exports_sync.quest_counts(h)
            print("  ", h, c)
            if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("total", 0) > 0:
                if best is None or c.get("total", 0) > best[1].get("total", 0):
                    best = (h, c)
        if best:
            print(f"\n>>> QuestService @ {best[0]}: total quests = {best[1].get('total')}, "
                  f"PENDING POKEMON REWARDS (dangling) = {best[1].get('dangling')}")
        else:
            print("\nno QuestService instance returned quests")
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        print("diag:", sc.exports_sync.diag())
        ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of("QuestService")
        r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "QuestService")
        hits = [h for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else [])
                if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) == "QuestService"]
        print(f"QuestService instances: {len(hits)}")
        best = None
        for h in hits:
            c = sc.exports_sync.count_progressed(h)
            print("  ", h, c)
            if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("progressed", 0) and c["progressed"] > 0:
                if best is None or c["progressed"] > best[1]["progressed"]:
                    best = (h, c)
        if best:
            print(f"\n>>> progressed quests={best[1]['progressed']}  PENDING POKEMON REWARDS={best[1]['dangling']}")
            print("    sample quest ids:", best[1].get("samples"))
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
```

```py
def count(finder, sc, ns, cls):
    if not ns:
        return None
    r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, cls)
    return [h for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else [])
            if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) == cls]


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        dde = count(finder, sc, "Niantic.Holoholo.Quests", "QuestDanglingEncounterData")
        print(f"QuestDanglingEncounterData instances: {len(dde) if dde is not None else 'n/a'}")
        if dde:
            okc = 0
            for h in dde[:120]:
                d = sc.exports_sync.dangling_ok(h)
                if d not in ("null", "no-method", None):
                    okc += 1

        for ns, cls in [("Holoholo.Rpc", "QuestPokemonEncounterProto"),

                        ("Niantic.Holoholo.Quests", "QuestMapPokemon"),
```

```py
"""Measure whether the catcher's visible targets are actually in catch range: read the player's GPS
position + every visible WildMapPokemon's lat/lng, compute distances. READ-ONLY."""
import sys, os, math
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))

function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});

 return out;};
"""


def hav(a, b):
    R = 6371000.0
    p1, p2 = math.radians(a[0]), math.radians(b[0])
    dp = math.radians(b[0] - a[0]); dl = math.radians(b[1] - a[1])
    x = math.sin(dp/2)**2 + math.cos(p1)*math.cos(p2)*math.sin(dl/2)**2
    return 2*R*math.asin(min(1, math.sqrt(x)))


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
        sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
        try:
            # spawns
            spawns = []
            rw = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton("Niantic.Holoholo.Map", "WildMapPokemon")
            for h in (rw.get("hits", []) if isinstance(rw, dict) else []):
                if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != "WildMapPokemon":
                    continue
                i = sc.exports_sync.wmp_loc(h)
                if i.get("lat") and i.get("vis"):
                    spawns.append(i)
            # player-position candidates
            cands = sc.exports_sync.lat_lng_getters()
            print("LatLng getter candidates:", cands)
            player = None
            for c in cands:
                cls, meth = c.split(".", 1)
                ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of(cls)
                if not ns:
                    continue
                r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, cls)
                for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []):
                    if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != cls:
                        continue
                    ll = sc.exports_sync.read_ll(h, meth)
                    if ll and ll.get("lat") and -90 < ll["lat"] < 90 and -180 < ll["lng"] < 180 and ll["lat"] != 0:
                        # plausible: spawns should be within a few km
                        if spawns:
                            d = min(hav((ll["lat"], ll["lng"]), (s["lat"], s["lng"])) for s in spawns)
                            if d < 5000:
                                print(f"PLAYER via {c} = {ll['lat']:.5f},{ll['lng']:.5f} (nearest spawn {d:.0f}m)")
                                if player is None:
                                    player = ll
            if not player:
                print("could not pin player position from candidates")
            print(f"\n{len(spawns)} visible spawns:")
            for s in sorted(spawns, key=lambda s: hav((player["lat"], player["lng"]), (s["lat"], s["lng"])) if player else 0):
                dist = hav((player["lat"], player["lng"]), (s["lat"], s["lng"])) if player else None
                print(f"  dex={s.get('dex')} cp={s.get('cp')} dist={f'{dist:.0f}m' if dist is not None else '?'}")
        finally:
            try: sc.unload(); finder.unload()
            except Exception: pass
    finally:
        try: sess.detach()
        except Exception: pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/recon_ratelimit.py`:

```py
"""RECON (READ-ONLY): verify the 'rolling spin rate-limit' explanation against the game internals.
Tests whether OUT_OF_RANGE is a disguised rate-limit or a genuine geometry/position rejection.
  (A) static: list EVERY field of FortSearchOutProto -> does any limit/quota/cooldown field exist,
      or is rate-limiting only expressible through Result=EXCEEDED_DAILY_LIMIT(5) ?
  (B) static: search ALL IL2CPP classes for RateLimit/Quota/Throttle/Limit -> is there a
      CLIENT-SIDE spin cap counter the game holds (which would prove a known, readable limit) ?
  (C) live: on the next spin, dump every NON-ZERO field of FortSearchOutProto -> a bare
      OUT_OF_RANGE (only result set, xp=0, cooldown=0) vs a daily-limit/cooldown/quota field set.
  (D) passive: PlayerStats.poke_stop_visits (lifetime stops spun) on inventory updates.
Pure read. No writes, no GPS injection."""

function eachClass(cb){ var h=H_(); var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp); var n=sp.readS32();

function findClass(name){ var h=H_(); var f=null; eachClass(function(k){ if(f)return; try{ if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===name) f=k; }catch(e){} }); return f; }
function fieldsList(k){ var h=H_(); var out=[]; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  while((f=h.cGF(k,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ out.push({n:h.fGN(f).readCString(), o:h.fGO(f)}); }catch(e){} } return out; }
function hookM(cls, fn){ var h=H_(); var k=findClass(cls); if(!k){ L("[no class] "+cls); return; } var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var m; while((m=h.cGM(k,it))&&!m.isNull()){ try{ if(h.mGN(m).readCString()!==fn[0])continue; var code=m.readPointer(); if(!code||code.isNull())continue; Interceptor.attach(code,{ onEnter:function(a){ this.s=a[0]; }, onLeave:function(){ try{ if(this.s&&!this.s.isNull()) fn[1](this.s); }catch(e){} } }); }catch(e){} } }

var LOG=[]; function L(s){ LOG.push(s); }
rpc.exports.drain=function(){ var o=LOG; LOG=[]; return o; };

// (A) static field list of a class
rpc.exports.fields=function(clsName){ var k=findClass(clsName); if(!k) return ["[no class] "+clsName];
  return fieldsList(k).map(function(x){ return x.n+" @0x"+x.o.toString(16); }); };

    var fs=fieldsList(k).map(function(x){return x.n;});
    res.push(nm+"  ::  "+fs.join(", "));
  } }catch(e){} }); return res; };

var RES={0:"NO_RESULT",1:"SUCCESS",2:"OUT_OF_RANGE",3:"IN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD",4:"INVENTORY_FULL",5:"EXCEEDED_DAILY_LIMIT",6:"POI_INACCESSIBLE"};

   var k=h.OGC(self); var nz=[];
   fieldsList(k).forEach(function(fld){ try{ var i32=self.add(fld.o).readS32(); var i64=self.add(fld.o).readS64();

   var plat=self.add(0x18).readDouble(), plng=self.add(0x20).readDouble(), flat=self.add(0x28).readDouble(), flng=self.add(0x30).readDouble();
   var dlat=(plat-flat)*111000.0, dlng=(plng-flng)*111000.0*Math.cos(plat*Math.PI/180);

 }catch(e){} }]);
 return "hooks installed (FortSearchOut/FortSearch/PlayerStats)"; };
"""


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    printed_static = False
    while time.time() - t0 < 600:
        sc = None; sess = None
        try:
            sess, pid = pg.get_session()
            sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.load()
            print(f"[{datetime.datetime.now():%H:%M:%S}] attached {pid}", flush=True)
            print("  install:", sc.exports_sync.install(), flush=True)
            if not printed_static:
                print("\n=== (A) FortSearchOutProto — EVERY field (is there any limit/quota/cooldown field?) ===", flush=True)
                for f in sc.exports_sync.fields("FortSearchOutProto"):
                    print("    ", f, flush=True)
                print("\n=== (B) CLIENT-SIDE classes matching RateLimit / Quota / Throttle / *Limit(fort|spin|stop|search|api|action) ===", flush=True)
                for needle in ("RateLimit", "Quota", "Throttle"):
                    for line in (sc.exports_sync.search(needle) or [])[:40]:
                        print(f"    [{needle}]", line, flush=True)
                for line in (sc.exports_sync.search("Limit") or []):
                    nm = line.split("  ::")[0].lower()
                    if any(t in nm for t in ("fort", "spin", "stop", "search", "api", "action", "map", "gym")):
                        print("    [Limit*]", line, flush=True)
                printed_static = True
            print("\n=== (C)/(D) WATCHING — please SPIN ONE FAILING STOP ONCE (catches keep PlayerStats fresh) ===", flush=True)
            while time.time() - t0 < 600:
                time.sleep(2)
                for line in (sc.exports_sync.drain() or []):
                    print("  ", line, flush=True)
        except Exception as e:
            try:
                sc.unload(); sess.detach()
            except Exception:
                pass
            print(f"  [{datetime.datetime.now():%H:%M:%S}] reconnect ({str(e)[:60]})", flush=True)
            time.sleep(5); continue


main()
```

```py
rpc.exports.install=function(){ var h=H_();

 hookM("GetMapObjectsOutProto",["MergeFrom", function(self){ var cells=rep(self,0x10); if(!cells||cells.cnt===0)return;

RESULT = {0: "NO_RESULT_SET", 1: "SUCCESS", 2: "OUT_OF_RANGE", 3: "IN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD",
          4: "INVENTORY_FULL", 5: "EXCEEDED_DAILY_LIMIT", 6: "POI_INACCESSIBLE"}
```

```py
RESULT = {0: "NO_RESULT_SET", 1: "SUCCESS", 2: "OUT_OF_RANGE", 3: "IN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD",
          4: "INVENTORY_FULL", 5: "EXCEEDED_DAILY_LIMIT", 6: "POI_INACCESSIBLE"}


def hav(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2):
    R = 6371000
    p1 = math.radians(lat1); p2 = math.radians(lat2)
    dp = math.radians(lat2-lat1); dl = math.radians(lng2-lng1)
    x = math.sin(dp/2)**2 + math.cos(p1)*math.cos(p2)*math.sin(dl/2)**2
    return 2*R*math.asin(min(1, math.sqrt(x)))


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    sc = sess.create_script(JS)
    sc.load()
    print("install:", sc.exports_sync.install(), flush=True)
    for line in (sc.exports_sync.drain() or []):
        print("  ", line, flush=True)
    print("\n>>> SPIN THE FAILING POKESTOP NOW. Watching 200s. <<<\n", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    last_req = {}
    while time.time() - t0 < 200:
        time.sleep(2)
        loc = sc.exports_sync.readloc()
        for line in (sc.exports_sync.drain() or []):
            if line.startswith("REQ || "):
                kv = {}
                for p in line.split("|| ")[1].split("  "):
                    if "=" in p:
                        k, v = p.split("=", 1)
                        try:
                            kv[k] = float(v)
                        except Exception:
                            kv[k] = v
                last_req = kv
                print(f"  SPIN REQUEST coords: {kv}", flush=True)
                # try to find player/fort lat-lng pairs
                lats = {k: v for k, v in kv.items() if "lat" in k.lower()}
                lngs = {k: v for k, v in kv.items() if ("lng" in k.lower() or "longitude" in k.lower())}
                if loc:
                    print(f"  avatar now: lat={loc['lat']:.7f} lng={loc['lng']:.7f}", flush=True)
                # compute distances between any lat/lng pairs and avatar
                if loc and lats and lngs:
                    for lk, lv in lats.items():
                        for gk, gv in lngs.items():
                            d = hav(loc['lat'], loc['lng'], lv, gv)
                            print(f"    dist(avatar -> {lk}/{gk}) = {d:.1f} m", flush=True)
            elif line.startswith("RESULT="):
                v = int(line.split("=")[1])
                print(f"  >>> SPIN RESULT: {RESULT.get(v, v)}", flush=True)
            else:
                print("  ", line, flush=True)
    try:
        sc.unload(); sess.detach()
    except Exception:
        pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/recon_spinwatch.py`:

```py
"""RECON (READ-ONLY): long watch on PokeStop spin results. Logs every spin you
attempt with a wall-clock stamp and EXITS the instant one returns SUCCESS (the
cooldown lifting). Runs up to 2h. Pure read -- it never spins for you (that would
reset the cooldown); you probe by spinning a stop every ~10-15 min."""
import sys, os, time, datetime
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))

import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

     iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]), CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
     cGM:b("il2cpp_class_get_methods","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]), mGN:b("il2cpp_method_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),
     tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"]) };

function findClass(name){ var h=H_(); var f=null; eachClass(function(k){ if(f)return; try{ if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===name) f=k; }catch(e){} }); return f; }

 var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var m; var hk=0;

   Interceptor.attach(code,{ onEnter:function(a){ this.s=a[0]; }, onLeave:function(){ try{ if(this.s&&!this.s.isNull()) L("R="+this.s.add(0x10).readS32()); }catch(e){} } }); hk++; }catch(e){} }
 return "hooked "+hk; };
"""

RESULT = {0: "NO_RESULT_SET", 1: "SUCCESS", 2: "OUT_OF_RANGE", 3: "IN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD",
          4: "INVENTORY_FULL", 5: "EXCEEDED_DAILY_LIMIT", 6: "POI_INACCESSIBLE"}


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    spins = 0
    last_beat = 0.0
    reconnects = 0
    print(f"WATCH START {datetime.datetime.now():%H:%M:%S} — probe by spinning a stop every ~10-15 min (don't spam). Up to 2h. Self-reconnects across PoGo crashes.", flush=True)
    while time.time() - t0 < 7200:
        sc = None
        sess = None
        try:
            sess, pid = pg.get_session()
            sc = sess.create_script(JS)
            sc.load()
            r = sc.exports_sync.install()
            tag = f"reconnect #{reconnects} " if reconnects else ""
            print(f"  [{datetime.datetime.now():%H:%M:%S}] {tag}attached pid={pid} ({r})", flush=True)
            while time.time() - t0 < 7200:
                time.sleep(2)
                for line in (sc.exports_sync.drain() or []):
                    if line.startswith("R="):
                        rv = int(line[2:])
                        spins += 1
                        el = (time.time() - t0) / 60.0
                        stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                        print(f"  [{stamp}  +{el:5.1f}min  spin#{spins}]  {RESULT.get(rv, rv)}", flush=True)
                        if rv == 1:
                            print(f"\n=== COOLDOWN CLEARED — spin SUCCEEDED at {stamp} (+{el:.1f} min into the watch) ===", flush=True)
                            try:
                                sc.unload(); sess.detach()
                            except Exception:
                                pass
                            return
                el = time.time() - t0
                if el - last_beat >= 120:
                    last_beat = el
                    print(f"  ...watching ({el/60:.0f} min, {spins} probes, {reconnects} PoGo restarts, still OUT_OF_RANGE)", flush=True)
        except Exception as e:
            reconnects += 1
            try:
                sc.unload(); sess.detach()
            except Exception:
                pass
            print(f"  [{datetime.datetime.now():%H:%M:%S}] gadget dropped ({str(e)[:60]}) — waiting for PoGo to relaunch...", flush=True)
            time.sleep(6)
            continue
    print(f"\n=== 2h elapsed, still no successful spin (probes seen: {spins}, PoGo restarts: {reconnects}) ===", flush=True)


main()

```

```py
def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()

        finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
        sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
        try:
            cands = sc.exports_sync.find("Stardust")
            print(f"\n== Stardust 0-arg int getters ({len(cands)}) ==")
            for c in cands:
                print("  ", c)
            # try to read each candidate's class as a singleton
            seen = set()
            for c in cands:
                cls = c.split(".")[0]; meth = c.split(".")[1].split(" ")[0]
                if cls in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(cls)
                ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of(cls)
                if not ns:
                    continue
                r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, cls)
                for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else [])[:3]:
                    if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != cls:
                        continue
                    val = sc.exports_sync.read_num(h, meth)
                    if val:
                        print(f"   {cls}.{meth} @{h} = {val}")
                        break
        finally:
            try: sc.unload(); finder.unload()
            except Exception: pass
    finally:
        try: sess.detach()
        except Exception: pass


main()
```

```py
   (function(nm){ Interceptor.attach(code,{ onEnter:function(a){ try{ if(a[0]&&!a[0].isNull()){ INST=a[0]; } CALLS[nm]=(CALLS[nm]||0)+1; }catch(e){} } }); })(nm); hk++; } }catch(e){} }

rpc.exports.readinst=function(){ var h=H_(); if(!INST||INST.isNull()) return null;

def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    sc = sess.create_script(JS)
    sc.load()
    for cls in ["SpaceTimeThrottle", "GameAnticheatAction", "WarningInfo", "WarnedPlayerReason"]:
        d = sc.exports_sync.dump(cls)
        print(f"\n=== {cls} ===", flush=True)
        if d:
            print("  fields :", d["fields"], flush=True)
            print("  methods:", d["methods"], flush=True)
        else:
            print("  (not found)", flush=True)
    print("\ninstall hook:", sc.exports_sync.install(), flush=True)
    print(">>> watching SpaceTimeThrottle for 40s — SPIN A STOP / move so it evaluates <<<", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < 40:
        time.sleep(4)
        calls = sc.exports_sync.calls() or {}
        if calls:
            print(f"  calls: {calls}", flush=True)
            inst = sc.exports_sync.readinst() or {}
            for k, v in inst.items():
                print(f"     {k}: {v}", flush=True)
            break
    else:
        print("  (SpaceTimeThrottle never called in window)", flush=True)
    try:
        sc.unload(); sess.detach()
    except Exception:
        pass


main()
```

```py
import sys, os, json

import pogo_il2cpp as pg

sess, pid = pg.get_session()
print('attached pid', pid)

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function helpers(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');var A={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){if(e.name.indexOf('il2cpp_')===0)A[e.name]=e.address;});
  function b(n,r,a){return new NativeFunction(A[n],r,a);}
  H={OGC:b('il2cpp_object_get_class','pointer',['pointer']),CGN:b('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),CGF:b('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']),FGN:b('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']),FGO:b('il2cpp_field_get_offset','uint32',['pointer'])};
  return H; }
function fieldsOf(p){ var h=helpers(); var cls=h.OGC(p); var out=[]; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var f;
  while((f=h.CGF(cls,it))&&!f.isNull()){try{out.push({nm:h.FGN(f).readCString(),off:h.CGN?h.FGO(f):0});}catch(e){}} return {cls:h.CGN(cls).readCString(), fields:out}; }

  var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var f;
  while((f=h.CGF(cls,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ var nm=h.CGF?h.FGN(f).readCString():''; var off=h.FGO(f); var lo=nm.toLowerCase();
    if(lo.indexOf('mega')>=0||lo.indexOf('temp')>=0||lo.indexOf('evol')>=0||lo.indexOf('bread')>=0||lo.indexOf('candy')>=0){
      var iv=null,rf=null; try{iv=p.add(off).readS32();}catch(e){}

      rec.f[nm+'@0x'+off.toString(16)]={int:iv, rf:rf};
    } }catch(e){} }
  return rec; };
"""
sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on('message', lambda m, d: None); sc.load()

    print('reflect of proto[0]:', json.dumps(sc.exports_sync.reflect(protos[0]))[:1500]); sess.detach(); sys.exit(1)

mewtwo_protos = [protos[i] for i, pv in enumerate(allpids) if pv == 150]
print(f'\nLIVE Mewtwo (pid 150) in bag: {len(mewtwo_protos)}')

print('\n=== full field list of a Mewtwo proto (to spot ANY mega/temp field) ===')
ref = sc.exports_sync.reflect(mewtwo_protos[0]) if mewtwo_protos else None
if ref:
    megaish = [f"{x['nm']}@0x{x['off']:x}" for x in ref['fields'] if any(k in x['nm'].lower() for k in ('mega', 'temp', 'evol', 'bread'))]
    print('  class:', ref['cls'])
    print('  mega/temp/evo fields present:', megaish)

print('\n=== per-Mewtwo mega/temp-evolution dump ===')
any_mega = False
for i, p in enumerate(mewtwo_protos):
    md = sc.exports_sync.megadump(p)
    nz = {k: v for k, v in md['f'].items() if (v.get('int') not in (None, 0)) or (v.get('rf') and v['rf'].get('count', 0) > 0)}
    flag = ''
    for k, v in nz.items():
        if v.get('rf') and v['rf'].get('count', 0) > 0 and ('temp' in k.lower() or 'mega' in k.lower() or 'evol' in k.lower()):
            any_mega = True; flag = '   <<<< HAS A TEMP/MEGA-EVOLUTION ENTRY'
    print(f'  Mewtwo#{i}: {nz}{flag}')
sess.detach()
print('\nTRIPLE-CHECK VERDICT:', 'A Mewtwo HAS a mega/temp-evolution unlock -> you DO have a Mega Mewtwo!' if any_mega else 'NO Mewtwo has any mega/temporary-evolution unlock -> confirmed: no Mega Mewtwo.')
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Comprehensive LIVE GO Fest Tokyo 2026 catch audit. Dumps the Form + Costume enums,
live-reads form_/costume_/shiny_ on every relevant species, and scores the exclusives
definitively (no DB, no guessing). READ-ONLY."""
import sys, os, json
from collections import Counter
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r'''
var P=null,CGN,CGF,FGN,FGFlags,FSGV,FGT,CFT,TGN,FGO;
function _p(){ if(CGN) return; _ensureInit(); var il=Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so');
  function nf(n,r,a){return new NativeFunction(il.getExportByName(n),r,a);}
  CGN=nf('il2cpp_class_get_name','pointer',['pointer']); CGF=nf('il2cpp_class_get_fields','pointer',['pointer','pointer']);
  FGN=nf('il2cpp_field_get_name','pointer',['pointer']); FGO=nf('il2cpp_field_get_offset','uint32',['pointer']);
  FGFlags=nf('il2cpp_field_get_flags','int',['pointer']); FSGV=nf('il2cpp_field_static_get_value','void',['pointer','pointer']);
  FGT=nf('il2cpp_field_get_type','pointer',['pointer']); CFT=nf('il2cpp_class_from_type','pointer',['pointer']); TGN=nf('il2cpp_type_get_name','pointer',['pointer']);
  var sp=Memory.alloc(4); var asms=IL2.dGA(IL2.dG(),sp); var na=sp.readS32();
  for(var a=0;a<na;a++){ var im=IL2.aGI(asms.add(a*Process.pointerSize).readPointer()); if(IL2.iGN(im).readCString()==='holo-protos.dll'){ P=im; break; } }
}
function dumpLits(cls){ var out={}; if(!cls||cls.isNull()) return out; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  while((f=CGF(cls,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ var fl=FGFlags(f); if((fl&0x10)&&(fl&0x40)){ var nm=FGN(f).readCString(); if(nm!=='value__'){ var b=Memory.alloc(8); b.writeU64(0); FSGV(f,b); out[b.readS32()]=nm; } } }catch(e){} } return out; }
function fieldInfo(cls){ var out={}; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  while((f=CGF(cls,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ var fl=FGFlags(f); if(fl&0x10) continue; out[FGN(f).readCString()]={off:FGO(f), type:FGT(f)}; }catch(e){} } return out; }

rpc.exports.setup=function(){ _p(); if(!P) return {err:'no protos'};
  var pp=IL2.cFN(P,Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'),Memory.allocUtf8String('PokemonProto'));
  var pdp=IL2.cFN(P,Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'),Memory.allocUtf8String('PokemonDisplayProto'));
  if(pp.isNull()||pdp.isNull()) return {err:'class not found'};
  var pf=fieldInfo(pp), df=fieldInfo(pdp);
  function fo(fields,names){ for(var k in fields){ var lk=k.toLowerCase(); for(var i=0;i<names.length;i++) if(lk===names[i]) return fields[k]; } return null; }
  var pidF=fo(pf,['pokemonid_','pokemonid']), dispF=fo(pf,['pokemondisplay_','pokemondisplay']);
  var formF=fo(df,['form_','form']), shinyF=fo(df,['shiny_','shiny']), costF=fo(df,['costume_','costume']);
  return {ok:true, pidOff:pidF?pidF.off:0x28, dispOff:dispF?dispF.off:0xd8,
    formOff:formF?formF.off:-1, shinyOff:shinyF?shinyF.off:-1, costOff:costF?costF.off:-1,
    formMap: formF?dumpLits(CFT(formF.type)):{}, costMap: costF?dumpLits(CFT(costF.type)):{}};
};

rpc.exports.scan=function(arrJson, pidsJson, dispOff,pidOff,formOff,shinyOff,costOff){
  var arr=JSON.parse(arrJson); var pids=JSON.parse(pidsJson); var want={}; for(var i=0;i<pids.length;i++) want[pids[i]]=1; var out={};
  for(var i=0;i<arr.length;i++){ var p=ptr(arr[i]); try{ var pid=p.add(pidOff).readS32(); if(!want[pid]) continue;
    var d=p.add(dispOff).readPointer(); var form=null,shiny=null,cost=null;
    if(d&&!d.isNull()){ if(formOff>=0)form=d.add(formOff).readS32(); if(shinyOff>=0)shiny=d.add(shinyOff).readU8(); if(costOff>=0)cost=d.add(costOff).readS32(); }
    if(!out[pid])out[pid]=[]; out[pid].push([form,cost,shiny]);
  }catch(e){} } return out;
};
'''

PIDS = {25: 'Pikachu', 10: 'Caterpie', 479: 'Rotom', 128: 'Tauros', 764: 'Comfey', 807: 'Zeraora',
        144: 'Articuno', 245: 'Suicune', 150: 'Mewtwo'}


def main():
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
    print('[*] connecting...')
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print('[*] attached', pid)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    s = sc.exports_sync.setup()
    if not s.get('ok'):
        print('[!] setup failed:', s); sc.unload(); sess.detach(); return
    fmap = {int(k): v for k, v in s['formMap'].items()}
    cmap = {int(k): v for k, v in s['costMap'].items()}
    print(f"offsets pid@{hex(s['pidOff'])} disp@{hex(s['dispOff'])} form@{hex(s['formOff'])} "
          f"shiny@{hex(s['shinyOff'])} costume@{hex(s['costOff'])}  | forms={len(fmap)} costumes={len(cmap)}")

    print('\n=== Form/Costume enum entries relevant to GO Fest 2026 / Mystic / Tokyo ===')
    for label, m in [('FORM', fmap), ('COSTUME', cmap)]:
        hits = {i: n for i, n in m.items() if any(k in n.lower() for k in ('gofest2026', 'mystic', 'tokyo', 'gofest_2026'))}
        print(f'  {label}: {hits if hits else "(none matched)"}')

    bag = pg.pick_singleton(sess, 'Niantic.Holoholo.Internal', 'PokemonBagImpl')
    protos = list(pg.walk_bag_protos(sess, bag).values())
    res = sc.exports_sync.scan(json.dumps(protos), json.dumps(list(PIDS)), s['dispOff'], s['pidOff'],
                               s['formOff'], s['shinyOff'], s['costOff'])
    sc.unload(); sess.detach()

    for pid_str, label in [(str(p), PIDS[p]) for p in PIDS]:
        rows = res.get(pid_str) or res.get(int(pid_str)) or []
        agg = Counter()
        for form, cost, shiny in rows:
            fn = fmap.get(form, f'?{form}') if form is not None else 'null'
            cn = cmap.get(cost, f'?{cost}') if cost not in (None, 0) else '-'
            agg[(fn, cn, bool(shiny))] += 1
        print(f'\n=== {label} ({pid_str}) — {len(rows)} mons (LIVE) ===')
        for (fn, cn, sh), c in sorted(agg.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
            print(f"   form={fn:28s} costume={cn:22s} shiny={sh}  x{c}{'  <<<SHINY' if sh else ''}")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Live-read the ACTUAL form_ + shiny_ on every Rotom / Tauros proto in the bag

  var pp=IL2.cFN(P,Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'),Memory.allocUtf8String('PokemonProto'));
  var pdp=IL2.cFN(P,Memory.allocUtf8String('Holoholo.Rpc'),Memory.allocUtf8String('PokemonDisplayProto'));

  var pidOff=-1, dispOff=-1; var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f;
  while((f=CGF(pp,it))&&!f.isNull()){ try{ var nm=FGN(f).readCString().toLowerCase(); if(nm==='pokemonid_'||nm==='pokemonid') pidOff=FGO(f); if(nm==='pokemondisplay_'||nm==='pokemondisplay') dispOff=FGO(f); }catch(e){} }
  var formOff=-1, shinyOff=-1, formType=null, pdpFields=[]; var it2=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it2.writePointer(ptr(0)); var f2;
  while((f2=CGF(pdp,it2))&&!f2.isNull()){ try{ var nm=FGN(f2).readCString(); pdpFields.push(nm); var lo=nm.toLowerCase(); if(lo==='form_'||lo==='form'){ formOff=FGO(f2); formType=FGT(f2);} if(lo==='shiny_'||lo==='shiny'){ shinyOff=FGO(f2);} }catch(e){} }

          pdpFields:pdpFields, formCount:Object.keys(formMap).length, formMap:formMap};

rpc.exports.scanPid = function(arrJson, pid, dispOff, pidOff, formOff, shinyOff){
  var arr=JSON.parse(arrJson); var out=[];

      var shiny=(shinyOff>=0)?d.add(shinyOff).readU8():null;

  }
  return out;
};

    sc.unload(); sess.detach()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
"""GROUND-TRUTH stardust audit. READ-ONLY. Runs alongside the catcher.

1. Enumerate EVERY IapService instance + its get_Stardusts / get_Coins (not just max).
2. Read InventoryCache PlayerCurrency (oneof case 5) + PlayerStats (case 4) -- the
   server-synced authoritative bag dictionary -- and pull the stardust currency value.
3. Hunt holo-game.dll for any PlayerProfile/Player/PlayerData/Inventory/CurrencyService
   class with a 0-arg int 'stardust'/'currency'-ish getter and read it on its live instance.
Touches nothing. One attach.
"""
import sys, os
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});

 H={dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]),iGN:b("il2cpp_image_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),iGCC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class_count","uint32",["pointer"]),iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]),CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),CGNS:b("il2cpp_class_get_namespace","pointer",["pointer"]),OGC:b("il2cpp_object_get_class","pointer",["pointer"]),cGM:b("il2cpp_class_get_methods","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),mGN:b("il2cpp_method_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),mGPC:b("il2cpp_method_get_param_count","uint32",["pointer"]),mGRT:b("il2cpp_method_get_return_type","pointer",["pointer"]),tGN:b("il2cpp_type_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),cMN:b("il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","int"]),cFN:b("il2cpp_class_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer"]),rI:b("il2cpp_runtime_invoke","pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer","pointer"]),tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"])};
 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}
function img(name){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()===name)return im;}return null;}
function mInv(m,obj){var h=H_();var exc=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);exc.writePointer(ptr(0));var r=h.rI(m,obj,ptr(0),exc);if(!exc.readPointer().isNull())return null;return r;}
```
