```py
rpc.exports.nsOf=function(cls){var h=H_();var im=img("holo-game.dll");var cnt=h.iGCC(im);for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++){var k=h.iGC(im,i);if(k.isNull())continue;try{if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===cls)return h.CGNS(k).readCString();}catch(e){}}return null;};
rpc.exports.clsName=function(inst){try{return H_().CGN(H_().OGC(ptr(inst))).readCString();}catch(e){return null;}};
rpc.exports.read32=function(inst,name){return read32(inst,name);};
// read both i32 and i64 (some currency fields are long)
rpc.exports.readNum=function(inst,name){var h=H_();var m=h.cMN(h.OGC(ptr(inst)),Memory.allocUtf8String(name),0);if(!m||m.isNull())return null;var r=mInv(m,ptr(inst));if(!r)return null;try{return {i32:r.add(0x10).readS32(), i64:r.add(0x10).readS64().toString()};}catch(e){return null;}};

// Find classes in holo-game.dll whose name matches /rx/ AND that have a 0-arg int getter
// whose name contains one of the wanted substrings. Returns [{cls,ns,getters:[...]}].
rpc.exports.findGetters=function(clsRx, getterSubs){var h=H_();var im=img("holo-game.dll");var cnt=h.iGCC(im);var cre=new RegExp(clsRx,"i");var out=[];
 for(var i=0;i<cnt&&out.length<60;i++){var k=h.iGC(im,i);if(k.isNull())continue;var cn;try{cn=h.CGN(k).readCString();}catch(e){continue;} if(!cre.test(cn))continue;
  var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var m;var gs=[];
  while((m=h.cGM(k,it))&&!m.isNull()){try{var nm=h.mGN(m).readCString();if(h.mGPC(m)!==0)continue;var lo=nm.toLowerCase();var hit=false;for(var s=0;s<getterSubs.length;s++){if(lo.indexOf(getterSubs[s])>=0){hit=true;break;}}if(!hit)continue;var rt="?";try{rt=h.tGN(h.mGRT(m)).readCString();}catch(e){}if(rt.indexOf("Int")>=0||rt.indexOf("Long")>=0||rt.indexOf("Single")>=0){gs.push(nm+" -> "+rt);}}catch(e){}}
  if(gs.length){out.push({cls:cn, ns:(h.CGNS(k).readCString()||""), getters:gs});}}
 return out;};

// InventoryCache currency: walk the dict, find oneof case 5 (PlayerCurrency) + case 4 (PlayerStats),
// dump candidate ints so we can read stardust the server-synced way.
rpc.exports.invCurrency=function(invAddr){var h=H_();var inv=ptr(invAddr);
 var icls=h.cFN(img("holo-game.dll"),Memory.allocUtf8String("Niantic.Holoholo.Collections"),Memory.allocUtf8String("InventoryCache"));
 var m=h.cMN(icls,Memory.allocUtf8String("GetCurrentItems"),0);if(!m||m.isNull())return {err:"no GetCurrentItems"};
 var coll=mInv(m,inv);if(!coll||coll.isNull())return {err:"null coll"};
 var dict=coll.add(0x10).readPointer();if(dict.isNull())return {err:"null dict"};
 var entries=dict.add(0x18).readPointer();if(entries.isNull())return {err:"null entries"};
 var count=entries.add(0x18).readS32();var hist={};var cur=[];var stats=[];
 for(var i=0;i<count;i++){var e=entries.add(0x20).add(i*0x18);var hash=e.add(0x0).readS32();if(hash<0)continue;
  var key=e.add(0x8).readPointer();var val=e.add(0x10).readPointer();if(key.isNull()||val.isNull())continue;
  var kcase=key.add(0x18).readS32();hist[kcase]=(hist[kcase]||0)+1;
  if(kcase===5||kcase===4){var rec={kcase:kcase,cls:null,raw:{}};try{rec.cls=h.CGN(h.OGC(val)).readCString();}catch(e){}
   [0x10,0x14,0x18,0x1c,0x20,0x24,0x28].forEach(function(o){try{rec.raw["i32@"+o.toString(16)]=val.add(o).readS32();}catch(e){}});
   try{rec.raw["i64@10"]=val.add(0x10).readS64().toString();}catch(e){}
   if(kcase===5)cur.push(rec);else stats.push(rec);}}
 return {count:count, hist:hist, currency:cur, stats:stats};};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached pid", pid)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        # ---- 1. EVERY IapService instance ----
        print("\n==== 1. ALL IapService instances ====")
        ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of("IapService")
        print("IapService namespace:", ns)
        iap_hits = []
        if ns:
            r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "IapService")
            iap_hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
        print(f"liveness hits: {len(iap_hits)} -> {iap_hits}")
        for h in iap_hits:
            cls = sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h)
            dust = sc.exports_sync.read32(h, "get_Stardusts")
            coins = sc.exports_sync.read32(h, "get_Coins")
            print(f"   {h}  cls={cls}  Stardusts={dust}  Coins={coins}")

        # ---- 2. InventoryCache server-synced currency ----
        print("\n==== 2. InventoryCache PlayerCurrency/PlayerStats (server-synced dict) ====")
        ic_r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton("Niantic.Holoholo.Collections", "InventoryCache")
        ic_hits = ic_r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(ic_r, dict) else []
        print(f"InventoryCache hits: {ic_hits}")
        for h in ic_hits:
            res = sc.exports_sync.inv_currency(h)
            if isinstance(res, dict) and res.get("err"):
                print(f"   {h}: ERR {res['err']}")
                continue
            print(f"   {h}: entries={res.get('count')} caseHist={res.get('hist')}")
            for rec in res.get("currency", []):
                print(f"      [PlayerCurrency case5] cls={rec.get('cls')} raw={rec.get('raw')}")
            for rec in res.get("stats", []):
                print(f"      [PlayerStats case4]    cls={rec.get('cls')} raw={rec.get('raw')}")

        # ---- 3. Hunt PlayerProfile/Player/Inventory/CurrencyService getters ----
        print("\n==== 3. Authoritative stardust getter hunt (holo-game.dll) ====")
        cls_rx = r"Player|Inventory|Currency|Wallet|Account|Trainer"
        subs = ["stardust", "dust", "currency", "stardstamount", "amount"]
        found = sc.exports_sync.find_getters(cls_rx, subs)
        print(f"candidate classes with stardust/currency-ish 0-arg numeric getters: {len(found)}")
        for f in found:
            print(f"\n   CLASS {f['ns']}.{f['cls']}")
            for g in f["getters"]:
                print(f"       getter: {g}")
            # try to read each getter on the live instance(s)
            try:
                rr = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(f["ns"], f["cls"])
                hh = rr.get("hits", []) if isinstance(rr, dict) else []
            except Exception as e:
                hh = []
                print(f"       (find_singleton err: {e})")
            for inst in hh[:4]:
                if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(inst) != f["cls"]:
                    continue
                for g in f["getters"]:
                    gname = g.split(" ")[0]
                    val = sc.exports_sync.read_num(inst, gname)
                    if val is not None:
                        print(f"       @{inst} {gname} = {val}")
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached pid", pid)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        # IapService all instances, i32+i64
        print("\n==== IapService instances (i32+i64) ====")
        ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of("IapService")
        r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "IapService") if ns else {}
        for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []):
            if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != "IapService":
                print(f"   {h}: not IapService ({sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h)})"); continue
            sd = sc.exports_sync.read_num(h, "get_Stardusts")
            co = sc.exports_sync.read_num(h, "get_Coins")
            print(f"   {h}: Stardusts={sd} Coins={co}")

        # IapService numeric getters list (to find any other stardust-ish getter)
        print("\n==== IapService 0-arg numeric getters ====")
        g = sc.exports_sync.num_getters(ns, "IapService")
        for x in (g.get("getters", []) if isinstance(g, dict) else []):
            print("   ", x)

        # InventoryCache deep
        print("\n==== InventoryCache deep (case 4/5/6 holders + inner proto) ====")
        ic_r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton("Niantic.Holoholo.Collections", "InventoryCache")
        for h in (ic_r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(ic_r, dict) else []):
            res = sc.exports_sync.inv_deep(h)
            if isinstance(res, dict) and res.get("err"):
                print(f"   {h}: ERR {res['err']}"); continue
            print(f"   {h}: entries={res.get('count')}")
            for rec in res.get("samples", []):
                print(f"      case{rec['kcase']} holder={rec['holderCls']} holderRaw={rec.get('holderRaw')}")
                for gn, info in rec.get("inner", {}).items():
                    print(f"          {gn}: cls={info.get('cls')} raw={info.get('raw')}")

        # ClientInventoryItem fields (to map the currency holder)
        print("\n==== ClientInventoryItem fields ====")
        f = sc.exports_sync.fields("Niantic.Holoholo.Collections", "ClientInventoryItem")
        if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("fields"):
            for fld in f["fields"]:
                print(f"   {fld['name']} @{hex(fld['off'])} : {fld['type']}")
        else:
            print("   ", f)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
      if(rt.indexOf("Int")<0&&rt.indexOf("Bool")<0&&rt.indexOf("String")<0&&rt.indexOf("Single")<0&&rt.indexOf("Enum")<0){holderGetters.push(nm);}}catch(e){}}}
  // call each holder getter; if result class matches Currency, capture
  for(var gi=0;gi<holderGetters.length;gi++){var gn=holderGetters[gi];try{var gm=h.cMN(h.OGC(val),Memory.allocUtf8String(gn),0);if(!gm||gm.isNull())continue;var pr=mInv(gm,val);if(!pr||pr.isNull())continue;var cn=cname(pr);if(!cn)continue;
    if(/Currenc|Stardust|PlayerWallet|Wallet/i.test(cn)){var raw={};[0x10,0x14,0x18,0x1c,0x20,0x24].forEach(function(o){try{raw["i32@"+o.toString(16)]=pr.add(o).readS32();}catch(e){}});
      var amt=read32(pr,"get_Amount");var sd=read32(pr,"get_Stardust");var q=read32(pr,"get_Quantity");
      found.push({holder:cname(val),getter:gn,proto:cn,raw:raw,get_Amount:amt,get_Stardust:sd,get_Quantity:q});}
  }catch(e){}}
  if(found.length>=6)break;
 }
 return {count:count, holderGetters:holderGetters, found:found};};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached pid", pid)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        # account identity: player level + box (sanity that 47k instance is THIS account)
        print("==== Account identity ====")
        for cls, getters in [
            ("PlayerProfileWatcher", ["get_Level", "get_Experience"]),
            ("PlayerMetadataProxy", ["get_Level"]),
            ("PokemonBagImpl", ["get_PokemonOnlyCount"]),
        ]:
            ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of(cls)
            if not ns:
                print(f"   {cls}: ns not found"); continue
            r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, cls)
            for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else [])[:3]:
                if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != cls:
                    continue
                vals = {g: sc.exports_sync.read32(h, g) for g in getters}
                print(f"   {cls} @{h}: {vals}")
                break

        print("\n==== InventoryCache currency hunt ====")
        ic_r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton("Niantic.Holoholo.Collections", "InventoryCache")
        for h in (ic_r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(ic_r, dict) else []):
            res = sc.exports_sync.find_currency(h)
            if isinstance(res, dict) and res.get("err"):
                print(f"   {h}: ERR {res['err']}"); continue
            print(f"   {h}: entries={res.get('count')}")
            print(f"      holder ref-getters: {res.get('holderGetters')}")
            for fr in res.get("found", []):
                print(f"      CURRENCY via {fr['getter']} -> {fr['proto']}: Amount={fr['get_Amount']} Stardust={fr['get_Stardust']} Qty={fr['get_Quantity']} raw={fr['raw']}")
            if not res.get("found"):
                print("      (no Currency-named proto surfaced from holder ref-getters)")
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
"""GROUND-TRUTH pass 4 (decisive). READ-ONLY.
- Re-read live IapService stardust (the non-zero instance).
- Scan EVERY InventoryCache entry holder for any int32 in [stardust*0.5 .. stardust*3] and
  also any LARGE int (>100000) -- to locate the server-synced currency field and check whether
  a ~700k value still lives anywhere in the synced bag (would mean server still has it).
One attach.
"""
import sys, os
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});

function img(name){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()===name)return im;}return null;}
function mInv(m,obj){var h=H_();var exc=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);exc.writePointer(ptr(0));var r=h.rI(m,obj,ptr(0),exc);if(!exc.readPointer().isNull())return null;return r;}
function cname(o){try{return H_().CGN(H_().OGC(ptr(o))).readCString();}catch(e){return null;}}

rpc.exports.clsName=function(inst){return cname(inst);};
rpc.exports.nsOf=function(cls){var h=H_();var im=img("holo-game.dll");var cnt=h.iGCC(im);for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++){var k=h.iGC(im,i);if(k.isNull())continue;try{if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===cls)return h.CGNS(k).readCString();}catch(e){}}return null;};

// Scan inventory holders for int32 in [lo,hi] OR > big. For each match, record holder class,
// key-case, offset, value. This locates the currency field by VALUE without knowing the proto layout.
rpc.exports.scanInts=function(invAddr,lo,hi,big){var h=H_();var inv=ptr(invAddr);
 var icls=h.cFN(img("holo-game.dll"),Memory.allocUtf8String("Niantic.Holoholo.Collections"),Memory.allocUtf8String("InventoryCache"));
 var m=h.cMN(icls,Memory.allocUtf8String("GetCurrentItems"),0);if(!m||m.isNull())return {err:"no GetCurrentItems"};

  var key=e.add(0x8).readPointer();var val=e.add(0x10).readPointer();if(key.isNull()||val.isNull())continue;
  var kcase=-1;try{kcase=key.add(0x18).readS32();}catch(e){}
  var cn=cname(val);
  // scan first 0x60 bytes of the holder value object as int32s
  for(var o=0x10;o<=0x5c;o+=4){var v;try{v=val.add(o).readS32();}catch(e){break;}
    if(v>=lo&&v<=hi){rng.push({case:kcase,cls:cn,off:o,val:v});}
    if(v>=big){bigs.push({case:kcase,cls:cn,off:o,val:v});}}
 }
 return {count:count, inRange:rng.slice(0,40), bigVals:bigs.slice(0,40)};};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached pid", pid)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton("Niantic.Holoholo.Storefront", "IapService")
        live = None
        for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []):
            if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != "IapService":
                continue
            v = sc.exports_sync.read_i(h, "get_Stardusts")
            if v and v > 0:
                live = (h, v)
        print(f"live IapService stardust: {live}")
        cur = live[1] if live else 47000
        lo, hi = int(cur * 0.5), int(cur * 3)
        big = 200000
        print(f"scanning InventoryCache holders for int in [{lo}..{hi}] and any > {big} ...")

        ic_r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton("Niantic.Holoholo.Collections", "InventoryCache")
        for h in (ic_r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(ic_r, dict) else []):
            res = sc.exports_sync.scan_ints(h, lo, hi, big)
            if isinstance(res, dict) and res.get("err"):
                print(f"   {h}: ERR {res['err']}"); continue
            print(f"   {h}: entries={res.get('count')}")
            print(f"   --- ints in [{lo}..{hi}] (currency-magnitude candidates) ---")
            for x in res.get("inRange", []):
                print(f"      case{x['case']:>3} {x['cls']} @{hex(x['off'])} = {x['val']}")
            print(f"   --- LARGE ints > {big} (would a ~700k value survive here?) ---")
            for x in res.get("bigVals", []):
                print(f"      case{x['case']:>3} {x['cls']} @{hex(x['off'])} = {x['val']}")
            if not res.get("bigVals"):
                print("      (none — NO large ~700k value present anywhere in the synced bag)")
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/trace_award.py`:

```py
"""LIVE AWARD READER (read-only hook): hook CatchPokemonOutProto.MergeFrom (wire parse) and read, per catch:
Status (caught/fled) + CaptureScoreProto.Stardust[] (per-bonus breakdown) + ActivityType[] (which bonus).
Reads protobuf RepeatedField<int> by raw offset (getters are obfuscated). Touches nothing — reads in onLeave."""
import sys, os, time
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});

 H={dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]),iGN:b("il2cpp_image_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),iGCC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class_count","uint32",["pointer"]),iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]),CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),cGM:b("il2cpp_class_get_methods","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),mGN:b("il2cpp_method_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),mGPC:b("il2cpp_method_get_param_count","uint32",["pointer"]),tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"])};
 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}
function img(name){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()===name)return im;}return null;}
function findClass(image,cls){var h=H_();var im=img(image);if(!im)return null;var cnt=h.iGCC(im);for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++){var k=h.iGC(im,i);if(k.isNull())continue;try{if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===cls)return k;}catch(e){}}return null;}
function readRF(rf){ // protobuf RepeatedField<int>: array@0x10, count@0x18, il2cpp array data@0x20
 try{ if(!rf||rf.isNull())return null; var arr=rf.add(0x10).readPointer(); var cnt=rf.add(0x18).readS32(); if(cnt<0||cnt>64)return {cnt:cnt,bad:1}; var v=[]; if(arr&&!arr.isNull()){for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++)v.push(arr.add(0x20+i*4).readS32());} return {cnt:cnt,v:v}; }catch(e){return {err:""+e};}
}
var EVENTS=[];
rpc.exports.getEvents=function(){var e=EVENTS;EVENTS=[];return e;};
rpc.exports.install=function(){
 var h=H_(); var st={hooks:0};
 var k=findClass("holo-protos.dll","CatchPokemonOutProto"); if(!k){st.err="no class";return st;}
 var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize); it.writePointer(ptr(0)); var m;
 while((m=h.cGM(k,it))&&!m.isNull()){
  try{ if(h.mGN(m).readCString()!=="MergeFrom") continue; if(h.mGPC(m)!==1) continue;
   var code=m.readPointer(); if(!code||code.isNull()) continue;
   Interceptor.attach(code,{onEnter:function(a){this.self=a[0];},onLeave:function(r){
     try{ var s=this.self; if(!s||s.isNull())return;
      var status=s.add(0x10).readS32();
      var dex=s.add(0x34).readS32();
      var sc=s.add(0x28).readPointer();
      var sd=null, act=null;
      if(sc&&!sc.isNull()){ sd=readRF(sc.add(0x28).readPointer()); act=readRF(sc.add(0x10).readPointer()); }
      // only log entries that look like a catch result (has a score)
      EVENTS.push({status:status,dex:dex,sd:sd,act:act});
     }catch(e){}
   }});
   st.hooks++;
  }catch(e){}
 }
 return st;
};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    st = sc.exports_sync.install()
    print(f"attached {pid} | install={st}", flush=True)
    if not st.get("hooks"):
        print("no hooks — aborting"); sess.detach(); return
    print("watching catch awards (Status / Stardust breakdown)...", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time(); n = 0
    while time.time() - t0 < 150 and n < 25:
        time.sleep(1.0)
        for e in (sc.exports_sync.get_events() or []):
            sd = e.get("sd") or {}
            act = e.get("act") or {}
            dust = sum(sd.get("v", [])) if isinstance(sd.get("v"), list) else None
            # skip merge-noise where there's no score array
            if not sd.get("v") and dust is None:
                continue
            n += 1
            print(f"  status={e.get('status')} dex={e.get('dex')} TOTAL_DUST={dust} "
                  f"breakdown={sd.get('v')} activityTypes={act.get('v')}", flush=True)
    print(f"done ({n} catches read)", flush=True)
    sess.detach()


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/trace_award2.py`:

```py
"""DEFINITIVE (read-only): over one window, SUM the per-catch award arrays (CaptureScoreProto.Stardust)
AND measure the real IapService stardust the total rises by. ratio = credited / award-sum tells us whether
the Star Piece(x1.5)/event(x2-3) multipliers are actually CREDITED or just missing from the display.
ratio ~1 => multipliers dropped (real bug). ~3-4.5 => applied (display-only). Touches nothing."""
import sys, os, time
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

JS = r"""
var H=null;
function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});
 function b(n,r,a){return e[n]?new NativeFunction(e[n],r,a):null;}
 H={dG:b("il2cpp_domain_get","pointer",[]),dGA:b("il2cpp_domain_get_assemblies","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),aGI:b("il2cpp_assembly_get_image","pointer",["pointer"]),iGN:b("il2cpp_image_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),iGCC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class_count","uint32",["pointer"]),iGC:b("il2cpp_image_get_class","pointer",["pointer","uint32"]),CGN:b("il2cpp_class_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),CGNS:b("il2cpp_class_get_namespace","pointer",["pointer"]),OGC:b("il2cpp_object_get_class","pointer",["pointer"]),cGM:b("il2cpp_class_get_methods","pointer",["pointer","pointer"]),mGN:b("il2cpp_method_get_name","pointer",["pointer"]),mGPC:b("il2cpp_method_get_param_count","uint32",["pointer"]),cMN:b("il2cpp_class_get_method_from_name","pointer",["pointer","pointer","int"]),rI:b("il2cpp_runtime_invoke","pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer","pointer"]),tA:b("il2cpp_thread_attach","pointer",["pointer"])};
 H.tA(H.dG());return H;}
function img(name){var h=H_();var sp=Memory.alloc(4);var a=h.dGA(h.dG(),sp);var n=sp.readS32();for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var im=h.aGI(a.add(i*Process.pointerSize).readPointer());if(h.iGN(im).readCString()===name)return im;}return null;}
function findClass(image,cls){var h=H_();var im=img(image);if(!im)return null;var cnt=h.iGCC(im);for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++){var k=h.iGC(im,i);if(k.isNull())continue;try{if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===cls)return k;}catch(e){}}return null;}
function readRF(rf){try{if(!rf||rf.isNull())return 0;var arr=rf.add(0x10).readPointer();var cnt=rf.add(0x18).readS32();if(cnt<0||cnt>64)return 0;var s=0;if(arr&&!arr.isNull()){for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++)s+=arr.add(0x20+i*4).readS32();}return s;}catch(e){return 0;}}
rpc.exports.nsOf=function(cls){var h=H_();var im=img("holo-game.dll");var cnt=h.iGCC(im);for(var i=0;i<cnt;i++){var k=h.iGC(im,i);if(k.isNull())continue;try{if(h.CGN(k).readCString()===cls)return h.CGNS(k).readCString();}catch(e){}}return null;};

rpc.exports.readDust=function(inst){var h=H_();var m=h.cMN(h.OGC(ptr(inst)),Memory.allocUtf8String("get_Stardusts"),0);if(!m||m.isNull())return null;var ex=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);ex.writePointer(ptr(0));var r=h.rI(m,ptr(inst),ptr(0),ex);if(!ex.readPointer().isNull())return null;try{return r?r.add(0x10).readS32():null;}catch(e){return null;}};
var NCATCH=0, SUMAWARD=0;
rpc.exports.stats=function(){return {n:NCATCH,sum:SUMAWARD};};
rpc.exports.install=function(){var h=H_();var st={hooks:0};var k=findClass("holo-protos.dll","CatchPokemonOutProto");if(!k)return st;var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));var m;
 while((m=h.cGM(k,it))&&!m.isNull()){try{if(h.mGN(m).readCString()!=="MergeFrom")continue;if(h.mGPC(m)!==1)continue;var code=m.readPointer();if(!code||code.isNull())continue;
  Interceptor.attach(code,{onEnter:function(a){this.self=a[0];},onLeave:function(r){try{var s=this.self;if(!s||s.isNull())return;var status=s.add(0x10).readS32();var sc=s.add(0x28).readPointer();if(!sc||sc.isNull())return;var dust=readRF(sc.add(0x28).readPointer());if(status===1&&dust>0){NCATCH++;SUMAWARD+=dust;}}catch(e){}}});
  st.hooks++;}catch(e){}}
 return st;};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)

    def find_iap():
        ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of("IapService")
        r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "IapService")
        best = None; bv = None
        for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []):
            if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != "IapService":
                continue
            v = sc.exports_sync.read_dust(h)
            if v is not None and (bv is None or v > bv):
                best = h; bv = v
        return best
    iap = find_iap()
    if not iap:
        print("no IapService"); sess.detach(); return
    d0 = sc.exports_sync.read_dust(iap)
    st = sc.exports_sync.install()
    print(f"attached {pid} | hooks={st.get('hooks')} | D0={d0}", flush=True)

    # catch window
    WINDOW = 80
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < WINDOW:
        time.sleep(5)
        s = sc.exports_sync.stats()
        print(f"  +{int(time.time()-t0)}s catches={s.get('n')} award_sum={s.get('sum')} dust_now={sc.exports_sync.read_dust(iap)}", flush=True)
    s = sc.exports_sync.stats()
    n, ssum = s.get("n", 0), s.get("sum", 0)

    # settle: wait for IapService to stop rising (batchy sync), up to 120s
    print("  settling (waiting for stardust to finish syncing)...", flush=True)
    last = sc.exports_sync.read_dust(iap); stable = 0; t1 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t1 < 120 and stable < 18:
        time.sleep(3)
        cur = sc.exports_sync.read_dust(iap)
        stable = stable + 3 if cur == last else 0
        last = cur
    d1 = last
    credited = d1 - d0
    print(f"\n==== RESULT over the window ====")
    print(f"catches counted (status=success): {n}")
    print(f"award-array stardust sum (base+flat, per proto): {ssum}")
    print(f"REAL stardust credited (IapService {d0} -> {d1}): {credited}")
    if ssum > 0:
        print(f"ratio credited/award = {credited/ssum:.2f}   "
              f"(~1.0 = multipliers DROPPED; ~1.5 = StarPiece only; ~3.0 = StarPiece+2x; ~4.5 = StarPiece+3x)")
    sess.detach()


main()
```

```py
def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    st = sc.exports_sync.install()
    print(f"attached {pid} | hooks={st.get('hooks')}", flush=True)
    if not st.get("hooks"):
        print("no hooks"); sess.detach(); return
    print("reading the bot's outgoing catch requests...", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time(); n = 0
    while time.time() - t0 < 90 and n < 12:
        time.sleep(1.0)
        for e in (sc.exports_sync.get_events() or []):
            n += 1
            print(f"  via={e.get('via')} enc={e['enc']} ball={e['ball']} spawnGUID={e['spawn']!r} HitPokemon={e['hit']} "
                  f"reticle={e['reticle']:.2f} spin={e['spin']:.2f} hitPos={e['hitpos']:.2f} arPlus={e['arplus']} flee={e['flee']}", flush=True)
    print(f"done ({n} requests read)", flush=True)
    sess.detach()
```

```py
var TARGETS=[
 ["QuestStateManager","OpenQuestEncounter",1,{}],
 ["QuestStateManager","OpenQuestEncounter",2,{}],
 ["QuestStateManager","OpenQuestListPageDefault",0,{}],

          if(dec.int)dec.int.forEach(function(i){try{info["i"+i]=args[i].toInt32();}catch(e){}});
          if(dec.cls)dec.cls.forEach(function(i){info["c"+i]=clsOf(args[i]);}); }catch(e){}
     EVENTS.push(info);
   }});

  }catch(e){status.push(label+" : ERR "+e);}
 });

"""


def main():
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(TRACE), exist_ok=True)
    tf = open(TRACE, "a", encoding="utf-8")

    def w(s):
        line = f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {s}"
        tf.write(line + "\n"); tf.flush(); print(line, flush=True)

    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    w(f"===== reward tracer attached pid={pid} =====")
    status = sc.exports_sync.install()
    hooked = sum(1 for s in status if s.endswith("HOOKED"))
    for s in status:
        w("  hook " + s)
    w(f"===== {hooked}/{len(status)} hooks live — CATCH ONE REWARD NOW =====")
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        while time.time() - t0 < RUN_SECONDS:
            evs = sc.exports_sync.get_events()
            for e in (evs or []):
                parts = [f"{k}={v}" for k, v in e.items() if k not in ("seq", "n")]
                w(f"  EVENT #{e.get('seq')} {e.get('n')} {' '.join(parts)}")
            time.sleep(1.0)
    finally:
        w("===== tracer stopping =====")
        try:
            sc.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
"""VERIFY (READ-ONLY): cross-check the EncounterSettingsProto field offsets against

"""

ENC_NS = "Niantic.Holoholo.Encounter"
ENC_CLS = "EncounterState"
ENC_PROTO = "EncounterSettingsProto"


def resolve_proto(finder, sc):
    """EncounterState @0x150 -> GameMasterData; crlp dict @0xd8 -> find EncounterSettingsProto value."""
    for _ in range(8):
        r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ENC_NS, ENC_CLS)
        hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
        for h in hits:
            cn = sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h)
            if not (cn and cn.endswith("." + ENC_CLS)):
                continue
            gm = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(h, 0x150)
            if not (gm and gm.startswith("0x")):
                continue
            dictp = sc.exports_sync.read_ptr(gm, 0xd8)
            if not (dictp and dictp.startswith("0x")):
                continue
            # walk the Dictionary<Type,IMessage>: entries @+0x18, array first elem @+0x20, stride 0x18, value @+0x10
            res = sc.exports_sync.walk_proto_bag(dictp)
            for ent in (res.get("entries", []) if isinstance(res, dict) else []):
                if ent.get("cls") and ent["cls"].endswith("." + ENC_PROTO):
                    return ent["ptr"], gm
        time.sleep(1.0)
    return None, None


# Add a tiny proto-bag walker (value class @ +0x10) to JS via a second export.
JS += r"""
function cname2(o){try{var h=H_();return (h.CGNS(h.OGC(ptr(o))).readCString()||"")+"."+h.CGN(h.OGC(ptr(o))).readCString();}catch(e){return null;}}
rpc.exports.walkProtoBag=function(dictAddr){var d=ptr(dictAddr);var out={entries:[]};try{
  var entries=d.add(0x18).readPointer();var count=d.add(0x20).readS32();if(entries.isNull()){out.err="null";return out;}
  var alen=entries.add(0x18).readS32();var base=entries.add(0x20);var n=Math.min(count<0?alen:count,alen,4000);
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var e=base.add(i*0x18);var v=null;try{v=e.add(0x10).readPointer();}catch(_){}
   if(v&&!v.isNull())out.entries.push({idx:i,cls:cname2(v),ptr:v.toString()});}
 }catch(e){out.err=""+e;}return out;};
"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid, flush=True)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    try:
        # 1. Authoritative metadata layout
        print(f"\n=== {ENC_PROTO} metadata field layout (holo-protos.dll) ===", flush=True)
        lay = sc.exports_sync.field_layout(ENC_PROTO, "holo-protos.dll")
        if isinstance(lay, dict) and lay.get("err"):
            print("  layout err:", lay["err"], flush=True)
        for f in (lay.get("fields", []) if isinstance(lay, dict) else []):
            print(f"   +0x{f['off']:x} {f['name']} : {f['type']}", flush=True)

        # 2. Resolve a live proto
        proto, gm = resolve_proto(finder, sc)
        print(f"\nlive {ENC_PROTO} = {proto}  (via GameMasterData {gm})", flush=True)
        if not proto:
            print("could not resolve live proto", flush=True); return
        print("class check:", sc.exports_sync.cls_name(proto), flush=True)

        # 3. Read every field by metadata offset
        print(f"\n=== ALL FIELDS read by metadata offset off {proto} ===", flush=True)
        allf = sc.exports_sync.read_all_fields(proto, ENC_PROTO, "holo-protos.dll")
        for f in (allf.get("fields", []) if isinstance(allf, dict) else []):
            print(f"   +0x{f['off']:x} {f['name']} ({f['type']}) = {f['val']}", flush=True)

        # 4. Raw float/i32 hex window for sanity
        print(f"\n=== raw [off, i32, f32] dump 0x10..0x90 ===", flush=True)
        for r in (sc.exports_sync.hex_floats(proto, 0x80) or []):
            f = r["f32"]
            note = ""
            if -1e6 < f < 1e6 and f != 0 and (abs(f) > 1e-3):
                note = "  <- plausible float"
            print(f"   +0x{r['off']:x}: i32={r['i32']:>12}  f32={f:.6g}{note}", flush=True)
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_read/verify_goal.py`:

```py
"""GOAL VERIFY (READ-ONLY): read the REAL stardust (max-value IapService instance) + box
(max-value PokemonBagImpl), then watch the running catcher land +10 Pokemon, and confirm stardust rose.
Runs alongside the catcher; touches nothing."""

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")

"""

NEED = 10
TIMEOUT = 600


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)

    def find_max(cls, getter):
        ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of(cls)
        if not ns:
            return None
        r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, cls)
        best = None; bestv = None
        for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []):
            if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) != cls:
                continue
            v = sc.exports_sync.read_i(h, getter)
            if v is not None and (bestv is None or v > bestv):
                best = h; bestv = v
        return best
    iap = find_max("IapService", "get_Stardusts")
    pb = find_max("PokemonBagImpl", "get_PokemonOnlyCount")
    if not iap or not pb:
        print("could not find stardust/box singleton"); sess.detach(); return

    def dust():
        return sc.exports_sync.read_i(iap, "get_Stardusts")
    def boxc():
        return sc.exports_sync.read_i(pb, "get_PokemonOnlyCount")

    d0, b0 = dust(), boxc()
    print(f"BASELINE | Stardust={d0} BOX={b0}  -- waiting for the catcher to land +{NEED}\n")
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < TIMEOUT:
        time.sleep(5)
        d, b = dust(), boxc()
        print(f"  +{int(time.time()-t0)}s | BOX {b} (+{b-b0}) | Stardust {d} (+{d-d0})")
        if b - b0 >= NEED:
            break
    d1, b1 = dust(), boxc()
    caught = b1 - b0; dust_gain = d1 - d0
    print(f"\nRESULT: caught={caught} (BOX {b0}->{b1}) | stardust +{dust_gain} ({d0}->{d1})")
    if caught >= NEED and dust_gain > 0:
        print(">>> GOAL MET: 10+ caught AND stardust earned.")
    else:
        print(">>> not yet: need 10 caught + stardust>0")
    sess.detach()


main()
```

```py
        try:
            return pg.get_session()

    return None, None

    sess, pid = attach()
    if not sess:
        print("could not attach"); return
    print("attached", pid)
    finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    sc.on("message", lambda m, d: print("  [pump]", m["payload"].get("s")) if m.get("type") == "send" and m.get("payload", {}).get("k") == "p" else None)
    st = sc.exports_sync.install()

    if not (st.get("pump") and st.get("pbt")):
        sess.detach(); return

    print("=> if delta is -1 and your screen showed NO encounter popup, the UI-free catch path works.")
    sess.detach()
```

```py
def main():
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(LOG), exist_ok=True)
    f = open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8")

    def w(s):
        line = f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {s}"; f.write(line + "\n"); f.flush(); print(line, flush=True)

    w(f"===== GYM FEEDER start MAX={MAX} berries=Razz+Nanab floor={BERRY_FLOOR} interval={FEED_INTERVAL_MS}ms — self-reconnecting =====")
    while True:
        sess = None
        try:
            for i in range(6):
                try:
                    sess, pid = pg.get_session(); break
                except Exception as e:
                    if i == 0:
                        w(f"waiting for PoGo... ({str(e)[:40]})")
                    time.sleep(5)
            if not sess:
                time.sleep(3); continue
            finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
            sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
            st = sc.exports_sync.install()
            need = ["pump", "feed", "defs", "pId", "pFort"]
            if not all(st.get(k) for k in need):
                raise RuntimeError(f"install incomplete {st}")
            sc.exports_sync.set_cfg(FEED_INTERVAL_MS, PER_DEFENDER_MAX, BERRY_FLOOR)
            sc.exports_sync.set_max(MAX)
            # ItemBag
            info = sc.exports_sync.find_item_bag(); ib = None
            if info:
                r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(info["ns"], info["cls"])
                ib = next((h for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []) if sc.exports_sync.count(h, RAZZ) >= 0), None)
            if ib:
                sc.exports_sync.set_item_bag(ib)
            # GymRootController (already-open gym); Initialize hook also captures future opens
            ns = sc.exports_sync.ns_of("GymRootController")
            grc = None
            if ns:
                rg = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "GymRootController")
                hits = [h for h in (rg.get("hits", []) if isinstance(rg, dict) else []) if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) == "GymRootController"]
                active = [h for h in hits if sc.exports_sync.grc_active(h)]
                grc = active[0] if active else (hits[0] if hits else None)
                w(f"GymRootController hits={len(hits)} active={len(active)}")
                if grc:
                    sc.exports_sync.set_grc(grc)
            razz = sc.exports_sync.count(ib, RAZZ) if ib else -1
            nanab = sc.exports_sync.count(ib, NANAB) if ib else -1
            w(f"connected pid={pid} | install ok | Razz={razz} Nanab={nanab} | gym={'open' if sc.exports_sync.stats().get('grc') else 'none yet — open a gym'}")
            w("===== OPEN A GYM and it'll feed every defender (Razz then Nanab). Watching. =====")
            sc.exports_sync.run(True)
            done = False; last_diag = 0
            while not done:
                for e in (sc.exports_sync.get_events() or []):
                    k = e.get("k")
                    if k == "feed":
                        b = "Razz" if e.get("berry") == RAZZ else ("Nanab" if e.get("berry") == NANAB else e.get("berry"))
                        w(f"FEED dex={e.get('spec')} cp={e.get('cp')} {b} pokemonId={e.get('id')}")
                    elif k == "result":
                        w(f"  -> {RESULT.get(e.get('res'), e.get('res'))}")
                    elif k == "stop":
                        w(f"STOP: {e.get('why')}"); done = True
                    elif k == "done":
                        w(f"===== DONE: fed {e.get('fed')} this session ====="); done = True
                    elif k == "err":
                        w(f"  err {e.get('m')}")
                now = time.time()
                if now - last_diag >= 4:
                    last_diag = now
                    d = sc.exports_sync.diag()
                    if not (isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("active")) and ns:
                        rg2 = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "GymRootController")
                        for h in (rg2.get("hits", []) if isinstance(rg2, dict) else []):
                            if sc.exports_sync.cls_name(h) == "GymRootController" and sc.exports_sync.grc_active(h):
                                sc.exports_sync.set_grc(h); d = sc.exports_sync.diag(); break
                    w(f"  [diag] {d}")
                time.sleep(0.5)
            sess.detach(); return
        except Exception as e:
            w(f"--- link drop: {str(e)[:200]} — reconnecting ---")
            try:
                sess.detach()
            except Exception:
                pass
            time.sleep(3)


main()
```

```py
"""#1 FORCE-ULTRA: on every catch sent via CatchPokemonProto, upgrade the ball to ULTRA_BALL(3).
Only upgrades POKE(1)/GREAT(2) -> ULTRA(3); leaves MASTER(4)/PREMIER(5)/etc untouched (so raid Premier
and intentional Master throws are preserved). Auto-disables if Ultra stock runs low (avoids fleeing on empty).
Server honors the client-chosen ball (proven: 13/13 manual Ultra catches in catch_log). REVERSIBLE: just stop this task.
Note: brief client UI/inventory desync possible (UI may show the selected ball; server records Ultra) until next sync."""

def main():
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(LOG), exist_ok=True)
    f = open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8")

    def w(s):
        f.write(f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {s}\n"); f.flush()

    w("===== force_ultra session start =====")
    while True:
        try:
            sess, pid = pg.get_session()
            finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
            sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)

            def on_msg(m, d):
                if m.get("type") != "send":
                    return
                p = m.get("payload", {})
                if p.get("k") == "forced":
                    w(f"FORCED {ITEM.get(p.get('from'), p.get('from'))}->ULTRA")
                elif p.get("k") == "pass":
                    w(f"pass ball={ITEM.get(p.get('ball'), p.get('ball'))} (not upgraded)")
            sc.on("message", on_msg)

            info = sc.exports_sync.find_item_bag()
            ib = None
            if info:
                r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(info["ns"], info["cls"])
                for h in (r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []):
                    if sc.exports_sync.count(h, 1) >= 0:
                        ib = h; break
            st = sc.exports_sync.hook()
            w(f"attached pid={pid} hook={st} itembag={'ok' if ib else 'NO'} FORCE=ON (upgrades Poke/Great->Ultra)")
            forcing = True
            while True:
                time.sleep(3)
                if ib:
                    u = sc.exports_sync.count(ib, 3)
                    if u >= 0:
                        if u <= MIN_ULTRA and forcing:
                            sc.exports_sync.set_force(False); forcing = False
                            w(f"Ultra low ({u}) -> forcing DISABLED (won't strand catches)")
                        elif u > MIN_ULTRA and not forcing:
                            sc.exports_sync.set_force(True); forcing = True
                            w(f"Ultra ok ({u}) -> forcing RE-ENABLED")
        except Exception as e:
            w(f"--- link drop: {str(e)[:90]} — reconnecting ---")
            time.sleep(3)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```py
def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        finder = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess)
        sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, MY_JS)
        try:
            # 1. the WainaPreferences we will save (Ball forced to 3), with full field dump
            wp = sc.exports_sync.pick_waina()
            if wp.get("err"):
                print("WainaPreferences:", wp["err"]); return
            print(f"\n=== WainaPreferences to SAVE @{wp['addr']} (Ball set to ULTRA_BALL) ===")
            for f in wp["fields"]:
                mark = ""
                if "Item:" in f:
                    try: mark = "   <-- " + ITEM.get(int(f.split("Item:")[1].strip()), "?")
                    except Exception: pass
                print("   ", f, mark)

            # 2. live PlayerService
            ns = sc.exports_sync.class_ns("holo-game.dll", "PlayerService")
            print(f"\nPlayerService namespace: {ns}")
            r = finder.exports_sync.find_singleton(ns, "PlayerService")
            hits = r.get("hits", []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []
            print(f"PlayerService live instances: {len(hits)}")
            if not hits:
                print("no PlayerService instance found"); return

            # 3. invoke the save on each candidate until one succeeds
            done = False
            for ps in hits:
                res = sc.exports_sync.invoke_save(ps, wp["addr"])
                print(f"  invoke on {ps}: {res}")
                if isinstance(res, dict) and res.get("ok"):
                    done = True
                    print("\n>>> SaveWainaPreferences invoked OK — Ultra-Ball pref pushed to the server.")
                    print(">>> TEST: catch a few with VGP3; Ultra count should now drop (Poke should hold).")
                    break
            if not done:
                print("\n(no candidate accepted the call — may need the populated singleton; report output.)")
        finally:
            sc.unload(); finder.unload()
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/game_write/item_cleanup.py`:

```py
"""Item-bag cleanup -- emulates the inventory management lost with Pokemod's paid plan.

WHY: the item bag hit 3684 against a 3650 cap, so PokeStop spins were returning
FortSearchOutProto Result=4 (INVENTORY_FULL) and awarding nothing -- roughly 38% of spins wasted.

SAFETY MODEL
  * DRY-RUN BY DEFAULT. --commit is required to discard anything, and discarding is irreversible.
  * PROTECTED is a hard blocklist re-checked at the moment of each call, not only when the plan
    is built. Golden Razz and Silver Pinap are on it because of a standing instruction ("do not
    touch my golden razz or silver"). Note that Silver Pinap's INTERNAL enum name is
    GoldenPinapBerry -- an easy and expensive thing to confuse with PinapBerry.
  * Only ids listed in KEEP_TO are ever trimmed. The policy is an allowlist of things to trim,
    not a denylist of things to spare, so an item type added by a future update defaults to
    untouched.
  * Balls are trimmed conservatively: they are the catcher's fuel, and running dry silently
    degrades catching, which is worse than a full bag.
"""
import argparse
import os
import sys

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, os.pardir, os.pardir))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
import pogo_il2cpp as pg  # noqa: E402

# item id -> ceiling to keep. ONLY these ids are ever trimmed.
KEEP_TO = {
    1: 1200,    # PokeBall     -- the catcher's default ball; keep a deep stock
    3: 300,     # UltraBall    -- reserved for the hardest targets
    101: 50,    # Potion
    102: 50,    # SuperPotion
    103: 100,   # HyperPotion
    104: 100,   # MaxPotion
    201: 50,    # Revive
    202: 150,   # MaxRevive
    703: 50,    # NanabBerry
    705: 120,   # PinapBerry
}

# NEVER discarded, whatever the policy says. Re-checked immediately before each call.
PROTECTED = {
    706,                                    # GoldenRazzBerry -- explicit standing instruction
    707, 708,                               # 708 IS GoldenPinapBerry == SILVER PINAP in-game.
                                            # I originally protected only 707, which is the WRONG id.
                                            # It survived purely because KEEP_TO is an allowlist and
                                            # 708 was never in it -- luck, not the guard. Both listed now.
    4,                                      # MasterBall
    301, 302,                               # LuckyEgg, MaxBoost
    401, 406,                               # Incense, Daily Adventure Incense
    501, 502, 503, 504, 505, 506,           # lure modules (TroyDisk*)
    901, 902, 903, 905,                     # incubators
    1301, 1302,                             # RareCandy, XlRareCandy
    1401, 1402, 1404, 1408, 1410, 1411,     # tickets / star piece / currency holders
    1101, 1102, 1103, 1104, 1105, 1106,     # evolution items
    1107, 1150, 1151, 1153, 1154,
    1201, 1202, 1203, 1204, 1250,           # move rerolls (Elite TMs live here)
    1501, 1502, 1503, 1504, 1505, 1506,     # Leader/Giovanni maps, Shadow Gems
    801, 804,                               # SpecialCamera, SoftSfida
    651, 709,                               # Beans, Poffin
}

JS = r"""

function H_(){ if(H)return H; var il=Process.findModuleByName("libil2cpp.so");var e={};
 il.enumerateExports().forEach(function(x){if(x.name.indexOf("il2cpp_")===0)e[x.name]=x.address;});

    turns out to be a required value this returns "threw" rather than discarding anything. */

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--commit", action="store_true", help="actually discard (IRREVERSIBLE)")
    ap.add_argument("--method", default=None, help="recycle method name resolved from the probe")
    ap.add_argument("--arity", type=int, default=3,
                    help="parameter count of the recycle method (probe reported RecycleItem/3)")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    sc = pg.get_script_with_helpers(sess, JS)
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        ib = pg.pick_singleton(sess, "Niantic.Holoholo.Internal", "ItemBagImpl")
        print("ItemBagImpl @", ib)
        print("recycle-ish methods on ItemBagImpl:")
        for x in (sc.exports_sync.recycle_methods(ib) or []):
            print("   ", x)
        print("methods returning RecycleItemOutProto (the real RPC path):")
        for x in (sc.exports_sync.find_recycle_rpc() or ["(none found)"]):
            print("   ", x)

        plan, freed = [], 0
        for item, ceiling in sorted(KEEP_TO.items()):
            if item in PROTECTED:
                continue
            have = sc.exports_sync.count(ib, item)
            if not isinstance(have, int) or have <= 0:
                continue
            if have > ceiling:
                n = have - ceiling
                plan.append((item, have, ceiling, n))
                freed += n

        print()
        print(f"{'item':>6} {'have':>6} {'keep':>6} {'discard':>8}")
        print("-" * 31)
        for item, have, ceiling, n in plan:
            print(f"{item:>6} {have:>6} {ceiling:>6} {n:>8}")
        print("-" * 31)
        print(f"would free: {freed}")

        if not args.commit:
            print()
            print("DRY RUN -- nothing discarded. Re-run with --commit --method <name> to apply.")
            return
        for item, have, ceiling, n in plan:
            if item in PROTECTED:   # re-checked at call time, not just when planning
                print(f"  SKIP protected {item}")
                continue
            r = sc.exports_sync.recycle_real(ib, item, have, n)
            after = sc.exports_sync.count(ib, item)
            print(f"  item {item}: discard {n} -> {r}; now {after}")
    finally:
        try:
            sc.unload()
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
def hav(a, b):
    R = 6371000.0
    dp = math.radians(b[0] - a[0]); dl = math.radians(b[1] - a[1])
    x = math.sin(dp / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(math.radians(a[0])) * math.cos(math.radians(b[0])) * math.sin(dl / 2) ** 2
    return 2 * R * math.asin(min(1, math.sqrt(x)))


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        st = sc.exports_sync.setup()
        print("setup:", st)
        secs = 70
        print(f"\ncollecting {secs}s — WALK normally and let VPGP catch...")
        end = time.time() + secs
        while time.time() < end:
            time.sleep(7)
            sc.exports_sync.reapply()
        r = sc.exports_sync.results()
        rng = sc.exports_sync.read_range()
        sess.detach()
        pos = r["pos"]; tptrs = r["targets"]
        print(f"\nInteractionRangeMeters now: {rng}")
        print(f"visible mons: {len(pos)}   unique Go-Plus targets: {len(tptrs)}")
        if len(pos) < 4:
            print("too few mons — walk more / re-run."); return
        center = (statistics.median([p["lat"] for p in pos.values()]),
                  statistics.median([p["lng"] for p in pos.values()]))
        vis = sorted(hav(center, (p["lat"], p["lng"])) for p in pos.values())
        tgt = sorted(hav(center, (pos[t]["lat"], pos[t]["lng"])) for t in tptrs if t in pos)
        matched = len(tgt)

        def rep(name, ds):
            if not ds:
                print(f"  {name}: none"); return
            print(f"  {name}: n={len(ds)}  median={ds[len(ds)//2]:.0f}m  MAX={max(ds):.0f}m")
        print("\n=== distance from player-center ===")
        rep("VISIBLE", vis)
        rep("GO-PLUS TARGETED", tgt)
        if tgt:
            print(f"     targeted dists: {[round(x) for x in tgt]}")
        if tgt and vis:
            ratio = max(tgt) / max(vis) if max(vis) else 0
            print(f"\n>>> targeted/visible ratio = {ratio:.2f}  (baseline at range=80 was ~0.34)")
            if ratio >= 0.7:
                print("    CONFIRMED: catch reach now tracks visible range — the wider sweep is LIVE.")
            elif matched < 3:
                print("    (too few matched targets for a clean verdict — walk a denser/longer route.)")
            else:
                print("    catch reach still below visible — patch may not be fully effective; re-examine.")
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass
```

```py
function kp(k){var b=[];var t=ptr(k);for(var i=0;i<8;i++){var v=t.and(0xff).toInt32();b.push((v<16?"0":"")+v.toString(16));t=t.shr(8);}return b.join(" ");}

 var h=H_();var k=findClass("holo-protos.dll","ClientMapObjectsInteractionRangeSettingsProto");if(!k)return{err:"no class"};
 var pat=kp(k);var out=[];
 Process.enumerateRanges("rw-").forEach(function(r){if(r.file||r.size<256||r.size>134217728)return;
   try{var hs=Memory.scanSync(r.base,r.size,pat);for(var i=0;i<hs.length&&out.length<60;i++){var p=hs[i].address;
     try{var v=p.add(0x10).readDouble();if(v>10&&v<400)out.push({addr:p.toString(),cur:v});}catch(e){}}}catch(e){}});

"""


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        r = sc.exports_sync.find_instances()
        if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("err"):
            print("ERR:", r["err"]); return
        hits = r.get("hits", [])
        targets = [h for h in hits if 60 <= h["cur"] < 320]  # anything below the 325 target
        print(f"found {len(hits)} instance(s); patching {len(targets)} (InteractionRangeMeters < 320):")
        for h in targets:
            ok = sc.exports_sync.write_d(h["addr"], 0x10, NEW_VAL)
            now = sc.exports_sync.read_d(h["addr"], 0x10)
            print(f"  @{h['addr']}  {h['cur']} -> {now}  (write {'ok' if ok else 'FAIL'})")
        if not targets:
            print(f"  nothing below 320 to patch; current value(s): {[h['cur'] for h in hits]} (already at 325?)."); return
        print(f"\nHOLDING {HOLD_SECS}s — WALK NOW and watch if VPGP catches the far visible mons. Re-applying every 3s...")
        end = time.time() + HOLD_SECS
        reverts = 0
        while time.time() < end:
            time.sleep(3)
            for h in targets:
                cur = sc.exports_sync.read_d(h["addr"], 0x10)
                if cur is not None and abs(cur - NEW_VAL) > 0.5:
                    reverts += 1
                    sc.exports_sync.write_d(h["addr"], 0x10, NEW_VAL)
        print(f"\nheld {HOLD_SECS}s ({reverts} re-applies). InteractionRangeMeters left at {NEW_VAL}.")
        print("Detaching now — the written value persists until the GameMaster re-parses; tell me what you saw.")
        sess.detach()
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
function kp(k){var b=[];var t=ptr(k);for(var i=0;i<8;i++){var v=t.and(0xff).toInt32();b.push((v<16?"0":"")+v.toString(16));t=t.shr(8);}return b.join(" ");}
```

```py
def hav(a, b):
    R = 6371000.0
    dp = math.radians(b[0] - a[0]); dl = math.radians(b[1] - a[1])
    x = math.sin(dp / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(math.radians(a[0])) * math.cos(math.radians(b[0])) * math.sin(dl / 2) ** 2
    return 2 * R * math.asin(min(1, math.sqrt(x)))


def main():
    sess, pid = pg.get_session()
    print("attached", pid)
    try:
        sc = sess.create_script(JS); sc.on("message", lambda m, d: None); sc.load()
        st = sc.exports_sync.setup(NEW_VIS)
        print("setup:", st)
        print(f"\nVISIBLE forced to {NEW_VIS} (holding against SpawnBooster). WALK {HOLD}s. Watch for 'out of range' / far flashes that don't catch...")
        time.sleep(HOLD)
        r = sc.exports_sync.results()
        print("\nreverting (visible -> 140)...")
        sc.exports_sync.revert()
        time.sleep(0.5)
        sess.detach()
        pos = r["pos"]; tptrs = r["targets"]
        print(f"visNow held at: {r['visNow']}")
        print(f"visible mons: {len(pos)}   unique Go-Plus targets: {len(tptrs)}")
        if len(pos) < 4:
            print("too few mons (stationary/backgrounded?) — can't judge."); return
        center = (statistics.median([p["lat"] for p in pos.values()]),
                  statistics.median([p["lng"] for p in pos.values()]))
        vis = sorted(hav(center, (p["lat"], p["lng"])) for p in pos.values())
        tgt = sorted(hav(center, (pos[t]["lat"], pos[t]["lng"])) for t in tptrs if t in pos)
        print(f"\nRENDERED max={max(vis):.0f}m (baseline was ~119-140)   median={vis[len(vis)//2]:.0f}m")
        if tgt:
            print(f"GO-PLUS TARGETED max={max(tgt):.0f}m   dists={[round(x) for x in tgt]}")
        else:
            print("GO-PLUS TARGETED: none matched")
        beyond = [d for d in vis if d > 145]
        print(f"\n>>> mons rendered beyond 145m: {len(beyond)}  ({[round(x) for x in beyond]})")
        if max(vis) > 160:
            print("    visible bump TOOK EFFECT (mons now render past the old ~140 cap).")
            if tgt and max(tgt) > 145:
                print("    Go-Plus IS targeting beyond 140 — check whether those actually CAUGHT or bounced out-of-range.")
        else:
            print("    visible did NOT exceed ~140 — SpawnBooster won the tug-of-war, or no mons exist past 140 server-side.")
    finally:
        try:
            sess.detach()
        except Exception:
            pass


main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Self-contained HTML bag-optimization report for a dex range (one region).
Usage: python gen_region_report.py [lo] [hi] [RegionName]   (default 1 151 'Kanto (Gen 1)')

Trim math is PLAIN-ONLY and bundle-correct: a copy is trimmable only if it is _truly_plain
(no costume / event-bg / art / decoration / Dynamax / Gmax / form-encoded-costume) AND kept
solely by the top-3 cap (`variant_floor` is its only reason). Collectibles are never counted.

REGION = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 'Kanto (Gen 1)'

RM = pr['reasons'] if (isinstance(pr, dict) and isinstance(pr.get('reasons'), dict)) else pr


def reasons(u):
    v = RM.get(u); return v if isinstance(v, list) else []


def tp(r):
    return (not (r['fresh_costume'] or 0) and not (r['special_bg_id'] or 0) and not (r['natural_art_background'] or 0)
            and not (r['costume_decoration_id'] and str(r['costume_decoration_id']) != '0')
            and not evolvable_forms.max_axis(r['fresh_bread_mode']) and not is_costume_form(r['fresh_form']))


allbag = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1").fetchone()['n']
rows = c.execute("SELECT * FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND pokemon_id BETWEEN ? AND ?", (LO, HI)).fetchall()
kept = [r for r in rows if reasons(r['uid_hex'])]


def bucket(r):
    rs = reasons(r['uid_hex'])
    if 'shiny' in rs: return 'Shiny'
    if 'hundo' in rs: return 'Hundo'
    if 'rarity' in rs: return 'Legendary'
    if 'shadow_best' in rs: return 'Shadow'
    if 'xxl' in rs: return 'XXL'
    if 'legacy' in rs: return 'Legacy'
    if any(x in rs for x in ('gl_iv', 'ul_iv', 'pvp_spread', 'pvp_rank', 'pvp_best_gl', 'pvp_best_ul')): return 'PvP'
    if any(x in rs for x in ('nundo', 'best_buddy', 'origin', 'adventure_effect', 'mighty')): return 'Other'
    if not tp(r): return 'Event/Variant'
    if 'dex_only_copy' in rs: return 'Dex-only'
    return 'Plain'


plain = [r for r in kept if tp(r)]
bnd = defaultdict(list)
for r in plain:
    bnd[(r['pokemon_id'], r['form'] or 0)].append(r)
trim2 = defaultdict(list); trim1 = defaultdict(list)
for k, lst in bnd.items():
    lst.sort(key=lambda r: (-(r['iv_total'] or 0), -(r['cp'] or 0)))
    for i, r in enumerate(lst):
        if reasons(r['uid_hex']) == ['variant_floor']:
            if i >= 2: trim2[r['species_name']].append(r)
            if i >= 1: trim1[r['species_name']].append(r)
fodder = sum(1 for r in plain if reasons(r['uid_hex']) == ['variant_floor'] and (r['iv_total'] or 0) < 36)
n2 = sum(len(v) for v in trim2.values()); n1 = sum(len(v) for v in trim1.values())

BUCKETS = ['Shiny', 'Hundo', 'Legendary', 'Shadow', 'XXL', 'Legacy', 'Event/Variant', 'PvP', 'Other', 'Dex-only', 'Plain']
COL = {'Shiny': '#f4c542', 'Hundo': '#e0556a', 'Legendary': '#9b6dff', 'Shadow': '#6b5b95', 'XXL': '#4a90d9',
       'Legacy': '#2bb3a3', 'Event/Variant': '#e066b0', 'PvP': '#5cb85c', 'Other': '#7d8590', 'Dex-only': '#56606b', 'Plain': '#ef8c3b'}
sp = {}
for r in kept:
    d = sp.setdefault(r['species_name'], {'pid': r['pokemon_id'], 'kept': 0, 'b': Counter()})
    d['kept'] += 1; d['b'][bucket(r)] += 1
for s in sp:
    sp[s]['t2'] = len(trim2.get(s, [])); sp[s]['t1'] = len(trim1.get(s, []))
maxk = max((d['kept'] for d in sp.values()), default=1)
rc = Counter(); solo = Counter()
for r in kept:
    rs = reasons(r['uid_hex'])
    for x in rs: rc[x] += 1
    if len(rs) == 1: solo[rs[0]] += 1

E = html.escape
def fname(r):
    return FORM_ENUM.get(r['fresh_form'] or 0) or 'base'

# ---- build HTML ----
rowsh = []
for s, d in sorted(sp.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]['kept']):
    seg = ''
    for b in BUCKETS:
        n = d['b'].get(b, 0)
        if n:
            seg += f'<span class="seg" style="width:{n/maxk*340:.1f}px;background:{COL[b]}" title="{b}: {n}"></span>'
    cand = trim2.get(s, [])
    det = ''
    if cand:
        items = ''.join(f"<tr><td>{(r['iv_total'] or 0)*100//45}%</td><td>{r['iv_atk']}/{r['iv_def']}/{r['iv_sta']}</td><td>{r['cp']}</td><td>{'shadow' if r['fresh_alignment']==1 else ('purified' if r['fresh_alignment']==2 else '')}</td><td>{E(fname(r))}</td></tr>" for r in sorted(cand, key=lambda r:-(r['iv_total'] or 0)))
        det = f'<tr class="detail" id="d{d["pid"]}"><td colspan="7"><b>{E(s)} — {len(cand)} trimmable at top-2 (3rd+ plain, no special trait):</b><table class="mini"><tr><th>IV%</th><th>spread</th><th>CP</th><th>state</th><th>form</th></tr>{items}</table></td></tr>'

    rowsh.append(det)

legend = ''.join(f'<span class="lg"><span class="dot" style="background:{COL[b]}"></span>{b}</span>' for b in BUCKETS)
levers = ''.join(f'<tr><td>{E(x)}</td><td class="num">{rc[x]}</td><td class="num">{solo.get(x,0)}</td></tr>' for x, _ in rc.most_common())

HTML = f"""<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>{E(REGION)} Bag Optimization</title>
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/keep_engine.py`:

```py
"""keep_engine.py -- the SINGLE source of truth that unifies the three systems.

For years there were THREE parallel implementations of "what's worth keeping":
  1. cull_v9.PROTECTION_RULES  (KEEP vs TRANSFER, sanity-gated)
  2. deep_profile's purpose block (COLLECTION / PVP / ... / TRANSFER)
  3. tags/registry.json rules   (the 16 server tags)
They drifted (shadow kept by cull but transferred by purpose; best_buddy column
mismatch; species-top-N sort-key differences; Reserve-tag sync gaps -> ~197 mons
disagreed on 2026-05-28).

THE MODEL: there is ONE keep-reason engine (cull_v9's registry) and THREE VIEWS:
  * CULL view    = transfer iff the reason set is EMPTY.
  * PURPOSE view = the single highest-PRIORITY reason's category.
  * TAG view     = the reasons PoGo can't filter natively (the custom 16 tags).

This module owns the reason -> (purpose, native-filterable?, related tag) mapping
and the purpose-priority collapse. deep_profile imports `classify_purpose`; the
system-map imports `REASON_META`. Change a mapping HERE and all views move together.
"""
import re

# Roles-first priority: an actionable battle/system role outranks passive
# collection; quality reserve outranks trade/junk. Index = priority (lower wins).
PURPOSE_PRIORITY = ['PVP', 'MEGA', 'ADVENTURE', 'MAX', 'COLLECTION', 'RESERVE', 'TRADE', 'TRANSFER']
_PRIO = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(PURPOSE_PRIORITY)}

# Per-reason metadata. Keys are reason PREFIXES (suffixes like _rank3 / _from_x
# / the ll_topN number are normalized away by reason_prefix()).
#   purpose : which PURPOSE view bucket this reason drives
#   native  : True if PoGo's in-game search can already filter it (=> no custom
#             tag needed, per the "only tag what's not native" philosophy)
#   tag     : the related custom server tag, or None
REASON_META = {
    # --- PVP (actionable battle role beats everything) ---
    'gl_top2_pvp':           {'purpose': 'PVP', 'native': False, 'tag': '1 GL IV / 1 GL Meta'},
    'ul_top2_pvp':           {'purpose': 'PVP', 'native': False, 'tag': '1 UL IV / 1 UL Meta'},
    'll_top':                {'purpose': 'PVP', 'native': False, 'tag': None},  # ll_topN collapses here
    # --- MEGA ---
    'current_mega_evolved':  {'purpose': 'MEGA', 'native': True,  'tag': '2 Mega'},
    'has_mega_level':        {'purpose': 'MEGA', 'native': False, 'tag': '2 Mega'},
    # --- ADVENTURE (only mons with CHARGES remaining are an actionable AE role;
    #     being an AE *species* is just a cull protection -> its purpose is the
    #     mon's collection/role value, usually COLLECTION as a legendary). ---
    'adventure_effect_uses':    {'purpose': 'ADVENTURE',  'native': True, 'tag': None},
    'adventure_effect_species': {'purpose': 'COLLECTION', 'native': True, 'tag': None},
    # --- MAX (Dynamax / Gigantamax) ---
    'bread':                 {'purpose': 'MAX', 'native': True, 'tag': None},
    # --- COLLECTION (passive keep-forever) ---
    'hundo':                 {'purpose': 'COLLECTION', 'native': False, 'tag': '4 Hundo'},
    'nundo':                 {'purpose': 'COLLECTION', 'native': False, 'tag': '4 Nundo'},
    'shiny_top5':            {'purpose': 'COLLECTION', 'native': True,  'tag': None},
    'shiny_protected_chain': {'purpose': 'COLLECTION', 'native': True,  'tag': None},
    'shiny_3star+':          {'purpose': 'COLLECTION', 'native': True,  'tag': None},
    'legendary':             {'purpose': 'COLLECTION', 'native': True,  'tag': None},
    'mythical':              {'purpose': 'COLLECTION', 'native': True,  'tag': None},
    'ultra_beast':           {'purpose': 'COLLECTION', 'native': True,  'tag': None},

# user_tag_<name> reasons: purpose derived from the tag's number-prefix scheme
# (1=PvP 2=Raid/Mega 3=Keep 4=Collection 5=Origin 6=Sort). A mon usually also
# carries the INTRINSIC reason (hundo, legendary, ...), which wins on priority;
# the user_tag is the fallback so a hand-tagged mon still gets a sensible purpose.
_TAGNUM_PURPOSE = {'1': 'PVP', '2': 'MEGA', '3': 'RESERVE', '4': 'COLLECTION',
                   '5': 'COLLECTION', '6': 'RESERVE'}
_SPECIAL_TAG_PURPOSE = {'6 trade': 'TRADE'}  # 6 Reserve -> RESERVE (default), 6 Trade -> TRADE


def reason_prefix(reason):
    """Normalize a raw cull reason string to its mapping key."""
    if reason.startswith('ll_top'):
        return 'll_top'
    if reason.startswith('user_tag_'):
        return 'user_tag'
    # strip trailing _rankN, _<digits>, _from_<owner>
    return re.sub(r'_(rank\d+|\d+|from_.*)$', '', reason)


def _reason_purpose(reason):
    """Purpose category a single reason maps to (None if unknown)."""
    if reason.startswith('user_tag_'):
        name = reason[len('user_tag_'):].strip()
        low = name.lower()
        if low in _SPECIAL_TAG_PURPOSE:
            return _SPECIAL_TAG_PURPOSE[low]
        digit = name[:1]
        return _TAGNUM_PURPOSE.get(digit, 'RESERVE')
    meta = REASON_META.get(reason_prefix(reason))
    return meta['purpose'] if meta else None


def classify_purpose(reasons, ivt=0):
    """Collapse a mon's keep-reason list to ONE purpose (the single view).

    reasons : list returned by cull_v9.is_protected(p, ctx)
    ivt     : iv_total, used only to split an unprotected mon into TRADE vs TRANSFER.

    Empty reasons -> TRADE (decent-IV dupe worth trading) or TRANSFER (junk).
    Otherwise -> the highest-PRIORITY purpose among the reasons.
    """
    if not reasons:
        return 'TRADE' if (ivt or 0) >= 37 else 'TRANSFER'
    best = None
    for r in reasons:
        pur = _reason_purpose(r)
        if pur is None:
            continue
        if best is None or _PRIO[pur] < _PRIO[best]:
            best = pur
    return best or 'RESERVE'  # protected but unmapped reason -> conservative keep


def purpose_of(p, ctx, cull):
    """Convenience: reasons + purpose for a cull-format row `p`.

    cull is the imported cull_v9 module (passed in to avoid a hard import cycle).
    Returns (reasons_list, purpose_str).
    """
    reasons = cull.is_protected(p, ctx)
    return reasons, classify_purpose(reasons, p['iv_total'] if 'iv_total' in p.keys() else 0)
```

```py
def _ae_ids_live():
    """Adventure-Effect roster = keep_config hand list UNION the species derived from the GAME'S OWN registry.

    User 2026-09-08: the roster "should be scanned every time". pogo_pipeline reads
    AdventureEffectService.adventureEffects in-walk -> system/analysis/ae_registry_live.json;
    system/scripts/derive_ae_roster.py turns it into system/analysis/ae_roster_derived.json. On 2026-09-08 the

    protection, never remove it, so a stale or missing derived file degrades to the hand list -- fail-soft.

        import json as _j, time as _t

        if os.path.exists(_p) and (_t.time() - os.path.getmtime(_p)) < 14 * 86400:

            extra = {int(x) for x in _d.get('species', [])} - ids
            if extra:
                print('[adventure_effect] live registry adds %s to the configured roster %s' % (sorted(extra), sorted(ids)))
            ids |= {int(x) for x in _d.get('species', [])}
    except Exception as _e:                                   # fail-soft: hand list only
        print('[adventure_effect] derived roster unreadable (%s) -- using keep_config list only' % _e)
    return ids

def topn(rows, n, bg_first=False, look=None):
    # uid as final tiebreak: stat-identical dupes otherwise fall to SQLite rowid order, which a recrawl
    # can reshuffle -- the irreversible Transfer membership must be reproducible run-to-run (audit F25).
    # COLLECTION FLOOR (user 2026-09-24 "thats the floor now"): every capped collection ladder that ranks by IV --
    # plain, costume / Max variants, legendary top-N, legacy fill, location cards, the card comb-up, the evolve
    # surplus list -- drops a copy under keep_config.collection_floor_iv (25%) unless it is the ladder's best.
    # keep_config.floor_top is the ONE implementation, shared with audit_cull / _lawcheck / preflight_transfer.
    # bg_first (2026-09-24): a COSTUME ladder puts its background copies first (costume_forms.backgrounds_first).
    # look (2026-10-25): a CARD ladder keeps each look's best under the floor too (keep_config.card_look).
    _s = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (-(r['iv_total'] or 0), -(r['cp'] or 0), r['uid_hex']))
    return keep_config.floor_top(costume_forms.backgrounds_first(_s) if bg_first else _s, look=look)[:n]


# Field separator for db_content_sha256(). chr(0x1f) = ASCII UNIT SEPARATOR: repr() escapes every
# control character, so this byte can never occur inside a rendered value and the join is
# unambiguous. Written as chr() rather than an escape so the source carries no literal control
# byte and no editor/heredoc can silently change what the separator IS.
_DBHASH_SEP = chr(0x1f)


def db_content_sha256(src):
    """CONTENT hash of the pokemon-table snapshot a pile was computed from -- THE one definition.

    Producer: keep_policy (stamped into system/analysis/pile_provenance.json as 'db_content_sha256').
    Consumer: audit_invariants.py, staleness family. Producer and consumer MUST derive the SAME digest
    for the same snapshot or the check inverts into a permanent false alarm, so this is ONE shared
    function -- import it, do not re-derive it:   from keep_policy import db_content_sha256
    (Same pattern, and same reason, as keep_config.fingerprint() for config_sha256.)

    WHY: provenance identified the database by db_mtime/db_size alone. Those are FILESYSTEM facts, not
    content facts. pokemon.db runs in WAL mode, so the main file is rewritten by a CHECKPOINT -- which
    fires whenever the last connection closes on a non-empty WAL, i.e. routinely, several times an hour
    with the dashboard and the autocull daemon both polling -- and its mtime moves without one
    pile-relevant value changing. MEASURED 2026-09-03 on a copy of the live bag: a write that changed
    ZERO values moved mtime 1788410388.116460 -> 1788410390.192748 with the size byte-identical, so a
    mtime/size consumer calls a perfectly current pile STALE. Size fails the other way too -- an
    in-place UPDATE leaves it identical, so it cannot see a real change (same run: one cp value +1 left
    the size at 19402752). Neither is a statement about the ROWS. This is: in that same run the digest
    held across the no-op write and moved only for the single real value.

    ALGORITHM -- canonical; any independent implementation must reproduce it EXACTLY:
      rows    : every row of `SELECT * FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1` -- precisely the set this engine
                judges, so the hash covers the pile's real dependency and nothing else
      order   : rows ascending by uid_hex
      columns : every ENGINE-INPUT column, sorted by NAME -- never SELECT *'s positional order, which
                a harmless schema migration reshuffles without changing one value. Pipeline OUTPUT
                columns are excluded (see _OUTPUT_COLS below): they are written downstream of the
                stamp and are not inputs to any keep decision
      value   : repr(v) of the raw sqlite value (None / int / float / str / bytes). repr escapes every
                control character, so the separator below can never occur INSIDE a rendered value
      join    : all values of all rows, flattened, joined by chr(0x1f), the ASCII UNIT SEPARATOR
      digest  : sha256 of that string, encoded utf-8
    Deliberately NOT included: file mtime, file size, row count, and any column-name header -- content
    only, so the digest is identical across processes, machines and WAL checkpoints for identical rows.

    `src` is either an open sqlite3.Connection (the SELECT is run on it) or an already-fetched list of
    sqlite3.Row / dict. keep_policy passes its OWN `rows` -- the literal snapshot that produced the
    pile -- so the stamp can never describe a different read than the one the engine actually judged.
    """
    import hashlib
    if hasattr(src, 'execute'):                      # a live connection: read the same set the engine reads
        _cur = src.execute("SELECT * FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1")
        _cols = [d[0] for d in _cur.description]
        recs = [dict(zip(_cols, tuple(t))) for t in _cur.fetchall()]
    else:
        recs = [keep_config.row_dict(r) for r in src]
    # EXCLUDE PIPELINE OUTPUT COLUMNS. The hash must cover the engine's INPUTS -- the bag facts the
    # keep decision is derived from -- and nothing the pipeline itself writes downstream of the
    # stamp. auth_tag_names is the tag MIRROR: set_db_tags_from_files writes it during SYNC, which
    # runs AFTER keep_policy stamps provenance, so including it made every SUCCESSFUL sync
    # invalidate the stamp it had just passed. MEASURED 2026-09-06 against the pre-sync snapshot:
    # the daemon's 23:50 cull synced, and the very next audit BLOCKed with a content mismatch whose
    # ENTIRE cause was auth_tag_names on 4,614 rows -- same 5,747 mons, 0 added, 0 removed, not one
    # bag fact changed. keep_policy reads this column ZERO times, so it cannot alter a decision.
    # This is the WAL/mtime lesson one level in: a gate that fires on the pipeline's own legitimate
    # write is noise, and a noisy gate on an IRREVERSIBLE output is worse than no gate, because it
    # trains everyone to wave it through. Add a column here ONLY if the engine never reads it AND
    # the sanctioned pipeline writes it after the stamp; anything else belongs in the digest.
    # NOTE: changing this set changes the digest -- re-run keep_policy to re-stamp, or the stored
    # stamp (computed under the old set) mismatches and reads as staleness.
    _OUTPUT_COLS = {'auth_tag_names'}
    cols = sorted(k for k in recs[0].keys() if k not in _OUTPUT_COLS) if recs else []
    parts = []
    for rec in sorted(recs, key=lambda d: d['uid_hex']):
        for k in cols:
            parts.append(repr(rec[k]))
    return hashlib.sha256(_DBHASH_SEP.join(parts).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()

def build_evo_graph(gm, seen_pids, with_all=False):
    """FORM-AWARE evolution graph keyed by speciesId so REGIONAL families resolve their OWN
    evolutions (Galarian Zigzagoon->Linoone->Obstagoon; Hisuian Sneasel->Sneasler, NOT Weavile).
    The old dex-keyed version picked one base speciesId per dex, so every regional pre-evo routed
    through the base form's family (wrong/empty terminal). A 'family' evolution counts ONLY if:
      (1) the TARGET is in the live dex (seen_pids) -- pvpoke lists evolutions PoGo hasn't enabled
```
