`pogo_extract/system/scripts/refresh_gamemaster.py`:

```py
"""refresh_gamemaster.py -- pull PvPoke's current game master, diff it, recompute every rank, and
REFUSE to leave a silently-changed pile behind.

WHY (user, 2026-09-08): "This should be checked often, at least once a month." pvpoke_gamemaster.json is
the base-stat source for EVERY PvP rank this project culls on, and it had gone 85 days without a
producer script. A species added or rebalanced upstream is simply missing/wrong here until refreshed.

WHAT IT DOES
  1. downloads https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pvpoke/pvpoke/master/src/data/gamemaster.json
  2. diffs it against the local file: species added/removed, base-stat changes, movepool changes
  3. backs up the local file (pvpoke_gamemaster.json.bak-<date>) and installs the new one
  4. recomputes every rank via system/scripts/rank_cache.py (offline -- no phone)
  5. reports every in-bag row that CROSSED the READY_RANK (<=5) protection line in either direction,
     and every row whose ranks went NULL (an unresolvable species = the Mudbray failure class)
  6. exits 0 when nothing crossed; exits 2 when something did or went NULL -- so a caller (full_audit)
     stops BEFORE any sync and a human looks. It never touches the phone and never edits the pile.

  --check-only   : just report the file's age and whether it is older than MAX_AGE_DAYS (exit 3 if so)
  --force        : refresh even if the file is younger than MAX_AGE_DAYS
  --ack          : a human has reviewed the rows a refresh moved across the keep line -- clear the stop. Until then
                   EVERY run exits 2 (system/analysis/gamemaster_review_pending.json), whatever the file's age. For a
                   refresh that died between installing the new file and diffing it, --ack ROLLS IT BACK instead (the
                   backup keeps its old mtime, so the next run downloads and diffs again).
  --accept-smaller: ONLY on Benny's word. A new client game master the content canary refused as damaged (a count under 90%
                   of the installed file's; audit I2.7 WARNs "REJECTED ... looks damaged") is let through to every other
                   check: a genuine format change also drops counts (2021-11: 20% fewer forms). Its loaders, keep-verdict
                   flips and review stop still apply.

Rank changes are expected and fine (a rebalanced species re-ranks); a change that moves a mon ACROSS
the keep line is the only thing that matters, and the pile gate (keep_policy -> preflight) still stands
behind this script -- it is a tripwire, not the gate.

THE CLIENT GAME MASTER (gamemaster_pokeminers.json), 2026-09-30: pokeminers_phase() runs on EVERY run -- it asks
PokeMiners' 13-byte latest/timestamp.txt, not the 30-day pvpoke clock. A NEW batch is downloaded, DIFFED and judged against
the bags (the active account's and every resting account's parked one: the file is shared) BEFORE it is installed
(gm_guard.assess reuses detect_legacy's pool functions, evolvable_forms, size_line (the size numbers and types an
XXL keep is scored by), costume_forms (a form the batch flags or unflags isCostume), isTradable, isTransferable and the
rarity classes): if any in-bag keep verdict flips it is HELD, not installed (gamemaster_pokeminers.pending.json beside the
installed file), the SAME review record is written and the run exits 2: --ack installs exactly the held bytes (dated backup +
stamp), --reject keeps the installed file and declines that batch -- both only on Benny's word; a candidate the engine cannot load, or one under 90% of the installed file on any
of gm_guard.content_counts' 14 structural counts, is never installed. Ids a batch prints as enum NUMBERS are named on
download (gm_guard.normalize_file), before it is judged, stamped or installed.
The batch is stamped in gamemaster_pokeminers.json.meta (batch time, APK, sha256) for audit_invariants I2.7.
  --selftest     : offline proof of all of it on synthetic fixtures (touches nothing outside a temp dir)
An unknown flag stops the run with exit 2 and does NOTHING (like full_audit.py).
"""
import sys, os, json, shutil, sqlite3, subprocess, time, urllib.request
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, '..', '..'))
GM = os.path.join(ROOT, 'pvpoke_gamemaster.json')
DL_STAMP = GM + '.downloaded'                 # {'ts': epoch} of the last DOWNLOAD installed (H04-11)
DB = os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db')
URL = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pvpoke/pvpoke/master/src/data/gamemaster.json'
PM = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(GM), 'gamemaster_pokeminers.json')   # the CLIENT game master: per-form evolvability, AE moves
PM_META = PM + '.meta'      # gm_guard's stamp of the installed batch (DATA: tools/data_manifest.txt [inventory] must carry it)
# pvpoke's META rankings (2026-09-29): the top-N gate for Power Up / Unlock 2nd Move (granular_tags.meta_top). Same monthly
# clock as the game master; pvpoke re-cuts them at season and move changes.
RANK_URL = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pvpoke/pvpoke/master/src/data/rankings/all/overall/rankings-%d.json'
RANK_DIR = os.path.join(ROOT, 'system', 'analysis', 'pvpoke_rankings')
RANK_CAPS = (1500, 2500, 10000)
# THE STOP MUST OUTLIVE THE PASS THAT RAISED IT (2026-09-29, H04). Exit 2 ("keep decisions moved -- do NOT sync until
# reviewed") was re-derived from the file's AGE on the very next run: the refresh had just installed a fresh
# pvpoke_gamemaster.json, so the next full_audit printed "fresh enough -- nothing to do", exited 0 and recrawled + synced
# on the unreviewed ranks. The crossing is recorded here; every run exits 2 until a human clears it with --ack.
REVIEW = os.path.join(ROOT, 'system', 'analysis', 'gamemaster_review_pending.json')


def _write_review(rec):
    """Atomically (re)write the pending-review record; False when it could not be written."""
    try:
        with open(REVIEW + '.tmp', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as _f:
            json.dump(rec, _f, indent=1)
        os.replace(REVIEW + '.tmp', REVIEW)
        return True
    except OSError as _e:
        print('!! could not write %s (%s)' % (REVIEW, _e))
        return False


def _clear_review():
    try:
        os.remove(REVIEW)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass


def review_gate(argv):
    """None = no review pending (carry on); else the exit code. --ack clears a pending review (exit 0) -- or, for a
    refresh that died between install and diff ('in progress'), rolls the install back (R-B review)."""
    pend = None
    if os.path.exists(REVIEW):
        try:
            pend = json.load(open(REVIEW, encoding='utf-8'))
        except Exception as e:                  # unreadable is still pending: fail closed
            pend = {'since': '? (unreadable: %s)' % e}
        if not isinstance(pend, dict):          # a null / list record is still a pending file: fail closed (R-B review --
            pend = {'since': '? (malformed record: %r)' % (pend,)}   # 'null' passed the gate, '[]' crashed it with rc 1)
    _interrupted = pend is not None and pend.get('status') == 'in progress'
    _held = pend is not None and pend.get('target') == 'pokeminers' and bool(pend.get('staged'))
    if '--reject' in argv:                      # 2026-09-30: decline a HELD client game master (only on Benny's word)
        if not _held:
            print('--reject: %s' % ('no game-master review was pending' if pend is None else
                  'this review is not a held client game master (a pvpoke rank crossing or an interrupted refresh) -- review '
                  'it, then --ack'))
            return 0 if pend is None else 2
        return _pm_reject(pend)
    if '--ack' in argv and _held:
        return _pm_accept(pend)
    if '--ack' in argv:
        if pend is None:
            print('--ack: no game-master review was pending')
            return 0
        if _interrupted:
            # nothing was diffed, so there is nothing to acknowledge: put the previous file back. copy2 keeps its OLD
            # mtime, so the next run downloads again, diffs it and records any crossing
            _dst = PM if pend.get('target') == 'pokeminers' else GM      # the record says WHICH file its backup belongs to
            _bak = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(_dst), pend.get('backup') or '?')
            if not os.path.exists(_bak):
                print('--ack: the interrupted refresh names no usable backup (%s) -- restore %s by '
                      'hand, then delete %s' % (pend.get('backup'), os.path.basename(_dst), REVIEW))
                return 2
            shutil.copy2(_bak, _dst)
            print('--ack: the interrupted %s refresh was rolled back to %s; the next run refreshes and diffs again'
                  % (pend.get('since'), pend.get('backup')))
        _clear_review()
        print('game-master review acknowledged (pending since %s: %d crossed, %d NULL) -- culls may continue'
              % (pend.get('since'), len(pend.get('crossed') or []), len(pend.get('nulled') or [])))
        return 0
    if pend is None:
        return None
    if _interrupted:
        print('The %s refresh stopped after installing the new game master and BEFORE its rank changes were diffed '
              '(killed / timed out) -- nothing may sync on ranks nobody compared.' % pend.get('since'))
    else:
        for l in (pend.get('lines') or [])[:40]:
            print('   ' + l)
        print(pend.get('headline') or
              'The %s refresh moved keep decisions across the rank<=%d line; nothing may sync until a human has reviewed them.'
              % (pend.get('since'), READY_RANK))
    print('   rows: %s -- %s' % (os.path.relpath(REVIEW, ROOT),
          'install the HELD game master: python system/scripts/refresh_gamemaster.py --ack | keep the installed one: --reject'
          if _held else 'clear it (an interrupted refresh: roll it back) with: python system/scripts/refresh_gamemaster.py --ack'))
    print('REVIEW PENDING since %s (%s): after review run refresh_gamemaster.py --ack'
          % (str(pend.get('since'))[:16], 'interrupted refresh' if _interrupted else '%d crossed, %d NULL' % (
              len(pend.get('crossed') or []), len(pend.get('nulled') or []))))
    return 2


def refresh_rankings(top_n=None):
    """Download the three ranking files; keep the old one on any doubt (fewer than 300 entries, no 'score'). Prints what
    moved in and out of the top-N -- the exact set the dust advice reads."""
    os.makedirs(RANK_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    if top_n is None:
        sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
        import keep_config as _kc
        top_n = max(_kc.pvp('power_up_meta_top'), _kc.pvp('unlock_meta_top')) or 200
    for cap in RANK_CAPS:
        dst = os.path.join(RANK_DIR, 'rankings-%d.json' % cap)
        tmp = dst + '.download'
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(RANK_URL % cap, timeout=60) as r, open(tmp, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(r.read())
            new = json.load(open(tmp, encoding='utf-8'))
            if not isinstance(new, list) or len(new) < 300 or 'score' not in new[0] or 'speciesId' not in new[0]:
                raise ValueError('unexpected shape (%s entries)' % (len(new) if isinstance(new, list) else '?'))
            top = lambda d: {x['speciesId'] for x in sorted(d, key=lambda x: -(x.get('score') or 0))[:top_n]}
            old = json.load(open(dst, encoding='utf-8')) if os.path.exists(dst) else []
            a, b = top(old), top(new)
            os.replace(tmp, dst)
            print('rankings-%d.json: %d entries | top-%d: +%d %s -%d %s' % (
                cap, len(new), top_n, len(b - a), sorted(b - a)[:10], len(a - b), sorted(a - b)[:10]))
        except Exception as e:
            print('rankings-%d.json: DOWNLOAD FAILED (%s) -- local file left untouched' % (cap, e))
            if os.path.exists(tmp):
                os.remove(tmp)


_PM_NOTE = ['']         # the client-game-master half of the ONE line main() ends with: full_audit shows only a run's LAST line, cut at 110


def _pm_ident(m):
    return ('%s%s' % (m['batch_utc'][:10], (' APK %s' % m['apk']) if m.get('apk') else '')) if m else 'unstamped'


def _pm_engine_inputs():
    """(move_map, form enum) every client-GM verdict is judged with. Raises when unreadable (the caller STOPs)."""
    mm = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'move_id_to_name.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    en = {int(k): v for k, v in json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'form_enum.json'), encoding='utf-8')).items()}
    return mm, en


def _pm_stop(gg, res, reason, bak=None, old_meta=None, new_meta=None, **held):
    """Write the SAME review record the pvpoke crossing writes (extra keys are ignored by review_gate / full_audit). `held`
    (a FLIPS since 2026-09-30): staged / batch_ts / meta_new / gm_path / meta_path -- what --ack installs and --reject declines."""
    crossed = sorted({f['uid'] for f in res.get('flips') or []})
    nulled = sorted(res.get('nulled') or [])
    lines = gg.review_lines(res, old_meta, new_meta, bak) if res.get('flips') or res.get('nulled') else [reason]
    shown = gg.review_lines(res, old_meta, new_meta, bak, with_digest=False) if res.get('flips') or res.get('nulled') else [reason]
    rec = {'since': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), 'kind': 'client_gm', 'target': 'pokeminers', 'reason': reason,
           'headline': 'The %s client game master check stopped the pass: %s. Nothing may sync until a human has reviewed it.'
                       % (time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'), reason),
           'crossed': crossed, 'nulled': nulled, 'backup': os.path.basename(bak) if bak else None, 'lines': lines[:500],
           'old': old_meta and {k: old_meta.get(k) for k in ('batch_utc', 'apk', 'sha256')},
           'new': new_meta and {k: new_meta.get(k) for k in ('batch_utc', 'apk', 'sha256')},
           'axes': res.get('axes') or {}, 'flips': (res.get('flips') or [])[:500]}
    if held.get('staged'):
        say = ('HELD, NOT INSTALLED: %s waits beside the installed file -- refresh_gamemaster.py --ack installs it (dated backup + '
               'stamp), --reject keeps the installed file and declines this batch' % held['staged'])
        lines, shown = lines[:1] + [say] + lines[1:], shown[:1] + [say] + shown[1:]
        rec['lines'] = lines[:500]
        rec.update(held)
    return _write_review(rec), shown


def _pm_accept(pend):
    """--ack on a HELD client game master (2026-09-30): install exactly the judged bytes (dated backup + stamp; the next run
    owes the reconcile + rank pass). A held file that is gone (another machine held it) or changed installs NOTHING: the record
    is cleared and the next run downloads and judges the batch again."""
    if ROOT not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
    import gm_guard as gg
    gm_path = pend.get('gm_path') if pend.get('gm_path') and os.path.exists(os.path.dirname(pend['gm_path'])) else PM
    meta_path = pend.get('meta_path') if pend.get('meta_path') and os.path.exists(os.path.dirname(pend['meta_path'])) else PM_META
    staged = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(gm_path), os.path.basename(pend['staged']))
    want = (pend.get('meta_new') or {}).get('sha256')
    try:
        judged = bool(want) and os.path.exists(staged) and gg.sha256_file(staged) == want
    except OSError:
        judged = False
    if not judged:
        _clear_review()
        print('--ack: the held game master %s is missing here or is not the judged bytes -- NOTHING installed; the next run '
              'downloads and judges that batch again' % os.path.basename(staged))
        return 0
    bak = gg.next_backup_path(gm_path)
    try:
        shutil.copy2(gm_path, bak)
        if os.path.exists(meta_path):
            shutil.copy2(meta_path, meta_path + '.bak-' + os.path.basename(bak).split('.bak-', 1)[1])
        os.replace(staged, gm_path)                          # atomic; the previous file is the backup above
    except OSError as e:
        print('--ack: NOT installed (%s) -- the installed game master stays and the review stays pending' % e)
        return 2
    if not gg.write_meta(meta_path, dict(pend.get('meta_new') or {}, tail_pending=True)):
        print('--ack: installed, but %s could not be written -- the next run re-adopts it' % os.path.basename(meta_path))
    _clear_review()
    print('--ack: installed the held client game master (batch %s); previous file kept as %s. The next cull reconciles and '
          're-ranks on it' % ((pend.get('new') or {}).get('batch_utc'), os.path.basename(bak)))
    return 0


def _pm_reject(pend):
    """--reject on a HELD client game master (2026-09-30): drop the held file, keep the installed one, and stamp the batch as
    DECLINED so no run downloads it again (a newer batch is judged as usual; --force re-judges this one)."""
    if ROOT not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
    import gm_guard as gg
    gm_path = pend.get('gm_path') if pend.get('gm_path') and os.path.exists(os.path.dirname(pend['gm_path'])) else PM
    meta_path = pend.get('meta_path') if pend.get('meta_path') and os.path.exists(os.path.dirname(pend['meta_path'])) else PM_META
    staged = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(gm_path), os.path.basename(pend['staged']))
    try:
        if os.path.exists(staged):
            os.remove(staged)
    except OSError as e:
        print('--reject: could not delete %s (%s) -- delete it by hand' % (os.path.basename(staged), e))
    meta, pinned = gg.read_meta(meta_path), False
    if meta:
        meta['declined'] = {'batch_ts': pend.get('batch_ts'), 'batch_utc': (pend.get('new') or {}).get('batch_utc'),
                            'at': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}
        pinned = gg.write_meta(meta_path, meta)
    _clear_review()
    print('--reject: kept the installed client game master; batch %s %s' % (
        (pend.get('new') or {}).get('batch_utc'),
        'is declined (a newer batch is judged as usual; refresh_gamemaster.py --force re-judges this one)' if pinned else
        'could NOT be marked declined (no writable stamp) -- the next run downloads it and stops on it again'))
    return 0


def pokeminers_phase(argv, fetch=None, now=None, gm_path=None, meta_path=None, db_path=None):
    """THE CLIENT GAME MASTER GUARD (2026-09-30) -> (rc, tail). rc None = carry on, 2 = a review is pending (the record is
    written), 1 = a new batch could not be installed safely. tail = a new client game master is installed (or owes its
    reconcile + rank pass): main() must run the pvpoke half even though its own 30-day clock has not run out.
      1. ask upstream's 13-byte latest/timestamp.txt -- EVERY run, no throttle (a monthly clock would leave a new batch
         unreviewed for weeks; the question costs 13 bytes and a failure is a WARN, never a stop)
      2. same batch and an unaltered file -> nothing to download (only the check time is stamped); an OLDER upstream batch
         (a stale edge or a rollback) is never installed over a newer one
      3. else download, then assess() against the bag BEFORE anything is installed:
           SAME            identical bytes: adopt the stamp (the file was installed before gm_guard existed)
           UNREADABLE_NEW  never installed, the installed file stays, WARN
           STOP            the baseline / the bag / a verdict cannot be read: nothing installed, record, rc 2
           CLEAR           dated backup, atomic install (of exactly the bytes that were judged), stamp
           FLIPS           HELD as <name>.pending.json + the record, NOTHING installed, rc 2: --ack installs the held bytes
                           (dated backup + stamp + the owed reconcile/rank pass), --reject declines the batch (2026-09-30)
           a DECLINED batch (meta 'declined', written by --reject) is never downloaded again; a newer one is judged as usual"""
    if ROOT not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
    import gm_guard as gg
    gm_path, meta_path, db_path = gm_path or PM, meta_path or PM_META, db_path or DB
    fetch = fetch or gg.http_get
    now = time.time() if now is None else now
    meta = gg.read_meta(meta_path)
    state = gg.local_state(gm_path, meta)
    tail = bool(meta and meta.get('tail_pending'))
    ups, errs = {}, []
    for name, (ts_url, _j, parse) in gg.SOURCES.items():      # BOTH upstreams (2026-11-03): the newer batch is the one judged
        try:
            ups[name] = parse(fetch(ts_url + '?cb=%d' % now, 15))
        except Exception as e:
            errs.append('%s: %s' % (name, e))
    if not ups:
        print('WARN pokeminers: cannot read either upstream timestamp (%s) -- the client game master is left as it is' % '; '.join(errs))
        _PM_NOTE[0] = 'pokeminers %s: NOT checked (upstream unreachable)' % _pm_ident(meta)
        return None, tail
    src = max(ups, key=lambda k: ups[k])
    up_ts, (ts_url, json_url, parse) = ups[src], gg.SOURCES[src]
    if state == 'ok' and up_ts < meta['batch_ts']:
        # NEVER A DOWNGRADE (2026-09-30): batches only move forward. An OLDER timestamp is a stale CDN edge or a rollback --
        # installing it would put the previous batch back and stop the pass twice (now, and again when the edge heals)
        print("WARN pokeminers: upstream's latest batch (%s UTC) is OLDER than the installed one (%s UTC) -- a stale edge or a "
              "rollback; nothing downloaded, the installed client game master stays" % (gg._utc(up_ts / 1000.0), meta.get('batch_utc', '?')))
        _PM_NOTE[0] = 'pokeminers %s: upstream is OLDER, kept' % _pm_ident(meta)
        return None, tail
    _dec = (meta or {}).get('declined') if state == 'ok' else None
    if _dec and _dec.get('batch_ts') == up_ts and '--force' not in argv:
        # DECLINED (--reject, 2026-09-30): the owner kept the installed file over this batch; asking again every run would stop
        # every cull on the same rows. A NEWER batch is judged as usual; --force re-judges this one.
        print('pokeminers: batch %s UTC was declined (--reject, %s) -- the installed client game master stays; a newer batch is '
              'judged as usual' % (gg._utc(up_ts / 1000.0), _dec.get('at', '?')))
        _PM_NOTE[0] = 'pokeminers %s kept (batch %s declined)' % (_pm_ident(meta), gg._utc(up_ts / 1000.0)[:10])
        return None, tail
    if state == 'ok' and meta['batch_ts'] == up_ts and '--force' not in argv:
        meta['checked_ts'], meta['checked_at'], meta['upstream_ts'] = int(now), gg._utc(now), up_ts
        meta.pop('rejected', None)                           # upstream's newest IS what is installed: nothing is rejected any more
        if meta.get('apk') is None and meta.get('source', 'pokeminers') == 'pokeminers':   # retried every run until it answers
            meta['apk'], meta['folder'] = gg.lookup_apk(up_ts, fetch)
        if not gg.write_meta(meta_path, meta):
            print('WARN pokeminers: could not update %s (read-only?) -- its check time stays old' % os.path.basename(meta_path))
        _PM_NOTE[0] = 'pokeminers %s = upstream latest' % _pm_ident(meta)
        print('pokeminers: batch %s (%s UTC) is upstream\'s latest -- nothing to download' % (_pm_ident(meta), meta['batch_utc']))
        return None, tail
    print('pokeminers: %s -- downloading batch %s UTC from %s to judge it against the bag'
          % ({'no-file': 'no local file', 'no-meta': 'the installed file has no stamp yet',
              'sha-mismatch': 'the installed file is not the one its stamp describes'}.get(
                  state, 're-checking (--force)' if '--force' in argv and meta and meta['batch_ts'] == up_ts else 'a NEW batch upstream'),
             gg._utc(up_ts / 1000.0), src))
    tmp = gm_path + '.download'

    def _drop():
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.remove(tmp)
    try:
        body = fetch(json_url + '?cb=%d' % now, 180)
        if parse(fetch(ts_url + '?cb=%d' % (now + 1), 15)) != up_ts:
            raise ValueError('upstream published while it was downloading; retried next run')
        with open(tmp, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(body)
    except Exception as e:
        _drop()
        print('WARN pokeminers: download failed (%s) -- the client game master is left as it is' % e)
        _PM_NOTE[0] = 'pokeminers %s: download FAILED, kept' % _pm_ident(meta)
        return None, tail
    # IDS AS NUMBERS (2026-09-30): 0.381.2 / 0.395.1 printed some ids as enum numbers (form 3290, pokemonId 1009); every reader
    # keys on names, so they are named HERE, before the file is judged, stamped or installed (tested lossless on those batches)
    try:
        _en = _pm_engine_inputs()[1]
    except Exception:
        _en = {}                                             # assess() STOPs on the unreadable enum below; names come from the batch
    try:
        named, left = gg.normalize_file(tmp, _en, gm_path if state != 'no-file' else None)
    except Exception as e:
        _drop()
        print('WARN pokeminers: the downloaded batch could not be rewritten with names (%s) -- the client game master is left as it is' % e)
        _PM_NOTE[0] = 'pokeminers %s: new batch NOT judged, kept' % _pm_ident(meta)
        return None, tail
    if named or left:
        print('pokeminers: the batch prints %d id(s) as enum numbers: %d named (its own templates, the installed file, the form enum)%s'
              % (named + left, named, '; %d left as numbers (nothing names them: they read as unknown)' % left if left else ''))
    res = gg.assess(gm_path, tmp, lambda: gg.load_bag(db_path), lambda: _pm_engine_inputs()[0], lambda: _pm_engine_inputs()[1],
                    canary='--accept-smaller' not in argv)
    v = res['verdict']
    if res.get('drops') and '--accept-smaller' in argv:
        print('pokeminers: --accept-smaller: the content canary\'s drops are let through by hand (%s); every other check still runs'
              % ', '.join('%s %d -> %d' % d for d in res['drops']))
    for l in gg.digest_lines(res['diff']) if res['diff'] else []:
        print('   ' + l)
    if v == 'UNREADABLE_NEW':
        _drop()
        print('WARN pokeminers: batch %s UTC NOT installed -- %s; the installed client game master stays'
              % (gg._utc(up_ts / 1000.0), res['reason']))
        if meta and state == 'ok':       # remember WHY, so the offline audit (I2.7) can say it; the next good check clears it
            meta['rejected'] = {'batch_ts': up_ts, 'batch_utc': gg._utc(up_ts / 1000.0), 'at': gg._utc(now), 'reason': res['reason'][:300]}
            meta['checked_ts'], meta['checked_at'], meta['upstream_ts'] = int(now), gg._utc(now), up_ts
            gg.write_meta(meta_path, meta)
        _PM_NOTE[0] = 'pokeminers %s: new batch REJECTED, kept' % _pm_ident(meta)
        return None, tail
    if v == 'STOP':
        _drop()
        ok, lines = _pm_stop(gg, res, res['reason'])
        for l in lines[:40]:
            print('   ' + l)
        print('pokeminers: STOP -- %s (nothing installed); review record %s' % (res['reason'], 'written' if ok else 'NOT WRITTEN'))
        return 2, tail
    if v == 'SAME':
        _drop()
        if state == 'ok' and meta['batch_ts'] != up_ts:
            print('WARN pokeminers: the timestamp moved (%s -> %s) but the content did not -- a stale CDN edge or a re-stamp; '
                  'NOT adopted, asked again next run' % (meta['batch_ts'], up_ts))
            _PM_NOTE[0] = 'pokeminers %s: timestamp moved, content same (kept)' % _pm_ident(meta)
            return None, tail
        apk, folder = gg.lookup_apk(up_ts, fetch) if src == 'pokeminers' else (None, None)
        # A file its stamp does not describe (sha-mismatch) may be a batch that was installed and killed before it was stamped:
        # the reconcile + rank pass it owed may never have run, so it is owed AGAIN (an extra pass is only slow; a missing one
        # leaves pvpoke's file drifted from the client game master)
        owed = bool(tail) or state == 'sha-mismatch'
        nm = gg.new_meta(up_ts, res['new']['sha256'], apk, folder, now, tail_pending=owed, source=src)
        if named:
            nm['ids_named'] = named                          # the stamped sha256 is of the NAMED bytes, not upstream's
        if meta and state == 'ok':                           # --force on an unchanged file: keep its install time and a known APK
            for k in ('downloaded_ts', 'downloaded_at'):
                nm[k] = meta.get(k, nm[k])
            if nm['apk'] is None:                            # the tree API may be refused now; it is the same batch, so the same APK
                nm['apk'], nm['folder'] = meta.get('apk'), meta.get('folder')
        gg.write_meta(meta_path, nm)
        _PM_NOTE[0] = 'pokeminers %s adopted = upstream latest' % _pm_ident(nm)
        print('pokeminers: the installed file IS upstream batch %s -- stamped %s' % (_pm_ident(nm), os.path.basename(meta_path)))
        return None, owed
    # CLEAR or FLIPS: install with a dated, never-overwritten backup
    apk, folder = gg.lookup_apk(up_ts, fetch) if src == 'pokeminers' else (None, None)
    nm = gg.new_meta(up_ts, res['new']['sha256'], apk, folder, now, tail_pending=True, source=src)
    if named:
        nm['ids_named'] = named                              # the stamped sha256 is of the NAMED bytes, not upstream's
    if v == 'FLIPS':
        # HELD, NOT INSTALLED (2026-09-30, review of #27: "the owner cannot decline"): until then a FLIPS installed first and
        # --ack only cleared the record, so a hand rollback was re-downloaded, re-installed and re-stopped by the next run. The
        # judged bytes now wait beside the installed file (a .json name, so the data store carries them to the next session)
        staged = (gm_path[:-5] if gm_path.endswith('.json') else gm_path) + '.pending.json'
        try:
            if gg.sha256_file(tmp) != res['new']['sha256']:  # a second refresh may have rewritten the download since it was judged
                raise OSError('the downloaded candidate changed after it was judged (a second refresh running?)')
            os.replace(tmp, staged)
        except OSError as e:
            _drop()
            print('WARN pokeminers: NOT installed or held -- %s (the installed file stays)' % e)
            return 1, tail
        ok, lines = _pm_stop(gg, res, res['reason'], None, meta, nm, staged=os.path.basename(staged), batch_ts=up_ts,
                             meta_new=dict(nm), gm_path=os.path.abspath(gm_path), meta_path=os.path.abspath(meta_path))
        if not ok:
            try:
                os.remove(staged)
            except OSError:
                pass
            print('WARN pokeminers: NOT installed -- the review record could not be written; the installed file stays')
            return 1, tail
        _PM_NOTE[0] = 'pokeminers %s HELD for review, not installed' % _pm_ident(nm)
        for l in lines[:40]:
            print('   ' + l)
        print('   rows: %s -- install it: python system/scripts/refresh_gamemaster.py --ack | keep the installed one: --reject'
              % os.path.relpath(REVIEW, ROOT))
        print('pokeminers: %s -- NEW GAME MASTER HELD, NOT INSTALLED: NEEDS A HUMAN (exit 2)' % res['reason'])
        return 2, tail
    bak = gg.next_backup_path(gm_path)
    try:
        shutil.copy2(gm_path, bak)
        if os.path.exists(meta_path):
            shutil.copy2(meta_path, meta_path + '.bak-' + os.path.basename(bak).split('.bak-', 1)[1])
    except OSError as e:
        _drop()
        print('WARN pokeminers: NOT installed -- the backup could not be written (%s); the installed file stays' % e)
        return 1, tail
    try:
        if gg.sha256_file(tmp) != res['new']['sha256']:      # a second refresh may have rewritten the download since it was judged
            raise OSError('the downloaded candidate changed after it was judged (a second refresh running?)')
        os.replace(tmp, gm_path)                             # atomic; the previous file is the backup above
    except OSError as e:
        _drop()
        print('WARN pokeminers: NOT installed -- %s (the installed file stays)' % e)
        return 1, tail
    if not gg.write_meta(meta_path, nm):
        print('WARN pokeminers: installed, but %s could not be written -- the next run re-adopts it' % os.path.basename(meta_path))
    print('pokeminers: installed batch %s; previous file kept as %s' % (_pm_ident(nm), os.path.basename(bak)))
    _PM_NOTE[0] = 'pokeminers installed %s, verdicts unchanged' % _pm_ident(nm)
    print('pokeminers: no in-bag keep verdict moves (move pools, evolution chain, size / types, costume, tradable, transferable, rarity) '
          '-- installed without a stop')
    return None, True


def _pm_tail_done():
    """The reconcile + rank pass an installed client game master owed has run (both exits below it stop or clear)."""
    try:
        import gm_guard as gg
        gg.clear_tail_pending(PM_META)
    except Exception:
        pass
MAX_AGE_DAYS = 30
READY_RANK = 5


def age_days(path):
    """Days since the game master was DOWNLOADED (H04-11, 2026-09-29): the file's mtime moved with every local rewrite --
    reconcile_gamemaster.py edits it in place, a rollback's copy2 restores an old one -- so a manual reconcile restarted
    the 30-day clock without a download. The install writes DL_STAMP; mtime is the fallback before the first stamp."""
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return 1e9
    if os.path.abspath(path) == os.path.abspath(GM) and os.path.exists(DL_STAMP):
        try:
            return (time.time() - float(json.load(open(DL_STAMP, encoding='utf-8'))['ts'])) / 86400.0
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
            pass                                  # an unreadable stamp: the mtime, as before
    return (time.time() - os.path.getmtime(path)) / 86400.0


def _set_dl_stamp(raw):
    """raw = the stamp file's previous text (None = there was none): restore it exactly on a rollback."""
    try:
        if raw is None:
            if os.path.exists(DL_STAMP):
                os.remove(DL_STAMP)
        else:
            open(DL_STAMP, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(raw)
    except OSError as e:
        print('!! could not restore %s (%s) -- the refresh clock may read wrong' % (os.path.basename(DL_STAMP), e))


def species(gm):
    return {p['speciesId']: p for p in (gm['pokemon'] if isinstance(gm, dict) and 'pokemon' in gm else gm)}


def ranks(con):
    return {r[0]: r[1:] for r in con.execute(
        'SELECT uid_hex, gl_rank, ul_rank, ll_rank FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1')}


FLAGS = ('--check-only', '--force', '--ack', '--reject', '--selftest', '--accept-smaller')


def main(argv):
    bad = [a for a in argv if a not in FLAGS]
    if bad:     # an unknown flag -- even --help -- must never fall through to a real download + install (full_audit.py's rule)
        print('flags: %s\nunknown: %s -- NOTHING was run' % (' '.join(FLAGS), ' '.join(bad)))
        return 2
    if '--selftest' in argv:                   # offline, synthetic fixtures, temp dir only -- BEFORE anything reads or downloads
        if ROOT not in sys.path:
            sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
        import gm_guard
        return gm_guard.selftest(sys.modules[__name__])
    age = age_days(GM)
    print('pvpoke_gamemaster.json age: %.1f days (limit %d)' % (age, MAX_AGE_DAYS))
    if '--check-only' in argv:
        return 3 if age > MAX_AGE_DAYS else 0
    _gate = review_gate(argv)                  # a pending review stops EVERY run until --ack, whatever the file's age
    if _gate is not None:
        return _gate
    try:
        _pm_rc, _pm_tail = pokeminers_phase(argv)   # the CLIENT game master, on EVERY run and not the 30-day clock (2026-09-30)
    except Exception as _e:                    # the guard itself broke: it installs only as its LAST step, so the old file stands
        print('WARN pokeminers: the client game master check CRASHED (%s: %s) -- nothing was installed by it; fix '
              'gm_guard.py' % (type(_e).__name__, _e))
        return 1
    if _pm_rc:
        return _pm_rc
    if age <= MAX_AGE_DAYS and '--force' not in argv and not _pm_tail:
        print('fresh enough (pvpoke %.0f d old) | %s' % (age, _PM_NOTE[0]))      # the LAST line: full_audit echoes only this
        return 0
    if _pm_tail:
        print('pokeminers: a new client game master is in -- refreshing pvpoke too, so reconcile + ranks judge them together')
    refresh_rankings()                                      # pvpoke meta rankings on the same clock (2026-09-29)
    tmp = GM + '.download'
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(URL, timeout=60) as r, open(tmp, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(r.read())
        new = json.load(open(tmp, encoding='utf-8'))
        N = species(new)
        if len(N) < 1000:
            raise ValueError('downloaded file has only %d species -- refusing' % len(N))
    except Exception as e:
        print('DOWNLOAD FAILED (%s) -- local file left untouched' % e)
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.remove(tmp)
        return 1

    O = species(json.load(open(GM, encoding='utf-8'))) if os.path.exists(GM) else {}
    added = sorted(set(N) - set(O)); removed = sorted(set(O) - set(N))
    stat = [s for s in N if s in O and N[s]['baseStats'] != O[s]['baseStats']]
    print('species: %d -> %d | added %d | removed %d | base-stat changes %d'
          % (len(O), len(N), len(added), len(removed), len(stat)))
    for s in stat:
        print('   stats %-24s %s -> %s' % (s, tuple(O[s]['baseStats'].values()), tuple(N[s]['baseStats'].values())))
    if removed:
        print('   removed: %s' % ', '.join(removed[:12]))
        # a removed speciesId that an override still points at would NULL that mon's ranks
        ov = open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'form_overrides_complete.py'), encoding='utf-8').read()
        hit = [s for s in removed if ("'%s'" % s) in ov]
        if hit:
            print('   *** form_overrides_complete.py still maps to removed speciesId(s): %s -- fix before '
                  'refreshing, or those mons lose their rank ***' % hit)
            os.remove(tmp)
            return 2

    bak = GM + '.bak-' + time.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    shutil.copy2(GM, bak)
    # RECORD BEFORE INSTALL (R-B review): the record was written only at the very end, so a refresh killed or timed out
    # between this install and the diff (reconcile 900 s + rank_cache 1800 s budgets; full_audit's own timeout is 1800 s)
    # left a FRESH file and no record -> the next run said 'fresh enough', recrawled and synced on ranks nobody compared.
    # Replaced by the crossing record below, or cleared on REFRESH OK and on every restore.
    if not _write_review({'status': 'in progress', 'since': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'),
                          'backup': os.path.basename(bak)}):
        os.remove(tmp)
        print('NOT installed: the in-progress record could not be written -- local file left untouched')
        return 1
    _old_dl = open(DL_STAMP, encoding='utf-8').read() if os.path.exists(DL_STAMP) else None
    os.replace(tmp, GM)
    _set_dl_stamp(json.dumps({'ts': time.time(), 'at': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}))   # H04-11: the download time
    print('installed; previous file kept as %s' % os.path.basename(bak))

    # A FRESH pvpoke FILE IS AN UNRECONCILED ONE (2026-09-20). pvpoke's gamemaster is missing evolution edges
    # the client's own game master has -- corsola_galarian -> cursola, zygarde -> zygarde_complete,
    # poltchageist -> sinistcha (which pvpoke files BACKWARDS), rockruff -> lycanroc_dusk (pvpoke's id is
    # misspelled 'lycranroc_dusk', so the stage was unrankable). _reachable() can only trim stages, never add
    # them, so a missing edge is a stage that is never scored -- the under-protection direction. Downloading a
    # new copy silently undoes every one of those fixes, so reconcile before the ranks are computed below.
    _rc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(ROOT, 'reconcile_gamemaster.py')],
                         capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
    for _l in (_rc.stdout or _rc.stderr).strip().splitlines():
        print('   reconcile: %s' % _l)
    if _rc.returncode != 0:
        print('reconcile_gamemaster FAILED rc=%d -- restoring previous game master' % _rc.returncode)
        shutil.copy2(bak, GM)
        _set_dl_stamp(_old_dl)
        _clear_review()
        return 2

    con = sqlite3.connect('file:%s?mode=ro' % DB, uri=True)
    before = ranks(con); con.close()
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(HERE, 'rank_cache.py')], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1800)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print('rank_cache FAILED rc=%d -- restoring previous game master' % r.returncode)
        shutil.copy2(bak, GM)
        _set_dl_stamp(_old_dl)
        _clear_review()
        return 1
    con = sqlite3.connect('file:%s?mode=ro' % DB, uri=True)
    after = ranks(con)
    names = {u: n for u, n in con.execute('SELECT uid_hex, species_name FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1')}
    con.close()
    _pm_tail_done()                            # the reconcile + rank pass a client-GM install owed has now run

    changed = [u for u in before if u in after and before[u] != after[u]]
    def prot(t):  # protected by rank = GL or UL rank <= READY_RANK
        return any(x is not None and x <= READY_RANK for x in t[:2])
    crossed = [u for u in changed if prot(before[u]) != prot(after[u])]
    nulled = [u for u in after if after[u][0] is None and after[u][1] is None
              and not (before.get(u, (None, None))[0] is None and before.get(u, (None, None))[1] is None)]
    print('ranks changed on %d row(s); crossed the rank<=%d line: %d; newly NULL: %d'
          % (len(changed), READY_RANK, len(crossed), len(nulled)))
    for u in crossed[:20]:
        print('   CROSSED %-14s gl %s->%s  ul %s->%s' % (names.get(u, u), before[u][0], after[u][0], before[u][1], after[u][1]))
    for u in nulled[:20]:
        print('   NULL    %-14s (species no longer resolves -- the Mudbray class; rule 15c keeps it, but fix the mapping)' % names.get(u, u))
    if crossed or nulled:
        # RECORDED, not just printed (H04): the next run finds a FRESH file and would otherwise exit 0 and sync.
        _lines = (['CROSSED %-14s %s gl %s->%s  ul %s->%s' % (names.get(u, u), u, before[u][0], after[u][0], before[u][1], after[u][1])
                   for u in crossed] + ['NULL    %-14s %s' % (names.get(u, u), u) for u in nulled])[:500]
        if not _write_review({'since': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), 'crossed': crossed, 'nulled': nulled,
                              'backup': os.path.basename(bak), 'lines': _lines}):
            print('!! the crossing record could not be written; the in-progress record still stops every run (--ack then '
                  'rolls this refresh back and the next run diffs it again)')
        print('   rows: %s -- after review: python system/scripts/refresh_gamemaster.py --ack' % os.path.relpath(REVIEW, ROOT))
        print('REFRESH APPLIED BUT NEEDS A HUMAN: keep decisions moved; every run exits 2 until --ack (exit 2)')   # <= 110
        return 2
    _clear_review()
    print('REFRESH OK -- no keep decision moved. | %s' % _PM_NOTE[0])
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
```

```py
"""regress_pvp_keepers.py -- PERMANENT regression fixtures for the 18 PvP keepers we LOST.

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
====================
A forensic audit (2026-09-07) found 24 pokemon that a CORRECT engine would have KEPT and that a
past engine put in the irreversible Transfer pile. 18 of them are gone for good. Two causes:

  * 17 predate any PvP-RANK rule -- the pre-2026-06-05 IV-MAGNITUDE era, the same defect that
    killed a 0/13/11 Great League rank-1 Mareep (see feedback-pvp-rank-not-iv-threshold and the
    *** DO NOT REINTRODUCE AN IV GATE HERE *** banner in pvp_iv_rule.py). Under a league CP cap the
    stat-product rank ANTI-correlates with IV%: low attack wins. Every IV floor/threshold ever added
    to a PvP path has therefore rejected exactly the spreads that rank #1.
  * 1 was a Mudbray whose species_name parsed as the placeholder "pid749". With no FORM_OVERRIDES
    entry and no resolvable slug, pvid() produced a speciesId absent from the gamemaster, the ranker

    protect". Its true rank was GREAT LEAGUE #2 of 4096, 99.65%.

The patches for that are elsewhere (rule 15b pvp_rank, rule 15c rank_unknown, the maxcp UNKNOWN
sentinel, the rank_cache NULL-on-unmappable fix). THIS FILE IS THE GUARD: it encodes the 18 real
spreads as permanent fixtures, inserts them into a SANDBOX copy of the bag, runs the REAL current
keep_policy, and fails the audit gate if any of them comes out TRANSFER -- or comes out KEPT for an
incidental reason with its PvP protection silently gone. A rule can be deleted; a fixture that
proves the rule cannot be deleted quietly.

WHAT IS ASSERTED (all three are hard; any failure exits non-zero)
================================================================
  A. RANK MATH + FORM MAPPING. Each fixture's GL/UL rank, percent and best-chain STAGE are

14 of the 18 are keepers under ANY viability margin. FOUR are not: the three Abra and the Wailmer

2026-09-30, only a copy that fits under the cap at that stage -- fixture_cp builds them that way). Raise

policy changed. Those four carry margin_sensitive=True and this script says so IN THE FAILURE TEXT,
so a future margin change produces an explained failure instead of a mystery. The user rejected

HARD RULES THIS FILE OBEYS
==========================
  * SANDBOX ONLY. The live pokemon.db is opened read-only (file: URI, mode=ro) and snapshotted with

USAGE

    """
    return rc.RankTableCache(pokemon_db, rc._content_hash(gm_bytes),
                             pkl_path=os.path.join(pkl_dir, 'regress_rank_tables.pkl'))


def _best_rank(cache, pokemon_db, sid, ivs, cap):
    """Best (lowest) rank across the evolution chain -- the same walk compute_ranks() does per row."""
    if sid not in pokemon_db:
        return None
    # 2026-09-08: mirrors rank_cache's VIABILITY-AWARE selection -- a stage that can reach the cap beats one
    # that cannot; among equals the lowest rank wins; fall back to the overall lowest if none is viable.
    # (Dottler 15/15/15: stage dottler ranks #1 by raw IV but maxes at 1,164 CP; orbeetle UL #3 is the real one.)
    best = None
    for stage in rc.get_evolutions(pokemon_db, sid):
        r = rc.compute_rank_for_iv(cache, stage, ivs[0], ivs[1], ivs[2], cap, False)
        if not r:
            continue
        cand = dict(r, stage=stage, viable=rc._stage_viable(cache, stage, cap, False))
        if best is None or (cand['viable'] and not best['viable']) or (cand['viable'] == best['viable'] and cand['rank'] < best['rank']):
            best = cand
    return best


def derive_ranks(cache, pokemon_db, fx):
    """(sid, gl, ul) for a fixture, via the live to_pvpoke_id + chain walk."""
    sid = rc.to_pvpoke_id(fx['species'], fx['form'], 0)
    return (sid,
            _best_rank(cache, pokemon_db, sid, fx['ivs'], GL_CAP),
            _best_rank(cache, pokemon_db, sid, fx['ivs'], UL_CAP))


def fixture_cp(pokemon_db, fx, sid):
    """CP of the specimen BUILT FOR THE LEAGUE THAT PROTECTS IT: the level at which its RANKED STAGE sits at its highest
    level under that cap -- a copy that can actually PLAY the spread.

    Since 2026-09-30 CP decides it (user: "Why would I keep any GL and UL pokemon that cant participate? powering up is
    fine, but if its impossible in its best form for pvp, then wtf"): rules 15 / 15b keep a top-5 spread only on a copy
    that fits under the cap at that stage, now or after evolving at its level (pvp_iv_rule.plays / fits). Until then
    the level came from the PRE-EVO's own cap (an Eevee at L50 is under 1,500, its Umbreon is not), which built
    specimens that could never play the league they protect -- 9 of these fixtures then failed the new law for the
    right reason. The spread is the same; only the copy is now one a correct engine keeps. The stage is the recorded
    chain's end for the protecting league (assertion A re-derives it); the own-species CP is taken at that level.
    """
    own = (pokemon_db.get(sid) or pokemon_db[TRUE_SID[fx['label']]])['baseStats']
    use = fx['gl'] if (fx['gl'] and fx['gl'][0] <= READY_RANK) else fx['ul']
    cap = GL_CAP if (fx['gl'] and fx['gl'][0] <= READY_RANK) else UL_CAP
    stage = str(use[2]).split('->')[-1].strip() if (use and len(use) > 2 and use[2]) else None
    tgt = ((pokemon_db.get(stage) or {}).get('baseStats') if stage else None) or own
    a, d, s = fx['ivs']
    idx = rc.find_max_idx(tgt['atk'], tgt['def'], tgt['hp'], a, d, s, cap, False)
    idx = min(max(idx, 0), rc.MAX_LEVEL_IDX)
    return rc.compute_cp(own['atk'], own['def'], own['hp'], a, d, s, rc.CPM[idx], False), idx


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sandbox
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def build_sandbox(sandbox):
    """A throwaway project tree: a CONSISTENT snapshot of the bag + the files keep_policy reads.

    The db is copied with sqlite's backup API through a mode=ro URI rather than shutil.copy: the
    dashboard and autocull_watch are live processes writing this database in WAL mode, and a byte
    copy taken mid-transaction is a torn read. Read-only is enforced by the URI, not by intent.
    """
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(sandbox, 'system', 'analysis', 'tagsets'), exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(sandbox, 'system', 'scripts'), exist_ok=True)
    sb_db = os.path.join(sandbox, 'pokemon.db')
    src = sqlite3.connect('file:%s?mode=ro' % LIVE_DB.replace('\\', '/'), uri=True)
    try:
        dst = sqlite3.connect(sb_db)
        try:
            src.backup(dst)
        finally:
            dst.close()
    finally:
        src.close()
    for fn in ROOT_INPUTS:
        shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(ROOT, fn), os.path.join(sandbox, fn))
    return sb_db


OVERCAP_UID = 'REGRESSOVERCAP000'
RANK_AXES = frozenset({'pvp_rank', 'gl_iv', 'ul_iv'})


def insert_fixtures(sb_db, pokemon_db, derived):
    """Insert the fixtures as synthetic in_bag rows, ranks written the way the ranker writes them.

    EVERY protection column keep_policy's data-completeness gate reads is set EXPLICITLY to 0. A NULL
    there would mark the row 'data_incomplete' and keep it unconditionally -- a fixture that passes
    because the engine could not judge it is a fixture that proves nothing. Same reasoning for the
    cosmetic/shiny/shadow/legendary/size columns: these mons must live or die on PvP alone.
    """
    con = sqlite3.connect(sb_db)
    cols = {r[1] for r in con.execute('PRAGMA table_info(pokemon)')}
    rows = []
    for i, fx in enumerate(FIXTURES):
        sid, gl, ul = derived[i]
        cp, lvl_idx = fixture_cp(pokemon_db, fx, sid)
        a, d, s = fx['ivs']
        r = {
            'uid_hex': 'REGRESSFIXTURE%03d' % i, 'in_bag': 1,
            'pokemon_id': fx['pid'], 'species_name': fx['species'], 'form': fx['form'],
            'form_region': fx['region'], 'gender': 1, 'nickname': None,
            'iv_atk': a, 'iv_def': d, 'iv_sta': s, 'iv_total': a + d + s,
            'iv_pct': round((a + d + s) / 45.0 * 100, 2), 'is_hundo': 0, 'is_zero': 0, 'is_component': 0, 'is_fusion': 0,
            'cp': cp, 'level': 1 + lvl_idx / 2.0, 'cp_multiplier': rc.CPM[lvl_idx],
            'num_additional_cpm': 0, 'height_m': 0.0, 'weight_kg': 0.0,
            'costume': 0, 'is_shiny': 0, 'alignment': 0, 'is_lucky': 0, 'is_traded': 0,
            'is_traded_flag_v2': 0, 'original_owner': None, 'original_owner_name': '',
            'is_favorite_v2': 0, 'is_deployed': 0, 'deployed_fort_id': '',
            'adventure_effects_left': 0, 'is_legendary': 0, 'is_mythical': 0,
            'is_ultra_beast': 0, 'is_paradox': 0, 'pokemon_size_category': 3,
            'costume_decoration_id': 0,
            # the data-completeness gate's columns, all explicitly present and unremarkable
            'fresh_shiny': 0, 'fresh_alignment': 0, 'fresh_costume': 0, 'fresh_form': fx['form'],
            'fresh_bread_mode': 0, 'fresh_natural_art_bg': 0, 'fresh_has_location_card': 0,
            'fresh_loc_card_enum': 0, 'fresh_is_strong': 0,
            # ranks exactly as rank_cache.compute_ranks would write them (NULL when unmappable)
            'gl_rank': gl['rank'] if gl else None, 'gl_pct': gl['pct'] if gl else None,
            'gl_stage': gl['stage'] if gl else None,
            'ul_rank': ul['rank'] if ul else None, 'ul_pct': ul['pct'] if ul else None,
            'ul_stage': ul['stage'] if ul else None,
        }
        missing = [k for k in r if k not in cols]
        if missing:
            con.close()
            raise SystemExit('FAIL setup: pokemon.db schema has no column(s) %s -- the fixture row '
                             'cannot be built. Re-run the crawl/migration.' % missing)
        rows.append(r)
    # OVER-CAP TWIN (2026-09-30 -- the other half of the law): the Eevee 0/15/14 spread again, at the level the PRE-EVO's
    # own Great League cap allows (L50). As Umbreon (GL #1) and Leafeon (UL #5) it is then over 1,500 / 2,500, so this
    # copy can never play the spread. A correct engine gives it NO PvP-rank axis (other axes may still keep it).
    ev = next(k for k, fx in enumerate(FIXTURES) if fx['label'] == 'Eevee 0/15/14')
    b = pokemon_db[derived[ev][0]]['baseStats']
    a, d, s = FIXTURES[ev]['ivs']
    ti = min(max(rc.find_max_idx(b['atk'], b['def'], b['hp'], a, d, s, GL_CAP, False), 0), rc.MAX_LEVEL_IDX)
    twin = dict(rows[ev])
    twin.update(uid_hex=OVERCAP_UID, cp=rc.compute_cp(b['atk'], b['def'], b['hp'], a, d, s, rc.CPM[ti], False),
                level=1 + ti / 2.0, cp_multiplier=rc.CPM[ti])
    rows.append(twin)
    keys = sorted(rows[0])
    con.executemany('INSERT INTO pokemon (%s) VALUES (%s)'
                    % (','.join(keys), ','.join('?' * len(keys))),
                    [tuple(r[k] for k in keys) for r in rows])
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    return [r['uid_hex'] for r in rows]


def run_engine(sandbox, sb_db):
    """keep_policy.main(), UNMODIFIED, with every output path repointed into the sandbox.

    keep_policy resolves five paths: DB, TD (tagsets), ROOT (gamemaster / legacy / dex /
    policy_reasons.json / pile_provenance.json) and -- for the fodder_oracle export only -- its own
    __file__. All four patch targets are asserted to be inside the sandbox before main() is called,
    because the live pile is the one irreversible output in this system and a test that can write it
    is a hazard, not a test.
    """
    import keep_policy
    sb_td = os.path.join(sandbox, 'system', 'analysis', 'tagsets')
    patched = dict(DB=sb_db, TD=sb_td, ROOT=sandbox,
                   __file__=os.path.join(sandbox, 'system', 'scripts', 'keep_policy.py'))
    sbx = os.path.abspath(sandbox)
    for k, v in patched.items():
        p = os.path.abspath(v)
        if not (p == sbx or p.startswith(sbx + os.sep)):
            raise SystemExit('FAIL setup: refusing to run -- keep_policy.%s would resolve to %s, '
                             'which is OUTSIDE the sandbox %s' % (k, v, sandbox))
    saved = {k: getattr(keep_policy, k) for k in patched}
    buf = io.StringIO()
    err = None
    try:
        for k, v in patched.items():
            setattr(keep_policy, k, v)
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
            keep_policy.main()
    except SystemExit as e:            # the engine's own ABORT tripwires are a RESULT, not a crash
        err = str(e)
    finally:
        for k, v in saved.items():
            setattr(keep_policy, k, v)
    pile, reasons = set(), {}
    pfile = os.path.join(sb_td, '6_Transfer.txt')
    rfile = os.path.join(sandbox, 'system', 'analysis', 'policy_reasons.json')
    if os.path.exists(pfile):
        pile = set(open(pfile, encoding='utf-8').read().split())
    if os.path.exists(rfile):
        reasons = json.load(open(rfile, encoding='utf-8'))
    return pile, reasons, buf.getvalue(), err

# standing anchors (assertion C) -- pure math, no db, no engine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def check_anchors(cache):
    """The numbers verified against the user's own app and two in-game screenshots."""
    out = []
    # 12/15/13: #1108 on the overlay's older rounded ladder, #1109 on the game's own multipliers (2026-09-30, see the docstring)
    for ivs, want_rank, want_pct in (((12, 15, 13), 1109, 96.88), ((12, 13, 14), 1151, 96.82)):
        r = rc.compute_rank_for_iv(cache, 'mewtwo_armored', ivs[0], ivs[1], ivs[2], UL_CAP, False)
        got = (r['rank'], round(r['pct'], 2)) if r else (None, None)
        out.append(('Armored Mewtwo UL %d/%d/%d' % ivs, got == (want_rank, want_pct),
                    '#%s %s%%' % got, '#%d %.2f%%' % (want_rank, want_pct)))
    # HP = floor((base_sta + iv_sta) * cpm);  CPM index = (level - 1) * 2.  Armored Mewtwo base_sta=214.
    for lvl, iv_sta, want in ((27.5, 15, 160), (50.0, 13, 190)):
        got = math.floor((214 + iv_sta) * rc.CPM[int((lvl - 1) * 2)])
        out.append(('Armored Mewtwo HP iv_sta=%d @L%s' % (iv_sta, lvl), got == want, str(got), str(want)))
    return out


def check_cpm_split_brain(pokemon_db, derived):
    """D4: rank_cache.CPM[98]=0.84029995 vs pvp_iv_rule.CPM50=0.84029999 -- two values for one number.

    (compute_all_ranks.py carries the rank_cache value; those two must agree with each other or the
    primary and fallback rankers disagree outright. pvp_iv_rule uses its own copy for the maxcp
    viability test only.)

    Neither file is this test's to fix (a sibling owns them), so this does NOT fail on the mere
    disagreement, and it does not fail on cosmetic drift either. Every fixture rank is recomputed
    with the L50 constant swapped for the other file's value, and the failure condition is
    DECISION-RELEVANT drift only:
      * a rank crossing the READY_RANK boundary (<=N vs >N) -- that flips rules 15/15b, or
      * a different best-chain STAGE -- that flips the maxcp viability test.
    A one-place reshuffle deep in the pack (float noise between two values that differ at the 8th
    decimal) changes no keep decision, and a gate that goes red for it is a gate people learn to wave
    through -- which on an IRREVERSIBLE output is worse than no gate at all. The measured drift is
    reported either way, so the day it reaches the top of a league this fails instead of whispering.
    """
    live = rc.CPM[rc.MAX_LEVEL_IDX]
    if live == pvp_iv_rule.CPM50:
        return True, 'CPM L50 constants AGREE (%r) -- defect D4 resolved' % pvp_iv_rule.CPM50
    drift, decisive = [], []
    tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='pogo_regress_cpm_')
    try:
        rc.CPM[rc.MAX_LEVEL_IDX] = pvp_iv_rule.CPM50
        alt = _rank_cache(open(GM_PATH, 'rb').read(), pokemon_db, tmpdir)
        for i, fx in enumerate(FIXTURES):
            sid, gl, ul = derived[i]
            for lab, cap, base in (('GL', GL_CAP, gl), ('UL', UL_CAP, ul)):
                b = _best_rank(alt, pokemon_db, sid, fx['ivs'], cap)
                r0, r1 = (base or {}).get('rank'), (b or {}).get('rank')
                s0, s1 = (base or {}).get('stage'), (b or {}).get('stage')
                if r0 == r1 and s0 == s1:
                    continue
                what = '%s %s: #%s via %s -> #%s via %s' % (fx['label'], lab, r0, s0, r1, s1)
                drift.append(what)
                ready = lambda r: (r is not None and r <= READY_RANK)
                if s0 != s1 or ready(r0) != ready(r1):
                    decisive.append(what)
    finally:
        rc.CPM[rc.MAX_LEVEL_IDX] = live
        shutil.rmtree(tmpdir, ignore_errors=True)
    if decisive:
        return False, ('CPM L50 split-brain (rank_cache %r vs pvp_iv_rule %r, defect D4) now changes a '
                       'KEEP-RELEVANT answer -- it crosses the ready_rank<=%d boundary or picks a '
                       'different chain stage: %s' % (live, pvp_iv_rule.CPM50, READY_RANK,
                                                      '; '.join(decisive[:6])))
    return True, ('CPM L50 split-brain still present (rank_cache %r vs pvp_iv_rule %r, defect D4). '
                  'MEASURED, not assumed: %d of %d fixture ranks shift under the other value%s -- none '
                  'crosses the ready_rank<=%d boundary and no chain stage changes, so no keep decision '
                  'moves. Still worth collapsing to one constant.'
                  % (live, pvp_iv_rule.CPM50, len(drift), 2 * len(FIXTURES),
                     (' (' + '; '.join(drift[:4]) + ')') if drift else '', READY_RANK))


SANDBOX_PREFIX = 'pogo_regress_pvp_'


def rmtree_hard(path, tries=4):
    """rmtree that actually works on Windows -- and SAYS SO when it does not.

    keep_policy.main() never closes its sqlite connection, and its many nested closures
    (cf/_vkey/_eff_cap/...) capture the enclosing frame, so the connection object sits in a reference
    CYCLE and refcounting alone never frees it. On Windows an open sqlite handle blocks deletion, so
    plain shutil.rmtree(ignore_errors=True) silently left a 19MB sandbox pokemon.db behind on EVERY
    run -- measured: 7 orphans, 133MB, after a single afternoon of testing. This gate runs on every
    full_audit, so a silent per-run leak is a disk filling up on its own. gc.collect() breaks the
    cycles first; the retry loop covers an indexer/AV racing us; and the return value is a REPORT,
    never a swallowed error.
    """
    gc.collect()
    for _ in range(tries):
        shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            return ''
        time.sleep(0.25)
        gc.collect()
    shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return ''
    left = [os.path.join(r, f) for r, _d, fs in os.walk(path) for f in fs]
    return ('sandbox %s could NOT be removed (%d file(s) still locked%s) -- delete it by hand; a '
            'later run of this test will sweep it.'
            % (path, len(left), (', e.g. ' + os.path.basename(left[0])) if left else ''))


def sweep_stale_sandboxes(max_age_s=3600):
    """Delete sandboxes an earlier crash (or the pre-2026-09-07 leak) left behind.

    Only directories with this script's own prefix, only in the system temp dir, only when untouched
    for an hour -- a live run finishes in seconds, so this can never remove a concurrent instance's
    tree. Best-effort and silent on error: cleanup must never be the reason a keeper gate fails.
    """
    swept = 0
    base = tempfile.gettempdir()
    try:
        names = os.listdir(base)
    except OSError:
        return 0
    for d in names:
        if not d.startswith(SANDBOX_PREFIX):
            continue
        p = os.path.join(base, d)
        try:
            if os.path.isdir(p) and (time.time() - os.stat(p).st_mtime) > max_age_s:
                shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
                swept += not os.path.exists(p)
        except OSError:
            pass
    return swept


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def live_artifact_hashes():
    """Fingerprint the live outputs this test must never write (belt-and-braces around the sandbox)."""
    out = {}
    for rel in ('system/analysis/tagsets/6_Transfer.txt', 'system/analysis/policy_reasons.json',
                'system/analysis/pile_provenance.json', 'system/analysis/fodder_oracle.json'):
        p = os.path.join(ROOT, rel)
        try:
            out[rel] = hashlib.sha256(open(p, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
        except OSError:
            out[rel] = None
    return out


def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    verbose = '-v' in argv or '--verbose' in argv
    keep_sandbox = '--keep-sandbox' in argv
    t0 = time.time()
    print('regress_pvp_keepers -- %d fixtures | ready_rank=%d viability_margin=%d gl_cap=%d ul_cap=%d'
          % (len(FIXTURES), READY_RANK, VIABILITY_MARGIN, GL_CAP, UL_CAP))

    gm_bytes = open(GM_PATH, 'rb').read()
    pokemon_db = {p['speciesId']: p for p in json.loads(gm_bytes.decode('utf-8'))['pokemon']}
    before = live_artifact_hashes()
    swept = sweep_stale_sandboxes()
    sandbox = os.environ.get('REGRESS_SANDBOX_DIR') or tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=SANDBOX_PREFIX)
    fails, notes = [], []
    try:
        cache = _rank_cache(gm_bytes, pokemon_db, sandbox)

        # ---- setup sanity ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        # A fixture form that is (or becomes) a COSTUME routes to the cosmetic cap instead of the
        # plain pool and stops modelling the plain specimen that was actually lost.
        for fx in FIXTURES:
            if is_costume_form(fx['form']):
                fails.append('FAIL setup %s: form %d now classifies as a COSTUME, so the fixture no '
                             'longer models a plain specimen -- pick the plain form id for this species.'
                             % (fx['label'], fx['form']))

        # ---- A. rank math + form mapping ---------------------------------------------------------
        derived = [derive_ranks(cache, pokemon_db, fx) for fx in FIXTURES]
        for i, fx in enumerate(FIXTURES):
            sid, gl, ul = derived[i]
            for lab, got, want in (('GL', gl, fx['gl']), ('UL', ul, fx['ul'])):
                if want is None:
                    if got is not None:
                        fails.append('FAIL rank %s %s: expected NO rank (deliberately unresolvable '
                                     'species %r) but got #%d via %s -- the placeholder now resolves, so '
                                     'this fixture no longer tests the NULL-rank path.'
                                     % (fx['label'], lab, sid, got['rank'], got['stage']))
                    continue
                w_rank, w_pct, w_chain = want
                w_stage = w_chain.split('->')[-1]
                if got is None:
                    fails.append('FAIL rank %s %s: expected #%d via %s but the chain produced NO rank at '
                                 'all -- speciesId %r missing from the gamemaster, or the (species,form) '
                                 'mapping broke.' % (fx['label'], lab, w_rank, w_stage, sid))
                elif (got['rank'], round(got['pct'], 2), got['stage']) != (w_rank, w_pct, w_stage):
                    fails.append('FAIL rank %s %s: engine says #%d %.2f%% via %s, the audit recorded '
                                 '#%d %.2f%% via %s -- the stat-product math or the (species,form)->'
                                 'speciesId mapping changed.'
                                 % (fx['label'], lab, got['rank'], got['pct'], got['stage'],
                                    w_rank, w_pct, w_stage))

        # ---- C. standing anchors -----------------------------------------------------------------
        for name, ok, got, want in check_anchors(cache):
            if not ok:
                fails.append("FAIL anchor %s: got %s, expected %s -- this number was verified against "
                             "the user's own app and in-game screenshots; a change that breaks it is "
                             "wrong." % (name, got, want))
        ok, msg = check_cpm_split_brain(pokemon_db, derived)
        (notes if ok else fails).append(msg if ok else 'FAIL cpm: ' + msg)

        # ---- B. the engine's decision -------------------------------------------------------------
        sb_db = build_sandbox(sandbox)
        uids = insert_fixtures(sb_db, pokemon_db, derived)
        pile, reasons, log, engine_err = run_engine(sandbox, sb_db)
        if engine_err:
            # keep_policy's own tripwires ABORT rather than emit a bad pile, so a leak may surface as
            # an abort instead of a pile membership. Either way the run produced no usable answer.
            fails.append('FAIL engine: keep_policy ABORTED -- %s'
                         % engine_err.strip().replace('\n', ' ')[:400])
        elif not reasons:
            fails.append('FAIL engine: keep_policy produced no policy_reasons.json in the sandbox')

        print('%-31s %-8s %s' % ('FIXTURE', 'VERDICT', 'KEEP REASONS'))
        for i, fx in enumerate(FIXTURES):
            uid = uids[i]
            why = sorted(reasons.get(uid, []))
            saved_by = sorted(set(why) & fx['axis'])
            note = MARGIN_NOTE if fx['margin_sensitive'] else ''
            if uid in pile or not why:
                verdict = 'TRANSFER'
                fails.append('FAIL %s: the CURRENT engine puts this spread in the IRREVERSIBLE '
                             'Transfer pile. %s%s' % (fx['label'], fx['why'], note))
            elif not saved_by:
                verdict = 'WEAK'
                fails.append('FAIL %s: KEPT, but ONLY by %s -- no PvP axis fired (wanted one of %s). '
                             'That is protection by accident: the day that axis moves, this mon is '
                             'released. %s%s'
                             % (fx['label'], why, sorted(fx['axis']), fx['why'], note))
            else:
                verdict = 'KEEP'
            print('%-31s %-8s %-40s %s'
                  % (fx['label'][:31], verdict, ','.join(why) or '-',
                     ('saved by ' + ','.join(saved_by)) if saved_by else ''))
        twy = sorted(reasons.get(OVERCAP_UID, []))
        bad = sorted(set(twy) & RANK_AXES)
        if bad:
            fails.append('FAIL over-cap twin: Eevee 0/15/14 at L50 is over the cap as Umbreon (GL) and Leafeon (UL), so it '
                         'can never play the spread, yet the engine still gives it %s (law 2(a), user 2026-09-30: "Why '
                         'would I keep any GL and UL pokemon that cant participate?")' % bad)
        print('%-31s %-8s %-40s %s' % ('Eevee 0/15/14 OVER-CAP twin', 'NO PVP' if not bad else 'PVP!',
                                       ','.join(twy) or '- (pile)', 'over the cap in both leagues: no rank axis'))
        if verbose:
            print('\n--- sandbox keep_policy log ---')
            for l in log.splitlines():
                print('   ' + l[:160])
    finally:
        if keep_sandbox:

              'correct engine keeps; do NOT sync a pile until this passes. (%.1fs)'

          'engine; ranks, form mappings and standing anchors all reproduce. (%.1fs)'
          % (len(FIXTURES), len(FIXTURES), time.time() - t0))
```

`pogo_extract/system/scripts/rename_tags.py`:

```py
EditTag keeps the tag Id (+0x38) and members; we just swap the name String* at
tagProto+0x40 to a fresh il2cpp string. Then mirror the new name into the DB
auth_tag_names and registry. Name limit = 15 chars (server-enforced).

REFUSES any rename naming the irreversible release pile, on EITHER side -- see
the PILE GATE block below. Every source name in RENAMES is a pre-2026-05-30 name
that is no longer among the 47 device tags, so in practice only the ad-hoc
--from/--to path is live, and it is gated too.

Usage:
  python rename_tags.py --only "Legacy"     # test one
  python rename_tags.py                      # apply all in RENAMES

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
HERE=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); ROOT=os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(HERE))
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT); sys.path.insert(0, HERE)   # HERE: tag_ops lives in system/scripts
os.chdir(ROOT)                      # pogo_il2cpp/bulk_tag.js use relative paths

                                    # through the module object, so a future local `import
                                    # tag_ops` inside main() cannot leave the name unbound
                                    # (the bug that bit prune_server_tag.py on 2026-09-07).
DB=os.path.join(ROOT,'pokemon.db')

RENAMES = {                          # current server name -> new (de-numbered) name, 2026-05-30
 '1 GL IV':'GL IV', '1 UL IV':'UL IV', '4 XXL':'XXL', '4 Hundo':'Hundo',
 '4 Nundo':'Nundo', '4 Costume':'Event', '3 Best Buddy':'Best Buddy',
 '3 Legacy Moves':'Legacy Moves', '5 Ethan':'Traded by E+F', '6 Transfer':'Transfer',
}                                    # '5 Florandez' is DELETED (merged into Traded by E+F), not renamed

JS=r"""
function _bindStrNew(){
  var f=null; Process.findModuleByName('libil2cpp.so').enumerateExports().forEach(function(e){ if(e.name==='il2cpp_string_new') f=e.address; });
  return new NativeFunction(f,'pointer',['pointer']);
}
function enumTags(svc){
  var cl=cFN('Niantic.Holoholo.Tagging','TaggingRpcService');
  var it=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);it.writePointer(ptr(0));
  var m,gn=null,gb=null;
  while((m=IL2.cGM(cl,it))&&!m.isNull()){var nm=IL2.mGN(m).readCString();if(nm==='get_NumberOfTags')gn=m;if(nm==='GetCachedTagToPokemonBindingForIndex')gb=m;}
  var tot=rI(gn,ptr(svc),ptr(0),null).add(0x10).readS32();
  var out=[];
  for(var i=0;i<tot;i++){var ib=Memory.alloc(4);ib.writeS32(i);var ar=Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);ar.writePointer(ib);var bp=rI(gb,ptr(svc),ar,null);if(bp.isNull())continue;
    var tp=bp.add(0x10).readPointer();var nm='';try{var ns=tp.add(0x40).readPointer();var ln=ns.add(0x10).readS32();if(ln>0&&ln<100){var ch=[];for(var ci=0;ci<ln;ci++)ch.push(String.fromCharCode(ns.add(0x14+ci*2).readU16()));nm=ch.join('');}}catch(e){}

    out.push({name:nm,tagProto:tp.toString(),members:mc});}
  return out;
}
function renameTag(svc, oldName, newName){
  _ensureInit();
  var tags=enumTags(svc); var tp=null;
  for(var i=0;i<tags.length;i++){ if(tags[i].name===oldName){ tp=ptr(tags[i].tagProto); break; } }
  if(!tp) return {ok:false, err:'old name not found'};

  if(s.isNull()) return {ok:false, err:'string_new null'};
  tp.add(0x40).writePointer(s);
  var cl=cFN('Niantic.Holoholo.Tagging','TaggingRpcService');

  if(!em) return {ok:false, err:'no EditTag'};
  var b=Memory.alloc(1); b.writeU8(1);
  var args=Memory.alloc(2*Process.pointerSize);
```
