`pokegenie_work/build_art.py`:

```py
"""Build ALL PokeGenie art from the official Pokemon GO asset mirror -- one pass, one source of truth.

Why this replaces fetch_sprites2.py + wire_sprites.py + add_mega_images.py + rebuild_pokedex_art.py:
the cached upstream listing those ran against held 5,733 files when the mirror actually has 11,726 --
5,993 missing, more than half. That silently cost real accuracy: costumes were never matched at all
(the old matcher passed an empty costume), and 13 mega species were invisible, which is why the user's
Mega Starmie and Mega Skarmory had no art. The listing is re-fetched live here, every run.

Naming upstream: pm<dex>[.f<FORM>][.c<COSTUME>][.g<GENDER>][.s].icon.png   (.s = shiny, .g2 = female)

Matching is two-pass and every candidate must EXIST upstream, so a pokemon can never be given another
species' picture:
  pass 1 -- shiny art only, most specific qualifier set first (form+costume+gender -> ... -> bare)
  pass 2 -- same ladder without shiny
Shiny accuracy is therefore preferred over qualifier depth, and species is never traded away for either.
A pokemon that matches nothing gets NO image and PokeGenie falls back to its own default.

Outputs (all written under pokegenie_out/):
  scan_thumb/<imageId>.jpg + image_map.json + source_map.json   collection thumbnails
  mega_thumb/<imageId>.jpg + mega_map.json                      megaImageId1/2 art
  pokedex_art/{pokedex_<k>, i_df_<k>.jpg} + pokedex_art_map.json  Pokedex + raid-boss tiles

Image ids are a deterministic hash of the pokemon uid, so a re-run overwrites its own files in place
rather than orphaning thousands of images in the app's data directory.

    python build_art.py [--jobs 24] [--no-refresh]
"""
import argparse, collections, hashlib, json, os, re, shutil, sqlite3, threading, urllib.parse, urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
ROOT = os.path.join(BASE, 'pogo_extract')
WORK = os.path.join(BASE, 'pokegenie_work')
OUT = os.path.join(BASE, 'pokegenie_out')
SPR = os.path.join(WORK, 'sprites')
RAW = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/master/'
TREES = 'https://api.github.com/repos/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/git/trees/'
_lock = threading.Lock()

# PokeGenie's Pokedex-art form suffix -> upstream form token (only where normalising is not enough)
PG_SUFFIX = {
    'Alola': 'ALOLA', 'Galarian': 'GALARIAN', 'Hisuian': 'HISUIAN', 'Paldean': 'PALDEA',
    'Mega': 'MEGA', 'MegaX': 'MEGA_X', 'MegaY': 'MEGA_Y',
    'Deoxysattack': 'ATTACK', 'Deoxysdefense': 'DEFENSE',
    'zyg10': 'TEN_PERCENT', 'formFour': 'FIFTY_PERCENT',
    'OriBaile': 'BAILE', 'OriPau': 'PAU', 'OriPom': 'POM_POM', 'OriSensu': 'SENSU',
    'FormMidday': 'MIDDAY', 'FormMidnight': 'MIDNIGHT',
    'Sword': 'CROWNED_SWORD', 'Shield': 'CROWNED_SHIELD',
}


def norm(s):
    return re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', (s or '').lower())


def image_id(seed):
    h = hashlib.sha1(seed.encode()).hexdigest()
    alpha = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
    n, out = int(h[:24], 16), []
    for _ in range(14):
        n, r = divmod(n, 36)
        out.append(alpha[r])
    return ''.join(out)


def _tree(sha):
    """One level of the upstream git tree."""
    req = urllib.request.Request(TREES + urllib.parse.quote(sha),
                                 headers={'User-Agent': 'pg-art', 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
        d = json.load(r)
    if d.get('truncated'):
        raise SystemExit('upstream tree listing came back TRUNCATED -- refusing to build on it')
    return d['tree']


def load_listing(refresh):
    p = os.path.join(SPR, 'upstream_files.json')
    if refresh or not os.path.exists(p):
        # The recursive whole-repo listing returns HTTP 500 since 2026-09-30, so walk
        # Images/Pokemon* one level at a time instead (a handful of small calls).
        images = next(t['sha'] for t in _tree('master') if t['path'] == 'Images' and t['type'] == 'tree')
        todo = [('Images/' + t['path'], t['sha']) for t in _tree(images)
                if t['type'] == 'tree' and t['path'].startswith('Pokemon')]
        files = []
        while todo:
            base, sha = todo.pop()
            for t in _tree(sha):
                path = base + '/' + t['path']
                if t['type'] == 'tree':
                    todo.append((path, t['sha']))
                elif t['type'] == 'blob' and path.endswith('.png'):
                    files.append(path)
        files.sort()
        json.dump(files, open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
        print('refreshed upstream listing: %d pokemon images' % len(files))
    return json.load(open(p, encoding='utf-8'))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=24)
    ap.add_argument('--no-refresh', action='store_true')
    a = ap.parse_args()
    os.makedirs(SPR, exist_ok=True)

    paths = {p.split('/')[-1]: p for p in load_listing(not a.no_refresh)}
    print('upstream icon files: %d' % len(paths))

    # index every icon by (dex, form, costume, gender, shiny)
    icons = {}
    forms_of = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for n in paths:
        m = re.match(r'pm(\d+)((?:\.[a-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*)\.icon\.png$', n)
        if not m:
            continue
        dex, rest = int(m.group(1)), m.group(2)
        f = c = g = ''
        s = False
        for part in [x for x in rest.split('.') if x]:
            if part == 's':
                s = True
            elif part[0] == 'f':
                f = part[1:]
            elif part[0] == 'c':
                c = part[1:]
            elif part[0] == 'g':
                g = part[1:]
        icons[(dex, f, c, g, s)] = n
        if f:
            forms_of[dex].add(f)

    form_enum = {int(k): v for k, v in json.load(
        open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'form_enum.json'), encoding='utf-8')).items()}
    cos_enum = {int(k): v for k, v in json.load(
        open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'costume_enum.json'), encoding='utf-8')).items()}

    # normalised token lookup per dex, so 'FlyingOkinawa' finds 'FLYING_OKINAWA'
    tok_by_dex = collections.defaultdict(dict)
    cos_by_dex = collections.defaultdict(dict)
    for (dex, f, c, g, s), n in icons.items():
        if f:
            tok_by_dex[dex].setdefault(norm(f), f)
        if c:
            cos_by_dex[dex].setdefault(norm(c), c)

    def form_token(dex, form_id, species):
        """numeric form -> the upstream token for THIS dex, or '' for the plain form

        Upstream is inconsistent about whether the token repeats the species: Rattata Alola is
        'pm19.fALOLA' but Unown A is 'pm201.fUNOWN_A' and Burmy Plant is 'pm412.fBURMY_PLANT'.
        Our enum name always carries the species ('UnownA', 'RattataAlola'), so try it BOTH ways --
        as-is and with the species prefix stripped. Missing this cost 114 pokemon their art.
        """
        name = form_enum.get(form_id or 0, '')
        if not name or name.lower() in ('unset', 'normal'):
            return ''
        cands = [name]
        s = name
        sp = species or ''
        bare = re.sub(r'\s*\(.*\)\s*$', '', sp)         # 'Minior (Core)' -> 'Minior'
        for cand in (sp, sp.replace(' ', ''), sp.replace('_', ''), bare, bare.replace(' ', '')):
            if cand and s.lower().startswith(cand.lower()):
                cands.append(s[len(cand):])
                break
        for cd in cands:
            tok = tok_by_dex[dex].get(norm(cd), '')
            if tok:
                return tok
        return ''

    def cos_token(dex, cos_id):
        name = cos_enum.get(cos_id or 0, '')
        if not name or name.lower() == 'unset':
            return ''
        return cos_by_dex[dex].get(norm(name), '')

    def pick(dex, f, c, g, shiny):
        """most specific existing icon; shiny-first, then the same ladder without shiny"""
        ladder = [(f, c, g), (f, c, ''), (f, '', g), ('', c, g),
                  (f, '', ''), ('', c, ''), ('', '', g), ('', '', '')]
        for want_shiny in ((True, False) if shiny else (False,)):
            for ff, cc, gg in ladder:
                n = icons.get((dex, ff, cc, gg, want_shiny))
                if n:
                    return n
        return None

    # ---------- resolve every pokemon in the bag ----------
    con = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db'))
    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    rows = con.execute('SELECT uid_hex, pokemon_id, species_name, fresh_form, form, fresh_costume, '
                       'fresh_shiny, gender FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1').fetchall()
    print('bag: %d' % len(rows))

    plan = {}                      # imageId -> upstream filename
    image_map, source_map, missing = {}, {}, []
    n_shiny = n_shiny_ok = n_cos = n_cos_ok = 0
    for r in rows:
        dex = r['pokemon_id']
        fid = r['fresh_form'] if r['fresh_form'] is not None else r['form']
        f = form_token(dex, fid, r['species_name'])
        c = cos_token(dex, r['fresh_costume'])
        g = '2' if r['gender'] == 2 else ''
        shiny = bool(r['fresh_shiny'])
        if shiny:
            n_shiny += 1
        if r['fresh_costume']:
            n_cos += 1
        fn = pick(dex, f, c, g, shiny)
        if not fn:
            missing.append(r['species_name'])
            continue
        iid = image_id('pgimg:' + r['uid_hex'])
        plan[iid] = fn
        image_map[r['uid_hex']] = iid
        source_map[r['uid_hex']] = fn
        if shiny and '.s.' in fn:
            n_shiny_ok += 1
        if r['fresh_costume'] and '.c' in fn:
            n_cos_ok += 1

    # ---------- mega art for every mega species the user owns ----------
    mega_species = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for (dex, f, c, g, s), n in icons.items():
        if f.startswith('MEGA') and not c and not g:
            mega_species[dex].add(f)
    print('mega species upstream: %d' % len(mega_species))

    mega_map, mega_fields = {}, {}
    for r in rows:
        dex = r['pokemon_id']
        if dex not in mega_species:
            continue
        toks = mega_species[dex]
        slots = ([('MEGA_X', 'megaImageId1'), ('MEGA_Y', 'megaImageId2')]
                 if 'MEGA_X' in toks else [('MEGA', 'megaImageId1')])
        shiny = bool(r['fresh_shiny'])
        for tok, field in slots:
            if tok not in toks:
                continue
            fn = (icons.get((dex, tok, '', '', True)) if shiny else None) \
                or icons.get((dex, tok, '', '', False))
            if not fn:
                continue
            mid = image_id('pgmega:%s:%s' % (tok, r['uid_hex']))
            plan[mid] = fn
            mega_map[mid] = fn
            mega_fields.setdefault(r['uid_hex'], {})[field] = mid

    # ---------- Pokedex art, OWNED species only ----------
    existing = [l.strip() for l in open(os.path.join(WORK, 'pokedex_names.txt'), encoding='utf-8')
                if l.strip()]
    owned = {int(re.match(r'pokedex_(\d+)', n).group(1)) for n in existing
             if re.match(r'pokedex_(\d+)', n)}
    owned |= {r['pokemon_id'] for r in rows}

    dex_plan = {}
    for nm in existing:                                   # replace every old scan photo
        m = re.match(r'pokedex_(\d+)(?:_(.+))?$', nm)
        if not m:
            continue
        dex, suf = int(m.group(1)), m.group(2)
        tok = ''
        if suf:
            want = norm(PG_SUFFIX.get(suf, suf))
            tok = tok_by_dex[dex].get(want, '')
            if not tok:                      # upstream may prefix the species: Plant -> BURMY_PLANT
                for k, v in tok_by_dex[dex].items():
                    if k.endswith(want):
                        tok = v
                        break
        fn = pick(dex, tok, '', '', False)
        if fn:
            dex_plan[nm[len('pokedex_'):]] = fn
    n_repl = len(dex_plan)
    n_mega_dex = n_fill = 0
    for dex, toks in mega_species.items():                 # mega tiles, owned only
        if dex not in owned:
            continue
        for tok, suf in (('MEGA', 'Mega'), ('MEGA_X', 'MegaX'), ('MEGA_Y', 'MegaY')):
            if tok in toks:
                k = '%d_%s' % (dex, suf)
                if k not in dex_plan:
                    dex_plan[k] = icons[(dex, tok, '', '', False)]
                    n_mega_dex += 1
    for dex in sorted(owned):                              # base tiles, owned only
        if str(dex) in dex_plan:
            continue
        fn = pick(dex, '', '', '', False)
        if fn:
            dex_plan[str(dex)] = fn
            n_fill += 1

    # ---------- download everything referenced, once ----------
    need = sorted(set(plan.values()) | set(dex_plan.values()))
    print('distinct upstream images referenced: %d' % len(need))
    failed = []

    def fetch(fn):
        dest = os.path.join(SPR, fn)
        if os.path.exists(dest) and os.path.getsize(dest) > 500:
            return
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(RAW + urllib.parse.quote(paths[fn]),
                                         headers={'User-Agent': 'pg-art'})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=40) as r:
                b = r.read()
            if len(b) > 500:
                open(dest, 'wb').write(b)
                return
        except Exception:
            pass
        with _lock:
            failed.append(fn)

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=a.jobs) as ex:
        for i, _ in enumerate(ex.map(fetch, need), 1):
            if i % 500 == 0:
                print('  downloaded %d/%d  failed %d' % (i, len(need), len(failed)))
    if failed:
        print('DOWNLOAD FAILURES: %d  e.g. %s' % (len(failed), failed[:6]))
    bad = set(failed)

    # ---------- write the three payloads ----------
    td, md, pd = (os.path.join(OUT, 'scan_thumb'), os.path.join(OUT, 'mega_thumb'),
                  os.path.join(OUT, 'pokedex_art'))
    for d in (td, md, pd):
        shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
        os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)

    n_t = n_m = 0
    for iid, fn in plan.items():
        if fn in bad:
            continue
        dest = md if iid in mega_map else td
        shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(SPR, fn), os.path.join(dest, iid + '.jpg'))
        if dest is md:
            n_m += 1
        else:
            n_t += 1
    n_d = 0
    for k, fn in dex_plan.items():
        if fn in bad:
            continue
        data = open(os.path.join(SPR, fn), 'rb').read()
        open(os.path.join(pd, 'pokedex_' + k), 'wb').write(data)
        open(os.path.join(pd, 'i_df_%s.jpg' % k), 'wb').write(data)
        n_d += 1

    json.dump(image_map, open(os.path.join(OUT, 'image_map.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
    json.dump(source_map, open(os.path.join(OUT, 'source_map.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=0)
    json.dump(mega_map, open(os.path.join(OUT, 'mega_map.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
    json.dump(mega_fields, open(os.path.join(OUT, 'mega_fields.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
    json.dump(dex_plan, open(os.path.join(OUT, 'pokedex_art_map.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=0)

    print()
    print('=== COLLECTION ===')
    print('  thumbnails written : %d / %d bag (%.1f%%)' % (n_t, len(rows), n_t / len(rows) * 100))
    n_shiny_art = sum(1 for r in rows if r['fresh_shiny'] and r['uid_hex'] in image_map)
    print('  shinies            : %d, of which got art %d, shiny-accurate %d (%.1f%% of those with art)'
          % (n_shiny, n_shiny_art, n_shiny_ok, n_shiny_ok / max(n_shiny_art, 1) * 100))
    print('  costumed           : %d, costume-accurate art %d (%.1f%%)'
          % (n_cos, n_cos_ok, n_cos_ok / max(n_cos, 1) * 100))
    print('  no art at all      : %d across %d species' % (len(missing), len(set(missing))))
    print('=== MEGA ===')
    print('  mega images        : %d for %d pokemon' % (n_m, len(mega_fields)))
    print('=== POKEDEX / RAID TILES ===')
    print('  old photos replaced: %d' % n_repl)
    print('  mega tiles added   : %d' % n_mega_dex)
    print('  base tiles filled  : %d' % n_fill)
    print('  total written      : %d entries (%d files), owned species only' % (n_d, n_d * 2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
import json, os, urllib.request, urllib.error, threading, urllib.parse
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
RAW = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/master/'
up = {p.split('/')[-1]: p for p in json.load(open('sprites/upstream_files.json'))}
need = json.load(open('sprites/still_need.json'))
lock = threading.Lock(); ok = {}; bad = []
def go(item):
    key, nm = item
    dest = os.path.join('sprites', nm)
    if os.path.exists(dest) and os.path.getsize(dest) > 500:
        with lock: ok[key] = nm
        return
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(RAW + urllib.parse.quote(up[nm]), headers={'User-Agent': 'pg'})
        b = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30).read()
        if len(b) > 500:
            open(dest, 'wb').write(b)
            with lock: ok[key] = nm
            return
    except Exception as e:
        pass
    with lock: bad.append(key)
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=24) as ex:
```

`pokegenie_work/fetch_all_sprites.py`:

```py
"""Download EVERY Pokemon GO icon (pm*.icon.png) from PokeMiners/pogo_assets that is not already in
pokegenie_work/sprites. Live tree listing (abort if truncated), same raw URL scheme as dl_now.py,
each file verified as PNG with the exact upstream byte size. Never overwrites existing files."""
import json, os, re, sys, time, threading, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

SPR = r"C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance\pokegenie_work\sprites"
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
API = "https://api.github.com/repos/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/git/trees/master?recursive=1"
RAW = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/master/"
D256 = "Images/Pokemon - 256x256/Addressable Assets/"
DREG = "Images/Pokemon/Addressable Assets/"
ICON = re.compile(r"pm(\d+).*\.icon\.png$")

H = {"User-Agent": "pg-sprites", "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}
_cache = {}

def subtree(sha):
    """One NON-recursive tree level (the recursive whole-repo listing 500s server-side)."""
    if sha not in _cache:
        for attempt in range(4):
            try:
                url = "https://api.github.com/repos/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/git/trees/" + urllib.parse.quote(sha)
                t = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers=H), timeout=120))
                break
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                if e.code in (500, 502, 503) and attempt < 3:
                    time.sleep(3 * (attempt + 1)); continue
                raise
        if t.get("truncated"):
            sys.exit("ABORT: live tree listing is truncated at " + sha)
        _cache[sha] = t["tree"]
    return _cache[sha]

def folder(path):
    sha = "master"
    for part in path.strip("/").split("/"):
        hit = [e for e in subtree(sha) if e["path"] == part and e["type"] == "tree"]
        if not hit:
            sys.exit("ABORT: upstream folder missing: " + path)
        sha = hit[0]["sha"]
    return {e["path"]: e for e in subtree(sha) if e["type"] == "blob" and ICON.match(e["path"])}

d256 = folder(D256)
dreg = folder(DREG)
json.dump({"d256": d256, "dreg": dreg}, open(os.path.join(SCR, "tree_live.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8"))

# which upstream folder the existing local files came from (byte-size match), so new files match them
local = {f: os.path.getsize(os.path.join(SPR, f)) for f in os.listdir(SPR) if f.endswith(".png")}
m256 = sum(1 for f, s in local.items() if f in d256 and d256[f]["size"] == s)
mreg = sum(1 for f, s in local.items() if f in dreg and dreg[f]["size"] == s)
print(f"live tree ok | 256-folder icons {len(d256)} | regular-folder icons {len(dreg)} | local pngs {len(local)}")
print(f"local files byte-identical to: 256-folder {m256}, regular-folder {mreg}")
src = d256 if m256 >= mreg else dreg
srcdir = D256 if src is d256 else DREG
extra = {n: b for n, b in (dreg if src is d256 else d256).items() if n not in src}
print(f"using {srcdir!r}; names only in the other folder: {len(extra)}")
allicons = dict(extra)
allicons.update(src)
allicons = {n: (b, (srcdir if n in src else (DREG if srcdir == D256 else D256))) for n, b in allicons.items()}

up_dex = {int(ICON.match(n).group(1)) for n in allicons}
todo = [(n, b, d) for n, (b, d) in allicons.items() if n not in local]
print(f"upstream species {len(up_dex & set(range(1, 1026)))}/1025 | to download {len(todo)} files, "
      f"{sum(b['size'] for n, b, d in todo) / 1e6:.1f} MB")
stale = sum(1 for n, (b, d) in allicons.items() if n in local and local[n] != b["size"] and d == srcdir)
print(f"existing local files whose upstream copy changed since (left untouched): {stale}")

lock = threading.Lock(); ok = []; bad = []

def go(item):
    n, b, d = item
    url = RAW + urllib.parse.quote(d + n)
    for attempt in range(4):
        try:
            data = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "pg-sprites"}), timeout=45).read()
            if data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" and len(data) == b["size"]:
                tmp = os.path.join(SPR, n + ".part")
                open(tmp, "wb").write(data)
                os.replace(tmp, os.path.join(SPR, n))
                with lock: ok.append(n)
                return
            err = f"bad content ({len(data)} B vs {b['size']})"
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            err = f"HTTP {e.code}"
        except Exception as e:
            err = type(e).__name__
        time.sleep(1.5 * (attempt + 1))
    with lock: bad.append((n, err))

t0 = time.time()
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=24) as ex:
    for i, _ in enumerate(ex.map(go, todo), 1):
        if i % 300 == 0:
            print(f"  {i}/{len(todo)}  ok {len(ok)}  failed {len(bad)}  {time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)

now = [f for f in os.listdir(SPR) if f.endswith(".png")]
now_dex = {int(ICON.match(f).group(1)) for f in now if ICON.match(f)}
print(f"\nDOWNLOADED {len(ok)} | FAILED {len(bad)} {bad[:10]}")
print(f"local pngs now {len(now)} | species covered {len(now_dex & set(range(1, 1026)))}/1025 | "
      f"shiny {sum(1 for f in now if '.s.icon' in f)}")
print("upstream species still not local:", sorted(up_dex - now_dex))
print("species with no PoGo icon upstream:", sorted(set(range(1, 1026)) - up_dex))
old = json.load(open(os.path.join(SPR, "_tree_raw.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
old_n = {b["path"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1] for b in old["tree"] if b["type"] == "blob" and ICON.match(b["path"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1])}
print("new upstream icons since the Sept 2 listing:", len(set(allicons) - old_n))
```

`pokegenie_work/fetch_sprites.py`:

```py
"""Fetch the official Pokemon GO icon sprites for every pokemon in the bag, shiny-accurate.

Why this exists: every on-device source was exhausted first and each was a dead end --
  * PoGo UnityCache (2GB, 13,984 bundles): 488 hold Texture2D, all 1,009 are avatar clothing/scenery.
  * PoGo DiskCache (938 files): PokeStop photos and item icons, no pokemon.
  * Live IL2CPP: 243 Texture2D objects exist, but they are GPU-side and not CPU-readable, so
    ImageConversion.EncodeToPNG returns nothing.
  * PokeGenie app_imageDir: 864 species-art files, no shiny and no costume variants, 136 species missing.
The game streams pokemon icons from Niantic's CDN on demand, so the art genuinely is not on the phone for
anything the user has not recently viewed. These are the same icons the game renders.

Naming: pokemon_icon_<dex:3>_<form:2>[_shiny].png  (form 00 = base). Regional/costume forms use higher
form numbers; we try the specific form first and fall back to 00 so a mon never gets a WRONG species.

    python fetch_sprites.py [--out sprites] [--limit N]
"""
import argparse, json, os, sqlite3, sys, time, urllib.error, urllib.request

ROOT = r"C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance\pogo_extract"
BASE = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/master/Images/Pokemon/"

# form_region -> the form suffix Niantic uses in the icon filename
REGION_FORM = {'alolan': 61, 'galarian': 62, 'hisuian': 63, 'paldean': 64}


def candidates(dex, form_region, shiny):
    """Filenames to try, most specific first."""
    out = []
    reg = (form_region or '').strip().lower()
    fnum = REGION_FORM.get(reg)
    suf = '_shiny' if shiny else ''
    if fnum is not None:
        out.append('pokemon_icon_%03d_%02d%s.png' % (dex, fnum, suf))
    out.append('pokemon_icon_%03d_00%s.png' % (dex, suf))
    if shiny:                     # last resort: non-shiny art rather than nothing
        if fnum is not None:
            out.append('pokemon_icon_%03d_%02d.png' % (dex, fnum))
        out.append('pokemon_icon_%03d_00.png' % dex)
    return out


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--out', default=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'sprites'))
    ap.add_argument('--limit', type=int, default=0)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    os.makedirs(a.out, exist_ok=True)

    con = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db'))
    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    rows = con.execute('SELECT DISTINCT pokemon_id, form_region, fresh_shiny FROM pokemon '
                       'WHERE in_bag=1').fetchall()
    # one download per distinct (dex, region, shiny) -- ~1.5k at most, not 5,592
    want = sorted({(r['pokemon_id'], (r['form_region'] or '').strip().lower(), 1 if r['fresh_shiny'] else 0)
                   for r in rows})
    if a.limit:
        want = want[:a.limit]
    print('distinct (dex, region, shiny) combinations needed: %d' % len(want))

    got, missing, cached = {}, [], 0
    for i, (dex, reg, shiny) in enumerate(want, 1):
        key = '%d|%s|%d' % (dex, reg, shiny)
        hit = None
        for fn in candidates(dex, reg, shiny):
            dest = os.path.join(a.out, fn)
            if os.path.exists(dest) and os.path.getsize(dest) > 500:
                hit = fn
                cached += 1
                break
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(BASE + fn, timeout=25) as r:
                    b = r.read()
                if len(b) > 500:
                    open(dest, 'wb').write(b)
                    hit = fn
                    break
            except urllib.error.HTTPError:
                continue           # this form does not exist upstream; try the next candidate
            except Exception as e:
                print('  net error on %s: %s' % (fn, e))
                time.sleep(1.5)
                continue
        if hit:
            got[key] = hit
        else:
            missing.append(key)
        if i % 100 == 0:
            print('  %d/%d  (have %d, missing %d)' % (i, len(want), len(got), len(missing)))

    json.dump(got, open(os.path.join(a.out, 'sprite_index.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=0)
    print('\nfetched/……cached: %d  (already on disk: %d)' % (len(got), cached))
    print('no upstream art: %d  %s' % (len(missing), missing[:10]))
    print('wrote %s' % os.path.join(a.out, 'sprite_index.json'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`pokegenie_work/fetch_sprites2.py`:

```py
"""Download the OFFICIAL PoGo icon for every distinct pokemon variant in the bag -- form, costume and
shiny accurate -- matching against the mirror's REAL filenames instead of guessing form numbers.

The first attempt guessed a numeric form id and failed on 536 combinations (Unown, Deoxys, Burmy, ...).
The mirror actually names files:

    pm<dex>[.f<FORM>][.c<COSTUME>][.g<GENDER>][.s].icon.png        .s = shiny

with FORM/COSTUME as NAMES, not numbers. Our DB stores a numeric `form` whose name is in
pogo_extract/form_enum.json (e.g. 1 -> 'UnownA', 963 -> 'RattataAlola'), so the form NAME is recoverable.
The enum name embeds the species ('UnownA', 'PikachuFlyingOkinawa'), while upstream uses only the variant
part ('.fA', '.fALOLA'), so we strip the species prefix and upper-case the remainder.

Matching is STRICTLY most-specific-first and always ends at the plain base form. A candidate is only used
if it EXISTS in the upstream listing, so a mon can never be given another species' picture -- if nothing
matches, it gets no art at all (PokeGenie then shows its own default).

    python fetch_sprites2.py [--jobs 16]
"""
import argparse, json, os, re, sqlite3, sys, threading, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(HERE), 'pogo_extract')
OUT = os.path.join(HERE, 'sprites')
RAW = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/master/'

_lock = threading.Lock()


def load_upstream():
    paths = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT, 'upstream_files.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    by_name = {}
    for p in paths:
        by_name[p.split('/')[-1]] = p
    return by_name


def variant_suffix(form_name, species):
    """'UnownA' + species 'Unown' -> 'A';  'RattataAlola' -> 'ALOLA';  '' when it is just the species."""
    if not form_name:
        return ''
    s = form_name
    for cand in (species, species.replace(' ', ''), species.replace('_', '')):
        if cand and s.lower().startswith(cand.lower()):
            s = s[len(cand):]
            break
    s = s.strip('_')
    if s.lower() in ('', 'normal', 'unset'):
        return ''
    return re.sub(r'(?<!^)(?=[A-Z])', '_', s).upper()


def candidates(dex, form_name, species, costume_name, shiny, upstream):
    """Ordered, most specific first; only names that actually exist upstream survive."""
    fv = variant_suffix(form_name, species)
    parts = []
    if costume_name:
        parts.append('.c' + costume_name.upper())
    if fv:
        parts.append('.f' + fv)
    out = []
    # every combination of the qualifiers we have, longest first, then bare
    for combo in ([''.join(parts)] if parts else []) + (['.f' + fv] if fv else []) + \
                 (['.c' + costume_name.upper()] if costume_name else []) + ['']:
        for suf in (('.s', '') if shiny else ('',)):
            nm = 'pm%d%s%s.icon.png' % (dex, combo, suf)
            if nm in upstream and nm not in out:
                out.append(nm)
    return out


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=16)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

    upstream = load_upstream()
    print('upstream pokemon images: %d' % len(upstream))
    fe = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'form_enum.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    form_name = {int(k): v for k, v in fe.items()} if isinstance(fe, dict) else {}

    con = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db'))
    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    rows = con.execute('SELECT pokemon_id, species_name, form, fresh_costume, fresh_shiny '
                       'FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1').fetchall()

    combos = {}
    for r in rows:
        key = '%d|%s|%s|%d' % (r['pokemon_id'], r['form'] or 0, r['fresh_costume'] or 0,
                               1 if r['fresh_shiny'] else 0)
        if key not in combos:
            combos[key] = (r['pokemon_id'], form_name.get(r['form'] or 0, ''), r['species_name'],
                           '', 1 if r['fresh_shiny'] else 0)
    print('distinct variants in bag: %d' % len(combos))

    index, missing = {}, []

    def work(item):
        key, (dex, fname, species, cos, shiny) = item
        cands = candidates(dex, fname, species, cos, shiny, upstream)
        if not cands:
            with _lock:
                missing.append(key)
            return
        for nm in cands:
            dest = os.path.join(OUT, nm)
            if os.path.exists(dest) and os.path.getsize(dest) > 500:
                with _lock:
                    index[key] = nm
                return
            for attempt in range(3):
                try:
                    req = urllib.request.Request(RAW + upstream[nm], headers={'User-Agent': 'pg-sprites'})
                    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                        b = resp.read()
                    if len(b) > 500:
                        open(dest, 'wb').write(b)
                        with _lock:
                            index[key] = nm
                        return
                    break
                except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                    if e.code in (429, 500, 502, 503):
                        time.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1))
                        continue
                    break
                except Exception:
                    time.sleep(1.5)
        with _lock:
            missing.append(key)

    items = list(combos.items())
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=a.jobs) as ex:
        for i, _ in enumerate(ex.map(work, items), 1):
            if i % 250 == 0:
                print('  %d/%d  have %d  missing %d' % (i, len(items), len(index), len(missing)))

    json.dump(index, open(os.path.join(OUT, 'sprite_index.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=0)
    print('\nmatched %d/%d variants (%.1f%%)' % (len(index), len(combos), len(index) / len(combos) * 100))
    print('no upstream art: %d  e.g. %s' % (len(missing), missing[:8]))
    print('wrote %s' % os.path.join(OUT, 'sprite_index.json'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`pokegenie_work/fill_dex_forms.py`:

```py
"""Give EVERY (dex, form) the user actually owns a Pokedex tile -- not just the ones PokeGenie
had already downloaded.

User 2026-09-03: "im pretty sure i have a galar rapidash, why isnt the photo loading?" -- correct.
build_art.py replaced the 864 Pokedex files PokeGenie already had and added base art per owned species,
but a regional/alternate form PokeGenie had NEVER downloaded got no tile at all. Galarian Rapidash is
one of those: its collection thumbnail was right (pm78.fGALARIAN) while the Pokedex tile was absent.

The authoritative key is the scan entry's own `form` value: PokeGenie renders a Pokedex entry from
`app_imageDir/i_df_<pokemonNumber>[_<form>].jpg` (and its `pokedex_...` twin), where <form> is exactly
the string written into the scan record. So the complete set of tiles the user needs is precisely the
distinct (pokemonNumber, form) pairs present in scan_data.json.

Resolution is most-specific-first against the live upstream listing and always ends at the plain base
form, so a form can never be given another species' art.

    python fill_dex_forms.py
"""
import collections, json, os, re, threading, urllib.parse, urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WORK = os.path.join(BASE, 'pokegenie_work')
OUT = os.path.join(BASE, 'pokegenie_out')
SPR = os.path.join(WORK, 'sprites')
ART = os.path.join(OUT, 'pokedex_art')
RAW = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/master/'
_lock = threading.Lock()

# PokeGenie's scan `form` value -> upstream form token, where normalising alone will not get there
FORM_TOKEN = {
    'Alola': 'ALOLA', 'Galarian': 'GALARIAN', 'Hisuian': 'HISUIAN', 'Paldean': 'PALDEA',
    'Mega': 'MEGA', 'MegaX': 'MEGA_X', 'MegaY': 'MEGA_Y',
    'Deoxysattack': 'ATTACK', 'Deoxysdefense': 'DEFENSE',
    'zyg10': 'TEN_PERCENT', 'formFour': 'FIFTY_PERCENT',
    'OriBaile': 'BAILE', 'OriPau': 'PAU', 'OriPom': 'POM_POM', 'OriSensu': 'SENSU',
    'FormMidday': 'MIDDAY', 'FormMidnight': 'MIDNIGHT',
    'Sword': 'CROWNED_SWORD', 'Shield': 'CROWNED_SHIELD',
}

norm = lambda s: re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', (s or '').lower())


def main():
    paths = {p.split('/')[-1]: p for p in
             json.load(open(os.path.join(SPR, 'upstream_files.json'), encoding='utf-8'))}
    icons, tok_by_dex, base = {}, collections.defaultdict(dict), {}
    for n in paths:
        m = re.match(r'pm(\d+)\.f([A-Z0-9_]+)\.icon\.png$', n)
        if m:
            dex, tok = int(m.group(1)), m.group(2)
            icons[(dex, tok)] = n
            tok_by_dex[dex].setdefault(norm(tok), tok)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'pm(\d+)\.icon\.png$', n)
        if m:
            base[int(m.group(1))] = n

    data = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT, 'scan_data.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    entries = data if isinstance(data, list) else (data.get('scans') or list(data.values())[0])
    pairs = collections.Counter()
    for e in entries:
        pairs[(e.get('pokemonNumber'), e.get('form') or '')] += 1
    print('distinct (dex, form) the user owns: %d' % len(pairs))

    have = {f for f in os.listdir(ART)} if os.path.isdir(ART) else set()
    want, missing_art, already = {}, [], 0
    for (dex, form), n in pairs.items():
        if not dex:
            continue
        key = '%d_%s' % (dex, form) if form else str(dex)
        if 'pokedex_' + key in have:
            already += 1
            continue
        tok = ''
        if form:
            t = FORM_TOKEN.get(form, form)
            tok = tok_by_dex[dex].get(norm(t), '')
            if not tok:                      # upstream may prefix the species: Plant -> BURMY_PLANT
                for k, v in tok_by_dex[dex].items():
                    if k.endswith(norm(t)):
                        tok = v
                        break
        fn = icons.get((dex, tok)) if tok else None
        fn = fn or base.get(dex)
        if not fn:
            missing_art.append((dex, form, n))
            continue
        want[key] = fn

    print('  already have a tile : %d' % already)
    print('  NEW tiles to write  : %d' % len(want))
    if missing_art:
        print('  no upstream art     : %s' % missing_art[:8])

    failed = []

    def fetch(item):
        key, fn = item
        src = os.path.join(SPR, fn)
        if not (os.path.exists(src) and os.path.getsize(src) > 500):
            try:
                req = urllib.request.Request(RAW + urllib.parse.quote(paths[fn]),
                                             headers={'User-Agent': 'pg-dexform'})
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=40) as r:
                    b = r.read()
                if len(b) <= 500:
                    with _lock:
                        failed.append(key)
                    return
                open(src, 'wb').write(b)
            except Exception:
                with _lock:
                    failed.append(key)
                return
        data = open(src, 'rb').read()
        open(os.path.join(ART, 'pokedex_' + key), 'wb').write(data)
        open(os.path.join(ART, 'i_df_%s.jpg' % key), 'wb').write(data)

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=24) as ex:
        list(ex.map(fetch, want.items()))

    print('wrote %d new tiles (%d files); failures: %d'
          % (len(want) - len(failed), (len(want) - len(failed)) * 2, len(failed)))
    for probe in ('78_Galarian', '77_Galarian', '78', '58_Hisuian'):
        print('  %-14s -> %s' % (probe, os.path.exists(os.path.join(ART, 'i_df_%s.jpg' % probe))))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`pokegenie_work/fill_dex_from_account.py`:

```py
"""Fill PokeGenie's Pokedex art from the LIVE PoGo account dex -- every species and form actually caught.

User 2026-09-03: "i meant the actual list of pokemon i have in my actual pogo account". Right: the bag
(pokemon.db in_bag=1) is only what is currently held, so a species or form caught and later transferred
had no tile, and forms PokeGenie had never downloaded had none either. The recrawl's read_dex step writes
the real thing:

Two passes, both most-specific-first and always ending at real art for THAT dex, so a species can never
be given another species' picture:
  1. base tile for every caught species. Some species have NO bare pm<dex>.icon.png upstream (Unown,
     Spinda, Burmy, Wormadam, Cherrim, Shellos, Gastrodon, Basculin) -- those fall back to a
     representative form icon instead of being left blank, which is what left holes in the dex.
  2. a tile per caught FORM, keyed the way PokeGenie names them (i_df_<dex>_<Form>.jpg, e.g.
     78_Galarian). A suffix PokeGenie does not happen to use is simply an unused file -- harmless.

Writes into pokegenie_out/pokedex_art/ alongside the existing tiles.

    python fill_dex_from_account.py
"""
import collections, json, os, re, threading, urllib.parse, urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
ROOT = os.path.join(BASE, 'pogo_extract')
WORK = os.path.join(BASE, 'pokegenie_work')
ART = os.path.join(BASE, 'pokegenie_out', 'pokedex_art')
SPR = os.path.join(WORK, 'sprites')
RAW = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/master/'
_lock = threading.Lock()

# our form-enum tail -> the suffix PokeGenie uses in its Pokedex filenames
PG_SUFFIX = {
    'Alolan': 'Alola', 'Alola': 'Alola', 'Galarian': 'Galarian', 'Hisuian': 'Hisuian',
    'Paldea': 'Paldean', 'Paldean': 'Paldean',
}
norm = lambda s: re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', (s or '').lower())


def main():
    paths = {p.split('/')[-1]: p for p in
             json.load(open(os.path.join(SPR, 'upstream_files.json'), encoding='utf-8'))}
    icons, tok_by_dex, base, any_form = {}, collections.defaultdict(dict), {}, collections.defaultdict(list)
    for n in paths:
        m = re.match(r'pm(\d+)\.f([A-Z0-9_]+)\.icon\.png$', n)
        if m:
            dex, tok = int(m.group(1)), m.group(2)
            icons[(dex, tok)] = n
            tok_by_dex[dex].setdefault(norm(tok), tok)
            any_form[dex].append((tok, n))
            continue
        m = re.match(r'pm(\d+)\.icon\.png$', n)
        if m:
            base[int(m.group(1))] = n

    caught = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'dex_caught.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    caught_forms = {int(k): v for k, v in
                    json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'dex_caught_forms.json'), encoding='utf-8')).items()}
    form_enum = {int(k): v for k, v in
                 json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'form_enum.json'), encoding='utf-8')).items()}
    print('live account dex: %d species caught, %d with form detail'
          % (len(caught), len(caught_forms)))

    con = None
    try:
        import sqlite3
        con = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db'))
        species = {r[0]: r[1] for r in con.execute(
            'SELECT DISTINCT pokemon_id, species_name FROM pokemon')}
    except Exception:
        species = {}

    def base_art(dex):
        if dex in base:
            return base[dex]
        for pref in ('NORMAL', 'INCARNATE', 'ALTERED', 'PLANT', 'ARIA', 'MIDDAY', 'HERO',
                     'SPRING', 'WEST', 'RED_STRIPED', 'OVERCAST', 'UNOWN_A'):
            if (dex, pref) in icons:
                return icons[(dex, pref)]
        f = sorted(any_form.get(dex) or [])
        return f[0][1] if f else None

    def form_suffix_and_art(dex, fid):
        name = form_enum.get(fid or 0, '')
        if not name or name.lower() in ('unset', 'normal'):
            return None, None
        tail = name
        sp = species.get(dex, '')
        for cand in (sp, sp.replace(' ', ''), sp.replace('_', '')):
            if cand and tail.lower().startswith(cand.lower()):
                tail = tail[len(cand):]
                break
        if not tail or tail.lower() == 'normal':
            return None, None
        tok = tok_by_dex[dex].get(norm(name)) or tok_by_dex[dex].get(norm(tail))
        if not tok:
            for k, v in tok_by_dex[dex].items():
                if k.endswith(norm(tail)):
                    tok = v
                    break
        if not tok:
            return None, None
        return PG_SUFFIX.get(tail, tail), icons[(dex, tok)]

    want, no_art, n_base, n_form = {}, [], 0, 0

            key = '%d_%s' % (dex, suf)

                continue
            want[key] = ffn
            n_form += 1

    print('  new form tiles : %d' % n_form)
    print('  species with NO upstream art at all: %d %s' % (len(no_art), no_art[:10]))

    failed = []

    def fetch(item):
        key, fn = item
        src = os.path.join(SPR, fn)
        if not (os.path.exists(src) and os.path.getsize(src) > 500):
            try:
                req = urllib.request.Request(RAW + urllib.parse.quote(paths[fn]),
                                             headers={'User-Agent': 'pg-dexacct'})
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=40) as r:
                    b = r.read()
                if len(b) <= 500:
                    with _lock:
                        failed.append(key)
                    return
                open(src, 'wb').write(b)
            except Exception:
                with _lock:
                    failed.append(key)
                return
        data = open(src, 'rb').read()
        open(os.path.join(ART, 'pokedex_' + key), 'wb').write(data)
        open(os.path.join(ART, 'i_df_%s.jpg' % key), 'wb').write(data)

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=24) as ex:
        list(ex.map(fetch, want.items()))
    print('wrote %d tiles (%d files), failures %d' % (len(want) - len(failed),
                                                      (len(want) - len(failed)) * 2, len(failed)))
    print('total Pokedex tiles now: %d' % len([f for f in os.listdir(ART) if f.startswith('pokedex_')]))
    for probe in ('78_Galarian', '201', '327', '412', '585', '586', '421', '422', '423', '550'):
        print('  i_df_%-12s -> %s' % (probe, os.path.exists(os.path.join(ART, 'i_df_%s.jpg' % probe))))
```

`pokegenie_work/fill_gap.py`:

```py
"""Close the form-art gap: upstream sometimes KEEPS the species prefix (fUNOWN_A, fBURMY_PLANT) and
sometimes drops it (fBLUE, fBLACK). The original matcher always stripped it, so every prefix-keeping
species (Unown letters, Burmy cloaks, ...) found nothing. Try both spellings."""
import json, os, re, sqlite3, threading, urllib.parse, urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

ROOT = '../pogo_extract'
RAW = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/master/'
up = {p.split('/')[-1]: p for p in json.load(open('sprites/upstream_files.json'))}
idx = json.load(open('sprites/sprite_index.json'))
fe = json.load(open(ROOT + '/form_enum.json'))
form_name = {int(k): v for k, v in fe.items()}

def snake(s):
    return re.sub(r'(?<!^)(?=[A-Z])', '_', s).upper().strip('_')

def variants(fname, species):
    """every plausible upstream spelling of this form's suffix"""
    if not fname or fname.lower() in ('unset', 'normal'):
        return []
    out = [snake(fname)]                       # prefix KEPT: UnownA -> UNOWN_A
    s = fname
    for c in (species, species.replace(' ', ''), species.replace('_', '')):
        if c and s.lower().startswith(c.lower()):
            s = s[len(c):]
            break
    s = s.strip('_')
    if s and s.lower() not in ('normal', 'unset'):
        out.append(snake(s))                   # prefix DROPPED: UnownA -> A
    # TRAILING SEGMENT: the species prefix can differ from species_name (form 'FlabebeRed' vs species
    # 'Flabebe' with accents), so prefix-stripping fails. Take the last CamelCase word(s) instead:
    # FlabebeRed -> RED, KyuremNormal -> NORMAL.
    words = re.findall(r'[A-Z][a-z0-9]*', fname)
    if len(words) > 1:
        out.append(words[-1].upper())
        out.append(snake(''.join(words[1:])))
    return [x for x in dict.fromkeys(out) if x]

con = sqlite3.connect(ROOT + '/pokemon.db'); con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
rows = con.execute('SELECT pokemon_id,species_name,form,fresh_shiny FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1').fetchall()

todo = {}
for r in rows:
    key = '%d|%s|%d' % (r['pokemon_id'], r['form'] or 0, 1 if r['fresh_shiny'] else 0)
    if key in idx or key in todo:
        continue
    dex = r['pokemon_id']; shiny = bool(r['fresh_shiny'])
    cands = []
    for v in variants(form_name.get(r['form'] or 0, ''), r['species_name']):
        for suf in (('.s', '') if shiny else ('',)):
            cands.append('pm%d.f%s%s.icon.png' % (dex, v, suf))
    for suf in (('.s', '') if shiny else ('',)):        # bare base form, last resort
        cands.append('pm%d%s.icon.png' % (dex, suf))
    hit = [c for c in cands if c in up]
    if hit:
        todo[key] = hit[0]

print('gap entries with an upstream match: %d' % len(todo))
lock = threading.Lock(); got = {}
def go(kv):
    k, nm = kv
    dest = os.path.join('sprites', nm)
    if os.path.exists(dest) and os.path.getsize(dest) > 500:
        with lock: got[k] = nm
        return
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(RAW + urllib.parse.quote(up[nm]), headers={'User-Agent': 'pg'})
        b = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30).read()
        if len(b) > 500:
            open(dest, 'wb').write(b)
            with lock: got[k] = nm
    except Exception:
        pass
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=24) as ex:
    list(ex.map(go, todo.items()))
idx.update(got)
json.dump(idx, open('sprites/sprite_index.json', 'w'), indent=0)
print('downloaded %d | index now %d' % (len(got), len(idx)))

```

`pokegenie_work/generate_pokegenie.py`:

```py
"""Generate a complete PokeGenie scan_data.json for the user's full current bag,
REPLACING old scans, with imageId from image_map.json when available. Field map reverse-
engineered from 6568 ground-truth entries (workflow wf_024767ce). PvP blocks omitted
(optional; PokeGenie recomputes from the exact IVs).

Two robustness fixes:
 - CPM: ~788 rows have cp_multiplier=0 in the DB -> derive CPM from level instead.
 - Base stats: chosen by which candidate form REPRODUCES the DB CP (self-correcting),
   so misresolved forms (e.g. armored vs regular Mewtwo) get the right maxCP."""
import sqlite3, json, os, sys, datetime
sys.path.insert(0, r"C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance\pogo_extract")
from pvp_iv_rule import pvid

ROOT = r"C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance\pogo_extract"
PGDIR = r"C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance\pokegenie_work\extracted"
OUT = r"C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance\pokegenie_out"

# build_art.py writes image_map.json and scan_thumb/<imageId>.jpg from PokeMiners assets,
# preferring shiny and exact form/costume/gender art. Missing matches omit imageId so
# PokeGenie uses its default. Do not regenerate this map with the old add_images.py workflow.
_imgmap_path = os.path.join(OUT, 'image_map.json')

print('image_map: %d entries' % len(IMAGE_MAP))
# build_art.py also writes mega_fields.json: uid_hex -> {megaImageId1[, megaImageId2]} (the mega art)
_megamap_path = os.path.join(OUT, 'mega_fields.json')
MEGA_FIELDS = json.load(open(_megamap_path, encoding='utf-8')) if os.path.exists(_megamap_path) else {}

mid2name = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'move_id_to_name.json'), encoding='utf-8'))

BY_DEX = {}
for _p in gm['pokemon']:
    _dex, _sid, _bs = _p.get('dex'), _p['speciesId'], _p.get('baseStats', {})
    if not _dex or not _bs or any(x in _sid for x in ('_mega', '_xl')): continue
    key = (_bs.get('atk'), _bs.get('def'), _bs.get('hp'))
    seen = BY_DEX.setdefault(_dex, [])
    if key not in [(b.get('atk'), b.get('def'), b.get('hp')) for b in seen]:
        seen.append(_bs)

CPM50 = 0.84029999
DUST = {1:200,2:200,3:400,4:400,5:600,6:600,7:800,8:800,9:1000,10:1000,11:1300,12:1300,13:1600,
        14:1600,15:1900,16:1900,17:2200,18:2200,19:2500,20:2500,21:3000,22:3000,23:3500,24:3500,
        25:4000,26:4000,27:4500,28:4500,29:5000,30:5000,31:6000,32:6000,33:7000,34:7000,35:8000,
        36:8000,37:9000,38:9000,39:10000,40:10000,41:11000,42:11000,43:12000,44:12000,45:13000,
        46:13000,47:14000,48:14000,49:15000,50:15000}
FORMREG = {'alolan':'Alola','galarian':'Galarian','hisuian':'Hisuian','paldean':'Paldean'}

def movename(mid):
    if not mid: return ""
    raw = mid2name.get(str(int(mid)))
    if not raw: return ""
    base = raw[:-5] if raw.endswith('_FAST') else raw
    nm = GM_NAME.get(base) or GM_NAME.get(raw)
    if nm: return nm
    if base.startswith('HIDDEN_POWER'): return 'Hidden Power'
    return ' '.join(w.capitalize() for w in base.split('_'))

def cp_at(b, a, d, s, cpm):
    return max(10, int((b.get('atk',0)+a) * (b.get('def',0)+d)**0.5 * (b.get('hp',0)+s)**0.5 * cpm*cpm / 10))
def hp_at(b, s, cpm):
    return max(10, int((b.get('hp',0)+s) * cpm))

conn = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db')); conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 ORDER BY pokemon_id, iv_total DESC").fetchall()

# canonical CPM per level (to fill the ~788 rows whose cp_multiplier is 0).
# pass 1: any nonzero total CPM covers the level; pass 2: prefer a clean base CPM.
CPM_BY_LEVEL = {}
for r in rows:
    own = (r['cp_multiplier'] or 0) + (r['additional_cpm'] or 0)
    if own > 0: CPM_BY_LEVEL[r['level']] = own
for r in rows:
    if (r['cp_multiplier'] or 0) > 0 and (r['additional_cpm'] or 0) == 0:
        CPM_BY_LEVEL[r['level']] = r['cp_multiplier']
gaps = sorted(l for l in set(r['level'] for r in rows)
              if l not in CPM_BY_LEVEL and any(((rr['cp_multiplier'] or 0)+(rr['additional_cpm'] or 0))==0 for rr in rows if rr['level']==l))
if gaps: print("WARN zero-CPM rows at levels with NO reference:", gaps)

def cpm_for(r):
    own = (r['cp_multiplier'] or 0) + (r['additional_cpm'] or 0)
    return own if own > 0 else CPM_BY_LEVEL.get(r['level'], 0.094)

def base_for(r, cpm, a, d, s, dbcp):
    """Pick the base-stat set whose CP reproduces the DB CP at this level; else trust pvid."""
    pv = BS.get(pvid(r['species_name'], r['form'] or 0))
    cands = ([pv] if pv else []) + BY_DEX.get(r['pokemon_id'], [])
    for b in cands:
        if dbcp and abs(cp_at(b, a, d, s, cpm) - dbcp) <= 1:
            return b, True
    return (pv or (cands[0] if cands else {})), False

entries = []; matched = fallback = 0
hp_calc = hp_ok = hp_known = 0
for i, r in enumerate(rows):
    a, d, s = r['iv_atk'] or 0, r['iv_def'] or 0, r['iv_sta'] or 0
    lvl = float(r['level'] or 1); lvlstr = f"{lvl:.1f}"
    cpm = cpm_for(r); dbcp = r['cp'] or 0
    base, ok = base_for(r, cpm, a, d, s, dbcp)
    matched += ok; fallback += (not ok)
    # ~half the rows have no stamina in the DB (PokeGenie then shows "HP 0"): compute max HP from the
    # same CP-matched base stats; the rows that do have it check the formula
    hp = r['stamina'] or 0
    if hp:
        hp_known += 1; hp_ok += (ok and hp_at(base, s, cpm) == hp)
    else:
        hp = hp_at(base, s, cpm); hp_calc += 1
    ivpct = (a + d + s) / 45.0
    comb = {"attackIV": a, "defenseIV": d, "staminaIV": s, "pokemonLevel": lvlstr}
    e = {
        "id": str(i), "pokemonNumber": r['pokemon_id'], "pokemonName": r['species_name'],
        "avgAttackIV": a, "minAttackIV": a, "maxAttackIV": a,
        "avgDefenseIV": d, "minDefenseIV": d, "maxDefenseIV": d,
        "avgStaminaIV": s, "minStaminaIV": s, "maxStaminaIV": s,
        "ivPercentage": ivpct, "ivLower": ivpct, "ivUpper": ivpct,
        "cp": dbcp, "hp": hp, "dust": DUST.get(int(lvl), 0),
        "pokemonLevelLower": lvlstr, "pokemonLevelUpper": "",
        "scannedIvComb": comb, "singleValidIvComb": dict(comb), "singleIVComb": True,
        "minBattleIV": a + d, "maxBattleIV": a + d, "setPokemonLevel": round((lvl - 1) * 2),
        "arcAngle": (cpm - 0.094) / (CPM50 - 0.094) * 180, "cpNext": 0,
        "gender": 3 if (r['gender'] in (0, None)) else int(r['gender']),
        "shadowPokemon": int(r['fresh_alignment'] or 0), "isLuckyPokemon": bool(r['is_lucky']),
        "quickMove": movename(r['move1']), "chargeMove": movename(r['move2']),
        "chargeMove2": movename(r['move3']), "hiddenPowerType": "",
        "height": "%.2f" % (r['height_m'] or 0), "weight": "%.2f" % (r['weight_kg'] or 0),
        "maxCPLower": max(cp_at(base, a, d, s, CPM50), dbcp), "maxCPUpper": max(cp_at(base, a, d, s, CPM50), dbcp),
        "maxHPLower": max(hp_at(base, s, CPM50), hp), "maxHPUpper": max(hp_at(base, s, CPM50), hp),
        "buddyBoost": False, "weatherBoost": False, "hatchedFromEgg": bool(r['hatched_from_egg']),
        "defendingGym": False, "favSelection": 0, "capturePriority": 0, "megaSwitched": False,
        "selectedMegaEvol": 0, "userManuallySetPokemonLevel": False, "unread": True,
        "trainerLevel": 0, "appOverallL": "0", "appStatsL": "0",
        "pvpPinned": False, "pvpSelected": False, "pvpStatus": 1,
    }
    reg = (r['form_region'] or '').strip().lower()
    if reg in FORMREG: e["form"] = FORMREG[reg]
    if r['creation_time_ms']:
        dt = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(r['creation_time_ms'] / 1000)
        e["captureDay"], e["captureMonth"], e["captureYear"] = dt.day, dt.month, dt.year
        e["timeOfScan"] = dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S') + '-0400'
    else:
        e["captureDay"] = e["captureMonth"] = e["captureYear"] = 0
        e["timeOfScan"] = "2026-06-04T12:00:00-0400"
    _iid = IMAGE_MAP.get(r['uid_hex'])
    if _iid:
        e["imageId"] = _iid
    e.update(MEGA_FIELDS.get(r['uid_hex'], {}))
    entries.append(e)

os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
json.dump(entries, open(os.path.join(OUT, 'scan_data.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'), separators=(',', ':'))
meta = json.load(open(os.path.join(PGDIR, 'metadata.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
meta['numScans'] = len(entries); meta['lastBackupDate'] = "2026-06-04T12:00:00-0400"
meta['lastNameGenDate'] = meta['lastBackupDate']; meta['lastPokedexBackupDate'] = meta['lastBackupDate']
json.dump(meta, open(os.path.join(OUT, 'metadata.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'))

arc0 = sum(1 for e in entries if e['arcAngle'] == 0)
mlt = sum(1 for e in entries if e['maxCPLower'] < e['cp'])
print(f"GENERATED {len(entries)} | base CP-matched {matched}, pvid-fallback {fallback}")
print(f"arcAngle==0: {arc0} | maxCP<cp: {mlt}")
print(f"HP: {hp_calc} computed (no stamina in DB) | formula matches the DB on {hp_ok} of {hp_known} known")
print("with imageId: %d of %d" % (sum(1 for e in entries if e.get('imageId')), len(entries)))
print("with mega art: %d" % sum(1 for e in entries if e.get('megaImageId1')))
```

`pokegenie_work/hp_formula.py`:

```py
import json
BASE = r'C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance'
data = json.load(open(BASE + r'\pokegenie_work\extracted\scan_data.json'))

# Collect (a,d,s) -> hpType pairs from ground truth where hpType is non-empty.
pairs = []
for e in data:
    if e.get('quickMove') == 'Hidden Power' and e.get('hiddenPowerType'):
        a = e.get('avgAttackIV'); d = e.get('avgDefenseIV'); s = e.get('avgStaminaIV')
        if a is None: continue
        pairs.append((int(a), int(d), int(s), e['hiddenPowerType']))
print('non-empty HP pairs:', len(pairs))

# PoGo Hidden Power type order (index 0..15):
HP_TYPES = ['Fighting', 'Flying', 'Poison', 'Ground', 'Rock', 'Bug', 'Ghost', 'Steel',
            'Fire', 'Water', 'Grass', 'Electric', 'Psychic', 'Ice', 'Dragon', 'Dark']

# Standard Gen-3 main-series formula uses bit0 of each of 6 stats. PoGo only has 3 IVs (atk/def/sta)
# 0..15 each. The PoGo Hidden Power formula (from datamines):
#   type = floor( (15 * X) / 63 ) where X derives from IV bits? Let's brute force a formula:
# Candidate A: idx = (a%2 + 2*(d%2) + 4*(s%2))  -> only 0..7, can't reach 16. No.
# Candidate B (known PoGo): idx = floor( ((a & 1) + 2*(d & 1) + 4*(s & 1)) * 15 / 7 )? only 0/2/4/6/8/10/12/15
# Let's just test the documented PoGo formula:
#   hp = floor( ( (atkIV % 2) + 2*(defIV % 2) + 4*(staIV % 2) ) ... ) -- insufficient bits.
# Actually PoGo uses ALL bits: hp_index = floor(15 * (sum over the 3 IVs of (iv & 8)?)) ...
# Brute force: find integer linear combo mod-based mapping that fits ALL pairs.

def test_formula(fn, name):
    ok = 0; bad = []
    for a, d, s, t in pairs:
        if HP_TYPES[fn(a, d, s) % 16] == t: ok += 1
        else: bad.append((a, d, s, t, HP_TYPES[fn(a, d, s) % 16]))
    print('%-40s %d/%d' % (name, ok, len(pairs)), '' if not bad else ('e.g. ' + str(bad[:3])))
    return ok

# Known correct PoGo formula (from reverse engineering, e.g. GoStadium / PokeGenie):
# idx = floor( ((a % 2) + 2*(d % 2) + 4*(s % 2)) * 16 / 8 )? no.
# The REAL one many tools use:
#   idx = floor( ( (atk & 1) + 2*(def & 1) + 4*(sta & 1) ) ... ) — but that maxes at 7.
# Try: uses (iv % 4) maybe. Let me brute force over masks/multipliers.
import itertools
best = (0, None)
for ma, md, ms in itertools.product(range(1, 16), repeat=3):
    for div in range(2, 64):
        def fn(a, d, s, ma=ma, md=md, ms=ms, div=div):
            return ((a & ma) + (d & md) * 2 + (s & ms) * 4) * 15 // div
        ok = sum(1 for a, d, s, t in pairs if HP_TYPES[fn(a, d, s) % 16] == t)
        if ok > best[0]:
            best = (ok, ('mask', ma, md, ms, 'div', div))
print('brute best:', best, 'of', len(pairs))

```

`pokegenie_work/match_old_photos.py`:

```py
"""Match current bag pokemon to a REAL historical PokeGenie scan photo from the old backup (pg.zip),
extracted to old_backup/. Conservative, date-verified matching -- never guess a picture.

Key = (pokemon_id/dex, cp, iv_atk, iv_def, iv_sta, gender_as_pokegenie).
For each bag row, look at all old-backup entries sharing that key:
  - if the old entry has a recorded capture date, accept only if it's within 1 day of the bag row's
    creation_date (UTC/local rollover slack) AND it's the unique such dated candidate for this row.
  - if no old entry has a date but exactly one undated candidate also matches this row's quick+charge
    move names, accept that (weaker corroboration, still real).
  - otherwise, no match (ambiguous or coincidental key collision) -- leave for app_imageDir fallback.
Each old-backup entry is used AT MOST ONCE (an old photo can't be assigned to two different mons).

Writes photo_map.json: {uid_hex: {"file": <path to old_backup/scan_thumb/<imageId>.jpg>, "conf": "confirmed"|"move-verified"}}
"""
import json, os, sqlite3, sys, datetime

ROOT = r"C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance\pogo_extract"
WORK = r"C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance\pokegenie_work"
OLD = os.path.join(WORK, 'old_backup')

sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)

def pg_gender(g):
    return 3 if (g in (0, None)) else int(g)

def load_move_namer():
    mid2name = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'move_id_to_name.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    gm = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'pvpoke_gamemaster.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    GM_NAME = {m['moveId']: m['name'] for m in gm['moves']}
    def movename(mid):
        if not mid: return ""
        raw = mid2name.get(str(int(mid)))
        if not raw: return ""
        base = raw[:-5] if raw.endswith('_FAST') else raw
        nm = GM_NAME.get(base) or GM_NAME.get(raw)
        if nm: return nm
        if base.startswith('HIDDEN_POWER'): return 'Hidden Power'
        return ' '.join(w.capitalize() for w in base.split('_'))
    return movename

def main():
    movename = load_move_namer()

    old = json.load(open(os.path.join(OLD, 'scan_data.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    thumb_dir = os.path.join(OLD, 'scan_thumb')

    # index old entries by key, keep only those with a real present thumbnail file
    from collections import defaultdict
    by_key = defaultdict(list)
    have_thumb = missing_thumb = 0
    for e in old:
        iid = e.get('imageId')
        if not iid or not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(thumb_dir, iid + '.jpg')):
            missing_thumb += 1
            continue
        have_thumb += 1
        key = (e['pokemonNumber'], e.get('cp', 0), e.get('avgAttackIV', 0),
               e.get('avgDefenseIV', 0), e.get('avgStaminaIV', 0), pg_gender(e.get('gender')))
        by_key[key].append(e)
    print('old entries: %d total, %d with a real present thumbnail, %d without' % (len(old), have_thumb, missing_thumb))

    con = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(ROOT, 'pokemon.db'))
    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    rows = con.execute('SELECT uid_hex, pokemon_id, cp, iv_atk, iv_def, iv_sta, gender, '
                        'creation_time_ms, move1, move2, fresh_shiny, is_hundo, in_bag '
                        'FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 ORDER BY creation_time_ms').fetchall()

    used_old_ids = set()  # id() of old entry dicts already claimed
    photo_map = {}
    confirmed = move_verified = ambiguous = no_candidate = 0
    shiny_confirmed = hundo_confirmed = 0

    for r in rows:
        key = (r['pokemon_id'], r['cp'] or 0, r['iv_atk'] or 0, r['iv_def'] or 0,
               r['iv_sta'] or 0, pg_gender(r['gender']))
        cands = [e for e in by_key.get(key, []) if id(e) not in used_old_ids]
        if not cands:
            no_candidate += 1
            continue

        bag_date = None
        if r['creation_time_ms']:
            bag_date = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(r['creation_time_ms'] / 1000).date()

        dated = [e for e in cands if e.get('captureYear', 0)]
        undated = [e for e in cands if not e.get('captureYear', 0)]

        dated_ok = []
        if bag_date is not None:
            for e in dated:
                try:
                    od = datetime.date(e['captureYear'], e['captureMonth'], e['captureDay'])
                except (ValueError, KeyError):
                    continue
                if abs((od - bag_date).days) <= 1:
                    dated_ok.append(e)

        if len(dated_ok) == 1:
            chosen = dated_ok[0]
            used_old_ids.add(id(chosen))
            photo_map[r['uid_hex']] = {'file': os.path.join(thumb_dir, chosen['imageId'] + '.jpg'),
                                        'conf': 'confirmed'}
            confirmed += 1
            if r['fresh_shiny']: shiny_confirmed += 1
            if r['is_hundo']: hundo_confirmed += 1
            continue
        elif len(dated_ok) > 1:
            ambiguous += 1
            continue

        # no dated candidate -- try move-name corroboration among undated entries
        if undated:
            bag_m1, bag_m2 = movename(r['move1']), movename(r['move2'])
            mv_ok = [e for e in undated if e.get('quickMove', '') == bag_m1 and e.get('chargeMove', '') == bag_m2
                     and (bag_m1 or bag_m2)]
            if len(mv_ok) == 1:
                chosen = mv_ok[0]
                used_old_ids.add(id(chosen))
                photo_map[r['uid_hex']] = {'file': os.path.join(thumb_dir, chosen['imageId'] + '.jpg'),
                                            'conf': 'move-verified'}
                move_verified += 1
                if r['fresh_shiny']: shiny_confirmed += 1
                if r['is_hundo']: hundo_confirmed += 1
                continue
            elif len(mv_ok) > 1:
                ambiguous += 1
                continue
        no_candidate += 1

    print('MATCHED: confirmed(date) %d, move-verified %d -> total %d' % (confirmed, move_verified, confirmed + move_verified))
    print('rejected as ambiguous (multiple candidates, no way to pick): %d' % ambiguous)
    print('no candidate at all: %d' % no_candidate)
    print('of matches: %d are currently shiny, %d are hundo' % (shiny_confirmed, hundo_confirmed))
    print('bag total: %d' % len(rows))

    out_path = os.path.join(WORK, 'photo_map.json')
    json.dump(photo_map, open(out_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=0)
    print('wrote', out_path, 'with', len(photo_map), 'entries')
```

`pokegenie_work/moveres.py`:

```py
import sqlite3, json, pickle
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
BASE = r'C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance'
con = sqlite3.connect(BASE + r'\pogo_extract\pokemon.db')
con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row; cur = con.cursor()
gm = json.load(open(BASE + r'\pogo_extract\pvpoke_gamemaster.json'))
mv_name = {m['moveId']: m['name'] for m in gm['moves']}

def norm_tok(s):
    if s is None:
        s = ''
    s = str(s)
    return s.lower().replace(' ', '').replace('-', '').replace('_', '')

forms = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set(), 'sid': []})
bydex = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set()})
byname = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set()})
for p in gm['pokemon']:
    sid = norm_tok(p['speciesId'])
    forms[sid]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves']); forms[sid]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])
    forms[sid]['sid'].append(p['speciesId'])
    bydex[p['dex']]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves']); bydex[p['dex']]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])
    byname[norm_tok(p['speciesName'])]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves'])
    byname[norm_tok(p['speciesName'])]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])

def candset(r):
    sp = norm_tok(r['species_name']); reg = norm_tok(r['form_region']); frm = norm_tok(r['form'])
    for key in [sp + reg, sp + frm, sp]:
        if key in forms:
            return forms[key]
    if sp in byname:
        return byname[sp]
    return bydex.get(r['pokemon_id'])

rows = cur.execute("SELECT pokemon_id,species_name,form,form_region,move1,move2,move3 FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1").fetchall()
fast_int = defaultdict(list); charge_int = defaultdict(list)
nocand = 0
for r in rows:
    cs = candset(r)
    if not cs:
        nocand += 1; continue
    if r['move1']: fast_int[r['move1']].append(frozenset(cs['f']))
    if r['move2']: charge_int[r['move2']].append(frozenset(cs['c']))
    if r['move3']: charge_int[r['move3']].append(frozenset(cs['c']))
print('rows with no candidate form:', nocand)

def resolve(intmap):
    res = {}
    for mid, sets in intmap.items():
        inter = set.intersection(*[set(s) for s in sets])
        if len(inter) == 1:
            res[mid] = (list(inter)[0], 'inter1', len(sets))
        elif len(inter) == 0:
            res[mid] = (None, 'empty', len(sets))
        else:
            res[mid] = (sorted(inter), 'multi', len(sets))
    return res

fres = resolve(fast_int); cres = resolve(charge_int)
solidF = sum(1 for v in fres.values() if v[1] == 'inter1')
solidC = sum(1 for v in cres.values() if v[1] == 'inter1')
print('FORM-AWARE: fast solid %d/%d, charge solid %d/%d' % (solidF, len(fres), solidC, len(cres)))
pickle.dump({'fres': fres, 'cres': cres,
             'fast_int': {k: [set(x) for x in v] for k, v in fast_int.items()},
             'charge_int': {k: [set(x) for x in v] for k, v in charge_int.items()}},
            open(BASE + r'\pokegenie_work\moveres.pkl', 'wb'))
print('still ambiguous fast:', sorted([k for k, v in fres.items() if v[1] != 'inter1']))
print('still ambiguous charge count:', sum(1 for v in cres.values() if v[1] != 'inter1'))
```

`pokegenie_work/moveres2.py`:

```py
import sqlite3, json, pickle
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
BASE = r'C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance'
con = sqlite3.connect(BASE + r'\pogo_extract\pokemon.db')
con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row; cur = con.cursor()
gm = json.load(open(BASE + r'\pogo_extract\pvpoke_gamemaster.json'))
mv_name = {m['moveId']: m['name'] for m in gm['moves']}

def norm_tok(s):
    if s is None: s = ''
    return str(s).lower().replace(' ', '').replace('-', '').replace('_', '')

forms = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set()})
bydex = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set()})
byname = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set()})
for p in gm['pokemon']:
    sid = norm_tok(p['speciesId'])
    forms[sid]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves']); forms[sid]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])
    bydex[p['dex']]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves']); bydex[p['dex']]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])
    byname[norm_tok(p['speciesName'])]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves'])
    byname[norm_tok(p['speciesName'])]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])

def candset(r):
    sp = norm_tok(r['species_name']); reg = norm_tok(r['form_region']); frm = norm_tok(r['form'])
    for key in [sp + reg, sp + frm, sp]:
        if key in forms: return forms[key]
    if sp in byname: return byname[sp]
    return bydex.get(r['pokemon_id'])

rows = cur.execute("SELECT pokemon_id,species_name,form,form_region,move1,move2,move3 FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1").fetchall()

# Per-ROW observations: a row gives (move1 in fastset), (move2 in chargeset), (move3 in chargeset),
# AND move2 != move3 as moveIds. Build candidate sets per integer (separate fast vs charge namespaces;
# but integers are globally unique in PoGo, so fast ints and charge ints never collide -> keep separate maps).
fast_cand = {}   # int -> set of possible moveIds (running intersection)
charge_cand = {}
# Also track, per row, the pair (m2,m3) for distinctness constraint
charge_pairs = []
for r in rows:
    cs = candset(r)
    f, c = set(cs['f']), set(cs['c'])
    if r['move1']:
        fast_cand[r['move1']] = fast_cand.get(r['move1'], set(f)) & f if r['move1'] in fast_cand else set(f)
    if r['move2']:
        charge_cand[r['move2']] = charge_cand.get(r['move2'], set(c)) & c if r['move2'] in charge_cand else set(c)
    if r['move3']:
        charge_cand[r['move3']] = charge_cand.get(r['move3'], set(c)) & c if r['move3'] in charge_cand else set(c)
    if r['move2'] and r['move3'] and r['move2'] != r['move3']:
        charge_pairs.append((r['move2'], r['move3'], frozenset(c)))

# Constraint propagation on charge_cand using distinctness within same form's charge set.
# Rebuild full per-row charge candidate lists for AC-3 style narrowing.
charge_rows = []  # list of (intA,intB, allowed_set) for distinct pairs
for a, b, allowed in charge_pairs:
    charge_rows.append((a, b, allowed))

def propagate(cand, pair_constraints):
    changed = True
    rounds = 0
    while changed and rounds < 50:
        changed = False; rounds += 1
        # singletons
        fixed = {i: next(iter(v)) for i, v in cand.items() if len(v) == 1}
        # distinctness: for a pair (a,b), if a is fixed, b cannot be that value
        for a, b, allowed in pair_constraints:
            if a in fixed and fixed[a] in cand.get(b, set()):
                cand[b].discard(fixed[a]); changed = True
            if b in fixed and fixed[b] in cand.get(a, set()):
                cand[a].discard(fixed[b]); changed = True
        # also: within allowed set, a and b together; if allowed has exactly 2 and both share, etc (skip)
    return cand

charge_cand = propagate(charge_cand, charge_rows)

def report(cand, label):
    solid = {i: next(iter(v)) for i, v in cand.items() if len(v) == 1}
    amb = {i: sorted(v) for i, v in cand.items() if len(v) != 1}
    print('%s: solid %d / %d ; ambiguous %d' % (label, len(solid), len(cand), len(amb)))
    return solid, amb

fsolid, famb = report(fast_cand, 'FAST')
csolid, camb = report(charge_cand, 'CHARGE')
print('--- ambiguous FAST ---')
for i, v in sorted(famb.items()):
    print(' ', i, [mv_name[x] for x in v])
print('--- ambiguous CHARGE (first 40) ---')
for i, v in sorted(camb.items())[:40]:
    print(' ', i, [mv_name[x] for x in v])

pickle.dump({'fast_cand': {k: set(v) for k, v in fast_cand.items()},
             'charge_cand': {k: set(v) for k, v in charge_cand.items()},
             'fsolid': fsolid, 'csolid': csolid, 'famb': famb, 'camb': camb,
             'charge_pairs': charge_pairs},
            open(BASE + r'\pokegenie_work\moveres2.pkl', 'wb'))

```

`pokegenie_work/moveres3.py`:

```py
import sqlite3, json, pickle
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
BASE = r'C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance'
con = sqlite3.connect(BASE + r'\pogo_extract\pokemon.db')
con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row; cur = con.cursor()
gm = json.load(open(BASE + r'\pogo_extract\pvpoke_gamemaster.json'))
mv_name = {m['moveId']: m['name'] for m in gm['moves']}

def norm_tok(s):
    if s is None: s = ''
    return str(s).lower().replace(' ', '').replace('-', '').replace('_', '')

forms = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set()})
bydex = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set()})
byname = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set()})
for p in gm['pokemon']:
    sid = norm_tok(p['speciesId'])
    forms[sid]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves']); forms[sid]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])
    bydex[p['dex']]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves']); bydex[p['dex']]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])
    byname[norm_tok(p['speciesName'])]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves'])
    byname[norm_tok(p['speciesName'])]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])

def candset(r):
    sp = norm_tok(r['species_name']); reg = norm_tok(r['form_region']); frm = norm_tok(r['form'])
    for key in [sp + reg, sp + frm, sp]:
        if key in forms: return forms[key]
    if sp in byname: return byname[sp]
    return bydex.get(r['pokemon_id'])

rows = cur.execute("SELECT pokemon_id,species_name,form,form_region,move1,move2,move3 FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1").fetchall()

# FREQUENCY VOTING: for each integer, count candidate moveIds across all carrier rows (union, weighted).
fast_vote = defaultdict(Counter); charge_vote = defaultdict(Counter)
fast_n = Counter(); charge_n = Counter()
for r in rows:
    cs = candset(r); f, c = cs['f'], cs['c']
    if r['move1']:
        for m in f: fast_vote[r['move1']][m] += 1
        fast_n[r['move1']] += 1
    if r['move2']:
        for m in c: charge_vote[r['move2']][m] += 1
        charge_n[r['move2']] += 1
    if r['move3']:
        for m in c: charge_vote[r['move3']][m] += 1
        charge_n[r['move3']] += 1

# A correct moveId should appear in EVERY carrier row's candidate set (support == n) IF gamemaster
# is complete. Legacy moves break this. So: best candidate = highest support fraction.
def best(vote, n):
    out = {}
    for i, cnt in vote.items():
        tot = n[i]
        ranked = cnt.most_common()
        topmove, topc = ranked[0]
        # support fraction
        out[i] = (topmove, topc / tot, tot, [(mv_name[m], c, round(c / tot, 3)) for m, c in ranked[:4]])
    return out

fb = best(fast_vote, fast_n); cb = best(charge_vote, charge_n)

# Distinctness sanity: for charge, if best(m2)==best(m3) for the SAME row's pair, that's a violation.
# Count violations of current frequency assignment.
viol = 0
for r in rows:
    if r['move2'] and r['move3'] and r['move2'] != r['move3']:
        if cb.get(r['move2'], (None,))[0] == cb.get(r['move3'], (None,))[0]:
            viol += 1
print('charge distinctness violations under frequency assignment:', viol)

# Report low-confidence (support fraction < 0.99) ones - these need manual/registry confirmation.
print('=== FAST low-confidence (frac<0.999) ===')
for i in sorted(fb):
    m, frac, tot, top = fb[i]
    if frac < 0.999:
        print(' ', i, '->', mv_name[m], 'frac=%.3f n=%d' % (frac, tot), top)
print('=== CHARGE low-confidence (frac<0.999) ===')
for i in sorted(cb):
    m, frac, tot, top = cb[i]
    if frac < 0.999:
        print(' ', i, '->', mv_name[m], 'frac=%.3f n=%d' % (frac, tot), top)

pickle.dump({'fb': fb, 'cb': cb}, open(BASE + r'\pokegenie_work\moveres3.pkl', 'wb'))
print('TOTAL fast ints:', len(fb), ' charge ints:', len(cb))
```
