`pokegenie_work/moveres_final.py`:

```py
import sqlite3, json, pickle
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
BASE = r'C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance'
con = sqlite3.connect(BASE + r'\pogo_extract\pokemon.db')
con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row; cur = con.cursor()
gm = json.load(open(BASE + r'\pogo_extract\pvpoke_gamemaster.json'))
mv_name_raw = {m['moveId']: m['name'] for m in gm['moves']}
mv_type = {m['moveId']: m['type'] for m in gm['moves']}

# ---- PokeGenie display-name normalization (derived from ground truth) ----
def pg_name(gm_name):
    n = gm_name.replace('(', '').replace(')', '')
    while '  ' in n: n = n.replace('  ', ' ')
    n = n.strip()
    n = n.replace('Future Sight', 'Futuresight')
    n = n.replace('Superpower', 'Super Power')
    n = n.replace('Techno Blast Douse', 'Techno Blast Water')  # Douse drive = Water in PokeGenie
    return n

def norm_tok(s):
    if s is None: s = ''
    return str(s).lower().replace(' ', '').replace('-', '').replace('_', '')

forms = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set()})
bydex = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set()})
byname = defaultdict(lambda: {'f': set(), 'c': set()})
for p in gm['pokemon']:
    sid = norm_tok(p['speciesId'])
    forms[sid]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves']); forms[sid]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])
    bydex[p['dex']]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves']); bydex[p['dex']]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])
    byname[norm_tok(p['speciesName'])]['f'] |= set(p['fastMoves'])
    byname[norm_tok(p['speciesName'])]['c'] |= set(p['chargedMoves'])

def candset(r):
    sp = norm_tok(r['species_name']); reg = norm_tok(r['form_region']); frm = norm_tok(r['form'])
    for key in [sp + reg, sp + frm, sp]:
        if key in forms: return forms[key]
    if sp in byname: return byname[sp]
    return bydex.get(r['pokemon_id'])

rows = cur.execute("SELECT pokemon_id,species_name,form,form_region,move1,move2,move3,fresh_alignment FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1").fetchall()

# Frequency voting (union) for fast + charge.
fast_vote = defaultdict(Counter); charge_vote = defaultdict(Counter)
fast_n = Counter(); charge_n = Counter()
for r in rows:
    cs = candset(r); f, c = cs['f'], cs['c']
    if r['move1']:
        for m in f: fast_vote[r['move1']][m] += 1
        fast_n[r['move1']] += 1
    if r['move2']:
        for m in c: charge_vote[r['move2']][m] += 1
        charge_n[r['move2']] += 1
    if r['move3']:
        for m in c: charge_vote[r['move3']][m] += 1
        charge_n[r['move3']] += 1

FAST = {}; CHARGE = {}
for i, cnt in fast_vote.items():
    FAST[i] = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
for i, cnt in charge_vote.items():
    CHARGE[i] = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

# Special / synthetic charged moves not in gamemaster movepools:
SPECIAL_CHARGE = {322: 'Frustration', 323: 'Return'}  # confirmed via shadow/purified alignment
# Special fast: 281 = Hidden Power (display 'Hidden Power'; element via hiddenPowerType)

# Build final int->PokeGenie-string maps.
def fast_pg(i):
    if i == 0: return ''
    if i == 281: return 'Hidden Power'  # element handled separately
    return pg_name(mv_name_raw[FAST[i]])

def charge_pg(i):
    if i == 0: return ''
    if i in SPECIAL_CHARGE: return SPECIAL_CHARGE[i]
    return pg_name(mv_name_raw[CHARGE[i]])

# Hidden Power element from the Pokemon's IVs is the official rule, BUT PoGo stores the HP type
# in the move id (281 is generic in gamemaster). Determine HP type from gamemaster? Not available.
# In PoGo the Hidden Power TYPE is computed from IVs. Derive element from IVs.
def hp_type_from_ivs(atk, dfn, sta):
    # Official Hidden Power type formula (PoGo): floor((sum of bit0 of each IV pattern)...).
    # PoGo formula: type = floor( ((a&1)+2*(d&1)+4*(s&1)+ ... ) )? Use the canonical 16-type table.
    # Standard: hp = (15 * ( (atk&1) + 2*(def&1) + 4*(sta&1) ... )) -- but PoGo uses a different one.
    pass

# Validate name coverage vs ground truth.
data = json.load(open(BASE + r'\pokegenie_work\extracted\scan_data.json'))
gt_fast = Counter(); gt_charge = Counter()
for e in data:
    if e.get('quickMove'): gt_fast[e['quickMove']] += 1
    if e.get('chargeMove'): gt_charge[e['chargeMove']] += 1
    if e.get('chargeMove2'): gt_charge[e['chargeMove2']] += 1

derived_fast_names = set(fast_pg(i) for i in FAST) | {'Hidden Power'}
derived_charge_names = set(charge_pg(i) for i in CHARGE) | set(SPECIAL_CHARGE.values())

# Which ground-truth move names can our maps NOT produce?
gt_fast_names = set(gt_fast) - {'Struggle'}
gt_charge_names = set(gt_charge) - {'Struggle'}
missing_fast = gt_fast_names - derived_fast_names
missing_charge = gt_charge_names - derived_charge_names
print('GT FAST names our table cannot produce:', sorted(missing_fast))
print('GT CHARGE names our table cannot produce:', sorted(missing_charge))
print()

# Reverse check: which derived names are NOT seen in ground truth (could indicate a wrong mapping
# OR simply a move present in bag but not in the old scans -> expected, since bag != old scans).
extra_fast = derived_fast_names - gt_fast_names - {''}
extra_charge = derived_charge_names - gt_charge_names - {''}
print('Derived FAST names NOT in ground truth (info only):', sorted(extra_fast))
print('Derived CHARGE names NOT in ground truth (info only):', sorted(extra_charge))
print()

# Confidence per fast/charge integer (frequency fraction).
def frac(vote, n, mp):
    return {i: vote[i][mp[i]] / n[i] for i in mp}
ff = frac(fast_vote, fast_n, FAST); cf = frac(charge_vote, charge_n, CHARGE)
print('FAST ints with confidence < 0.95:', {i: round(ff[i], 3) for i in ff if ff[i] < 0.95})
print('CHARGE ints with confidence < 0.95 (excl 322/323):',
      {i: round(cf[i], 3) for i in cf if cf[i] < 0.95 and i not in SPECIAL_CHARGE})

# Save the final maps as JSON for downstream use.
FAST_OUT = {str(i): fast_pg(i) for i in FAST}
FAST_OUT['281'] = 'Hidden Power'
CHARGE_OUT = {str(i): charge_pg(i) for i in CHARGE}
for i, nm in SPECIAL_CHARGE.items():
    CHARGE_OUT[str(i)] = nm
json.dump({'fast': FAST_OUT, 'charge': CHARGE_OUT}, open(BASE + r'\pokegenie_work\move_id_to_pgname.json', 'w'), indent=1)
print('\nWrote move_id_to_pgname.json  (fast %d, charge %d)' % (len(FAST_OUT), len(CHARGE_OUT)))
pickle.dump({'FAST': FAST, 'CHARGE': CHARGE, 'ff': ff, 'cf': cf, 'mv_name_raw': mv_name_raw,
             'fast_vote': dict(fast_vote), 'charge_vote': dict(charge_vote)},
            open(BASE + r'\pokegenie_work\moveres_final.pkl', 'wb'))

`pokegenie_work/rebuild_pokedex_art.py`:

```py
"""Replace PokeGenie's Pokedex art with official Pokemon GO art, and complete the coverage.

User 2026-09-03: "btw the Drampa you saw was my old scan photo. so you need to nuke my old photos."
Correct. PokeGenie builds its POKEDEX art out of the user's own capture-screen screenshots: every
app_imageDir/pokedex_<dex>[_<Form>] (and its i_df_<dex>[_<Form>].jpg twin) was a cropped old scan --
which is also why the "Current Raid Bosses" row showed a scan photo for Drampa and a "?" for everything
the user had never scanned. Both files hold the same PNG bytes under two names, so both get rewritten.

Resolution is most-specific-first and ALWAYS ends at the plain base form, and every candidate must exist
upstream, so a species can never be given another species art:
    1. curated PokeGenie-suffix -> upstream form token
    2. fuzzy match of the suffix against this dex's real upstream form tokens
    3. bare pm<dex>.icon.png

Also adds what was never there: _Mega / _MegaX / _MegaY for all mega species (so mega raid bosses and the
mega Pokedex entries render), and base art for every remaining dex upstream has.

    python rebuild_pokedex_art.py [--jobs 16]
"""
import argparse, collections, json, os, re, threading, urllib.parse, urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WORK = os.path.join(BASE, 'pokegenie_work')
OUT = os.path.join(BASE, 'pokegenie_out', 'pokedex_art')
SPR = os.path.join(WORK, 'sprites')
RAW = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeMiners/pogo_assets/master/'
_lock = threading.Lock()

# PokeGenie's own form suffix -> the upstream form token
SUFFIX = {
    'Alola': 'ALOLA', 'Galarian': 'GALARIAN', 'Hisuian': 'HISUIAN', 'Paldean': 'PALDEA',
    'Mega': 'MEGA', 'MegaX': 'MEGA_X', 'MegaY': 'MEGA_Y',
    'Therian': 'THERIAN', 'Incarnate': 'INCARNATE', 'Female': 'FEMALE', 'Male': 'MALE',
    'Hero': 'HERO', 'Rainy': 'RAINY', 'Sunny': 'SUNNY', 'Aqua': 'AQUA',
    'Deoxysattack': 'ATTACK', 'Deoxysdefense': 'DEFENSE',
    'Plant': 'PLANT', 'Sandy': 'SANDY', 'Trash': 'TRASH',
    'Altered': 'ALTERED', 'Land': 'LAND', 'Black': 'BLACK', 'White': 'WHITE', 'Aria': 'ARIA',
    'Burn': 'BURN', 'Chill': 'CHILL', 'Douse': 'DOUSE', 'Shock': 'SHOCK',
    'Unbound': 'UNBOUND', 'zyg10': 'TEN_PERCENT', 'formFour': 'FIFTY_PERCENT',
    'OriBaile': 'BAILE', 'OriPau': 'PAU', 'OriPom': 'POM_POM', 'OriSensu': 'SENSU',
    'FormMidday': 'MIDDAY', 'FormMidnight': 'MIDNIGHT',
    'Sword': 'CROWNED_SWORD', 'Shield': 'CROWNED_SHIELD',
}


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=16)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(SPR, exist_ok=True)

    upstream = json.load(open(os.path.join(SPR, 'upstream_files.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    paths = {p.split('/')[-1]: p for p in upstream}
    forms = collections.defaultdict(dict)      # dex -> {FORM_TOKEN: filename}, non-shiny only
    base = {}
    for n in paths:
        m = re.match(r'pm(\d+)\.f([A-Z0-9_]+)\.icon\.png$', n)
        if m:
            forms[int(m.group(1))][m.group(2)] = n
            continue
        m = re.match(r'pm(\d+)\.icon\.png$', n)
        if m:
            base[int(m.group(1))] = n
    print('upstream: %d species with base art, %d with form art' % (len(base), len(forms)))

    existing = [l.strip() for l in open(os.path.join(WORK, 'pokedex_names.txt'), encoding='utf-8')
                if l.strip()]
    print('existing PokeGenie pokedex art files (all old scan photos): %d' % len(existing))

    def resolve(dex, suf):
        """upstream filename for this (dex, PokeGenie suffix); never another species"""
        if suf:
            tok = SUFFIX.get(suf)
            if tok and tok in forms.get(dex, {}):
                return forms[dex][tok]
            key = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', suf.lower())
            for t, fn in forms.get(dex, {}).items():
                if re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', t.lower()) == key:
                    return fn
        if dex in base:
            return base[dex]
        f = forms.get(dex) or {}
        for t in ('NORMAL', 'INCARNATE', 'ALTERED', 'PLANT', 'ARIA', 'MIDDAY', 'HERO'):
            if t in f:
                return f[t]
        return sorted(f.values())[0] if f else None

    want, unresolved = {}, []
    for nm in existing:                                   # 1. replace every old photo
        m = re.match(r'pokedex_(\d+)(?:_(.+))?$', nm)
        if not m:
            unresolved.append(nm)
            continue
        fn = resolve(int(m.group(1)), m.group(2))
        if fn:
            want[nm[len('pokedex_'):]] = fn
        else:
            unresolved.append(nm)
    n_replaced = len(want)

    # User 2026-09-03: "you're only filling the current pokemon i have in my dex right? not pokemon i
    # havent caught or seen yet?" -- right. Art is only ever written for a species the user ACTUALLY HAS,
    # so the Pokedex never illustrates something they have not caught. "Has" = the species PokeGenie
    # already held art for (i.e. they scanned it at some point) plus everything currently in the bag.
    # Reading PoGo's lifetime PokedexImpl would be the exact set, but that means attaching to the running
    # game, and the game is not to be touched mid-play.
    owned = {int(re.match(r'pokedex_(\d+)', nm).group(1)) for nm in existing
             if re.match(r'pokedex_(\d+)', nm)}
    n_prev = len(owned)
    try:
        import sqlite3
        con = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(BASE, 'pogo_extract', 'pokemon.db'))
        bag = {r[0] for r in con.execute('SELECT DISTINCT pokemon_id FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1')}
        owned |= bag
    except Exception as e:
        bag = set()
        print('  (bag read failed, using scanned species only: %s)' % e)
    print('  owned species: %d (%d already had art, %d in bag, %d new from bag)'
          % (len(owned), n_prev, len(bag), len(owned) - n_prev))

    n_mega = 0                                            # 2. mega art, owned species only
    for dex, f in forms.items():
        if dex not in owned:
            continue
        for tok, suf in (('MEGA', 'Mega'), ('MEGA_X', 'MegaX'), ('MEGA_Y', 'MegaY')):
            if tok in f:
                key = '%d_%s' % (dex, suf)
                if key not in want:
                    want[key] = f[tok]
                    n_mega += 1

    n_fill = 0                                            # 3. base art, owned species only
    for dex, fn in base.items():
        if dex in owned and str(dex) not in want:
            want[str(dex)] = fn
            n_fill += 1

    print('  replacing old photos : %d' % n_replaced)
    print('  adding mega art      : %d' % n_mega)
    print('  filling base coverage: %d' % n_fill)
    if unresolved:
        print('  could not resolve    : %d %s' % (len(unresolved), unresolved[:6]))

    got, failed = {}, []

    def work(item):
        key, fn = item
        src = os.path.join(SPR, fn)
        if not (os.path.exists(src) and os.path.getsize(src) > 500):
            try:
                req = urllib.request.Request(RAW + urllib.parse.quote(paths[fn]),
                                             headers={'User-Agent': 'pg-dex'})
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
                    b = r.read()
                if len(b) <= 500:
                    with _lock:
                        failed.append(key)
                    return
                open(src, 'wb').write(b)
            except Exception:
                with _lock:
                    failed.append(key)
                return
        data = open(src, 'rb').read()
        open(os.path.join(OUT, 'pokedex_' + key), 'wb').write(data)
        open(os.path.join(OUT, 'i_df_%s.jpg' % key), 'wb').write(data)
        with _lock:
            got[key] = fn

    items = list(want.items())
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=a.jobs) as ex:
        for i, _ in enumerate(ex.map(work, items), 1):
            if i % 300 == 0:
                print('  %d/%d  ok %d  failed %d' % (i, len(items), len(got), len(failed)))

    json.dump(got, open(os.path.join(BASE, 'pokegenie_out', 'pokedex_art_map.json'), 'w',
                        encoding='utf-8'), indent=0)
    print('\nwrote %d entries (%d files) to %s' % (len(got), len(got) * 2, OUT))
    if failed:
        print('failed: %d  e.g. %s' % (len(failed), failed[:8]))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import sqlite3, json, pickle
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
BASE = r'C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance'
con = sqlite3.connect(BASE + r'\pogo_extract\pokemon.db')
con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row; cur = con.cursor()
gm = json.load(open(BASE + r'\pogo_extract\pvpoke_gamemaster.json'))
mv_name = {m['moveId']: m['name'] for m in gm['moves']}
P = pickle.load(open(BASE + r'\pokegenie_work\moveres_final.pkl', 'rb'))
FAST, CHARGE = P['FAST'], P['CHARGE']
fast_vote, charge_vote = P['fast_vote'], P['charge_vote']

def norm_tok(s):
    if s is None: s = ''
    return str(s).lower().replace(' ', '').replace('-', '').replace('_', '')

# Examine the actual SPECIES carrying each low-confidence integer to confirm winner by reasoning.
def show_carriers(intcol, mid, slot_label, limit=12):
    rows = cur.execute(
        "SELECT species_name, form, form_region, move1, move2, move3 FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND %s=? LIMIT ?" % intcol,
        (mid, limit)).fetchall()
    sps = Counter()
    for r in rows:
        sps[(r['species_name'], r['form_region'])] += 1
    print('  [%s id=%d] carriers:' % (slot_label, mid), dict(sps))

# Low-confidence FAST: 224, 243
print('=== FAST 224 (winner=%s) ===' % mv_name[FAST[224]])
show_carriers('move1', 224, 'fast')
print('  full vote:', [(mv_name[m], c) for m, c in fast_vote[224].most_common(6)])
print('=== FAST 243 (winner=%s) ===' % mv_name[FAST[243]])
show_carriers('move1', 243, 'fast')
print('  full vote:', [(mv_name[m], c) for m, c in fast_vote[243].most_common(6)])

# Low-confidence CHARGE: 33,125,292,293,91,391
for mid in (33, 125, 292, 293, 91, 391):
    print('=== CHARGE %d (winner=%s) ===' % (mid, mv_name[CHARGE[mid]]))
    rows = cur.execute("SELECT species_name, form_region FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1 AND (move2=? OR move3=?) LIMIT 10", (mid, mid)).fetchall()
    print('  carriers:', dict(Counter((r['species_name'], r['form_region']) for r in rows)))
    print('  vote:', [(mv_name[m], c) for m, c in charge_vote[mid].most_common(6)])

# Now: are the "GT cannot produce" charge moves actually present in the bag under a different winner?
# Map each such GT name to its gamemaster moveId, then check if that moveId is the winner of SOME int,
# OR if some int's vote includes it strongly.
gt_missing = ['Acrobatics','Bleakwind Storm','Fell Stinger','Fusion Flare','High Horsepower',
 'High Jump Kick','Ice Burn','Octazooka','Sacred Fire','Sandsear Storm','Sparkling Aria',
 'Synchronoise','Volt Tackle','Weather Ball Water']
name2id = {v: k for k, v in mv_name.items()}
# normalize gm names to compare
def pg(n):
    n=n.replace('(','').replace(')','')
    while '  ' in n: n=n.replace('  ',' ')
    n=n.strip().replace('Future Sight','Futuresight').replace('Superpower','Super Power').replace('Techno Blast Douse','Techno Blast Water')
    return n
pg2id = {}
for mid_str, nm in mv_name.items():
    pg2id[pg(nm)] = mid_str
print('\n=== Are GT-missing charge moves present in any bag mon? ===')
for nm in gt_missing:
    mvid = pg2id.get(nm)
    if not mvid:
        print('  %-20s -> NO gamemaster moveId (synthetic/typed)' % nm); continue
    # is this moveId the winner of any int? is it in any int's vote?
    won = [i for i, w in CHARGE.items() if w == mvid]
    voted = [(i, charge_vote[i][mvid]) for i in charge_vote if mvid in charge_vote[i]]
    # does any BAG mon's form actually list this move? count bag mons whose form has it
    print('  %-20s moveId=%-22s winnerOfInts=%s votedInInts=%s' % (nm, mvid, won, voted[:5]))

    m=CPM[L]
    return max(int(((b['atk']+a)*(b['def']+d)**0.5*(b['hp']+s)**0.5*m*m)/10),10)
def stat_prod(b,a,d,s,L):
    m=CPM[L]
    return (b['atk']+a)*m*(b['def']+d)*m*int((b['hp']+s)*m)
def best_for(b,a,d,s,cap=1500,maxlvl=51):
    bs,bl,bc=0,None,0
    for L in LEVELS:
        if L>maxlvl: break
        c=calc_cp(b,a,d,s,L)
        if c<=cap:
            sp=stat_prod(b,a,d,s,L)
            if sp>bs: bs,bl,bc=sp,L,c
    return bl,bc,bs
def species_best(b,cap=1500,maxlvl=51):
    best=0
    for a,d,s in itertools.product(range(16),repeat=3):
        _,_,sp=best_for(b,a,d,s,cap,maxlvl)
        if sp>best: best=sp
    return best

    elif len(mism)<8: mism.append((d['pokemonName'],a,dd,s,'cp',bc,pr['maxCP'],'lvl',enc_lvl,pr['levelLower'],'prod',prodidx,pr['prodLower']))
    if tested>=400: break

LEVELS = sorted(CPM)

def calc_cp(base, a, d, s, L):
    m = CPM[L]
    cp = int(((base['atk']+a) * (base['def']+d)**0.5 * (base['hp']+s)**0.5 * m*m) / 10)
    return max(cp, 10)

def stat_prod(base, a, d, s, L):
    m = CPM[L]
    A = (base['atk']+a)*m
    D = (base['def']+d)*m
    H = int((base['hp']+s)*m)   # HP floored
    return A*D*H

def best_for(base, a, d, s, cap=1500, maxlvl=50):
    bs, bl, bc = 0, None, 0
    for L in LEVELS:
        if L > maxlvl: break
        c = calc_cp(base, a, d, s, L)
        if c <= cap:
            sp = stat_prod(base, a, d, s, L)
            if sp > bs:
                bs, bl, bc = sp, L, c
    return bl, bc, bs

# Build species base-stat lookup from gamemaster
with open(r'C:\Users\Blanco\Desktop\Claude Operations\Phone Maintenance\pogo_extract\pvpoke_gamemaster.json','r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    gm = json.load(f)
base_by_dex = {}
for p in gm['pokemon']:
    dx = p.get('dex')
    bs = p.get('baseStats')
    if dx and bs and 'atk' in bs:
        # prefer the plain (non-form / first) entry per dex
        base_by_dex.setdefault(dx, bs)

def species_best_product(base, cap=1500, maxlvl=50):
    """Best stat product over all 4096 IVs (rank-1 reference)."""
    best = 0
    for a,d,s in itertools.product(range(16),range(16),range(16)):
        _,_,sp = best_for(base,a,d,s,cap,maxlvl)
        if sp > best: best = sp
    return best

# Test against scan ground truth: Huntail dex367 15/15/15
h = base_by_dex[367]
bl,bc,bsp = best_for(h,15,15,15)
ref = species_best_product(h)
print('Huntail 367 15/15/15: level=%s cp=%s prodIdx=%d  (scan: lvl42 cp1470 prod9347)'%(bl,bc,round(10000*bsp/ref)))

`pokegenie_work/wire_sprites.py`:

```py
"""Build PokeGenie thumbnails from the OFFICIAL PoGo sprites (form + shiny accurate)."""
import hashlib, json, os, shutil, sqlite3
ROOT = '../pogo_extract'
OUT = '../pokegenie_out'
idx = json.load(open('sprites/sprite_index.json'))
fe = json.load(open(ROOT + '/form_enum.json'))
con = sqlite3.connect(ROOT + '/pokemon.db'); con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
rows = con.execute('SELECT uid_hex,pokemon_id,species_name,form,fresh_shiny FROM pokemon WHERE in_bag=1').fetchall()

def iid(u):
    h = hashlib.sha1(('pgimg:' + u).encode()).hexdigest()
    a = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'; n = int(h[:24], 16); o = []
    for _ in range(14):
        n, r = divmod(n, 36); o.append(a[r])
    return ''.join(o)

td = os.path.join(OUT, 'scan_thumb'); os.makedirs(td, exist_ok=True)
mapping, src, miss, shiny_ok, shiny_tot = {}, {}, [], 0, 0
for r in rows:
    key = '%d|%s|%d' % (r['pokemon_id'], r['form'] or 0, 1 if r['fresh_shiny'] else 0)
    fn = idx.get(key)
    if r['fresh_shiny']: shiny_tot += 1
    if not fn:
        miss.append(r['species_name']); continue
    p = os.path.join('sprites', fn)
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        miss.append(r['species_name']); continue
    i = iid(r['uid_hex'])
    shutil.copyfile(p, os.path.join(td, i + '.jpg'))
    mapping[r['uid_hex']] = i
    src[r['uid_hex']] = fn
    if r['fresh_shiny'] and '.s.' in fn: shiny_ok += 1
json.dump(mapping, open(os.path.join(OUT, 'image_map.json'), 'w'))
json.dump(src, open(os.path.join(OUT, 'source_map.json'), 'w'), indent=0)
print('bag %d | with official sprite: %d (%.1f%%)' % (len(rows), len(mapping), len(mapping)/len(rows)*100))
print('shinies %d | with TRUE shiny art: %d' % (shiny_tot, shiny_ok))
print('no art: %d across %d species' % (len(miss), len(set(miss))))

`tools/README.md`:

```md
# tools

## `triple_check.py` — run before you say "done"

```bash
python tools/triple_check.py            # git state, compile/parse, self-tests, guards, secrets (ALL history), doc links, data store
python tools/triple_check.py --gate     # + the 11-audit gate (pull first)
python tools/triple_check.py --fresh    # everything on a fresh clone of origin/main + a data pull
```
Read-only (no Frida; the phone is only read). Ends with `ALL CLEAR` (exit 0) or `NOT DONE` (exit 1). CI runs it on every push.

## `pogo_data.py` — the phone data store

The game data never goes in git. It lives on the phone in `/data/local/tmp/pogo_data/`, one versioned tarball per group
(groups and their files: [`data_manifest.txt`](data_manifest.txt)). Full story: [`../docs/data.md`](../docs/data.md).

```bash
python tools/pogo_data.py status                   # phone version vs this checkout, per group
python tools/pogo_data.py pull                     # every non-cold group (only what changed)
python tools/pogo_data.py push --group inventory   # owner only; refused if the phone moved since your pull
python tools/pogo_data.py selftest                 # offline check (CI runs it)
```

Device: `$ADB_TARGET` (the cloud hook sets it; default `100.98.158.56:5555`). Standard library only.

```

`tools/pogo_data.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""pogo_data.py -- the PoGo DATA lives on the PHONE, not in git.

Why: cloud sessions start on a fresh VM, can push only their own git branch, and git LFS does not work there; the game
data (pokemon.db, snapshots, walk outputs, per-account sets, catcher studies, gym state) changes on every run, so git
would bloat by gigabytes. Every session that does phone work reaches the phone anyway, so the phone keeps the one copy:

    /data/local/tmp/pogo_data/<group>.tar.gz   one tarball per group (tools/data_manifest.txt: inventory, catcher, gym, *-cold)
    /data/local/tmp/pogo_data/<group>.json     {"version", "at", "by", "sha256", "bytes", "files"}

Each group has its OWN version, so the Inventory, AutoCatcher and Gym sessions never block each other.

  python tools/pogo_data.py status                 # every group: phone version vs what this checkout holds
  python tools/pogo_data.py pull                   # every non-cold group (or --group G, repeatable)
  python tools/pogo_data.py push --group G         # REFUSED if the phone's G moved since this checkout pulled it
  python tools/pogo_data.py selftest               # offline: manifest, tar round trip, sqlite copy, guards

Guards: a pull never overwrites a local file that is NEWER than the phone's copy (--force to take the phone's anyway);
a push never overwrites a newer phone version (pull first, or --force); nothing git tracks is ever packed, so a pull
cannot roll code back; SQLite files are packed through the backup API (WAL-safe) and their stale -wal/-shm are removed
on pull. Device: $ADB_TARGET (the cloud hook sets 127.0.0.1:5555; the PC default is the phone's Tailscale address).
"""
import argparse, glob, hashlib, json, os, socket, sqlite3, subprocess, sys, tarfile, tempfile, time

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
MANIFEST = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'data_manifest.txt')
HELD = os.path.join(ROOT, '.pogo_data_held.json')          # {group: version this checkout holds}
PHONE_DIR = '/data/local/tmp/pogo_data'
DEV = os.environ.get('ADB_TARGET', '100.98.158.56:5555')


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- manifest
def manifest(path=MANIFEST):
    """{group: [(pattern, newest_n or None, exclude?)]}. Lines: "[group]", "pattern", "pattern | newest N", "!pattern"."""
    groups, cur = {}, None
    for raw in open(path, encoding='utf-8'):
        line = raw.split('#', 1)[0].strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        if line.startswith('[') and line.endswith(']'):
            cur = line[1:-1].strip()
            groups.setdefault(cur, [])
            continue
        if cur is None:
            raise SystemExit('data_manifest.txt: pattern before any [group]: %r' % line)
        pat, _, opt = line.partition('|')
        pat = pat.strip().replace('\\', '/')
        n = int(opt.split()[-1]) if opt.strip().startswith('newest') else None
        groups[cur].append((pat.lstrip('!'), n, pat.startswith('!')))
    return groups


def tracked(root=ROOT):
    """Paths git tracks here (never packed: a pull must not roll code back). Empty outside a git checkout."""
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', root, 'ls-files', '-z'], capture_output=True, timeout=60).stdout
        return set(out.decode('utf-8', 'replace').split('\0')) - {''}
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        return set()


def files_for(group, groups, root=ROOT, skip=frozenset()):
    """Repo-relative paths (forward slashes) the group matches now, in manifest order, minus "!" excludes and `skip`."""
    out, drop = [], set()
    for pat, n, excl in groups.get(group, []):
        hits = [p for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(root, pat), recursive=True) if os.path.isfile(p)]
        if n:
            hits = sorted(hits, key=os.path.getmtime, reverse=True)[:n]
        rel = [os.path.relpath(p, root).replace(os.sep, '/') for p in hits]
        (drop.update if excl else out.extend)(rel)
    seen, uniq = set(), []
    for p in out:
        if p not in seen and p not in drop and p not in skip and not p.endswith(('-wal', '-shm', '-journal')):
            seen.add(p)
            uniq.append(p)
    return uniq


def _sqlite_copy(src, dst):
    a, b = sqlite3.connect('file:%s?mode=ro' % src.replace('\\', '/'), uri=True), sqlite3.connect(dst)
    try:
        a.backup(b)
    finally:
        b.close(); a.close()


def sha256_file(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b''):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def build_tar(paths, dst, root=ROOT):
    """Write a gzip tarball of the repo-relative paths to dst (streamed: the cold group is GBs); return (bytes, sha256).
    *.db goes through the SQLite backup API."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td, tarfile.open(dst, mode='w:gz', compresslevel=6) as tf:
        for rel in paths:
            src = os.path.join(root, rel)
            if rel.endswith('.db'):
                tmp = os.path.join(td, 'copy.db')
                if os.path.exists(tmp):
                    os.remove(tmp)
                _sqlite_copy(src, tmp)
                os.utime(tmp, (os.path.getmtime(src),) * 2)
                src = tmp
            tf.add(src, arcname=rel, recursive=False)
    return os.path.getsize(dst), sha256_file(dst)


def newer_here(tar_path, root=ROOT):
    """Members whose local copy is NEWER than the packed one and differs in size (a pull would lose local work)."""
    out = []
    with tarfile.open(tar_path, mode='r:gz') as tf:
        for m in tf.getmembers():
            p = os.path.join(root, m.name)
            if (m.isfile() and os.path.isfile(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 0 and os.path.getmtime(p) > m.mtime + 2
                    and os.path.getsize(p) != m.size):
                out.append(m.name)
    return out


def extract_tar(tar_path, root=ROOT, skip=frozenset()):
    """Extract into the checkout, except paths in `skip` (git-tracked files: a pull never rolls code back)."""
    with tarfile.open(tar_path, mode='r:gz') as tf:
        members = [m for m in tf.getmembers() if m.name not in skip]
        for m in members:
            if m.name.startswith('/') or '..' in m.name.split('/') or not (m.isfile() or m.isdir()):
                raise SystemExit('refusing tar member %r (outside the checkout or not a plain file)' % m.name)
        for m in members:
            if m.name.endswith('.db'):                       # a stale WAL replayed onto a replaced DB corrupts it
                for ext in ('-wal', '-shm', '-journal'):
                    p = os.path.join(root, m.name + ext)
                    if os.path.exists(p):
                        os.remove(p)
        if sys.version_info >= (3, 12):
            tf.extractall(root, members=members, filter='data')
        else:
            tf.extractall(root, members=members)
        return len(members)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- phone
def _xfer_timeout(nbytes):
    """adb push/pull deadline: the tailnet link has measured ~1 MB/s (2026-09-29; a 1.6 GB push died at a flat 900 s),
    so allow 200 KB/s with a 15-minute floor."""
    return max(900, nbytes / 200e3)


def adb(*args, timeout=900):
    r = subprocess.run(['adb', '-s', DEV] + list(args), capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit('adb %s failed (rc %d): %s' % (' '.join(args[:2]), r.returncode,
                                                         (r.stderr or r.stdout).decode('utf-8', 'replace').strip()[:300]))
    return r.stdout


def phone_meta():
    """{group: meta} for every <group>.json on the phone."""
    out = adb('shell', 'for f in %s/*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && { printf "%%s\\t" "$f"; tr -d "\\n" < "$f"; echo; }; done; true'
              % PHONE_DIR).decode('utf-8', 'replace')
    metas = {}
    for line in out.splitlines():
        path, _, body = line.partition('\t')
        if path.endswith('.json') and body.strip():
            try:
                metas[os.path.basename(path)[:-5]] = json.loads(body)
            except ValueError:
                raise SystemExit('unreadable meta on the phone: %s' % path)
    return metas


def phone_put(local_path, name):
    """adb push to a temp name, check its sha256 on the phone, then rename into place (readers never see half a file)."""
    adb('shell', 'mkdir -p %s' % PHONE_DIR)
    tmp = '%s/.%s.tmp' % (PHONE_DIR, name)
    adb('push', local_path, tmp, timeout=_xfer_timeout(os.path.getsize(local_path)))
    want = sha256_file(local_path)
    got = adb('shell', 'sha256sum %s' % tmp).decode().split()[0]
    if got != want:
        raise SystemExit('upload of %s corrupted (sha %s != %s) -- nothing replaced' % (name, got[:12], want[:12]))
    adb('shell', 'mv -f %s %s/%s' % (tmp, PHONE_DIR, name))


def _held():
    try:
        return json.load(open(HELD))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return {}


def _hold(group, version):
    h = _held()
    h[group] = version
    json.dump(h, open(HELD, 'w'), indent=1, sort_keys=True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- commands
def cmd_status(_a):
    metas, held = phone_meta(), _held()
    for g in sorted(set(manifest()) | set(metas)):
        m = metas.get(g) or {}
        print('%-15s phone v%-4s %7s  %-19s by %-12s | here v%s' % (
            g, m.get('version', '-'), '%.1fMB' % (m['bytes'] / 1e6) if m else '-', m.get('at', ''), m.get('by', ''),
            held.get(g, '-')))
    return 0


def cmd_pull(a):
    metas, skip = phone_meta(), tracked()
    groups = a.group or sorted(g for g in metas if not g.endswith('-cold'))
    if not groups:
        raise SystemExit('no data on the phone yet (%s) -- seed it from the PC: push --group <g> --force' % PHONE_DIR)
    rc = 0
    for g in groups:
        m = metas.get(g)
        if not m:
            print('%s: not on the phone -- skipped' % g)
            continue
        if _held().get(g) == m['version'] and not a.force:
            print('%s: already at v%s' % (g, m['version']))
            continue
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            dst = os.path.join(td, g + '.tar.gz')
            t0 = time.time()
            adb('pull', '%s/%s.tar.gz' % (PHONE_DIR, g), dst, timeout=_xfer_timeout(m['bytes']))
            if sha256_file(dst) != m['sha256']:
                raise SystemExit('%s: the download does not match its meta sha -- nothing extracted (a push in flight? retry)'
                                 % g)
            lose = [] if a.force else newer_here(dst)
            n = 0 if lose else extract_tar(dst, skip=skip)
            size = os.path.getsize(dst)
        if lose:
            print('%s: REFUSED -- %d local file(s) are newer than the phone copy v%s (a pull would lose them): %s%s\n'
                  '   push them first (push --group %s), or pull --force to take the phone copy.'
                  % (g, len(lose), m['version'], ', '.join(lose[:5]), ' ...' if len(lose) > 5 else '', g))
            rc = 3
            continue
        _hold(g, m['version'])
        print('%s: v%s, %d files, %.1f MB in %.0f s' % (g, m['version'], n, size / 1e6, time.time() - t0))
    return rc


def cmd_push(a):
    groups, metas, skip = manifest(), phone_meta(), tracked()
    for g in a.group:
        if g not in groups:
            raise SystemExit('no group %r in data_manifest.txt (have: %s)' % (g, ', '.join(sorted(groups))))
        m = metas.get(g) or {}
        if m and m.get('version') != _held().get(g) and not a.force:
            raise SystemExit('%s: REFUSED -- the phone holds v%s but this checkout holds v%s (another session pushed since).'
                             ' Pull it first, or --force if you are sure.' % (g, m.get('version'), _held().get(g)))
        paths = files_for(g, groups, skip=skip)
        if not paths:
            print('%s: no files match -- skipped' % g)
            continue
        t0 = time.time()
        ver = int(m.get('version') or 0) + 1
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            tp, mp = os.path.join(td, g + '.tar.gz'), os.path.join(td, g + '.json')
            size, sha = build_tar(paths, tp)
            meta = {'version': ver, 'at': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), 'sha256': sha, 'bytes': size,
                    'files': len(paths), 'by': os.environ.get('POGO_DATA_BY') or (
                        'cloud' if os.environ.get('CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE') == 'true' else socket.gethostname())}
            with open(mp, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(meta, f)
            phone_put(tp, g + '.tar.gz')                 # tarball first: a reader who sees the new meta finds its data
            phone_put(mp, g + '.json')
        _hold(g, ver)
        print('%s: v%d, %d files, %.1f MB pushed in %.0f s' % (g, ver, len(paths), size / 1e6, time.time() - t0))
    return 0


def cmd_selftest(_a):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(td, 'a', 'snaps'))
        for i in range(5):
            p = os.path.join(td, 'a', 'snaps', 's%d.gz' % i)
            open(p, 'wb').write(b'x' * (i + 1))
            os.utime(p, (1000 + i, 1000 + i))
        c = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(td, 'a', 'db.db'))
        c.execute('pragma journal_mode=wal'); c.execute('create table t(x)'); c.execute('insert into t values (7)')
        c.commit()                                           # left OPEN: the row sits in the WAL, not the main file
        open(os.path.join(td, 'a', 'code.py'), 'w').write('print(1)')
        open(os.path.join(td, 'a', 'secret.xml'), 'w').write('k')
        m = os.path.join(td, 'm.txt')
        open(m, 'w').write('[hot]\na/db.db\na/*.py\na/*.xml\n!a/secret.xml\na/snaps/*.gz | newest 2  # latest two\n'
                           '[hot-cold]\na/snaps/*.gz\n')
        g = manifest(m)
        hot = files_for('hot', g, td, skip={'a/code.py'})
        assert hot == ['a/db.db', 'a/snaps/s4.gz', 'a/snaps/s3.gz'], hot
        assert len(files_for('hot-cold', g, td)) == 5
        data = os.path.join(td, 'hot.tar.gz')
        build_tar(hot, data, td)
        c.close()
        out = os.path.join(td, 'out')
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(out, 'a'))
        open(os.path.join(out, 'a', 'db.db-wal'), 'wb').write(b'stale')
        assert extract_tar(data, out) == 3
        assert not os.path.exists(os.path.join(out, 'a', 'db.db-wal'))
        r = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(out, 'a', 'db.db'))
        assert r.execute('select x from t').fetchone() == (7,)
        r.close()
        p = os.path.join(out, 'a', 'snaps', 's4.gz')
        open(p, 'wb').write(b'local work, longer')           # newer AND different -> a pull must refuse
        assert newer_here(data, out) == ['a/snaps/s4.gz']
        open(p, 'wb').close()                                # 0 bytes (an accidental sqlite3.connect) never blocks
        assert newer_here(data, out) == []
        out2 = os.path.join(td, 'out2')
        os.makedirs(out2)
        assert extract_tar(data, out2, skip={'a/db.db'}) == 2 and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(out2, 'a', 'db.db'))
    print('pogo_data selftest: OK')
    return 0


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    sp = ap.add_subparsers(dest='cmd', required=True)
    sp.add_parser('status')
    p = sp.add_parser('pull')
    p.add_argument('--group', action='append', help='repeatable; default: every non-cold group on the phone')
    p.add_argument('--force', action='store_true', help='take the phone copy even over newer local files')
    p = sp.add_parser('push')
    p.add_argument('--group', action='append', required=True, help='repeatable: inventory, catcher, gym, inventory-cold')
    p.add_argument('--force', action='store_true', help='push although the phone moved since this checkout pulled')
    sp.add_parser('selftest')
    a = ap.parse_args()
    return {'status': cmd_status, 'pull': cmd_pull, 'push': cmd_push, 'selftest': cmd_selftest}[a.cmd](a)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tools/triple_check.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""triple_check.py -- ONE command that proves the repo, the code, the secrets, the docs and the phone data store are in
order. Run it before you tell Benny anything is "done".

Benny, 2026-09-29: "Once done, triple check everything. Same for future posterity."

  python tools/triple_check.py             # repo + code + secrets (all history) + docs + data store (if the phone answers)
  python tools/triple_check.py --gate      # ... + the 11-audit gate (needs `python tools/pogo_data.py pull` first)
  python tools/triple_check.py --fresh     # all of it on a FRESH clone of origin/main + a data pull = what GitHub really holds

Read-only. It never touches the game (no Frida); the phone is only read (`sha256sum`, `cat`) over adb.
Exit 0 = no FAIL (WARNs are listed and worth reading); exit 1 = at least one FAIL.
"""
import argparse, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, 'tools'))
import pogo_data  # noqa: E402  (the data-store helpers: manifest, files_for, tracked, phone_meta)

PY = sys.executable
SECRET = re.compile(rb'AIza[0-9A-Za-z_\-]{30,}|tskey-(?:auth|client|api)-[0-9A-Za-z]{8,}|gh[pousr]_[0-9A-Za-z]{30,}'
                    rb'|xox[baprs]-[0-9A-Za-z-]{10,}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}'
                    rb'|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{15,}\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{15,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}'
                    rb'|[A-Za-z0-9._%+\-]+@(?:gmail|bellsouth|yahoo|outlook|hotmail|icloud)\.[a-z]+')
SELFTESTS = [['tools/pogo_data.py', 'selftest'], ['pogo_extract/walk_tripwires.py', '--selftest'],
             ['pogo_extract/cull_report.py', '--selftest'], ['pogo_extract/independent_law.py'],
             ['pogo_extract/system/scripts/check_constant_drift.py'], ['pogo_extract/bag_art.py', '--selftest'],
             ['pogo_extract/system/scripts/refresh_gamemaster.py', '--selftest'],
             ['pogo_extract/game_opportunities.py', '--selftest'], ['AutoCatcher/tools/test_gym_stab.py']]
results = []


def say(level, area, msg):
    results.append(level)
    print('%-4s  %-9s %s' % (level, area, msg), flush=True)


def run(cmd, cwd=ROOT, timeout=900):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)


def out(cmd, cwd=ROOT):
    return run(cmd, cwd).stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace').strip()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- repo
def check_repo():
    fetched = run(['git', 'fetch', '-q', 'origin']).returncode == 0
    dirty = [l for l in out(['git', 'status', '--porcelain']).splitlines() if l.strip()]
    if dirty:
        say('FAIL', 'repo', '%d uncommitted change(s) -- commit or discard them first: %s'
            % (len(dirty), '; '.join(l.strip() for l in dirty[:5])))
    else:
        say('PASS', 'repo', 'working tree clean')
    head = out(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'])
    main = out(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'origin/main'])
    ahead = out(['git', 'rev-list', '--count', 'origin/main..HEAD']) or '?'
    behind = out(['git', 'rev-list', '--count', 'HEAD..origin/main']) or '?'
    if not fetched:
        say('WARN', 'repo', 'could not fetch origin -- ahead/behind are from the last fetch')
    if ahead == '0' and behind == '0':
        say('PASS', 'repo', 'HEAD %s == origin/main' % head)
    else:
        say('WARN', 'repo', 'HEAD %s vs origin/main %s: %s ahead, %s behind -- push/merge your branch, or pull'
            % (head, main, ahead, behind))
    extra = [b for b in out(['git', 'branch', '-r']).split() if b.startswith('origin/') and b not in ('origin/main', 'origin/HEAD')]
    if extra:
        say('WARN', 'repo', 'remote branches besides main (merged ones should be deleted): %s' % ', '.join(extra[:8]))
    if shutil.which('gh'):
        r = run(['gh', 'pr', 'list', '--state', 'open', '--json', 'number,title'])
        if r.returncode == 0:
            prs = r.stdout.decode().strip()
            if prs not in ('', '[]'):
                say('WARN', 'repo', 'open pull requests: %s' % prs[:300])
            else:
                say('PASS', 'repo', 'no open pull requests')


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- code
def check_code():
    files = [f for f in out(['git', 'ls-files', '*.py']).splitlines() if f]
    bad = []
    for f in files:
        try:
            compile(open(os.path.join(ROOT, f), 'rb').read(), f, 'exec')
        except (SyntaxError, ValueError) as e:
            bad.append('%s: %s' % (f, e))
    say('FAIL' if bad else 'PASS', 'code', '%d Python files compile%s' % (len(files), ('; broken: ' + '; '.join(bad[:3])) if bad else ''))
    bash = shutil.which('bash')
    if bash:
        sh = [f for f in out(['git', 'ls-files', '*.sh']).splitlines() if f]
        bad = [f for f in sh if run([bash, '-n', f]).returncode != 0]
        say('FAIL' if bad else 'PASS', 'code', '%d shell scripts parse%s' % (len(sh), ('; broken: ' + ', '.join(bad[:5])) if bad else ''))
    for t in SELFTESTS:
        r = run([PY] + t)
        say('PASS' if r.returncode == 0 else 'FAIL', 'code', '%s -> rc %d' % (' '.join(t), r.returncode))
    r = run([PY, 'full_audit.py', '--not-a-flag'], cwd=os.path.join(ROOT, 'pogo_extract'))
    say('PASS' if r.returncode == 2 else 'FAIL', 'guards', 'full_audit.py refuses an unknown flag (rc %d, want 2)' % r.returncode)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- secrets
def check_secrets():
    paths = {}
    for line in out(['git', 'rev-list', '--objects', '--all']).splitlines():
        sha, _, path = line.partition(' ')
        if path:
            paths.setdefault(sha, path)
    p = subprocess.run(['git', 'cat-file', '--batch'], cwd=ROOT, input=('\n'.join(paths) + '\n').encode(), capture_output=True)
    data, i, blobs, hits, biggest = p.stdout, 0, 0, [], (0, '')
    while i < len(data):
        nl = data.index(b'\n', i)
        hdr, i = data[i:nl].split(), nl + 1
        if len(hdr) != 3:
            continue
        size = int(hdr[2])
        body, i = data[i:i + size], i + size + 1
        if hdr[1] != b'blob':
            continue
        blobs += 1
        path = paths.get(hdr[0].decode(), '?')
        biggest = max(biggest, (size, path))
        m = SECRET.search(body)
        if m and not path.endswith(('.github/workflows/ci.yml', 'tools/triple_check.py')):
            hits.append('%s (%s...)' % (path, m.group(0)[:12].decode('ascii', 'replace')))
    say('FAIL' if hits else 'PASS', 'secrets', '%d blobs in ALL history, %d key/token/email hits%s'
        % (blobs, len(hits), (': ' + '; '.join(hits[:5])) if hits else ''))
    say('PASS' if biggest[0] < 20e6 else 'WARN', 'secrets', 'largest blob ever committed: %.2f MB (%s)' % (biggest[0] / 1e6, biggest[1]))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- docs
def check_docs():
    tracked = set(pogo_data.tracked(ROOT))
    dirs = set()
    for p in tracked:
        d = os.path.dirname(p)
        while d and d not in dirs:
            dirs.add(d)
            d = os.path.dirname(d)
    legacy = lambda p: p.startswith('pogo_extract/') and p not in ('pogo_extract/CLAUDE.md', 'pogo_extract/README.md') \
        and p.count('/') == 1
    broken, old, n = [], 0, 0
    for p in sorted(x for x in tracked if x.endswith('.md')):
        for m in re.finditer(r'\]\(([^)\s]+)\)', open(os.path.join(ROOT, p), encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()):
            t = m.group(1)
            if re.match(r'^(https?:|mailto:|#)', t):
                continue
            n += 1
            full = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(p), t.split('#')[0].replace('%20', ' '))).replace(os.sep, '/')
            if full not in tracked and full.rstrip('/') not in dirs:
                if legacy(p):
                    old += 1
                else:
                    broken.append('%s -> %s' % (p, t))
    say('FAIL' if broken else 'PASS', 'docs', '%d relative links, %d broken%s' % (n, len(broken), (': ' + '; '.join(broken[:5])) if broken else ''))
    if old:
        say('WARN', 'docs', '%d links in old pogo_extract research notes point at data kept out of git (expected)' % old)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- data store
def check_data():
    dev = pogo_data.DEV
    if not shutil.which('adb') or out(['adb', '-s', dev, 'get-state']) != 'device':
        say('WARN', 'data', 'phone not reachable at %s -- data store NOT checked' % dev)
        return
    metas, held, groups = pogo_data.phone_meta(), pogo_data._held(), pogo_data.manifest()
    sums = out(['adb', '-s', dev, 'shell', 'cd %s && sha256sum *.tar.gz 2>/dev/null; ls -a | grep -c "\\.tmp$"' % pogo_data.PHONE_DIR]).splitlines()
    have = {l.split()[1][:-7]: l.split()[0] for l in sums if l.endswith('.tar.gz')}
    tmp = sums[-1].strip() if sums else '0'
    if tmp not in ('0', ''):
        say('WARN', 'data', '%s half-uploaded .tmp file(s) on the phone (an interrupted push)' % tmp)
    skip = pogo_data.tracked(ROOT)
    for g in sorted(groups):
        m = metas.get(g)
        if not m and g.endswith('-cold'):
            # the cold archive stays on the PC by choice (Benny 2026-09-30: "maybe pc is ok"), not a gap to warn about
            say('PASS', 'data', '%-14s kept on the PC, not the phone (by choice)' % g)
            continue
        if not m:
            say('WARN', 'data', '%-14s not on the phone yet' % g)
            continue
        ok = have.get(g) == m['sha256']
        say('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL', 'data', '%-14s v%s (%s by %s) sha256 %s'
            % (g, m['version'], m['at'], m.get('by'), 'matches its meta' if ok else 'DOES NOT MATCH its meta'))
        if held.get(g) not in (None, m['version']):
            say('WARN', 'data', '%-14s this checkout holds v%s, the phone v%s -- pull before working' % (g, held.get(g), m['version']))
        t0 = time.mktime(time.strptime(m['at'], '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))
        newer = [f for f in pogo_data.files_for(g, groups, skip=skip) if os.path.getmtime(os.path.join(ROOT, f)) > t0 + 2]
        if newer and held.get(g) is not None:
            say('WARN', 'data', '%-14s %d local file(s) changed after the last push -- the owner should push: %s'
                % (g, len(newer), ', '.join(newer[:4])))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- gate
def check_gate():
    db = os.path.join(ROOT, 'pogo_extract', 'pokemon.db')
    if not os.path.exists(db) or os.path.getsize(db) < 1_000_000:
        say('FAIL', 'gate', 'no pokemon.db here -- run `python tools/pogo_data.py pull` first')
        return
    r = run([PY, 'full_audit.py', '--audits-only'], cwd=os.path.join(ROOT, 'pogo_extract'), timeout=1800)
    last = [l for l in r.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace').splitlines() if l.strip()][-1:] or ['(no output)']
    say('PASS' if r.returncode == 0 else 'FAIL', 'gate', '11 audits rc %d: %s' % (r.returncode, last[0][:110]))


def fresh():
    url = out(['git', 'remote', 'get-url', 'origin'])
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        clone = os.path.join(td, 'repo')
        if run(['git', 'clone', '-q', url, clone]).returncode != 0:
            print('FAIL  fresh     could not clone %s' % url)
            return 1
        print('fresh clone of origin/main at %s' % out(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], cwd=clone), flush=True)
        pull = run([PY, 'tools/pogo_data.py', 'pull'], cwd=clone, timeout=3600)
        print(pull.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace').strip(), flush=True)
        return subprocess.run([PY, 'tools/triple_check.py', '--gate'], cwd=clone).returncode


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument('--gate', action='store_true', help='also run the 11-audit gate (needs a data pull first)')
    ap.add_argument('--fresh', action='store_true', help='run everything on a fresh clone of origin/main + a data pull')
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.fresh:
        return fresh()
    check_repo(); check_code(); check_secrets(); check_docs(); check_data()
    if a.gate:
        check_gate()
    fails, warns = results.count('FAIL'), results.count('WARN')
    print('\n%s -- %d PASS, %d WARN, %d FAIL' % ('ALL CLEAR' if not fails else 'NOT DONE', results.count('PASS'), warns, fails))
    return 1 if fails else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
